title: A Temple In My Heart
lyrics:
A Temple In My Heart, A Prayer In My Soul,
A Song On My Lips, And I Sing To You
[Chorus:] Baba Sai Baba, Sathya Sai Baba,
Baba Sai Baba, I Sing To You
Sathya Sai Baba, Baba Sai Baba, Sathya Sai Baba, I Call To You
A Name On My Lips, And I Call To You
[Chorus:] Baba Sai Baba, Sathya Sai Baba ...
A Smile On My Lips And I Sing To You
[Chorus:] Baba Sai Baba, Sathya Sai Baba ...
devanagari:
अ टेम्पल इन माइ हार्ट अ प्रेर इन माइ सोल
अ सोङ आन माइ लिप्स अन्ड आइ सिङ टू यू
बाबा साई बाबा सत्य साई बाबा
बाबा साई बाबा आइ सिङ टू यू
सत्य साई बाबा बाबा साई बाबा सत्य साई बाबा आइ कोल टू यू
अ नेम आन माइ लिप्स अन्ड आइ कोल टू यू
बाबा साई बाबा सत्य साई बाबा
अ स्माइल आन माइ लिप्स अन्ड आइ सिङ टू यू
बाबा साई बाबा सत्य साई बाबा

title: Aao Aao Antaryami
lyrics:
Aao Aao Antaryami
Adi Narayana Sai Narayana [ Aao Aao ... ]
Hrudaya Vihari Hey Giridhari
Hey Giridhari Hey Giridhari
Hari Hari Sri Hari Sai Murari

title: Aao Aao Nandalala
lyrics:
Aao Aao Nandalala
Sundara Shyama Gopala
Sundara Sai Gopala
Tum Hi Ho Bansi Dhari Shyama
Ayodhya Pati Sita Rama
Parthi Baba Karuna Nidhan
Makhan Chora Yashoda Bala
meaning: Welcome O Krishna, the son of Nanda. One with beautiful form, and the holder of the divine flute. You are Lord Rama of Ayodhya, the Lord of Sita. You are Lord Sai of Parthi, the compassionate one. You are also the butter-stealing son of Mother Yashoda.
devanagari:
आओ आओ नंदलाला  
सुंदर श्याम गोपाला [ आओ आओ ... ]  
तुम ही हो बंसीधारी श्यामा  
अयोध्या पति सीता रामा 
पर्ति बाबा करुणा निधान  
माखन चोरा यशोदा बाला
respell:
Āo Āo Nandalālā
Sundara Shyām Gopālā [ Āo Āo ... ]
Tum Hī Ho Baṃsīdhārī Shyāmā
Ayodhyā Pati Sītā Rāmā
Parti Bābā Karuṇā Nidhān
Mākhan Chorā Yashodā Bālā

title: Aao Aao Sai Natha
lyrics:
Aao Aao Sai Natha
Aao Aao Hey Jagannatha [ Aao Aao ... ]
Darshan Ke Liye Taras Rahey Hain
Nayan Hamarey O Sai
Darsha Dikhao Daya Ke Sagar
Aao Shankara Hey Parameshwara
--
Aao Aao Sai Natha
Aao Aao Hey Jagannatha (2)
meaning: This bhajan is a fervent invocation, a heartfelt cry from the devotee's soul, imploring the Supreme Lord—addressed as Sai, Jagannath, and Shiva—to manifest His divine presence. It expresses an intense spiritual yearning for a glimpse of the divine form, recognizing the deity as an ocean of compassion whose sacred vision alone can quench the soul's deepest thirst.
devanagari:
आओ आओ साई नाथा
आओ आओ हे जगन्नाथा [ आओ आओ ... ]
दर्शन के लिए तरस रहे हैं
नयन हमारे ओ साई
दर्श दिखाओ दया के सागर
आओ शंकर हे परमेश्वर
--
आओ आओ साई नाथा
आओ आओ हे जगन्नाथा (2)
respell:
Āo Āo Sāī Nāthā
Āo Āo He Jagannāthā [ Āo Āo ... ]
Darshan Ke Lie Taras Rahe Haiṃ
Nayan Hamāre O Sāī
Darsha Dikhāo Dayā Ke Sāgar
Āo Shaṅkar He Parameshwar
--
Āo Āo Sāī Nāthā
Āo Āo He Jagannāthā (2)

title: Aao Aao Sai Pyare
lyrics:
Aao Aao Sai Pyare
Keertan Karoon Mein Sai Tumhare
Tum Ho Mere Nayanon Ke Tare
Darshan Do Jeevan Ke Sahare
meaning:
Welcome oh dear Sai
I sing your glory, oh Lord Supreme
You are the shining star of my eyes
Grant me your Darshan oh divine companion of my life
devanagari:
आओ आओ साई प्यारे  
कीर्तन करूँ मैं साई तुम्हारे 
[ आओ आओ ... ]  
तुम हो मेरे नयनों के तारे  
दर्शन दो जीवन के सहारे
respell:
Āo Āo Sāī Pyāre
Kīrtan Karūm̐ Maiṃ Sāī Tumhāre
[ Āo Āo ... ]
Tum Ho Mere Nayanoṃ Ke Tāre
Darshan Do Jīvan Ke Sahāre

title: Aao Prabhu Aao Sai Bhagawan
lyrics:
Aao Prabhu Aao Sai Bhagawan
Sathya Sai Bhagawan
Sathya Dharma Shanti Prema Pradata
Nitya Nirmala Jeevana Data
Jagadoddharana Sab Dukh Harana
Aao Narayana Bhakton Ke Pran
meaning:
Welcome oh Lord Sai
Our deal lord Sathya Sai
You are the grantor of truth, righteouness, peace and love
You grant a life that is pure and blemishless
You are the savior of this creation and the life breath of your devotees
Come oh dear Sai who is the very life of his devotees
devanagari:
आओ प्रभु आओ साई भगवान
सत्य साई भगवान
[ आओ प्रभु ... ]
सत्य धर्म शांति प्रेम प्रदाता
नित्य निर्मल जीवन दाता
जगदोधारण भक्त परायण
आओ (साई) नारायण भक्तों के प्राण
respell:
Āo Prabhu Āo Sāī Bhagavān
Satya Sāī Bhagavān
[ Āo Prabhu ... ]
Satya Dharma Shānti Prem Pradātā
Nitya Nirmala Jīvan Dātā
Jagadodhāraṇ Bhakta Parāyaṇ
Āo (sāī) Nārāyaṇ Bhaktoṃ Ke Prāṇ

title: Aao Pyare Nayan Hamare Sai Hamare Aao
lyrics:
Aao Pyare Nayan Hamare Sai Hamare Aao
Tum Bin Koi Nahi Rakhvale
Tum Bin Kaun Sahare Baba (3)
Aao Sai Pyare
--
Sai Hamare Aao (3)
meaning:
Welcome oh beloved  Lord Sai!
You are as precious as our eyes.
Who can we rely on to protect us other than you
Who can we rely on for support other than you o Baba
Welcome oh dear Sai
Please come oh loving Sai
devanagari:
आओ प्यारे नैना हमारे साई हमारे आओ  
तुम बिन कोई नहीं रखवाले  
तुम बिन कौन सहारे (बाबा)  
तुम बिन कौन सहारे आओ साई प्यारे  
साई हमारे आओ (3)
respell:
Āo Pyāre Nainā Hamāre Sāī Hamāre Āo
Tum Bin Koī Nahī Rakhavāle
Tum Bin Kaun Sahāre (bābā)
Tum Bin Kaun Sahāre Āo Sāī Pyāre
Sāī Hamāre Āo (3)

title: Aao Sai Gopal
lyrics:
Aao Sai Gopal
Aao Gopal Aao Gopal Aao Sai Gopal [ Aao Sai ... ]
Aao Hey Prabhu Parama Dayal
Aao Natavara Lal
Aao Shankara Aao Abhayankara Aao Shiva Shankara Sai
meaning: O Sai Gopal, supremely compassionate Lord, we earnestly call for your presence. Come, beloved Krishna, come, O Shankara, giver of fearlessness, Shiva Sai, and bless us with your divine grace.
devanagari:
आओ साई गोपाल  
आओ गोपाल आओ गोपाल आओ साई गोपाल [ आओ साई ... ]  
आओ हे प्रभु परम दयाल  
आओ नटवर लाल  
आओ शंकर आओ अभयंकरा आओ शिव शंकर साई
respell:
Āo Sāī Gopāl
Āo Gopāl Āo Gopāl Āo Sāī Gopāl [ Āo Sāī ... ]
Āo He Prabhu Param Dayāl
Āo Naṭavar Lāl
Āo Shaṅkar Āo Abhayaṅkarā Āo Shiv Shaṅkar Sāī

title: Aao Sai Narayana Darshan Deejo
lyrics:
Aao Sai Narayana Darshan Deejo
Tum Ho Jagat Vidhata (2)
Tum Hi Ho Brahma Tum Hi Ho Vishnu
Tum Hi Ho Shankara Roopa (2)
Aao Sai Narayana Darshan Deejo
Tum Ho Jagat Vidhata (2)
Tum Hi Ho Brahma Tum Hi Ho Vishnu
Tum Hi Ho Shankara Roopa (2)
Tum Hi Ho Rama Tum Hi Ho Krishna
Tum Ho Vishwa Vidhata (2)

-----

Come Sai Lord Incarnate Give Us Your Darshan
You Are The Lord Of Creation (2)
You Are That Rama You Are That Krishna
You Are Our Lord And Provider (2)
You Are Creator You Are Protector
You Are Destroyer Of Darkness (2)
meaning: Oh Sai Narayana, we earnestly call upon You to bestow Your divine vision upon us. You are the supreme architect of the cosmos, embodying Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva, and manifesting as Rama and Krishna. Truly, You are the sole creator and sustainer of all existence.
devanagari:
आओ साई नारायण दर्शन दीजो  
तुम हो जगत विधाता (2)  
तुम ही हो ब्रह्मा तुम ही हो विष्णु  
तुम ही हो शंकरा रूपा (2) 
आओ साई नारायण दर्शन दीजो  
तुम हो जगत विधाता (2) 
तुम ही हो ब्रह्मा तुम ही हो विष्णु  
तुम ही हो शंकरा रूपा (2) 
तुम ही हो राम तुम ही हो कृष्णा 
तुम हो विश्व विधाता (2)  

-----

Come Sai Lord Incarnate Give Us Your Darshan  
You Are The Lord Of Creation (2)  
You Are That Rama You Are That Krishna  
You Are Our Lord And Provider (2)  
You Are Creator You Are Protector  
You Are Destroyer Of Darkness (2)
respell:
Āo Sāī Nārāyaṇ Darshan Dījo
Tum Ho Jagat Vidhātā (2)
Tum Hī Ho Brahmā Tum Hī Ho Vishṇu
Tum Hī Ho Shaṅkarā Rūpā (2)
Āo Sāī Nārāyaṇ Darshan Dījo
Tum Ho Jagat Vidhātā (2)
Tum Hī Ho Brahmā Tum Hī Ho Vishṇu
Tum Hī Ho Shaṅkarā Rūpā (2)
Tum Hī Ho Rām Tum Hī Ho Kṛushṇā
Tum Ho Vishwa Vidhātā (2)

-----

Come Sai Lord Incarnate Give Us Your Darshan
You Are The Lord Of Creation (2)
You Are That Rama You Are That Krishna
You Are Our Lord And Provider (2)
You Are Creator You Are Protector
You Are Destroyer Of Darkness (2)

title: Adi Narayana Sai Narayana
lyrics:
Adi Narayana Sai Narayana
Jaya Hari Narayana Jaya Jaya
Pandhari Vasa Hari Narayana
Parthi Nivasa Sai Narayana
Varada Narayana Veda Narayana
Jaya Hari Narayana Jaya Jaya
meaning: Victory to Lord Sai Narayana, the Primordial One. You are the resident of Pandhari and the Lord of Parthi. Victory to Lord Narayana who confers boons, who is the source of the origin of the Vedas
devanagari:
आदि नारायण साई नारायण
जय हरि नारायणा जय जय [आदि नारायण ..]
पंढरी वासा हरि नारायण
पर्ति निवासा साई नारायण
वरद नारायण वेद नारायण [ जय हरि ... ]
respell:
Ādi Nārāyaṇ Sāī Nārāyaṇ
Jaya Hari Nārāyaṇā Jaya Jaya [ādi nārāyaṇ ..]
Paṇḍharī Vāsā Hari Nārāyaṇ
Parti Nivāsā Sāī Nārāyaṇ
Varad Nārāyaṇ Ved Nārāyaṇ [ Jaya Hari ... ]

title: Adi Parashakthi Ma Ananda Roopini
lyrics:
Adi Parashakthi Ma Ananda Roopini Ma
Parthi Nivasini Ma Jagadodharini Ma [Adi Parashakthi]
Teri Mahima Jo Koi Gave
Janam Janam Ka Dukh Bisrave
Premamayi Sai Ma Sathya Swaroopini Ma [ Parthi Nivasini Ma ... ]
meaning: O Mother Sai, you are the primal divine energy and the very form of joy, residing in Parthi as the world's redeemer. Whoever extols your greatness sheds the burdens of many births, for you are the loving Sai, the essence of truth itself.
devanagari:
आदि पराशक्ति मा आनन्द रूपिणी मा
पर्ती निवासिनी मा जगदोद्धारिणी मा [आदि पराशक्ति]
तेरी महिमा जो कोई गावे
जनम जनम का दुख बिसरावे
प्रेममयी साई मा सत्य स्वरूपिणी मा
respell:
Ādi Parāshakti Mā Ānanda Rūpiṇī Mā
Partī Nivāsinī Mā Jagadoddhāriṇī Mā [ādi Parāshakti]
Terī Mahimā Jo Koī Gāve
Janam Janam Kā Dukh Bisarāve
Premamayī Sāī Mā Satya Swarūpiṇī Mā

title: Adi Shesha Ananta Shayana
lyrics:
Adi Shesha Ananta Shayana Srinivasa Sri Venkatesha
Raghukula Tilaka Raghu Ramachandra
Sita Pathey Sri Ramachandra [ Adi Shesha ]
Yadu Kula Tilaka Yashoda Bala
Radha Pathey Gopala Krishna
Pannaga Bhooshana Gowri Manohara
Uma Pathey Shiva Shambho Shankara
meaning: Oh Lord Srinivasa Venkatesha, resting on the cosmic serpent Adi Shesha, we praise You, along with Sri Ramachandra, the jewel of the Raghu clan and husband of Sita, and Gopala Krishna, Yashoda's child and Radha's beloved. Our heartfelt salutations also go to Shiva Shambho Shankara, adorned with serpents and dear to Gauri and Uma.
devanagari:
आदि शेषा अनन्त शयना श्रीनिवासा श्री वेंकटेशा
रघुकुल तिलका रघु रामचन्द्रा
सीता पते श्री रामचन्द्रा [आदि शेषा]
यदु कुल तिलका यशोदा बाला
राधा पते गोपाल कृष्णा
पन्नग भूषण गौरी मनोहर
उमा पते शिव शम्भो शंकर
respell:
Ādi Sheshā Ananta Shayanā Shrīnivāsā Shrī Veṅkaṭeshā
Raghukul Tilakā Raghu Rāmachandrā
Sītā Pate Shrī Rāmachandrā [ādi Sheshā]
Yadu Kul Tilakā Yashodā Bālā
Rādhā Pate Gopāla Kṛushṇā
Pannaga Bhūshaṇ Gaurī Manohar
Umā Pate Shiv Shambho Shaṅkar

title: Ajanubahum Aravinda Netram
lyrics:
Ajanubahum Aravinda Netram
Atmabhi Ramam Manasa Smarami
Prabhu Sai Ramam Manasa Smarami
Bhooloka Vaikuntha Parthi Nivasam
Prabhu Sai Ramam Manasa Smarami
meaning: Meditate on the form of Lord Rama, whose abode is the Heart of devotees, whose arms extend upto His knees and whose eyes are like the blooming lotus. Meditate on Lord Sai Rama, the Dweller of Parthi, which is verily the Heaven on Earth.
devanagari:
अजानुबाहुम् अरविन्द नेत्रम्
आत्माभि रामम् मनसा स्मरामि
प्रभु साई रामम् मनसा स्मरामि
भूलोक वैकुण्ठ पर्ती निवासम्
प्रभु साई रामम् मनसा स्मरामि
respell:
Ajānubāhum Aravinda Netram
Ātmābhi Rāmam Manasā Smarāmi
Prabhu Sāī Rāmam Manasā Smarāmi
Bhūlok Vaikuṇṭha Partī Nivāsam
Prabhu Sāī Rāmam Manasā Smarāmi

title: Akhanda Jyoti Jalao Sai Man Mandir Mein
lyrics:
Akhanda Jyoti Jalao Sai Man Mandir Mein
Akhanda Jyoti Jalao
Koti Surya Sama Teja Swaroopa
Sai Tum Ho Divya Swaroopa
Akhanda Jyoti Jalao
Divya jyoti Jnana Jyoti Prema Jyoti Jalao
Akhanda Jyoti Jalao
meaning: O Lord Sai! Illumine the temple of my mind so that the flame of knowledge may glow continuously. O Sai, the one with the effulgence of ten million suns, kindle the infinite flame of divinity, wisdom and Divine Love in my mind.
devanagari:
अखण्ड ज्योति जलाओ साई मन मंदिर में  
अखण्ड ज्योति जलाओ  
कोटि सूर्य सम तेज स्वरूपा  
साई तुम हो दिव्य स्वरूपा  
अखण्ड ज्योति जलाओ (2)  
दिव्य ज्योति ज्ञान ज्योति प्रेम ज्योति जलाओ  
अखण्ड ज्योति जलाओ
respell:
Akhaṇḍa Jyoti Jalāo Sāī Man Mandir Meṃ
Akhaṇḍa Jyoti Jalāo
Koṭi Sūrya Sam Teja Swarūpā
Sāī Tum Ho Divya Swarūpā
Akhaṇḍa Jyoti Jalāo (2)
Divya Jyoti Jñāna Jyoti Prem Jyoti Jalāo
Akhaṇḍa Jyoti Jalāo

title: Akhila Jagat Ke Data Sai
lyrics:
Akhila Jagat Ke Data Sai
Shirdi Nivasi Bhagawan
Darshan Do Bhagawan Sai
Darshan Do Bhagawan
Kalimala Bhanjana Parama Dayaghana
Karunanidhe Shirdivasa
Karunanidhe Parthivasa
Deenajanavana Parthi Mahesha
Shirdi Nivasi Bhagawan
Darshan Do Bhagawan Sai
meaning:
O Lord Sai! You are the Supreme Lord of all beings in all universes. You alone are the provider of everyone.
O Lord! You are the same one who graced the land of Shirdi with Your physical presence.
O Beloved Lord Sai! Please grant us the bliss of Your darshan.
Bless us with the vision of Your form please.
O Lord! You are the Supremely Compassionate One who incarnated in this age of Kali to redeem us.
Our salutations to You, O The Infinite Source of Compassion, the One who made Shirdi His abode.
Our salutations to You, O the Storehouse of Compassion, You are the One who made Puttaparthi too Your abode.
O Supreme Lord of Puttaparthi, You are the refuge of the weak and destitute who is ever engaged in alleviating their suffering.
O Lord! You are the One who presided over the holy land of Shirdi.
O Lord Sai! Grant us the boon of witnessing Your form,  Bless us with the vision so that we can see You.
devanagari:
अखिल जगत के दाता साई
शिर्डी निवासी भगवान
दर्शन दो भगवान (साई)
कालिमल भंजन परम दयाघन
करुणा निधे शिर्डी वसा (पर्ती वसा)
दीन जनावना पर्ती महेशा
शिर्डी निवासी भगवान [ दर्शन दो ... ]
respell:
Akhil Jagat Ke Dātā Sāī
Shirḍī Nivāsī Bhagavān
Darshan Do Bhagavān (sāī)
Kālimala Bhañjana Param Dayāghan
Karuṇā Nidhe Shirḍī Vasā (partī Vasā)
Dīna Janāvanā Partī Maheshā
Shirḍī Nivāsī Bhagavān [ Darshan Do ... ]

title: Alakh Niranjana Bhava Bhaya Bhanjana Narayan Narayan
lyrics:
Alakh Niranjana Bhava Bhaya Bhanjana Narayan Narayan
Narayan Narayan Narayan Sriman Narayan
meaning:
The Imperceivable, Immaculate One
Remover of the fears of worldly existence, Narayana
O Narayana, Supreme Lord Narayana.
devanagari:
अलख निरंजन भव भय भंजन नारायण नारायण
नारायण नारायण नारायण श्रीमन नारायण
respell:
Alakh Nirañjana Bhava Bhaya Bhañjana Nārāyaṇ Nārāyaṇ
Nārāyaṇ Nārāyaṇ Nārāyaṇ Shrīman Nārāyaṇ

title: Allah Allah Karo Pukar
lyrics:
Allah Allah Karo Pukar
Sathya Sai Ki Jai Jai Kar
Yeshu Pita Ki Jai Jai Kar
Mahavir Ki Jai Jai Kar
Zoroastra Ki Jai Jai Kar
Sarva Dharma Ki Jai Jai Kar
meaning: Victory to Allah, Yesu, Mahavir, Zoroaster and Sathya Sai who is the embodiment of all religions.
devanagari:
अल्लाह अल्लाह करो पुकार  
सत्य साईं की जय जय कार  
येसु पिता की जय जय कार  
महावीर की जय जय कार  
जोराष्ट्र की जय जय कार  
सर्व धर्म की जय जय कार
respell:
Allāh Allāh Karo Pukār
Satya Sāīṃ Kī Jay Jay Kār
Yesu Pitā Kī Jay Jay Kār
Mahāvīr Kī Jay Jay Kār
Jorāshṭra Kī Jay Jay Kār
Sarwa Dharma Kī Jay Jay Kār

title: Allah Allah Sai Baba
lyrics:
Allah Allah Sai Baba
Yeshu Masiha Sai Baba
Nanak Sri Buddha Sai Baba
Zoroastra Mahavir Sai Baba
meaning: Chant the name of Sai Baba who is Allah, Zohrasthra, Nanak,Yesu and Mahavir (all names, all forms)
devanagari:
अल्ला अल्ला साई बाबा
येशु मसीहा साई बाबा
नानक श्री बुद्ध साई बाबा
ज़ोहराष्ट्र महावीर साई बाबा
respell:
Allā Allā Sāī Bābā
Yeshu Masīhā Sāī Bābā
Nānak Shrī Buddha Sāī Bābā
ज़oharāshṭra Mahāvīr Sāī Bābā

title: Allah Bhajo Maula Bhajo Hey Allah Sai Bhagawan
lyrics:
Allah Bhajo Maula Bhajo Hey Allah Sai Bhagawan
Ram Bhajo Sai Krishna Bhajo Hey Rama Krishna Bhagawan
Nanak Bhajo Gautam Bhajo Hey Buddha Sai Bhagawan
Yeshu Bhajo Zoroastra Bhajo Hey Mahavir Bhagawan
Sai Bhajo Shirdi Sai Bhajo Hey Shirdi Sai Bhagawan
Sathya Bhajo Sathya Sai Bhajo Hey Sathya Sai Bhagawan
meaning: Chant the divine names of God - Allah, Maula, Rama, Krishna, Nanak, Buddha, Zoroaster, Mahavira, Shirdi Sai and Sathya Sai.Chant the divine names of God - Allah, Maula, Rama, Krishna, Nanak, Buddha, Zoroaster, Mahavira, Shirdi Sai and Sathya Sai.
devanagari:
अल्लाह भजो मौलाह भजो हे अल्लाह साई भगवान
राम भजो हे कृष्ण भजो हे राम कृष्ण भगवान
नानक भजो गौतम भजो हे बुद्ध साई भगवान
येसु भजो जोहराष्ट्र भजो हे महावीर भगवान
साई भजो शिर्डी साई भजो हे शिर्डी साई भगवान
सत्य भजो सत्य साई भजो हे सत्य साई भगवान
respell:
Allāh Bhajo Maulāh Bhajo He Allāh Sāī Bhagavān
Rām Bhajo He Kṛushṇa Bhajo He Rām Kṛushṇa Bhagavān
Nānak Bhajo Gautam Bhajo He Buddha Sāī Bhagavān
Yesu Bhajo Joharāshṭra Bhajo He Mahāvīr Bhagavān
Sāī Bhajo Shirḍī Sāī Bhajo He Shirḍī Sāī Bhagavān
Satya Bhajo Satya Sāī Bhajo He Satya Sāī Bhagavān

title: Allah Eshwar Ek Hi Nam
lyrics:
Allah Eshwar Ek Hi Nam
Bhajare Manuva Baba Nam
Allah Bolo Eshwar Bolo Bolo Sai Ram
Nanak Bolo Yeshu Bolo Bolo Sai Ram
Gautama Buddha Mahavir Bolo Bolo Sai Ram
Bolo Sairam Bolo Bolo Sai Ram
meaning:
The divine names of Allah and Eshwar point to only one Divinity. 
O mind! Chant the Divine name of Baba (Fatherhood of God).
Chant the holy names Allah, Eshwar, Nanak, Jesus, Gauthama Buddha, Mahavir, Sairam.
devanagari:
अल्लाह ईश्वर एक ही नाम  
भजरे मनुवा मोहम्मद (बाबा) नाम [ अल्लाह ईश्वर ... ]  
अल्लाह बोलो ईश्वर बोलो बोलो साईं राम  
नानक बोलो येशु बोलो बोलो साईं राम  
गौतम बुद्ध महावीर बोलो बोलो साईं राम  
बोलो साईं राम बोलो बोलो साईं राम
respell:
Allāh Īshwar Ek Hī Nām
Bhajare Manuvā Mohammad (bābā) Nām [ Allāh Īshwar ... ]
Allāh Bolo Īshwar Bolo Bolo Sāīṃ Rām
Nānak Bolo Yeshu Bolo Bolo Sāīṃ Rām
Gautama Buddha Mahāvīr Bolo Bolo Sāīṃ Rām
Bolo Sāīṃ Rām Bolo Bolo Sāīṃ Rām

title: Allah Eshwar Tum Ho
lyrics:
Allah Eshwar Tum Ho
Yeshu Buddha Prabhu Tum Ho
Zoroastra Mahavir Tum Ho
Sai Rama Ho Sai Krishna Ho
Sarva Dharma Prabhu Tum Ho
Sri Sathya Sai Prabhu Tum Ho
meaning:
O Lord Sai! You are Allah, Eshwar, Jesus , Buddha, Zohrashtra, Mahavira, Rama and Krishna.
You are the Lord Sri Sathya Sai who is the Lord of all religions.
devanagari:
अल्लाह ईश्वर तुम हो
येशु बुद्ध प्रभु तुम हो
ज़ोहराष्ट्र महावीर तुम हो
साई राम हो साई कृष्ण हो
सर्व धर्म प्रभु तुम हो
श्री सत्य साई प्रभु तुम हो
respell:
Allāh Īshwar Tum Ho
Yeshu Buddha Prabhu Tum Ho
ज़oharāshṭra Mahāvīr Tum Ho
Sāī Rām Ho Sāī Kṛushṇa Ho
Sarwa Dharma Prabhu Tum Ho
Shrī Satya Sāī Prabhu Tum Ho

title: Allah Ho Akbar Allah Ho Akbar Allah Ho Akbar
lyrics:
Allah Ho Akbar Allah Ho Akbar Allah Ho Akbar
Yeshu Pita Prabhu Allah Ho Akbar Shirdi Sai Parthi Sai Tum Ho
Guru Nanak Bhi Tum Ho
Zoroastra Mahavir Tum Ho
Yeshu Pita Prabhu Tum Ho
Allah Ho Akbar Tum Ho
Sai Allah Ho Akbar Tum Ho
meaning: Allah is supreme, Allah is Supreme and as he is also Yesu, Shirdi Sai, Parthi Sai, Guru Nanak, Zohrashtra and Mahavir chant their glorious names.
devanagari:
अल्लाह हो अकबर, अल्लाह हो अकबर, अल्लाह हो अकबर  
येसु पिता प्रभु अल्लाह हो अकबर, शिर्डी साई पर्ति साई तुम हो  
गुरु नानक भी तुम हो  
जोराष्ट्र महावीर तुम हो  
येसु पिता प्रभु तुम हो  
अल्लाह हो अकबर तुम हो ( साई )  
ला इलाहा इल अल्लाह, मोहम्मदुर रसूल अल्लाह
respell:
Allāh Ho Akabar, Allāh Ho Akabar, Allāh Ho Akabar
Yesu Pitā Prabhu Allāh Ho Akabar, Shirḍī Sāī Parti Sāī Tum Ho
Guru Nānak Bhī Tum Ho
Jorāshṭra Mahāvīr Tum Ho
Yesu Pitā Prabhu Tum Ho
Allāh Ho Akabar Tum Ho ( Sāī )
Lā Ilāhā Il Allāh, Mohammadur Rasūl Allāh

title: Allah Ho Tum Eshwar Bhi Tum Mahavir Nanak Ram
lyrics:
Allah Ho Tum Eshwar Bhi Tum Mahavir Nanak Ram
Partheesha Sai Shankara Tum Hi Ho Mere Pran
Zoroastra Yeshu Buddha Tum Ho Sab Ke Palanhar
Sachidananda Sai Tera Brindavan Shubh Dham
meaning:
O Sai who resides in the sacred abode of Brindavan, You are Allah, Eshwara, Mahavir, Nanak, Ram.
O Sai Shankara of Parthi, you are our very life indeed.
You are our protector and the embodiment of this existance, knowledge and bliss.
devanagari:
अल्लाह हो तुम ईश्वर भी तुम महावीर नानक राम  
पर्तीश साई शंकरा तुम ही हो मेरे प्राण [ अल्लाह हो ... ]  
जोराष्ट्र येसु बुद्ध तुम हो सब के पालनहार  
सच्चिदानंद साई तेरा ब्रिंदावन शुभ धाम
respell:
Allāh Ho Tum Īshwar Bhī Tum Mahāvīr Nānak Rām
Partīsha Sāī Shaṅkarā Tum Hī Ho Mere Prāṇ [ Allāh Ho ... ]
Jorāshṭra Yesu Buddha Tum Ho Sab Ke Pālanahār
Sachchidānanda Sāī Terā Brindāvan Shubh Dhām

title: Allah Nam Bhajo Bhajore Bhajo Maula Nam Bhajo Bhajore Bhajo
lyrics:
Allah Nam Bhajo Bhajore Bhajo Maula Nam Bhajo Bhajore Bhajo
Nanak Yeshu Mahavir Nam Bhajo
Sri Buddha Deva Bhajo Bhajore Bhajo Sri Sai Baba Bhajo Bhajore Bhajo
Sri Raghu Rama Bhajo Govinda Krishna Bhajo
Sri Sathya Sai Bhajo Bhajore Bhajo
meaning: Chant the divine name of Allah, Maulah, Nanak, Yesu, Mahavir, Buddha, Sai Baba, Rama, Govinda, Krishna and Sri Sathya Sai Baba.
devanagari:
अल्लाह नाम भजो भजोरें भजो मौलाह नाम भजो भजोरें भजो
नानक येसु महावीर नाम भजो
श्री बुद्ध देवा भजो भजोरें भजो श्री साई बाबा भजो भजोरें भजो
श्री रघु राम भजो गोविन्द कृष्ण भजो
श्री सत्य साई भजो भजोरें भजो
respell:
Allāh Nām Bhajo Bhajoreṃ Bhajo Maulāh Nām Bhajo Bhajoreṃ Bhajo
Nānak Yesu Mahāvīr Nām Bhajo
Shrī Buddha Devā Bhajo Bhajoreṃ Bhajo Shrī Sāī Bābā Bhajo Bhajoreṃ Bhajo
Shrī Raghu Rām Bhajo Govinda Kṛushṇa Bhajo
Shrī Satya Sāī Bhajo Bhajoreṃ Bhajo

title: Allah Sai Bolo Maula Sai Bolo
lyrics:
Allah Sai Bolo Maula Sai Bolo
Prem Se Bolo Jo Bhi Nam Bolo
Zoroastra Mahavir Buddha Nam Bolo
Sathya Dharma Shanti Prema Roopa Sai Bolo
meaning:
Chant the name of Lord Sai who is Allah himself.
Chant any name with Love.
Chant  the name of Lord Zoroastra, Mahavira and Buddha. Chant the name of  Lord Sathya Sai who personifies Truth, Righteouness, Peace and Love.

title: Allah Sai Maula Sai
lyrics:
Allah Sai Maula Sai
Sadguru Sai Antaryami
Nanak Sai Prema Sai
Yeshu Sai Karuna Sagara
Sarva Dharma Priya Sathya Sai
meaning:
O Lord Sai, you are Allah, the all prevading Divine Teacher.
You are Guru Nanak, Prema Sai. You are Jesus the loving and compassionate one. You are revered lovingly by all faiths.
devanagari:
अल्लाह साई मौलाह साई
सद्गुरु साई अंतयार्मी
नानक साई प्रेम साई
येसु साई करुणा सागर
सर्व धर्म प्रिय सत्य साई
respell:
Allāh Sāī Maulāh Sāī
Sadguru Sāī Antayārmī
Nānak Sāī Prem Sāī
Yesu Sāī Karuṇā Sāgar
Sarwa Dharma Priy Satya Sāī

title: Allah Tum Ho Eshwar Tum Ho
lyrics:
Allah Tum Ho Eshwar Tum Ho
Tum Hi Ho Ram Rahim
Yeshu Tum Ho Nanak Tum Ho
Zoroastra Bhi Ho Mahavir Tum Ho
Gautama Buddha Karim
Mere Ram Mere Ram Ram Rahim
meaning: O Lord you are Allah, Eshwara, Rama, Rahim, Jesus , Guru Nanak, Zohrashtra, Mahavira, Gautama Buddha.
devanagari:
अल्लाह तुम हो ईश्वर तुम हो  
तुम ही हो राम रहीम  
मेरे राम मेरे राम राम रहीम  
येसु तुम हो नानक तुम हो  
जोरास्ट्र भी हो महावीर तुम हो  
गौतम बुद्ध करीम [ मेरे राम ... ]
respell:
Allāh Tum Ho Īshwar Tum Ho
Tum Hī Ho Rām Rahīm
Mere Rām Mere Rām Rām Rahīm
Yesu Tum Ho Nānak Tum Ho
Jorāsṭra Bhī Ho Mahāvīr Tum Ho
Gautama Buddha Karīm [ Mere Rām ... ]

title: Amba Bhavani Shiva Shambu Kumara
lyrics:
Amba Bhavani Shiva Shambu Kumara
Sri Gananatha Shantakara
Purana Purusha Sathya Sai Natha
Pranava Swaroopa Partheesha
meaning: Beloved Son of Shiva and Parvati, O Lord Ganesha you are the giver of peace, O Lord Sathya Sai, you are the Supreme Being. You are the form of OM, Lord of Puttaparthi
devanagari:
अम्बा भवानी शिव शम्भु कुमारा
श्री गणनाथा शान्तकारा
पुराण पुरुष सत्य साईं नाथा
प्रणव स्वरूपा पर्तीशा
respell:
Ambā Bhavānī Shiv Shambhu Kumārā
Shrī Gaṇanāthā Shāntakārā
Purāṇ Purush Satya Sāīṃ Nāthā
Praṇava Swarūpā Partīshā

title: Amba Bhavani Tribhuvana Mohini
lyrics:
Amba Bhavani Tribhuvana Mohini
Ananda Roopini Jagat Janani
Sadananda Roopini Sai Janani
Adi Parashakti Abhaya Pradayini
Bhairavi Shankari Bhava Bhaya Harini
Durga Chandi Durita Nivarini
Mata Maheshwari Gauri Shivani
meaning: Oh Divine Mother you are the most pleasing form in all three worlds, you bestow eternal happiness. You are Shakthi who is the divine consort of lord Shankara, who grants protection to her devotees and vanquishes difficulties.You are our mother divine, oh Gowri.
devanagari:
अम्बा भवानी त्रिभुवन मोहिनी  
आनंद रूपिणी जगत जननी  
सदानंद रूपिणी साई जननी  
आदि पराशक्ति अभय प्रदायिनी  
भैरवी शंकारी भव भय हारिणी  
दुर्गा चंडी दुर्गत निवारिणी  
माता महेश्वरी गौरी शिवानी
respell:
Ambā Bhavānī Tribhuvan Mohinī
Ānanda Rūpiṇī Jagat Jananī
Sadānanda Rūpiṇī Sāī Jananī
Ādi Parāshakti Abhaya Pradāyinī
Bhairavī Shaṅkārī Bhava Bhaya Hāriṇī
Durgā Chaṇḍī Durgat Nivāriṇī
Mātā Maheshwarī Gaurī Shivānī

title: Amba Mandahasa Vadani Manohari Sai Jagat Janani
lyrics:
Amba Mandahasa Vadani Manohari Sai Jagat Janani
Mata Mata Mata Jagat Janani
Jagat Janani Shubhakarini
Sai Jaganmata
Sathya Sai Jaganmata
meaning: I worship the ever so pleasant and auspicious Mother of the Universe, Mother Sai who has an enchanting face with a charming smile.
devanagari:
अम्बा मन्द हास वदनी मनोहरी साई जगत जननी
माता माता माता जगत जननी [ अम्बा मन्दा ... ]
जगत जननी शुभ करिणी
साई जगन्माता
सत्य साई जगन्माता
respell:
Ambā Manda Hās Vadanī Manoharī Sāī Jagat Jananī
Mātā Mātā Mātā Jagat Jananī [ Ambā Mandā ... ]
Jagat Jananī Shubh Kariṇī
Sāī Jaganmātā
Satya Sāī Jaganmātā

title: Amba Parameshwari Akhilandeshwari
lyrics:
Amba Parameshwari Akhilandeshwari
Adi Parashakti Palayamam
Sri Bhuvaneshwari Raja Rajeshwari
Ananda Roopini Palayamam
Sadananda Roopini Palayamam
meaning: O Mother, the consort of Lord Parameshwara, Divine Mother of the entire Universe, the all-pervasive and eternal One, the Supreme Goddess of the world, the bliss-personified, we pray to You to protect us.
devanagari:
अम्बा परमेश्वरी अखिलांडेश्वरी
आदि पाराशक्ति पालय माम
श्री भुवनेश्वरी राज राजेश्वरी
आनंद रूपिणी पालय माम
respell:
Ambā Parameshwarī Akhilāṇḍeshwarī
Ādi Pārāshakti Pālay Mām
Shrī Bhuvaneshwarī Rāj Rājeshwarī
Ānanda Rūpiṇī Pālay Mām

title: Amba Shankari Parameshwari Shashi Shekhari Amba
lyrics:
Amba Shankari Parameshwari Shashi Shekhari Amba
Sarveshwari Jagadeeshwari Maheshwari Amba
Amba Sundari Guna Manjari Shiva Shankari Amba
Kadambari Shwetambari Hari Sodari Amba
meaning: Glory to Mother who is the consort of Lord Shiva. You are the Goddess who is the protector of the Universe, You are the Goddess who is most beautiful endowed with good qualities in abundance. You are the sibling of Lord Hari. We offer our salutations to You O Mother.
devanagari:
अम्बा शंकारी परमेश्वरी शशि शेखरी अम्बा  
सर्वेश्वरी जगदीश्वरी महेश्वरी अम्बा  
सुंदरी गुण मंजरी शिव शंकारी अम्बा  
कादंबरी श्वेताम्बरी हरि सोदरी अम्बा
respell:
Ambā Shaṅkārī Parameshwarī Shashi Shekharī Ambā
Sarweshwarī Jagadīshwarī Maheshwarī Ambā
Sundarī Guṇ Mañjarī Shiv Shaṅkārī Ambā
Kādambarī Shwetāmbarī Hari Sodarī Ambā

title: Amba Vandanam Eshwaramba Vandanam
lyrics:
Amba Vandanam Eshwaramba Vandanam
Janani Vandanam Jagat Janani Vandanam (2)
Sai Vandanam Sai Mata Vandanam
Mata Vandanam Eshwaramba Nandanam
meaning: Oh Divine Mother Amba, we offer our heartfelt salutations to you, and to Eshwaramba, your blessed earthly mother. We bow to you, Mother of the Universe, and to you, Mother Sai, the cherished child of Eshwaramba.
devanagari:
अम्बा वन्दनम् ईश्वराम्बा वन्दनम्  
जननी वन्दनम् जग जननी वन्दनम् (२)  
साई वन्दनम् साई माता वन्दनम्  
माता वन्दनम् ईश्वराम्बा नन्दनम्
respell:
Ambā Vandanam Īshwarāmbā Vandanam
Jananī Vandanam Jag Jananī Vandanam (2)
Sāī Vandanam Sāī Mātā Vandanam
Mātā Vandanam Īshwarāmbā Nandanam

title: Ambe Gowri Ma
lyrics:
Ambe Gowri Ma Jagadambe Gowri Ma
Ambe Jagadambe Jaya Ambe Gowri Ma
Mahalakshmi Mata Meri Ambe Gowri Ma
Daya Nidhey Dukha Harnevali Ambe Gowri Ma
Bholi Bhaali Mata Meri Ambe Gowri Ma [ Ambe Jagadambe ... ]

title: Ambe Janani Abhirami
lyrics:
Ambe Janani Abhirami
Abhaya Pradayini Shivakami [ Ambe Janani ]
Sambhavi Shankari Sarveshwari
Shantha Swaroopini Shivaranjani
Sathya Swaroopini Sai Mata
Shashwata Ananda Dayini Mata

title: Ambika Tanaya Gajanana
lyrics:
Ambika Tanaya Gajanana
Gajavadana Gananatha Gajanana
Pahi Ganesha Vinayaka
Tribhuvana Palaka Mangala Dayaka
Vidya Buddhi Siddhi Pradayaka
Pahi Ganesha Vinayaka
meaning: O loving son of Mother Parvati, the Elephant-headed Lord Ganesha, kindly protect us. You are the sustainer of the three worlds, the one who confers auspiciousness, knowledge, wisdom and success.
devanagari:
अम्बिक तनया गजानना  
गजवदना गणनाथ गजानना  
पाहि गणेशा विनायक  
त्रिभुवन पालक मङ्गल दायक  
विद्या बुद्धि सिद्धि प्रदायक  
पाहि गणेशा विनायक (2)
respell:
Ambika Tanayā Gajānanā
Gajavadanā Gaṇanātha Gajānanā
Pāhi Gaṇeshā Vināyaka
Tribhuvana Pālaka Maṅgala Dāyaka
Vidyā Buddhi Siddhi Pradāyaka
Pāhi Gaṇeshā Vināyaka (2)

title: Anand Se Bolo Jai Baba Jai Prem Se Bolo Jai Baba Jai
lyrics:
Anand Se Bolo Jai Baba Jai Prem Se Bolo Jai Baba Jai
Jai Jai Jai Amba Ki Jai
Jai Jai Jai Mahalakshmi Ki Jai
Jai Jai Jai Shirdi Ki Jai
Jai Jai Jai Sathya Sai Ki Jai
meaning: Chant "Victory to the lord" blissfully and with love. Sing the glory of mother Amba, Mahalakshmi, Shirdi Sai and Sathya Sai.
devanagari:
आनंद से बोलो जय बाबा जय प्रेम से बोलो जय बाबा जय
जय जय जय अम्बा की जय
जय जय जय महालक्ष्मी की जय
जय जय जय शिरडी की जय
जय जय जय सत्य साई की जय
respell:
Ānand Se Bolo Jay Bābā Jay Prem Se Bolo Jay Bābā Jay
Jay Jay Jay Ambā Kī Jay
Jay Jay Jay Mahālakshmī Kī Jay
Jay Jay Jay Shiraḍī Kī Jay
Jay Jay Jay Satya Sāī Kī Jay

title: Ananda Ram Ananda Shyam
lyrics:
Ananda Ram Ananda Shyam
Narayana Hari Narayana
Narayana Sai Narayana
Prema Swaroopa Brahmananda
Sachidananda Hari Narayana
Narayana Hari Narayana
Narayana Sai Narayana
meaning: We chant the  names of blissful Lord Ram and Shyam, we chan your name Oh Narayana as Hari and Sai. O Lord, you are the embodiment of Divine Love, truth, awareness and bliss.
devanagari:
आनंद राम आनंद श्याम  
नारायणा हरि नारायणा  
नारायणा साई नारायणा  
प्रेम स्वरूपा ब्रह्मानंदा  
सच्चिदानंद हरि नारायणा  
नारायणा हरि नारायणा [ नारायणा साई ... ]
respell:
Ānanda Rām Ānanda Shyām
Nārāyaṇā Hari Nārāyaṇā
Nārāyaṇā Sāī Nārāyaṇā
Prem Swarūpā Brahmānandā
Sachchidānanda Hari Nārāyaṇā
Nārāyaṇā Hari Nārāyaṇā [ Nārāyaṇā Sāī ... ]

title: Ananda Sagara Muralidhara
lyrics:
Ananda Sagara Muralidhara
Meera Prabhu Radhe Shyam Venu Gopala
Nanda Yashoda Ananda Kishora
Jai Jai Gokula Bala Jai Venu Gopala
Jai Jai Gokula Bala Jai Sai Gopala
meaning:
Lord Krishna you are the ocean of bliss who plays charming notes on the flute
You are the lord of Meera and Radha
Glory to the son of Nanda and Yashoda
Glory to the celebrated child of Gokula who has incarnated as Lord Sai.
devanagari:
आनंद सागरा मुरलीधरा
मीरा प्रभु राधे श्याम वेंणु गोपाला [ आनंद सागर ... ]
नंद यशोदा आनंद किशोरा
जय जय गोकुल बाला जय वेंणु (साई) गोपाला
respell:
Ānanda Sāgarā Muralīdharā
Mīrā Prabhu Rādhe Shyām Veṇṇu Gopālā [ Ānanda Sāgar ... ]
Nanda Yashodā Ānanda Kishorā
Jay Jay Gokul Bālā Jay Veṇṇu (sāī) Gopālā

title: Ananda Sri Sai Parthi Pureesha
lyrics:
Ananda Sri Sai Parthi Pureesha
Sadananda Madhava Prashanthi Vasa
Mandara Dhara Govinda Mukunda
Sundara Roopa Sri Satya Sai Natha [ Sadananda Madhava ... ]
meaning: O blissful Sri Sai, Lord of Parthi, you are eternal joy, Madhava, dwelling in Prashanthi. You are Govinda and Mukunda, the one who bore the Mandara mountain, manifesting in a beautiful form as Sri Satya Sai Natha.

title: Anandamaya Bhagawan Hey Premamaya Bhagawan
lyrics:
Anandamaya Bhagawan Hey Premamaya Bhagawan
O Bhagawan Sai Bhagawan
Hey Karuna Nidhe Prabhu Sai Ram
Krupa Nidhe Deenon Ke Pran
Lelo Prabhu Mujhe Sharan Lagalo
Mujhe Daya Karo Bhagawan
Mujhe Krupa Karo Bhagawan
meaning:
O Lord Sai, You are love and bliss personified, repository of compassion and kindness and hope of the downtrodden. 
Accept us at Your Lotus Feet, show us your infinite grace and mercy O Lord.
devanagari:
आनंदमय भगवान हे प्रेममय भगवान
ओ भगवान साईं भगवान [ आनंदमय भगवान ... ]
हे करुणा निधे प्रभु साईं राम
कृपा निधे दीनों के प्राण
लेलो प्रभु मुझे शरण लगालो
मुझे दया (कृपा) करो भगवान
respell:
Ānandamaya Bhagavān He Premamaya Bhagavān
O Bhagavān Sāīṃ Bhagavān [ Ānandamaya Bhagavān ... ]
He Karuṇā Nidhe Prabhu Sāīṃ Rām
Kṛupā Nidhe Dīnoṃ Ke Prāṇ
Lelo Prabhu Mujhe Sharaṇ Lagālo
Mujhe Dayā (kṛupā) Karo Bhagavān

title: Anandame Sai Namame
lyrics:
Anandame Sai Namame
Adbhutame Sai Geetame
Akhandame Jyotirmayame
Sundarame Sai Roopame
Ati Sundarame Sai Roopame
meaning:
Dear Lord Sai, Chanting your name is divine bliss 
Singing your glory is a wonderful experience
Your effulgence is all pervading
Your form divine is beauty beyond description
devanagari:
आनंदमें साई नाममें
अद्भुतमें साई गीतमें
अखंडमें ज्योतिर्मयमें
सुंदरमें साई रूपमें
अति सुंदरमें साई रूपमें
respell:
Ānandameṃ Sāī Nāmameṃ
Adbhutameṃ Sāī Gītameṃ
Akhaṇḍameṃ Jyotirmayameṃ
Sundarameṃ Sāī Rūpameṃ
Ati Sundarameṃ Sāī Rūpameṃ

title: Anatha Bandho Sai Prabho
lyrics:
Anatha Bandho Sai Prabho
Aparadha Kshama Karo Sai Prabho
Jeeva Yatra Mey Saath Raho Tum
Prema Bhakthi Hum Ko Deejo
Hrudaya Mandir Se Math Jao
Charanamrutha Seva Deejo Prabhu
meaning: O Lord Sai, friend of the helpless, please forgive our transgressions and remain with us throughout our life's journey. Grant us pure love and devotion, never leave the sanctuary of our hearts, and bless us with the opportunity to serve your sacred feet.
devanagari:
अनाथ बंधो साई प्रभो  
अपराध क्षमा करो साई प्रभो  
जीव यात्रा में साथ रहो तुम  
प्रेम भक्ति हम को दीजो  
हृदय मंदिर से मत जाओ  
चरणामृत सेवा दीजो प्रभु
respell:
Anātha Bandho Sāī Prabho
Aparādh Kshamā Karo Sāī Prabho
Jīva Yātrā Meṃ Sāth Raho Tum
Prema Bhakti Ham Ko Dījo
Hṛudaya Mandir Se Mat Jāo
Charaṇāmṛuta Sevā Dījo Prabhu

title: Anjana Nanda Veeram
lyrics:
Anjana Nanda Veeram Ashoka Vana Sancharam
Vande Lanka Bhayankaram
Sita Shoka Vinashakaram
meaning: Homage to the heroic son of Anjana, who traversed the Ashoka Vana. He instilled terror in Lanka and brought an end to Sita's profound anguish.
devanagari:
अञ्जना नन्द वीरम् अशोक वन संचारम्
वन्दे लंका भयङ्करम्
सीता शोक विनाशकरम्
respell:
Añjanā Nanda Vīram Ashok Van Sañchāram
Vande Laṅkā Bhayaṅkaram
Sītā Shok Vināshakaram

title: Anjaneya Veera Hanumanta Shoora
lyrics:
Anjaneya Veera Hanumanta Shoora
Vayukumara Vanara Veera

Sri Ram Jai Ram Jai Jai Ram Sita Ram Jai Radhe Shyam
meaning: Brave Hanuman, Son of Vayu (Wind God). Brave Lord of the Vanaras (monkeys). Victory to Sita and Ram and Radha and Krishna.
devanagari:
अञ्जनेय वीरा हनुमन्त शूरा
वायु कुमारा वानर वीरा [ अञ्जनेय ... ]
वायु कुमारा वानर वीरा
श्री राम जय राम जय जय राम सीता राम जय राधे श्याम (4)
respell:
Añjaney Vīrā Hanumanta Shūrā
Vāyu Kumārā Vānara Vīrā [ añjaneya ... ]
Vāyu Kumārā Vānara Vīrā
shrī rām jaya rām jaya jaya rām sītā rām jaya rādhe shyām (4)

title: Antar Jyot Jalao Sai
lyrics:
Antar Jyot Jalao Sai
Brahma Sanathani Daya Karo
Daya Karo Hey Poorna Jyotirmayi
Shiva Shaktimayi Krupa Karo
Deena Dayamayi Patita Pavani
Sai Jagat Janani Krupa Karo
meaning: Oh Mother Sai! You have neither beginning nor end. Kindly illumine our soul and shower your mercy. Oh Effulgent Mother of the Universe! You are the form of Shiva and Shakthi and merciful to the deprived. Kindly protect us.
devanagari:
अंतर ज्योति जलाओ साई  
ब्रह्म सनातनी दया करो  
दया करो हे पूर्ण ज्योतिर्मयी  
शिव शक्तिमयी कृपा करो  
दीन दयामयी पतित पावनी  
साई जगत जननी रक्षा (कृपा) करो
respell:
Antar Jyoti Jalāo Sāī
Brahma Sanātanī Dayā Karo
Dayā Karo He Pūrṇa Jyotirmayī
Shiv Shaktimayī Kṛupā Karo
Dīna Dayāmayī Patita Pāvanī
Sāī Jagat Jananī Rakshā (kṛupā) Karo

title: Antaranga Sai Anatha Natha Sai
lyrics:
Antaranga Sai Anatha Natha Sai
Deena Bandhu Sai Karuna Sindhu Sai
Rama Krishna Shiva Shakti Prema Roopa Sai
Yuga Avatar Baba Sri Sathya Sai
meaning: Oh Sai Bhagawan, you are love and bliss personified, repository of compassion and kindness and hope of the downtrodden. You are verily Rama, Krishna and the incarnation of Supreme Love of the modern era otherwise known as Sri Sathya Sai.
devanagari:
अंतरंग साई अनाथ नाथ साई  
दीन बंधु साई करुणा सिंधु साई 
[ अंतरंग साई ... ]  
राम कृष्ण शिव शक्ति प्रेम रूप साई  
युग अवतार बाबा श्री सत्य साई
respell:
Antaraṅg Sāī Anātha Nātha Sāī
Dīna Bandhu Sāī Karuṇā Sindhu Sāī
[ Antaraṅg Sāī ... ]
Rām Kṛushṇa Shiv Shakti Prem Rūp Sāī
Yug Avatāra Bābā Shrī Satya Sāī

title: Antaryami Sai
lyrics:
Antaryami Sai
Poorna Brahma Avatari
Hey Giridhari Hrudaya Vihari Krishna Kunja Vihari
Gopala Leela Dhari
Hey Gopi Mana Sanchari
Madhusudana Murari
Hey Giridhari Hrudaya Vihari Krishna Kunja Vihari
meaning: Oh indweller Sai, you have descended from supreme unmanifested state (Brahman). You are Krishna, the reisder in the hearts of devotees, who wandered in the Brindavan lifting Giridhari mountain. Exhibited divine Leela (sports) with Gopi Gopala imprinting yourself in their minds. You are Madhusudhana and Murari.
devanagari:
अन्तर्यामी साई
पूर्ण ब्रह्म अवतारी
हे गिरिधारी हृदय विहारी कृष्णा कुंज विहारी
गोपाला लीला धारी
हे गोपी मन संचारी
मधुसूदना मुरारी
हे गिरिधारी हृदय विहारी कृष्णा कुंज विहारी
respell:
Antaryāmī Sāī
Pūrṇa Brahma Avatārī
He Giridhārī Hṛudaya Vihārī Kṛushṇā Kuñj Vihārī
Gopālā Līlā Dhārī
He Gopī Mana Sañchārī
Madhusūdanā Murārī
He Giridhārī Hṛudaya Vihārī Kṛushṇā Kuñj Vihārī

title: Anupama Sundara Nanda Kishora
lyrics:
Anupama Sundara Nanda Kishora
Brindavana Ghana Shyam
Murali Madhava Radhe Govinda
Madhusudana Ghana Shyam Sathya Sai Sundara Shyam
Brinda Vihari Mandara Giridhari
Kamala Nayana Bhagawan
Bhakton Ke Prabhu Partheeshwara Sai
Natawara Sundara Shyam Sathya Sai Sundara Shyam
meaning: O Krishna Son of Nanda! You are unsurpassingly beautiful! You are dark as the clouds and adored in Brindavan as Radhey Govinda, Madhusudhana and Giridhari. O Lotus eyed Lord Sathya Sai! You are beloved to your devotees and adored as the same dancing Shyam.
devanagari:
अनुपम सुंदर नंद किशोरा
ब्रिंदावन घन श्याम
मुरली माधव राधे गोविन्दा
मधुसूदन घन श्याम सत्य साईं सुंदर श्याम
ब्रिंद विहारी मंदर गिरिधारी
कमल नयन भगवान
भक्तों के प्रभु पर्तिश्वर साईं
नटवर सुंदरा श्याम सत्य साईं सुंदरा श्याम
respell:
Anupama Sundara Nanda Kishorā
Brindāvan Ghan Shyām
Muralī Mādhava Rādhe Govindā
Madhusūdana Ghan Shyām Satya Sāīṃ Sundara Shyām
Brind Vihārī Mandara Giridhārī
Kamala Nayan Bhagavān
Bhaktoṃ Ke Prabhu Partishwar Sāīṃ
Naṭavar Sundarā Shyām Satya Sāīṃ Sundarā Shyām

title: Araj Suno Mere Parama Krupalo
lyrics:
Araj Suno Mere Parama Krupalo
Partheeshwara Sai Deva
Sathya Sanathana Antaryami
Sakala Charachara Tum Ho Swami
Janam Maran Se Par Karo
Bhava Bandhan Se Uddhar Karo
Baba Bhava Bandhan Se Uddhar Karo
meaning: O Supremely merciful lord of Parthi! Please listen to my prayer and to help me to come out of bondage of the cycle of birth and death. O Lord Sai! You are omnipresent, infinite and indweller of our heart.
devanagari:
अरज सुनो मेरे परम कृपालु
पर्तिश्वर साई देवा
[ अरज सुनो ... ]
सत्य सनातन अंतर्यामी
सकल चराचर तुम हो स्वामी
जनम मरण से पार करो
भव बंधन से उद्धार करो (बाबा)
respell:
Araj Suno Mere Param Kṛupālu
Partishwar Sāī Devā
[ Araj Suno ... ]
Satya Sanātana Antaryāmī
Sakal Charāchara Tum Ho Swāmī
Janam Maraṇ Se Pār Karo
Bhava Bandhan Se Uddhār Karo (bābā)

title: Aravinda Lochana Arta Janavana
lyrics:
Aravinda Lochana Arta Janavana
Sai Narayana Sathya Narayana
Eshwaramba Nandana Dosha Nivarana
Parama Niranjana Hey Shubhanana
meaning: O Lotus eyed Lord Narayana! You are the protector of the deprived and distressed. O Auspicious son of Mother Eshwaramba, the blemishless one! You are the redeemer of our defects.
devanagari:
अरविंद लोचन आर्त जनवन  
साई नारायण सत्य नारायण 
[ अरविंद लोचन ... ]  
ईश्वराम्बा नंदन दोष निवारण  
परम निरंजन हे शुभनन
respell:
Aravind Lochana Ārta Janavan
Sāī Nārāyaṇ Satya Nārāyaṇ
[ Aravind Lochana ... ]
Īshwarāmbā Nandana Dosha Nivāraṇ
Param Nirañjana He Shubhanana

title: Aruna Ramana Sri Gurudeva
lyrics:
Aruna Ramana Sri Gurudeva
Sesha Ramana Sadguru Deva
Bhava Bhaya Harana Sri Sai Deva
Guru Hai Sat Chit Ananda Deva
Ananda Deva Sri Sai Deva
meaning:
O Lord Sai, we worship you as our Guru, who gives delight to the eyes at the dawn. 
You are the blissful eternal Guru reclining on Shesha (seven headed serpent) who protects us from fear and worldly miseries. 
You are the Lord Sai who is the embodiment of Existence, Awareness and Bliss
devanagari:
अरुणा रमणा श्री गुरु देवा
शेशा रमणा सदगुरु देवा [ अरुणा रमणा ... ]
भव भय हरणा श्री साई देवा
गुरु है सत चित आनंद देवा
आनंद देवा श्री साई देवा
respell:
Aruṇā Ramaṇā Shrī Guru devā
Sheshā Ramaṇā Sadaguru Devā [ aruṇā ramaṇā ... ]
Bhava Bhaya Haraṇā Shrī Sāī Devā
Guru Hai Sat Chit Ānanda Devā
Ānanda Devā Shrī Sāī Devā

title: Arunachala Shiva Arunachala Shiva Arunachala Shiva Aruna Shiva
lyrics:
Arunachala Shiva Arunachala Shiva Arunachala Shiva Aruna Shiva
Akshaya Linga Atma Linga
Tejomaya Vigraha Linga
Iha Para Sukha Dayaka Esha Iha Para Sukha Dayaka
Iha Para Sukha Dayaka Sai Iha Para Sukha Dayaka
--
Om Namah Shivaya Shivaya Namah Om (3)
meaning: O Lord Sai, we worship you as our Guru, who gives delight to the eyes at the dawn. You are the blissful eternal Guru reclining on Shesha (seven headed serpent) who protects us from fear and worldly miseries. You are the Lord Sai who is the embodiment of Existence, Awareness and Bliss
devanagari:
अरुणाचल शिव, अरुणाचल शिव, अरुणाचल शिव, अरुण शिवा
अक्षय लिंगा आत्म लिंगा
तेजोनमय विग्रह लिंगा  
इह पर सुख दायका, ईशा (साई), इह पर सुख दायका  
ॐ नमः शिवाय, शिवाय नमः ॐ (3)
respell:
Aruṇāchala Shiv, Aruṇāchala Shiv, Aruṇāchala Shiv, Aruṇ Shivā
Akshay Liṅgā Ātma Liṅgā
Tejonamaya Vigrah Liṅgā
Ih Para Sukh Dāyakā, Īshā (sāī), Ih Para Sukh Dāyakā
Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy, Shivāy Namaḥ Oṃ (3)

title: Arunachala Shiva
lyrics:
Arunachala Shiva
Shiva Shankara Samba Shiva
Hara Shankara Sai Shiva [ Arunachala Shiva ]
Chandrachooda Madanaanthaka Hara Shiva
Ganga Jatadhara Gowri Manohara
Parthi Pureeshwara Sai Shankara
Hara Hara Shankara Sai Shiva Shiva Shankara Sai
meaning: Oh Shiva, Lord of Arunachala, you are the auspicious Shankara, our beloved Sai. Adorned with the crescent moon and holding the sacred Ganga in your matted locks, you are the beloved of Gowri, the vanquisher of desire, and the divine Sai Shankara, Lord of Puttaparthi.
devanagari:
अरुणाचल शिव  
शिव शंकर सांबा शिव  
हर शंकर साई शिव [ अरुणाचल शिव ]  
चंद्रचूड़ा मदानांथक हर शिव  
गंगा जटाधर गौरी मनोहर  
पार्थी पूरेश्वर साई शंकर  
हर हर शंकर साई शिव शिव शंकर साई
respell:
Aruṇāchala Shiv
Shiv Shaṅkar Sāmbā Shiv
Har Shaṅkar Sāī Shiv [ Aruṇāchala Shiv ]
Chandrachūḍa़ā Madānānthaka Har Shiv
Gaṅgā Jaṭādhara Gaurī Manohar
Pārthī Pūreshwar Sāī Shaṅkar
Har Har Shaṅkar Sāī Shiv Shiv Shaṅkar Sāī

title: At Your Feet Dear Lord We Pray
lyrics:
At Your Feet Dear Lord We Pray
Grace Us With Your Love This Day
Sai Baba, Sai Baba, You Are Krishna, You Are Rama
Oh Baba, Oh Baba, You Are Mother, You Are Father
All Names, Every Form, All That Was And Will Be Born
(You Are) All Names Every Form All That Is Forever More
meaning: We humbly pray for Your divine love and grace, dear Lord. We recognize Sai Baba as the embodiment of all revered deities like Krishna and Rama, and the nurturing presence of both mother and father. You are the ultimate reality, encompassing all names, forms, and all that ever was, is, or will be.
devanagari:
ऐट योर फीट डिर लोर्ड वी प्रे
ग्रेस अस विद योर लव दिस डे
साई बाबा साई बाबा यू आर कृष्ण यू आर राम
ओ बाबा ओ बाबा यू आर मदर यू आर फादर
ओल नेम्ज एवरई फोर्म ओल दैट वाज अन्ड विल बी बोर्न
यू आर ओल नेम्ज एवरई फोर्म ओल दैट इज फरएवर मोर

title: Atma Jyoti Namo Paramatma Jyoti Namo
lyrics:
Atma Jyoti Namo Paramatma Jyoti Namo
Akhanda Jyoti Namo Mama Jeevana Jyoti Namo
Antaryami Namo Sri Sadguru Sai Namo
meaning:
I bow down to the ominpresent light of the lord within
I bow to the ever effulgent light that is the very essence of my life
I bow to the indwelling guru , Lord Sai

title: Atma Lingam Bhajore Ati Adbhuta Lingam Bhajore
lyrics:
Atma Lingam Bhajore Ati Adbhuta Lingam Bhajore
Naga Lingam Nava Mani Lingam
Nabhi Kamala Udbhava Lingam
Eshwara Lingam Bhajore Sayeeshwara Lingam Bhajore
meaning:
Lets all sing the praise of the auspicious and amazing form of Lord Shiva
Lets contemplate on Naga Lingam that is adorned with nine precious gems
Lets contemplate on the Linga form that emerged out of the lotus from the navel of the lord
Lets sing praises in the name of the Eshwara and Sayeeshwara Lingam
devanagari:
आत्म लिंगम् भजोरे अति अद्भुत लिंगम् भजोरे
नाग लिंगम् नवमणि लिंगम्
नाभि कमला उद्भव लिंगम्
ईश्वर लिंगम् भजोरे साईश्वर (पर्तिश्वर) लिंगम् भजोरे
respell:
Ātma Liṅgam Bhajore Ati Adbhuta Liṅgam Bhajore
Nāga Liṅgam Navamaṇi Liṅgam
Nābhi Kamalā Udbhava Liṅgam
Īshwar Liṅgam Bhajore Sāīshwar (partishwar) Liṅgam Bhajore

title: Atma Rama Ananda Ramana
lyrics:
Atma Rama Ananda Ramana
Achyuta Keshava Hari Narayana
Bhava Bhaya Harana Vandita Charana
Raghukula Bhooshana Rajeeva Nayana
Adi Narayana Ananta Shayana
Sachidananda Sai Narayana
meaning:
O Rama who is the indweller of every heart, you are the embodiement of bliss
We remember you as Achyuta, Keshava, Narayana and Sai - the removers of worldly fears
You are the lotus eyed jewel of Raghu dynasty, who resides in the endless ocean
You are the embodiment of truth, awareness and bliss (Sat-Chith-Ananda), we bow down to your lotus feet.
devanagari:
आत्म रामा आनंद रामणा
अच्युता केशव हरि नारायण
भव भय हरणा वन्दिता चरणा
रघुकुल भूषण राजीव नयना
आदि नारायण अनन्त शयना
सच्चिदानंद सत्य (साई) नारायणा
respell:
Ātma Rāmā Ānanda Rāmaṇā
Achyutā Keshav Hari Nārāyaṇ
Bhava Bhaya Haraṇā Vanditā Charaṇā
Raghukul Bhūshaṇ Rājīva Nayanā
Ādi Nārāyaṇ Ananta Shayanā
Sachchidānanda Satya (sāī) Nārāyaṇā

title: Aum Ennum Pranava Roopa Nayaka
lyrics:
Aum Ennum Pranava Roopa Nayaka
Umayavalin Balane Vinayaka
Devar Muvar Potrum Veda Nayaka
Devadi Devane Vinayaka
Valvinaigal Neekkum Parthi Nayaka
Vendum Varam Thandhidum Vinayaka
Mounathin Muzhu Porule Nayaka
Mukkannan Maindhane Vinayaka
meaning: O Lord Vinayaka, you are the divine form of Om, son of Uma and Shiva, revered by the trinity of gods as the supreme Lord and master of the Vedas. You are the Lord of Parthi who removes all karmic burdens, granting every desired boon and embodying the profound essence of silent contemplation.

title: Om Hari Om Hari Om Bhajore Sada Om Hari Om Hari Om
lyrics:
Om Hari Om Hari Om Bhajore Sada Om Hari Om Hari Om
Sathya Narayana Hari Om
Sai Narayana Hari Om
Narayana Hari Narayana Hari Narayana Hari Om
Sathya Narayana Hari Om
Sai Narayana Hari Om
meaning: Chant incessantly the divine names of Lord Hari, Narayana and Sai. Lord Sathya Sai is verily Lord Narayana.
devanagari:
ॐ हरि ॐ हरि ॐ भजोरें सदा ॐ हरि ॐ हरि ॐ
सत्य (साईं) नारायणा हरि ॐ (2)
नारायणा हरि नारायणा हरि नारायणा हरि ॐ (2)
सत्य (साईं) नारायणा हरि ॐ
respell:
Oṃ Hari Oṃ Hari Oṃ Bhajoreṃ Sadā Oṃ Hari Oṃ Hari Oṃ
Satya (sāīṃ) Nārāyaṇā Hari Oṃ (2)
Nārāyaṇā Hari Nārāyaṇā Hari Nārāyaṇā Hari Oṃ (2)
Satya (sāīṃ) Nārāyaṇā Hari Oṃ

title: Om Hari Om Sai Shankara Om
lyrics:
Om Hari Om Sai Shankara Om
Om Hari Om Shirdipureeshwara Om
Parthi Vihari Shivom Trinetradhari Shivom
Patita Pavana Pahi Mahesha Shiva Shiva Hara Hara Om
meaning: O Hari, O Sai Shankara, the Lord of Shirdi and Parthi, the three-eyed Lord Shiva, You are the One who forgives and uplifts the fallen, protect us Oh Supreme Lord!
devanagari:
ॐ हरि ॐ साई शंकर ॐ  
ॐ हरि ॐ शिर्डीपूरीश्वर ॐ  
पर्तिविहारी शिवोम त्रिनेत्र धारी शिवोम  
पतित पावना पाहि महेश शिव शिव हर हर ॐ
respell:
Oṃ Hari Oṃ Sāī Shaṅkar Oṃ
Oṃ Hari Oṃ Shirḍīpūrīshwar Oṃ
Partivihārī Shivom Trinetr Dhārī Shivom
Patita Pāvanā Pāhi Mahesh Shiv Shiv Har Har Oṃ

title: Om Jagat Janani Sai Mata
lyrics:
Om Jagat Janani Sai Mata
Omkara Roopini Sai Mata
Abhaya Pradayini Sai Mata
Sai Mata Sathya Sai Mata
Anatha Rakshaki Sai Mata
meaning: O Mother of the Universe, Sai. Your form is Pranava, Mother Sai. You are the destroyer of fear and the protector of the forlon. Mother of the Universe, Sai, we offer our prayers to You who grants universal protection to the underprivileged, destitute and deprived.
devanagari:
ॐ जग जननी साई माता
ओंकार रूपिणी साई माता [ ॐ जगा ... ]
अभय प्रदायिनी साई माता
साई माता सत्य साई माता
अनाथ रक्षकी साई माता (2)
respell:
Oṃ Jag Jananī Sāī Mātā
Oṅkār Rūpiṇī Sāī Mātā [ oṃ jagā ... ]
Abhaya Pradāyinī Sāī Mātā
Sāī Mātā Satya Sāī Mātā
Anātha Rakshakī Sāī Mātā (2)

title: Om Namah Shivaya Om Namah Shivaya
lyrics:
Om Namah Shivaya Om Namah Shivaya
Om Namah Shivaya Namah Om Namah Om
Gangadhara Hara Gaurivara
Kailasa Natha Namah Om
Gangotri Vasa Sri Sai Natha
Om Namah Shivaya Namah Om Namah Om
meaning: Chant the mantra: 'Om Namah Shivaya', (I bow to Lord Shiva). He is the beloved of Gowri, with mother Ganga in his tresses. We bow down to Him, who is the Lord of Kailasa, who resides in Gangotri (origin of Ganga in Himalayas); He is verily our Lord Sai Nath.
devanagari:
ॐ नमः शिवाया ॐ नमः शिवाया
ॐ नमः शिवाय नमः ॐ नमः ॐ
गंगाधरा हर गौरी वरा
कैलास नाथा नमः ॐ
गंगोत्री वासा श्री साई नाथा [ ॐ नमः शिवाय नमः ॐ ... ]
respell:
Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāyā Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāyā
Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy Namaḥ Oṃ Namaḥ Oṃ
Gaṅgādharā Har Gaurī Varā
Kailās Nāthā Namaḥ Oṃ
Gaṅgotrī Vāsā Shrī Sāī Nāthā [ Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy Namaḥ Oṃ ... ]

title: Om Namah Shivaya Namo Narayana
lyrics: Om Namah Shivaya Namo Narayana
meaning: Chant the sacred mantra Om Namah Shivaya and and bow in reverence to the sacred name Narayana
devanagari: ॐ नमः शिवाय नमो नारायण (४)
respell: Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy Namo Nārāyaṇ (4)

title: Aum Namah Shivaya Shivaya Namah Aum
lyrics:
Aum Namah Shivaya Shivaya Namah Aum Aum Namah Shivaya Shivaya Namah Aum
Shiva Shiva Hara Hara Haraya Namah Aum Hara Hara Shiva Shiva Shivaya Namah Aum
Hara Hara Mahadeva Hara Hara Mahadeva [ Aum Namah ... ]
Dama Dama Dama Dama Damaru Baajey
Dhimithaka Dhimithaka Mrudanga Baajey [ Hara Hara ... ]
meaning: Salutations to you, O Shiva, the auspicious one, the great Lord who dispels all sorrow and evil. We hear the rhythmic 'dama dama' of your Damaru and the 'dhimithaka dhimithaka' of your Mrudanga, resonating with your divine cosmic dance.
devanagari:
ॐ नमः शिवाय शिवाय नमः ॐ ॐ नमः शिवाय शिवाय नमः ॐ
शिव शिव हर हर हराय नमः ॐ हर हर शिव शिव शिवाय नमः ॐ
हर हर महादेवा हर हर महादेवा [ ॐ नमः ... ]
डम डम डम डम डमरू बाजे
धिमितक धिमितक मृदंग बाजे [ हर हर ... ]
respell:
Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy Shivāy Namaḥ Oṃ Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy Shivāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Shiv Shiv Har Har Harāy Namaḥ Oṃ Har Har Shiv Shiv Shivāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Har Har Mahādevā Har Har Mahādevā [ Oṃ Namaḥ ... ]
Ḍama Ḍama Ḍama Ḍama Ḍamarū Bāje
Dhimitaka Dhimitaka Mṛudaṅga Bāje [ Har Har ... ]

title: Om Namo Bhagavate Vasudevaya
lyrics:
Om Namo Bhagavate Vasudevaya
Hari Om Namo Bhagavate Vasudevaya
Om Namah Shivaya Om Namo Narayanaya
Om Namo Bhagavate Vasudevaya
Hari Hari Om Namo Bhagavate Vasudevaya
meaning: I bow down to Thee, O Lord Krishna! son of Vasudeva. I bow down to Lord Shiva, to Lord Narayana. Adoration to Lord Vishnu and Lord Shiva.
devanagari:
ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाया
हरि ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाया 
[ ॐ नमो ... ]
ॐ नमः शिवाय ॐ नमो नारायणाय (2) 
[ हरि हरि ॐ नमो ... ]
respell:
Oṃ Namo Bhagavate Vāsudevāyā
Hari Oṃ Namo Bhagavate Vāsudevāyā
[ Oṃ Namo ... ]
Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy Oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya (2)
[ Hari Hari Oṃ Namo ... ]

title: Aum Shivaya Aum Shivaya
lyrics:
Aum Shivaya Aum Shivaya
Shambho Shankara Aum Shivaya (3)
meaning: Oh Shiva, we offer our heartfelt salutations to you! You are Shambho, the benevolent giver of happiness, and Shankara, the bestower of all auspiciousness. We bow to your divine presence, Shiva.
devanagari:
ॐ शिवाय ॐ शिवाय  
शम्भो शंकर ॐ शिवाय (3)
respell:
Oṃ Shivāy Oṃ Shivāy
Shambho Shaṅkar Oṃ Shivāy (3)

title: Om Sri Ram Jai Ram Jai Jai Ram
lyrics:
Om Sri Ram Jai Ram Jai Jai Ram (4)
Sita Ram Sita Ram Sita Ram
Radhe Shyam Radhe Shyam Radhe Shyam
meaning: Victory to Lord Rama, the Lord of Sita. Chant the name of the Lord: Sita Ram and Radhey Shyam (the beloved of Radha).
devanagari:
ॐ श्री राम जय राम जय जय राम (४)
सीता राम सीता राम सीता राम
राधे श्याम राधे श्याम राधे श्याम
respell:
Oṃ Shrī Rām Jay Rām Jay Jay Rām (4)
Sītā Rām Sītā Rām Sītā Rām
Rādhe Shyām Rādhe Shyām Rādhe Shyām

title: Omkara Priya Sai Rama
lyrics:
Omkara Priya Sai Rama
Munijana Sevita Sai Rama
Shantakara Sai Rama
Sakshatkara Sai Rama
Bhava Raga Priya Sai Rama
Bhagavata Priya Sai Rama
Nada Swaroopa Sai Rama
Natya Kalapa Sai Rama
meaning: We pray to Sai Rama, who loves the Omkar (Primordial sound), who is always worshipped by pious souls, who is the embodiment of peace, who could grant self realization, the one who loves devotees who are immersed in the divine consciousness. He is the embodiment of divine music and dance.
devanagari:
ओंकारा प्रिय साई रामा
मुनिजन सेविता साई रामा
शान्ताकारा साई रामा
साक्षात्करा साई राम
भाव राग प्रिय साई रामा
भागवपा प्रिय साई रामा
नाद स्वरूपा साई रामा
नाट्य कलापा साई रामा
respell:
Oṅkārā Priy Sāī Rāmā
Munijana Sevitā Sāī Rāmā
Shāntākārā Sāī Rāmā
Sākshātkarā Sāī Rām
Bhāva Rāg Priy Sāī Rāmā
Bhāgavapā Priy Sāī Rāmā
Nāda Swarūpā Sāī Rāmā
Nāṭya Kalāpā Sāī Rāmā

title: Ayodhya Ke Sita Ram Brindavan Ke Radhe Shyam
lyrics:
Ayodhya Ke Sita Ram Brindavan Ke Radhe Shyam
Radhe Shyam Jaya Radhe Shyam
Radha Madhava Radhe Shyam
Sai Ram Sathya Sai Ram
Parthi Pureeshwara Sai Ram
meaning: Chant the names of Sita Ram, the Lord of Ayodhya and Radhey Shyam who resides in Brindavan, Victory to Lord Sairam of Parthi
devanagari:
अयोध्या के सीता राम वृन्दावन के राधे श्याम
राधे श्याम जय राधे श्याम
राधा माधव राधे श्याम
साई राम सत्य साई राम
पर्ती पूरीश्वर साई राम
respell:
Ayodhyā Ke Sītā Rām Vṛundāvan Ke Rādhe Shyām
Rādhe Shyām Jaya Rādhe Shyām
Rādhā Mādhava Rādhe Shyām
Sāī Rām Sathya Sāī Rām
Partī Pūrīshwar Sāī Rām

title: Ayodhya Shiromani Dasharatha Rama
lyrics:
Ayodhya Shiromani Dasharatha Rama
Saketa Ranjana Kaivalya Dhama
Neeraja Lochana Sai Narayana
Bandha Vimochana Bhakta Parayana
Prana Sakha Mere Prabhu Sai Rama
Saketa Ranjana Kaivalya Dhama
meaning:
Sing the glory of the Lotus eyed Saketa Rama, son of Dasharatha and the jewel in the crown of Ayodhya dynasty.
Free us from the bondage of life and death as you are our dearest companion and our ultimate abode.
devanagari:
अयोध्या शिरोमणि दशरथ रामा
साकेत रञ्जन कैवल्य धामा
[ अयोध्या शिरोमणि ... ]
नीरज लोचन साई नारायण
बंध विमोचन भक्त परायण
प्राण सखा मेरे प्रभु साई रामा
[ साकेत रञ्जन ... ]
respell:
Ayodhyā Shiromaṇi Dasharath Rāmā
Sāket Rañjana Kaivalya Dhāmā
[ Ayodhyā Shiromaṇi ... ]
Nīraj Lochana Sāī Nārāyaṇ
Bandha Vimochana Bhakta Parāyaṇ
Prāṇ Sakhā Mere Prabhu Sāī Rāmā
[ Sāket Rañjana ... ]

title: Ayodhya Vasi Ram Hain Dwaraka Mein Aye
lyrics:
Ayodhya Vasi Ram Hain Dwaraka Mein Aye
Dwarka Vasi Shyam Hain Shirdi Mein Aye
Shirdi Vasi Shyam Hain Parthi Sathya Sai
Bolo Ram Sai Ram Bolo Sathya Sai Ram
meaning: Chant the name of Sathya Sai Ram, He is the same Lord who incarnated in Ayodhya as Ram, in Dwarka as Shyam, in Shirdi as Lord Shirdi Sai and in Puttaparthi as Sathya Sai.
devanagari:
अयोध्या वासी राम है द्वारका में आए
द्वारका वासी श्याम है शिर्डी में आए
शिर्डी वासी श्याम है पर्ती सत्य साईं
बोलो राम साईं राम बोलो सत्य साईं राम
respell:
Ayodhyā Vāsī Rām Hai Dwārakā Meṃ Āe
Dwārakā Vāsī Shyām Hai Shirḍī Meṃ Āe
Shirḍī Vāsī Shyām Hai Partī Satya Sāīṃ
Bolo Rām Sāīṃ Rām Bolo Satya Sāīṃ Rām

title: Ayodhya Vasi Ram Ram Ram Dasharatha Nandana Ram
lyrics:
Ayodhya Vasi Ram Ram Ram Dasharatha Nandana Ram
Patita Pavana Janaki Jeevana Sita Mohana Ram
Ayodhya Vasi Ram Ram Ram Dasharatha Nandana Ram
Patita Pavana Janaki Jeevana Sita Mohana Ram
meaning: Chant the name of Rama, the Lord of Ayodhya, the son of Dasharatha and the consort of Sita and whose name purifies the deprived.
devanagari:
अयोध्या वासी राम राम राम दशरथ नंदन राम  
पतित पावन जानकी जीवन सीता मोहन राम  
अयोध्या वासी राम राम राम दशरथ नंदन राम  
पतित पावन जानकी जीवन सीता मोहन राम
respell:
Ayodhyā Vāsī Rām Rām Rām Dasharath Nandana Rām
Patita Pāvan Jānakī Jīvan Sītā Mohan Rām
ayodhyā vāsī rām rām rām dasharath nandana rām
patita pāvan jānakī jīvan sītā mohan rām

title: Ayodhya Vihari Sri Rama Rama Rama
lyrics:
Ayodhya Vihari Sri Rama Rama Rama
Dwaraka Vihari Sri Krishna Krishna Krishna
Saptagiri Vihari Govinda Govinda
Nija Bhakta Hrudaya Vihari Sri Sai Natha Deva
meaning:
Sing the glory of Rama who is the resident of Ayodhya
Sing the glory of Krishna who is the resident of Dwaraka
Sing the glory of Govinda who resides on seven hills
Sing the glory of Sai who resides deep in the heart of devotees.
devanagari:
अयोध्या विहारी श्री राम राम रामा
द्वारका विहारी श्री कृष्ण कृष्ण कृष्णा
सप्तगिरी विहारी गोविंद गोविंदा
निज भक्त हृदय विहारी श्री साई नाथ देवा
respell:
Ayodhyā Vihārī Shrī Rām Rām Rāmā
Dwārakā Vihārī Shrī Kṛushṇa Kṛushṇa Kṛushṇā
Saptagirī Vihārī Govind Govindā
Nija Bhakta Hṛudaya Vihārī Shrī Sāī Nātha Devā

title: Ayyappa Sharaname Swami Ayyappa
lyrics:
Ayyappa Sharaname (3) Swami Ayyappa Sharaname (2)
Sabarinayaka Shanthi Dayaka, Ayyappa Sharaname Swami Ayyappa Sharaname
Parthi Nayaka Prashanthi Dayaka, Ayyappa Sharaname Swami Ayyappa Sharaname
meaning: Lord Ayyappa, I seek refuge in You! You are the divine leader of Sabari, bestowing peace, and the Lord of Parthi, granting supreme tranquility. My complete surrender is at Your feet, Swami Ayyappa.
devanagari:
अय्यप्पा शरणमे अय्यप्पा शरणमे अय्यप्पा शरणमे स्वामी अय्यप्पा शरणमे स्वामी अय्यप्पा शरणमे
सबरीनायका शान्ति दायका, अय्यप्पा शरणमे स्वामी अय्यप्पा शरणमे
पर्ती नायका प्रशान्ति दायका, अय्यप्पा शरणमे स्वामी अय्यप्पा शरणमे
respell:
Ayyappā Sharaṇame ayyappā Sharaṇame Ayyappā Sharaṇame swāmī ayyappā sharaṇame swāmī ayyappā sharaṇame
Sabarīnāyakā Shānti Dāyakā, Ayyappā Sharaṇame Swāmī Ayyappā Sharaṇame
Partī Nāyakā Prashānti Dāyakā, Ayyappā Sharaṇame Swāmī Ayyappā Sharaṇame

title: Baba Aao Mere Keertan Mein
lyrics:
Baba Aao Mere Keertan Mein
Antaryami Darsha Dikhao
Naiya Hamari Par Lagao
Antar Jyoti Jalao Sai
Jeevan Jyoti Tumho Sai
meaning: O beloved Baba, grant Your Divine Darshan while we sing Your glory and help us cross the boat of life. Kindle the lamp of wisdom in our hearts just as You illuminate our lives.
devanagari:
बाबा आओ मेरे कीर्तन में
अंतर्यामी दर्शन दिखाओ
नैया हमारे पार लगाओ
[ बाबा आओ ... ]
अंतर ज्योति जलाओ साई
जीवन ज्योति तुम हो साई
respell:
Bābā Āo Mere Kīrtan Meṃ
Antaryāmī Darshan Dikhāo
Naiyā Hamāre Pār Lagāo
[ Bābā Āo ... ]
Antar Jyoti Jalāo Sāī
Jīvan Jyoti Tum Ho Sāī

title: Bada Chitta Chora Brindavana Sanchara
lyrics:
Bada Chitta Chora Brindavana Sanchara
Gopala Gopala Hey Murali Gopala
Govardhanoddhara Gopala Bala
Gopi Manohara Radhe Gopala
meaning: Chant the name of Lord Gopala (Krishna), who played in Brindavan, who lifted the Govardhana mountain and who captivated the hearts of Radha and the Gopis.
devanagari:
बड़ा चित्त चोरा ब्रिंदावन संचारा
गोपाला गोपाला हे मुरली गोपाला  
गोवर्धनोधरा गोपाल बाला  
गोपी मनोहरा राधे गोपाला
respell:
Baḍa़ā Chitta Chorā Brindāvan Sañchārā
Gopālā Gopālā He Muralī Gopālā
Govardhanodharā Gopāla Bālā
Gopī Manoharā Rādhe Gopālā

title: Bahut Diya Mujhe/Tune Anand Baba
lyrics:
Bahut Diya Mujhe Anand Baba
Dukh Ko Sukh Kiya Jeevan Me Mera 
[ Bahut Diya ... ]
Tumne Mujhko Prema Sikhaya
Sathya Dharma Ka Raaha Dikhaya
Man Mandir Me Deep Jalaya
Paavan Kiya Tune Jeevan Mera
devanagari:
बहुत दिया मुझे आनंद बाबा
दुख को सुख किया जीवन में मेरा
[ बहुत दिया ... ]
तुमने मुझे प्रेम सिखाया
सत्य धर्म का राह दिखाया
मन मंदिर में दीप जलाया
पावन किया तूने जीवन मेरा
respell:
Bahut Diyā Mujhe Ānand Bābā
Dukh Ko Sukh Kiyā Jīvan Meṃ Merā
[ Bahut Diyā ... ]
Tumane Mujhe Prem Sikhāyā
Satya Dharma Kā Rāh Dikhāyā
Man Mandir Meṃ Dīp Jalāyā
Pāvan Kiyā Tūne Jīvan Merā

title: Bala Gopal Jai Jai Sai Shyam
lyrics:
Bala Gopal Jai Jai Sai Shyam
Prem Bharo Dil Mein Hamare Sairam
Hamare Sairam Bade Pyare Sairam
Prem Bharo Dil Mein Hamare Sairam
Hum Bhakton Ke Tum Ek Sairam
Tumhare Jagat Mein Bada Pyara Pyara Nam
Sang Raho Har Dum Hamare Sairam
Sang Raho Hamare Sairam (Sada)
meaning: Victory to Sai Shyam, the divine child! O Sai Ram, please fill our hearts with your love and remain with us always. Your beloved name resonates throughout the world, and you are the sole refuge for your devotees.
devanagari:
बाल गोपाल जय जय साईं श्याम  
प्रेम भरो दिल में हमारे साईं राम  
हमारे साईं राम बड़े प्यारे साईं राम  
[ प्रेम भरो... ]  
हम भक्तों के तुम एक साईं राम  
तुम्हरे जगत में बड़ा प्यारा प्यारा नाम  
संग रहो हर दम हमारे साईं राम  
संग रहो हमारे साईं राम
respell:
Bāla Gopāl Jay Jay Sāīṃ Shyām
Prem Bharo Dil Meṃ Hamāre Sāīṃ Rām
Hamāre Sāīṃ Rām Baḍa़e Pyāre Sāīṃ Rām
[ Prem Bharo... ]
Ham Bhaktoṃ Ke Tum Ek Sāīṃ Rām
Tumhare Jagat Meṃ Baḍa़ā Pyārā Pyārā Nām
Saṅg Raho Har Dam Hamāre Sāīṃ Rām
Saṅg Raho Hamāre Sāīṃ Rām

title: Bala Gopala Sai Bala Gopala
lyrics:
Bala Gopala Sai Bala Gopala
Devaki Nandana Gopala
Vasudeva Nandana Gopala
Yashoda Nandana Gopala
Nanda Gopala Ananda Gopala
Sai Gopala Sathya Sai Gopala
meaning: Oh young Gopala, divine Sai, we lovingly remember you! You are the cherished son of Devaki and Vasudeva, fostered by Yashoda and Nanda, the very embodiment of bliss. We invoke you, Sai Gopala, Sathya Sai Gopala.
devanagari:
बाल गोपाला साई बाल गोपाला
देवकी नंदन गोपाला
वसुदेव नंदन गोपाला
यशोद्धा नंदन गोपाला
नंदा गोपाला आनंदा गोपाला
साई गोपाला सत्य साई गोपाला
respell:
Bāla Gopālā Sāī Bāla Gopālā
Devakī Nandana Gopālā
Vasudeva Nandana Gopālā
Yashoddhā Nandana Gopālā
Nandā Gopālā Ānandā Gopālā
Sāī Gopālā Satya Sāī Gopālā

title: Bansidhara Kanhaiya Ghana Shyama Sundara
lyrics:
Bansidhara Kanhaiya Ghana Shyama Sundara
Giridhari Gopa Bala Brindavana Vihara [ Bansidhara ... ]
Govinda Madhava Harey Madhusudhana Mukunda
Radhey ( Sai ) Govinda Radhey ( Sai ) Gopala Radhey ( Sai ) Govinda Radhey ( Sai )
meaning: Oh beautiful Krishna, dark as a cloud, you are the enchanting flute-player, the mountain-lifter, and the playful cowherd of Vrindavan. We lovingly chant your divine names – Govinda, Madhava, Madhusudhana, Mukunda – invoking you as Radha's beloved and as the divine Sai.
devanagari:
बंसिधरा कन्हैया घन श्याम सुंदरा
गिरिधारी गोप बाला ब्रिंदावन विहारा [ बंसिधरा ... ]
गोविन्द माधव हरे माधुसूदन मुकुंदा
राधे गोविन्द राधे गोपाल राधे गोविन्द राधे
साई गोविन्द साई गोपाल साई गोविन्द साई
respell:
Baṃsidharā Kanhaiyā Ghan Shyām Sundarā
Giridhārī Gop Bālā Brindāvan Vihārā [ Baṃsidharā ... ]
Govinda Mādhava Hare Mādhusūdana Mukundā
Rādhe Govinda Rādhe Gopāla Rādhe Govinda Rādhe
Sāī Govinda Sāī Gopāla Sāī Govinda Sāī

title: Beda Par Karo Mere Sai
lyrics:
Beda Paar Karo Mere Sai
Uddhar Karo Mere Baba
Allah Eshwar Sai Baba
Shirdi Baba Parthi Baba
Reham Nazar Karo Sai Baba
Daya Karo Sai Krupa Karo
meaning: This bhajan is a heartfelt plea to Sai Baba, asking him to guide and liberate the devotee through life's journey. It recognizes him as the universal divine, embodying Allah and Ishwar, manifest in both Shirdi and Parthi. The devotee earnestly requests his merciful gaze, compassion, and blessings.
devanagari:
बेडा पार करो मेरे साईं  
उद्धार करो मेरे बाबा [ बेडा पार ... ]  
अल्लाह ईश्वर साईं बाबा  
शिर्डी बाबा पर्ति बाबा  
रहम नज़र करो साईं बाबा  
दया करो साईं कृपा करो
respell:
Beḍā Pār Karo Mere Sāīṃ
Uddhār Karo Mere Bābā [ Beḍā Pār ... ]
Allāh Īshwar Sāīṃ Bābā
Shirḍī Bābā Parti Bābā
Raham Naja़r Karo Sāīṃ Bābā
Dayā Karo Sāīṃ Kṛupā Karo

title: Bhagawan Bhagawan Darshan Do Bhagawan
lyrics:
Bhagawan Bhagawan Darshan Do Bhagawan
Allah Sai Buddha Zoroastra
Nanak Sai Yeshu Mahavir
Sabke Malik Ek Hain Bhagawan
Parthi Pureeshwara Ram
meaning: O Lord, grant us Your divine vision. We recognize that figures like Allah, Buddha, Zoroaster, Nanak, Jesus, and Mahavir are all diverse manifestations of the one supreme God, who is You, the Lord of Puttaparthi.
devanagari:
भगवान भगवान दर्शन दो भगवान
अल्लाह साई बुद्ध जोहराष्ट्र
नानक साई येशु महावीर
सबका मालिक एक है भगवान
पर्ती पूरीश्वर राम
respell:
Bhagavān Bhagavān Darshan Do Bhagavān
Allāh Sāī Buddha Joharāshṭra
Nānak Sāī Yeshu Mahāvīr
Sabakā Mālik Ek Hai Bhagavān
Partī Pūrīshwar Rām

title: Bhagawan Bhagawan Patita Pavana Ram
lyrics:
Bhagawan Bhagawan Patita Pavana Ram
Daya Karo Daya Karo Daya Karo Bhagawan
Sai Patita Pavana Ram
Deenadayalu Parama Krupalu
Raksha Karo Bhagawan
Sai Krupa Karo Bhagawan
meaning: O Lord, purifier of the fallen, we earnestly seek your mercy. You are compassionate to the humble and supremely kind. Please grant us your protection and divine grace.
devanagari:
भगवान भगवान पतीत पावन राम  
दया करो दया करो दया करो भगवान  
पतीत पावन राम ( साई )  
दीन दयालु परम कृपालु  
रक्षा करो भगवान  
साई कृपा करो भगवान
respell:
Bhagavān Bhagavān Patīta Pāvan Rām
Dayā Karo Dayā Karo Dayā Karo Bhagavān
Patīta Pāvan Rām ( Sāī )
Dīna Dayālu Param Kṛupālu
Rakshā Karo Bhagavān
Sāī Kṛupā Karo Bhagavān

title: Bhairavi Ambe Bhavani
lyrics:
Bhairavi Ambe Bhavani
Jagadambe Ma Jagat Janani
Amba Bhairavi Ambe Bhavani
Narayani Patita Pavani
Parthipureeshwari Sai Janani
meaning: O Divine Mother Bhairavi, Amba, Bhavani, You are the Mother of the entire universe, its very creator. Narayani, purifier of all who have stumbled, You are the sovereign Goddess of Puttaparthi, our beloved Mother Sai.
devanagari:
भैरवी अम्बे भवानी
जगदम्बे मा जगत् जननी
अम्बा भैरवी अम्बे भवानी
नारायणी पतित पावनी
पर्तीपुरीश्वरी साई जननी
respell:
Bhairavī Ambe Bhavānī
Jagadambe Mā Jagat Jananī
Ambā Bhairavī Ambe Bhavānī
Nārāyaṇī Patita Pāvanī
Partīpurīshwarī Sāī Jananī

title: Bhaja Mana Krishna Gopal
lyrics:
Bhaja Mana Krishna Gopal
Bhaja Krishna Gopal Bhajo Manare
Bhajo Nanda Gopal Bhajore
Mukunda Gopal Bhajore
Bhaja Govindam Bhaja Govindam Bhaja Govindam Bhajore
meaning: O mind! Chant the name of Krishna; who is known as Gopala, Mukundha and Govinda; beloved son of Nanda.
devanagari:
भज मन कृष्ण गोपाल  
भज कृष्ण गोपाल भजो मनरे [ भज मन ... ]  
यदु नंद गोपाल भजोरें  
मुकुंद गोपाल भजोरें  
भज गोविंदं भज गोविंदं भज गोविंदं भजरे (2)
respell:
Bhaja Mana Kṛushṇa Gopāl
Bhaja Kṛushṇa Gopāl Bhajo Manare [ Bhaja Mana ... ]
Yadu Nanda Gopāl Bhajoreṃ
Mukund Gopāl Bhajoreṃ
Bhaja Govindaṃ Bhaja Govindaṃ Bhaja Govindaṃ Bhajare (2)

title: Bhaja Mana Panduranga Vitthala Jaya Vitthala
lyrics:
Bhaja Mana Panduranga Vitthala Jaya Vitthala
Purandhara Vitthala Vitthala Jaya Vitthala
Bhaja Mana Panduranga Vitthala Jaya Vitthala
Purandhara Vitthala Vitthala Jaya Vitthala
meaning: O my mind, devotedly worship Lord Panduranga Vitthala, the victorious divine presence. Glorify Vitthala, the beloved deity revered by Purandara Dasa, and chant His name with utmost devotion.
devanagari:
भज मन पांडुरंग विट्ठला जय विट्ठला
पुरंदर विट्ठला विट्ठला जय विट्ठला [ भज मन पांडुरंग ... ]
भज मन पांडुरंग विट्ठला जय विट्ठला
पुरंदर विट्ठला विट्ठला जय विट्ठला
respell:
Bhaja Mana Pāṇḍuraṅg Viṭṭhalā Jay Viṭṭhalā
Purandara Viṭṭhalā Viṭṭhalā Jay Viṭṭhalā [ Bhaja Mana Pāṇḍuraṅg ... ]
Bhaja Mana Pāṇḍuraṅg Viṭṭhalā Jay Viṭṭhalā
Purandara Viṭṭhalā Viṭṭhalā Jay Viṭṭhalā

title: Bhaja Mana Radhe Shyama Gopala
lyrics:
Bhaja Mana Radhe Shyama Gopala
Murali Manohara Radhe Gopala
Nandakishora Natavaralala
Parthi Vihara Sai Gopala
Parthi Vihara Prabhu Sai Gopala
meaning: O mind, adore Radha's Shyam, Gopala, the enchanting flute-player. He is Nanda's beloved son, the divine dancer, now manifest as Sai Gopala, residing in Parthi.
devanagari:
भज मन राधे श्याम गोपाला
मुरली मनोहर राधे गोपाला [ भज मन राधे ... ]
नंद किशोरा नटवर लाला (2)
पर्ती विहारा साई गोपाला
respell:
Bhaja Mana Rādhe Shyām Gopālā
Muralī Manohar Rādhe Gopālā [ Bhaja Mana Rādhe ... ]
Nanda Kishorā Naṭavar Lālā (2)
Partī Vihārā Sāī Gopālā

title: Bhaja Mana Ram Bhaja Mana Ram
lyrics:
Bhaja Mana Ram Bhaja Mana Ram
Panduranga Sri Ranga Bhaja Mana Ram
Bhaja Mana Madhava Bhaja Mana Keshava
Bhaja Mana Yadava Bhaja Mana Ram
Bhaja Mana Mukunda Bhaja Mana Govinda
Bhaja Mana Ananda Bhaja Mana Ram
(Panduranga Sri Ranga..)
meaning:
Chant the holy name of Ram
Chant the holy name of Panduranga
Chant the holy names of Mahava and Keshava 
Chant the holy names of Mukunda and Govinda
Chant the name of Mukunda who bestows ultimate happiness
devanagari:
भज मन राम भज मन राम
पांडुरंग श्री रंग भज मन राम
भज मन माधव भज मन केशव
भज मन यादव भज मन राम
[ पांडुरंग श्री ... ]
भज मन मुकुंद भज मन गोविंद
भज मन आनंद भज मन राम
[ पांडुरंग श्री ... ]
respell:
Bhaja Mana Rām Bhaja Mana Rām
Pāṇḍuraṅg Shrī Raṅg Bhaja Mana Rām
Bhaja Mana Mādhava Bhaja Mana Keshav
Bhaja Mana Yādava Bhaja Mana Rām
[ Pāṇḍuraṅg Shrī ... ]
Bhaja Mana Mukund Bhaja Mana Govind
Bhaja Mana Ānanda Bhaja Mana Rām
[ Pāṇḍuraṅg Shrī ... ]

title: Bhaja Mana Shyama Sundara Giridhari
lyrics:
Bhaja Mana Shyama Sundara Giridhari
Mora Mukuta Peetambara Dhari
Madhura Madhura Hey Muralidhari
Meera Ke Prabhu Giridhara Naagara
Giridhara Naagara
Govardhana Dhara Shyama (Sai) Murari
meaning: O mind, meditate on the beautiful, dark-hued Krishna, the lifter of Govardhana Mountain. He wears a peacock feather crown and yellow robes, plays a sweet flute, and is the cherished Lord of Meera.
devanagari:
भज मन श्याम सुंदर गिरिधारी
मोर मुकुट पीताम्बर धारी
मधुरा मधुरा हे मुरलीधारी
मीरा के प्रभु गिरिधर नागर
गोवर्धन धर श्याम (साई) मुरारी
respell:
Bhaja Mana Shyām Sundara Giridhārī
Mora Mukuṭ Pītāmbara Dhārī
Madhurā Madhurā He Muralīdhārī
Mīrā Ke Prabhu Giridhara Nāgar
Govardhana Dhara shyām (sāī) murārī

title: Bhaja Mana Shyama Sundara Giridhari
lyrics:
Bhaja Mana Shyama Sundara Giridhari
Mora Mukuta Peetambaradhari
Meera Ke Prabhu Giridhara Nagara
Giridhara Nagara Giridhara Nagara
Meera Ke Prabhu Giridhara Nagara
Murali Manohara Shyama Murari
meaning: O mind, lovingly chant the name of Shyam Sundara, the beautiful dark Lord who lifted the mountain, adorned with a peacock crown and yellow garments. He is Mira's beloved, the enchanting flutist, Shyam Murari.
devanagari:
भज मन श्याम सुन्दर गिरधारी
मोर मुकुट पीताम्बरधारी
मीरा के प्रभु गिरधर नागर
गिरधर नागर गिरधर नागर
मीरा के प्रभु गिरधर नागर
मुरली मनोहर श्याम मुरारी
respell:
Bhaja Mana Shyām Sundara Giradhārī
Mora Mukuṭ Pītāmbaradhārī
Mīrā Ke Prabhu Giradhara Nāgar
Giradhara Nāgar Giradhara Nāgar
Mīrā Ke Prabhu Giradhara Nāgar
Muralī Manohar Shyām Murārī

title: Bhaja Mana Sita Ram
lyrics:
Bhaja Mana Sita Ram
Bhaja Mana Sri Raghuram Sai Ram
Bhaja Mana Sita Ram
Bhajare Manasa Bhaja Sai Ram
Bhajo Bhajo Parthi Baba Nam
Bhajo Bhajo Bhajo Parthi Baba Nam
meaning: Worship Lord Rama by always keeping His Divine Name in the mind. The Divine consort of Sita, The scion of Raghu dynasty and the Lord of Puttaparthi!
devanagari:
भज मन सीता राम
भज मन श्री रघुराम साई राम
भज मन सीता राम
भजरे मानस भज साई राम
भजो भजो पर्ती बाबा नाम
भजो भजो भजो पर्ती बाबा नाम
respell:
Bhaja Mana Sītā Rām
Bhaja Mana Shrī Raghurām Sāī Rām
Bhaja Mana Sītā Rām
Bhajare Mānasa Bhaja Sāī Rām
Bhajo Bhajo Partī Bābā Nām
Bhajo Bhajo Bhajo Partī Bābā Nām

title: Bhaja Ramam Bhaja Ramam
lyrics:
Bhaja Ramam Bhaja Ramam
Bhajare Manasa Bhaja Ramam
Kalyana Ramam Bhaja Ramam
Kodanda Ramam Bhaja Ramam
Pattabhi Ramam Bhaja Ramam
Pavana Namam Bhaja Ramam
Bhava Taraka Namam Bhaja Ramam
meaning: O mind, ceaselessly chant the name of Rama, the benevolent Lord, who wields the mighty Kodanda bow and reigns as the crowned king. His pure and sacred name alone liberates us from the cycle of worldly existence.
devanagari:
भज रामम् भज रामम्
भज रे मानस भज रामम्
कल्याण रामम् भज रामम्
कोदण्ड रामम् भज रामम्
पट्टाभि रामम् भज रामम्
पावन नामम् भज रामम्
भव तारक नामम् भज रामम्
respell:
Bhaja Rāmam Bhaja Rāmam
Bhaj Re Mānasa Bhaj rāmam
Kalyāṇ Rāmam Bhaja Rāmam
Kodaṇḍa Rāmam Bhaja Rāmam
Paṭṭābhi Rāmam Bhaja Rāmam
Pāvan Nāmam Bhaja Rāmam
Bhava Tārak Nāmam Bhaja Rāmam

title: Bhaja Ranga Hare Vitthala
lyrics:
Bhaja Ranga Hare Vitthala
Panduranga Hare Vitthala
Sai Ranga Hare Panduranga Hare
Bhaja Rakhumayi Ranga Vitthala
Panduranga Hare Vitthala
---
Vitthala Vitthala Panduranga Vitthala
Vitthala Vitthala Parthi Ranga Vitthala
Panduranga Hare Vitthala
meaning: Chant the Holy name of Lord Vittala. Glory to Lord Panduranga, the consort of Rakumayi. Sing the glory of Lord Sai who is none other than Lord Vittala.
devanagari:
भज रंगा हरे विट्ठला
पांडुरंगा हरे विट्ठला
साई रंगा हरे पांडुरंगा हरे
भज रखुमाई रंग विट्ठला
पांडुरंगा हरे विट्ठला
---
विट्ठल विट्ठल पांडुरंग विट्ठल
विट्ठल विट्ठल पर्ती रंगा विट्ठल
पांडुरंगा हरे विट्ठला
respell:
Bhaja Raṅgā Hare Viṭṭhalā
Pāṇḍuraṅgā Hare Viṭṭhalā
Sāī Raṅgā Hare Pāṇḍuraṅgā Hare
Bhaja Rakhumāī Raṅg Viṭṭhalā
Pāṇḍuraṅgā Hare Viṭṭhalā
---
Viṭṭhala Viṭṭhala Pāṇḍuraṅg Viṭṭhala
Viṭṭhala Viṭṭhala Partī Raṅgā Viṭṭhala
Pāṇḍuraṅgā Hare Viṭṭhalā

title: Bhajana Karo Manuva Govinda Hare
lyrics:
Bhajana Karo Manuva Govinda Hare
Govinda Murari Gopala Murari
Mathuranatha Hey Giridhari
Radha Madhava Hey Giridhari
meaning: O mind, worship Lord Krishna, known by many names - Govinda, Murari, Gopala, the Lord of Mathura, Giridhari, the Lord of Radha.
devanagari:
भजन करो मनुवा गोविन्दा हरे
गोविन्द मुरारी गोपाल मुरारी [ भजन करो ... ]
मथुरा नाथा हे गिरिधारी
राधा माधव हे गिरिधारी (2)
respell:
Bhajan Karo Manuvā Govindā Hare
Govinda Murārī Gopāla Murārī [ Bhajan Karo ... ]
Mathurā Nāthā He Giridhārī
Rādhā Mādhava He Giridhārī (2)

title: Bhajare Manasa Sai Ram
lyrics:
Bhajare Manasa Sai Ram
Parthipuri Ke Sai Bhagawan
Eshwar Allah Tere Nam
Yeshu Buddha Bhi Tere Nam
Shirdipuri Ke Sai Bhagawan
Parthipuri Ke Sai Bhagawan
meaning: O mind, worship Sai Ram, the divine Lord of Parthi. You are known by countless names – Ishwar, Allah, Jesus, and Buddha – embodying the one God of Shirdi and Parthi.
devanagari:
भजरे मानस साई राम
पर्तीपुरी के साई भगवान
ईश्वर अल्लाह तेरे नाम
येशु बुद्ध भी तेरे नाम
शिरडीपुरी के साई भगवान
पर्तीपुरी के साई भगवान
respell:
Bhajare Mānasa Sāī Rām
Partīpurī Ke Sāī Bhagavān
Īshwar Allāh Tere Nām
Yeshu Buddha Bhī Tere Nām
Shiraḍīpurī Ke Sāī Bhagavān
Partīpurī Ke Sāī Bhagavān

title: Bhajare Rama Charan Satatam Bhajare Rama Charan
lyrics:
Bhajare Rama Charan Satatam Bhajare Rama Charan
Bhajare Janaki Jeevana Ramam
Bhajare Ramam Bhadrachala Ramam
Bhajare Pavana Taraka Namam
Bhajare Sri Rama Rameti Ramam
meaning: Let us constantly worship the sacred feet of Lord Rama. We adore Rama, the beloved life of Janaki, the divine resident of Bhadrachala, whose pure name liberates all. Let us chant "Sri Rama, Rama" and immerse ourselves in His divine presence.
devanagari:
भजरे राम चरण सततम् भजरे राम चरण
भजरे जानकी जीवन रामम्
भजरे रामम् भद्राचल रामम्
भजरे पावन तारक नामम्
भजरे श्री राम रामेति रामम्
respell:
Bhajare Rām Charaṇ Satatam Bhajare Rām Charaṇ
Bhajare Jānakī Jīvan Rāmam
Bhajare Rāmam Bhadrāchala Rāmam
Bhajare Pāvan Tārak Nāmam
Bhajare Shrī Rām Rāmeti Rāmam

title: Bhajo Bhajo Ram Sathya Sai Ram
lyrics:
Bhajo Bhajo Ram Sathya Sai Ram
Bhajo Bhajo Shyam Sai Ghana Shyam [ Bhajo Bhajo ... ]
Kali Yug Ke Avatar
Jagadodhara Sai Bhagawan
Patitha Pavana Sita Ram ( Sai Ram )
meaning: Oh Lord Sai, we earnestly chant Your names, Ram and Shyam, recognizing You as the divine incarnation of the Kali Yuga. You are the savior of the universe, the compassionate purifier who redeems all fallen souls, embodying the essence of Sita Ram.
devanagari:
भजो भजो राम सत्य साईं राम
भजो भजो श्याम साईं घन श्याम [ भजो भजो ... ]
कली युग के अवतार
जगतोद्धारा साईं भगवान
पतित पावन सीता राम ( साईं राम )
respell:
Bhajo Bhajo Rām Satya Sāīṃ Rām
Bhajo Bhajo Shyām Sāīṃ Ghan Shyām [ Bhajo Bhajo ... ]
Kalī Yug Ke Avatār
Jagatoddhārā Sāīṃ Bhagavān
Patita Pāvan Sītā Rām ( Sāīṃ Rām )

title: Bhajo Bhajo Vitthala Panduranga Vitthala
lyrics:
Bhajo Bhajo Vitthala Panduranga Vitthala
Pandari Natha Panduranga Bhajo Mana Vitthala
Partheeshwara Sai Natha Vitthala
Parameshwara Sathya Sai Vitthala
Rakhumayi Vitthala Ranga Sai Vitthala
meaning: This bhajan is a heartfelt invitation to continuously chant the name of Lord Vittala, the divine ruler of Pandharpur. It reveres him as the Supreme Being, manifest also as Sai Nath of Parthi, and the beloved consort of Rakumayi.
devanagari:
भजो भजो विट्ठला पांडुरंग विट्ठला  
पंढरी नाथ पांडुरंग भजो मन विट्ठला [ भजो भजो ... ]  
पर्तिश्वरा साई नाथा विट्ठला  
परमेश्वरा सत्य साई विट्ठला  
रकुमाई विट्ठला रंग साई विट्ठला
respell:
Bhajo Bhajo Viṭṭhalā Pāṇḍuraṅg Viṭṭhalā
Paṇḍharī Nātha Pāṇḍuraṅg Bhajo Mana Viṭṭhalā [ Bhajo Bhajo ... ]
Partishwarā Sāī Nāthā Viṭṭhalā
Parameshwarā Satya Sāī Viṭṭhalā
Rakumāī Viṭṭhalā Raṅg Sāī Viṭṭhalā

title: Bhajo Gananayaka Gajavadana
lyrics:
Bhajo Gananayaka Gajavadana
Mangala Dayaka Shubhacharana
Siddhi Vinayaka Shiva Nandana
Ananda Dayaka Chitta Chandana
Buddhi Pradayaka Jaga Vandana
meaning: This bhajan praises Ganesha, the elephant-headed deity and son of Shiva, whose sacred presence brings blessings and success. He grants profound joy and wisdom, and is revered by all creation.
devanagari:
भजो गणनायक गजवदना   
मंगल दायक शुभ चरणा  
[ भजो गणनायक ... ]  
सिद्धि विनायक शिव नंदना   
आनंद दायक चित चंदना 
बुद्धि प्रदायक जग वंदना
respell:
Bhajo Gaṇanāyak Gajavadanā
Maṅgal Dāyak Shubh Charaṇā
[ Bhajo Gaṇanāyak ... ]
Siddhi Vināyak Shiv Nandanā
Ānanda Dāyak Chita Chandanā
Buddhi Pradāyak Jaga Vandanā

title: Bhajo Ghana Shyama Bhajo Murali Gopala Bhajo
lyrics:
Bhajo Ghana Shyama Bhajo Murali Gopala Bhajo
Nanda Ke Lal Bhajo (Radhey) (2)
Giridhara Gopala Mathura Natha
Kamala Nayana Hey Kaivalya Dhama [ Nanda Ke ... ]
meaning: Chant the name of  Krishna, the dark-hued flute player and Nanda's cherished son. Meditate on the mountain-bearer, the sovereign of Mathura, whose lotus eyes reveal the ultimate abode of liberation.
devanagari:
भजो घन श्याम भजो मुरली गोपाल भजो
नन्द के लाल भजो (राधे) (2)
गिरिधर गोपाला  मथुरा नाथा 
कमल नयन हे कैवल्य धामा [नन्द के ]
respell:
Bhajo Ghan Shyām Bhajo Muralī Gopāla Bhajo
Nanda Ke Lāl Bhajo (rādhe) (2)
Giridhara Gopālā  Mathurā Nāthā
Kamala Nayan He Kaivalya Dhāmā [nand Ke ]

title: Bhajo Madhura Hari Nam Nirantara Bhajo Madhura Hari Nam
lyrics:
Bhajo Madhura Hari Nam Nirantara Bhajo Madhura Hari Nam
Sarala Bhav Se Sai Bhajo
Madhura Bhav Se Baba Bhajo
Hari Hi Sukh Hai Hari Hi Shanti
Hari Prasanthi Nivasi Ram
meaning: Continuously chant the sweet name of Hari. With simple and loving devotion, remember Sai and Baba, for Hari is the very essence of joy and tranquility. This divine Hari, who is Ram, resides in Prashanthi.
devanagari:
भजो मधुर हरि नाम निरंतर भजो मधुर हरि नाम  
सरल भाव से साईं भजो  
मधुर भाव से बाबा भजो  
हरि ही सुख है हरि ही शांति  
हरि प्रशांति निवासी राम
respell:
Bhajo Madhura Hari Nām Nirantara Bhajo Madhura Hari Nām
Saral Bhāv Se Sāīṃ Bhajo
Madhura Bhāv Se Bābā Bhajo
Hari Hī Sukh Hai Hari Hī Shānti
Hari Prashānti Nivāsī Rām

title: Bhajo Mana Bhajo Ram Ram Ram
lyrics:
Bhajo Mana Bhajo Ram Ram Ram
Sri Ram Sri Ram Ram
Sri Ram Ram Ram Ram
Bhajo Bhajo Mana Baba Nam
Bhajo Bhajo Mana Sai Nam
Ram Ram Ram Ram
Sri Ram Ram Ram Ram
meaning: O mind, dedicate yourself to the sacred repetition of Lord Rama's name. Constantly invoke the divine by chanting the names of Baba and Sai.
devanagari:
भजो मन भजो राम राम राम
श्री राम श्री राम राम
श्री राम राम राम राम
भजो भजो मन बाबा नाम
भजो भजो मन साई नाम
राम राम राम राम
श्री राम राम राम राम
respell:
Bhajo Mana Bhajo Rām Rām Rām
Shrī Rām Shrī Rām Rām
Shrī Rām Rām Rām Rām
Bhajo Bhajo Mana Bābā Nām
Bhajo Bhajo Mana Sāī Nām
Rām Rām Rām Rām
Shrī Rām Rām Rām Rām

title: Bhajo Radhe Govinda Bhajo Shyama Gopal
lyrics:
Bhajo Radhey Govinda Bhajo Shyama Gopal
Shyama Gopal Bhajo Murali Gopal [ Bhajo Radhey ... ]
Keshava Narahari Shyama Gopal
Madhava Murahara Murali Gopal
meaning: Chant the sacred names of Krishna, the beloved of Radha, the dark-hued cowherd. Meditate upon the flute-player, the slayer of Mura, known also as Keshava and Madhava.
devanagari:
भजो राधे गोविन्द भजो श्याम गोपाल  
श्याम गोपाल भजो मुरली गोपाल [ भजो राधे ... ]  
केशव नरहरी श्याम गोपाल  
माधव मुरहारा मुरली गोपाल
respell:
Bhajo Rādhe Govinda Bhajo Shyām Gopāl
Shyām Gopāl Bhajo Muralī Gopāl [ Bhajo Rādhe ... ]
Keshav Naraharī Shyām Gopāl
Mādhava Murahārā Muralī Gopāl

title: Bhajo Sita Ram Bhajo Radhe Shyam
lyrics:
Bhajo Sita Ram Bhajo Radhe Shyam
Govinda Gopala Sai Hare Ram
Keshava Madhava Radha Vallabha
Varada Narayana Nayanabhi Ram
Govinda Gopala Sai Hare Ram
meaning: Chant the divine names of Sita-Ram and Radha-Shyam, invoking the beloved forms of the Lord. We call upon Govinda, Gopala, Sai, and Hare Ram, along with Keshava, Madhava, and Radha's own beloved. O Narayana, giver of blessings and beauty to our eyes, we praise your glorious presence.
devanagari:
भजो सीता राम भजो राधे श्याम
गोविंद गोपाल साई हरे राम
केशव माधव राधा वल्लभ
वरद नारायण नयनभि राम
गोविंद गोपाल साई हरे राम
respell:
Bhajo Sītā Rām Bhajo Rādhe Shyām
Govind Gopāla Sāī Hare Rām
Keshav Mādhava Rādhā Vallabh
Varad Nārāyaṇ Nayanabhi Rām
Govind Gopāla Sāī Hare Rām

title: Bhajore Bhajore Gananatham Bhajore
lyrics:
Bhajore Bhajore Gananatham Bhajore
Buddhi Pradayaka Papa Vinashaka
Vighnesham Bhajore
Abhaya Pradayaka Ananda Dayaka
Shiva Nandanam Bhajore Gananatham Bhajore
meaning: Oh, let us chant the name of Gananatha, the Lord who bestows wisdom and eradicates all our transgressions. We worship Vighnesha, the son of Shiva, who grants fearlessness and fills our hearts with pure bliss.
devanagari:
भजोरे भजोरे गणनाथम् भजोरे
बुद्धि प्रदायक पाप विनाशक
विघ्नेशम् भजोरे
अभय प्रदायक आनंद दायक
शिव नंदनम् भजोरे गणनाथम् भजोरे
respell:
Bhajore Bhajore Gaṇanātham Bhajore
Buddhi Pradāyak Pāpa Vināshak
Vighnesham Bhajore
Abhaya Pradāyak Ānanda Dāyak
Shiv Nandanam Bhajore Gaṇanātham Bhajore

title: Bhajore Sada Bhajo Rama Krishna Govinda
lyrics:
Bhajore Sada Bhajo Rama Krishna Govinda
Bhajo Hari Deena Bandhu Krishna Rama Govinda
Bhajore Anatha Natha Sai Rama Govinda
Bhajo Hari Deena Bandhu Krishna Rama Govinda
