meaning: Always chant the holy names of Rama, Krishna, and Govinda. These divine names, including Sai, are the compassionate friends of the humble and the ultimate refuge for the forlorn.
devanagari:
भजोरे सदा भजो राम कृष्ण गोविन्दा 
भजो हरि दीन बन्धु कृष्णा रामा गोविन्दा 
भजोरे अनाथ नाथ साई रामा गोविन्दा 
भजो हरि दीन बन्धु कृष्णा रामा गोविन्दा
respell:
Bhajore Sadā Bhajo Rām Kṛushṇa Govindā
Bhajo Hari Dīna Bandhu Kṛushṇā Rāmā Govindā
Bhajore Anātha Nātha Sāī Rāmā Govindā
Bhajo Hari Dīna Bandhu Kṛushṇā Rāmā Govindā

title: Bhajore Bhai Sai Ram
lyrics:
Bhajorey Bhai Sai Ram
Shirdipureesha Sai Ram
Puttaparthipureesha Sai Ram
Bhajorey Bhai Sai Ram
Dwarakamayi Sai Ram
Sada Sukha Dayi Sai Ram
Shirdipureesha Sai Ram
Puttaparthipureesha Sai Ram
meaning: Worship Lord Sai Ram, the Lord of Puttaparthi, Dwaraka and Shirdi. He always grants happiness to all.
devanagari:
भजोरें भाई साई राम  
शिर्डी (पर्ती) पूरीशा साई राम [ भजोरें भाई ... ]  
द्वारकामाई साई राम  
सदा सुख दाई साई राम  
शिर्डी (पर्ती) पूरेश साई राम
respell:
Bhajoreṃ Bhāī Sāī Rām
Shirḍī (partī) Pūrīshā Sāī Rām [ Bhajoreṃ Bhāī ... ]
Dwārakāmāī Sāī Rām
Sadā Sukh Dāī Sāī Rām
Shirḍī (partī) Pūresh Sāī Rām

title: Bhajorey Bhai Sai Ram
lyrics:
Bhajorey Bhai Sai Ram
Sai Sab Ka Hai Bhagawan [ Bhajorey Bhai ... ]
Ram Hi Sai Krishna Hi Sai
Yuga Avatara Narayana Sai [ Sai Sab Ka ... ]
meaning: Chant the name of Sai Ram, o brother, for Sai is the universal Lord. He is none other than Rama, Krishna, and Narayana, the divine incarnation who has manifested for this present age.
devanagari:
भजोरें भाई साई राम  
साई सब का है भगवान [ भजोरें भाई ... ]  
राम ही साई कृष्ण ही साई  
युग अवतार नारायण साई [ साई सब का ... ]
respell:
Bhajoreṃ Bhāī Sāī Rām
Sāī Sab Kā Hai Bhagavān [ Bhajoreṃ Bhāī ... ]
Rām Hī Sāī Kṛushṇa Hī Sāī
Yug Avatāra Nārāyaṇ Sāī [ Sāī Sab Kā ... ]

title: Bhajore Bhajo Sai Hare Ram
lyrics:
Bhajore Bhajo Sai Hare Ram
Govinda Gopala Sai Hare Ram
Madhava Mohana Sai Hare Ram
Sri Madhusudana Bhava Bhaya Bhanjana
Bharey Premanand Se Bolo Ram Hare Ram
Govinda Gopala Sai Hare Ram
Madhava Mohana Sai Hare Ram
meaning: Devote yourself to chanting the sacred names of Sai, who embodies Govinda, Gopala, Madhava, and Mohana. This divine Madhusudana dispels the fear of worldly existence; therefore, utter these names with profound love and blissful joy.
devanagari:
भजोरें भजो साईं हरे राम  
गोविन्द गोपाल साईं हरे राम  
माधव मोहन साईं हरे राम (हे) [ भजोरें भजो ... ]  
श्री मधुसूदन भव भय भंजन  
भरे प्रेमानंद से बोलो राम हरे राम  
गोविन्द गोपाल साईं हरे राम [ माधव मोहन ... ]
respell:
Bhajoreṃ Bhajo Sāīṃ Hare Rām
Govinda Gopāla Sāīṃ Hare Rām
Mādhava Mohan Sāīṃ Hare Rām (he) [ Bhajoreṃ Bhajo ... ]
Shrī Madhusūdana Bhava Bhaya Bhañjana
Bhare Premānand Se Bolo Rām Hare Rām
Govinda Gopāla Sāīṃ Hare Rām [ Mādhava Mohan ... ]

title: Bhajare Manuva Sadguru Deva
lyrics:
Bhajore Manuva Sadguru Deva
Parama Krupalo Sai Mahadeva
Nis Din Dhyan Karoon Mein Tera
Janam Janam Ka Mite Andhera
Para Brahma Parameshwara Roopa (Deva)
Parama Krupalo Sai Mahadeva
meaning: O Mind, chant and worship Lord Sai who is the supreme God and preceptor. O Lord, from the day I started meditating on You, the ignorance accumulated from several births is vanished. You are the Supreme God.
devanagari:
भजोरे मनुवा सद्गुरु देवा
परम कृपालु साई महादेवा
[ भजोरे मनुवा ... ]
निस दिन ध्यान करूँ मैं तेरा
जनम जनम का मिटे अंधेरा
परब्रह्म परमेश्वर रूपा (देवा)
[ परम कृपालु ... ]
respell:
Bhajore Manuvā Sadguru Devā
Param Kṛupālu Sāī Mahādevā
[ Bhajore Manuvā ... ]
Nis Din Dhyān Karūm̐ Maiṃ Terā
Janam Janam Kā Miṭe Andherā
Parabrahma Parameshwar Rūpā (devā)
[ Param Kṛupālu ... ]

title: Bhakta Vatsala Tero Nam O Sai
lyrics:
Bhakta Vatsala Tero Nam O Sai
Dukha Bhanjana Tero Nam O Sai
Tum Sang Bandhi Prem Ki Dori
Sumiran Karoon Tero Nam O Sai
Patitoddharana Bhakta Parayana
Partheeshwara Sairam
meaning: O Sai, Your name is deeply cherished by devotees and eradicates all suffering. We are tied to You by a bond of pure love, prompting us to constantly meditate on Your name. You are the redeemer of the fallen and the ultimate haven for all who surrender to You, O Lord of Parthi.
devanagari:
भक्त वत्सल तेरो नाम ओ साई
दुख भंजन तेरो नाम ओ साई
तुम संग बाँधी प्रेम की डोरी
सुमिरन करूँ तेरो नाम ओ साई
पतितोद्धारणा भक्त परायण
पर्तीश्वर साई राम
respell:
Bhakta Vatsal Tero Nām O Sāī
Dukha Bhañjana Tero Nām O Sāī
Tum Saṅg Bām̐dhī Prem Kī Ḍorī
Sumiran Karūm̐ Tero Nām O Sāī
Patitoddhāraṇā Bhakta Parāyaṇ
Partīshwar Sāī Rām

title: Bhakthon Ne Hai Aaj Pukara
lyrics:
Bhakthon Ne Hai Aaj Pukara
Hum Ne Pukara Baba Sab Ne Pukara
Deejo Deejo Hum Ko Sahara
Aana Hi Padega Baba Aana Hi Padega
Shirdi Se Aao Chahey Parthi Se Aao
Mathura Se Aao Ya Ayodhya Se Aao
Mecca Se Aao Ya Madina Se Aao
O Merey Baba (Maulah) O Merey Sai Tum Kahin Se Bhi Aao [ Aana Hi Padega ... ]
meaning: Oh Baba, we, your devotees, call out to You today, earnestly seeking Your support and solace. You simply must come, whether from Shirdi, Parthi, Mathura, Ayodhya, Mecca, or Madina – Oh my Sai, please come to us from wherever You may be!

title: Bhasma Bhooshitanga Sai Chandrashekhara
lyrics:
Bhasma Bhooshitanga Sai Chandrashekhara
Phala Netra Shooladhari Sai Shankara
Sama Gana Priyakara Sai Shankara
Hara Hara Hara Shiva Shambho Natana Shekhara
Parthi Vasa Sai Deva Sai Shankara
Sai Shankara Sathya Sai Shankara
meaning: This bhajan reveres Lord Shiva, adorned with sacred ash, the moon, a third eye, and a trident. It hails him as the connoisseur of Sama Veda music and the cosmic dancer, embodying Sai Shankara, the divine presence residing in Parthi.
devanagari:
भस्म भूषितांग साई चंद्रशेखरा
फाल नेत्र शूलधारी साई शंकरा [ भस्म भूषितंगा ... ]
साम गान प्रियकरा साई शंकरा
हर हर हर शिव शंभो नटना शेखरा
पर्ती वसा साई देव साई शंकरा
साई शंकरा सत्य साई शंकरा
respell:
Bhasma Bhūshitāṅga Sāī Chandrashekharā
Phāla Netra Shūladhārī Sāī Shaṅkarā [ Bhasma Bhūshitaṅgā ... ]
Sām Gān Priyakarā Sāī Shaṅkarā
Har Har Har Shiv Shambho Naṭanā Shekharā
Partī Vasā Sāī Deva Sāī Shaṅkarā
Sāī Shaṅkarā Satya Sāī Shaṅkarā

title: Bhasma Vibhushita Bhavani Shankara
lyrics:
Bhasma Vibhushitha Bhavani Shankara
Bhava Bhaya Nasha Bhola Shankara
Hara Hara Shankara Samba Shiva
Hara Hara Shankara Sai Shiva
Om Namah Shivaya Shivaya Namah Om (3)
meaning: O Lord Shankara, adorned with sacred ash and beloved of Bhavani, you are the innocent one who destroys the fear of worldly existence. We hail you, Shiva, who is with Uma and manifest as Sai, as we continuously chant "Om Namah Shivaya."
devanagari:
भस्म विभूषित भवानी शंकर  
भव भय नाश भोला शंकर  
हर हर शंकर सांब शिवा
हर हर शंकर साई शिवा
ॐ नमः शिवाय शिवाय नमः ॐ(3)
respell:
Bhasma Vibhūshit Bhavānī Shaṅkar
Bhava Bhaya Nāsha Bholā Shaṅkar
Har Har Shaṅkar Sāmb Shivā
Har Har Shaṅkar Sāī Shivā
Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy Shivāy Namaḥ Oṃ(3)

title: Bhava Bhaya Harana Vandita Charana
lyrics:
Bhava Bhaya Harana Vandita Charana
Jaya Radha Jaya Madhava Shourie
Jaya Radha Jaya Madhava
Mangala Charana Kalimala Dahana
Narayana Keshava
Jaya Radha Jaya Madhava Shourie
Jaya Radha Jaya Madhava
meaning: This bhajan offers deep reverence to the Lord's sacred feet, which dispel the fears of worldly existence and purify the soul by burning away the impurities of the Kali Yuga. It celebrates the divine glory of Radha and Krishna, invoking them as the auspicious Narayana and Keshava.
devanagari:
भव भय हरणा वन्दिता चरणा
जय राधा जय माधवा (शौरी)
मंगल चरणा कालिमल दहना
नारायणा केशवा (साई) [ जय राधा ... ]
respell:
Bhava Bhaya Haraṇā Vanditā Charaṇā
Jaya Rādhā Jaya Mādhavā (shaurī)
Maṅgal Charaṇā Kālimala Dahanā
Nārāyaṇā Keshavā (sāī) [ Jaya Rādhā ... ]

title: Bhavanasha Puttaparthi Pureesha
lyrics:
Bhavanasha Puttaparthipurisha
Jaya Shiva Shankara Hey Paramesha 
Bhavanasha Puttaparthipurisha
Mrityumjaya Himashailagireesha
Mohanakara Mana Mohana Vinasha
Jyothi Prakasha Sathya Saisha
Jaya Shiva Shankara Hey Paramesha
meaning: Oh Lord Sai, dweller of Puttaparthi, you destroy the cycle of birth and death. Victory to you, Shiva Shankara, supreme Lord of the universe and Lord of the snow-clad mountains, who conquers death, removes all mental delusion, and shines as the divine light of Sathya Sai.
devanagari:
भव नाशा पुट्टपर्ती पूरीशा
जय शिव शंकर हे जगदीशा [ भव नाशा ... ]  
मृत्युञ्जय हिम शैल गिरिशा  
मोहनकार मन मोह विनाशा  
ज्योति प्रकाशा सत्य साईशा  
जय शिव शंकर हे परमेशा
respell:
Bhava Nāshā Puṭṭapartī Pūrīshā
Jaya Shiv Shaṅkar He Jagadīshā [ Bhava Nāshā ... ]
Mṛutyuñjaya Him Shail Girishā
Mohanakār Mana Moha Vināshā
Jyoti Prakāshā Satya Sāīshā
Jaya Shiv Shaṅkar He Parameshā

title: Bhava Sagar Se Par Utaro
lyrics:
Bhava Sagar Se Par Utaro
Sai Nath Bhagawan
Allah Yeshu Buddha Mahavira
Sab Namon Ki Ek Hai Mahima
Sarva Dharma Ke Palan Hare
Sai Nath Bhagawan
meaning: O Lord Sai Nath, please ferry me across the ocean of worldly existence. The divine essence of Allah, Jesus, Buddha, and Mahavira is one and the same, for you are the protector and nurturer of all religions.
devanagari:
भव सागर से पार उतारो
साईं नाथ भगवान [ भव सागर ... ]
अल्लाह येसु बुद्ध महावीर
सब नामों की एक है महिमा
सर्व धर्म के पालनहार [ साईं नाथ भगवान ]
respell:
Bhava Sāgar Se Pār Utāro
Sāīṃ Nāth Bhagavān [ Bhava Sāgar ... ]
Allāh Yesu Buddha Mahāvīr
Sab Nāmoṃ Kī Ek Hai Mahimā
Sarwa Dharma Ke Pālanahār [ Sāīṃ Nāth Bhagavān ]

title: Bhavani Nandana Bala Gajanana
lyrics:
Bhavani Nandana Bala Gajanana
Pranava Swaroopa Pahi
Parthipureeshwara Sai
Hey Parthipureeshwara Sai
meaning: O young Gajanana, beloved son of Mother Bhavani, you are the very embodiment of the sacred sound Om. We earnestly seek your protection, O Lord Sai, divine ruler of Parthi.
devanagari:
भवानी नन्दन बाल गजानन
प्रणव स्वरूपा पाहि
पर्तीपूरीश्वर साई
हे पर्तीपूरीश्वर साई
respell:
Bhavānī Nandana Bāla Gajānana
Praṇava Swarūpā Pāhi
Partīpūrīshwar Sāī
He Partīpūrīshwar Sāī

title: Bhola Bhandari Baba Shiva Shiva Shiva Sai Baba
lyrics:
Bhola Bhandari Baba Shiva Shiva Shiva Sai Baba
Anatha Rakshaka Deena Dayala Patita Pavana Sai Baba [Bhola Bandari.. ]
Yogeshwara Sai Murari Yogeshwara Hey Tripurari
Nityananda Brahmananda Premananda Sai Baba
meaning: "O Sai Baba, You are Shiva, Krishna, and the Supreme Divine in one. You are the protector of the helpless, the giver of compassion and grace, the Lord of Yoga, and the source of eternal bliss and divine love. We seek Your guidance, protection, and blessings so that our lives may be filled with peace, devotion, and spiritual fulfillment
devanagari:
भोला भंडारी बाबा शिव शिव शिव साईं बाबा
अनाथ रक्षक दीन दयाला पतित पावन साईं बाबा [ भोला भंडारी ... ]
योगेश्वर साईं मुरारी योगेश्वर हे त्रिपुरारी
नित्यनंदा ब्रह्मानंदा प्रेमानंदा साईं बाबा
respell:
Bholā Bhaṇḍārī Bābā Shiv Shiv Shiv Sāīṃ Bābā
Anātha Rakshak Dīna Dayālā Patita Pāvan Sāīṃ Bābā [ Bholā Bhaṇḍārī ... ]
Yogeshwar Sāīṃ Murārī Yogeshwar He Tripurārī
Nityanandā Brahmānandā Premānandā Sāīṃ Bābā

title: Bhola Nath Hare Jagadeesha
lyrics:
Bhola Nath Hare Jagadeesha
Shaileshwara Hara Uma Mahesha
Bhava Bhayahari Hey Tripurari
Shiva Gangadhara Sai Murari
Bhola Nath Bhola Nath
Sai Nath Sai Nath
meaning: O Bhola Nath, innocent Lord of the universe, who dwells on the mountains with Uma, you are the remover of all fear and suffering. O Tripurari, Shiva who holds the sacred Ganga, we recognize you as Sai Murari, our beloved Sai Nath.
devanagari:
भोला नाथ हरे जगदीशा
शैलेश्वर हर उमा महेश [ भोला नाथ हरे ... ]
भाव भय हारी हे त्रिपुरारी
शिव गंगाधर साई मुरारी
भोला नाथ भोला नाथ
साई नाथ साई नाथ
respell:
Bholā Nāth Hare Jagadīshā
Shaileshwar Har Umā Mahesh [ Bholā Nāth Hare ... ]
Bhāva Bhaya Hārī He Tripurārī
Shiv Gaṅgādhara Sāī Murārī
Bholā Nāth Bholā Nāth
Sāī Nāth Sāī Nāth

title: Bhola Nath Shambho Shankara
lyrics:
Bhola Nath Shambho Shankara
Sai Nath Bhola Maheshwara
Dama Dama Damaru Bhole Shankara
Dhimi Dhimi Dhimi Dhimi Natana Manohara
Parthi Pureeshwara Sai Shankara
Bhola Maheshwara Sai Shankara
meaning: Oh innocent Lord Shankara, Shambho, and Maheshwara, we recognize you as Sai Nath. With your damaru sounding "dama dama," you perform a captivating, gentle dance, O Lord of Parthi, Sai Shankara.
devanagari:
भोला नाथ शम्भो शंकर
साई नाथ भोला महेश्वर
दम दम डमरू भोले शंकर
धीमी धीमी धीमी धीमी नटन मनोहर
पर्ती पूरीश्वर साई शंकर
भोला महेश्वर साई शंकर
respell:
Bholā Nāth Shambho Shaṅkar
Sāī Nāth Bholā Maheshwar
Dama Dama Ḍamarū Bhole Shaṅkar
Dhīmī Dhīmī Dhīmī Dhīmī Naṭana Manohar
Partī Pūrīshwar Sāī Shaṅkar
Bholā Maheshwar Sāī Shaṅkar

title: Bhola Shankara Bhola
lyrics:
Bhola Shankara Bhola
Hara Bhola Shankara Bhola
Shaileshwara Hara Vishwambara Dhara
Hara Bhola Shankara Bhola
Surya Chandra Pralayagni Netra Dhara
Shaktisahita Shiva Natana Manohara
meaning: Lord Shankara, the innocent and benevolent remover of sorrows, who presides over the mountains and sustains the entire universe. His three eyes represent the Sun, Moon, and the cosmic fire of dissolution, and he enchants all with his divine dance alongside Goddess Shakti.
devanagari:
भोला शंकर भोला ( हर )
शैलेश्वर हर विश्वम्बर धर [ हर भोला शंकर ... ]
सूर्य चंद्र प्रलयाग्नि नेत्र धर
शक्ति सहित शिव नटन मनोहर
respell:
Bholā Shaṅkar Bholā ( har )
Shaileshwar Har Vishwambara Dhara [ har bholā shaṅkar ... ]
Sūrya Chandra Pralayāgni Netra dhara
Shakti Sahit Shiv Naṭana manohar

title: Bhuvana Bandhava Sai Bhagawan
lyrics:
Bhuvana Bandhava Sai Bhagawan
Matha Pitha Bandhu Sakha Tum Ho Bhagawan
Eshwar Bhi Tum Ho Allah Nanak Tum Ho
Prabhu Yeshu Tum Ho Mahavir Tum Ho
Buddha Deva Tum Ho Mere Pran Nath Tum Ho
Sai Ram Sai Ram
meaning: O Lord Sai, friend of all creation, you are my cherished mother, father, kin, and companion. You embody Ishwar, Allah, Nanak, Lord Jesus, Mahavir, and Buddha Deva, truly the very breath and essence of my being.
devanagari:
भुवन बान्धवा साई भगवान
माता पीता बन्धु सखा तुम हो भगवान
ईश्वर भी तुम हो अल्लाह नानक तुम हो
प्रभु येशु तुम हो महावीर तुम हो
बुद्ध देव तुम हो मेरे प्राण नाथ तुम हो
साई राम साई राम
respell:
Bhuvan Bāndhavā Sāī Bhagavān
Mātā Pītā Bandhu Sakhā Tum Ho Bhagavān
Īshwar Bhī Tum Ho Allāh Nānak Tum Ho
Prabhu Yeshu Tum Ho Mahāvīr Tum Ho
Buddha Deva Tum Ho Mere Prāṇ Nāth Tum Ho
Sāī Rām Sāī Rām

title: Bolo Baba Ki Jai Sai Baba Ki Jai
lyrics:
Bolo Baba Ki Jai Sai Baba Ki Jai
O Shirdi Baba Ki Jai Parthi Baba Ki Jai [ Bolo Baba Ki ... ]
Treta Yug Mey Ram Roop Dwapar Mey Krishna Kanhaiyi
Kaliyug Mey Sai Shakthi Jad Chaitan Mey Hai Samayi
Har Avartaron Mey Roop Tera Sai Kan Kan Mey Tu Samaya
Prashanthi Vasi Sai Shankar Teri Adbhuth Maya
meaning: We hail Sai Baba, the Lord of Shirdi and Parthi, who manifested as Rama in Treta Yuga and Krishna in Dwapar Yuga. In this Kali Yuga, Sai is the all-pervading divine energy present in every conscious and inert being, revealing His wondrous cosmic play from Prashanthi Nilayam.
devanagari:
बोलो बाबा की जय साई बाबा की जय
ओ शिर्डी बाबा की जय पर्ती बाबा की जय [ बोलो बाबा की ... ]
त्रेतायुग में राम रूप द्वापर में कृष्ण कन्हाई
कलियुग में साई शक्ति जड़ चेतन में है समायी
हर अवतारों में रूप तेरा साई कण कण में तू समाया
प्रशांति वासी साई शंकर तेरी अद्भुत माया
respell:
Bolo Bābā Kī Jay Sāī Bābā Kī Jay
O Shirḍī Bābā Kī Jay Partī Bābā Kī Jay [ Bolo Bābā Kī ... ]
Tretāyug Meṃ Rām Rūp Dwāpar Meṃ Kṛushṇ Kanhāī
Kaliyug Meṃ Sāī Shakti Jaḍa़ Chetan Meṃ Hai Samāyī
Har Avatāroṃ Meṃ Rūp Terā Sāī Kaṇ Kaṇ Meṃ Tū Samāyā
Prashānti Vāsī Sāī Shaṅkar Terī Adbhut Māyā

title: Bolo Bolo Sab Mil Bolo Om Namah Shivaya
lyrics:
Bolo Bolo Sab Mil Bolo Om Namah Shivaya
Om Namah Shivaya Om Namah Shivaya
Joota Jata Mein Gangadhari
Trishoola Dhari Damaru Bajae
Dama Dama Dama Dama Damaru Baja
Goonj Utao Om Namah Shivaya
Om Namah Shivaya
meaning: This bhajan invites everyone to unite in chanting "Om Namah Shivaya," honoring Lord Shiva who holds the sacred Ganga in his matted hair, wields the trident, and plays his damaru drum. Let the rhythmic beat of the damaru and the powerful mantra resonate all around.
devanagari:
बोलो बोलो सब मिल बोलो ॐ नमः शिवाय  
ॐ नमः शिवाय ॐ नमः शिवाय  
[ बोलो बोलो ... ]  
जूट जटा में गंगाधारी  
त्रिशूल धारी डमरू बजावे  
डम डम डम डम डमरू बजा  
गूंज उठाओ ॐ नमः शिवाय  
ॐ नमः शिवाय (3)
respell:
Bolo Bolo Sab Mil Bolo Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy
Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy
[ Bolo Bolo ... ]
Jūṭā Jaṭā Meṃ Gaṅgādhārī
Trishūl Dhārī Ḍamarū Bajāve
Ḍama Ḍama Ḍama Ḍama Ḍamarū Bajā
Gūñj Uṭhāo Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy
Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy (3)

title: Bolo Jai Jai Kar Bolo Jai Jai Kar
lyrics:
Bolo Jai Jai Kar Bolo Jai Jai Kar
Bolo Jai Jai Kar Sai Baba Ki
Patita Pavana He Ghana Shyama
Sai Gopala He Ghana Shyama
Prema Bhagawan Sai Bhagawan
Sai Ram Sai Ram
meaning: Chant victory to Sai Baba who isthe also Ghana Shyama the saviour of afflicted. Chant Sai Gopala, Prema Bhagawan (Lord whose form is Love) and Sai Bhagawan.
devanagari:
बोलो जय जय कार बोलो जय जय कार  
बोलो जय जय कार साई बाबा की  
पतित पावन हे घनश्याम  
साई गोपाला हे घनश्याम  
प्रेम भगवान साई भगवान  
साई राम साई राम (2)
respell:
Bolo Jay Jay Kār Bolo Jay Jay Kār
Bolo Jay Jay Kār Sāī Bābā Kī
Patita Pāvanā Hey Ghanashyāmā
Sāī Gopālā Hey Ghanashyāmā
Prema Bhagavān Sāī Bhagavān
Sāī Rām Sāī Rām (2)

title: Bolo Jai Sai Ram Bolo Jai Sai Ram
lyrics:
Bolo Jai Sai Ram Bolo Jai Sai Ram
Bolo Jai Sathya Sai Ram [Bolo Jai ..]
Mandir Mein Sai Ram
Masjid Mein Sai Ram
Gurudware Mein Sai Ram
Girija Ghar Mein Sai Ram
Bolo Jai Sathya Sai Ram (2x)
meaning: Let us hail the name of Lord Sathya Sai Ram. He is the one that resides in a temple, a mosque, a gurudwara and all holy places- lets us all hail that omnipresent lord.
devanagari:
बोलो जय साई राम बोलो जय साई राम
बोलो जय सत्य साई राम [बोलो जय]
मंदिर में साई राम
मस्जिद में साई राम
गुरुद्वारे में साई राम
गिरिजा घर में साई राम
बोलो जय सत्य साई राम (2x)
respell:
Bolo Jay Sāī Rām Bolo Jay Sāī Rām
Bolo Jay Satya Sāī Rām [bolo Jay]
Mandir Meṃ Sāī Rām
Masjid Meṃ Sāī Rām
Gurudwāre Meṃ Sāī Rām
Girijā Ghar Meṃ Sāī Rām
Bolo Jay Satya Sāī Rām (2x)

title: Bolo Narayana Jai Jai Vitthala
lyrics:
Bolo Narayana Jai Jai Vitthala
Sai Narayana Ranga Ranga Vitthala [ Bolo Narayana.. ]
Govinda Vitthala Rakhumayi Vitthala
Gopala Vitthala Panduranga Vitthala
Sri Ranga Vitthala Sai Ranga Vitthala
meaning: This bhajan is a joyful call to chant the many names of Lord Vittala. It celebrates him as Narayana, Govinda, Gopala, and Panduranga, recognizing the divine presence of Sai Baba within these various forms of the Supreme Being.
devanagari:
बोलो नारायणा जय जय विट्ठला  
साई नारायणा रंग रंग विट्ठला [ बोलो नारायणा ... ]  
गोविन्द विट्ठला रकुमाई विट्ठला  
गोपाल विट्ठला पांडुरंग विट्ठला  
श्री रंग विट्ठला साई रंग विट्ठला
respell:
Bolo Nārāyaṇā Jay Jay Viṭṭhalā
Sāī Nārāyaṇā Raṅg Raṅg Viṭṭhalā [ Bolo Nārāyaṇā ... ]
Govinda Viṭṭhalā Rakumāī Viṭṭhalā
Gopāla Viṭṭhalā Pāṇḍuraṅg Viṭṭhalā
Shrī Raṅg Viṭṭhalā Sāī Raṅg Viṭṭhalā

title: Bolo Ram Sai Ram Sathya Sai Ram
lyrics:
Bolo Ram Sai Ram Sathya Sai Ram
Sathya Nam Sai Nam Hari Ka Nam
Sri Hari Hari Om Hari Narayana
Bhaja Manuva Tu Sathya Narayana
Mere Ram Hey Ghana Shyam Sathya Sai Ram
Sathya Nam Sai Nam Hari Ka Nam
meaning: Chant the name of Lord Sathya Sai Ram, the Lords name is Sathya, the eternal and changeless truth. Chant the name of Lore Hari and Lord Narayana. Oh Mind, You chant the name of Sathya Narayana oh my Lord Rama, my Ghana Shyam, my Sathya Sai Ram.The Lord's name is Sathya, the eternal changeless truth.
devanagari:
बोलो राम साई राम सत्य साई राम
सत्य नाम साई नाम हरि का नाम
श्री हरि हरि ॐ हरि नारायण
भज मनुवा तू सत्य नारायण
मेरे राम हे घन श्याम सत्य साई राम
सत्य नाम साई नाम हरि का नाम
respell:
Bolo Rām Sāī Rām Satya Sāī Rām
Satya Nām Sāī Nām Hari Kā Nām
Shrī Hari Hari Oṃ Hari Nārāyaṇ
Bhaja Manuvā Tū Satya Nārāyaṇ
Mere Rām He Ghan Shyām Satya Sāī Rām
Satya Nām Sāī Nām Hari Kā Nām

title: Bolo Ram, Sai Ram
lyrics:
Bolo Ram, Sai Ram, Sathya Sai Ram
Sathya Naam, Sai Naam, Hari Ka Naam
Sri Hari Hari Bol, Hari Narayana
Bhajo Manuva Tu, Sathya Narayana
Merey Ram, Hey Ghana Shyam, Sathya Sai Ram [ Sathya Naam ... ]
meaning: O mind, chant the divine names of Ram, Sai Ram, and Sathya Sai Ram, for these are the very names of Truth, of Sai, and of Hari. Proclaim the glory of Sri Hari, Hari Narayana, my beloved Ram, my cloud-hued Shyam, and Sathya Sai Ram.
devanagari:
बोलो राम, साई राम, सत्य साई राम
सत्य नाम, साई नाम, हरि का नाम
श्री हरि हरि बोल, हरि नारायण
भजो मनुवा तू, सत्य नारायण
मेरे राम, हे घन श्याम, सत्य साई राम [ सत्य नाम ... ]
respell:
Bolo Rām, Sāī Rām, Satya Sāī Rām
Satya Nām, Sāī Nām, Hari Kā Nām
Shrī Hari Hari Bol, Hari Nārāyaṇ
Bhajo Manuvā Tū, Satya Nārāyaṇ
Mere Rām, He Ghan Shyām, Satya Sāī Rām [ Satya Nām ... ]

title: Bolo Sai Ram Sathya Sai Ram
lyrics:
Bolo Sai Ram Sathya Sai Ram
Prashanthi Vasa Sathya Sai Ram [ Bolo Sai Ram ... ]
Tan Man Lekey Man Mey Basaake
Sai Ram Bolo Sathya Sai Rama
meaning: Let us joyfully chant the name of Sathya Sai Ram, the divine resident of Prashanthi. Dedicate your entire being, body and mind, to enshrine Him within your heart as you continuously utter His sacred name.
devanagari:
बोलो साई राम सत्य साई राम  
प्रशांति वासा सत्य साई राम [ बोलो साई राम ... ]  
तन मन लेके मन में बसाके  
साई राम बोलो सत्य साई राम
respell:
Bolo Sāī Rām Satya Sāī Rām
Prashānti Vāsā Satya Sāī Rām [ Bolo Sāī Rām ... ]
Tan Man Leke Man Meṃ Basāke
Sāī Rām Bolo Satya Sāī Rām

title: He Brahma Vishnu Maheshwara Sayeeshwara
lyrics:
Hey Brahma Vishnu Maheshwara Sayeeshwara
Daya Karo Kripa Karo Parameshwara
Sai Ram Sai Ram
Parama Dayala Papa Vinasha
Raksha Karo Raksha Karo Sayeeshwara
Daya Karo Kripa Karo Parameshwara
meaning: O Sayeeshwara, embodiment of Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva, we implore you to grant us your divine mercy and grace, O Supreme Lord. You are the ultimate fount of compassion, the vanquisher of all transgressions; please extend your protection over us.
devanagari:
ब्रह्मा विष्णु महेश्वरा साईेश्वरा (हे)
दया करो कृपा करो परमेश्वरा
साई राम साई राम (2)
परम दयाला पाप विनाशा
रक्षा करो रक्षा करो साईेश्वरा [ दया करो ... ]
respell:
Brahmā Vishṇu Maheshwarā Sāīeshwarā (he)
Dayā Karo Kṛupā Karo Parameshwarā
Sāī Rām Sāī Rām (2)
Param Dayālā Pāpa Vināshā
Rakshā Karo Rakshā Karo Sāīeshwarā [ Dayā Karo ... ]

title: Brahmananda Roopa Sri Sai Deva
lyrics:
Brahmananda Roopa Sri Sai Deva
Kunja Vihara Ananda Chanda
Nithyananda Atmananda Keshava Govinda
Govinda Gopala Jaya Ananda Mukunda
meaning: Lord Sri Sai's from gives supreme bliss. He is the charmer of Brindavan. Chant his name as Keshava and Govinda to get everlasting happiness and bliss. Victory to Govinda, Gopala and Mukunda.
devanagari:
ब्रह्मानंद रूपा श्री साई देवा
कुंज विहारा आनंद चन्दा
नित्यानंद आत्मानंद केशवा गोविंदा
गोविंदा गोपाला जय आनंद मुकुंदा
respell:
Brahmānanda Rūpā Shrī Sāī Devā
Kuñj Vihārā Ānanda Chandā
Nityānanda Ātmānanda Keshavā Govindā
Govindā Gopālā Jaya Ānanda Mukundā

title: Brahmanda Nayaka Baba Parthi Pureeshwara Baba
lyrics:
Brahmanda Nayaka Baba Parthi Pureeshwara Baba
Chand Aur Suraj Tum Ne Banaye
Nadiya Sagar Tum Ne Banaye
Ayodhya Nagari Tum Ne Banayi Dwaraka Nagari Tum Ne Basayi
Shirdi Parthi Tum Ne Banayi
meaning: Oh Baba, You are the creator of this universe! You reside in Parthi. You created the sun and the moon. You made the rivers and oceans. You made the city of Ayodhya and established the city of Dwaraka. You created the holy cities of Shirdi and Parthi.
devanagari:
ब्रह्माण्ड नायका बाबा पर्तिपूरीश्वर बाबा
चाँद और सूरज तुम ने बनाए
नदिया सागर तुम ने बनाए (2) [ ब्रह्माण्ड ... ]
अयोध्या नगरी तुम ने बनाई द्वारका नगरी तुम ने बसाई 
शिर्डी पर्ती तुम ने बनाई
respell:
Brahmāṇḍa Nāyakā Bābā Partipūrīshwar Bābā
Chām̐d Aur Sūraj Tum Ne Banāe
Nadiyā Sāgar Tum Ne Banāe (2) [ Brahmāṇḍa ... ]
Ayodhyā Nagarī Tum Ne Banāī Dwārakā Nagarī Tum Ne Basāī
Shirḍī Partī Tum Ne Banāī

title: Buddha Mahavira Yeshu Sai
lyrics:
Buddha Mahavira Yeshu Sai
Vahe Guru Vahe Guru Bol Manuva
Allah Yeshu Sat Guru Sai
Geeta Veda Quran Ho Sai
Tan Mein Sai Man Mein Sai
Rom Rom Mein Sai Sai
Vahe Guru Vahe Guru Bol Manuva
meaning: Oh mind chant the names of Buddha, Mahavir and Yesu. You are the Supreme Teacher, you are the same as Allah and Yeshu. You are the essence of all scriptures like Bhagavad Gita, Vedas or the Quran. You are the one permeating in every cell of our being, energizing every bit of our mind. You are the one One reverberating in every hair of my body, every inch of my being.
devanagari:
बुद्ध महावीर येसु साईं
वाहे गुरु वाहे गुरु बोल मनुवा
अल्लाह येसु सद्गुरु साईं
गीता वेद कुरान हो साईं
तन में साईं मन में साईं
रोम रोम में साईं साईं [ वाहे गुरु ... ]
respell:
Buddha Mahāvīr Yesu Sāīṃ
Vāhe Guru Vāhe Guru Bol Manuvā
Allāh Yesu Sadguru Sāīṃ
Gītā Ved Kurān Ho Sāīṃ
Tan Meṃ Sāīṃ Man Meṃ Sāīṃ
Rom Rom Meṃ Sāīṃ Sāīṃ [ Vāhe Guru ... ]

title: Chanda Kirana Kula Mandana Ram
lyrics:
Chanda Kirana Kula Mandana Ram
Srimad Dasharatha Nandana Ram
Kausalya Sukha Vardhana Ram
Vishwamitra Priya Dhana Ram
Rama Rama Jaya Raja Ram
Rama Rama Jaya Sita Ram
Rama Rama Jaya Raja Ram
Rama Rama Jaya Sai Ram
meaning: O beloved prince  of King Dasharatha, Lord Rama, You are the crown jewel of the Solar Dynasty, radiating bliss and happiness. You are the cause of Mother Kausalya's happiness and Sage Vishwamitra's beloved treasure. Victory to You, O King Rama, consort of  Mother Sita.
devanagari:
चंड किरण कुल मंडन राम  
श्रीमद दशरथ नंदन राम  
कौसल्या सुख वर्धन राम  
विश्वामित्र प्रिय धन राम  
राम राम जय राजा राम  
राम राम जय सीता राम  
राम राम जय राजा राम  
राम राम जय साई राम
respell:
Chaṇḍa Kiraṇ Kul Maṇḍana Rām
Shrīmad Dasharath Nandana Rām
Kausalyā Sukh Vardhana Rām
Vishwāmitra Priy Dhana Rām
Rām Rām Jaya Rājā Rām
Rām Rām Jaya Sītā Rām
Rām Rām Jaya Rājā Rām
Rām Rām Jaya Sāī Rām

title: Chandi Chamundi Jaya Vaishnavi Devi
lyrics:
Chandi Chamundi Jaya Vaishnavi Devi Ma
Mahisha Samhaarini Mangala Roopini Jaya Maha Kaali Ma
Chandi Chamundi Jaya Mangala Gowri Ma
Bhava Bhaya Harini Pashupathi Mohini Jaya Jaya Lalitey Ma
Jagadodharini Jaya Bhavatari Jaya Jaya Devi Ma
Trishoola Dharini Trinetra Dharini Jaya Jaya Durge Ma
meaning: This bhajan offers triumphant praise to the Divine Mother, invoked through her powerful forms like Chandi, Kali, and Durga. It celebrates her as the vanquisher of evil, the source of all blessings, and the compassionate one who dispels worldly anxieties. Revered as the universe's savior, she is depicted with the trident and three eyes, embodying ultimate protection and grace.
devanagari:
चंडी चामुंडी जय वैष्णवी देवी मा
महिषा संहारिणी मंगल रूपिणी जय महा काली मा
चंडी चामुंडी जय मंगल गौरी मा
भव भय हारिणी पशुपति मोहिनी जय जय ललिते मा
जगदोद्धारिणी जय भावतारी जय जय देवी मा
त्रिशूल धारिणी त्रिनेत्र धारिणी जय जय दुर्गे मा
respell:
Chaṇḍī Chāmuṇḍī Jaya Vaishṇavī Devī Mā
Mahishā Saṃhāriṇī Maṅgal Rūpiṇī Jaya Mahā Kālī Mā
Chaṇḍī Chāmuṇḍī Jaya Maṅgala Gaurī Mā
Bhava Bhaya Hāriṇī Pashupati Mohinī Jaya Jaya Lalite Mā
Jagadoddhāriṇī Jaya Bhāvatārī Jaya Jaya Devī Mā
Trishūl Dhāriṇī Trinetra Dhāriṇī Jaya Jaya Durge Mā

title: Chandra Vadana Kamala Nayana
lyrics:
Chandra Vadana Kamala Nayana
Narayana Hari Narayana
Anantha Shayana Deena Sharanya [ Narayana Sai ... ]
meaning: We praise Lord Narayana, whose countenance is radiant like the moon and whose eyes are beautiful like lotuses. He reclines upon the cosmic serpent Ananta, offering solace and protection to the humble and distressed.
devanagari:
चन्द्र वदना कमला नयना
नारायणा हरि नारायणा
अनन्त शयना दीन शरण्या [ नारायणा साई ... ]
respell:
Chandra Vadanā Kamalā Nayanā
Nārāyaṇā Hari Nārāyaṇā
Ananta Shayanā Dīna Sharaṇyā [ Nārāyaṇā Sāī ... ]

title: Chandra Kaladhara Samba Sadashiva
lyrics:
Chandra Kaladhara Samba Sadashiva
Shambho Mahadeva
Shiva Shambho Mahadeva
Om Namah Shivaya Shivaya Namah Om
meaning: O Sadashiva, eternally auspicious one, adorned with the crescent moon and accompanied by Shakti, you are Shambhu, the Great God, source of all joy. We offer our heartfelt salutations, chanting "Om Namah Shivaya."
devanagari:
चन्द्रकला धर सांब सदाशिव  
शम्भो महादेवा (शिव) (3)  
ॐ नमः शिवाय शिवाय नमः ॐ (2)
respell:
Chandrakalā Dhara Sāmb Sadāshiv
Shambho Mahādevā (shiv) (3)
Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy Shivāy Namaḥ Oṃ (2)

title: Chandra Shekhara Sayeeshwara
lyrics:
Chandra Shekhara Sayeeshwara
Chandra Kaladhara Hridayeeshwara
Prema Pradayaka Parameshwara
Parameshwara Sayeeshwara Sathya Sayeeshwara
Prema Pradayaka Parameshwara
Prasanthi Nilaya Hara Shankara
meaning: Oh Lord Sai, Shiva, who bears the crescent moon upon your head, you are the divine Lord residing within our hearts. Supreme Giver of boundless love, Sathya Sai, you are the ultimate Shiva, dwelling eternally in Prasanthi Nilayam.
devanagari:
चन्द्रशेखरा साईश्वरा
चन्द्रकला धारा हृदयेश्वरा [ चन्द्रशेखरा ... ]
प्रेम प्रदायक परमेश्वरा
परमेश्वरा साईश्वरा सत्य साईश्वरा [ प्रेम प्रदायक ... ]
प्रशांति निलया हर शंकरा
respell:
Chandrashekharā Sāīshwarā
Chandrakalā Dhārā Hṛudayeshwarā [ Chandrashekharā ... ]
Prem Pradāyak Parameshwarā
Parameshwarā Sāīshwarā Satya Sāīshwarā [ Prem Pradāyak ... ]
Prashānti Nilayā Har Shaṅkarā

title: Chandrashekaraya Namah Aum
lyrics:
Chandrashekaraya Namah Aum
Gangadharaya Namah Aum [ Chandrashekaraya ... ]
Aum Namah Shivaya Namah Aum
Hara Hara Haraya Namah Aum
Shiva Shiva Shivaya Namah Aum
Sayeeshwaraya Namah Aum (Sathya)
meaning: We offer our humble salutations to Lord Shiva, who graces his brow with the crescent moon and cradles the holy Ganga in his matted locks. We chant your sacred names, Hara and Shiva, the auspicious remover of all ills, and bow to your divine manifestation as Sayeeshwara.
devanagari:
चन्द्रशेखराय नमः ॐ
गंगाधराय नमः ॐ [ चन्द्रशेखराय ... ]
ॐ नमः शिवाय नमः ॐ
हर हर हराय नमः ॐ
शिव शिव शिवाय नमः ॐ
साईश्वराय नमः ॐ (सत्य)
respell:
Chandrashekharāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Gaṅgādharāy Namaḥ Oṃ [ Chandrashekharāy ... ]
Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Har Har Harāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Shiv Shiv Shivāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Sāīshwarāy Namaḥ Oṃ (satya)

title: Chant the name of God
lyrics:
Chant the name of God, Sing the Glory of the Lord
Harey Ram Harey Ram Harey Krishna Sai Ram
Call Him Allah or Buddha Jesus Zohrashtra
Say Ram Rahim Mahaveer Sai Natha
He is All names and All forms choose anyone
He is All names and All forms Almighty One
devanagari:
चैन्ट द नेम अव गाड सिङ द ग्लोरी अव द लोर्ड
हरे राम हरे राम हरे कृष्ण साई राम
कोल हिम अल्लाह ओर बुद्ध जीजस ज़ोहराष्ट्र
से राम रहीम महवीर साई नाथा
हे इज ओल नेम्ज अन्ड ओल फोर्म्ज चूज एनीवन
हे इज ओल नेम्ज अन्ड ओल फोर्म्ज ओल्माइटी वन

title: Charana Kamala Bando
lyrics:
Charana Kamala Bando Sai Nath Ke Charana Kamala Bando (2)
Jo Trishavanto Piyo Charanamrutha Jeevan Mey Paavey Anando [ Charana Kamala ... ]
meaning: Humbly bow to the lotus feet of Lord Sai Nath. Whoever yearns for and partakes of the divine nectar flowing from His feet will experience profound joy and contentment in their life.
devanagari:
चरण कमल बंदो साई नाथ के चरण कमल बंदो (२)
जो तृषावंतो पियो चरणामृत जीवन में पावे आनंदो [ चरण कमल ... ]
respell:
Charaṇ Kamala Bando Sāī Nāth Ke Charaṇ Kamala Bando (2)
Jo Tṛushāvanto Piyo Charaṇāmṛuta Jīvan Meṃ Pāve Ānando [ Charaṇ Kamala ... ]

title: Charana Kamala Bhajorey Manasa
lyrics:
Charana Kamala Bhajorey Manasa
Sai Janani Nalina Mrudula Dala [ Charana Kamala ... ]
Tirtha Triveni Sangama Charanam
Tribhuvana Sai Mangala Charanam
Sanchitha Paapa Vinashaka Charanam
Sharanagatha Paripalita Charanam
meaning: O mind, worship the lotus feet of Mother Sai, tender as lotus petals and as sacred as the confluence of holy rivers. These auspicious feet bless all realms, destroy accumulated sins, and offer divine protection to those who surrender.
devanagari:
चरण कमल भजोरें मानस
साई जननी नलिन मृदुल दल [ चरण कमल ... ]
तीर्थ त्रिवेणी संगम चरणम्
त्रिभुवन साई मंगल चरणम्
संचित पाप विनाशक चरणम्
शरणागत परिपालित चरणम्
respell:
Charaṇ Kamala Bhajoreṃ Mānasa
Sāī Jananī Nalin Mṛudula Dala [ Charaṇ Kamala ... ]
Tīrtha Triveṇī Saṅgam Charaṇam
Tribhuvan Sāī Maṅgal Charaṇam
Sañchita Pāpa Vināshak Charaṇam
Sharaṇāgat Paripālit Charaṇam

title: Chitta Chora Muralivala
lyrics:
Chitha Chora Muraliwala
Nandalala Nanda Gopala
Nandalala Nandalala
Brindavana Shyama Gopala
Mathura Vraja Gokula Bala
Mana Mohana Madana Gopala
Nandalala Nandalala
Nandalala Nanda Gopala
Nandalala Nandalala
meaning: Oh Krishna, you are the thief of our hearts, the enchanting flutist, Nanda's beloved cowherd boy. Dwelling in Vrindavan, Mathura, Vraja, and Gokul, you are the dark-hued charmer who captivates every mind.
devanagari:
चित्त चोरा मुरलीवाला
नंदलाल नंद गोपाला
नंदलाला नंदलाला
वृंदावन श्याम गोपाला
मथुरा व्रज गोकुल बाला
मन मोहन मदन गोपाला
नंदलाला नंदलाला
नंदलाल नंद गोपाला
नंदलाला नंदलाला
respell:
Chitta Chorā Muralīvālā
Nandalāl Nanda Gopālā
Nandalālā Nandalālā
Vṛundāvan Shyām Gopālā
Mathurā Vraj Gokul Bālā
Mana Mohan Madana Gopālā
Nandalālā Nandalālā
Nandalāl Nanda Gopālā
Nandalālā Nandalālā

title: Chitta Chora Yashoda Ke Bal Navaneeta Chora Gopal
lyrics:
Chitta Chora Yashoda Ke Bal Navaneeta Chora Gopal
Gopal Gopal Gopal Govardhana Dhara Gopal
Gopal Gopal Gopal Gopal Govardhana Dhara Gopal
meaning: O Lord Gopala (Krishna), the beloved Prince of Mother Yashoda, You are the captivator/stealer of the hearts of devotees, their Chitta, the spiritual Heart which is the seat of consciousness. You are the stealer of butter, i. e. hearts of the Gopis (devotees). Chant the name of Gopala, the one who protects the cows or tends the cows as a cowherd. Chant the name of the Govardhanadhara Gopal, who held aloft the mountain Govardhana to protect the villagers against the torrential rain.
devanagari:
चित्त चोरा यशोदा के बाल नवनीत चोर गोपाल
गोपाल गोपाल गोपाल गोवर्धनधर गोपाल
गोपाल गोपाल गोपाल गोपाल गोवर्धनधर गोपाल
respell:
Chitta Chorā Yashodā Ke Bāl Navanīta Chora Gopāl
Gopāl Gopāl Gopāl Govardhanadhara Gopāl
Gopāl Gopāl Gopāl Gopāl Govardhanadhara Gopāl

title: Chitta Raja Chitta Raja
lyrics:
Chitha Raja Chitha Raja
Brindavana Ghana Mangala Charana
Savari Surath Prema Bharana [ Chitha Raja ... ]
Roopa Manohara Murali Madhuvana
Parthi Pureeshwara Chitha Raja Chitha Raja
meaning: O King of my heart, your divine footsteps sanctified the lush groves of Brindavan. Your dark, lovely form embodies pure love, and your captivating presence, like a sweet melody from your flute, enchants all. Lord of Parthi, you reign supreme within my consciousness.
devanagari:
चित्त राजा चित्त राजा
ब्रिंदावन घन मंगल चरणा
सावरी सुरत प्रेम भारणा [ चित्त राजा ... ]
रूप मनोहर मुरली मधुवन
पर्तिपूरीश्वर चित्त राजा चित्त राजा
respell:
Chitta Rājā Chitta Rājā
Brindāvan Ghan Maṅgal Charaṇā
Sāvarī Surat Prem Bhāraṇā [ Chitta Rājā ... ]
Rūp Manohar Muralī Madhuvan
Partipūrīshwar Chitta Rājā Chitta Rājā

title: Chithravathi Thata Vishala Sundara Sai
lyrics:
Chithravathi Thata Vishala Sundara Sai 
Avadhootha Chinthana Guru Deva Sathya Sai
Merey Baba Sai, Merey Baba Sai
Yamuna Teera Sri Krishna Kanhaiya Sai
Avadhootha Chinthana Guru Deva Sathya Sai
Shirdi Baba Sai Parthi Baba Sai
Avadhootha Chinthana Guru Deva Sathya Sai
meaning: Oh beautiful and expansive Sai, dwelling by the sacred Chitravathi river, you are the divine Guru, contemplated by the greatest renunciates. My beloved Baba, you are none other than Lord Krishna, the darling Kanhaiya of the Yamuna's banks, manifest as Sai of Shirdi and Parthi.
devanagari:
चित्रवती तट विशाल सुंदर साई
अवधूत चिन्तना गुरु देवा सत्य साई
मेरे बाबा साई, मेरे बाबा साई
यमुना तीर श्री कृष्ण कन्हैया साई
अवधूत चिन्तना गुरु देवा सत्य साई
शिर्डी बाबा साई पर्ती बाबा साई
अवधूत चिन्तना गुरु देवा सत्य साई
respell:
Chitravatī Taṭa Vishāl Sundara Sāī
Avadhūta Chintanā Guru Devā Satya Sāī
Mere Bābā Sāī, Mere Bābā Sāī
Yamunā Tīra Shrī Kṛushṇa Kanhaiyā Sāī
Avadhūta Chintanā Guru Devā Satya Sāī
Shirḍī Bābā Sāī Partī Bābā Sāī
Avadhūta Chintanā Guru Devā Satya Sāī

title: Dasharathe Rama Jaya Jaya Rama
lyrics:
Dasharathe Rama Jaya Jaya Rama
Raghukula Bhushana Raja Rama
Sita Vallabha Sundara Rama
Sri Rama Jaya Rama Sathya Sai Rama
--
Sita Vallabha Sundara Rama
Sundara Rama
Sri Rama Jaya Rama Sathya Sai Rama (sung in audio)
meaning: Oh Rama, son of Dasharatha, we hail your victory! You are the majestic ornament of the Raghu lineage, the beautiful beloved of Sita. We praise you, glorious Rama, who manifests as Sathya Sai.
devanagari:
दाशरथे राम जय जय राम
रघुकुल भूषण राजा राम [ दाशरथे ... ]
सीता वल्लभ सुंदर राम
श्री राम जय राम सत्य साईं मा
respell:
Dāsharathe Rām Jaya Jaya Rām
Raghukul Bhūshaṇ Rājā Rām [ Dāsharathe ... ]
Sītā Vallabh Sundara Rām
Shrī Rām Jaya Rām Satya Sāīṃ Mā

title: Dama Dama Dama Dama Damaru Baje
lyrics:
Dama Dama Dama Dama Damaru Baje
Nache Shankara Nache Re
Tunga Himachala Shringa Nivasita
Nache Pralayankara Nache Re
Srishti Stithi Laya Jaya Abhayankara
Nache Re Shiva Nache Re
Nache Re Sai Nache Re
meaning: Lord Shankara dances to the rhythmic 'dama dama' beat of his damaru drum. Residing on the high Himalayan peaks, he is the fearless cosmic dancer who orchestrates creation, preservation, and dissolution, invoked here as Sai Shiva.
devanagari:
डम​ डम​ डम​ डम​ डमरु भाजे
नाचे शंकर नाचे रे
तुंग हिमाचल श्रृंग निवासित
नाचे प्रलयंकर नाचे रे
सृष्टि स्थिति लय जय अभयंकर
नाचे रे शिव नाचे रे
नाचे रे साई नाचे रे
respell:
Ḍama​ Ḍama​ Ḍama​ Ḍama​ Ḍamaru Bhāje
Nāche Shaṅkar Nāche Re
Tuṅga Himāchala Shrṛuṅg Nivāsit
Nāche Pralayaṅkar Nāche Re
Sṛushṭi Sthiti Lay Jaya Abhayaṅkar
Nāche Re Shiv Nāche Re
Nāche Re Sāī Nāche Re

title: Dama Dama Damaru Damaru Natha Shiva
lyrics:
Dama Dama Damaru Damaru Natha Shiva
Dhimitha Dhimitha Dhimi Bholey Natha Shiva [ Dama Dama ... ]
Natana Manohara Nataraja Shiva
Hara Hara Shankara Bholey Nath Shiva
Shambho Shankara Vishwanath Shiva
Shivaya Namah Shiva Sai Nath Shiva
meaning: This bhajan celebrates Lord Shiva, whose divine dance resonates with the rhythmic "dam dam" and "dhim dhim" of his drum. It hails him as Nataraja, the captivating dancer, and invokes his many forms like Shankara, Shambho, and Vishwanath. The song praises his benevolent and easy-to-please nature, concluding with salutations to Sai Nath as Shiva.
devanagari:
डम डम डमरु डमरु नाथ शिव
धिमित धिमित धिम भोले नाथ शिव [डम डम ... ]
नटन मनोहर नटराजा शिव
हर हर शंकर भोले नाथ शिव
शंभो शंकर विश्वनाथ शिव
शिवाय नमः शिव साई नाथ शिव
respell:
Ḍama Ḍama Ḍamaru Ḍamaru Nātha Shiv
Dhimita Dhimita Dhim Bhole Nātha Shiv [ḍam Ḍama ... ]
Naṭana Manohar Naṭarājā Shiv
Har Har Shaṅkar Bhole Nāth Shiv
Shambho Shaṅkar Vishwanāth Shiv
Shivāy Namaḥ Shiv Sāī Nāth Shiv

title: Danava Bhanjana Rama Sai Shyamala Komala Ram
lyrics:
Danava Bhanjana Rama Sai Shyamala Komala Ram
Hey Rama Rama Jaya Rama Sai Rama Rama Ram
Dasharatha Nandana Rama Sai Daya Sagara Ram
Deenon Ke prabhu Ram Sai Rama Rama Ram
meaning: Oh sweet and charming Rama, you annihilated the demons (Danavas). Victory be to you, Lord Rama the son of king Dasharatha. You are the ocean  of compassion, the refuge to the destitue. O Rama, you are none other than our Sai Rama.
devanagari:
दानव भंजन राम साई श्यामल कोमल राम
हे राम राम जय राम साई राम राम राम [ दानव भंजन ... ]
दशरथ नंदन राम साई दया सागर राम
दीनों के प्रभु राम साई राम राम राम
respell:
Dānava Bhañjana Rām Sāī Shyāmala Komala Rām
He Rām Rām Jaya Rām Sāī Rām Rām Rām [ Dānava Bhañjana ... ]
Dasharath Nandana Rām Sāī Dayā Sāgar Rām
Dīnoṃ Ke Prabhu Rām Sāī Rām Rām Rām

title: Dance Shiva Dance
lyrics:
Dance Shiva Dance In Our Hearts (2)
Blow Out The Winds Of Desire ( Sai )
Purify Our Hearts Purify
Let Our Sins Die In Your Fire
Dance Shiva Dance In Our Hearts (3)
And Love Will Flow Like A River
devanagari:
डैन्स शिव डैन्स इन आउअर हार्ट्स
ब्लो आउट द विन्ड्ज अव डिजाइअर साई
प्युरफाइ आउअर हार्ट्स प्युरफाइ
लेट आउअर सिन्ज डाइ इन योर फाइअर
डैन्स शिव डैन्स इन आउअर हार्ट्स
अन्ड लव विल फ्लो लाइक अ रिवर

title: Dancing Ganesh, Playful Ganesh
lyrics:
Dancing Ganesh, Playful Ganesh,
Dance with me, Play with me, be my Ganesh,
Be my Ganesh, be my Ganesh,
Teach me how to dance with my fears, Ganesh
Gowri Ganesh Uma Ganesh
Parvathi Nandana Sri Ganesh
Sharanam Ganesh Sharanam Ganesh
Shiva Nandana Ganapathi Ganesh
devanagari:
डैन्सिङ गणेश प्लेफल गणेश
डैन्स विद मी प्ले विद मी बी माइ गणेश
बी माइ गणेश बी माइ गणेश
टीच मी हाउ टू डैन्स विद माइ फिर्ज गणेश
गौरी गणेश यूम गणेश
पार्वती नंदन श्री गणेश
शरणम् गणेश शरणम् गणेश
शिव नंदन गनपथि गणेश

title: Mujhe Darsha Dikhao Bhagawan
lyrics:
Mujhe Darsha Dikhao Bhagawan
Hey Sai Natha Bhagawan
Tum Janat Sab Antaryami
Deejo Mere Prabhu Amrit Vani
Tum Ho Mere Atma Ram Baba
Puran Karo Meri Man Ki Kamna
meaning: The devotee earnestly prays to Lord Sai, the all-knowing indwelling spirit, to reveal His divine form. They seek His sacred, life-giving words and acknowledge Him as their true inner Self, imploring Him to fulfill their heart's deepest desires.
devanagari:
दर्श दिखाओ भगवान (मुझे)  
हे साईं नाथ भगवान [ दर्श दिखाओ ... ]  
तुम जानत सब अंतर्यामी  
दीजो मेरे प्रभु अमृत वाणी  
तुम हो मेरे आत्मा राम बाबा  
पूर्ण करो मेरे मन की कामना
respell:
Darsha Dikhāo Bhagavān (mujhe)
He Sāīṃ Nātha Bhagavān [ Darsha Dikhāo ... ]
Tum Jānat Sab Antaryāmī
Dījo Mere Prabhu Amṛuta Vāṇī
Tum Ho Mere Ātmā Rām Bābā
Pūrṇ Karo Mere Man Kī Kāmanā

title: Darsha Dikhao Mere Sai Nandalala
lyrics:
Darsha Dikhao Mere Sai Nandalala
Daya Karo Mujhe Krishna Gopala
Devaki Nandana Deena Dayala
Mathura Natha Madana Gopala
Sai Narayana Sada Krupala
Daya Karo Mujhe Krishna Gopala
Daya Karo Mujhe Sai Gopala
meaning: O Lord Gopala, the beloved son of Nanda grant me your vision and show your compassion on me. O Lord, the loving son of Mother Devaki, You are the compassionate Lord of the weak, you are the Lord of Mathura and the most beautiful one. Oh ever compassionate Lord Sai, you are none other than Lord Krishna and Narayana. Shower your mercy and grace on me.
devanagari:
दर्श दिखाओ मेरे साईं नंदलाला
दया करो मुझे कृष्ण (साईं) गोपाला [ दर्श दिखाओ ... ]
देवकी नंदन दीन दयाला
मथुरा नाथ मदन गोपाला
साईं नारायण सदा कृपाला [ दया करो ... ]
respell:
Darsha Dikhāo Mere Sāīṃ Nandalālā
Dayā Karo Mujhe Kṛushṇa (sāīṃ) Gopālā [ Darsha dikhāo ... ]
Devakī Nandana Dīna Dayālā
Mathurā Nātha Madana Gopālā
Sāīṃ Nārāyaṇ Sadā Kṛupālā [ Dayā Karo ... ]

title: Dasharatha Nandana Rama Daya Sagara Rama
lyrics:
Dasharatha Nandana Rama Daya Sagara Rama
Dashamukha Mardana Rama Daitya Kulantaka Rama
Lakshmana Sevita Rama Lakshmi Manohara Rama
Lakshmana Sevita Rama Rama Lakshmi Manohara Rama
(Ati) Sukshma Swaroopa Rama Sundara Vadana Rama
meaning: O Rama, son of Dasharatha and an ocean of compassion, you vanquished the ten-headed Ravana, thereby ending the lineage of demons. Served by Lakshmana and captivating to Lakshmi, you embody a beautiful yet subtle divine form.
devanagari:
दशरथ नंदन रामा दया सागरा रामा
दश मुख मर्धन रामा दैत्य कुलान्तक रामा [ दशरथ नंदन ... ]
लक्ष्मण सेवित रामा लक्ष्मी मनोहर रामा
(अति) सूक्ष्म स्वरूपा रामा सुंदर वदना रामा
respell:
Dasharath Nandana Rāmā Dayā Sāgarā Rāmā
Dasha Mukha Mardhana Rāmā Daitya Kulāntaka rāmā [ dasharath nandana ... ]
Lakshmaṇa Sevit Rāmā Lakshmī Manohar Rāmā
(ati) Sūkshma Swarūpā Rāmā Sundar Vadanā Rāmā

title: Dasharatha Nandana Rama Daya Sagara Rama
lyrics:
Dasharatha Nandana Rama Daya Sagara Rama
Raghukula Tilaka Rama Sathya Sai Sri Parandhama
Ahalyoddharaka Rama Shapa Vimochana Rama
Shirdipureesha Rama Puttaparthipuri Parandhama
meaning: O Rama, beloved son of Dasharatha and jewel of the Raghu clan, you are an ocean of boundless compassion. You are the one who freed Ahalya from her curse, manifesting as Sathya Sai, the supreme Lord of Shirdi and Puttaparthi.
devanagari:
दशरथ नंदन रामा दया सागरा रामा
रघुकुल तिलका रामा सत्य साई श्री परंधामा [ दशरथ नंदन ... ]
अहल्ल्योधारक रामा शाप विमोचन रामा
शिर्डी पुरीशा रामा पुट्टपर्ती पुरी परंधामा
respell:
Dasharath Nandana Rāmā Dayā Sāgarā Rāmā
Raghukul Tilakā Rāmā Satya Sāī Shrī Parandhāmā [ Dasharath Nandana ... ]
Ahallyodhārak Rāmā Shāp Vimochana Rāmā
Shirḍī Purīshā Rāmā Puṭṭapartī Purī Parandhāmā

title: Dasharatha Nandana Sri Ramachandra Dharma Samrakshaka Ram
lyrics:
Dasharatha Nandana Sri Ramachandra Dharma Samrakshaka Ram
Devaki Nandana Muralidhara Ananda Dayaka Shyam
Eshwaramba Suta Sri Sathya Sai Premamrita Bhagawan
Jaya Jaya Jaya Shiva Shakti Swaroopa Mangala Dayaka Ram
--
Dasharatha Nandana Ram
Ananda Dayaka Shyam
Premamrita Bhagawan
Jai Jai Jai Sai Ram
Bolo Jai Jai Jai Sai Ram
meaning: The same Supreme Lord who came as Rama to protect righteousness and as Krishna to spread divine joy has now come as Sathya Sai Baba to shower love and spiritual wisdom. As the embodiment of Shiva-Shakti, He blesses humanity with peace, righteousness, love, happiness, and divine grace. Glory to Sai Ram!
devanagari:
दशरथ नंदन श्री रामचंद्रा धर्म संरक्षक राम
देवकी नंदन मुरलीधरा आनंद दायक श्याम
ईश्वराम्बा सुत श्री सत्य साई प्रेमामृत भगवान
जय जय जय शिव शक्ति स्वरूपा मंगल दायक नाम
---
दशरथ नंदन राम
आनंद दायक श्याम
प्रेमामृत भगवान
जय जय जय साई राम (बोलो)
respell:
Dasharath Nandana Shrī Rāmachandrā Dharma Saṃrakshak Rām
Devakī Nandana Muralīdharā Ānanda Dāyak Shyām
Īshwarāmbā Sut Shrī Satya Sāī Premāmṛuta Bhagavān
Jaya Jaya Jaya Shiv Shakti Swarūpā Maṅgal Dāyak Nām
---
Dasharath Nandana Rām
Ānanda Dāyak Shyām
Premāmṛuta Bhagavān
Jay Jay Jay Sāī Rām (bolo)

title: Dasharatha Ram Janaki Ram
lyrics:
Dasharatha Ram Janaki Ram
Maruti Sevita Manobhi Ram
Sita Ram Sri Raghu Ram
Parthipureeshwara Sri Sai Ram
Jaya Jaya Ram Janaki Ram
Ahalyoddharaka Ananda Ram
meaning: Oh Lord Rama, son of Dasharatha and beloved of Janaki, you are served by Maruti and bring delight to our minds. We glorify you, Raghu Rama, the blissful savior of Ahalya, and also invoke Lord Sai Rama, the divine ruler of Parthi. Victory to you, Sita Rama!
devanagari:
दशरथ राम जानकी राम
मारुती सेवित मनोभी राम
सीता राम श्री रघु राम
पर्तीपूरीश्वर श्री साई राम
जय जय राम जानकी राम
अहलोद्धारक आनंद राम
respell:
Dasharath Rām Jānakī Rām
Mārutī Sevit Manobhī Rām
Sītā Rām Shrī Raghu Rām
Partīpūrīshwar Shrī Sāī Rām
Jaya Jaya Rām Jānakī Rām
Ahaloddhārak Ānanda Rām

title: Datta Guru Datta Guru Dattareya Guru
lyrics:
Datta Guru Datta Guru Dattareya Guru
Sai Natha Deena Natha Brahma Roopa Guru
Alakh Niranjana Bhava Bhaya Bhanjana Dattreya Guru
Dattatreya Guru
Sai Natha Guru
meaning: We invoke the divine teacher Dattatreya and Lord Sai Nath, who is the protector of the humble and a manifestation of the Absolute Truth. This pure, untainted Guru, Dattatreya, dispels all fear associated with the cycle of worldly existence.
devanagari:
दत्त गुरु दत्त गुरु दत्तात्रेय गुरु
साई नाथ दीन नाथ ब्रह्म रूप गुरु
अलख निरंजन भव भय भंजन दत्तात्रेय गुरु
दत्तात्रेय गुरु
साई नाथ गुरु
respell:
Datta Guru Datta Guru Dattātrey Guru
Sāī Nātha Dīna Nātha Brahma Rūp Guru
Alakh Nirañjan Bhava Bhaya Bhañjana Dattātrey Guru
Dattātrey Guru
Sāī Nāth Guru

title: Dattatreya Sadguru Deva
lyrics:
Dattatreya Sadguru Deva
Dehi Dehi Tava Sri Pada Seva
Tum Hi Brahma Sanatana Deva
Vishnu Narayana Sri Vasudeva
Pannaga Bhushana Shiva Mahadeva
Dehi Dehi Tava Sri Pada Seva
meaning: O Dattatreya, divine Sadguru, we implore you to grant us the privilege of serving your holy feet. You are the eternal Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva, the great lord adorned with serpents. Bestow upon us this sacred service.
devanagari:
दत्तात्रेया सद्गुरु देवा
देहि देहि तव श्री पाद सेवा
तुम ही ब्रह्म सनातन देवा
विष्णु नारायण श्री वासुदेवा
पन्नग भूषण शिव महादेवा
देहि देहि तव श्री पाद सेवा
respell:
Dattātreyā Sadguru Devā
Dehi Dehi Tava Shrī Pāda Sevā
Tum Hī Brahma Sanātana Devā
Vishṇu Nārāyaṇ Shrī Vāsudevā
Pannaga Bhūshaṇ Shiv Mahādevā
Dehi Dehi Tava Shrī Pāda Sevā

title: Daya Karo Bhagawan Shankara Daya Karo Bhagawan
lyrics:
Daya Karo Bhagawan Shankara Daya Karo Bhagawan
Parvati Ramana Pannaga Bhooshana Neelakantha Daya Karo
Chandrashekara Chandrakala Dhara Vibhuti Sundara Daya Karo
Trishoola Dhari Trinetra Dhari Gangadhari Daya Karo
meaning: O Lord Shiva, compassionate Shankara, consort of Parvati and savior of the world, we pray for Your mercy. O Neelakantha, Chandrashekara, Trishula-bearing and three-eyed Lord, bless us with Your grace, remove our suffering, purify our hearts, and guide us toward peace, wisdom, and liberation
devanagari:
दया करो भगवान शंकर दया करो भगवान
पार्वती रमणा पन्नग भूषणा नीलकंठा दया करो [ दया करो ]
चंद्रशेखरा चंद्रकला धरा विभूति सुंदर दया करो [ दया करो ... ]
त्रिशूल धारी त्रिनेत्र धारी गंगाधारी दया करो
respell:
Dayā Karo Bhagavān Shaṅkar Dayā Karo Bhagavān
Pārwatī Ramaṇā Pannaga Bhūshaṇā Nīlakaṇṭhā Dayā Karo [ Dayā Karo ]
Chandrashekharā Chandrakalā Dharā Vibhūti Sundara Dayā Karo [ Dayā Karo ... ]
Trishūl Dhārī Trinetra Dhārī Gaṅgādhārī Dayā Karo

title: Daya Karo Hari Narayana
lyrics:
Daya Karo Hari Narayana
Daya Karo Hey Krupa Karo
Krupa Karo Baba Daya Karo
Daya Karo Krupa Karo Narayana
Hey Daya Karo Krupa Karo Narayana
Deena Ke Bandhu Deena Sharana Hari Narayana
Narayana Narayana
Deena Ke Bandhu Deena Sharana Hari Narayana
Daya Karo Krupa Karo Narayana
meaning: Oh Hari Narayana, please shower us with your boundless mercy and compassion. You are the true friend and refuge for the helpless and downtrodden, Baba, so grant us your divine grace.
devanagari:
दया करो हरी नारायणा
दया करो हे कृपा करो
कृपा करो बाबा दया करो
दया करो कृपा करो नारायणा
हे दया करो कृपा करो नारायणा
दीन के बंधु दीन शरण हरी नारायणा
नारायणा नारायणा
दीन के बंधु दीन शरण हरी नारायणा
दया करो कृपा करो नारायणा
respell:
Dayā Karo Harī Nārāyaṇā
Dayā Karo He Kṛupā Karo
Kṛupā Karo Bābā Dayā Karo
Dayā Karo Kṛupā Karo Nārāyaṇā
He Dayā Karo Kṛupā Karo Nārāyaṇā
Dīna Ke Bandhu Dīna Sharaṇ Harī Nārāyaṇā
Nārāyaṇā Nārāyaṇā
Dīna Ke Bandhu Dīna Sharaṇ Harī Nārāyaṇā
Dayā Karo Kṛupā Karo Nārāyaṇā

title: Daya Karo Hari Narayana
lyrics:
Daya Karo Hari Narayana
Krupa Karo He Jaga Vandana
Bhavateeta Bhagya Vidhata
Deenanatha Anatha Ke Natha
meaning: Oh Lord Hari Narayana, please shower us with your boundless compassion and grace, for you are revered by the entire universe. You transcend all states of being, are the architect of our destiny, and the ultimate protector of the humble and the helpless.
devanagari:
दया करो हरि नारायणा
कृपा करो हे जग वंदना [ दया करो ... ]
भावातीता भाग्य विधाता
दीनानाथा अनाथ के नाथा
respell:
Dayā Karo Hari Nārāyaṇā
Kṛupā Karo He Jaga Vandanā [ dayā karo ... ]
Bhāvātītā Bhāgya Vidhātā
Dīnānāthā Anātha Ke Nāthā

title: Daya Karo Hey Daya Nidhe He Bhagawan
lyrics:
Daya Karo Hey Daya Nidhey Hey Bhagawan
Tan Man Dhan Sab Sharana Tumharey [ Daya Karo ... ]
Adi Anantha Hari Avinashi
Sada Nirantara Ghat Ghat Vasi
Deena Dayala Sada Krupala (2)
meaning: O Lord, fount of compassion, grant us Your mercy, as our body, mind, and wealth are all surrendered to You. You are the eternal, all-pervading Hari, ever kind and merciful to the humble.
devanagari:
दया करो हे दया निदे हे भगवान
तन मन धन सब शरण तुम्हारे [ दया करो ... ]
आदि अनन्ता हरि अविनाशी
सदा निरन्तर घट घट वासी
दीन दयाला सदा कृपाला (2)
respell:
Dayā Karo He Dayā Nidhe He Bhagavān
Tan Man Dhan Sab Sharaṇ Tumhāre [ Dayā Karo ... ]
Ādi Anantā Hari Avināshī
Sadā Nirantara Ghaṭ Ghaṭ Vāsī
Dīna Dayālā Sadā Kṛupālā (2)

title: Daya Karo Hey Karuna Nidhan Sai
lyrics:
Daya Karo Hey Karuna Nidhan Sai
Tum Ho Data Daya Karo
Tum Ho Sai Krupa Karo
Prabhu Tum Sai Antaryami
Parthipuri Bhagawan
Tum Ho Data Daya Karo
Tum Ho Sai Krupa Karo
meaning: O Sai, ocean of compassion, please shower us with your mercy. You are the divine giver and inner guide, so bestow your grace upon us.
devanagari:
दया करो हे करुणा निधान साई
तुम हो दाता दया करो
तुम हो साई कृपा करो
प्रभु तुम साई अंतर्यामी
पर्तीपुरी भगवान
पर्तीपुरी भगवान
तुम हो दाता दया करो
respell:
Dayā Karo He Karuṇā Nidhān Sāī
Tum Ho Dātā Dayā Karo
Tum Ho Sāī Kṛupā Karo
Prabhu Tum Sāī Antaryāmī
Partīpurī Bhagavān
Partīpurī Bhagavān
tuma ho dātā dayā karo

title: Daya Karo Sadguru Sai Daya Karo
lyrics:
Daya Karo Sadguru Sai Daya Karo
Shirdi Nivasa Sai Daya Karo
Parthi Nivasa Sai Daya Karo
Meera Ke Prabhu Giridhara Nagara
Tum Ho Brahma Eshwara
Radha Kanta Parvati Ramana
Deena Bandhava Sai Daya Karo
Parthi Nivasa Sai Daya Karo
meaning: O Sadguru Sai, residing in Shirdi and Parthi, we pray for your divine compassion. You are Meera's Lord, the mountain-lifter, embodying Brahma, Ishwara, Radha's beloved, and Parvati's consort, ever the friend of the helpless.
devanagari:
दया करो सद्गुरु साई दया करो
शिर्डी निवासा साई दया करो
पर्ती निवासा साई दया करो [ दया करो ... ]
मीरा के प्रभु गिरिधर नागर
तुम हो ब्रह्म ईश्वर
राधा कान्ता पार्वती रमणा
दीन बंधवा साई दया करो [ पर्ती निवासा ... ]
respell:
Dayā Karo Sadguru Sāī Dayā Karo
Shirḍī Nivāsā Sāī Dayā Karo
Partī Nivāsā Sāī Dayā Karo [ Dayā Karo ... ]
Mīrā Ke Prabhu Giridhara Nāgar
Tum Ho Brahma Īshwar
Rādhā Kāntā Pārwatī Ramaṇā
Dīna Bandhavā Sāī Dayā Karo [ Partī Nivāsā ... ]

title: Daya Karo Sai Narayana
lyrics:
Daya Karo Sai Narayana
Karuna Sagara Narayana
Pankaja Nayana Pannaga Shayana
Sri Vasudeva Narayana
Papa Vinasha Prasanthi Vasa
Parthipuri Sai Narayana
Paramananda Narayana
meaning: O Sai Narayana, grant us your mercy, for you are an ocean of compassion. With lotus eyes, reclining on the serpent, you destroy sins, residing in Prashanthi Nilayam at Puttaparthi, the very essence of supreme bliss.
devanagari:
दया करो साई नारायणा
करुणा सागर नारायणा
पंकज नयन पन्नग शयना
श्री वासुदेव नारायणा
पाप विनाशा प्रशांति वासा
पर्तीपुरी साई नारायणा
परमानंदा नारायणा
respell:
Dayā Karo Sāī Nārāyaṇā
Karuṇā Sāgar Nārāyaṇā
Paṅkaj Nayan Pannaga Shayanā
Shrī Vāsudeva Nārāyaṇā
Pāpa Vināshā Prashānti Vāsā
Partīpurī Sāī Nārāyaṇā
Paramānandā Nārāyaṇā

title: Daya Karo Shiva Gangadhari
lyrics:
Daya Karo Shiva Gangadhari
Krupa Karo Shiva Hey Tripurari
Naama Madhura Shubha Mangala Kaari
Alakha Niranjana Trishula Dhari
Daya Karo Krupa Karo Raksha Karo Bhola Bhandari
meaning: O Lord Shiva, who holds the sacred Ganga and vanquished Tripura, please bestow your compassion and grace upon us. Your sweet name brings all good fortune, and though imperceptible, you are pure, bearing the trident. Mercifully protect us, O innocent and generous giver.
devanagari:
दया करो शिव गंगाधारी  
कृपा करो शिव हे त्रिपुरारी [ दया करो ... ]  
नाम मधुर शुभ मंगलकारी  
अलख निरंजन त्रिशूल धारी  
दया करो दया करो दया करो भोला भंडारी
respell:
Dayā Karo Shiv Gaṅgādhārī
Kṛupā Karo Shiv He Tripurārī [ Dayā Karo ... ]
Nāma Madhura Shubh Maṅgalakārī
Alakh Nirañjana Trishūl Dhārī
Dayā Karo Dayā Karo Dayā Karo Bholā Bhaṇḍārī

title: Daya Sagara Karunakara
lyrics:
Daya Sagara Karunakara  
Jagadeeshwara Sayeeshwara [ Daya Sagara ]
Bhuvaneshwara Akhileshwara
Guna Gambhira Sayeeshwara (2)
meaning: Oh Lord Sai, you are the source of infinite mercy and compassion, the divine ruler of the cosmos. You are the sovereign of all worlds and the entire universe, embodying profound and noble virtues.
devanagari:
दया सागरा करुणाकरा
जगदीश्वरा साईश्वरा [ दया सागरा ]
भुवनेश्वरा अखिलेश्वरा
गुण गंभीरा साईश्वरा (2)
respell:
Dayā Sāgarā Karuṇākarā
Jagadīshwarā Sāīshwarā [ Dayā Sāgarā ]
Bhuvaneshwarā Akhileshwarā
Guṇ Gambhīrā Sāīshwarā (2)

title: Daya Sudha Barsao Mata Jaya Jaya Jaya Ambe
lyrics:
Daya Sudha Barsao Mata Jaya Jaya Jaya Ambe
Prema Sudha Barsao Mata Jaya Jaya Jaya Ambe
Devi Niranjani Sai Bhavani
Jaya Jaya Jaya Ambe
meaning: Oh Mother Ambe, pour forth the sweet nectar of your compassion and boundless love upon us. Hail to you, Stainless Goddess Sai Bhavani, we sing your eternal glories!
devanagari:
दया सुधा बरसाओ माता जय जय जय अम्बे  
प्रेम सुधा बरसाओ माता जय जय जय अम्बे  
देवी निरंजनि साई भवानी  
जय जय जय अम्बे (2)
respell:
Dayā Sudhā Barasāo Mātā Jaya Jaya Jaya Ambe
Prem Sudhā Barasāo Mātā Jaya Jaya Jaya Ambe
Devī Nirañjani Sāī Bhavānī
Jaya Jaya Jaya Ambe (2)

title: Dayabhi Rama Janaki Rama
lyrics:
Dayabhi Rama Janaki Rama
Madhura Manohara Prabhu Sai Rama
Atma Rama Nayanabhi Rama
Kodanda Rama Pattabhi Rama
Raghupati Raghava Raja Rama
Madhura Manohara Prabhu Sai Rama
meaning: O Rama, ocean of compassion and beloved of Janaki, You are the beautiful indwelling Self, enchanting to our eyes. We praise You, the mighty wielder of the Kodanda bow, crowned King of the Raghu dynasty, sweet and captivating Lord Sai Rama.
devanagari:
दयाभी रामा जनाकी रामा
मधुर मनोहर प्रभु साई रामा
आत्मा रामा नयनाभि रामा
कोदंड रामा पट्टाभि रामा
राघुपति राघव राजा रामा [ मधुर मनोहर ... ]
respell:
Dayābhī Rāmā Janākī Rāmā
Madhura Manohar Prabhu Sāī Rāmā
Ātmā Rāmā Nayanābhi Rāmā
Kodaṇḍa Rāmā Paṭṭābhi Rāmā
Rāghupati Rāghav Rājā Rāmā [ Madhura Manohar ... ]

title: Dayamaya Sri Rama Hare
lyrics:
Dayamaya Sri Rama Harey
Krupamaya Sri Sai Harey
Dharma Swaroopa Rama Harey
Prema Swaroopa Sai Harey
Sathya Dharma Shanthi Daata Sathya Sai Baba Harey
meaning: Oh compassionate Lord Rama, and merciful Lord Sai, we hail you! You are Rama, the very form of righteousness, and Sai, the embodiment of divine love. Oh Sathya Sai Baba, you are the generous bestower of truth, dharma, and peace.
devanagari:
दयामया श्री राम हरे
कृपामया श्री साई हरे
धर्म स्वरूपा राम हरे
प्रेम स्वरूपा साई हरे
सत्य धर्म शान्ति दाता सत्य साई बाबा हरे
respell:
Dayāmayā Shrī Rām Hare
Kṛupāmayā Shrī Sāī Hare
Dharma Swarūpā Rām Hare
Prem Swarūpā Sāī Hare
Satya Dharma Shānti Dātā Satya Sāī Bābā Hare

title: Deena Bandhava Baba Daya Sagara
lyrics:
Deena Bandhava Baba Daya Sagara
Patita Pavana Sai Karunakara
Sathya Sai Prema Sai Shanti Dharma Sindhu Sai
Jeevan Adhar Sai Janani Janaka Bandhu Sai
Patita Pavana Sai Karunakara
meaning: O Baba, friend of the downtrodden and ocean of boundless mercy, you purify the fallen with your grace. You are Sathya Sai, the very essence of Truth, Love, Peace, and Righteousness, the eternal support and companion throughout our many lives.
devanagari:
दीन बांधवा बाबा दया सागरा
पतित पावना साई करुणाकरा
[ दीन बांधवा ... ]
सत्य साई प्रेम साई शांति धर्म सिंधु साई
जीवन का आधार साई जनम जनम बंधु साई
[ पतित पावना ... ]
respell:
Dīna Bāndhavā Bābā Dayā Sāgarā
Patita Pāvanā Sāī Karuṇākarā
[ Dīna Bāndhavā ... ]
Satya Sāī Prem Sāī Shānti Dharma Sindhu Sāī
Jīvan Kā Ādhār Sāī Janam Janam Bandhu Sāī
[ Patita Pāvanā ... ]

title: Deena Bandhava Sri Sai Deva
lyrics:
Deena Bandhava Sri Sai Deva
Daya Sagara Devadi Deva
Pahi Prabho Sayeeshwara
Dehi Vibho Jagadeeshwara
Sharanam Prabho Sathya Sai Deva
meaning: O Sri Sai, you are the beloved friend of the helpless and an infinite ocean of compassion. As the God of all gods and Lord of the Universe, I plead for your protection and grace. I take my ultimate refuge in you, O Lord.
devanagari:
दीना बान्धवा श्री साई देवा
दया सागरा देवादी देवा [ दीना बान्धवा ... ]
पाहि प्रभो साईश्वरा
देहि विभो जगदीश्वरा
शरणम् प्रभो सत्य साई देवा
respell:
Dīnā Bāndhavā Shrī Sāī Devā
Dayā Sāgarā Devādī Devā [ Dīnā Bāndhavā ... ]
Pāhi Prabho Sāīshwarā
Dehi Vibho Jagadīshwarā
Sharaṇam Prabho Satya Sāī Devā

title: Deena Bandhu Vitthala Jai Karuna Sindhu Vitthala Jai
lyrics:
Deena Bandhu Vitthala Jai Karuna Sindhu Vitthala Jai
Vitthala Vitthala Vitthala Jai Vitthala Vitthala Vitthala Jai
Pandhari Natha Vitthala Jai Panduranga Vitthala Jai
Parthi Pureesha Vitthala Jai Prasanthi Nilaya Vitthala Jai
meaning: Oh Vitthala, friend of the humble and ocean of boundless compassion, we hail Your glory! Victory to You, Lord of Pandharpur, Panduranga, who also manifests as the divine master of Parthi and Prasanthi Nilayam.
devanagari:
दीना बंधु विट्ठला जय करुणा सिंधु विट्ठला जय
विट्ठला विट्ठला विट्ठला जय विट्ठला विट्ठला विट्ठला जय
पंढरी नाथा विट्ठला जय पांडुरंगा विट्ठला जय
पर्ती पूरीशा विट्ठला जय प्रशांति निलया विट्ठला जय [ विट्ठला विट्ठला ... ]
respell:
Dīnā Bandhu Viṭṭhalā Jay Karuṇā Sindhu Viṭṭhalā Jay
Viṭṭhalā Viṭṭhalā Viṭṭhalā Jay Viṭṭhalā Viṭṭhalā Viṭṭhalā Jay
Paṇḍharī Nāthā Viṭṭhalā Jay Pāṇḍuraṅgā Viṭṭhalā Jay
Partī Pūrīshā Viṭṭhalā Jay Prashānti Nilayā Viṭṭhalā Jay [ Viṭṭhalā Viṭṭhalā ... ]

title: Deena Dayala Hari Parama Dayala
lyrics:
Deena Dayala Hari Parama Dayala
Radha Ramana Hari Govinda Gopala
Madhura Manohara Krishna Gopala
Radha Ramana Hari Govinda Gopala
Meera Ke Prabhu Giridhara Bala
Brindavana Ghana Madana Gopala
meaning: O Lord Krishna, You are the compassionate and loving protector of all. As Radha's beloved, Meera's Lord, Govinda, Gopala, and the lifter of Govardhana Hill, You enchant the hearts of devotees with Your beauty, grace, and divine love. We worship You and seek Your blessings, protection, and the joy of Your presence in our lives
devanagari:
दीन दयाला हरि परम दयाला
राधा रमण हरि गोविन्द गोपाला
मधुर मनोहर कृष्ण गोपाला
राधा रमण हरि गोविन्द गोपाला
मीरा के प्रभु गिरिधर बाला
ब्रिन्दावन घन मदन गोपाला
respell:
Dīna Dayālā Hari Param Dayālā
Rādhā Ramaṇa Hari Govinda Gopālā
Madhura Manohar Kṛushṇa Gopālā
Rādhā Ramaṇa Hari Govinda Gopālā
Mīrā Ke Prabhu Giridhara Bālā
Brindāvan Ghan Madana Gopālā

title: Deena Dayala Sri Sai Rama
lyrics:
Deena Dayala Sri Sai Rama
Jagadoddhara Prasanthi Rama
Anatha Rakshaka Ananda Rama
Ananda Rama Prabhu Sai Rama
Anatha Rakshaka Ananda Rama
Atmabhi Rama Prabhu Sai Rama
meaning: O Lord Sai Rama, You are compassionate to the distressed and the savior of the entire world, emanating from Prashanthi. You are the blissful protector of the helpless, the very delight and indweller of our souls.
devanagari:
दीन दयाला श्री साई रामा
जगदोद्धारा प्रशांति रामा
अनाथ रक्षक आनंद रामा
आनंद रामा प्रभु साई रामा
अनाथ रक्षक आनंद रामा
आत्माभि रामा प्रभु साई रामा
respell:
Dīna Dayālā Shrī Sāī Rāmā
Jagadoddhārā Prashānti Rāmā
Anātha Rakshak Ānanda Rāmā
Ānanda Rāmā Prabhu Sāī Rāmā
Anātha Rakshak Ānanda Rāmā
Ātmābhi Rāmā Prabhu Sāī Rāmā

title: Deena Dukhiyon Ke Taran Karan
lyrics:
Deena Dukhiyon Ke Taran Karan
Tum Ho Isa Masiha O Sai Baba [Deena Dukhiyon..]
Dharma Uddharana Bhakta Parayana
Adi Narayana Sai
Alakha Niranjana Bhava Bhaya Bhanjana
Parthi Narayana Sai
meaning: Oh Sai Baba, you are the compassionate savior of the poor and suffering, truly a divine Messiah. You are the upholder of righteousness, the ultimate refuge for devotees, and the primordial Lord Narayana. Pure and unmanifest, you dispel the fear of the cycle of birth and death, O Narayana of Parthi.
devanagari:
दीन दुखियों के तारण कारण
तुम हो इसा मसीहा ओ साईं बाबा [ दीन दुखियों ... ]
धर्म उद्धरण भक्त परायण
आदि नारायण साईं
अलख निरंजन भव भय भंजन
पर्ती नारायण साईं (2)
respell:
Dīna Dukhiyoṃ Ke Tāraṇ Kāraṇ
Tum Ho Isā Masīhā O Sāīṃ Bābā [ Dīna Dukhiyoṃ ... ]
Dharma Uddharaṇ Bhakta Parāyaṇ
Ādi Nārāyaṇ Sāīṃ
Alakh Nirañjan Bhava Bhaya Bhañjana
Partī Nārāyaṇ Sāīṃ (2)

title: Deena Dukhiyon Se Prem Karo Mera Sai Prasanna Hoga
lyrics:
Deena Dukhiyon Se Prem Karo Mera Sai Prasanna Hoga
Sai Mera Mein Tera Yeh Prem Ki Behati Dhara
Yeh Prem Ki Behati Dhara
Mera Sai Prasanna Hoga
meaning: Embrace the poor and suffering with love, for this brings great joy to my Sai. This reciprocal bond, where Sai is mine and I am His, represents the ever-flowing stream of divine love.
devanagari:
दीन दुखियों से प्रेम करो मेरा साई प्रसन्न होगा  
साई मेरा मैं तेरा ये प्रेम की बहती धारा  
ये प्रेम की बहती धारा  
मेरा साई प्रसन्न होगा
respell:
Dīna Dukhiyoṃ Se Prem Karo Merā Sāī Prasanna Hogā
Sāī Merā Maiṃ Terā Ye Prem Kī Bahatī Dhārā
Ye Prem Kī Bahatī Dhārā
Merā Sāī Prasanna Hogā

title: Deena Janavani Vara Dayini
lyrics:
Deena Janavani Vara Dayini
Jnana Swaroopini Narayani
Sayeeshwari Amba Jagadeeshwari
Veda Roopini Vageshwari
Veda Swaroopini Vageshwari
Prema Pradayini Partheeshwari
Mata Maheshwari Mana Mohini
Sayeeshwari Amba Jagadeeshwari
meaning: Oh Mother Sai, protector of the humble and bestower of blessings, you are the embodiment of wisdom, Narayani, the supreme Goddess of the universe. As the very form of the Vedas and the Goddess of speech, you shower us with love, enchanting our minds as the great Mother Maheshwari of Parthi.
devanagari:
दीन जनावनी वर दायिनी
ज्ञान स्वरूपिणी नारायणी
साईश्वरी अम्बा जगदीश्वरी
वेद (स्व)रूपिणी वागेश्वरी
प्रेम प्रदायिनी पर्तिश्वरी
माता महेश्वरी मन मोहिनी [ साईश्वरी अम्बा ... ]
respell:
Dīna Janāvanī Var Dāyinī
Jñāna Swarūpiṇī Nārāyaṇī
Sāīshwarī Ambā Jagadīshwarī
Ved (swa)rūpiṇī Vāgeshwarī
Prem Pradāyinī Partishwarī
Mātā Maheshwarī Mana Mohinī [ Sāīshwarī Ambā ... ]

title: Deena Natha Shankara
lyrics:
Deena Natha Shankara
Karuna Sagara Shankara
Parthi Pureeshwara Shankara
Bhola Natha Kailasa Vasa
Parthi Pureeshwara Hey Paramesha
Sayeeshwara Deva
meaning: Oh Shankara, protector of the helpless and ocean of boundless compassion, we bow to You. You are the simple-hearted dweller of Kailasa, the Supreme Lord of Parthi, our divine Sai.
devanagari:
दीना नाथा शंकरा
करुणा सागर शंकरा
पर्तिपूरीश्वर शंकरा
भोला नाथ कैलासा वासा
पर्तिपूरीश्वर हे परमेशा
साईश्वर देवा
respell:
Dīnā Nāthā Shaṅkarā
Karuṇā Sāgar Shaṅkarā
Partipūrīshwar Shaṅkarā
Bholā Nātha Kailāsā Vāsā
Partipūrīshwar He Parameshā
Sāīshwar Devā

title: Dehi Sharanam Simha Vahini
lyrics:
Dehi Sharanam Simha Vahini
Dehi Sharanam Asura Vinashini
Dehi Sharanam Bhava Bhaya Harini
Dehi Sharanam Hari Narayani
Dehi Sharanam Brahma Sanatani
Dehi Sharanam Sai Narayani
meaning: Oh Divine Mother, lion-rider and destroyer of all evil, grant me your sacred refuge. You are Narayani, the eternal Brahman, who removes the fear of worldly cycles; in your form as Sai, please protect me.
devanagari:
देहि शरणम् सिंह वाहिनी
देहि शरणम् असुर विनाशिनी
देहि शरणम् भव भय हारिणी
देहि शरणम् हरि नारायणी
देहि शरणम् ब्रह्म सनातनी
देहि शरणम् साई नारायणी
respell:
Dehi Sharaṇam Siṃh Vāhinī
Dehi Sharaṇam Asur Vināshinī
Dehi Sharaṇam Bhava Bhaya Hāriṇī
Dehi Sharaṇam Hari Nārāyaṇī
Dehi Sharaṇam Brahma Sanātanī
Dehi Sharaṇam Sāī Nārāyaṇī

title: Deva Devottama Deena Samrakshaka
lyrics:
Deva Devottama Deena Samrakshaka
Devadi Deva Dayamaya
Sri Sai Deva Kripamaya
Patitoddhara Papa Vidoora
Parthi Vihara Parameshwara
Bhasmodbhavakara Bhava Bhaya Nashaka
Sri Sai Deva Kripamaya
meaning: Oh Lord Sai, You are the supreme among gods, the protector of the helpless, and the very embodiment of divine compassion and grace. Dwelling in Parthi, You uplift the fallen, remove all sins, manifest sacred ash, and destroy the fear of worldly existence.
devanagari:
देव देवोत्तम दीन सम्रक्षक
देवादी देव दयामयया
श्री साई देव कृपामया [ देव देवोत्तम ... ]
पतितोद्धारा पाप विदूरा
पर्ति विहारा परमेश्वरा
भस्मोद्भवकर भव भय नाशन [ श्री साई देव ... ]
respell:
Deva Devottama Dīna Samrakshak
Devādī Deva Dayāmayayā
Shrī Sāī Deva Kṛupāmayā [ Deva Devottama ... ]
Patitoddhārā Pāpa Vidūrā
Parti Vihārā Parameshwarā
Bhasmodbhavakar Bhava Bhaya Nāshan [ Shrī Sāī Deva ... ]

title: Deva Senapate Skanda Subrahmanya Pahimam
lyrics:
Deva Senapathey Skanda Subrahmanya Paahi Maam  
Paahi Parameshwara Skanda Subrahmanya Paahi Maam
Subrahmanya Shanmukha Natha
Sai Natha Karuna Sindho
meaning: Oh Lord Subrahmanya, divine commander of the gods, we earnestly seek your protection. You are the Supreme Lord, the six-faced Skanda, an ocean of compassion manifest as Sai Natha.
devanagari:
देव सेनापते स्कन्दा सुभ्रमण्य पाहि माम्  
पाहि परमेश्वरा स्कन्दा सुब्रमण्या पाहि माम्  
सुब्रमण्या शण्मुख नाथा
साई नाथा करुणा सिंधो [ पाहि परमेश्वरा ... ]
respell:
Deva Senāpate Skandā Subhramaṇya Pāhi Mām
Pāhi Parameshwarā Skandā Subramaṇyā Pāhi Mām
Subramaṇyā Shaṇmukha Nāthā
Sāī Nāthā Karuṇā Sindho [ Pāhi Parameshwarā ... ]

title: Devaki Tanaya Daya Nidhe
lyrics:
Devaki Tanaya Daya Nidhe
Daya Nidhe Kripa Nidhe
Darshana Deejo Deva Deva
Darshana Deejo Sai Deva
Deena Natha Sai Natha
meaning: O Son of Devaki, boundless ocean of compassion and grace, we humbly pray for your divine vision. O Lord of Lords, Sai, protector of the meek, please bestow upon us your sacred sight.
devanagari:
देवकी तनया दया निधे
दया निधे कृपा निधे [देवकी तनया ..]
दर्शन दीजो देव (साई) देवा
दीना नाथा साई नाथा
respell:
Devakī Tanayā Dayā Nidhe
Dayā Nidhe Kṛupā Nidhe [devakī Tanayā ..]
Darshan Dījo Deva (sāī) Devā
Dīnā Nāthā Sāī Nāthā

title: Devi Bhavani Jagat Janani
lyrics:
Devi Bhavani Jagat Janani
Mandahasini Ananda Dayini
Mangala Karini Karunya Roopini
Narayani Devi Narayani
Mahishasura Mardini Ambe Bhavani
meaning: Oh Divine Mother Bhavani, creator of the cosmos, your gentle smile bestows pure bliss and auspiciousness upon us. You are the compassionate Narayani, Ambe, who vanquished the demon Mahishasura.
devanagari:
देवी भवानी जगत जननी
मंद हासिनी आनंद दायिनी [ देवी भवानी ... ]
मंगल कारिणी करुण्य रूपिणी
नारायणी देवी नारायणी
महिषासुर मर्दिनी अम्बे भवानी
respell:
Devī Bhavānī Jagat Jananī
Manda Hāsinī Ānanda Dāyinī [ Devī Bhavānī ... ]
Maṅgal Kāriṇī Karuṇya Rūpiṇī
Nārāyaṇī Devī Nārāyaṇī
Mahishāsur Mardinī Ambe Bhavānī

title: Devi Bhavani Ma Jaya Sai Bhavani Ma
lyrics:
Devi Bhavani Ma Jaya Sai Bhavani Ma
Daya Karo Sai Ma Kripa Karo Sai Ma
Jaya Ma Jaya Ma Jaya Devi Bhavani Ma
Jaya Parthi Nivasini Ma Jaya Sai Bhavani Ma
meaning: Victory to Mother Sai Bhavani, the destroyer of the cycle of birth and demise. O Sai Ma, bestow upon us Your mercy and compassion. O Mother, resident of Parthi, victory and glory to You!
devanagari:
देवी भवानी मा जय साई भवानी मा
दया करो साई मा कृपा करो साई मा
जय मा जय मा जय देवी भवानी मा
जय पर्ती निवासिनी मा जय साई भवानी मा
respell:
Devī Bhavānī Mā Jaya Sāī Bhavānī Mā
Dayā Karo Sāī Mā Kṛupā Karo Sāī Mā
Jaya Mā Jaya Mā Jaya Devī Bhavānī Mā
Jaya Partī Nivāsinī Mā Jaya Sāī Bhavānī Mā

title: Devi Jagajjanani Sai Mata
lyrics:
Devi Jagajjanani Sai Mata
Pranava Swaroopini Praneshwari
Jnana Pradayini Jnaneshwari
Tripura Sundari Dakshayani
Bhagawati Bharati Narayani
Jagadeeshwari Jaganmohini
Karunamayi Sathya Sayeeshwari
meaning: Oh Divine Mother Sai, You are the Mother of the universe, the very form of Om and the essence of life itself. Giver of wisdom, You are the beautiful daughter of Daksha, embodying Bhagawati, Bharati, and Narayani. Ruler and enchantress of all worlds, You are the compassionate Goddess Sai of Truth.
devanagari:
देवी जगज्जननी साई माता
प्रणव स्वरूपिणी प्राणेश्वरी
ज्ञान प्रदायिनी ज्ञानेश्वरी
त्रिपुर सुंदरी दाक्षायणी
भगवती भारती नारायणी
जगदीश्वरी जगन्मोहिनी
करुणामयी सत्य साईश्वरी
respell:
Devī Jagajjananī Sāī Mātā
Praṇava Swarūpiṇī Prāṇeshwarī
Jñāna Pradāyinī Jñāneshwarī
Tripura Sundarī Dākshāyaṇī
Bhagavatī Bhāratī Nārāyaṇī
Jagadīshwarī Jaganmohinī
Karuṇāmayī Satya Sāīshwarī

title: Devi Sai Ma Devi Saraswati Ma
lyrics:
Devi Sai Ma Devi Saraswati Ma
Durga Bhavani Ma Kali Kapalini Ma
Jagadoddharini Ma
Sathya Sai Daya Karo Ma
meaning: We invoke the Divine Mother in her various forms—Sai, Saraswati, Durga, and Kali—who embody wisdom, protection, and fierce liberation. O Uplifter of the cosmos, we humbly pray for your boundless mercy and grace.
devanagari:
देवी साई मा देवी सरस्वती मा  
दुर्गा भवानी मा काली कपालिनी मा  
जगदोधारिणी मा  
साई दया करो मा (सत्य)
respell:
Devī Sāī Mā Devī Saraswatī Mā
Durgā Bhavānī Mā Kālī Kapālinī Mā
Jagadodhāriṇī Mā
Sāī Dayā Karo Mā (satya)

title: Dhanya Ho Eshwaramba
lyrics:
Dhanya Ho Eshwaramba
Jag Ko Deejo Lal Baba
Dhanya Ho Dhanya Ho
Kali Yug Mein Avatar Liye
Sakala Charachara Ke Bhagawan
Jagadoddhara Sai Narayana
Dhanya Ho Dhanya Ho
--
Dhanya Ho Dhanya Ho
Dhanya Ho Eshwaramba
meaning: Glory to you, Mother Eshwaramba, for gifting the world our beloved Sai Baba. He is the Lord of all creation, Sai Narayana, who incarnated in this Kali Yuga to uplift the entire universe.
devanagari:
धन्य हो ईश्वराम्बा
जग को दीजो लाल बाबा
धन्य हो धन्य हो
कली युग में अवतार लिए
सकल चराचर के भगवान
जगतोद्धारा साई नारायण
धन्य हो धन्य हो
धन्य हो ईश्वराम्बा
respell:
Dhanya Ho Īshwarāmbā
Jag Ko Dījo Lāl Bābā
Dhanya Ho Dhanya Ho
Kalī Yug Meṃ Avatār Lie
Sakal Charāchara Ke Bhagavān
Jagatoddhārā Sāī Nārāyaṇ
Dhanya Ho Dhanya Ho
Dhanya Ho Īshwarāmbā

title: Dhim Dhim Dhimi Dhimi Natana Shiva
lyrics:
Dhim Dhim Dhimi Dhimi Natana Shiva
Tandava Keli Vilasa Shiva
Leela Manusha Vesha Shiva
Lingodbhavakara Sai Shiva
Sai Shiva Hara Bala Shiva
meaning: Oh Shiva, you are the cosmic dancer, moving to the rhythm of 'Dhim Dhim,' delighting in the Tandava. You assume a human form as a divine sport, Sai Shiva, manifesting the sacred Lingam. Hail to you, youthful Sai Shiva!
devanagari:
धिम धिम धिमी धिमी नटन शिवा
तांडव केली विलास शिवा
लीला मनुष वेष शिवा
लिंगोद्धवकर साई शिवा (आत्मा)
साई शिव हर बाल शिवा
respell:
Dhim Dhim Dhimī Dhimī Naṭana Shivā
Tāṇḍava Kelī Vilās Shivā
Līlā Manusha Vesh Shivā
Liṅgoddhavakar Sāī Shivā (ātmā)
Sāī Shiv Har Bāla Shivā

title: Dhimita Dhimita Dhim Dhimita Dhimita Dhim Nache Bhola Nath
lyrics:
Dhimita Dhimita Dhim Dhimita Dhimita Dhim Nache Bhola Nath
Nache Bhola Nath (4)
Om Dhimita Dhimita Dhim Dhimita Dhimita Dhim Nache Bhola Nath
Mridanga Bole Shiva Shiva Shiva Om
Damaru Bole Hara Hara Hara Om
Veena Bole Sairam Sairam
Nache Bhola Nath (4)
meaning: Lord Bhola Nath (Shiva) dances with vibrant energy to the rhythmic sounds of "Dhimita Dhim." The mridanga drum resonates with chants of "Shiva Shiva Om," the damaru echoes "Hara Hara Om," and the veena sings "Sairam," all joining in the divine celebration.
devanagari:
धिमित धिमित धिम धिमित धिमित धिम नाचे भोला नाथ
नाचे भोला नाथ (४)
मृदंग बोले शिव शिव शिव ॐ
डमरू बोले हर हर हर ॐ
वीणा बोले साई राम साई राम
नाचे भोला नाथ (४)
respell:
Dhimita Dhimita Dhim Dhimita Dhimita Dhim Nāche Bholā Nāth
Nāche Bholā Nāth (4)
Mṛudaṅga Bole Shiv Shiv Shiv Oṃ
Ḍamarū Bole Har Har Har Oṃ
Vīṇā Bole Sāī Rām Sāī Rām
Nāche Bholā Nāth (4)

title: Divine Mother Soham
lyrics:
Divine Mother Soham You And I Are One
Shirdi Baba Soham You And I Are One
Jesus Christ Soham You And I Are One
Divine Father Soham You And I Are One
Brahma Brahma Soham You And I Are One
Allah Allah Soham You And I Are One
Buddha Buddha Soham You And I Are One
Sathya Sai Soham You And I Are One
devanagari:
डिवाइन मदर सोहम यू अन्ड आइ आर वन
शिर्डी बाबा सोहम यू अन्ड आइ आर वन
जीजस क्राइस्ट सोहम यू अन्ड आइ आर वन
डिवाइन फादर सोहम यू अन्ड आइ आर वन
ब्रह्म ब्रह्म सोहम यू अन्ड आइ आर वन
अल्लाह अल्लाह सोहम यू अन्ड आइ आर वन
बुद्ध बुद्ध सोहम यू अन्ड आइ आर वन
सत्य साई सोहम यू अन्ड आइ आर वन

title: Dont Worry Be Happy
lyrics:
Dont Worry, Be Happy For Baba Loves Us So
Illusions Are Many But Underneath Them All
There Is One Reality That You And I Are One
That God Is Love And Love Is God And God And Man Are One
meaning: Cast aside all worries and embrace happiness, for the Divine's boundless love eternally embraces us. Beneath the veil of countless illusions, the singular truth reveals our inherent unity, affirming that God is pure love, and this divine essence is one with all humanity.
devanagari:
डोन्ट वरई बी हैपी फोर बाबा लव्ज अस सो
इलूजन्ज आर मेनी बट अन्डरनीथ देम ओल
देर इज वन रीऐलटी दैट यू अन्ड आइ आर वन
दैट गाड इज लव अन्ड लव इज गाड अन्ड गाड अन्ड मन आर वन

title: Dum Dum Dum Dum Damaru Bhaje
lyrics:
Dum Dum Dum Dum Damaru Bhaje
Hara Bhole Nath Shiva Shambho Bhaje
Hara Sai Nath Shiva Shambho Bhaje
Ghana Ghana Ghana Ghana Ghanta Bhaje
Hara Gauri Nath Shiva Shambho Bhaje
Hara Sai Nath Shiva Shambho Bhaje
meaning:
The sound of the Damaru praises the Merciful Lord (Bholenath) and Lord Sainath.
The ringing of the Bell glorifies the consort of Mother Gowri (Gowrinath) and Lord Sainath.
devanagari:
डम डम डम डम डमरू बजे
हर भोले नाथ शिव शंभो भजे
हर साईं नाथ शिव शंभो भजे
घण घण घण घण घंटा बजे
हर गौरी नाथ शिव शंभो भजे
[ हर साईं नाथ ... ]
respell:
Ḍam Ḍam Ḍam Ḍam Ḍamarū Baje
Har Bhole Nāth Shiv Shambho Bhaje
Har Sāīṃ Nāth Shiv Shambho Bhaje
Ghaṇ Ghaṇ Ghaṇ Ghaṇ Ghaṇṭā Baje
Har Gaurī Nāth Shiv Shambho Bhaje
[ Har Sāīṃ Nāth ... ]

title: Durga Amba Bhavani Jai Jai Durga Amba Bhavani
lyrics:
Durga Amba Bhavani Jai Jai Durga Amba Bhavani
Mangala Karini Sankata Harini
Pranava Swaroopini Mata Jai Jai
Durga Amba Bhavani
meaning: Oh Mother Durga, Amba, Bhavani, we hail your glorious presence! You are the bestower of all auspiciousness, the remover of all sorrows and difficulties. Divine Mother, embodiment of the sacred sound Om, we offer our salutations to you.
devanagari:
दुर्गा अम्बा भवानी जय जय दुर्गा अम्बा भवानी
मंगल करिणी संकट हरिणी
प्रणव स्वरूपिणी माता जय जय
दुर्गा अम्बा भवानी
respell:
Durgā Ambā Bhavānī Jay Jay Durgā Ambā Bhavānī
Maṅgal Kariṇī Saṅkaṭ Hariṇī
Praṇava Swarūpiṇī Mātā Jay Jay
Durgā Ambā Bhavānī

title: Durga Bhavani Ma Jaya Jaya Sai Ma
lyrics:
Durga Bhavani Ma Jaya Jaya Sai Ma
Kali Kapalini Ma Jaya Jaya Sai Ma
Parama Shivani Ma Jaya Jaya Sai Ma
Jagadoddharini Ma Jaya Jaya Sai Ma
meaning: Jubilant praise to Mother Sai, she is  the embodiment of the Divine Mother in all her powerful manifestations, including Durga, Bhavani, Kali, and Shivani. She is  the supreme cosmic energy and the compassionate redeemer who uplifts the entire world.
devanagari:
दुर्गा भवानी माँ जय जय साई माँ
काली कपालिनी मा जय जय साई माँ [ दुर्गा भवानी ... ]
परम शिवानी माँ जय जय साई माँ
जगतोद्धारिणी माँ जय जय साई माँ
respell:
Durgā Bhavānī Mām̐ Jaya Jaya Sāī Mām̐
Kālī Kapālinī Mā Jaya Jaya Sāī Mām̐ [ Durgā Bhavānī ... ]
Param Shivānī Mām̐ Jaya Jaya Sāī Mām̐
Jagatoddhāriṇī Mām̐ Jaya Jaya Sāī Mām̐

title: Durge Durge Durge Jai Jai Ma
lyrics:
Durge Durge Durge Jai Jai Ma
Amba Durge Durge Durge Jai Jai Ma
Karuna Sagari Ma
Kali Kapalini Ma
Jagadoddharini Ma
Amba Durge Jai Jai Ma
Amba Durge Sai Ma
meaning: Oh Mother Durga, we celebrate your victory! You are the boundless ocean of compassion, the fierce Kali who shatters all illusion, and the divine power who uplifts the entire universe. We offer our devotion to you, Mother Durga, who manifests as Sai.
devanagari:
दुर्गे दुर्गे दुर्गे जय जय माँ (2)  
करुणा सागरि माँ  
काली कपालिनी माँ  
जगदोधारिणी माँ  
(अम्बा) दुर्गे जय जय (साई) माँ
respell:
Durge Durge Durge Jay Jay Mām̐ (2)
Karuṇā Sāgari Mām̐
Kālī Kapālinī Mām̐
Jagadodhāriṇī Mām̐
(ambā) Durge Jay Jay (sāī) Mām̐

title: Ek Baar Kshama Karo Sai
lyrics:
Ek Baar Kshama Karo Sai Merey Baba Sri Sathya Sai
Kshama Murthy Sai Baba Prema Murthy Sathya Sai [ Ek Baar ... ]
Shirdi Ke Sai Teri Dwarakamayi
Parthi Ke Sai Teri Yaad Mujhey Aayi [ Kshama Murthy ... ]
meaning: The devotee humbly implores Sri Sathya Sai Baba, the very embodiment of forgiveness and boundless love, to grant pardon. They recall the divine presence of Shirdi Sai, whose spirit now manifests as the Sai of Parthi, affirming the eternal continuity of the Lord's grace.
devanagari:
एक बार क्षमा करो साई मेरे बाबा श्री सत्य साई
क्षमा मूर्ति साई बाबा प्रेम मूर्ति सत्य साई [ एक बार ... ]
शिर्डी के साई तेरी द्वारकामायी
पर्ती के साई तेरी याद मुझे आई [ क्षमा मूर्ति ... ]
respell:
Ek Bār Kshamā Karo Sāī Mere Bābā Shrī Satya Sāī
Kshamā Mūrti Sāī Bābā Prem Mūrti Satya Sāī [ Ek Bār ... ]
Shirḍī Ke Sāī Terī Dwārakāmāyī
Partī Ke Sāī Terī Yād Mujhe Āī [ Kshamā Mūrti ... ]

title: Eshwar Allah Ek Tumhi Ho
lyrics:
Eshwar Allah Ek Tum Hi Ho
Karuna Sindhu Ram
Deena Janon Ke Jeevan Sahare
Bhakta Janon Ke Jeevan Sahare
Daya Karo Bhagawan
Mujhe Kripa Karo Bhagawan
Karuna Sagar Dayabhi Ram
Jai Sai Ram Bolo Jai Sai Ram (2)
meaning: Eshwar and Allah are one, O Lord Ram, an ocean of compassion. You are the refuge and life-giver for the humble and the devotees; bestow your grace upon us, O Bhagawan. We joyfully chant victory to Sai Ram.
devanagari:
ईश्वर अल्लाह एक तुम ही हो
करुणा सिंधो राम
दीन (भक्त) जनों के जीवन सहारे
दया (मुझे कृपा) करो भगवान
करुणा सागर दयाभि राम
जय साई राम बोलो जय साई राम (2)
respell:
Īshwar Allāh Ek Tum Hī Ho
Karuṇā Sindho Rām
Dīna (bhakta) Janoṃ Ke Jīvan Sahāre
Dayā (mujhe Kṛupā) Karo Bhagavān
Karuṇā Sāgar Dayābhi Rām
Jay Sāī Rām Bolo Jay Sāī Rām (2)

title: Eshwar Allah Tere Nam Sai Tere Nam
lyrics:
Eshwar Allah Tere Nam Sai Tere Nam
Sarva Dharma Priya Sai Ram Sathya Sai Ram
Allah Sai Maula Sai
Yeshu Buddha Sai He Mahavir Sai
Govinda Sai Gopala Sai Nanak Sai
Sarva Dharma Priya Sai Ram Sathya Sai Ram
meaning: O Sai, Your divine presence is known by all sacred names – Eshwar, Allah, Jesus, Buddha, Mahavir, Govinda, Gopala, and Nanak. You are the beloved truth of all faiths, O Sathya Sai Ram, embracing every spiritual path as Your own.
devanagari:
ईश्वर अल्लाह तेरे नाम साई तेरे नाम
सर्व धर्म प्रिय साई राम सत्य साई राम
अल्लाह साई मौलाह साई
येशु बुद्ध साई हे महावीर साई
गोविन्द साई गोपाल साई नानक साई [ सर्व धर्म ... ]
respell:
Īshwar Allāh Tere Nām Sāī Tere Nām
Sarwa Dharma Priy Sāī Rām Satya Sāī Rām
Allāh Sāī Maulāh Sāī
Yeshu Buddha Sāī He Mahāvīr Sāī
Govinda Sāī Gopāla Sāī Nānak Sāī [ Sarwa Dharma ... ]

title: Eshwaramba Nandana Jagat Vidhata
lyrics:
Eshwaramba Nandana Jagat Vidhata
Parthi Nivasa Sai Deva Daya Karo Guru Deva (Hey)
Kamala Nayana Hey Hrudaya Vihari
Ananda Dayaka Hey Giridhari
Charan Sharan Mey Lelo Hum Ko
Yuga Avatara Krishna (Sai) Murari [ Parthi Nivasa ... ]
meaning: O Divine Sai, son of Eshwaramba and creator of the universe, you dwell in Puttaparthi. O lotus-eyed Guru, indweller of our hearts and bestower of bliss, please have mercy on us. O Krishna-Sai, incarnation of this age, take us into the refuge of your sacred feet.
devanagari:
ईश्वरम्बा नंदन जगत विधाता
पर्ती निवासा साई देवा दया करो गुरु देवा (हे)
कमल नयन हे हृदय विहारी
आनंद दायक हे गिरिधारी
चरण शरण मे लो हम को
युग अवतारा कृष्ण (साई) मुरारी [पर्ती निवासा ...]
respell:
Īshwarambā Nandana Jagat Vidhātā
Partī Nivāsā Sāī Devā Dayā Karo Guru Devā (he)
Kamala Nayan He Hṛudaya Vihārī
Ānanda Dāyak He Giridhārī
Charaṇ Sharaṇ Me Lo Ham Ko
Yug Avatārā Kṛushṇa (sāī) Murārī [partī Nivāsā ...]
