title: Eshwaramba Priya Nandana
lyrics:
Eshwaramba Priya Nandana
Ratnakara Kula Bhushana
Akhila Loka Nayaka
Parama Pujya Pavana
Apasthamba Sutrana
Antaranga Rangana
Bharadwajasa Gotrana
Bhavya Nama Keertana
meaning: Oh, beloved son of Eshwaramba, jewel of the Ratnakara clan, you are the Lord of all worlds, supremely pure and worthy of worship. Born in the sacred lineages of Apastamba and Bharadwaja, you dwell within our hearts, and we joyfully sing your glorious name.
devanagari:
ईश्वरम्बा प्रिय नन्दना
रत्नाकर कुल भूषणा
अखिल लोका नायका
परम पूज्य पावना
अपस्तम्बा सूत्रणा
अन्तरङ्गा रङ्गणा
भारद्वाजस गोत्रणा
भव्य नामा कीर्तना
respell:
Īshwarambā Priy Nandanā
Ratnākar Kul Bhūshaṇā
Akhil Lokā Nāyakā
Param Pūjya Pāvanā
Apastambā Sūtraṇā
Antaraṅgā Raṅgaṇā
Bhāradwājasa Gotraṇā
Bhavya Nāmā Kīrtanā

title: Eshwaramba Priya Nandana Hey Sai Rama
lyrics:
Eshwaramba Priya Nandana Hey Sai Rama
Ikshvaku Vamsha Deepa Hey Sai Rama
Devagiri Sutha Sai Shirdi Sai Rama
Godavari Thata Vasi Hey Sai Rama
Prema Sai Natha Avatara Sai Rama
Sarvatma Swaroopa Sathya Sai Rama
meaning: O Sai Rama, you are the beloved son of Eshwaramba and the radiant light of Rama's ancient lineage. You are the same Lord who dwelt in Shirdi and will incarnate as Prema Sai, for your true nature is the divine Self residing within all beings.
devanagari:
ईश्वरम्बा प्रिय नंदन हे साई रामा
इक्ष्वाकु वंश दीप हे साई रामा
देवगिरी सुत साई शिर्डी साई रामा
गोदावरी तट वासी हे साई रामा
प्रेम साई नाथा अवतार साई रामा
सर्वात्म स्वरूप सत्य साई रामा
respell:
Īshwarambā Priy Nandana He Sāī Rāmā
Ikshwāku Vaṃsh Dīpa He Sāī Rāmā
Devagirī Sut Sāī Shirḍī Sāī Rāmā
Godāvarī Taṭa Vāsī He Sāī Rāmā
Prem Sāī Nāthā Avatāra Sāī Rāmā
Sarwātma Swarūp Satya Sāī Rāmā

title: Eshwaramba Priya Nandana
lyrics:
Eshwaramba Priya Nandana
Sai Jaya Jaga Vandana
Ratnakara Kula Bhushana
Rajeeva Nayana Narayana
Narayana Sai Narayana
meaning: Oh Sai, beloved son of Mother Eshwaramba, victory to You, adored by the entire world! You are the radiant jewel of the Ratnakara lineage, the lotus-eyed Narayana, truly Hari Himself.
devanagari:
ईश्वरम्बा प्रिय नंदना
साई जय जग वंदना (2) [ ईश्वरम्बा ... ]
रत्नाकर कुल भूषणा
राजीव नयन नारायणा
नारायणा हरि नारायणा
नारायणा साई नारायणा
नारायणा हरि नारायणा (3) (नारायणा साई नारायणा)
respell:
Īshwarambā Priy Nandanā
Sāī Jaya Jaga Vandanā (2) [ Īshwarambā ... ]
Ratnākar Kul Bhūshaṇā
Rājīva Nayan Nārāyaṇā
Nārāyaṇā Hari Nārāyaṇā
Nārāyaṇā Sāī Nārāyaṇā
Nārāyaṇā Hari Nārāyaṇā (3) (nārāyaṇā Sāī Nārāyaṇā)

title: Eshwaramba Priya Tanaya Sai Narayana
lyrics:
Eshwaramba Priya Tanaya Sai Narayana
Sai Narayana Sathya Narayana
Kali Yug Mein Avatar Liye
Kan Kan Mein Tera Nam O Sai
Kan Kan Mein Tera Nam
meaning: O Sai Narayana, beloved son of Eshwaramba, you are the very embodiment of truth. Having incarnated in this Kali Yuga, your sacred name echoes through every particle of existence.
devanagari:
ईश्वराम्बा प्रिय तनया साई नारायणा
साई नारायण सत्य नारायण [ ईश्वराम्बा ... ]
कली युग में अवतार लिए
कण कण में तेरा नाम (ओ साई) (2)
respell:
Īshwarāmbā Priy Tanayā Sāī Nārāyaṇā
Sāī Nārāyaṇ Satya Nārāyaṇ [ Īshwarāmbā ... ]
Kalī Yug Meṃ Avatār Lie
Kaṇ Kaṇ Meṃ Terā Nām (o Sāī) (2)

title: Eshwari Nandana Parthi Gajanana
lyrics:
Eshwari Nandana Parthi Gajanana
Pranava Swaroopa Pahi Prabho
Omkareshwara Pashupati Nandana
Parthipureeshwara Palaya Maam
meaning: O Lord of Parthi, you are the elephant-faced son of Mother Eshwari and the very embodiment of the sacred sound Om. As Omkareshwara and the beloved Pashupati, please protect and sustain us.
devanagari:
ईश्वरी नंदन पर्ती गजानन
प्रणव स्वरूपा पाहि प्रभो
ओंकारेश्वर पशुपति नंदन
पर्तीपुरीश्वर पालय माम्
respell:
Īshwarī Nandana Partī Gajānana
Praṇava Swarūpā Pāhi Prabho
Oṅkāreshwar Pashupati Nandana
Partīpurīshwar Pālay Mām

title: Eshwari Nandana Sai Gopala
lyrics:
Eshwari Nandana Sai Gopala
Sri Madhusudana Krishna Krishna
Sai Madhusudana Krishna Krishna
Jagadoddhara Parthi Vihara
Prema Swaroopa Premavatara
Dwarakamai Sri Sathya Sai
Hey Jaganmohana Krishna Krishna
Sai Jaganmohana Krishna Krishna
meaning: O Sai Gopala, son of Eshwari, you are Krishna, the slayer of Madhu, the uplifter of the universe residing in Parthi. You are the very embodiment and incarnation of love, Sri Sathya Sai, who, like Dwarakamayi, enchants the entire world.
devanagari:
ईश्वरि नन्दन साई गोपाला
हे (साई) मधुसूदन कृष्णा कृष्णा [ ईश्वरि नन्दन ... ]
जगतोद्धारा पर्ती विहारा
प्रेम स्वरूपा प्रेमावतारा
द्वारकामयी श्री सत्य साई
हे (साई) जगन्मोहन कृष्णा कृष्णा
respell:
Īshwari Nandana Sāī Gopālā
He (sāī) Madhusūdana Kṛushṇā Kṛushṇā [ Īshwari Nandana ... ]
Jagatoddhārā Partī Vihārā
Prem Swarūpā Premāvatārā
Dwārakāmayī Shrī Satya Sāī
He (sāī) Jaganmohan Kṛushṇā Kṛushṇā

title: Every Moment Of My Life
lyrics:
Every Moment Of My Life Please Be With Me
In Every Single Act Of Mine Be Thou My Guide
Baba Sai Baba
When I Slip When I Fall Lend Me A Hand
When I Stray Far Away Lead Me Back Again
Baba Sai Baba
From The Darkness Into Light Lead Me, Father
From The Unreal To The Real
Baba Sai Baba (2)
meaning: Oh Baba Sai, I humbly ask for your unwavering presence and divine guidance in every step of my journey. Should I stumble or wander, please uplift me and illuminate my path, leading me from illusion to the profound reality of your truth.
devanagari:
एवरई मोमन्ट अव माइ लाइफ प्लीज बी विद मी
इन एवरई सिङ्गल ऐक्ट अव माइन बी दाउ माइ गाइड
बाबा साई बाबा
वेन आइ स्लिप वेन आइ फोल लेन्ड मी अ हैन्ड
वेन आइ स्ट्रे फार अवे लेड मी बैक अगेन
बाबा साई बाबा
फ्रम द डार्क्नस इन्टू लाइट लेड मी फादर
फ्रम द अन्रील टू द रील
बाबा साई बाबा

title: Everyone Is My Brother
lyrics:
Everyone Is My Brother When I Say Sai Ram, Sai Ram Sai Ram
No More Difference Between Us When I Say Sai Ram, Sai Ram Sai Ram
Sai Ram, Sai Ram, Baba Help Me Always Say Sai Ram
Sai Ram, Sai Ram, Everyday Please Help Me Say Sai Ram
Only Light Is Around Me When I Say Sai Ram, Sai Ram Sai Ram
No More Darkness Around Me When I Say Sai Ram, Sai Ram Sai Ram
Sai Ram, Sai Ram, Baba Help Me Always Say Sai Ram
Sai Ram, Sai Ram, Everyday Please Help Me Say Sai Ram
devanagari:
एव्रीवन इज माइ ब्रदर वेन आइ से साई राम साई राम साई राम
नो मोर डिफरअन्स बिट्वीन अस वेन आइ से साई राम साई राम साई राम
साई राम साई राम बाबा हेल्प मी ओल्वेज से साई राम
साई राम साई राम एव्रीडे प्लीज हेल्प मी से साई राम
ओन्ली लाइट इज अरआउन्ड मी वेन आइ से साई राम साई राम साई राम
नो मोर डार्क्नस अरआउन्ड मी वेन आइ से साई राम साई राम साई राम
साई राम साई राम बाबा हेल्प मी ओल्वेज से साई राम
साई राम साई राम एव्रीडे प्लीज हेल्प मी से साई राम

title: Gaana Priyey Sai Karunamayi
lyrics:
Gaana Priyey Sai Karunamayi
Kadambari Amba Katyayani [ Gaana Priyey ... ]
Hari Vallabhey Sukha Dayini
Aumkara Roopini Narayani
Bhuvaneshwari (Amba) Jaganmohini
Sri Chakra Vasini Sayeeshwari

title: Gajamukha Gajamukha Gananatha
lyrics:
Gajamukha Gajamukha Gananatha
Suramuni Vandita Guna Sheela
Gajamukha Gajamukha Gananatha
Suramuni Vandita Guna Sheela
Gajamukha Gajamukha Gananatha
Suramuni Vandita Guna Sheela
meaning: Oh Gajamukha, elephant-faced Lord, leader of the Ganas, we honor your divine presence. You are the embodiment of virtue, revered by gods and sages alike.
devanagari:
गजमुख गजमुख गणनाथा 
सुरमुनि वंदिता गुण शीला 
[ गजमुख ... ]  
सुरमुनि वंदिता गुण शीला 
गजमुख गजमुख गणनाथा 
[ सुरमुनि ... ]
respell:
Gajamukha Gajamukha Gaṇanāthā
Suramuni Vanditā Guṇ Shīlā
[ Gajamukha ... ]
Suramuni Vanditā Guṇ Shīlā
Gajamukha Gajamukha Gaṇanāthā
[ Suramuni ... ]

title: Gajanana Gajanana
lyrics:
Gajanana Gajanana
Prathama Poojana Ganaraya
Prathama Prarthana Sri Ganaraya
Lambodara Ganaraya
meaning: We invoke Lord Ganesha, the elephant-faced and pot-bellied deity. He is the revered King of the Ganas, to whom all initial worship and prayers are devoutly offered.
devanagari:
गजानना गजानना
प्रथम पूजन गणराया [ गजानना ... ]
प्रथम प्रार्थना श्री गणराया
लंबोद्धरा गणराया
respell:
Gajānanā Gajānanā
Prathama Pūjana Gaṇarāyā [ Gajānanā ... ]
Prathama Prārthanā Shrī Gaṇarāyā
Lamboddharā Gaṇarāyā

title: Gajanana He Shubhanana
lyrics:
Gajanana Hey Shubhanana
Gowri Manohara Priya Nandana
Pashupathi Tanaya Gajanana
Parama Niranjana Shubhanana (Hey)
meaning: O Gajanana, whose very presence is auspicious, you are the beloved son who delights Mother Gowri. Child of Pashupati, you are the ultimate pure being, always radiating grace and good fortune.
devanagari:
गजानना हे शुभानना  
गौरी मनोहर प्रिय नंदना  
पशुपति तनया गजानना  
परम निरंजन शुभनना (हे)
respell:
Gajānanā He Shubhananā
Gaurī Manoharā Priy Nandanā
Pashupati Tanayā Gajānanā
Paramā Nirañjana Shubhananā (he)

title: Gajanana Hey Gajanana
lyrics:
Gajanana Hey Gajanana
Gauri Nandana Gajanana
Hey Shiva Nandana Jaya Jagavandana
Vidya Buddhi Pradayaka
Parama Niranjana Mooshika Vahana
Parthi Pureeshwara Gajanana
meaning: Oh Gajanana, elephant-faced Lord, You are the cherished son of Gauri and Shiva, worshipped throughout the cosmos. You grant us knowledge and wisdom, You are supremely pure, riding upon Your mouse, and the divine ruler of Puttaparthi.
devanagari:
गजानना हे गजानना
गौरी नंदन गजानना [ गजानना हे ... ]
हे शिव नंदन जय जग वंदन
विद्या बुद्धि प्रदायका
परम निरंजन मूषिक वाहन
पर्ती पूरीश्वर गजानना
respell:
Gajānanā He Gajānanā
Gaurī Nandan Gajānanā [ Gajānanā He ... ]
He Shiv Nandana Jaya Jaga Vandana
Vidyā Buddhi Pradāyakā
Param Nirañjana Mūshik Vāhan
Partī Pūrīshwar Gajānanā

title: Gajanana Hey Shubhanana
lyrics:
Gajanana Hey Shubhanana
Parama Niranjana Gajavadana
Vakratunda Dhara Vighna Vinasha
Pranava Swaroopa Parthi Pureesha
Siddhi Vinayaka Pahi Gajanana
Parama Niranjana Gajavadana
meaning: Oh Gajanana, with your auspicious elephant face, you are supremely pure and the destroyer of all obstacles. Embodiment of the sacred Om and Lord of Parthi, Siddhi Vinayaka, please protect us and grant us success.
devanagari:
गजानना हे शुभनना
परम निरञ्जना गजवदना
वक्रतुण्ड धर विघ्न विनाशा
प्रणव स्वरूप पर्तीपूरीशा
सिद्धि विनायक पाहि गजानन [ परम निरञ्जना ... ]
respell:
Gajānanā He Shubhananā
Param Nirañjanā Gajavadanā
Vakratuṇḍa Dhara Vighna Vināshā
Praṇava Swarūp Partīpūrīshā
Siddhi Vināyak Pāhi Gajānana [ Param Nirañjanā ... ]

title: Gajavadana Gajanana
lyrics:
Gajavadana Gajanana
Gowri Tanaya Gajanana
Jai Jai Jai Jai Gajanana (3)
Devadi Deva Gajanana
Gowri Tanaya Gajanana
meaning: Oh Gajanana, elephant-faced Lord, beloved son of Mother Gowri, we hail your glorious name! You are the supreme God of all deities, and we sing praises of victory to you.
devanagari:
गजवदना गजानना
गौरी तनया गजानना  
[ गजवदना ... ]  
जय जय जय जय गजानना (3)  
देवाधिदेव गजानना
[ गौरी तनया ... ]
respell:
Gajavadanā Gajānanā
Gaurī Tanayā Gajānanā
[ Gajavadanā ... ]
Jay Jaya Jaya jaya gajānanā (3)
Devādhidev Gajānanā
[ gaurī tanayā ... ]

title: Gajavadana Gananatha Gajavadana Vinayaka
lyrics:
Gajavadana Gananatha Gajavadana Vinayaka
Siddhi Vidhata Shiva Tanaya
Buddhi Pradayaka Gajanana
Parvati Nandana Bhava Bhaya Bhanjana
Yuga Yuga Vandita Jaya Sri Ganesha
meaning: Oh elephant-faced Ganesha, Lord of the Ganas and remover of all obstacles, you are the beloved son of Shiva and Parvati. You bestow success and profound wisdom, dispelling the fear of worldly existence. Victory to you, Lord Ganesha, revered and worshipped throughout all ages!
devanagari:
गजवदना गणनाथा गजवदना विनायका
सिद्धि विधाता शिव तनया
बुद्धि प्रदायक गजानना
पार्वती नंदन भव भय भंजन
युग युग वंदिता जय श्री गणेशा
respell:
Gajavadanā Gaṇanāthā Gajavadanā Vināyakā
Siddhi Vidhātā Shiv Tanayā
Buddhi Pradāyak Gajānanā
Pārwatī Nandana Bhava Bhaya Bhañjana
Yug Yug Vanditā Jaya Shrī Gaṇeshā

title: Gajavadana Gananatha Natha
lyrics:
Gajavadana Gananatha Natha
Gowri Vara Tanaya Gunaalaya [ Gajavadana ... ]
Vidya Dayaka Buddhi Pradayaka
Siddhi Vinayaka Hey Shubha Dayaka
meaning: O elephant-faced Lord, leader of the celestial hosts and beloved son of Mother Gowri, you are the embodiment of virtues. You graciously bestow knowledge, wisdom, and success, bringing auspiciousness to all who seek your blessings.
devanagari:
गजवदन गणनाथा नाथा
गौरी वर तनया गुणालया [ गजवदना ... ]
विद्या दायक बुद्धि प्रदायक
सिद्धि विनायक हे शुभ दायक
respell:
Gajavadana Gaṇanāthā Nāthā
Gaurī Var Tanayā Guṇālayā [ Gajavadanā ... ]
Vidyā Dāyak Buddhi Pradāyak
Siddhi Vināyak He Shubh Dāyak

title: Gajavadana Gananatha Natha
lyrics:
Gajavadana Gananatha Natha
Gaurivara Tanaya Gunalaya
Vidya Dayaka Buddhi Pradayaka
Siddhi Vinayaka Hey Shubha Dayaka
meaning: O elephant-faced Lord, master of the Ganas, beloved son of Gauri and abode of all virtues. You are the bestower of knowledge, intellect, and all auspiciousness, O Siddhi Vinayaka.
devanagari:
गजवदना गणनाथा नाथा
गौरीवर तनया गुणालया
विद्या दायक बुद्धि प्रदायक
सिद्धि विनायक हे शुभ दायक
respell:
Gajavadanā Gaṇanāthā Nāthā
Gaurīvar Tanayā Guṇālayā
Vidyā Dāyak Buddhi Pradāyak
Siddhi Vināyak He Shubh Dāyak

title: Gajavadana Gananatha
lyrics:
Gajavadana Gananatha
Gauri Tanaya Dayamaya
Bhuvanadhara Pranava Swaroopa
Palaya Palaya Parthipureesha
meaning: Oh elephant-faced Lord, leader of the celestial hosts, compassionate son of Gauri, You are the very support of the universe, the embodiment of Om. Protect us, protect us, Lord of Parthi!
devanagari:
गजवदना गणनाथा
गौरी तनया दयामया [ गजवदना ... ]
भुवनाद्धारा प्रणव स्वरूप
पालय पालय पर्ती पूरीश्वर
respell:
Gajavadanā Gaṇanāthā
Gaurī Tanayā Dayāmayā [ Gajavadanā ... ]
Bhuvanāddhārā Praṇava Swarūp
Pālay Pālay Partī Pūrīshwar

title: Gajavadana Jaya Namostute
lyrics:
Gajavadana Jaya Namostute
Nagajanandana Namostute
Vijaya Pradayaka Vighnanasha
Gajavadana Jaya Namostute
Mangaladayaka Namostute
Shubha Mangaladayaka Namostute
meaning: O elephant-faced Lord, we offer our victorious salutations to you, son of the mountain's daughter. You are the giver of triumph, the destroyer of all obstacles, and the bestower of every good and auspicious blessing.
devanagari:
गजवदना जय नमोस्तुते
नगजानंदन नमोस्तुते
विजय प्रदायक विघ्ननाशा
गजवदना जय नमोस्तुते
मंगलदायक नमोस्तुते
शुभ मंगलदायक नमोस्तुते
respell:
Gajavadanā Jaya Namostute
Nagajānandana Namostute
Vijaya Pradāyak Vighnanāshā
Gajavadanā Jaya Namostute
Maṅgaladāyak Namostute
Shubh Maṅgaladāyak Namostute

title: Gana Lola Gopala
lyrics:
Gana Lola Gopala
Sai Manohara Gopala [Gana Lola]
Jagadoddhara Parthi Vihara
Meera Ke Prabhu Giridhara Bala
--
Gopala Sai Gopala (5)
meaning: Oh Gopala, who delights in the joy of music, enchanting Sai, you are the liberator of all worlds. Dwelling in Parthi, you are the beloved Lord of Meera, the divine child who lifted the mountain. We sing your name, Gopala Sai, Gopala!
devanagari:
गान लोला गोपाला
साई मनोहर गोपाला [गान लोला]
जगदोद्धारा पर्ती विहारा
मीरा के प्रभु गिरिधर बाला
--
गोपाला साई गोपाला (5)
respell:
Gān Lolā Gopālā
Sāī Manohar Gopālā [gān Lolā]
Jagadoddhārā Partī Vihārā
Mīrā Ke Prabhu Giridhara Bālā
--
Gopālā Sāī Gopālā (5)

title: Gananatha Sai Gajanana
lyrics:
Gananatha Sai Gajanana
Partheeshwara Dukha Bhanjana
Kailasapathe Shiva Nandana Deena Natha Hare He Niranjana
Siddhi Pradata Shubhanana Jagadeeshwara Shanti Niketana
Jagadeeshwara Shanti Niketana
meaning: O Ganesha, elephant-faced Lord of the Ganas and Parthi, you are the remover of all suffering. Son of Shiva, pure and protector of the humble, you bestow spiritual powers with your auspicious countenance, embodying the Lord of the Universe and the very abode of peace.
devanagari:
गणनाथ साई गजानना
पर्तीश्वरा दुःख भंजना
कैलाश पते शिव नंदना दीन नाथ हरे हे निरंजना
सिद्धि प्रदाता शुभानना जगदीश्वर शांति निकेतना
जगदीश्वर शांति निकेतना
respell:
Gaṇanātha Sāī Gajānanā
Partīshwarā Duḥkha Bhañjanā
Kailāsh Pate Shiv Nandanā Dīna Nātha Hare He Nirañjanā
Siddhi Pradātā Shubhānanā Jagadīshwar Shānti Niketanā
Jagadīshwar Shānti Niketanā

title: Gananayakam Ganeshwaram (Sai)
lyrics:
Gananayakam Ganeshwaram (Sai)
Gowri Tanayam Gajananam [ Gananayakam ... ]
Mooshika Vahana Sri Gananatham
Paashankusha Dhara Bala Gajananam
Ananda Tandava Narthana Ganapathim
Vinayakam Vighnanashakam Vighneshwaram
meaning: O Ganesha, elephant-faced son of Gowri, you are the revered chief of the celestial beings, mounted on your mouse and holding the noose and goad. You perform a blissful cosmic dance, and as the pure Vinayaka, you are the ultimate dispeller of all hindrances.
devanagari:
गणनायकं गणेश्वरं (साई)  
गौरी तनयं गजाननं [गणनायकं ...]  
मूषिक वाहन श्री गणनाथं  
पाशांकुश धर बाल गजाननं  
आनंद तांडव नर्तन गणपतिं  
विनायकं विमलाचरं विघ्नेश्वरं
respell:
Gaṇanāyakaṃ Gaṇeshwaraṃ (sāī)
Gaurī Tanayaṃ Gajānanaṃ [gaṇanāyakaṃ ...]
Mūshik Vāhan Shrī Gaṇanāthaṃ
Pāshāṅkush Dhara Bāla Gajānanaṃ
Ānanda Tāṇḍava Nartana Gaṇapatiṃ
Vināyakaṃ Vimalācharaṃ Vighneshwaraṃ

title: Ganapati Om Jaya Ganapati Om
lyrics:
Ganapati Om Jaya Ganapati Om
Gajamukha Varada Ganapati Om
Mooshika Vahana Gajanana
Modaka Hasta Gajanana
Parama Niranjana Gajanana
Pada Namaste Gajanana
meaning: Victory to you, Lord Ganapati, the elephant-faced bestower of all blessings. O Gajanana, who rides upon a mouse and holds a sweet modaka, you are the supremely pure one. I offer my humble salutations at your divine feet.
devanagari:
गणपति ॐ जय गणपति ॐ
गजमुख वरदा गणपति ॐ [ गणपति ॐ ... ]
मूषिक वाहन गजानना
मोदक हस्ता गजानना
परम निरंजन गजानना
पाद नमस्ते गजानना
respell:
Gaṇapati Oṃ Jaya Gaṇapati Oṃ
Gajamukha Varadā Gaṇapati Oṃ [ Gaṇapati Oṃ ... ]
Mūshik Vāhan Gajānanā
Modaka Hastā Gajānanā
Param Nirañjana Gajānanā
Pāda Namaste Gajānanā

title: Ganesha Sharanam Sharanam Ganesha
lyrics:
Ganesha Sharanam Sharanam Ganesha (4)
Sayeesha Sharanam Sharanam Sayeesha (4)
meaning: Oh Ganesha, we take refuge in you, surrendering completely to your divine grace. Oh Sai, we also seek your protection and find our ultimate shelter in your loving presence.
devanagari:
गणेश चरणम् शरणम् गणेशा (4)  
साईश चरणम् शरणम् साईशा (4)
respell:
Gaṇesha Charaṇam Sharaṇam Gaṇeshā (4)
Sāīsh Charaṇam Sharaṇam Sāīshā (4)

title: Ganga Jatadhara Gauri Shankara Girija Mano Ramana
lyrics:
Ganga Jatadhara Gauri Shankara Girija Mano Ramana
Jaya Mrutyunjaya Mahadeva Maheshwara Mangala Shubha Charana
Nandi Vahana Naga Bhooshana
Nirupama Guna Sadana
Natana Manohara Neelakantha Sai
Neeraja Dala Nayana
meaning: This bhajan praises Lord Shankara, who holds the sacred Ganga in his matted hair and is the cherished companion of Girija. He is the death-conquering Mahadeva, whose blessed feet bring prosperity, riding Nandi and adorned with serpents. The captivating blue-throated dancer, Sai, is the very source of matchless qualities, with eyes resembling lotus petals.
devanagari:
गंगा जाताधर गौरी शंकर गिरिजा मनो रमणा
जय मृत्युंजय महादेव महेश्वर मंगल शुभ चरणा
नंदी वाहना नाग भूषणा
निरुपम गुण सदना
नटन मनोहर नीलकंठ साई
नीरज दल नयना
respell:
Gaṅgā Jātādhara Gaurī Shaṅkar Girijā Mano Ramaṇā
Jaya Mṛutyuñjaya Mahādeva Maheshwar Maṅgal Shubh Charaṇā
Nandī Vāhanā Nāga Bhūshaṇā
Nirupama Guṇ Sadanā
Naṭana Manohar Nīlakaṇṭh Sāī
Nīraj Dala Nayanā

title: Gangadhara Gauri Mahesha
lyrics:
Gangadhara Gauri Mahesha
Tripurantaka Jyoti Prakasha
Halahaladhara Paramesha
Chandrashekara Sai Mahesha
meaning: Sing the glory of Lord Shiva, the consort of Gowri and the one who bears the Ganges and the moon on His head. He illuminates us by destroying the demon "Tripura" who symbolizes the darkness within us. He is the ultimate Lord who drank the deadly poison of "Haalaa-hala" for the welfare of the world during the churning of the ocean. He is verily our Lord Sai Mahesha.
devanagari:
गंगाधर गौरी महेशा
त्रिपुरान्तक ज्योति प्रकाशा
हालाहलाधर परमेशा
चन्द्रशेखर साई महेशा
respell:
Gaṅgādhara Gaurī Maheshā
Tripurāntaka Jyoti Prakāshā
Hālāhalādhara Parameshā
Chandrashekhar Sāī Maheshā

title: Gangadhara Hara Gangadhara Hara Kailasa Natha Prabhu Shankara
lyrics:
Gangadhara Hara Gangadhara Hara Kailasa Natha Prabhu Shankara
Bhava Nasha Bhava Bandha Vimochana
Sathya Sai Shiva Shankara
meaning: We praise the Lord Sathya Sai, the One who is Auspicious, Captivating - The One who bears the Ganges on his head, One who is the Lord of the mountain 'Kailasa' and the One who liberates us from the bondage of the world and prevents us from taking birth again and again.
devanagari:
गंगाधरा हर गंगाधरा हर कैलासा नाथ प्रभु शंकरा
भव नाशा भव बंध विमोचन
सत्य साईं शिव शंकरा
respell:
Gaṅgādharā Har Gaṅgādharā Har Kailāsā Nātha Prabhu Shaṅkarā
Bhava Nāshā Bhava Bandha Vimochana
Satya Sāīṃ Shiv Shaṅkarā

title: Gangadhara Hara Gauri Shiva
lyrics:
Gangadhara Hara Gauri Shiva
Shambho Shankara Samba Shiva
Jaya Partheeshwara Jaya Parameshwara
Shirdi Nivasa Sayeeshwara
Parthipureesha Sayeeshwara
Jagadoddhara Sayeeshwara
Shambho Shankara Samba Shiva
meaning:
O Lord Shiva, the embodiment of auspiciousness who holds Ganga on the head and the constant companion of Goddess Gowri.
We seek Divine protection from you.
Glory to the lord of Parthi, who is the supreme. He had incarnated in Shirdi and has come to Parthi too. He constantly helps for uplifting the mankind.
devanagari:
गंगाधर हर गौरी शिवा
शंभो शंकर साम्ब शिवा
जय पर्तीश्वर जय परमेश्वर
शिरडी निवासा साईश्वरा
पर्तीपुरीशा साईश्वरा
जगदोद्धारा साईश्वरा
शंभो शंकर साम्ब शिवा
respell:
Gaṅgādhara Har Gaurī Shivā
Shambho Shaṅkar Sāmba Shivā
Jaya Partīshwar Jaya Parameshwar
Shiraḍī Nivāsā Sāīshwarā
Partīpurīshā Sāīshwarā
Jagadoddhārā Sāīshwarā
Shambho Shaṅkar Sāmba Shivā

title: Gangadhara Paahi Maam
lyrics:
Gangadhara Paahi Maam
Sai Natha Guru Satchidananda Guru [ Gangadhara Paahi ... ]
Neelakanta Shiva Gangadhara
Neelakanta Shiva Neelakanta Shiva Neelakanta Shiva Gangadhara Neelakanta Shiva Gangadhara
Bhasma Vibhushitha Gangadhara
meaning: Oh Gangadhara, bearer of the sacred Ganga, please protect me. Lord Sai, our divine Guru, you are the very essence of Truth, Consciousness, and Bliss, none other than Neelakanta Shiva, adorned with holy ash.
devanagari:
गंगाधरा पाहि माम
साई नाथ गुरु सच्चिदानंद गुरु [ गंगाधरा पाहि ... ]

नीलकंठ शिव नीलकंठ शिव नीलकंठ शिव गंगाधरा नीलकंठ शिव गंगाधरा

Nīlakaṇṭh Shiv Nīlakaṇṭh Shiv Nīlakaṇṭh Shiv Gaṅgādharā Nīlakaṇṭh Shiv Gaṅgādharā

title: Garuda Vahana Narayana
lyrics:
Garuda Vahana Narayana
Hey Shesha Shayana Narayana [ Garuda Vahana ... ]
Sri Lakshmi Ramana Narayana
Hari Aum Hari Aum Narayana
meaning: Oh Narayana, you who ride the mighty Garuda and recline upon the cosmic serpent Shesha. You are the beloved of Sri Lakshmi, and we chant your sacred names, Hari Aum, Hari Aum.
devanagari:
गरुड़ वाहना नारायणा
हे शेष शयना नारायणा [ गरुड़ वाहना ... ]
श्री लक्ष्मी रमणा नारायणा
हरि ॐ हरि ॐ नारायणा
respell:

He Shesh Shayanā Nārāyaṇā [ Garuḍa़ Vāhanā ... ]
Shrī Lakshmī Ramaṇā Nārāyaṇā
Hari Oṃ Hari Oṃ Nārāyaṇā

title: Gauri Nandana Gajanana
lyrics:
Gauri Nandana Gajanana
Gangadhara Hara Shambho Nandana
Parama Sumangala Mooshika Vahana
Gana Vinodana Gajanana
Hey Gana Vinodana Gajanana
meaning: Oh Gajanana, elephant-faced Lord, You are the beloved son of Mother Gauri and Lord Shiva, who bears the Ganga. Supremely auspicious, You ride the mouse and delight in the joy of music.
devanagari:
गौरी नंदन गजानना 
गंगाधर हर शंभो नंदना 
परम सुमंगल मूषिक वाहना
गाना विनोदना गजानना 
हे गाना विनोदना गजानना
respell:
Gaurī Nandana Gajānanā
Gaṅgādhara Har Shambho Nandanā
Param Sumaṅgal Mūshik Vāhanā
Gānā Vinodanā Gajānanā
He Gānā Vinodanā Gajānanā

title: Ghana Ghana Neela Vadana Ati Sundara
lyrics:
Ghana Ghana Neela Vadana Ati Sundara
Megha Shyamala Madhava Murahara
Mandasmita Mukha Radha Manohara
Govinda Gopala Natavara Giridhara
Megha Shyamala Madhava Murahara
meaning: Oh Lord Krishna, your beautiful face is a deep, dense blue, dark like a rain cloud, you are Madhava, the slayer of the demon Mura. Your gentle smile captivates Radha, and you are revered as Govinda, Gopala, the supreme dancer, and the lifter of mountains.
devanagari:
घन घन नील वदन अति सुंदर
मेघ श्यामल माधव मुरहर [ घन घन ... ]
मंदस्मित मुख राधा मनोहर
गोविन्द गोपाल नटवर गिरिधर [ मेघ श्यामल ... ]
respell:
Ghan Ghan Nīla Vadana Ati Sundara
Megha Shyāmala Mādhava Murahar [ Ghan Ghan ... ]
Mandasmita Mukha Rādhā Manohar
Govinda Gopāla Naṭavar Giridhara [ Megha Shyāmala ... ]

title: Ghana Shyama Bhajo Giridhari Bhajo
lyrics:
Ghana Shyama Bhajo Giridhari Bhajo
Mana Mohana Muralidhari Bhajo
Vrinda Vihari Shyama Bhajo
Madhuvana Sanchari Shyama Bhajo
Hridaya Nivasi Shyama Bhajo
Antaryami Sai Bhajo
Sarvantaryami Sai Bhajo
meaning: Worship the dark-hued Lord Krishna, the mountain-lifter who enchants all minds with His flute, roaming through Vrindavan and Madhu forest. Adore this Shyama, the divine resident within our hearts, for He is the omnipresent Sai, the indweller of all beings.
devanagari:
घन श्याम भजो गिरिधारी भजो
मन मोहन मुरलीधारी भजो [घन श्याम भजो ...]
वृंद विहारी श्याम भजो
मधुवन संचारी श्याम भजो
हृदय निवासी श्याम भजो
अंतर्यामी साई भजो
सर्वान्तर्यामी साई भजो
respell:
Ghan Shyām Bhajo Giridhārī Bhajo
Mana Mohan Muralīdhārī Bhajo [ghan shyām bhajo ...]
Vṛund Vihārī Shyām Bhajo
Madhuvan Sañchārī Shyām Bhajo
Hṛudaya Nivāsī Shyām Bhajo
Antaryāmī Sāī Bhajo
Sarwāntaryāmī Sāī Bhajo

title: Ghana Shyama Gopala Ghana Shyama Gopala
lyrics:
Ghana Shyama Gopala Ghana Shyama Gopala
Mana Mohana Jagan Mohana
Yadu Nandana Gopal
Gopala Gopala Shyama Gopala
Gopala Gopala Sai Gopala
meaning: Oh Gopala, whose form is like a dark monsoon cloud, you are the captivating one who enchants our minds and the entire universe. Beloved son of the Yadu dynasty, we sing your praises, our dark-hued Lord, our Sai Gopala.
devanagari:
घन श्याम गोपाला घन श्याम गोपाला
मन मोहना जगन्मोहना
यदु नंदना गोपाल
गोपाल गोपाल श्याम गोपाल 
गोपाल गोपाल श्याम गोपाल
respell:

Mana Mohanā Jaganmohanā
Yadu Nandanā Gopāl
Gopāla Gopāla Shyām Gopāla
Gopāla Gopāla Shyām Gopāla

title: Ghana Shyama Sundara
lyrics:
Ghana Shyama Sundara
Bansi Dhara Prabhu Krishna Kanhaiya
Tum Ho Mere Ma Bap Bhaiya
Devaki Tanaya He Nandalala
Deena Bandhava Dwaraka Natha
Radha Hridaya Nivasa Hare Krishna
Madhusudana Muralidhara
Partheeshwara Sathya Sayeeshwara
meaning: O beautiful, dark-hued Krishna, flute-bearer, you are my everything – my mother, father, and brother. You are Devaki's son, Nanda's beloved, friend of the downtrodden, Lord of Dwaraka, and dweller in Radha's heart, ultimately revealed as Sathya Sai, Lord of Parthi.
devanagari:
घनश्यामा सुन्दरा 
बंसीधर प्रभु कृष्ण कन्हैया 
तुम हो मेरे माँ बाप भैया  
[घनश्यामा सुंदरा ]
देवकी तनया हे नंदलाला 
दीनबांधवा द्वारकनाथा 
राधा हृदय निवासा हरे कृष्ना 
मधुसूदना मुरलीधरा 
पर्तिईश्वरा सत्यसाईश्वरा
respell:
Ghanashyāmā Sundarā
Baṃsīdhar Prabhu Kṛushṇ Kanhaiyā
Tum Ho Mere Mām̐ Bāp Bhaiyā
[ghanashyāmā Sundarā ]
Devakī Tanayā He Nandalālā
Dīnabāndhavā Dwārakanāthā
Rādhā Hṛudaya nivāsā hare kṛushnā
Madhusūdanā Muralīdharā
partiīshwarā satyasāīshwarā

title: Giridhar Mere Gopala
lyrics:
Giridhar Mere Gopala
Radhe Gopala Sai Gopala
Nanda Kishora Makhana Chora
Yashoda Bala Gopala
Radhe Gopala Sai Gopala
meaning: Oh my Gopala, you are the mountain-lifter, Radha's beloved, and the divine Sai. You are Nanda's youthful son, the playful butter thief, and Yashoda's dear child.
devanagari:
गिरिधर मेरे गोपाला
राधे गोपाला साई गोपाला
नन्द किशोरा माखन चोरा
यशोदा बाला गोपाला
राधे गोपाला साई गोपाला
respell:

Yashodā Bālā Gopālā

title: Giridhara Bala He Nandalala
lyrics:
Giridhara Bala Hey Nandalala  
Devaki Nandana Shyama Gopala [ Giridhara ... ]
Keshava Madhava Shyama Gopala
Shyama Gopala Shyama Gopala
Bansidhara Hey Sai Gopala
meaning: Oh beloved child, mountain-lifter, son of Nanda! You are Devaki's dark-hued darling, our divine cowherd. Keshava, Madhava, you are the enchanting flute-player, our very own Sai Gopala.
devanagari:
गिरिधर बाला हे नंदलाला
देवकी नंदन श्याम गोपाला [ गिरिधर ... ]

title: Giridhara Gopala Hey Giridhara Gopala Hey Giridhara Gopala
lyrics:
Giridhara Gopala Hey Giridhara Gopala Hey Giridhara Gopala
Meera Ke Prabhu Giridhara Nagara
Suradasa Ke Shyama Manohara
Bhakton Ke Sathya Sai Manohara
meaning: Chant the name of Lord Gopala, upholder of Giri mountain, Chant the name of Lord of Mira and Suradasa, Lord Shyama Giridhari; Chant the name of beautiful Lord Sathya Sai, beloved of His devotees
devanagari:
गिरिधर गोपाला हे गिरिधर गोपाला हे गिरिधर गोपाला

सूरदास के श्याम मनोहर  
भक्तों के सत्य साईं मनोहर
respell:

Mīrā Ke Prabhu Giridhara Nāgar

title: Giridhara Gopala Muralidhara Hare
lyrics:
Giridhara Gopala Muralidhara Hare
Govinda Gopala Damodara
Hare Govinda Gopala Damodara
meaning:
Chant the name of Lord Krishna, the
cowherd boy, who held aloft the Govardhana mountain, the One with the flute and in whom resides the whole Universe.
devanagari:

Giridhara Gopāla Muralīdharā Hare [ Govinda Gopāla ... ]

title: Giridhara Govinda Gopala Ghana Shyama Nandalala
lyrics:
Giridhara Govinda Gopala Ghana Shyama Nandalala
Mana Mohana Madhusudana Hey Madhava
Damodara Janardana Muralidhara Mana Mohana
Namo Sai Narayanaya Namo Sathya Narayanaya
Namo Sai Narayanaya
meaning:
O Lord, the beloved son of Nanda,  Your divine names are Giridhara,  Govinda,  Gopala and GhanaShyama! 
O Madhava, Madhusudana,  You are so attractive! 
I bow down to Lord Sai Narayana who Himself is Janardana (the one who protects the people),  Damodara (the one who was tied by the rope),  Muralidhara (the one who holds the flute)
devanagari:
गिरिधर गोविन्द गोपाल घन श्याम नन्दलाला 
मन  मोहना  मधुसूदना हे माधवा 
दामोदरा  जनार्दना मुरलीधरा मन मोहना
नमो साई नारायणाय नमो सत्य नारायणाय
नमो साई नारायणाय
respell:
Giridhara Govinda Gopāla Ghan Shyām Nandalālā
Mana  Mohanā  Madhusūdanā He Mādhavā
Dāmodarā  Janārdanā Muralīdharā Mana Mohanā
Namo Sāī Nārāyaṇāya Namo Satya Nārāyaṇāya
Namo Sāī Nārāyaṇāya

title: Giridhari Hey Nandalala
lyrics:
Giridhari Hey Nandalala
Yashoda Ke Bala Tribhuvana Pala
Jagadoddhara Gokula Bala
Radha Lola Munijana Pala
Parthi Vihara Sai Gopala
meaning: Oh Giridhari, beloved Nandalala, child of Yashoda and protector of the three worlds. You are the savior of the universe, the child of Gokula, who delights in the flute and guards the sages. We invoke you, Sai Gopala, dweller of Parthi.
devanagari:
गिरिधारी हे नंदलाला
यशोदा के बाला त्रिभुवन पाला
जगतोत्धारा गोकुल बाला
राधा लोला मुनिजन पाला
पर्ती विहारा साई गोपाला
respell:

Yashodā Ke Bālā Tribhuvan Pālā
Jagatotdhārā Gokul Bālā

title: Giridhari Lal Shyama Gopal
lyrics:
Giridhari Lal Shyama Gopal
Natavaralal Madana Gopal
Mathura Natha Krishna Gopal
Sri Madhusudana Murali Gopal
Yashoda ke Bal Nanda Gopal
Eshwaramba Priya Sai Gopal
meaning: Oh, Gopala, the dark-hued mountain-lifter, the supreme dancer who enchants all hearts! You are the Lord of Mathura, the slayer of Madhu, the sweet flute player, and the beloved child of Yashoda and Nanda. We praise you, Sai Gopala, cherished by Mother Ishwaramba.
devanagari:
गिरिधारी लाल श्यामा गोपाल
नटवरलाल मदन गोपाल
मथुरा नाथा कृष्ण गोपाल
श्री मधुसूदन मुरली गोपाल
यशोदा के बाल नन्द गोपाल
ईश्वरम्बा प्रिय साई गोपाल
respell:
Giridhārī Lāl Shyāmā Gopāl
Naṭavaralāl Madana Gopāl
Mathurā Nāthā Kṛushṇa Gopāl
Shrī Madhusūdana Muralī Gopāl
Yashodā ke Bāl Nanda Gopāl
Īshwarambā Priy Sāī Gopāl

title: Giridhari Murari Govinda
lyrics:
Giridhari Murari Govinda
Ghanashyama Murari Gopala
Radhe Krishna Murari Govinda
Sathya Sai Murari Gopala
meaning: O Lord Govinda, the One who held the mountain on His little finger. Who is as dark as the rain cloud, the One who destroyed demon Mura. O Lord of Radha, You are indeed our Lord Sathya Sai.
devanagari:

राधे कृष्ण मुरारी गोविंदा
सत्य साईं मुरारी गोपाला
respell:

lyrics:
Gokula Nandana Shyama Murari
Makhana Chora Gopala Sai
Mathura Natha Madana Murari
Shyama Sundara Sai Gokula Bala
Suradasa Prabhu Hey Giridhari

Natavara Shyama Gopala
Makhana Chora Gopala Sai
meaning: O dark-hued Krishna, delight of Gokul and butter thief, you are the charming Lord of Mathura. You are the beautiful child of Gokul, the mountain-lifter, and the supreme dancer, manifest as Sai. We adore you, O Gopala, our beloved Lord.

नटवर श्याम गोपाल

title: Gopala Daya Nidhe
lyrics:
Gopala Daya Nidhe
Bala Gopala Daya Nidhe
Sri Parthi Kripa Nidhe Sai Rama
Gopala Daya Nidhe
Nanda Mukunda Govinda Nityananda
meaning: Oh Gopala, fount of boundless compassion, divine child Gopala, you are the very ocean of mercy. Sai Rama, the embodiment of grace at Parthi, you are Nanda's beloved Mukunda, Govinda, the source of eternal bliss.
devanagari:

lyrics:
Gopala Giridhara Bala
Gopi Lola Gokula Bala
Goparipala Narayana (2)
Narayana Narayana
Goparipala Narayana

meaning: Chant the name of Lord Krishna, the cowherd boy, who lifted the Govardhana mountain. He is the boy of Gokula and gave happiness to the Gopis. Chant the name of Lord Narayana, Govinda - the protector of cows.

title: Gopala Gopala Nacho Gopala
lyrics:
Gopala Gopala Nacho Gopala
Nacho Nacho Sai Nandalala
Rhuma Jhuma Rhuma Jhuma Nacho Gopala
Nacho Nacho Sai Nandalala
meaning: O Gopala, beloved son of Nanda, we implore you to dance for us. As you move, let the delightful "Rhuma Jhuma" jingle of your anklets fill the air, enchanting all who hear.

lyrics:
Gopala Gopala Radhe Nandalala
Govinda Gopala Radhe Nandalala
Brindavana Sanchara Radhe Nandalala
Murali Manohara Radhe Nandalala
meaning: O Gopala, darling son of Nanda and beloved of Radha, we invoke your name, Govinda! You roam the sacred groves of Vrindavan, captivating all hearts with the enchanting music of your flute.

lyrics:
Gopala Radha Lola
Murali Lola Nandalala
Keshava Madhava Janardhana
Vanamala Brindavana Bala
Murali Lola Nandalala
meaning:
Chant the name of Gopala, who gives joy to Radha, the son of Nanda who played his flute.
 The Lord Keshava, Madhava and Janardhana.
The one who takes care of Brindavan and the one who wears the garland of jungle flowers.

Keshav Mādhava Janārdanā
Vanamālā Vṛundāvan Bālā [ Muralī Lolā ... ]

title: Gopala Radhe Krishna Govinda Govinda Gopal
lyrics:
Gopala Radhe Krishna Govinda Govinda Gopal
Gopal Gopal Gopal
Govinda Govinda Gopala Radhe Krishna
Govinda Govinda Gopala Sai Krishna
Govinda Govinda Gopal
Sai Govinda Govinda Gopal
meaning: A loving invocation of Lord Krishna, repeatedly chanting His names like Gopala, Radhe Krishna, and Govinda. It celebrates the divine presence of Krishna, further identifying Him with Sai, highlighting the oneness of God.
devanagari:
गोपाल राधे कृष्ण गोविंदा गोविंदा गोपाल
गोपाल गोपाल गोपाल
गोविंद गोविंद गोपाल राधे कृष्णा
गोविंद गोविंद गोपाल साई कृष्णा
गोविंद गोविंद गोपाल
साई गोविंद गोविंद गोपाल
respell:
Gopāla Rādhe Kṛushṇa Govindā Govindā Gopāl
Gopāl Gopāl Gopāl
Govind Govind Gopāla Rādhe Kṛushṇā
Govind Govind Gopāla Sāī Kṛushṇā
Govind Govind Gopāl
Sāī Govind Govind Gopāl

title: Govinda Bolo Gopala Bolo
lyrics:
Govinda Bolo Gopala Bolo
Ram Nam Bolo Hari Nam Bolo
Allah Sai Yeshu Nanak
Zoroastra Mahavira Buddha Nam Bolo
Yeh Nam Sare Hain Jeevan Sahare
Parmanand Ke Yeh Kholte Hain Dware
Jo Nam Chaho Voh Nam Bolo
Prem Se Bolo Bhav Se Bolo
meaning: Chant the sacred names of Govinda, Rama, Hari, Allah, Sai, Yesu, Nanak, Zoroaster, Mahavira, and Buddha. These divine appellations offer life's support and open the gateway to ultimate joy, so speak any name you choose with love and heartfelt devotion.
devanagari:
गोविन्द बोलो गोपाल बोलो
राम राम बोलो हरि नाम बोलो
अल्लाह साई येसु नानक
झोरोस्ट्र महावीर बुद्ध नाम बोलो [ गोविन्द बोलो ... ]  
यह नाम सारे हैं जीवन सहारे
परमानंद के यह खोलते हैं द्वारे
जो नाम चाहो वो नाम बोलो
प्रेम से बोलो भाव से बोलो
respell:
Govinda Bolo Gopāla Bolo
Rām Rām Bolo Hari Nām Bolo
Allāh Sāī Yesu Nānak
Jhorosṭra Mahāvīr Buddha Nām Bolo [ Govinda Bolo ... ]
Yah Nām Sāre Haiṃ Jīvan Sahāre
Paramānanda Ke Yah Kholate Haiṃ Dwāre
Jo Nām Chāho Vo Nām Bolo
Prem Se Bolo Bhāv Se Bolo

title: Govinda Bolo Guru Sai Bolo
lyrics:
Govinda Bolo Guru Sai Bolo
Gopala Bolo Guru Sai Bolo [ Govinda Bolo ... ]
Shirdi Sai Bolo Shiva Guru Naam Bolo
Sathya Sai Bolo Sadguru Naam Bolo
Sai Ram Sai Ram
Prema Sai Bolo Parabrahma Bolo
Parthi Baba Bolo Paramatma Bolo
Sai Ram Sai Ram
meaning: Chant the sacred names of Govinda and Gopala, for they are one with Guru Sai. We invoke Shirdi Sai, Sathya Sai, and Prema Sai, recognizing them as the Supreme Absolute and the Universal Self, continuously chanting 'Sai Ram'.
devanagari:
गोविन्द बोलो गुरु साई बोलो
गोपाल बोलो गुरु साई बोलो [ गोविन्द बोलो ... ]
शिर्डी साई बोलो शिव गुरु नाम बोलो
सत्य साई बोलो सद्गुरु नाम बोलो
साई राम साई राम
प्रेम साई बोलो परब्रह्मा बोलो
पर्ती बाबा बोलो परमात्मा बोलो
साई राम साई राम
respell:
Govinda Bolo Guru Sāī Bolo
Gopāla Bolo Guru Sāī Bolo [ Govinda Bolo ... ]
Shirḍī Sāī Bolo Shiv Guru Nām Bolo
Satya Sāī Bolo Sadguru Nām Bolo
Sāī Rām Sāī Rām
Prem Sāī Bolo Parabrahmā Bolo
Partī Bābā Bolo Paramātmā Bolo
Sāī Rām Sāī Rām

title: Govinda Gopala Hey Nandalala
lyrics:
Govinda Gopala Hey Nandalala
Radhe Gopala Gopi Gopala
Meera Ke Nath Prabhu Murali Gopala
Govardhanoddhara Gopala Bala
Radhe Gopala Gopi Gopala
meaning: Oh Govinda, Gopala, beloved son of Nanda, you are the divine cowherd of Radha and the Gopis. You are the Lord of Meera, the enchanting flute player, and the young Gopala who lifted Mount Govardhan.
devanagari:
गोविन्द गोपाला हे नंदलाला
राधे गोपाला गोपी गोपाल
मीरा के नाथ प्रभु मुरली गोपाला
गोवर्धनोधर गोपाल बाला  [ राधे गोपाला ... ]
respell:
Govinda Gopālā He Nandalālā
Rādhe Gopālā Gopī Gopāla
Mīrā Ke Nātha Prabhu Muralī Gopālā
Govardhanodhara Gopāla Bālā  [ Rādhe Gopālā ... ]

title: Govinda Gopala Narayana Hari
lyrics:
Govinda Gopala Narayana Hari
Narayana Hari Narayana Hari (2) [ Govinda Gopala ... ]
Jagadodhara Narayana Hari
Bhaktha Uddhara Narayana Hari
Parti Pureesha Narayana Hari [ Narayana Hari ... ]
Narayana Hari Jai Jai Narayana Hari (2)
(Jai Jai) Narayana Hari (2)
meaning: Oh Govinda, Gopala, Narayana Hari, we praise your divine names! You are the uplifter of the universe and the compassionate redeemer of all devotees. Victory to you, Lord of Parthi, Narayana Hari.
devanagari:
गोविंदा गोपाला नारायण हरि
नारायण हरि नारायण हरि (2) [ गोविंदा गोपाला ... ]
जगतोद्धारा  नारायण हरि
भक्तोद्धारा नारायण हरि
पर्ति पूरीशा नारायण हरि [ नारायण हरि ... ]
नारायण हरि जय जय नारायण हरि (2)
(जय जय) नारायण हरि (2)
respell:
Govindā Gopālā Nārāyaṇ Hari
Nārāyaṇ Hari Nārāyaṇ Hari (2) [ Govindā Gopālā ... ]
Jagatoddhārā  Nārāyaṇ Hari
Bhaktoddhārā Nārāyaṇ Hari
Parti Pūrīshā Nārāyaṇ Hari [ Nārāyaṇ Hari ... ]
Nārāyaṇ Hari Jay Jay Nārāyaṇ Hari (2)
(jay Jay) Nārāyaṇ Hari (2)

title: Govinda Gopala Prabhu Giridhari
lyrics:
Govinda Gopala Prabhu Giridhari
Govinda Gopala Hrudaya Vihari
Nanda Kumara Navaneeta Chora
Parthi Vihara Bada Chitta Chora
Hrudaya Vihara Bada Chitta Chora
meaning: Chant the various names of Govinda (the source of unalloyed happiness), Gopala (the one who fosters cowherd and people), Giridhari ( the one who  lifted the mountain). Glory to the one who is the indweller of our hearts, to the one who is the son of Nanda and to the one who stole butter in Gokula. Glory to the very same Lord of Parthi who steals our Hearts.
devanagari:
गोविंदा गोपाल प्रभु गिरिधारी
गोविंदा गोपाल हृदय विहारी [ गोविन्द गोपाल ... ]
नंद कुमारा नवनीत चोरा
पर्ति (हृदय) विहरार बड़ा चित्त चोरा
respell:
Govindā Gopāla Prabhu Giridhārī
Govindā Gopāla Hṛudaya Vihārī [ Govinda Gopāla ... ]
Nanda Kumārā Navanīta Chorā
Parti (hṛudaya) Viharār Baḍa़ā Chitta Chorā

title: Govinda Gopala
lyrics:
Govinda Gopala
Jaya Madhava Gopala
Mukunda Murali Gopala
Madhusudana Gopala
Yashoda Nanda Gopala
Yadu Nandana Gopala
Jaya Muralidhara Gopala
Madhusudana Gopala
meaning: Oh Govinda, Gopala, we hail your glorious names! Victory to Madhava, Mukunda, the divine cowherd who plays the enchanting flute. You are Madhusudana, the cherished child of Yashoda and Nanda, the delight of the Yadu lineage.
devanagari:
गोविन्द गोपाला
जय माधव गोपाला
मुकुन्द मुरली गोपाला
मधुसूदन गोपाला
यशोदा नन्द गोपाला
यदु नन्दन गोपाला
जय मुरलीधरा गोपाला
मधुसूदन गोपाला
respell:
Govinda Gopālā
Jaya Mādhava Gopālā
Mukunda Muralī Gopālā
Madhusūdana Gopālā
Yashodā Nanda Gopālā
Yadu Nandana Gopālā
Jaya Muralīdharā Gopālā
Madhusūdana Gopālā

title: Govinda Govinda Gayiye Re Bhajo Radhe Gopala Krishna Gayiye
lyrics:
Govinda Govinda Gayiye Re Bhajo Radhe Gopala Krishna Gayiye
Murali Manohara Gayiye Re Bhajo Nanda Ke Lal Prabhu Gayiye
Giridhari Giridhari Gayiye Re Mayi Meera Ke Nath Prabhu Gayiye
Giridhari Giridhari Gayiye Mayi Meera Ke Nath Prabhu Gayiye
meaning: Sing the name of Lord Krishna - Govinda, Gopala and worship the Lord of Radha. Sing the name of the enchanting flute player and worship the Lord, the Son of Nanda. Sing the name of the Lord of Mother Meera.
devanagari:
गोविन्द गोविन्द गाइयेरे भजो राधे गोपाल कृष्ण गाइये
मुरली मनोहरा गाइयेरे भजो नन्दा के लाल प्रभु गाइये
गिरिधारी गिरिधारी गाइयेरे मायि मीरा के नाथ प्रभु गाइये (2)
respell:
Govinda Govinda Gāiyere Bhajo Rādhe Gopāla Kṛushṇa Gāiye
Muralī Manoharā Gāiyere Bhajo Nandā Ke Lāl Prabhu Gāiye
Giridhārī Giridhārī Gāiyere Māyi Mīrā Ke Nāth Prabhu Gāiye (2)

title: Govinda Hare Gopala Hare
lyrics:
Govinda Hare Gopala Hare
Govinda Hare Avatar Hare
Treta Mein Sita Ram Bane
Dwapar Mein Radhe Shyam Bane
Kaliyug Mein Sai Nam Liye
Sai Nam Liye Sarva Nam Liye
meaning: Glory to the divine cowherd boy, Lord Krishna. The One who was Rama in Treta yuga, and the one who was Shyama the consort of Radha in Dwapara yuga. In the Kali Yuga, we chant the name of Sai and Surrender at His Lotus Feet.
devanagari:
गोविन्द हरे गोपाल हरे
गोविन्द हरे अवतार हरे [ गोविन्द ... ]
त्रेतामे सीता राम बने
द्वापरमे राधे श्याम बने
कली युगमे साई नाम लिए
साई नाम लिए सर्व नाम लिए
respell:
Govinda Hare Gopāla Hare
Govinda Hare Avatār Hare [ Govinda ... ]
Tretāme Sītā Rām Bane
Dwāparame Rādhe Shyām Bane
Kalī Yugame Sāī Nām Lie
Sāī Nām Lie Sarwa Nām Lie

title: Govinda Hare Gopala Hare Hey Gopi Gopa Bala
lyrics:
Govinda Hare Gopala Hare Hey Gopi Gopa Bala
Govinda Hare Gopala Hare Hey Murali Gana Lola
Govinda Hare Gopala Hare Hey Radha Ramana Lola
Govinda Hare Gopala Hare Hey Murali Gana Lola
meaning: Lord Hari is the destroyer of illusion. He is known by many names. Govinda(essence of vedas), Gopala (divine cowherd), one who is immersed in the melody of flute, one who is in divine union with Radha.
devanagari:
गोविन्द हरे गोपाल हरे हे गोपी गोपा बाला
गोविन्द हरे गोपाल हरे हे मुरली गान लोला
गोविन्द हरे गोपाल हरे हे राधा रमण लोला
गोविन्द हरे गोपाल हरे हे नंद गोपा बाला
respell:
Govinda Hare Gopāla Hare He Gopī Gopā Bālā
Govinda Hare Gopāla Hare He Muralī Gān Lolā
Govinda Hare Gopāla Hare He Rādhā Ramaṇa Lolā
Govinda Hare Gopāla Hare He Nanda Gopā Bālā

title: Govinda Krishna Jai Gopala Krishna Jai Govinda Govinda Govinda Gopala Jai
lyrics:
Govinda Krishna Jai Gopala Krishna Jai Govinda Govinda Govinda Gopala Jai
Krishna Krishna Radha Krishna Govinda Krishna Gopala Krishna [ Govinda ... ]
Keshava Madhava Sai Narayana Govinda Govinda Narayana
Nandalala Vraja Bala Hey Sai Narayana Krishna Krishna
meaning: Oh Govinda Krishna, Gopala Krishna, we hail your divine names! You are the beloved Krishna of Radha, the supreme Keshava, Madhava, and Narayana. We lovingly remember you as Nandalala, the cherished child of Vraja.
devanagari:
गोविन्द कृष्ण जय गोपाल कृष्ण जय गोविन्द गोविन्द गोविन्द गोपाल जय
कृष्ण कृष्ण राधा कृष्ण गोविन्द कृष्ण गोपाल कृष्ण [ गोविन्द ... ]
केशव माधव साई नारायण गोविन्द गोविन्द नारायण
नंदलाला व्रज बाला हे साई नारायण कृष्ण कृष्ण
respell:
Govinda Kṛushṇa Jay Gopāla Kṛushṇa Jay Govinda Govinda Govinda Gopāla Jay
Kṛushṇa Kṛushṇa Rādhā Kṛushṇa Govinda Kṛushṇa Gopāla Kṛushṇa [ Govinda ... ]
Keshav Mādhava Sāī Nārāyaṇ Govinda Govinda Nārāyaṇ
Nandalālā Vraj Bālā He Sāī Nārāyaṇ Kṛushṇa Kṛushṇa

title: Govinda Krishna Jai Gopala Krishna Jai Gopala Pala Bala Radha Krishna Jai
lyrics:
Govinda Krishna Jai Gopala Krishna Jai Gopala Pala Bala Radha Krishna Jai
Krishna Jai Krishna Jai Krishna Jai Krishna Krishna Krishna Krishna Jai
Gopika Mala Hari Pyari Mayi Meera Manavihari Madana Mohana Muralidhari Krishna Jai
Krishna Jai Rama Krishna Jai Radha Krishna Jai Bala Krishna Krishna Krishna Krishna Jai
Krishna Jai Krishna Jai Krishna Jai Krishna Jai Krishna Krishna Krishna Krishna Jai
meaning: Glory to Krishna; Glory to child Krishna, the Lord of Radha; Glory to the beloved Lord who wears the garland of the Gopis; Glory to the one who dwells in the Heart of Meera; Glory to the Lord of Love who enchants our Hearts; Glory to the Lord who plays flute; Glory to Thee.
devanagari:
गोविन्द कृष्ण जय गोपाल कृष्ण जय गोपाल पाल बाल राधा कृष्ण जय
कृष्ण जय कृष्ण जय कृष्ण जय कृष्ण कृष्ण कृष्ण कृष्ण जय [ गोविन्द ... ]
गोपीका माल हारी प्यारी माई मीरा मन विहारी मदन मोहन मुरलीधारी कृष्ण जय
कृष्ण जय राम कृष्ण जय राधा कृष्ण जय बाल कृष्ण कृष्ण कृष्ण कृष्ण जय
कृष्ण जय कृष्ण जय कृष्ण जय कृष्ण जय कृष्ण कृष्ण कृष्ण कृष्ण जय
respell:
Govinda Kṛushṇa Jay Gopāla Kṛushṇa Jay Gopāla Pāla Bāla Rādhā Kṛushṇa Jay
Kṛushṇa Jay Kṛushṇa Jay Kṛushṇa Jay Kṛushṇa Kṛushṇa Kṛushṇa Kṛushṇa Jay [ Govinda ... ]
Gopīkā Māla Hārī Pyārī Māī Mīrā Mana Vihārī Madana Mohan Muralīdhārī Kṛushṇa Jay
Kṛushṇa Jay Rām Kṛushṇa Jay Rādhā Kṛushṇa Jay Bāla Kṛushṇa Kṛushṇa Kṛushṇa Kṛushṇa Jay
Kṛushṇa Jay Kṛushṇa Jay Kṛushṇa Jay Kṛushṇa Jay Kṛushṇa Kṛushṇa Kṛushṇa Kṛushṇa Jay

title: Govinda Krishna Vitthala Venu Gopala Krishna Vitthala
lyrics:
Govinda Krishna Vitthala Venu Gopala Krishna Vitthala
Panduranga Vitthala Jaya Pandhari Natha Vitthala
Govinda Vitthala Gopala Vitthala
Panduranga Vitthala Pandhari Natha Vitthala
--
Vitthala Vitthala Panduranga
meaning: Chant the names  of Lord Govinda, Lord Krishna with the flute, Lord Vitthala and Panduranga who is the Lord of Pandharpur.
devanagari:
गोविन्द कृष्ण विट्ठला वेणु गोपाला कृष्ण विट्ठला
पांडुरंग विट्ठला जय पंढरी नाथ विट्ठला
गोविन्द विट्ठला गोपाल विट्ठला
पांडुरंग विट्ठला पंढरी नाथ विट्ठला
विट्ठला विट्ठला पांडुरंग (4)
respell:
Govinda Kṛushṇa Viṭṭhalā Veṇu Gopālā Kṛushṇa Viṭṭhalā
Pāṇḍuraṅg Viṭṭhalā Jaya Paṇḍharī Nātha Viṭṭhalā
Govinda Viṭṭhalā Gopāla Viṭṭhalā
Pāṇḍuraṅg Viṭṭhalā Paṇḍharī Nātha Viṭṭhalā
Viṭṭhalā Viṭṭhalā Pāṇḍuraṅg (4)

title: Govinda Krishna Vitthale Venu Gopala Krishna Vitthale
lyrics:
Govinda Krishna Vitthale Venu Gopala Krishna Vitthale
Ranga Ranga Vitthale Sri Panduranga Vitthale
meaning: Sing the glory of Govinda, Krishna and Vitthala. Sing the glory  of Venugopala  the one who plays the flute. You are Panduranga who is the lord of Pandhari.
devanagari:
गोविन्द कृष्ण विट्ठले वेणु गोपाल कृष्ण विट्ठले
रंगा रंगा विट्ठले श्री पांडुरंग विट्ठले
गोविन्द कृष्ण विट्ठले वेणु गोपाल कृष्ण विट्ठले [ रंगा रंगा ... ]
respell:
Govinda Kṛushṇa Viṭṭhale Veṇu Gopāla Kṛushṇa Viṭṭhale
Raṅgā Raṅgā Viṭṭhale Shrī Pāṇḍuraṅg Viṭṭhale
Govinda Kṛushṇa Viṭṭhale Veṇu Gopāla Kṛushṇa Viṭṭhale [ Raṅgā Raṅgā ... ]

title: Govinda Madhava Gopala Keshava
lyrics:
Govinda Madhava Gopala Keshava
Jaya Nanda Mukunda Nanda Govinda Radhey Gopala [ Govinda Madhava ... ]
Giridhari Giridhari Jaya Radhey Gopala
Ghana Shyama Shyama Shyama Jaya Jaya Radhey (Sai) Gopala [ Jaya Nanda ... ]
meaning: Oh Govinda, Madhava, Gopala, Keshava, we sing your glory, you who are the beloved son of Nanda and Radha. Victory to Mukunda, the dark-hued Giridhari who lifted the mountain, now manifest as Sai Gopala.
devanagari:
गोविंदा माधवा गोपाल केशवा
जय नंद मुकुंद नंद गोविंदा राधे गोपाला [ गोविंदा माधव ... ]
गिरिधारी गिरिधारी जय राधे गोपाला
घन श्याम श्याम श्याम जय जय राधे (साई) गोपाला [ जय नंद ... ]
respell:
Govindā Mādhavā Gopāla Keshavā
Jaya Nanda Mukund Nanda Govindā Rādhe Gopālā [ Govindā Mādhava ... ]
Giridhārī Giridhārī Jaya Rādhe Gopālā
Ghan Shyām Shyām Shyām Jaya Jaya Rādhe (sāī) Gopālā [ Jaya Nanda ... ]

title: Govinda Madhava Gopala Keshava
lyrics:
Govinda Madhava Gopala Keshava
Krishna Krishna Radha Krishna
Krishna Krishna Gopala
Gokula Bala Gopi Ramana
Mana Mohana Madhusudana Jaya Madhava Jaya Keshava
meaning:
Chant the divine names of Lord Krishna who protects cowherds (Gopala) and slayed demon Keshi (Keshava). 
Chant the divine name of Krishna, who was dear to the Gopis and Radha.
 Victory to the one who is attractive, slayer of the demons Madhu and Keshi.
devanagari:
गोविन्द माधवा गोपाल केशवा (3)
कृष्णा कृष्णा साई कृष्णा
कृष्णा कृष्णा गोपाला
गोकुल बाला गोपी रमणा
मन मोहना मधुसूदना जय माधवा जय केशवा
respell:
Govinda Mādhavā Gopāla Keshavā (3)
Kṛushṇā Kṛushṇā Sāī Kṛushṇā
Kṛushṇā Kṛushṇā Gopālā
Gokul Bālā Gopī Ramaṇā
Mana Mohanā Madhusūdanā Jaya Mādhavā Jaya Keshavā

title: Govinda Murari Madhava
lyrics:
Govinda Murari Madhava
Govinda Gopala Keshava
Janardhana Sai Parthi Vihari
Govardhanoddhari Madhava
Madhava Keshava Hari Narayana
meaning: Oh Govinda, slayer of Mura, sweet Madhava, protector of cows, and beautiful-haired Keshava! You are Janardhana, the remover of suffering, Sai who dwells in Parthi, and the one who lifted Govardhana mountain. We praise you, Hari Narayana, in all your glorious forms.
devanagari:
गोविन्द मुरहरी माधवा
गोविन्द गोपाल केशवा [ गोविन्द मुरहरी ... ]
जनार्दना साई पर्ती विहारी
गोवर्धनोद्धारि माधवा
माधवा केशवा हरि नारायणा
respell:
Govinda Muraharī Mādhavā
Govinda Gopāla Keshavā [ Govinda Muraharī ... ]
Janārdanā Sāī Partī Vihārī
Govardhanoddhāri Mādhavā
Mādhavā Keshavā Hari Nārāyaṇā

title: Govinda Narayana Gopala Narayana
lyrics:
Govinda Narayana Gopala Narayana
Govinda Govinda Narayana
Govinda Gopala Narayana
Govinda Govinda Narayana
Govinda Gopala Narayana
meaning: Govinda, Narayana, Gopala, I call upon your sacred names, seeking your divine grace. Through this continuous chanting, I remember your presence and find joy in your eternal being.
devanagari:
गोविन्द नारायणा गोपाल नारायणा
गोविन्द गोविन्द नारायणा
गोविन्द गोपाल नारायणा
गोविन्द गोविन्द नारायणा
गोविन्द गोपाल नारायणा
respell:
Govinda Nārāyaṇā Gopāla Nārāyaṇā
Govinda Govinda Nārāyaṇā
Govinda Gopāla Nārāyaṇā
Govinda Govinda Nārāyaṇā
Govinda Gopāla Nārāyaṇā

title: Govinda Rama Jai Jai Gopala Rama
lyrics:
Govinda Rama Jai Jai Gopala Rama
Madhava Rama Jai Jai Keshava Rama
Durlabha Rama Jai Jai Sulabha Rama
Ek Tum Rama Jai Jai Anek Tum Rama
meaning: Hail to Lord Rama, who is also revered by the divine names of Krishna, such as Govinda, Gopala, Madhava, and Keshava. Though sometimes perceived as difficult to grasp, this divine presence is also profoundly accessible. We praise Rama, the singular truth that manifests in countless forms.
devanagari:
गोविन्द रमा जय जय गोपाल रमा
माधव रमा जय जय केशव रमा [ गोविन्द राम ... ]
दुलभ रमा जय जय सुलभ रमा
एक तुम रमा जय जय अनेक तुम रमा
respell:
Govinda Ramā Jay Jay Gopāla Ramā
Mādhava Ramā Jay Jay Keshav Ramā [ Govinda Rām ... ]
Dulabh Ramā Jay Jay Sulabh Ramā
Ek Tum Ramā Jay Jay Anek Tum Ramā

title: Govinda Sai Krishna Govinda Govinda
lyrics:
Govinda Sai Krishna Govinda Govinda
Gopala Sai Krishna Govinda Govinda
Mohana Bala Krishna Govinda Govinda
Parthi Nivasa Krishna Govinda Govinda
meaning: The Divine incarnation of Lord Krishna brings the memory of His divine form, joyful childhood and protection to devotees. He is the breath of Vedas (Govinda). He is, in essence verily the Lord Sai of Puttaparthi.
devanagari:
गोविन्द साई कृष्ण गोविन्द गोविन्द  
गोपाल साई कृष्ण गोविन्द गोविन्द [गोविन्द साई कृष्ण]  
मोहन बाल कृष्ण गोविन्द गोविन्द  
पर्ती निवासा कृष्ण गोविन्द गोविन्द
respell:
Govinda Sāī Kṛushṇa Govinda Govinda
Gopāla Sāī Kṛushṇa Govinda Govinda [govinda Sāī Kṛushṇa]
Mohan Bāla Kṛushṇa Govinda Govinda
Partī Nivāsā Kṛushṇa Govinda Govinda

title: Gauri Ganesh Uma Ganesh
lyrics:
Gauri Ganesh Uma Ganesh
Parvati Nandana Sri Ganesh
Sharanam Ganesh Sharanam Ganesh
Shiva Nandana Ganapati Ganesh
meaning: Chant the name of Lord Ganesha, beloved son of Mother Gowri, I surrender to Thee, Lord of all Demigods, beloved child of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati.
devanagari:
गौरी गणेश उमा गणेश  
पार्वती नंदन श्री गणेश  
शरणं गणेश शरणं गणेश  
शिव नंदन गणपति गणेश
respell:
Gaurī Gaṇesh Umā Gaṇesh
Pārwatī Nandana Shrī Gaṇesh
Sharaṇaṃ Gaṇesh Sharaṇaṃ Gaṇesh
Shiv Nandana Gaṇapati Gaṇesh

title: Gauri Ganesha Vinayaka
lyrics:
Gauri Ganesha Vinayaka
Shuklambaradhara Natha Gajanana
Sri Gananatha Vinayaka
Gajavadana Jaya Ganapati Vandana
Mangala Murti Gajanana
meaning: Victory to Lord Ganesha, Vinayaka (The unparalleled leader), the son of Gowri who is adorned with white garment. Victory to Lord Ganapati, the Elephant faced Lord. We offer our obeisance to you, O Lord Gajanana, the bestower of auspiciousness.
devanagari:
गौरी गणेशा विनायका (3)  
शुक्लाम्बरधर नाथ गजानन  
श्री गणराया विनायका  
गजवदना जय गणपति वंदना  
मंगल मूर्ति गजानना (2)
respell:
Gaurī Gaṇeshā Vināyakā (3)
Shuklāmbaradhara Nātha Gajānana
Shrī Gaṇanāthā Vināyakā
Gajavadanā Jaya Gaṇapati Vandanā
Maṅgal Mūrti Gajānanā (2)

title: Gauri Manohara Hey Nataraja
lyrics:
Gauri Manohara Hey Nataraja
Shiva Shiva Shankara Hey Shiva Raja
Pavana Charita Pahi Mahesha
Pahi Mahesha Hey Jagadeesha
Karunamaya Prabhu Hey Jagadeesha
meaning:
O Nataraja (the Lord of dance), the Beloved of Mother Gowri, 
Shiva, the Lord of auspiciousness, Shiva, the Sovereign. 
Whose saga is itself purifying, I surrender to Thee O Lord Supreme!
The embodiment of compassion, the Master and Lord of the Universe.
devanagari:
गौरी मनोहर हे नटराजा
शिव शिव शंकर हे शिव राजा
पावन चरिता पाहि महेशा
पाहि महेशा हे जगदीशा
करुणामया प्रभो हे जगदीशा
respell:
Gaurī Manohar He Naṭarājā
Shiv Shiv Shaṅkar He Shiv Rājā
Pāvan Charitā Pāhi Maheshā
Pāhi Maheshā He Jagadīshā
Karuṇāmayā Prabho He Jagadīshā

title: Gauri Nandana Bala Gajanana
lyrics:
Gauri Nandana Bala Gajanana
Gajavadana Gananatha Gajanana
Maha Ganapathe Pahi Gajanana
Gajanana Pahi Gajanana
meaning: Victory to the son of Mother Gowri (Parvati), the little Lord Ganesha, who has the face of an elephant and who is the Master of Shiva's army. Protect us O Lord, You are none other than Lord Sai.
devanagari:
गौरी नंदन बाल गजानन
गजवदना गणनाथ गजानन [ गौरी नंदन ... ]
महागणपते पाही गजानन
गजानना साई गजानना
respell:
Gaurī Nandana Bāla Gajānana
Gajavadanā Gaṇanātha Gajānana [ Gaurī Nandana ... ]
Mahāgaṇapate Pāhī Gajānan
Gajānanā Sāī Gajānanā

title: Hey Gauri Nandana Gajanana
lyrics:
Hey Gauri Nandana Gajanana
Girija Nandana Niranjana
Parvati Nandana Shubhanana
Pahi Prabho Mam Pahi Prasanna
meaning: Oh Gajanana, beloved son of Gauri, Girija, and Parvati, your stainless form and auspicious face radiate purity. Lord, we earnestly seek your protection and your benevolent grace.
devanagari:
गौरी नंदन गजानना (हे)
गिरिजा नंदन निरंजना 
[गौरी नंदन ...]
पार्वती नंदन शुभानना 
पाही प्रभो माम पाही प्रसन्ना
respell:
Gaurī Nandana Gajānanā (he)
Girijā Nandana Nirañjanā
[gaurī Nandan ...]
Pārwatī Nandana Shubhānanā
Pāhī Prabho Mām Pāhī Prasannā

title: Gauri Nathaya Vishwanathaya
lyrics:
Gauri Nathaya Vishwanathaya
Sai Nathaya Namah Shivaya
Gunateetaya Gunadharaya
Sai Nathaya Namah Shivaya
Kala Kalaya Kalateetaya
Kala Roopaya Namah Shivaya
Prema Roopaya Parthi Vasaya
Sai Nathaya Namah Shivaya
--
Om Namah Shivaya Sai Shivaya (4)
meaning: Obeisance to Lord Shiva, who is the consort of Gowri and the Lord of the Universe. You are Sai Natha who is with all attributes and also attribute less. You are the embodiment of time, beyond time and the Lord of time. You are the resident of Parthi whose form is Love
devanagari:
गौरी नाथाय विष्वनाथाय
साई नाथाय नमः शिवाय
गुणातीताय गुणाधाराय [ साई नाथाय ... ]
काल कालाय कालतीताय
काल रूपाय नमः शिवाय
प्रेम रूपाय पर्ति वासाय [ साई नाथाय ... ]
ॐ नमः शिवाय साई शिवाय (4)
respell:
Gaurī Nāthāya Vishwanāthāya
Sāī Nāthāya Namaḥ Shivāy
Guṇātītāya Guṇādhārāy [ Sāī Nāthāya ... ]
Kāl Kālāy Kālatītāya
Kāl Rūpāya Namaḥ Shivāy
Prem Rūpāya Parti Vāsāy [ Sāī Nāthāya ... ]
Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy Sāī Shivāy (4)

title: Gauri Sutaya Om Namah Om
lyrics:
Gauri Sutaya Om Namah Om
Lambodaraya Om Namah Om
Vighneshwaraya Om Namah Om
Bhava Dukha Bhanjana Om Namah Om
meaning:
Salutations to the loving son of mother Gowri and to the one who is large-bellied. 
Prostrations to the one who is the Lord of obstacles and remover of worldly pains and sorrows.
devanagari:
गौरी सुताय ॐ नमः ॐ
लम्बोदराय ॐ नमः ॐ [ गौरी सुताया ... ]
विघ्नेश्वराय ॐ नमः ॐ
भव दुःख भंजन ॐ नमः ॐ
respell:
Gaurī Sutāya Oṃ Namaḥ Oṃ
Lambodarāy Oṃ Namaḥ Oṃ [ Gaurī Sutāyā ... ]
Vighneshwarāy Oṃ Namaḥ Oṃ
Bhava Duḥkha Bhañjana Oṃ Namaḥ Oṃ

title: Gauri Vara Gangadhara
lyrics:
Gauri Vara Gangadhara
Shambho Shiva Hara Bimbadhara
Vyagrambaradhara Jyoti Prakasha
Pavana Nama Hare Paramesha
--
Om Namah Shivaya Shivaya Namah Om
meaning: We offer salutations to Shiva, the beloved of Gauri, who bears the sacred Ganga and the crescent moon. Adorned in tiger skin, He is the radiant divine light, the Supreme Lord whose holy name dispels all suffering.
devanagari:
गौरी वरा गंगाधरा
शंभो शिवा बिम्बाधरा [ गौरी वरा ... ]
व्याघ्रंबरधार ज्योति प्रकाशा
पावन नाम हरे परमेशा
ॐ नमः शिवाय शिवाय नमः ॐ (2)
respell:
Gaurī Varā Gaṅgādharā
Shambho Shivā Bimbādharā [ Gaurī Varā ... ]
Vyāghrambaradhāra Jyoti Prakāshā
Pāvan Nāma Hare Parameshā
Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy Shivāy Namaḥ Oṃ (2)

title: Guru Baba Guru Baba
lyrics:
Guru Baba Guru Baba
Charana Namostute Guru Baba
Vidya Dayaka Guru Baba
Shanta Swaroopa Guru Baba
Prashanta Swaroopa Guru Baba
Guruvara Guruvara Guru Baba
meaning:
O Baba, Our Guru!
We bow down at Your Lotus Feet
You are the bestower of True Knowledge
You are the very Embodiment of Peace
O Baba, the Greatest among Gurus
Victory to Thee!
devanagari:
गुरु बाबा गुरु बाबा  
चरण नमोस्तुते गुरु बाबा  
विद्या दायक गुरु बाबा  
(प्र)शान्त स्वरूपा गुरु बाबा  
गुरुवर गुरुवर गुरु बाबा
respell:
Guru Bābā Guru Bābā
Charaṇ Namostute Guru Bābā
Vidyā Dāyak Guru Bābā
(pra)shānta Swarūpā Guru Bābā
Guruvar Guruvar Guru Bābā

title: Guru Brahma Guru Vishnu Guru Devo Maheshwara
lyrics:
Guru Brahma Guru Vishnu Guru Devo Maheshwara
Jaya Deva Priya Deva Sri Sathya Sayeeshwara
Jai Jai Jai Karunakara
Jai Jai Jai Akhileshwara
Jai Jai Jai Shirdeeshwara
Jai Jai Jai Partheeshwara
meaning: We honor the Guru as the divine trinity of Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva. All glory to the beloved Lord Sathya Sai, the compassionate ruler of the universe. We celebrate the divine presence manifest in Shirdi and Parthi.
devanagari:
गुरु ब्रह्मा गुरु विष्णु गुरु देवो महेश्वरा
जय देवा प्रियदेवा देवा श्री सत्य साईश्वरा
जय जय जय करुणाकरा
जय जय जय अखिलेश्वरा
जय जय जय शिरडीश्वरा
जय जय जय पर्तीश्वरा
respell:
Guru Brahmā Guru Vishṇu Guru Devo Maheshwarā
Jaya Devā Priyadevā Devā Shrī Satya Sāīshwarā
Jay Jay Jay Karuṇākarā
Jay Jay Jay Akhileshwarā
Jay Jay Jay Shiraḍīshwarā
Jay Jay Jay Partīshwarā

title: Guru Deva Guru Govinda
lyrics:
Guru Deva Guru Govinda
Mandara Giridhara Shirdi Maheshwara
Jaya Partheeshwara Sai Shiva
Sundara Roopa Sri Sai Deva
Vaidehi Mohana Narayana
meaning: O Divine Teacher, O Lord Govinda, you are the mighty one who bore the Mandara mountain. We praise you, Sai Shiva, Lord of Shirdi and Parthi, whose beautiful form is none other than Narayana, the beloved enchanter of Vaidehi.
devanagari:
गुरु देवा गुरु गोविन्दा
मन्दार गिरिधर शिर्डी पूरीश्वर
जय पर्तीश्वर साई शिवा [ गुरु देवा ... ]
सुन्दर रूपा श्री साई देवा
वैदेही मोहन नारायणा (2)
respell:
Guru Devā Guru Govindā
Mandāra Giridhara Shirḍī Pūrīshwar
Jaya Partīshwar Sāī Shivā [ Guru Devā ... ]
Sundara Rūpā Shrī Sāī Devā
Vaidehī Mohan Nārāyaṇā (2)

title: Guru Deva Priya Deva Sai Deva Dayamaya
lyrics:
Guru Deva Priya Deva Sai Deva Dayamaya
Vibhuti Sundara Shashankha Shekara
Sai Shankara Daya Karo (2) [ Guru Deva ... ]
Gokula Nandana Sai Gopala
Raghukula Bhooshana Sai Rama
Hey Madanaantaka Daya Karo (2)
meaning: O Divine Guru, Beloved Sai, embodiment of compassion, you are Shiva, beautifully adorned with sacred ash and the crescent moon. We implore your mercy, O Sai, who manifests as the joyful Gopala of Gokula, the glorious Rama of the Raghu clan, and the Destroyer of Kama. Please bestow your grace upon us.
devanagari:
गुरु देवा प्रिय देवा साई देवा दयामया
विभूति सुंदर शशांक शेखर
साई शंकर दया करो (2) [ गुरु देव ... ]
गोकुल नंदन साई गोपाल
रघुकुल भूषण साई राम
हे मदनांतक दया करो (2)
respell:
Guru Devā Priy Devā Sāī Devā Dayāmayā
Vibhūti Sundara Shashāṅk Shekhar
Sāī Shaṅkar Dayā Karo (2) [ Guru Deva ... ]
Gokul Nandana Sāī Gopāla
Raghukul Bhūshaṇ Sāī Rām
He Madanāntaka Dayā Karo (2)

title: Guru Mahima Gao
lyrics:
Guru Mahima Gao
Sadguru Sai Ananta Guru
Brahmananda Ananda Guru
Sarva Dharma Priya Sai Guru
(Sai Guru Sathya Sai Guru
Sarva Dharma Priya Sai Guru)
Guru Ke Vani Gao
meaning: Sing the glorious praise of the Guru! He is Sadguru Sai, the infinite teacher, who embodies the supreme bliss of Brahman. Sai Guru is the very truth of all faiths; let us sing his sacred teachings.
devanagari:
गुरु महिमा गाओ (3)  
सद्गुरु साई आनंद गुरु  
ब्रह्मानंद आनंद गुरु  
सर्व धर्म सत्य साई गुरु  
साई गुरु सत्य साई गुरु [ सर्व धर्म ... ]  
गुरु के वाणी गाओ
respell:
Guru Mahimā Gāo (3)
Sadguru Sāī Ānanda Guru
Brahmānanda Ānanda Guru
Sarwa Dharma Satya Sāī Guru
Sāī Guru Satya Sāī Guru [ Sarwa Dharma ... ]
Guru Ke Vāṇī Gāo

title: Guru Meri Pooja, Guru Gobind
lyrics:
Guru Meri Pooja, Guru Gobind
Guru Mera Paar-braham, Guru Bhagwant

Guru Mera Deo, Alakh Abheo
Sarab Pooj, Charan Gur Seo

Guru Meri Pooja ....

Guru Mera Gyaan, Guru Hridey Dhyaan
Guru Gopal, Purakh Bhagwaan

Guru Meri Pooja ....
meaning: My Guru is my worship, my Lord Gobind, the Supreme Reality, and my Divine Being. My Guru is my unseen Deity, worthy of all adoration; I serve at the Guru's feet, for the Guru is my knowledge, my heart's meditation, and the Supreme Lord.
devanagari:
गुरु मेरी पूजा, गुरु गोबिंद
गुरु मेरा पार-ब्रह्म, गुरु भगवंत

गुरु मेरा देव, अलख अभेओ
सरब पूज, चरण गुरु सेओ

गुरु मेरी पूजा ....

गुरु मेरा ज्ञान, गुरु हृदय ध्यान
गुरु गोपाल, पुरख भगवान

गुरु मेरी पूजा ....
respell:
Guru Merī Pūjā, Guru Gobind
Guru Merā Pāra-brahm, Guru Bhagavant

Guru Merā Dev, Alakh Abheo
Sarab Pūj, Charaṇ Guru Seo

Guru Merī Pūjā ....

Guru Merā Jñān, Guru Hṛuday Dhyān
Guru Gopāl, Purakh Bhagavān

Guru Merī Pūjā ....

title: Guru Nanak Ji Ki Jai Jai Kar
lyrics:
Guru Nanak Ji Ki Jai Jai Kar
Jo Bole So Hoye Nihal
Allah (Maula) Sai Lelo Salam
Salam Salam Lakhon (Mera) Salam
Yesu Pita Prabhu Sai Ram
Buddha Zoroastra Mahaveer Nam
Salam Salam Lakhon (Mera) Salam
meaning: We offer our salutations to the One Divine Lord who is worshipped as Guru Nanak, Allah, Jesus, Buddha, Zoroaster, Mahavira, Sai Ram, and by many other names. Though religions may differ in form, they all point to the same Supreme Truth. May peace, love, respect, and unity prevail among all people.
devanagari:
गुरु नानक जी की जय जय कार  
जो बोले सो होए निहाल  
अल्लाह (मौलाह) साई लेलो सलाम  
सलाम सलाम लाखों (मेरा) सलाम  
येसु पिता प्रभु साई राम  
बुद्ध जोह्राष्ट्र महावीर नाम [ सलाम सलाम ... ]
respell:
Guru Nānak Jī Kī Jay Jay Kār
Jo Bole So Hoe Nihāl
Allāh (maulāh) Sāī Lelo Salām
Salām Salām Lākhoṃ (merā) Salām
Yesu Pitā Prabhu Sāī Rām
Buddha Johrāshṭra Mahāvīr Nām [ Salām Salām ... ]

title: Guru Sai Maheshwara
lyrics:
Guru Sai Maheshwara
Karunakara Karunamaya
Prashanthi Sai Sundara
Parabrahma Roopa Parathpara
Trivikrama Narayana
Brahma Vishnu Maheshwara
meaning: O Guru Sai, Great Lord, you are the very embodiment of compassion and mercy. Beautiful Sai of Prashanthi, you manifest as the Supreme Absolute, transcending all, and are verily Narayana, who traversed the three worlds. Indeed, you encompass Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva, the cosmic trinity.
devanagari:
गुरु साई महेश्वरा
करुणाकरा करुणामया
प्रशान्ति साई सुन्दरा
परब्रह्म रूपा परात्परा
त्रिविक्रमा नारायणा
ब्रह्म विष्णु महेश्वरा
respell:
Guru Sāī Maheshwarā
Karuṇākarā Karuṇāmayā
Prashānti Sāī Sundarā
Parabrahma Rūpā Parātparā
Trivikramā Nārāyaṇā
Brahma Vishṇu Maheshwarā

title: Gurudev Mahadev Saidev
lyrics:
Gurudev Mahadev Saidev (3x)
Bharahma Vishnu Saidev
Sathya Sai Guru Mahadev
meaning: Oh Divine Teacher, Great God, Sai, we recognize you as the supreme Lord. You embody Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva, the very essence of creation, preservation, and dissolution. Sathya Sai, our beloved Guru, you are indeed the Great God manifest.
devanagari:
गुरुदेव महादेव साईदेव (3x)
ब्रह्मा विष्णु साईदेव
सत्य साई गुरु महादेव
respell:
Gurudev Mahādev Sāīdev (3x)
Brahmā Vishṇu Sāīdev
Satya Sāī Guru Mahādev

title: Guruvara Nam Pavana Nam
lyrics:
Guruvara Nam Pavana Nam
Sadguru Naam Guru Nanak Naam
Guruvara Nam Pavana Nam
Sadguru Sai Baba Nam
--
Jai Guru Sadguru Nanak Nam Jai Bolo Sai Baba Nam
meaning: Chant the holy names of the Guru, for they are truly purifying. Proclaim the glory of the true Gurus, Guru Nanak and Sai Baba, whose names bring blessings.
devanagari:
गुरुवर नाम पावन नाम  
सद्गुरु नाम गुरु नानक नाम  
गुरुवर नाम पावन नाम  
सद्गुरु साई बाबा नाम  
जय गुरु सद्गुरु नानक नाम जय बोलो साई बाबा नाम
respell:
Guruvar Nām Pāvan Nām
Sadguru Nām Guru Nānak Nām
Guruvar Nām Pāvan Nām
Sadguru Sāī Bābā Nām
Jay Guru Sadguru Nānak Nām Jay Bolo Sāī Bābā Nām

title: Guruvayurpura Sri Hari Krishna Narayana Gopal
lyrics:
Guruvayurpura Sri Hari Krishna Narayana Gopal
Mukunda Madhava Muralidhari Narayana Gopal
Narayana Gopal Sai Narayana Gopal
Govardhana Giridhari Murari Narayana Gopal
Mukunda Madhava Muralidhari Narayana Gopal
meaning: O Lord Krishna, residing in Guruvayur, we lovingly chant your sacred names: Hari, Narayana, Gopal, Mukunda, Madhava, and Muralidhari. You are the divine protector, the one who lifted Govardhana mountain, and the beloved Sai Narayana, our eternal refuge.
devanagari:
गुरुवायुरपुर श्री हरि कृष्णा नारायण गोपाल
मुकुंद माधव मुरलीधारी नारायण गोपाल
नारायण गोपाल साई नारायण गोपाल (२)
गोवर्धन गिरिधारी मुरारी नारायण गोपाल [ मुकुंद माधव ... ]
respell:
Guruvāyurapura Shrī Hari Kṛushṇā Nārāyaṇ Gopāl
Mukund Mādhava Muralīdhārī Nārāyaṇ Gopāl
Nārāyaṇ Gopāl Sāī Nārāyaṇ Gopāl (2)
Govardhana Giridhārī Murārī Nārāyaṇ Gopāl [ Mukund Mādhava ... ]

title: Hara Hara Gange Hara Hara Gange
lyrics:
Hara Hara Gange Hara Hara Gange
Hey Nataraja Hey Shivaraja Hara Hara Hara Hara Gange
Parthipureeshwara Jaya Gangadhara
Hara Hara Hara Hara Gange
Shankara Shiva Shankara Shiva Shankara Shankara Sai
meaning: Let us chant the glorious name of Shiva who adorns the Ganges in His matted hair. Oh Shankara, You are the master of the divine dance and none other than Lord Sai, the resident of Parthi, who bestows auspiciousness.
devanagari:
हर हर गंगे हर हर गंगे
हे नटराजा हे शिव राजा हर हर हर हर गंगे [ हर हर ... ]
पर्तिपूरीश्वरा जय गंगाधरा
हर (4) गंगे [ हर हर ... ]
शंकरा शिव शंकरा शिव शंकर शंकर साई (2)
respell:
Har Har Gaṅge Har Har Gaṅge
He Naṭarājā He Shiv Rājā Har Har Har Har Gaṅge [ Har Har ... ]
Partipūrīshwarā Jaya Gaṅgādharā
Har (4) Gaṅge [ Har Har ... ]
Shaṅkarā Shiv Shaṅkarā Shiv Shaṅkar Shaṅkar Sāī (2)

title: Hara Hara Hara Hara Mahadeva
lyrics:
Hara Hara Hara Hara Mahadeva
Shiva Shiva Shiva Shiva Sadashiva
Om Hara Hara Hara Hara Mahadeva
Om Namo Namo Namah Shivaya
Brahma Vishnu Surarchitaya Om Namo Namo Namah Shivaya
Uma Ganesha Sharavana Sevita Om Namo Namo Namah Shivaya
Om Namo Namo Namah Shivaya
meaning: Oh Great God Mahadeva, remover of all suffering, and Eternal Shiva, we repeatedly chant your auspicious names. We offer our deepest salutations to you, who are revered by Brahma, Vishnu, and all the gods, and lovingly served by your divine consort Uma and your sons Ganesha and Sharavana.
devanagari:
हर हर हर हर महादेवा
शिव शिव शिव शिव सदाशिवा
ॐ हरा हरा हरा हरा महादेवा
ॐ नमो नमो नमः शिवाय
ब्रह्मा विष्णु सुरार्चिताय ॐ नमो नमो नमः शिवाय
उमा गणेश शरवण सेवित ॐ नमो नमो नमः शिवाय [ ॐ नमो ... ]
respell:
Har Har Har Har Mahādevā
Shiv Shiv Shiv Shiv Sadāshivā
Oṃ Harā Harā Harā Harā Mahādevā
Oṃ Namo Namo Namaḥ Shivāy
Brahmā Vishṇu Surārchitāya Oṃ Namo Namo Namaḥ Shivāy
Umā Gaṇesha Sharavaṇ Sevit Oṃ Namo Namo Namaḥ Shivāy [ Oṃ Namo ... ]

title: Hara Hara Hara Hara Namami Shankara Bhajamana Sai Ram
lyrics:
Hara Hara Hara Hara Namami Shankara Bhajamana Sai Ram
Hara Hara Shiva Shiva Sadashiva Bhajamana Sai Ram
Shiva Shiva Shiva Shiva Sadashiva Bhajamana Sai Ram
meaning: Hail, hail, hail to Shankar, to whom I humbly bow. O mind, worship Sai Ram! Constantly invoke the names of Shiva, the eternally auspicious one, and let your heart resonate with Sai Ram.
devanagari:
हर हर हर हर नमामि शंकर भज मन साई राम  
हर हर शिव शिव सदाशिवा भज मन साई राम  
शिव शिव शिव शिव सदाशिवा भज मन साई राम
respell:
Har Har Har Har Namāmi Shaṅkar Bhaja Mana Sāī Rām
Har Har Shiv Shiv Sadāshivā Bhaja Mana Sāī Rām
Shiv Shiv Shiv Shiv Sadāshivā Bhaja Mana Sāī Rām

title: Hara Hara Hara Hara Samba Shiva
lyrics:
Hara Hara Hara Hara Samba Shiva
Vibhuti Sundara Sai Shiva
Gangadhara Hara Gauri Shiva
Trishuladhari Trinetra Shiva
Parthipuri Paramesha Shiva
Vibhuti Sundara Sai Shiva
meaning: O Shiva, remover of all suffering, divine consort of Parvati, we praise Your sacred form. You are the beautiful one adorned with holy ash, the three-eyed Lord who bears the Ganga and wields the trident, the Supreme Being of Parthi, Sai Shiva.
devanagari:
हर हर हर हर साम्ब शिवा
विभूति सुंदर साई शिवा
गंगाधर हर गौरी शिवा
त्रिशूल धारी त्रिनेत्र शिवा
पर्तीपुरी परमेश शिवा [ विभूति सुंदर ... ]
respell:
Har Har Har Har Sāmba Shivā
Vibhūti Sundara Sāī Shivā
Gaṅgādhara Har Gaurī Shivā
Trishūl Dhārī Trinetra Shivā
Partīpurī Paramesha Shivā [ Vibhūti Sundara ... ]

title: Hara Hara Shambho Karuna Sindho
lyrics:
Hara Hara Shambho Karuna Sindho
Shiva Shiva Shankara Lokapate
Paripalaya Mam Parthipureeshwara
Sai Shiva Kailasapathe
meaning: Oh Shambho, ocean of compassion, Shiva, Shankar, Lord of the universe! We earnestly pray for your protection, Lord of Parthi, Sai Shiva, who is the very Lord of Kailasa.
devanagari:
हर हर शम्भो करुणा सिन्धो
शिव शिव शङ्कर लोकपते
परिपालय माम् पर्तिपूरीश्वर
साई शिवा कैलासपते
respell:
Har Har Shambho Karuṇā Sindho
Shiv Shiv Shaṅkar Lokapate
Paripālay Mām Partipūrīshwar
Sāī Shivā Kailāsapate

title: Hara Hara Shankara Samba Sadashiva Esha Mahesha
lyrics:
Hara Hara Shankara Samba Sadashiva Esha Mahesha
Tandava Priyakara Chandrakaladhara Esha Mahesha
Amba Guha Lambodara Vandita Esha Mahesha
Tunga Himachala Shringa Nivasita Esha Mahesha
meaning: "O Lord Shiva, Supreme Mahesha and Eternal Sadashiva! You are the auspicious Lord who removes ignorance, performs the cosmic dance, and blesses all creation. Worshipped by Your divine family and residing in Kailasa, You are the source of wisdom, strength, and spiritual liberation. We bow to You with devotion and reverence."
devanagari:
हर हर शंकरा साम्ब सादाशिव ईशा महेशा
तांडव प्रियकर चंद्रकला धारा ईशा महेशा
अम्बा गुहा लम्बोद्धर वन्दिता ईशा महेशा
विन्ध्य हिमाचल श्रिंग निवाश्रित ईशा महेशा
respell:
Har Har Shaṅkarā Sāmba Sādāshiv Īshā Maheshā
Tāṇḍava Priyakar Chandrakalā Dhārā Īshā Maheshā
Ambā Guhā Lamboddhara Vanditā Īshā Maheshā
Vindhya Himāchala Shriṅg Nivāshrit Īshā Maheshā

title: Hara Shiva Shankara Bhole Nath Shirdi Pureeshwara Sai Nath
lyrics:
Hara Shiva Shankara Bholey Nath Shirdi Pureeshwara Sai Nath
Shiva Shiva Shankara Bholey Nath Parthi Pureeshwara Sai Nath
Phani Bhooshana Shiva Gowri Nath
Parama Sumangala Sai Nath
Girija Ramana Paramananda Samadhipriya Ganga Nath
meaning: Oh Lord Shiva, the innocent and simple one, you are truly Sai Nath, the divine master of Shirdi and Parthi. Adorned with serpents, beloved of Gauri, you are the supremely auspicious one, ever blissful in meditation, and the bearer of the sacred Ganga.
devanagari:
हरा शिव शंकर भोलेनाथ शिर्डी पूरीश्वर साईंनाथ
शिव शिव शंकर भोलेनाथ पर्ति पूरीश्वर साईंनाथ
फणि भूषण शिव गौरीनाथ
परम सुमंगला साईंनाथ
गिरिजा रमणा परमआनंदा समाधीप्रिय गंगानाथ
respell:
Harā Shiv Shaṅkar Bholenāth Shirḍī Pūrīshwar Sāīnnātha
Shiv Shiv Shaṅkar Bholenāth Parti Pūrīshwar Sāīnnātha
Phaṇi Bhūshaṇ Shiv Gaurīnāth
Param Sumaṅgalā Sāīnnāth
Girijā Ramaṇā Paramaānandā Samādhīpriy Gaṅgānātha

title: Hara Shiva Shankara Shashanka Shekhara Hara Bham Hara Bham Bham Bham Bolo
lyrics:
Hara Shiva Shankara Shashanka Shekhara Hara Bham Hara Bham Bham Bham Bolo
Bhava Bhayankara Girija Shankara Dhimi Dhimi Dhimitaka Nartana Khelo
meaning: Chant the sacred names of Lord Shiva, the moon-crested deity, with the powerful sound of "Hara Bham." He is Shankara, beloved of Girija, who dances to the rhythmic drumbeats, fearlessly dispelling the terrors of worldly existence.
devanagari:
हरा शिव शंकर शशांक शेखर हर बम हर बम बम बम बोलो
भवा भयंकर गिरिजा शंकर धिमी धिमी धिमी थक नर्तन केलो
हरा शिव शंकर शशांक शेखर हर बम हर बम बम बम बोलो [ भवा भयंकर ... ]
respell:
Harā Shiv Shaṅkar Shashāṅk Shekhar Har Bam Har Bam Bam Bam Bolo
Bhavā Bhayaṅkar Girijā Shaṅkar Dhimī Dhimī Dhimī Thaka Nartana Kelo
Harā Shiv Shaṅkar Shashāṅk Shekhar Har Bam Har Bam Bam Bam Bolo [ Bhavā Bhayaṅkar ... ]

title: Hare Krishna Hare Rama Hare Hare Hare Hare
lyrics:
Hare Krishna Hare Rama Hare Hare Hare Hare
Hare Hare Hare Hare
Krishna Rama Rama Krishna Hare Hare
Govinda Krishna Gopala Krishna
Krishna Rama Rama Krishna Hare Hare
meaning: Oh divine Krishna and Rama, we chant your holy names, invoking your sacred presence. We lovingly call upon you, Krishna, as Govinda and Gopala, seeking your eternal grace and blessings.
devanagari:
हरे कृष्णा हरे रामा हरे हरे हरे हरे
हरे हरे हरे हरे
कृष्णा रामा रामा कृष्णा हरे हरे
गोविंद कृष्णा गोपाल कृष्णा
कृष्णा रामा रामा कृष्णा हरे हरे
respell:
Hare Kṛushṇā Hare Rāmā Hare Hare Hare Hare
Hare Hare Hare Hare
Kṛushṇā Rāmā Rāmā Kṛushṇā Hare Hare
Govind Kṛushṇā Gopāla Kṛushṇā
Kṛushṇā Rāmā Rāmā Kṛushṇā Hare Hare

title: Hare Ram Hare Ram Hare Rama Krishna Hare Ram
lyrics:
Hare Ram Hare Ram Hare Rama Krishna Hare Ram
Mukunda Madhava Sri Sai Ram
Govinda Gopala Radha Ke Shyam
Giridhara Gopala Meera Ke Shyam
Bolo Ram Bolo Shyam Bolo Sai Ghanashyam
meaning: Oh divine Lord, we earnestly chant your sacred names: Rama, Krishna, Mukunda, Madhava, and the revered Sai Ram. We invoke Govinda, the cowherd Gopala, the beloved Shyam of Radha and Meera, and the mountain-lifter Giridhara. Let us speak these names – Ram, Shyam, and Sai Ghanashyam – and immerse ourselves in your grace.
devanagari:
हरे राम हरे राम हरे राम कृष्ण हरे राम
मुकुंद माधव श्री साई राम
गोविंद गोपाल राधा के श्याम
गिरीधर गोपाल मीरा के श्याम
बोलो राम बोलो श्याम बोलो साई घनश्याम
respell:
Hare Rām Hare Rām Hare Rām Kṛushṇa Hare Rām
Mukund Mādhava Shrī Sāī Rām
Govind Gopāla Rādhā Ke Shyām
Girīdhara Gopāla Mīrā Ke Shyām
Bolo Rām Bolo Shyām Bolo Sāī Ghanashyām

title: Hare Rama Hare Rama Rama Rama Hare Hare
lyrics:
Hare Rama Hare Rama Rama Rama Hare Hare
Hare Krishna Hare Krishna Krishna Krishna Hare Hare
Satsangatve Nissangatvam Nissangatve Nirmohatvam
Nirmohatve Nischala Tatvam Nishchala Tatve Jeevan Mukti
meaning: We incessantly chant the sacred names of Lord Rama and Lord Krishna! Through the company of the wise, we attain detachment, which then frees us from all delusion. This journey culminates in realizing the unwavering truth and achieving liberation in this very life.
devanagari:
हरे रामा हरे रामा रामा रामा हरे हरे
हरे कृष्णा हरे कृष्णा कृष्णा कृष्णा हरे हरे
सत्संगत्वे निस्संगत्वम् निस्संगत्वे निर्मोहत्वम्
निर्मोहत्वे निश्चल तत्वम् निश्चल तत्वे जीवन मुक्ति
respell:
Hare Rāmā Hare Rāmā Rāmā Rāmā Hare Hare
Hare Kṛushṇā Hare Kṛushṇā Kṛushṇā Kṛushṇā Hare Hare
Satsaṅgatwe Nissaṅgatwam Nissaṅgatwe Nirmohatwam
Nirmohatwe Nishchala Tatwam Nishchala Tatwe Jīvan Mukti

title: Hare Krishna Hare Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram
lyrics:
Hare Krishna Hare Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram
Gopal Govinda Bolo Jai Sai Ram
Madhava Mukunda Bolo Jai Sai Ram
He Parameshwara Parthipureeshwara Daya Karo He Sai Ram
Jai Jai Ram Sai Ram Jai Jai Ram
Jai Jai Ram Sai Ram Jai Jai Ram Bolo
Jai Jai Ram Sai Ram Jai Jai Ram
meaning: Chant the names of the Lord Krishna, Rama, Gopala, Govinda, Madhava and Mukunda. Bless us O Sai, the Lord of Parthi, who is the Supreme Lord. Victory to You O Sai Rama.
devanagari:
हरे कृष्ण हरे राम साई राम साई राम
गोपाल गोविन्द (माधव मुकुंद) बोलो जय साई राम
हे परमेश्वर पर्ति पूरीश्वर दया करो हे साई राम
जय जय राम साई राम जय जय राम
जय जय राम साई राम जय जय राम बोलो [ जय जय राम ... ]
respell:
Hare Kṛushṇa Hare Rām Sāī Rām Sāī Rām
Gopāl Govinda (mādhava Mukund) Bolo Jay Sāī Rām
He Parameshwar Parti Pūrīshwar Dayā Karo He Sāī Rām
Jay Jay Rām Sāī Rām Jay Jay Rām
Jay Jay Rām Sāī Rām Jay Jay Rām Bolo [ Jay Jay Rām ... ]

title: Hare Murare Sai Ram Hare Murare Ram
lyrics:
Hare Murare Sai Ram Hare Murare Ram
Parama Sumangala Sai Ram Parama Sumangala Ram
Eshwar Allah Tere Nam Sab Tum Ho Bhagawan
Parama Sumangala Sai Ram Parama Sumangala Ram
meaning: O Sai Ram, Murari, and Ram, You are the source of all supreme auspiciousness. Ishwar and Allah are but Your sacred names, for You alone are the one divine Lord, manifest in all forms and revered by all.
devanagari:
हरे मुरारे साई राम हरे मुरारे राम  
परम सुमंगल साई राम परम सुमंगल राम  
ईश्वर अल्लाह तेरे नाम सब तुम हो भगवान [ परम सुमंगल ... ]
respell:
Hare Murāre Sāī Rām Hare Murāre Rām
Param Sumaṅgal Sāī Rām Param Sumaṅgal Rām
Īshwar Allāh Tere Nām Sab Tum Ho Bhagavān [ Param Sumaṅgal ... ]

title: Hare Sai Hare Sai Sai Sai Hare Hare
lyrics:
Hare Sai Hare Sai Sai Sai Hare Hare
Hare Baba Hare Baba Sai Baba Hare Hare
Achyutam Keshavam Rama Narayanam
Krishna Damodaram Vasudevam Bhaje
Sridharam Madhavam Gopika Vallabham
Sadguru Nayakam Sai Natham Bhaje
meaning: We joyfully chant your sacred names, O Sai, O Baba, invoking your divine presence. We worship you, who are the infallible Achyuta, Keshava, Rama, Narayana, Krishna Damodara, Vasudeva, Sridhara, and Madhava, the beloved of the Gopis, our Sadguru and supreme Lord Sai.
devanagari:
हरे साई हरे साई साई साई हरे हरे
हरे बाबा हरे बाबा बाला बाबा हरे हरे [ हरे साई ... ]
अच्युतम् केशवम् राम नारायणम्
कृष्ण दामोदरम् वासुदेवम् भजे
श्रीधरम् माधवम् गोपिका वल्लभम्
सद्गुरु नायकम् साईं रामम् भजे
respell:
Hare Sāī Hare Sāī Sāī Sāī Hare Hare
Hare Bābā Hare Bābā Bālā Bābā Hare Hare [ Hare Sāī ... ]
Achyutam Keshavam Rām Nārāyaṇam
Kṛushṇa Dāmodaram Vāsudevam Bhaje
Shrīdharam Mādhavam Gopikā Vallabham
Sadguru Nāyakam Sāīṃ Rāmam Bhaje

title: Hari Anandamaya Jaya Narayana
lyrics:
Hari Anandamaya Jaya Narayana (Sai)
Vasudeva Nandana Radha Jeevana
Paramananda Madhava
--
Narayana Hari Narayana (3)
Narayana Sai Narayana
meaning: Oh Hari, full of divine bliss, victory to you, Narayana! You are the cherished son of Vasudeva and the very essence of Radha's life. We celebrate you, Madhava, the ultimate source of supreme joy.
devanagari:
हरि आनंदमय जय नारायणा ( साई )
वसुदेव नंदन राधा जीवन
परमानंदा माधवा
नारायणा हरि ( साई ) नारायणा (3)
respell:
Hari Ānandamaya Jaya Nārāyaṇā ( Sāī )
Vasudeva Nandana Rādhā Jīvan
Paramānandā Mādhavā
Nārāyaṇā Hari ( Sāī ) Nārāyaṇā (3)

title: Hari Om Ananda Narayana
lyrics:
Hari Om Ananda Narayana
Narayana Hari (Sai) Narayana [Hari Om Ananda..]
Triloka Palana Narayana
Parthi Nivasa Narayana
Puttaparthi Nivasa Narayana
meaning: Oh Narayana, divine Hari Om, you are the very essence of bliss. You are the protector of all three worlds, dwelling as Sai in Puttaparthi.
devanagari:
हरि ॐ आनंद नारायणा
नारायणा हरि (साई) नारायणा [ हरि ॐ ... ]
त्रिलोक पालन नारायणा
पर्ती निवासा नारायणा
respell:
Hari Oṃ Ānanda Nārāyaṇā
Nārāyaṇā Hari (sāī) Nārāyaṇā [ Hari Oṃ ... ]
Trilok Pālan Nārāyaṇā
Partī Nivāsā Nārāyaṇā

title: Hari Om Hari Om Hari Om Narayana
lyrics:
Hari Om Hari Om Hari Om Narayana
Shantakara Bhujaga Shayana Padmanabha Narayana
Lakshmi Ramana Kamala Nayana Sai Natha Narayana
Hari Om Hari Om Hari Om Narayana
meaning: Oh Narayana, we invoke your sacred name, you who are the very form of peace, reclining upon the cosmic serpent. From your navel springs the lotus, and you are the beloved of Lakshmi, with eyes like a blooming lotus. We adore you as Lord Sai.
devanagari:
हरि ॐ हरि ॐ हरि ॐ नारायणा (२)
शान्ताकारा भुजंग शयना पद्मनाभ नारायणा
लक्ष्मी रमणा कमल नयना साई नाथा नारायणा
हरि ॐ हरि ॐ हरि ॐ नारायणा

Hari Oṃ Hari Oṃ Hari Oṃ Nārāyaṇā

title: Hari Aum Namah Shivaya (2)
lyrics:
Hari Aum Namah Shivaya (2)
Hari Aum Hari Aum Hari Aum Namah Shivaya (2)
meaning: Oh divine Hari, we offer our deepest salutations to Shiva, the auspicious one, resonating with the sacred sound of Om. Through this chant, we honor the benevolent Lord, seeking his grace and presence in every moment.
devanagari:
हरि ॐ नमः शिवाय (२)
हरि ॐ हरि ॐ हरि ॐ नमः शिवाय (२)
respell:

title: Hari Om Namah Shivaya
lyrics:
Hari Om Namah Shivaya
Shiva Shiva Shankara Hara Parameshwara Sayeeshwaraya Namah Om (2)
meaning: We offer profound salutations to Lord Shiva, the auspicious one and remover of suffering, invoking Him with the sacred mantra 'Hari Om Namah Shivaya'. Our reverence is directed to this Supreme Lord, who is also manifest as Lord Sai.
devanagari:
हरि ॐ नमः शिवाया

title: Hari Om Namo Shiva Shakti Namo
lyrics:
Hari Om Namo Shiva Shakti Namo
Sadguru Sri Sathya Namo
Hari Om Namo Sita Ram Namo
Jaya Sadguru Sri Sathya Namo
Hari Om Namo Radhe Shyam Namo
Jaya Sadguru Sri Sathya Sai Namo
meaning: Hari Om, we bow to Shiva and Shakti, to Sita and Ram, and to Radha and Shyam. All glory and salutations to our true guru, Sri Sathya Sai, who embodies these divine forms.
devanagari:

हरि ॐ नमो राधे श्याम नमो
जय सद्गुरु श्री सत्य साईं नमो
