title: Hari Aum Tat Sat Hari
lyrics:
Hari Aum Tat Sat Hari Aum Tat Sat Hari Aum Tat Sat Hari Aum
Krishna Krishna Krishna Krishna Jaya Radha Krishna
Govinda Govinda Bhajo Radhey Govinda Gopala Gopala Bhajo Krishna Mukunda

title: Hari Om Tat Sat Namah Shivaya
lyrics:
Hari Om Tat Sat Namah Shivaya 
Sai Om Tat Sat Namah Shivaya [Hari Om Tat..]
Shiva Shiva Shivaya Namah Shivaya 
Sai Om Tat Sat Namah Shivaya

meaning: Oh Hari, the Supreme Truth, we offer our salutations to Shiva, the auspicious one. Sai, you embody that very Absolute Reality, and we bow to Shiva. We continuously chant the sacred name of Shiva, recognizing the divine essence in all.

Sāī Oṃ Tat Sat Namaḥ Shivāy

title: Hari Bhajana Bina Sukha Shanti Nahin
lyrics:
Hari Bhajana Bina Sukha Shanti Nahin
Hari Nam Bina Ananda Nahin
Prema Bhakti Bina Uddhara Nahin
Guru Seva Bina Nirvana Nahin
Japa Dhyana Bina Samyoga Nahin
Prabhu Darsha Bina Prajnana Nahin
Daya Dharma Bina Satkarma Nahin
Bhagawan Bina Koi Apna Nahin
Hari Nam Bina Paramatma Nahin
Sai Nam Bina Paramatma Nahin
meaning: Know that without chanting the Divine Name and cultivating loving devotion, there is no true peace, joy, or liberation. Only through serving the Guru, meditating, and living righteously with compassion can one attain divine vision and realize the Supreme Self, for God alone is our eternal companion.
devanagari:
हरि भजन बिना सुख शांति नहीं
हरि नाम बिना आनंद नहीं

गुरु सेवा बिना निर्वाण नहीं
जप ध्यान बिना संयोग नहीं
प्रभु दर्श बिना प्रज्ञान नहीं
दया धर्म बिना सत्कर्म नहीं
भगवान बिना कोई अपना नहीं
हरि नाम बिना परमात्मा नहीं
साई नाम बिना परमात्मा नहीं
respell:

Sāī Nām Binā Paramātmā Nahīṃ

title: Hari Bol Hari Bol Hari Hari Bol
lyrics:
Hari Bol Hari Bol Hari Hari Bol
Mukunda Madhava Govinda Bol
Hari Bol Hari Bol Hari Hari Bol
Keshava Madhava Govinda Bol
meaning: Chant the holy name of Hari, chant Hari! We lovingly invoke Mukunda, Madhava, Govinda, and Keshava, continuously repeating their divine names. Let us immerse ourselves in their glorious presence through this devotional chanting.
devanagari:

केशव माधव गोविंद बोल
respell:

title: Hari Bolo Hare Rama Nam
lyrics:
Hari Bolo Hare Rama Nam
Hari Bolo Hare Krishna Nam
Hari Bolo Sathya Sai Ram
Hari Bolo Hare Rama Nam
meaning: Chant the divine name of Hari, invoking the beloved Lord Rama. Speak forth the sacred names of Krishna and Sathya Sai Ram, for through these holy utterances, we remember the divine.

title: Hari Guna Gan Karo Man Mero
lyrics:
Hari Guna Gan Karo Man Mero
Sai Guna Gan Karo Man Mero
Hare Rama Hare Krishna Krishna Krishna Sai Krishna
Sai Guna Gan Karo Man Mero
meaning: Oh my mind, dedicate yourself to praising the divine qualities of Hari and Sai. Continuously invoke the names of Hare Rama, Hare Krishna, and Sai Krishna, letting their sacred essence resonate within you.

title: Hari Hari Aum Sri Hari Hari Aum
lyrics:
Hari Hari Aum Sri Hari Hari Aum
Govinda Giridhara Nara Hari Aum
Mukunda Madhava Hari Hari Aum
Natavara Naagara, Natavara Naagara Jai Hari Aum
Karuna Sagara Sri (Sai) Hari Aum
meaning: O Hari, Govinda, Giridhara, Mukunda, and Madhava! You are the compassionate Lord who protects Your devotees, removes suffering, grants liberation, and fills life with divine joy. Whether worshipped as Krishna, Vishnu, or Sai, You are the same Supreme Being. We chant Your holy names and seek Your grace, love, and guidance.
devanagari:
हरी हरी ॐ श्री हरी हरी ॐ
गोविन्द गिरिधर नर हरी ॐ
मुकुन्द माधव हरी हरी ॐ
नटवर नागर, नटवर नागर जय हरी ॐ
करुणा सागर श्री (साई) हरी ॐ

Mukunda Mādhava Harī Harī Oṃ

lyrics:
Hari Hari Bhajo Mana Sai Ram Bhajorey
Sai Ram Bhajo Mana Sai Krishna Bhajorey [ Hari Hari ... ]
Mukunda Madhava Vittala Bhajorey
Govinda Govinda Madhava Bhajorey
meaning: O mind, ceaselessly chant the holy names of Hari and Sai Ram. Immerse yourself in the divine remembrance of Sai Krishna, Mukunda, Madhava, and Vittala. Constantly repeat the sacred names of Govinda and Madhava.

गोविंद गोविंद माधव भजोरें

title: Hari Hari Govinda Narayana
lyrics:
Hari Hari Govinda Narayana
Sri Hari Bol Jaya Hari Bol
Hari Hari Govinda Narayana
Hare Rama Hare Krishna Prasanthi Raja Ram
Sai Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram Bolo
meaning: Oh divine Hari, Govinda, and Narayana, we joyfully chant your names, proclaiming victory to the glorious Hari! We invoke Rama and Krishna, the King of Peace, and continuously utter the sacred name of Sai Ram.

साई राम साई राम साई राम बोलो

Shrī Hari Bol Jaya Hari Bol

lyrics:
Hari Hari Govinda Narayana
Sri Hari Bol Jaya Hari Bol [ Hari Hari ... ]
Harey Rama Harey Krishna Prashanthi Raja Ram
Sai Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram Bolo
meaning: Let us continuously chant the sacred names of the Divine, invoking Hari, Govinda, Narayana, Rama, and Krishna. We celebrate the glorious Sai Ram, the King of Prashanthi, by repeating his holy name.

respell:

lyrics:

Sai Shyam Guna Gao

meaning: Chant the sacred names of Hari and Govinda, and sing their divine glories. Utter the names Sai Ram and Sai Shyam, and praise the holy name of Sai.

साई राम गुण गाओ
गोविन्द गोविन्द गोविन्द बोलो [ गोविन्द के ... ]

title: Hari Hari Hari Hari Smarana Karo
lyrics:
Hari Hari Hari Hari Smarana Karo
Hari Charana Kamala Dhyana Karo
Murali Madhava Seva Karo
Murahara Giridhari Bhajana Karo
meaning: Oh seeker, constantly remember Hari's sacred name and meditate upon His divine lotus feet. Devote yourself to Murali Madhava, the enchanting flute player, and sing the glories of Murahara, the mountain-lifting Giridhari.

title: Hari Hari Narayana
lyrics:
Hari Hari Narayana
Hari Govinda Narayana
Hari Gopala Narayana
Hari Hari Narayana
Hrishikesha Narayana
Partheesha Narayana
meaning: Oh Narayana, we invoke your sacred names: Hari, the remover of sorrow; Govinda and Gopala, the divine protector. You are Hrishikesha, master of our senses, and the Lord of Parthi.

हरि गोपाल नारायणा

title: Hari Hari Om Shiva Shankara Om
lyrics:
Hari Hari Om Shiva Shankara Om
Narayana Hari Om
Keshava Hey Jaya Madhava Hey
Narayana Hari Om
Paramatma Antaryami
Narayana Hari Om
meaning:
Meditate on the primordial sound of OM
Chant the names of the divine lord as Hari, Shiva, Shankara, Keshava and Madhava
Meditate on the lord who is the indweller of every being
Mediatate on the form who is supreme consciousness himself
devanagari:

Nārāyaṇ Hari Oṃ

title: Hari Hari Sumiran Hari Hari Bhajo Man
lyrics:
Hari Hari Sumiran Hari Hari Bhajo Man
Hari Hi Tero Tan Man Aur Dhan [ Hari Hari ... ]
Tulsidas Bhajey Ramam Ramam
Meera Daasi Bhaja Govindam
Hari Bin Jeevan Kaisa Jeevan
Hari Charanan Mey Arpan Kar Man
meaning: O mind, constantly remember and worship Lord Hari, for He is your true essence, your very being, and all your wealth. Following the path of great devotees like Tulsidas and Meera, dedicate yourself to Him, as life without Hari holds no true meaning. Therefore, surrender your heart completely at His divine feet.
devanagari:
हरि हरि सुमिरन हरि हरि भजो मन
हरि ही तेरो तन मन और धन [ हरि हरि ... ]
तुलसीदास भजे रामं रामं
मीरा दासी भज गोविंदम
हरि बिन जीवन कैसा जीवन
हरि चरणन में अर्पण कर मन
respell:

title: Hari Manna Thumi Govinda Manna
lyrics:
Hari Mhana Tuhi Govinda Mhana Tuhi Gopala Mhana Tuhi Narayana
Govinda Gopala Hari Narayana
Shyama Mhana Radha Shyama Mhana Radha Shyama Mhana Sai Shyama Mhana
Shyama Mhana Ghanashyama Mhana Megha Shyama Mhana Sai Shyama Mhana
Esha Mhana Sarvesha Mhana Partheesha Mhana Sayeesha Mhana
Govinda Gopala Hari Narayana (3)
meaning:
Chant the name of Hari! Chant the name of Govinda! Chant the name of Gopala! Chant the name of Narayana!
Govinda, Gopala, Hari, Narayana!
Chant the name of Shyama (Krishna)! Chant Radha's Shyama! Chant Sai Shyama!
Chant Ghanashyama (the dark-hued Lord)! Chant Megha Shyama (the cloud-colored Lord)! Chant Sai Shyama!
Chant the Lord! Chant the Lord of all! Chant the Lord of Parthi! Chant Lord Sai!
Govinda, Gopala, Hari, Narayana!
devanagari:
हरी म्हणा तुम्ही गोविन्द म्हणा तुम्ही गोपाल म्हणा तुम्ही नारायणा
गोविन्द गोपाल हरी नारायणा
राम म्हणा राजा राम म्हणा सीता राम म्हणा अम्मा राम म्हणा
श्याम म्हणा घन श्याम म्हणा मेघ श्याम म्हणा राधे श्याम म्हणा
ईश म्हणा सर्वेश म्हणा पर्तीश म्हणा साईशा म्हणा
respell:

Govinda Gopāla Harī Nārāyaṇā
Rām Mhaṇā Rājā Rām Mhaṇā Sītā Rām Mhaṇā Ammā Rām Mhaṇā
Shyām Mhaṇā Ghan Shyām Mhaṇā Megha Shyām Mhaṇā Rādhe Shyām mhaṇā
Īsh Mhaṇā Sarwesh Mhaṇā Partīsha Mhaṇā Sāīshā Mhaṇā

title: Hari Nam Gate Chalo Sai Nam Gate Chalo
lyrics:
Hari Nam Gaate Chalo Sai Nam Gaate Chalo
Madhava Govinda Govinda Madhava Nam Gaate Chalo
Govinda Vitthala Gopala Vitthala
Jaya Parthi Vitthala Jaya Sai Vitthala
Madhava Govinda Govinda Madhava Nam Gaate Chalo
meaning: Keep chanting the divine names of Hari and Sai, and let your voice resonate with the names of Madhava and Govinda. Hail to Govinda, Vitthala, and Gopala, and victory to Sai Vitthala, the beloved Lord of Parthi.
devanagari:

माधव गोविन्द गोविन्द माधव नाम गाते चलो [ हरी नाम ... ]  
गोविन्द विट्ठला गोपाल विट्ठला  
जय पर्ती विट्ठला जय साई विट्ठला (2) [ माधव गोविन्द ... ]
respell:

Govinda Viṭṭhalā Gopāla Viṭṭhalā
Jaya Partī Viṭṭhalā Jaya Sāī Viṭṭhalā (2) [ Mādhava Govinda ... ]

title: Hari Narayana Hari Narayana Hari Narayana Bhajore
lyrics:
Hari Narayana Hari Narayana Hari Narayana Bhajore
Shyama Sundara Madana Gopala
Sachidananda Sai Gopala
Gopalana Gopi Gopalana Gopi Gopalana Bhajore
Narayana Hari Narayana Hari Narayana Bhajore
--
Narayana Bhajore
Hari Narayana Bhajore
Sai Narayana Bhajore
meaning: This bhajan is a heartfelt call to worship Hari Narayana, the divine Lord. It celebrates Him as the enchanting, dark-hued Gopala, who embodies absolute Truth, Consciousness, and Bliss, and lovingly protects the cows and Gopis.
devanagari:

गोपालना गोपी गोपालना गोपी गोपालना भजो रे

title: Hari Narayana Hari Narayana
lyrics:
Hari Narayana Hari Narayana
Nitya Niranjana Sai Narayana
Narahari Roopa Namo Narayana
Rajeeva Lochana Sai Narayana
meaning: O Hari Narayana, eternal and utterly pure, we earnestly call upon your divine name. You are Sai, the Man-Lion form, to whom we offer our humble salutations, O lotus-eyed Narayana.
devanagari:

lyrics:

Hari Narayana Sai Narayana

Jaya Sai Narayana Narayana
meaning: Oh Hari Narayana, divine remover of sorrow and cosmic sustainer, we chant your sacred names. Glory to you, Narayana, and to Sai, who is verily your divine form.

title: Hey Akhilandeshwari Ma
lyrics:
Hey Akhilandeshwari Ma
Anatha Rakshaki Ma
Chamundeshwari Karuna Sagari
Palaya Maam Dehi
Hey Tribhuvana Palini Ma
Hey Trishoola Dharini Ma
Jaya Ma Jaya Ma Jaya Ma
Jagadeeshwari Sai Ma
Partheeshwari Sai Ma

title: Hey Anatha Natha Sai Tum Ho Antaryami
lyrics:
Hey Anatha Natha Sai Tum Ho Antaryami
Tum Ho Mere Bhagawan
Deena Dukha Bhanjana Sahara Do Mujhe
O Mere Sai Bhagawan
Hridaya Mandir Mein Aao Sai Mere
Deejo Kripa Vardan
Tum Ho Mere Bhagawan
meaning: O Sai, my inner guide and protector of the vulnerable, you are truly my divine Lord. Please alleviate my suffering and grant me your support, entering the sanctuary of my heart to bestow your sacred grace.
devanagari:
हे अनाथ नाथ साईं तुम हो अंतर्यामी  
तुम हो मेरे भगवान  
दीन दुख भंजन सहारा दो मुझे  
ओ मेरे साईं भगवान  
हृदय मंदिर में आओ साईं मेरे  
दीजो कृपा वरदान [ तुम हो ... ]
respell:

Hṛudaya Mandir Meṃ Āo Sāīṃ Mere

title: Hey Brahma Hey Vishnu
lyrics:
Hey Brahma Hey Vishnu
Dayamaya Hey Maheshwara
Sathya Sai Parameshwara
Hey Brahma Hey Vishnu
Maha Shakti Shiva Sai Shankara
Poorna Teja Sai Avatara
meaning: Oh Sathya Sai, you are the compassionate Supreme Lord, embodying Brahma, Vishnu, and Maheshwara. You are the great divine power, Shiva Sai Shankara, the complete and radiant Avatar.
devanagari:
हे ब्रह्मा हे विष्णु
दयामया हे महेश्वरा
सत्य साई परमेश्वरा
हे ब्रह्मा हे विष्णु
महा शक्ति शिव साई शंकर
पूर्ण तेज साई अवतारा
respell:
He Brahmā He Vishṇu
Dayāmayā He Maheshwarā
Satya Sāī Parameshwarā
He Brahmā He Vishṇu
Mahā Shakti Shiv Sāī Shaṅkar
Pūrṇa Teja Sāī Avatārā

title: He Vraja Bal Yadu Nanda Gopal
lyrics:
Hey Brij Bal Yadu Nanda Gopal
Shyama Sundara Mohana Gopal [ Hey Brij ... ]
Yashoda Ke Bal Yadu Nanda Gopal
Gopal Gopal Gokula Bal
meaning: Oh Gopala, the enchanting dark-skinned beauty, you are the beloved child of Nanda and Yashoda, the very heart of Braj and Gokul. You embody the charm of the Yadu lineage.

title: Hey Chinmayi Sai Janani
lyrics:
Hey Chinmayi Sai Janani
Mata Jaganmayi Sai Janani
Shabdha Brahmamayi Sai Janani
Paratparamayi Sai Janani
Shiva Shaktimayi Sai Janani
Nityanandamayi Sai Janani
meaning: Oh Mother Sai, you are pure consciousness, permeating the entire cosmos and manifesting as the primordial sound-Brahman. You are the supreme reality, the divine power of Shiva and Shakti, and the source of eternal joy.
devanagari:
हे चिन्मयी साई जननी

शिव शक्तिमयी साई जननी
नित्यानन्दमयी साई जननी
respell:

title: Hey Deena Dayalu Hare Hare
lyrics:
Hey Deena Dayalu Hare Hare
Sri Ram Hare Hare
Sri Ram Jaya Ram Sai Ram
Hey Bandha Vimochana Rama Hare
Hey Rajeeva Lochana Rama Hare
Sri Ram Hare Hare
Sri Ram Jaya Ram Sai Ram
meaning: Oh Lord Rama, compassionate to the humble and downtrodden, we praise your divine name. You are the liberator from all worldly bonds, the beautiful lotus-eyed one. Victory to Sri Rama, our beloved Sai Rama!

श्री राम जय राम साई राम
respell:

lyrics:
Hey Deena Dayalu Sai Rama Ram

meaning: Oh Sai Rama, you are the compassionate one who cares for the humble and the distressed, and the supremely merciful one. You purify the fallen and shower boundless affection upon your devotees; we lovingly chant your sacred name.

title: Hey Govinda Hey Ananda Nanda Gopala
lyrics:

Mandara Giridhari Hare Natavara Lala
Madhava Keshava Madana Gopala
meaning: Oh Govinda, blissful cowherd son of Nanda, enchanting flute-player of dark complexion. You are the lifter of Mandara mountain, the playful dancer, Madhava, Keshava, the captivating Gopala.

lyrics:

आओ प्रभु आओ आओ [ मुझे आकर ... ]

title: Hey Indushekhara Raja Shivaraja Shankara
lyrics:
Hey Indushekhara Raja Shiva Raja Shankara
Hey Indushekhara Shambho Shiva Raja Shankara
Hey Hara Hara Shiva Shiva Pinaka Vaibhava Raja Shankara
Shiva Raja Shankara
meaning: Oh King Shankara, King Shiva, whose brow is adorned by the crescent moon, we invoke your auspicious presence. We hail your glorious majesty, Shambho, You who wield the mighty Pinaka bow.

lyrics:

meaning: "O Sathya Sai, embodiment of Lord Rama, You are the compassionate Lord with lotus-like eyes and the protector of the poor and helpless. You uplift those who seek You, guide them on the path of righteousness, and fill their lives with love, grace, and peace. We praise and remember Your holy name and seek Your blessings.

lyrics:
Hey Kamala Vadana Sai Ranga
Kaivalya Panduranga
Sai Gopala Ghana Ghana Neela
Kutila Kuntala Tribhuvana Pala
Brahma Vishnu Maheshwara Roopa
Maya Lola Brahma Swaroopa
meaning: Oh Lotus-faced Sai Ranga, you are Panduranga, the very essence of liberation. You are Sai Gopala, dark as dense clouds with curly locks, the protector of the three worlds. Embodiment of Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva, you are the supreme Brahman, delighting in the cosmic play of illusion.
devanagari:
हे कमल वदन साई रंगा
कैवल्य पांडुरंगा
साई गोपाला घन घन नीला
कुटिल कुंतला त्रिभुवन पाला
ब्रह्मा विष्णू महेश्वरा रूपा
माया लोला ब्रह्म स्वरूपा

lyrics:

Shyama Gopala Madana Gopala
Vitthala Jaya Panduranga Panduranga
meaning: Oh Krishna, Oh Krishna, we sing your glorious names! Victory to Vitthala, our beloved Panduranga. You are Nanda's youthful, dark-complexioned cowherd, the enchanting Gopala who steals all hearts.

lyrics:

Mathura Natha Madana Gopala
Nanda Mukunda Shyama Gopala

meaning: We lovingly call upon Krishna by his many names: Madhava, Govinda, and Gopala. He is the enchanting Lord of Mathura, Nanda's beloved son, and the dark-hued cowherd. Victory to Krishna, Hari Govinda!

lyrics:
Hey Madhava Yadu Nandana
Mana Mohana Hey Madhusudana
Janardana Radha Jeevana
Gopalana Gopi Ranjana
meaning: Oh Madhava, beloved son of the Yadu clan, you are the enchanter of all minds and the vanquisher of the demon Madhu. You are Janardana, the very life of Radha, the protector of cows, and the delight of the Gopis.

title: Hey Nirakari Allah Hey Avatari Prabhu Ram
lyrics:
Hey Nirakari Allah Hey Avatari Prabhu Ram
Janam Janam Mere Sath Raho Tum Sathya Sai Bhagawan
Nanak Yeshu Buddha Mahavir
Sab Hain Sai Bhagawan
Janam Janam Mere Sath Raho Tum Sathya Sai Bhagawan
meaning: O Sathya Sai, you are the formless Allah and the incarnate Ram, my eternal Mother, Father, and very breath of life. I pray for your constant presence through every lifetime, for you embody the divine essence of Nanak, Jesus, Buddha, and Mahavir.
devanagari:
हे निराकारी अल्लाह हे अवतारी प्रभु राम
जनम जनम मेरे साथ रहो तुम सत्य साईं भगवान [ हे निराकारी ... ]
तुम ही हमारे माता पिता साईं
तुम ही हमारे प्राण (राम) [ जनम जनम ... ]
नानक येसु बुद्ध महावीर
सब है साईं भगवान [ जनम जनम ... ]
respell:
He Nirākārī Allāh He Avatārī Prabhu Rām
Janam Janam Mere Sāth Raho Tum Satya Sāīṃ Bhagavān [ He Nirākārī ... ]
Tum Hī Hamāre Mātā pitā sāīṃ
Tum Hī Hamāre Prāṇ (rām) [ Janam janama ... ]
nānaka yesu buddha mahāvīr
sab hai sāīṃ bhagavān [ janama janama ... ]

title: Hey Parthipureesha Prasanthivasa Sai Murari
lyrics:
Hey Parthipureesha Prasanthivasa Sai Murari
Sai Murari Sai Murari Sai Murari Sai Murari
Hey Rishikesha Hridaya Nivasa Hridaya Nivasa
Sai Murari Sai Murari Sai Murari Sai Murari
meaning: O Sai Murari, Lord of Puttaparthi and embodiment of Lord Krishna, You are the source of peace and the ruler of our senses. Though worshipped in sacred places, You truly dwell in the hearts of all. Guide us, protect us, and fill our lives with Your love, peace, and divine presence.
devanagari:
हे पर्तिपुरीशा प्राशंती वासा साई मुरारी
साई मुरारी साई मुरारी साई मुरारी साई मुरारी [ हे पर्तिपुरीशा ... ]
हे हृषीकेशा हृदय निवासा हृदय निवासा [ साई मुरारी ... ]
respell:
He Partipurīshā Prāshantī Vāsā Sāī Murārī
Sāī Murārī Sāī Murārī Sāī Murārī Sāī Murārī [ He Partipurīshā ... ]
He Hṛushīkeshā Hṛudaya Nivāsā Hṛudaya Nivāsā [ Sāī Murārī ... ]

title: Hey Parthipureesha Prasanthivasa Sadguru Sairam
lyrics:
Hey Parthipureesha Prasanthivasa Sadguru Sairam
Sadguru Sai Ram (2)
Hare Ram Hare Ram Hare Ram Hare Ram
Hare Ram Sai Ram
Hey Anatha Natha Deena Bandho Sadguru Sai Ram
Sadguru Sai Ram
Hare Ram Hare Ram Hare Ram Hare Ram
Hare Ram Sai Ram
meaning: O Lord Sai, the sacred preceptor who dwells in Prasanthi Nilayam is the refuge of the forlorn. Repeat the name of Ram who is none other than Lord Sai.
devanagari:
हे पर्तीपुरीशा प्रसान्तिवासा सद्गुरु साईराम
सद्गुरु साई राम (2)
हरे राम हरे राम हरे राम हरे राम
हरे राम साई राम
हे अनाथ नाथा दीना बन्धो सद्गुरु साई राम
सद्गुरु साई राम
हरे राम हरे राम हरे राम हरे राम
हरे राम साई राम
respell:
He Partīpurīshā Prasāntivāsā Sadguru Sāīrām
Sadguru Sāī Rām (2)
Hare Rām Hare Rām Hare Rām Hare Rām
Hare Rām Sāī Rām
He Anātha Nāthā Dīnā Bandho Sadguru Sāī Rām
Sadguru Sāī Rām
Hare Rām Hare Rām Hare Rām Hare Rām
Hare Rām Sāī Rām

title: Hey Prasanthi Nilaya Ram Hey Parthipuri Bhagawan
lyrics:
Hey Prasanthi Nilaya Ram Hey Parthipuri Bhagawan
Ahalyoddharaka Ram He Dasharathe Raghu Ram
Sri Ram Jaya Ram
Sri Ram Ram Ram Jaya Ram
Sai Ram Ram Ram Sai Ram
meaning: Oh Lord Rama, divine resident of Prasanthi Nilayam and God of Puttaparthi, we praise You! You are the liberator of Ahalya, the noble son of King Dasharatha from the Raghu dynasty. All glory and victory to You, Sai Rama.
devanagari:
हे प्रशांति निलया राम हे पर्तीपूरी भगवान
अहल्योद्धारक राम हे दाशरथे रघु राम
श्री राम जय राम
श्री राम राम राम जय राम
साई राम राम राम साई राम
respell:
He Prashānti Nilayā Rām He Partīpūrī Bhagavān
Ahalyoddhārak Rām He Dāsharathe Raghu Rām
Shrī Rām Jaya Rām
Shrī Rām Rām Rām Jaya Rām
Sāī Rām Rām Rām Sāī Rām

title: Hey Ram Bhagawan
lyrics:
Hey Ram Bhagawan
Hey Karuna Sindhu Ram
Hey Deena Bandhu Sai Ram
Bhakta Premi O Karuna Karo
Daya Karo Bhagawan
Mujhe Kripa Karo Bhagawan
Hey Janaki Jeevana Ram
Hey Parthipureeshwara Ram
Hey Deena Bandhu Sai Ram
meaning: Oh Lord Rama, ocean of compassion and friend to the helpless, we earnestly seek your divine presence. Please, O beloved of devotees, bestow your mercy and grace upon us, for you are the very life of Janaki and the Lord of Puttaparthi.
devanagari:
हे राम भगवान
हे करुणा सिंधु राम
हे दीन बंधु साई राम
भक्त प्रेमी ओ करुणा करो
दया करो भगवान
मुझे कृपा करो भगवान
हे जानकी जीवन राम
हे पर्तीपुरीश्वर राम
हे दीन बंधु साई राम
respell:
He Rām Bhagavān
He Karuṇā Sindhu Rām
He Dīna Bandhu Sāī Rām
Bhakta Premī O Karuṇā Karo
Dayā Karo Bhagavān
Mujhe Kṛupā Karo Bhagavān
He Jānakī Jīvan Rām
He Partīpurīshwar Rām
He Dīna Bandhu Sāī Rām

title: Hey Ram Parthipureeshwara Ram
lyrics:
Hey Ram Parthipureeshwara Ram
Hey Ram Vaidehi Priya Ram
Hey Patita Pavana Sai Ram
Manimaya Bhushana Ram
Kausalyatmaja Ram
Ravana Mardana Ram
Pavana Putra Priya Ram
Hey Patita Pavana Sai Ram
meaning: Oh Lord Rama, son of Kausalya and beloved of Sita, You are the radiant Lord of Parthi, adorned with brilliant jewels. You vanquished Ravana, are dear to Hanuman, and purify all who are downtrodden, O Sai Ram.
devanagari:
हे राम पर्तिपूरीश्वर राम
हे राम वैदेही प्रिय राम
हे पातित पावन साई राम
मणिमय भूषण राम
कौसल्यात्मज राम
रावण मर्धन राम
पवन पुत्र प्रिय राम (हे) [ पतित पावन ... ]
respell:
He Rām Partipūrīshwar Rām
He Rām Vaidehī Priy Rām
He Pātita Pāvan Sāī Rām
Maṇimaya Bhūshaṇ Rām
Kausalyātmaja Rām
Rāvaṇ Mardhana Rām
Pavan Putra Priy Rām (he) [ Patita Pāvan ... ]

title: Hey Rama Doota Hey Rama Bhakta Hey Rama Dasa Namo Namo
lyrics:
Hey Rama Doota Hey Rama Bhakta Hey Rama Dasa Namo Namo
Sita Mata Shoka Vinasha
Anatha Natha Namo Namo
Maruti Raya Mahanubhava
Ati Balavanta Namo Namo
Veeranjaneya Namo Namo
meaning: Oh Hanuman, messenger, devotee, and servant of Lord Rama, we bow to you. You are the dispeller of Mother Sita's sorrow, the protector of the helpless, and the supremely mighty, noble Maruti.
devanagari:
हे राम दूता हे राम भक्ता हे राम दासा नमो नमो
सीता माता शोक विनाशा
अनाथ नाथा नमो नमो
मारुति राया महानुभावा
अति बलवंता (वीर अंजनेया) नमो नमो
respell:
He Rām Dūtā He Rām Bhaktā He Rām Dāsā Namo Namo
Sītā Mātā Shok Vināshā
Anātha Nāthā Namo Namo
Māruti Rāyā Mahānubhāvā
Ati Balavantā (vīr Añjaneyā) Namo Namo

title: Hey Rama Narayana
lyrics:
Hey Rama Narayana
Hare Krishna Janardana
Nityananda Brahmananda
Krishna Madhusudana
Hare Krishna Janardana
meaning: Oh Rama, divine Narayana, and Krishna, who removes the distress of all beings, we call upon you. You are the embodiment of eternal and supreme bliss, Krishna, the valiant slayer of the demon Madhu.
devanagari:
हे राम नारायणा
हरे कृष्ण जनार्दना [ हे राम ... ]
नित्यानंदा ब्रह्मानंदा
कृष्णा मधुसूदना [ हरे कृष्ण ... ]
respell:
He Rām Nārāyaṇā
Hare Kṛushṇa Janārdanā [ He Rām ... ]
Nityānandā Brahmānandā
Kṛushṇā Madhusūdanā [ Hare Kṛushṇa ... ]

title: Hey Sai Jagannatha Hey Sai Jagannatha Hey Sai Jagannatha
lyrics:
Hey Sai Jagannatha Hey Sai Jagannatha Hey Sai Jagannatha
Deena Bandhu Sai Natha Karuna Sindhu Jagannatha
Hey Sai Jagannatha Hey Sai Jagannatha
Hey Shirdi Jagannatha Hey Parthi Jagannatha Hey Sai Jagannatha
meaning: Oh Sai, Lord of the Universe, we invoke your divine presence! You are the compassionate friend to the helpless, an ocean of mercy, manifest in both Shirdi and Parthi.
devanagari:
हे साई जगन्नाथा हे साई जगन्नाथा हे साई जगन्नाथा  
दीन बंधु साई नाथा करुणा सिंधु जगन्नाथा  
हे साई जगन्नाथा हे साई जगन्नाथा  
हे शिर्डी जगन्नाथा हे पर्ति जगन्नाथा हे साई जगन्नाथा
respell:
He Sāī Jagannāthā He Sāī Jagannāthā He Sāī Jagannāthā
Dīna Bandhu Sāī Nāthā Karuṇā Sindhu Jagannāthā
He Sāī Jagannāthā He Sāī Jagannāthā
He Shirḍī Jagannāthā He Parti Jagannāthā He Sāī Jagannāthā

title: Hey Sai Ranga Hey Panduranga
lyrics:
Hey Sai Ranga Hey Panduranga
Karunantaranga Hridayantaranga
Sri Ranga Ranga Jaya Ranga Ranga
Ananda Ranga Sadananda Ranga
Karunantaranga Hridayantaranga
meaning: Oh Sai Ranga, Oh Panduranga, You are the very essence of compassion dwelling within our hearts. Glorious Lord, You are the embodiment of eternal joy and bliss.
devanagari:
हे साई रंगा हे पांडुरंगा
करुणांतरंगा हृदयांतरंगा [हे साई रंगा...]
श्री रंगरंगा जय रंगरंगा
आनंद रंगा सदानंद रंगा
करुणांतरंगा हृदयांतरंगा
respell:
He Sāī Raṅgā He Pāṇḍuraṅgā
Karuṇāntaraṅgā Hṛudayāntaraṅgā [he sāī raṅgā...]
Shrī Raṅgaraṅgā Jaya Raṅgaraṅgā
Ānanda Raṅgā Sadānanda Raṅgā
Karuṇāntaraṅgā Hṛudayāntaraṅgā

title: Hey Sesha Shayana Narayana
lyrics:
Hey Sesha Shayana Narayana
Vedabharana Narayana
Bhava Bhaya Harana Narayana
Pavana Charana Narayana
Sai Pavana Charana Narayana
--
Narayana Hari Narayana
Narayana Sai Narayana
meaning: Oh Narayana, divine Lord who rests upon the cosmic serpent Shesha and upholds the sacred Vedas. Your holy feet dispel the fear of worldly cycles, and we chant your pure name, Narayana Hari, Narayana Sai.
devanagari:
हे शेष शयन नारायणा
वेद भारणा नारायणा
भव भय हरणा नारायणा
पावन चरण नारायणा
नारायणा हरि (साई) नारायणा (3)
respell:
He Shesh Shayan Nārāyaṇā
Ved Bhāraṇā Nārāyaṇā
Bhava Bhaya Haraṇā Nārāyaṇā
Pāvan Charaṇ Nārāyaṇā
Nārāyaṇā Hari (sāī) Nārāyaṇā (3)

title: He Shiva Nandana Jaya Jagavandana
lyrics:
Hey Shiva Nandana Jaya Jagavandana
Jaya Gauri Suta Pahi Gajanana
Parvati Nandana Parama Dayaghana
Pahi Prabho Mam Pahi Gajanana
meaning: We praise Ganesha, the beloved son of Shiva and Gauri, worshipped throughout the cosmos. O elephant-faced Lord, born of Parvati, you embody profound compassion. Please grant me your divine protection.
devanagari:
हे शिव नंदन जय जग वंदन
जय गौरी सुत पाही गजानन
पार्वती नंदन परम दया घन
पाही प्रभो माम पाही गजानन
respell:
He Shiv Nandana Jaya Jaga Vandana
Jaya Gaurī Sut Pāhī Gajānana
Pārwatī Nandana Param Dayā Ghan
Pāhī Prabho Mām Pāhī Gajānana

title: Hey Shiva Shankara Namami Shankara Shiva Shankara Shambho
lyrics:
Hey Shiva Shankara Namami Shankara Shiva Shankara Shambho
Hey Girija Pathi Bhavani Shankara
Shiva Shankara Shambho
meaning: I bow to Lord Shiva, the benevolent Shankara, who embodies auspiciousness and brings joy. He is the divine consort of Girija and Bhavani, and I offer my heartfelt salutations to him.
devanagari:
हे शिव शंकर नमामि शंकर शिव शंकर शम्भो
हे गिरिजा पति भवानी शंकर
शिव शंकर शम्भो (3)
respell:
He Shiv Shaṅkar Namāmi Shaṅkar Shiv Shaṅkar Shambho
He Girijā Pati Bhavānī Shaṅkar
Shiv Shaṅkar Shambho (3)

title: Hey Shyama Sundara Hey Sai Sundara
lyrics:
Hey Shyama Sundara Hey Sai Sundara
Parthipureeshwara Hey Sai Sundara
Neela Megha Sundara Neeraja Lochana
Brahmanda Nayaka Hey Sai Sundara
meaning: Oh beautiful Sai, whose dark complexion is captivating, Lord of Parthi! Your eyes are like lotuses, your form as lovely as a dark cloud, and you are the supreme ruler of the entire universe.
devanagari:
हे श्याम सुंदरा हे साई सुंदरा
पर्ती पुरीश्वरा हे साई सुंदरा
[ हे श्याम ... ]  
नील मेघ सुंदरा नीरज लोचना  
ब्रह्मांड नायका हे साई सुंदरा
respell:
He Shyām Sundarā He Sāī Sundarā
Partī Purīshwarā He Sāī sundarā
[ He Shyām ... ]
Nīla Megha Sundarā Nīraj Lochanā
brahmāṇḍa nāyakā he sāī sundarā

title: Hey Vishwapala Gopala
lyrics:
Hey Viswapala Gopala 
Hey Deena Pala Gopala
Meera Ke Prabhu Giridhara Bala
Giridhara Bala Sai Gopala
meaning: Oh Gopala, you are the divine protector of the entire universe and the compassionate guardian of the humble. You are Meera's beloved Lord, the youthful one who lifted the mountain, and indeed, you are Sai Gopala.
devanagari:
हे विश्व पाला गोपाला
हे दीन पाला गोपाला
मीरा के प्रभु गिरिधर बाला
गिरिधर बाला साई गोपाला
respell:
He Vishwa Pālā Gopālā
He Dīna Pālā Gopālā
Mīrā Ke Prabhu Giridhara Bālā
Giridhara Bālā Sāī Gopālā

title: Hey Vishwanath Hey Gaurinath Hey Sai Nath Bhagawan
lyrics:
Hey Vishwanath Hey Gaurinath Hey Sai Nath Bhagawan
Daya Karo Daya Karo Daya Karo Bhagawan
Deena Dayala Sai Ghana Shyama
Patita Pavana Hey Sai Rama
Daya Karo Daya Karo Daya Karo Bhagawan
meaning: Oh Lord of the Universe, consort of Gowri, Oh Divine Sai, we earnestly pray for your mercy. You are the compassionate one to the humble, dark and beautiful like a rain cloud, and the purifier of all who have strayed. Bestow your grace upon us, Oh Sai Ram.
devanagari:
हे विश्वनाथ हे गौरी नाथ हे साई नाथ भगवान
दया करो दया करो दया करो भगवान [ हे विश्वनाथ ... ]
दीन दयाला साई घन श्यामा
पतित पावन हे साई राम [ दया करो ... ]
respell:
He Vishwanāth He Gaurī Nāth He Sāī Nāth Bhagavān
Dayā Karo Dayā Karo Dayā Karo Bhagavān [ He Vishwanāth ... ]
Dīna Dayālā Sāī Ghan Shyāmā
Patita Pāvan He Sāī Rām [ Dayā Karo ... ]

title: Heyramba Janani Sri Sai Janani
lyrics:
Heyramba Janani Sri Sai Janani
Bhavani Jagadambe Ma (2)
Tribhuvana Palini Hey Karunamayi
Uma Sharadamba (2)
Raksha Karo Sai Ma
meaning: Oh Mother of Ganesha, Divine Mother Sai, Bhavani, Mother of the Universe, we call upon you. Sustainer of the three worlds, embodiment of compassion, Uma, Sharada, please grant us your protection, Mother Sai.
devanagari:
हे रंभ जननी श्री साई जननी
भवानी जगदम्बे मा (2)
त्रिभुवन पालिनी हे करुणामयी
उमा शारदाम्बा (2)
रक्षा करो साई मा
respell:
He Rambh Jananī Shrī Sāī jananī
Bhavānī Jagadambe Mā (2)
Tribhuvan Pālinī He Karuṇāmayī
Umā Shāradāmbā (2)
Rakshā Karo Sāī Mā

title: Hum Sab Boley Namah Shivaya
lyrics:
Hum Sab Boley Namah Shivaya Hara Hara Hara Hara Mahadeva, Hara Hara Hara Hara Mahadeva
Terey Dhyan Mey Khoyen Hum Sab Nis Din Tera Bhajan Karoon
Hara Hara Hara Hara Mahadeva, Hara Hara Hara Hara Mahadeva
Tum Hi Badey Dayalu Ho Shankar Tum Hi Badey Krupalu
Sathya Sai Hai Naam Tumhara Jag Ke Tum Rakhwaley Ho [ Hara Hara ... ]
Namah Shivaya Namah Shivaya (8)

title: Hum Sab Milkar Mangal Gayein
lyrics:
Hum Sab Milkar Mangal Gayein
Sai Bhagawan Sathya Sai Bhagawan (2)
Sab Sukh Jeevan Sai Bhagawan
Sab Dukh Harana Sai Bhagawan
Sathya Swaroopa Sai Bhagawan
Hridaya Nivasa Sai Bhagawan
Parthi Nivasa Sai Bhagawan
--
Sai Bhagawan Sathya Sai Bhagawan
meaning: Let us all join together in singing the auspicious praise of Lord Sathya Sai. He is the divine source of all happiness, dispelling every sorrow, and the very embodiment of Truth, dwelling within our hearts and in Parthi.
devanagari:
हम सब मिलकर मंगल गायें
साई भगवान सत्य साई भगवान (2)
सब सुख जीवन साई भगवान
सब दुख हरणा साई भगवान
सत्य स्वरूपा साई भगवान
हृदय निवासा साई भगवान
पर्ति निवासा साई भगवान
respell:
Ham Sab Milakar Maṅgal Gāyeṃ
Sāī Bhagavān Satya Sāī Bhagavān (2)
Sab Sukh Jīvan Sāī Bhagavān
Sab Dukha Haraṇā Sāī Bhagavān
Satya Swarūpā Sāī Bhagavān
Hṛudaya Nivāsā Sāī Bhagavān
Parti Nivāsā Sāī Bhagavān

title: I bow down at the Feet of Ganesha
lyrics:
I bow down at the Feet of Ganesha
Ganesha Ganesha 
[ I bow down … ]
Ganesha, I Pray, You will clear my way (3)
Ganesha Ganesha 
[ I bow down … ]
Jai Ganesha, Sai Ganesha, clear my way to Baba
Jai Ganesha, Sai Ganesha, clear my way to Swami
Jai Ganesha, Sai Ganesha, clear my way to Baba
Ganesha Ganesha
meaning: I humbly bow at your divine feet, Lord Ganesha, earnestly praying that you clear all obstacles from my path. Hail Ganesha, beloved Sai Ganesha, please illuminate and smooth my spiritual journey towards the divine presence of Baba, my revered Swami.
devanagari:
I bow down at the Feet of Ganesha
Ganesha Ganesha 
[ I bow down … ]
Ganesha, I Pray, You will clear my way (3)
Ganesha Ganesha 
[ I bow down … ]
Jai Ganesha, Sai Ganesha, clear my way to Baba

Jai Ganesha, Sai Ganesha, clear my way to Baba
Ganesha Ganesha
respell:
I bow down at the Feet of Ganesha
Ganesha Ganesha

Ganesha, I Pray, You will clear my way (3)

[ I bow down … ]
Jai Ganesha, Sai Ganesha, clear my way to Baba

Ganesha Ganesha

title: I Keep Feeling Your Love
lyrics:
I Keep Feeling Your Love In Me Over And Over Again
And Its Sweeter And Sweeter As The Days Go By
Oh What A Love Between My Sai And I
My Sai And I, My Sai And I
meaning: I continually experience your divine love resonating within me, a feeling that deepens and becomes ever more precious with each passing day. This profound and beautiful bond between my Sai and me is truly incomparable.
devanagari:
आइ कीप फीलिङ योर लव इन मी ओवर अन्ड ओवर अगेन
अन्ड इट्स स्वीटर अन्ड स्वीटर ऐज द डेज गो बाइ
ओ वट अ लव बिट्वीन माइ साई अन्ड आइ
माइ साई अन्ड आइ माइ साई अन्ड आइ

title: I Will Love You More And More
lyrics:
I Will Love You More And More Each Day
I Will Love You Dear Sai Forever And A Day
I Will Sing My Lord
I Will Serve my lord
I Will Call Your Name Everyday
Aum Gam Ganapathi Vinayaka
Buddha Jesus Allah Allah
Guru Nanak Mahavira
Aum Sri Bhagawan Sai Natha
I Will Love You More And More Each Day
I Will Love You Dear Sai Forever And A Day
In My Heart My Lord
I Will Build My Lord
Prashanthi Just For you
I Will Fill My Heart With Love My Lord
If I Love All You Know My Love is True
devanagari:
आइ विल लव यू मोर अन्ड मोर ईच डे
आइ विल लव यू डिर साई फरएवर अन्ड अ डे
आइ विल सिङ माइ लोर्ड
आइ विल सरव माइ लोर्ड
आइ विल कोल योर नेम एव्रीडे
ॐ गम गनपथि विनायका
बुद्ध जीजस अल्लाह अल्लाह
गुरु नानक माहावीरा
ॐ श्री भगवान साई नाथा
आइ विल लव यू मोर अन्ड मोर ईच डे
आइ विल लव यू डिर साई फरएवर अन्ड अ डे
इन माइ हार्ट माइ लोर्ड
आइ विल बिल्ड माइ लोर्ड
प्रशांति जस्ट फोर यू
आइ विल फिल माइ हार्ट विद लव माइ लोर्ड
इफ आइ लव ओल यू नो माइ लव इज ट्रू

title: In the stillness of the morning
lyrics:
In the stillness of the morning, I listen for Your call, Bhagawan
Your touch upon my shoulder, Your presence in my soul, Sai
But when I turn to greet you, no other do I see, Bhagawan
For all my endless searching, I am the one I seek, Bhagawan
meaning: In the quiet dawn, the devotee yearns for a divine call and touch, sensing a profound spiritual presence. Yet, upon turning to greet this external form, they realize the ultimate truth: the God they endlessly search for is none other than their own inner self.
devanagari:
इन द स्टिल्नस अव द मोर्निङ आइ लिसन फोर योर कोल भगवान
योर टच अपान माइ शोल्डर योर प्रेजन्स इन माइ सोल साई
बट वेन आइ टरन टू ग्रीट यू नो अदर डू आइ सी भगवान
फोर ओल माइ एन्ड्लस सरचिङ आइ ऐम द वन आइ सीक भगवान

title: Jagadambe Devi Bhavani
lyrics:
Jagadambe Devi Bhavani
Jaganmatey Shakti Durge
Kumara Gananathamba Kalyani Shyamalamba
Janani Durge Varadey Mata
Uma Maheshwari Kalavati
Jaganmatey Shakti Durge
meaning: Oh Jagadambe Bhavani, Divine Mother of the universe, powerful Durga! You are the auspicious Kalyani, the dark Shyamala, the mother of Kumara and Gananatha. Beloved Mother Durga, bestower of boons, Uma Maheshwari, and embodiment of all arts, we invoke your sacred names.
devanagari:
जगदम्बे देवी भवानी
जगन्माते शक्ति दुर्गे (2) [ जगदम्बे ... ]
कुमार गणनाथाम्बा कल्याणी श्यामालाम्बा
जननी दुर्गे वरदे माता
(अम्बा) उमा महेश्वरी कलावती [ जगन्माते ... ]
respell:
Jagadambe Devī Bhavānī
Jaganmāte Shakti Durge (2) [ Jagadambe ... ]
Kumāra Gaṇanāthāmbā Kalyāṇī Shyāmālāmbā
Jananī Durge Varade Mātā
(ambā) Umā Maheshwarī Kalāvatī [ Jaganmāte ... ]

title: Jagadashraya Sri Raghu Rama
lyrics:
Jagadashraya Sri Raghu Rama
Jagadoddhara Sita Rama
Parama Pavana Taraka Nama
Sri Rama Shata Koti Pranama
Sai Rama Koti Pranama
Sharanam Sharanam Atma Rama
meaning: Oh Lord Rama, the very support and uplifter of the universe, accompanied by Sita, your supremely pure name is the liberator. We offer countless salutations to you, Sri Rama and Sai Rama, and surrender completely to you, the divine indweller of our soul.
devanagari:
जगदाश्रय श्री रघु रामा
जगतोद्धारा सीता रामा [ जगदाश्रय श्री ... ]  
परम पावन तारक नामा
श्री रामा शत कोटि प्रणामा
साई रामा कोटि प्रणामा
शरणम् शरणम् आत्म रामा
respell:
Jagadāshray Shrī Raghu Rāmā
Jagatoddhārā Sītā Rāmā [ Jagadāshray Shrī ... ]
Param Pāvan Tārak Nāmā
Shrī Rāmā Shat Koṭi Praṇāmā
Sāī Rāmā Koṭi Praṇāmā
Sharaṇam Sharaṇam Ātma Rāmā

title: Jagadeesha Hare Jaya Ho
lyrics:
Jagadeesha Hare Jaya Ho
Jagadoddhara Jaya Jaya Ho
Allah Yeshu Nanak Sai
Antaryami Buddha Mahavira
Zoroastra Sarva Dharma Priya Deva
Prasanthi Nivasa Sathya Sai Deva
Jaya Ho Jaya Ho
meaning: Hail to the Lord of the Universe, the world's redeemer! This divine presence is recognized across faiths as Allah, Jesus, Nanak, Buddha, Mahavira, and Zoroaster, dwelling within all hearts. We celebrate Sathya Sai, the embodiment of this universal God who loves all religions and resides in the abode of peace.
devanagari:
जगदीशा हरे जय हो
जगतोद्धारा जय जय हो [ जगदीशा हरे ... ]
अल्लाह येसु नानक साईं
अंतर्यामी बुद्ध महावीर
झोराष्ट्र सर्व धर्म प्रिय देवा
शांति निवास सत्य साईं देवा (प्र)
जय हो जय हो (२)
respell:
Jagadīshā Hare Jaya Ho
Jagatoddhārā Jaya Jaya Ho [ Jagadīshā Hare ... ]
Allāh Yesu Nānak Sāīṃ
Antaryāmī Buddha Mahāvīr
Jhorāshṭra Sarwa Dharma Priy Devā
Shānti Nivās Satya Sāīṃ Devā (pra)
Jaya Ho Jaya Ho (2)

title: Jagadeesha Hare He Shiva Shambho
lyrics:
Jagadeesha Harey Shiva Shambho
Samba Shiva Hara Sai Shiva
Hey Tripurari Bhava Bhaya Haari
Parthi Pureeshwara Shiva Shambho [ Samba Shiva ... ]
meaning: Oh Shiva, Lord of the Universe, the benevolent Shambho, You are Samba Shiva, the remover of all suffering, manifest as Sai. Great Destroyer of Tripura, You dispel the fear of worldly existence, O Lord of Parthi.
devanagari:
जगदीशा हरे हे शिव शम्भो
साम्ब शिवा हर साई शिवा
हे त्रिपुरारी भव भय हारी
पर्तिपूरीश्वर शिव शम्भो [साम्ब शिव ...]
respell:
Jagadīshā Hare He Shiv shambho
Sāmba Shivā Har Sāī Shivā
He Tripurārī Bhava Bhaya Hārī
Partipūrīshwar Shiv Shambho [sāmb shiv ...]

title: Jagadeeshwari Daya Karo Ma
lyrics:
Jagadeeshwari Daya Karo Ma
Shiva Shankari Kripa Karo Ma
Sayeeshwari Raksha Karo Ma
Partheeshwari Bhala Karo Ma
Shiva Shankari Kripa Karo Ma
meaning: Oh Mother, Divine Ruler of the cosmos, please shower us with your boundless compassion. Beloved Shankari, consort of Shiva, we seek your benevolent grace and protection, Sayeeshwari, as you, the Goddess of Parthi, guide us towards all good fortune.
devanagari:
जगदीश्वरी दया करो मा
शिव शंकरी कृपा करो मा
साईश्वरी रक्षा करो मा
पर्तीश्वरी भला करो मा [ शिव शंकरी ... ]
respell:
Jagadīshwarī Dayā Karo Mā
Shiv Shaṅkarī Kṛupā Karo Mā
Sāīshwarī Rakshā Karo Mā
Partīshwarī Bhalā Karo Mā [ Shiv Shaṅkarī ... ]

title: Jagadeeshwari Jaya Mata Bhavani
lyrics:
Jagadeeshwari Jaya Mata Bhavani
Karunya Lavanya Akhilandeshwari
Hey Shiva Shankari Triloka Palini
Sharanagata Paripalini Mata
meaning: Oh Mother Bhavani, victorious Goddess of the universe, You are the compassionate and beautiful ruler of all creation. As Shiva's divine consort, You are the guardian of the three realms, the Mother who unfailingly protects all who seek refuge in You.
devanagari:
जगदीश्वरी जय माता भवानी
कारुण्य लावण्य अखिलांडेश्वरी
हे शिव शंकरी त्रिलोक पालिनी
शरणागत परिपालिनी माता
respell:
Jagadīshwarī Jaya Mātā Bhavānī
Kāruṇya Lāvaṇya Akhilāṇḍeshwarī
He Shiv Shaṅkarī Trilok Pālinī
Sharaṇāgat Paripālinī Mātā

title: Jagadoddharini Mata Durga Jagadoddharini Ma
lyrics:
Jagadoddharini Mata Durga Jagadoddharini Ma
Jago Jago Ma Jago Jago Ma Jago Jago Ma Janani
Hey Durga Devi Rana Chandi Devi He Shiva Ramana Jago Ma
Hey Shiva Ramana Jago Ma
Jago Jagadoddharini Ma
meaning: Oh Mother Durga, uplifter of the universe, we earnestly call for your awakening. In your forms as gentle Gauri and fierce Chandi, beloved of Shiva, please arise and enlighten us.
devanagari:
जगतोद्धारिणी माता दुर्गा जगतोद्धारिणी माँ
जागो जागो माँ जागो जागो माँ जागो जागो मा जननी
हे दुर्गा देवी रण चंडी देवी हे शिव रमणा जागो माँ
हे शिव रमणा जागो माँ
जागो जगतोद्धारिणी माँ
respell:
Jagatoddhāriṇī Mātā Durgā Jagatoddhāriṇī Mām̐
Jāgo Jāgo Mām̐ Jāgo Jāgo Mām̐ Jāgo Jāgo Mā Jananī
He Durgā Devī Raṇ Chaṇḍī Devī He Shiv Ramaṇā Jāgo Mām̐
He Shiv Ramaṇā Jāgo Mām̐
Jāgo Jagatoddhāriṇī Mām̐

title: Jagame Sarvam Vishnu Mayam
lyrics:
Jagame Sarvam Vishnu Mayam
Sadguru Sri Sathya Sai Mayam
Omkara Nada Mayam
Om Shiva Shakti Mayam
Prema Mayam Sai Nama Mayam
Pranavakara Brahma Mayam
meaning: All existence is permeated by the divine essence of Vishnu, manifest in our Sadguru Sri Sathya Sai. It resonates with the primordial sound of Om, embodying the sacred energy of Shiva-Shakti, and is filled with boundless love, echoing the name of Sai, the very form of Pranava and ultimate Brahman.
devanagari:
जगमे सर्वम् विष्णु मयम्
सद्गुरु श्री सत्य साई मयम्
ॐकार नाद मयम्
ॐ शिव शक्ति मयम्
प्रेम मायम् साई नाम मयम्
प्रणवाकारा ब्रह्म मयम्
respell:
Jagame Sarwam Vishṇu Mayam
Sadguru Shrī Satya Sāī Mayam
Oṃkār Nāda Mayam
Oṃ Shiv Shakti Mayam
Prem Māyam Sāī Nāma Mayam
Praṇavākārā Brahma Mayam

title: Jaganmate Jagat Janani
lyrics:
Jaganmate Jagat Janani
Jaya Jagadambe Devi Bhavani
Devi Saraswati Durga Lakshmi
Mahishasura Samharini Mata
meaning: Hail to the Universal Mother, the divine creator and sustainer of all existence. You manifest as Saraswati, Durga, and Lakshmi, the powerful Goddess who vanquished the demon Mahishasura.
devanagari:
जगन्माते जगत जननी
जय जगदम्बे देवी भवानी
देवी सरस्वती दुर्गा लक्ष्मी
महिषासुर संहारिणी माता
respell:
Jaganmāte Jagat Jananī
Jaya Jagadambe Devī Bhavānī
Devī Saraswatī Durgā Lakshmī
Mahishāsur Saṃhāriṇī Mātā

title: Jagat Janani Shiva Sai Shankari
lyrics:
Jagat Janani Shiva Sai Shankari
Mata Maheshwari Parvati Ma
Abhaya Pradayini Gana Vinodini
Mata Bhavani Ma Jaya Ma
Jaya Ma Jaya Ma
Kali Kapalini Ma
meaning: Oh Divine Mother, creator of the universe, you are Shankari, Maheshwari, and Parvati. You bestow fearlessness upon us, delight in our devotional songs, and manifest as the powerful Kali Kapalini. Victory to you, Bhavani Ma!
devanagari:
जगत् जननी शिव साई शङ्करी
माता महेश्वरी पार्वती माँ
अभय प्रदायिनी गान विनोदिनी
माता भवानी मा जय माँ
जय मा जय माँ
काली कपालिनी माँ
respell:
Jagat Jananī Shiv Sāī Shaṅkarī
Mātā Maheshwarī Pārwatī Mām̐
Abhaya Pradāyinī Gān Vinodinī
Mātā Bhavānī Mā Jaya Mām̐
Jaya Mā Jaya Mām̐
Kālī Kapālinī Mām̐

title: Jagat Palana Jaganmohana
lyrics:
Jagat Palana Jaganmohana
Sundara Sai Gopalana
Munijana Sevitha Madhusudhana [ Jagat Palana ... ]
Keshava Govinda Janardhana
Sridhara Madhava Damodara
Achyutha Anantha Narayana
Sri Sai Krishna Narayana (2) [ Munijana Sevitha ... ]
devanagari:
जगत पालना जगन्मोहना
सुंदर साई गोपालना  
मुनिजन सेवित मधुसूदना [ जगत पालना ... ]
केशवा गोविन्द जनार्दना
श्रीधरा माधवा दामोदरा
अच्युता अनन्ता नारायणा
श्री साई कृष्णा नारायणा (2) [ मुनिजन सेवित ... ]
respell:
Jagat Pālanā Jaganmohanā
Sundara Sāī Gopālanā
Munijana Sevit Madhusūdanā [ Jagat Pālanā ... ]
Keshavā Govinda Janārdanā
Shrīdharā Mādhavā Dāmodarā
Achyutā Anantā Nārāyaṇā
Shrī Sāī Kṛushṇā Nārāyaṇā (2) [ Munijana Sevit ... ]

title: Jagata Uddharana Parthi Viharana
lyrics:
Jagata Uddharana Parthi Viharana
Tum Ho Mangala Dham (Prabhu)
Jai Sai Ram Jai Sai Ram
Paapa Vimochana Bhava Bhaya Bhanjana
Sundara Nayanabhi Ram [ (Baba) Tum Ho ... ]
Jai Sai Ram Jai Sai Ram
meaning: O Sai Ram, you are the world's redeemer, dwelling in Parthi, and the very fount of all blessings. You free us from sin and conquer the fear of the cycle of existence, appearing as the beautiful-eyed Ram. Victory to Sai Ram!
devanagari:
जगतोद्धारण पर्ती विहारण
तुम हो मंगल धाम (प्रभु)
जय साई राम जय साई राम
पाप विमोचन भव भय भंजन
सुंदर नयनभि राम [(बाबा) तुम हो ...]
जय साई राम जय साई राम
respell:
Jagatoddhāraṇ Partī Vihāraṇ
Tum Ho Maṅgal Dhām (prabhu)
Jay Sāī Rām Jay Sāī Rām
Pāpa Vimochana Bhava Bhaya Bhañjana
Sundara Nayanabhi Rām [(bābā) tuma Ho ...]
Jay Sāī Rām Jay Sāī Rām

title: Jagatpate Hari Sai Gopala
lyrics:
Jagatpathey Hari Sai Gopala
Jagadodhara Sai Nandalala
Mathuradhipathey Krishna Gopala
Madhura Madhura Hey Gaana Vilola
Jagadodhara Sai Nandalala
Sai Nandalala Jai Jai Gopala (3)
meaning: Oh Lord Gopala, Sai, you are the master and uplifter of the entire universe, the beloved son of Nanda. You are Krishna, the ruler of Mathura, who delights in sweet melodies. Victory to you, Sai Nandalala!
devanagari:
जगत्पते हरि साई गोपाला
जगतोद्धारा साई नंदलाला
मथुराधिपते कृष्ण गोपाला
मधुर मधुर हे गान विलोला
जगतोद्धारा साई नंदलाला
साई नंदलाला जय जय गोपाला (3)
respell:
Jagatpate Hari Sāī Gopālā
Jagatoddhārā Sāī Nandalālā
Mathurādhipate Kṛushṇa Gopālā
Madhura Madhura He Gān Vilolā
Jagatoddhārā Sāī Nandalālā
Sāī Nandalālā Jay Jay Gopālā (3)

title: Jago Jago Jago Shankara
lyrics:
Jago Jago Jago Shankara
Jago Jago Sayeeshwara
Halaahala dhara Hey Paramesha
Hey Tripurari Jaya Partheesha
Gangadhara Shankara
Gowri vara Shankara
Jaya Gangadhara Shankara
Jaya Sayeeshwara Shankara
Sathya Sayeeshwara Shankara
meaning: Awaken, awaken, O Lord Shankara, awaken, O Sayeeshwara! O Supreme Lord, who bore the cosmic poison and holds the sacred Ganga, O Destroyer of Tripura and beloved consort of Gowri, we hail You as the victorious Lord of Parthi, Sathya Sayeeshwara.
devanagari:
जागो जागो जागो शंकरा
जागो जागो साईश्वरा
हालाहलधर हे परमेशा
हे त्रिपुरारी जय पर्तीशा
गंगाधरा शंकरा
गौरीवरा शंकरा
जय गंगाधरा शंकरा
जय साईश्वरा शंकरा
सत्य साईश्वरा शंकरा
respell:
Jāgo Jāgo Jāgo Shaṅkarā
Jāgo Jāgo Sāīshwarā
Hālāhaladhara He Parameshā
He Tripurārī Jaya Partīshā
Gaṅgādharā Shaṅkarā
Gaurīvarā Shaṅkarā
Jaya Gaṅgādharā Shaṅkarā
Jaya Sāīshwarā Shaṅkarā
Satya Sāīshwarā Shaṅkarā

title: Jai Durga Lakshmi Saraswati Sai Jaganmata
lyrics:
Jai Durga Lakshmi Saraswati Sai Jaganmata
Sai Jaganmata Mam Pahi Jaganmata
meaning: Hail to Durga, Lakshmi, Saraswati, and Sai, O Divine Mother of the entire universe! Sai, Universal Mother, I earnestly implore you, please safeguard me.
devanagari:
जय दुर्गा लक्ष्मी सरस्वती साई जगन्माता  
साई जगन्माता माम पाहि जगन्माता (2)
respell:
Jay Durgā Lakshmī Saraswatī Sāī Jaganmātā
Sāī Jaganmātā Mām Pāhi Jaganmātā (2)

title: Jai Ganaraya Sri Ganaraya
lyrics:
Jai Ganaraya Sri Ganaraya
Jai Ganaraya Sri Ganaraya Mangala Murti Moreya
Sindura Vadana Pankaja Charana
Sindura Vadana Pankaja Charana Mangala Murti Moreya
Siddhi Vinayaka Mangala Data
Siddhi Vinayaka Mangala Dayaka Mangala Murti Moreya
Ashta Vinayaka Mangala Dayaka Mangala Murti Moreya
meaning: This bhajan joyfully celebrates Lord Ganesha, hailing him as the embodiment of auspiciousness and the bestower of success and blessings. Devotees invoke his various forms, praising his vermillion-hued face and lotus feet with the traditional chant "Moriya."
devanagari:
जय गणराया श्री गणराया  
जय गणराया श्री गणराया मंगल मूर्ति मोरया  
सिद्धि विनायक मंगल दाता  
अष्ट विनायक मंगल दायक मंगला मूर्ति मोरया  
सिंधुरा वदना पंकज चरणा  
सिंधुरा वदना पंकज चरणा गणपति बप्पा मोरया
respell:
Jay Gaṇarāyā Shrī Gaṇarāyā
Jay Gaṇarāyā Shrī Gaṇarāyā Maṅgal Mūrti Morayā
Siddhi Vināyak Maṅgal Dātā
Ashṭa Vināyak Maṅgal Dāyak Maṅgalā Mūrti Morayā
Sindhurā Vadanā Paṅkaj Charaṇā
Sindhurā Vadanā Paṅkaj Charaṇā Gaṇapati Bappā Morayā

title: Jai Ganesha Pahi Mam Sri Ganesha Raksha Mam
lyrics:
Jai Ganesha Pahi Mam Sri Ganesha Raksha Mam
Jai Ganesh Jai Ganesh Jai Ganesha Raksha Mam
Lambodara Gauri Suta Jai Ganesha Paahi Mam
Mangalakara Sankatahara Jai Ganesha Raksha Mam
Jai Ganesh Jai Ganesh Jai Ganesha Raksha Mam
meaning: Victory to you, Lord Ganesha! O large-bellied son of Mother Gauri, please protect and save me. You are the bestower of all auspiciousness and the remover of every trouble.
devanagari:
जय गणेश पाहि माम श्री गणेश रक्ष माम  
जय गणेश जय गणेश जय गणेश रक्ष माम  
लंबोदर गौरी सुत जय गणेश पाहि माम  
मंगल कार संकट हरा जय गणेश रक्ष माम [ जय गणेश जय गणेश ...]
respell:
Jay Gaṇesha Pāhi Mām Shrī Gaṇesha Raksha Mām
Jay Gaṇesh Jay Gaṇesh Jay Gaṇesha Raksha Mām
Lambodara Gaurī Sut Jay Gaṇesha Pāhi Mām
Maṅgal Kār Saṅkaṭ Harā Jay Gaṇesha Raksha Mām [ Jay Gaṇesh Jay Gaṇesh ...]

title: Jai Hari Bol Jai Sita Ram Gopi Gopala Bhajo Radhe Shyam
lyrics:
Jai Hari Bol Jai Sita Ram Gopi Gopala Bhajo Radhe Shyam
Hare Ram Ram Ram Ghana Shyam Shyam Shyam
Sri Raghu Nandana Sri Rama Dasharathe Jaya Raghu Rama
Nanda Kishora Navaneeta Chora Brindavana Govinda Lala
Hare Ram Ram Ram Ghana Shyam Shyam Shyam
meaning: Chant the divine names of lord Krishna(very life of Gopikas) and lord Rama, the divine consort of mother Sita. Lord Rama brought glory to his father Dasharatha and sanctified the Raghu dynasty. Lord Krishna stole butter (the very lives of gopis) and sanctified the entire Vrindavan.
devanagari:
जय हरि बोल जय सीता राम गोपी गोपाल भजो राधे श्याम
हरे राम राम राम घन श्याम श्याम श्याम
श्री रघु नंदन श्री रामा दाशरथे जय रघु रामा
नंद किशोरा नवनीत चोरा वृंदावन गोविंद लाला [ हरे राम राम ... ]
respell:
Jay Hari Bol Jay Sītā Rām Gopī Gopāla Bhajo Rādhe Shyām
Hare Rām Rām Rām Ghan Shyām Shyām Shyām
Shrī Raghu Nandana Shrī Rāmā Dāsharathe Jaya Raghu Rāmā
Nanda Kishorā Navanīta Chorā Vṛundāvan Govind Lālā [ Hare Rām Rām ... ]

title: Jai Hari Krishna Jai Hari Krishna Govardhana Giridhari
lyrics:
Jai Hari Krishna Jai Hari Krishna Govardhana Giridhari
Radha Jeevana Radha Mohana
Manjula Kunja Vihari
Jaya Manjula Kunja Vihari
meaning: Glory to Lord Krishna, the lifter of Govardhan Hill. He is Radha's very life and enchanter, who delights in wandering through the beautiful groves of Vrindavan.
devanagari:
जय हरि कृष्णा जय हरि कृष्णा गोवर्धन गिरिधारी
राधा जीवन राधा मोहन
मंजुल कुंज विहारी
respell:
Jay Hari Kṛushṇā Jay Hari Kṛushṇā Govardhana Giridhārī
Rādhā Jīvan Rādhā Mohan
Mañjula Kuñj Vihārī

title: Jai Jai Bhavani Ma Ambe Bhavani Ma
lyrics:
Jai Jai Bhavani Ma Ambe Bhavani Ma
Ambe Bhavani Ma Sai Bhavani Ma
Shirdi Nivasi Ma Parthi Nivasi Ma
Hridaya Nivasi Ma Sai Bhavani Ma
meaning: Oh glorious Mother Bhavani, victorious Ambe, we celebrate your divine presence! You are the very essence of Sai, dwelling in the sacred abodes of Shirdi and Parthi, and eternally residing within the sanctuary of our hearts.
devanagari:
जय जय भवानी मा अम्बे भवानी मा
अम्बे भवानी मा साई भवानी मा [ जय जय भवानी ... ]
शिर्डी निवासी मा पर्ती निवासी मा
हृदय निवासी मा अम्बे (साई) भवानी मा
respell:
Jay Jay Bhavānī Mā Ambe Bhavānī Mā
Ambe Bhavānī Mā Sāī Bhavānī Mā [ Jay Jay Bhavānī ... ]
Shirḍī Nivāsī Mā Partī Nivāsī Mā
Hṛudaya Nivāsī Mā Ambe (sāī) Bhavānī Mā

title: Jai Jai Gopala
lyrics:
Jai Jai Gopala
Sai Gopala Shyama Gopala [ Jai Jai ... ]
Hey Nandalala Gopi Lola Gokula Bala
Brindavana Sanchara [ Sai Gopala ... ]
meaning: Victory to Gopala, the divine cowherd! We celebrate Sai Gopala, the dark-hued Lord, who is Nanda's beloved child, the delight of the Gopis, and the one who roams through the sacred land of Brindavan.
devanagari:
जय जय गोपाला
साई गोपाला श्याम गोपाला [ जय जय ... ]
हे नंदलाला गोपी लोला गोकुल बाला
ब्रिंदावन संचारा [ साई गोपाला ... ]
respell:
Jay Jay Gopālā
Sāī Gopālā Shyām Gopālā [ Jay Jay ... ]
He Nandalālā Gopī Lolā Gokul Bālā
Brindāvan Sañchārā [ Sāī Gopālā ... ]

title: Jai Jai Guru Deva Sri Sai Mahadeva
lyrics:
Jai Jai Guru Deva Sri Sai Mahadeva (3)
Brahma Vishnu Maheshwara Sai Mahadeva
Mata Pita Guru Deva Sri Sai Mahadeva
meaning: Glory to the revered preceptor Mahadeva, who is the embodiment of Mother, Father, Preceptor and the Trinity Brahma, Vishnu and Maheshwara.
devanagari:
जय जय गुरु देवा श्री साई महादेवा (3)
ब्रह्मा विष्णु महेश्वरा साई महादेवा
मात पिता गुरु देवा श्री साई महादेवा
respell:
Jay Jay Guru Devā Shrī Sāī Mahādevā (3)
Brahmā Vishṇu Maheshwarā Sāī Mahādevā
Māta Pitā Guru Devā Shrī Sāī Mahādevā

title: Jai Jai Hanuman Jaya Hanuman
lyrics:
Jai Jai Hanuman Jaya Hanuman
Maruti Raya Jaya Hanuman
Mahanubhava Jaya Hanuman
Vayu Kumara Jaya Hanuman
Vanara Veera Jaya Hanuman
Anjani Putra Jaya Hanuman
Ati Balavanta Jaya Hanuman
Sri Ramadoota Jaya Hanuman
Sri Rama Bhakta Jaya Hanuman
meaning: Victory to Hanuman, the mighty son of Vayu and Anjani! O great soul, valiant warrior, and supremely powerful one, you are the devoted messenger of Lord Rama.
devanagari:
जय जय हनुमान जय हनुमान
मारुती राया जय हनुमान
महानुभावा जय हनुमान
वायु कुमारा जय हनुमान
वानर वीरा जय हनुमान
अंजनी पुत्रा जय हनुमान
अति बलवंता जय हनुमान
श्री रामदूता जय हनुमान
श्री राम भक्ता जय हनुमान
respell:
Jay Jay Hanumān Jaya Hanumān
Mārutī Rāyā Jaya Hanumān
Mahānubhāvā Jaya Hanumān
Vāyu Kumārā Jaya Hanumān
Vānara Vīrā Jaya Hanumān
Añjanī Putrā Jaya Hanumān
Ati Balavantā Jaya Hanumān
Shrī Rāmadūtā Jaya Hanumān
Shrī Rām Bhaktā Jaya Hanumān

title: Jai Jai Jai Gananayaka Jai Jai Vighna Vinashaka
lyrics:
Jai Jai Jai Gananayaka Jai Jai Vighna Vinashaka
Jaya Shubha Mangala Dayaka Vidya Buddhi Pradayaka
Gajavadana Gauri Nandana
Gangadhara Shiva Shambho Nandana
meaning: Hail to Ganesha, the revered leader of Shiva's celestial hosts and the remover of all obstacles. He is the bestower of auspiciousness, wisdom, and intellect. This elephant-faced deity is the beloved son of Gauri and Shiva, the benevolent one who bears the Ganga.
devanagari:
जय जय जय गणनायका जय जय विघ्न विनाशका
जय शुभ मंगल दायका विद्या बुद्धि प्रदायका
गजवदना गौरी नंदन (2)
गंगाधर शिव शंभो नंदन
respell:
Jay Jay Jay Gaṇanāyakā Jay Jay Vighna Vināshakā
Jaya Shubh Maṅgal Dāyakā Vidyā Buddhi Pradāyakā
Gajavadanā Gaurī Nandana (2)
Gaṅgādhara Shiv Shambho Nandana

title: Jai Jai Jai Jai Ganapati Deva
lyrics:
Jai Jai Jai Jai Ganapati Deva
Mata Parvathi Pitha Mahadeva
Gajanana Gajanana
Gajanana Hey Ganapati Deva
meaning: Victory, victory to you, Lord Ganapati! Your divine mother is Parvati and your father is the great Lord Mahadeva. O elephant-faced one, we joyfully praise you, Lord Ganapati!
devanagari:
जय जय जय जय गणपति देवा (३)
माता पार्वती पिता महादेवा (२)
[ जय जय ... ]
गजानना गजानना
गजानना हे गणपति देवा
respell:
Jay Jay Jay Jay Gaṇapati Devā (3)
Mātā Pārwatī Pitā Mahādevā (2)
[ Jaya jaya ... ]
Gajānanā Gajānanā
gajānanā he gaṇapati devā

title: Jai Jai Jai Mana Mohana Jai Jai Jai Madhusudana
lyrics:
Jai Jai Jai Mana Mohana Jai Jai Jai Madhusudana
Madava Keshava
Keshava Madhava
Gopala Gopalana
meaning: Oh Lord Krishna, enchanter of all hearts, we sing Your glorious victory! You are Madhusudana, the vanquisher of evil, and known by the divine names of Madhava, Keshava, and Gopala. We celebrate You, the protector of the universe.
devanagari:
जय जय जय मना मोहना जय जय जय मधुसूदना
माधवा केशवा
केशवा माधवा
गोपाला गोपालना
respell:
Jay Jay Jay Manā Mohanā Jay Jay Jay Madhusūdanā
Mādhavā Keshavā
Keshavā Mādhavā
Gopālā Gopālanā

title: Jai Jai Jai Narayana
lyrics:
Jai Jai Jai Narayana
Govinda Gopala Narayana
Mukunda Madhava Narayana
Sri Krishna Govinda Narayana
Narayana Sathya Narayana
meaning:
Victory to the Lord who is Himself the pathway to ultimate destination for humanity.
He is the divine protector and the breath of Vedas. 
He is praised in various names and forms: Giver of liberation (Mukunda), destroyer of ignorance (Madhava), supreme attractor (Krishna) and ultimate  truth of existence (Sathya)
devanagari:
जय जय जय नारायणा
गोविंद गोपाल नारायणा
मुकुंद माधव नारायणा
श्री कृष्ण गोविन्द नारायणा
नारायणा सत्य नारायणा
respell:
Jay Jay Jay Nārāyaṇā
Govind Gopāla Nārāyaṇā
Mukund Mādhava Nārāyaṇā
Shrī Kṛushṇa Govinda Nārāyaṇā
Nārāyaṇā Satya Nārāyaṇā

title: Jai Jai Janani Sai Janani Ambe Bhavani Ma
lyrics:
Jai Jai Janani Sai Janani Ambe Bhavani Ma
Jaya Ma Jaya Ma
Sai Bhavani Ma
Sathya Sai Bhavani Ma
Simhavahini Trishula Dharini Ambe Bhavani Ma
Jai Jai Janani Sai Janani Parthi Nivasini Ma
Jaya Ma Jaya Ma
Sai Bhavani Ma
meaning: Oh Divine Mother Sai, Ambe Bhavani, victory to you! You are the lion-rider, the trident-wielder, the very essence of Sathya Sai. Residing in Parthi, we ceaselessly praise your glorious form.
devanagari:
जय जय जननी साई जननी अम्बे भवानी माँ
जय माँ जय माँ
साई भवानी माँ (सत्य)
सिंह वाहिनी त्रिशूल धारिणी अम्बे भवानी माँ
जय जय जननी साई जननी पर्ती निवासिनी माँ
जय माँ जया माँ [ साई भवानी ... ]
respell:
Jay Jay Jananī Sāī Jananī Ambe Bhavānī Mām̐
Jaya Mām̐ Jaya Mām̐
Sāī Bhavānī Mām̐ (satya)
Siṃh Vāhinī Trishūl Dhāriṇī Ambe Bhavānī Mām̐
Jay Jay Jananī Sāī Jananī Partī Nivāsinī Mām̐
Jaya Mām̐ Jayā Mām̐ [ Sāī Bhavānī ... ]

title: Jai Jai Prabhu Giridhari Natavara Nandalala
lyrics:
Jai Jai Prabhu Giridhari Natavara Nandalala
Natavara Nandalala Hey Giridhara Gopala
Hey Giridhara Gopala Hey Giridhara Gopala Hey Giridhara Gopala
meaning: Hail, Lord Giridhari, the supreme dancer and beloved son of Nanda! Oh Giridhara Gopala, you who lifted the mountain and protect all beings, we continuously call upon your divine name.
devanagari:
जय जय प्रभु गिरिधारी नटवर नंदलाला
नटवर नंदलाला हे गिरिधर गोपाला (हे)
हे गिरिधर गोपाला हे गिरिधर गोपाला हे गिरिधर गोपाला
respell:
Jay Jay Prabhu Giridhārī Naṭavar Nandalālā
Naṭavar Nandalālā He Giridhara Gopālā (he)
He Giridhara Gopālā He Giridhara Gopālā He Giridhara Gopālā

title: Jai Jai Rama Krishna Hari
lyrics: Jai Jai Rama Krishna Hari (7 Times)
meaning: Glory, glory to the divine names of Rama, Krishna, and Hari! We joyfully invoke these sacred forms of the Lord, whose very utterance purifies and uplifts the soul.
devanagari: जय जय राम कृष्ण हरि (7 बार)
respell: Jay Jay Rām Kṛushṇa Hari (7 Bār)

title: Jai Jai Sai Ma Hey Sai Saraswati Ma
lyrics:
Jai Jai Sai Ma Hey Sai Saraswati Ma
Hey Veena Vadini Ma Vidya Dayini Ma
Mukti Pradayini Ma Shakti Pradayini Ma
Hey Veena Vadini Ma Vidya Dayini Ma
meaning: Victory to Mother Sai, who embodies Saraswati! Oh divine player of the Veena, you are the bestower of knowledge, liberation, and strength.
devanagari:
जय जय साई माँ जय साई सरस्वती माँ
वीणा वादिनी माँ विद्या दायिनी माँ [ जय जय ... ]
मुक्ति प्रदायिनी माँ शक्ति प्रदायिनी माँ [ वीणा वादिनी ... ]
respell:
Jay Jay Sāī Mām̐ Jaya Sāī Saraswatī Mām̐
Vīṇā Vādinī Mām̐ Vidyā Dāyinī Mām̐ [ Jay Jay ... ]
Mukti Pradāyinī Mām̐ Shakti Pradāyinī Mām̐ [ Vīṇā Vādinī ... ]

title: Jai Jai Sri Ram Sai Harey Ram
lyrics:
Jai Jai Sri Ram Sai Harey Ram
Jai Jai Sri Ram Neela Gagana Shyam [ Jai Jai ... ]
Raghu Nandana Bhava Bhanjana Jai Jai Sri Ram
Rajeeva Dala Lochana Jai Jai Sri Ram
Raghuveera Ranadheera Jai Jai Sri Ram
Parthi Puri Raghava Jai Jai Sai Ram
meaning: Hail to Lord Rama, whose divine form shines like the dark blue sky and whose eyes resemble lotus petals. Oh Son of Raghu, You are the brave warrior who dispels all worldly suffering. Victory to You, Sai Rama, the beloved Lord of Parthi.
devanagari:
जय जय श्री राम साई हरे राम  
जय जय श्री राम नीला गगन श्याम [ जय जय ... ]  
रघु नंदन भव भंजन जय जय श्री राम  
राजीव दल लोचन जय जय श्री राम  
रघुवीर रणधीरा जय जय श्री राम  
पर्ति पुरी राघवा जय जय साई राम
respell:
Jay Jay Shrī Rām Sāī Hare Rām
Jay Jay Shrī Rām Nīlā Gagan Shyām [ Jay Jay ... ]
Raghu Nandana Bhava Bhañjana Jay Jay Shrī Rām
Rājīva Dala Lochana Jay Jay Shrī Rām
Raghuvīr Raṇadhīrā Jay Jay Shrī Rām
Parti Purī Rāghavā Jay Jay Sāī Rām

title: Jai Jai Vaishnavi Devi Ma Jai Jai Vaishnavi Devi Ma
lyrics:
Jai Jai Vaishnavi Devi Ma Jai Jai Vaishnavi Devi Ma
Jai Ma Jai Ma Jai Ma Sai Ma
Jai Jai Ma Jai Jai Ma Jai Jai Ma Sai Ma
Sherawali Ma Jyotawali Ma
Pahadawali Ma Jai Jaga Janani Sai Ma
Jai Ma Jai Ma Jai Ma Sai Ma
Jai Jai Ma Jai Jai Ma Jai Jai Ma Sai Ma
meaning: Oh Mother Vaishnavi Devi, we hail your glorious presence, Mother Sai! You are the lion-mounted goddess, radiant with divine light, who resides in the sacred mountains. Victory to you, the universal Mother of all creation.
devanagari:
जय जय वैष्णवी देवी मा जय जय वैष्णवी देवी मा  
जय मा जय मा जय मा साई मा  
जय जय मा जय जय मा जय जय मा साई मा  
[ जय जय वैष्णवी ... ]  
शेरावाली मा ज्योता वाली मा  
पहाड़ावाली मा, जय जग जननी साई मा  
[जय मा ... ]
respell:
Jay Jay Vaishṇavī Devī Mā Jay Jay Vaishṇavī Devī Mā
Jay Mā Jay Mā Jay Mā Sāī Mā
Jay Jay Mā Jay Jay Mā Jay Jay Mā Sāī Mā
[ Jay Jay Vaishṇavī ... ]
Sherāvalī Mā Jyotā Vālī mā
Pahāḍa़āvalī Mā, Jay Jaga Jananī Sāī Mā
[jay Mā ... ]

title: Jai Jai Vitthala Panduranga Vitthala
lyrics:
Jai Jai Vitthala Panduranga Vitthala
Pundalika Varada Panduranga Vitthala
meaning: Glorify Lord Panduranga Vitthala! He is the benevolent giver of boons, who graciously blessed His devotee Pundalika.
devanagari:
जय जय विट्ठला पांडुरंग विट्ठला
पुंडरीक वरदा पांडुरंग विट्ठला
जय जय विट्ठला पांडुरंग विट्ठला [ पुंडरीक ... ]
respell:
Jay Jay Viṭṭhalā Pāṇḍuraṅg Viṭṭhalā
Puṇḍarīk Varadā Pāṇḍuraṅg Viṭṭhalā
Jay Jay Viṭṭhalā Pāṇḍuraṅg Viṭṭhalā [ Puṇḍarīk ... ]

title: Jai Sai Ram Jai Sai Ram
lyrics:
Jai Sai Ram Jai Sai Ram
Premavatara Sai Avatara
Ramavatara Sai Raghu Ram
Krishnavatara Sai Ghanashyam
Shiva Avatara Sai Bhagawan
Sarva Avatara Sathya Sai Ram
meaning: Victory to Sai Ram, the divine incarnation of boundless love. You are revered as the very embodiment of Rama, the noble Raghu scion, and Krishna, the dark-hued Lord. Oh Sathya Sai Ram, you are the supreme Lord Shiva and the culmination of all divine manifestations.
devanagari:
जय साई राम जय साई राम
प्रेमावतारा साई अवतारा
रामावतारा साई रघु राम
कृष्णावतारा साई घनश्याम
शिवावतारा साई भगवान
सर्वावतारा सत्या साई राम
respell:
Jay Sāī Rām Jay Sāī Rām
Premāvatārā Sāī Avatārā
Rāmāvatārā Sāī Raghu Rām
Kṛushṇāvatārā Sāī Ghanashyām
Shivāvatārā Sāī Bhagavān
Sarwāvatārā Satyā Sāī Rām

title: Jai Sai Ram Jai Sai Ram
lyrics:
Jai Sai Ram Jai Sai Ram
Jai Sai Ram Jai Jai Ram
Bolo Jai Sai Ram Jai Jai Ram
Anatha Rakshaka Sai Ram
Apadbandhava Sai Ram
Prema Swaroopa Sai Ram
Premavatara Sai Ram
Poornavatara Sai Ram
meaning: Victory to Lord Sai Ram. Thou art the refuge to those who have no refuge. In times of difficulties, Thou art our kinsman. O Lord Sai Ram! Thy form is love. In fact, Thou art the Incarnation of Love and Complete Manifestation of the Supreme Consciousness.
devanagari:
जय साई राम जय साई राम
जय साई राम जय जय राम (बोलो) (२)
अनाथ रक्षक साई राम
आपद बांधव साई राम
प्रेम स्वरूपा साई राम
प्रेमावतारा साई राम
पूर्णावतारा साई राम
respell:
Jay Sāī Rām Jay Sāī Rām
Jay Sāī Rām Jay Jay Rām (bolo) (2)
Anātha Rakshak Sāī Rām
Āpad Bāndhava Sāī Rām
Prem Swarūpā Sāī Rām
Premāvatārā Sāī Rām
Pūrṇāvatārā Sāī Rām

title: Jai Santoshi Ma Jai Jai Sai Ma
lyrics:
Jai Santoshi Ma Jai Jai Sai Ma (3)
Mangalakarini Ma Sai Sankata Harini Ma
Triloka Palini Ma Sai Trishoola Dharini Ma
meaning: Hail to Mother Santoshi, who bestows all blessings and dispels every trouble. She is the guardian of the three worlds, ever-present with her divine trident.
devanagari:
जय सन्तोषी माँ जय जय साई माँ (3)
मंगल करिणी माँ साई संकट हरिणी माँ
त्रिलोक पालिणी माँ साई त्रिशूल धारिणी माँ
respell:
Jay Santoshī Mām̐ Jay Jay Sāī Mām̐ (3)
Maṅgal Kariṇī Mām̐ Sāī Saṅkaṭ Hariṇī Mām̐
Trilok Pāliṇī Mām̐ Sāī Trishūl Dhāriṇī Mām̐

title: Janaki Jeevana Rama Raghuveera
lyrics:
Janaki Jeevana Rama Raghuveera
Jaya Bhuvaneshwara Raghava Sundara
Ravikula Mandana Asura Nikhandana
Alakha Nirajana Rama
Jaya Bhuvaneshwara Raghava Sundara
meaning: Oh Rama, life of Janaki and hero of the Raghu clan, glory to You, the beautiful Lord of the universe! You are the radiant jewel of the Solar dynasty, the vanquisher of demons, the imperceptible and stainless divine.
devanagari:
जानकी जीवन राम रघुवीर
जय भुवनेश्वर राघव सुंदर
रविकुल मंडन असुर निखंडन
अलख निरजन रामा
जय भुवनेश्वर राघव सुंदर
respell:
Jānakī Jīvan Rām Raghuvīr
Jaya Bhuvaneshwar Rāghav Sundara
Ravikul Maṇḍana Asur Nikhaṇḍana
Alakh Nirajana Rāmā
Jaya Bhuvaneshwar Rāghav Sundara

title: Janani Janani Sathya Sai Shubha Janani
lyrics:
Janani Janani Sathya Sai Shubha Janani
Jagat Karini Paripoorani Sayeeshwari Janani
Sathya Swaroopini Janani
Dharma Samvardhini Janani
Shanta Swaroopini Janani
Prema Pradayini Janani
Sai Prema Pradayini Janani
meaning:
Oh Auspicious Mother Sathya Sai, You ferry the entire world across the ocean of life and death. 
You give in abundant measure. 
You are the very embodiment of Truth.
You are the one who promotes right conduct in people. 
You are the embodiment of blissful peace. 
You give selfless love in abundance.
devanagari:
जननी जननी सत्य साईं शुभ जननी
जगत कारिणी परिपूर्णी सईेश्वरी जननी
सत्य स्वरूपिणी जननी
धर्म संवर्धिनी जननी
शान्त स्वरूपिणी जननी
प्रेम प्रदायिनी जननी (साईं)
respell:
Jananī Jananī Satya Sāīṃ Shubh Jananī
Jagat Kāriṇī Paripūrṇī Saīeshwarī Jananī
Satya Swarūpiṇī Jananī
Dharma Saṃvardhinī Jananī
Shānta Swarūpiṇī Jananī
Prem Pradāyinī Jananī (sāīṃ)

title: Janani Krupa Karo Ambe
lyrics:
Janani Krupa Karo Ambe
Sai Janani Jaya Jagadambe
Janani Janani Janani Janani
Mata Maheshwari Mangalakarini Ambe
Mangalakarini Tripureshwari Jagadambe
Abhaya Dayini Amrita Bhashini Ambe
Sai Janani Jaya Jagadambe
Janani Janani Janani Janani
meaning: O Divine Mother, Ambe, grant us your grace. You are Sai, the victorious Mother of the Universe, the great goddess who brings all good fortune. Your divine speech, sweet as nectar, bestows fearlessness upon us.
devanagari:
जननी कृपा करो अम्बे
साई जननी जय जगदम्बे
जननी जननी जननी जननी [ जननी कृपा ... ]
माता महेश्वरी मंगल करिणी अम्बे
मंगल करिणी त्रिपुरेश्वरी जगदम्बे
अभय दायिनी अमृत भाषिणी अम्बे
साई जननी जय जगदम्बे [ जननी जननी ... ]
respell:
Jananī Kṛupā Karo Ambe
Sāī Jananī Jaya Jagadambe
Jananī Jananī Jananī Jananī [ Jananī Kṛupā ... ]
Mātā Maheshwarī Maṅgal Kariṇī Ambe
Maṅgal Kariṇī Tripureshwarī Jagadambe
Abhaya Dāyinī Amṛuta Bhāshiṇī Ambe
Sāī Jananī Jaya Jagadambe [ Jananī Jananī ... ]

title: Janani Ma Sai Janani Ma
lyrics:
Janani Ma Sai Janani Ma
Prema Vahini Ma Jnana Vahini Ma
Dharma Vahini Ma Jnana Vahini Ma
Prasanthi Vahini Chira Sukha Dayini
Jaya Jaya Sai Ma
meaning: Mother Sai, the Divine Mother, embodies and flows as pure love, profound wisdom, and righteous conduct. She is the very current of supreme peace, bestowing lasting happiness upon all.
devanagari:
जननी माँ साई जननी माँ
प्रेम वाहिनी माँ ज्ञान वाहिनी माँ
धर्म वाहिनी माँ ज्ञान वाहिनी माँ
प्रशांति वाहिनी चिर सुख दायिनी
जय जय साई माँ
respell:
Jananī Mām̐ Sāī Jananī Mām̐
Prem Vāhinī Mām̐ Jñāna Vāhinī Mām̐
Dharma Vāhinī Mām̐ Jñāna Vāhinī Mām̐
Prashānti Vāhinī Chira Sukh Dāyinī
Jaya Jaya Sāī Mām̐

title: Janani Sai Devi Dayamayi
lyrics:
Janani Sai Devi Dayamayi
Janani Ma Kripalini Ma
Tum Ho Prema Swaroopini Ma
Daya Karo Sathya Sai Ma
Kripa Karo Sathya Sai Ma
Janani Prema Dayini Ma
meaning: O Divine Mother Sai, You are inherently compassionate and the very form of love. We pray to You, Sathya Sai Mother, to shower us with Your boundless grace and kindness.
devanagari:
जननी साई देवी दयामयी
जननी माँ कृपालिनी माँ
तुम हो प्रेम स्वरूपिणी माँ
दया करो सत्य साई माँ
जननी प्रेम दयिनी माँ
respell:
Jananī Sāī Devī Dayāmayī
Jananī Mām̐ Kṛupālinī Mām̐
Tum Ho Prem Swarūpiṇī Mām̐
Dayā Karo Satya Sāī Mām̐
Jananī Prem Dayinī Mām̐

title: Janardana Nandalala Govinda Gopala
lyrics:
Janardana Nandalala Govinda Gopala
Hare Krishna Hare Krishna
Krishna Krishna Gopala
Sai Krishna Gopala
meaning: Oh Janardana, darling son of Nanda, Govinda, Gopala, we invoke Your divine presence. Hare Krishna, Hare Krishna, Krishna Krishna Gopala, Sai Krishna Gopala, we continuously chant Your sacred names, seeking Your boundless grace.
devanagari:
जनार्दना नंदलाला गोविन्दा गोपाला
हरे कृष्णा हरे कृष्णा
कृष्णा कृष्णा गोपाला  
साई कृष्णा गोपाला
respell:
Janārdanā Nandalālā Govindā Gopālā
Hare Kṛushṇā Hare Kṛushṇā
Kṛushṇā Kṛushṇā Gopālā
Sāī Kṛushṇā Gopālā

title: Jaya Anjeneya Jaya Rama Doota
lyrics:
Jaya Anjeneya Jaya Rama Doota Sharanam Prabho Sharanam
Vanara Veera Vayu Kumara
Ranadheera Sharanam
Rama Priye Sharanam (Sai)
Sathya Sai Hanuman Sharanam
Ram Ram Jaya Jaya Ram Ram Jaya Jaya 
Ram Ram Jaya Jaya Ram(2)
meaning: Victory to Anjaneya, the glorious messenger of Lord Rama! O valiant warrior, son of the Wind God, and brave hero in battle, we seek refuge in you, beloved of Rama. We surrender to you, Sathya Sai Hanuman, chanting victory to Lord Rama.
devanagari:
जय अञ्जनेया जय राम दूता शरणं प्रभो शरणं
वानर वीरा वायु कुमारा 
रणधीरा शरणं
राम प्रिये शरणं (साई)
सत्य साई हनुमान शरणं
राम राम जय जय राम राम जय जय 
राम राम जय जय राम (२)
respell:
Jaya Añjaneyā Jaya Rām Dūtā Sharaṇaṃ Prabho Sharaṇaṃ
Vānara Vīrā Vāyu Kumārā
Raṇadhīrā Sharaṇaṃ
Rām Priye Sharaṇaṃ (sāī)
Satya Sāī Hanumān Sharaṇaṃ
Rām Rām Jaya Jaya Rām Rām Jaya Jaya
Rām Rām Jaya Jaya Rām (2)

title: Jaya Devi Bhavani Ma
lyrics:
Jaya Devi Bhavani Ma
Jaya Sai Bhavani Ma
Jagadeeshwari Sai Ma Parameshwari Sai Ma
Jaya Sai Bhavani Ma Jaya Parthi Nivasini Ma
meaning: Oh Divine Mother Bhavani, we celebrate your victory and presence, recognizing you as Sai. You are the Supreme Goddess, the sovereign ruler of the entire universe, whose divine abode is Puttaparthi.
devanagari:
जय देवी भवानी माँ 
जय साई भवानी माँ 
जगदीश्वरी साई माँ  परमेश्वरी साई माँ 
जय साई भवानी माँ  जय पर्ती निवासिनी माँ
respell:
Jaya Devī Bhavānī Mām̐
Jaya Sāī Bhavānī Mām̐
Jagadīshwarī Sāī Mām̐  Parameshwarī Sāī Mām̐
Jaya Sāī Bhavānī Mām̐  Jaya Partī Nivāsinī Mām̐

title: Jaya Devi Durga Gauri Shankari Parvati
lyrics:
Jaya Devi Durga Gowri Shankari Parvathi  
Bhuvana Mohini Lalita Lakshmi Kalavathi [ Jaya Devi ... ]
Kamala Kamini Hari Narayani Bhagawathi
Veda Mata Vidya Dayini Bharati
Hamsa Vahini Veena Paani Saraswathi
meaning: We celebrate the Divine Mother, who embodies the power of Durga, Gowri, Shankari, and Parvati. She is also the captivating Lakshmi, mistress of all arts, and the beloved Narayani. We honor her as Saraswati, the Mother of Vedas, bestower of wisdom, who rides a swan and holds the veena.
devanagari:
जय देवी दुर्गा गौरी शंकारी पार्वती  
भुवन मोहिनी ललिता लक्ष्मी कलावती [ जय देवी ... ]  
कमल कामिनी हरि नारायणी भागवती  
वेद माता विद्या दायिनी भारती  
हंस वाहिनी वीणा पानी सरस्वती
respell:
Jaya Devī Durgā Gaurī Shaṅkārī Pārwatī
Bhuvan Mohinī Lalitā Lakshmī Kalāvatī [ Jaya Devī ... ]
Kamala Kāminī Hari Nārāyaṇī Bhāgavatī
Ved Mātā Vidyā Dāyinī Bhāratī
Haṃs Vāhinī Vīṇā Pānī Saraswatī

title: Jaya Ganesh Jaya Ganesh Jaya Ganesha Deva
lyrics:
Jaya Ganesh Jaya Ganesh Jaya Ganesha Deva
Sri Ganesha Sri Ganesha Sri Ganesha Deva
Bhaktoddharana Bhakta Jana Poshana
Papa Vinashana Bhakta Samrakshana
Omkara Pranava Sri Roopa
Parvati Nandana Jaya Jaga Vandana
meaning: Victory to you, Lord Ganesha, the divine one who uplifts and nourishes your devotees. You destroy all obstacles and sins, protecting the faithful, embodying the sacred sound Om, and as Parvati's beloved son, you are revered by the entire world.
devanagari:
जय गणेश जय गणेश जय गणेश देवा
श्री गणेश श्री गणेश श्री गणेश देवा
भक्तोद्धारणा भक्त जन पोषणा
पाप विनाशना भक्त संरक्षणा
ॐकारा प्रणव श्री रूपा
पार्वति नन्दना जय जग वन्दना
respell:
Jaya Gaṇesh Jaya Gaṇesh Jaya Gaṇesha Devā
Shrī Gaṇesha Shrī Gaṇesha Shrī Gaṇesha Devā
Bhaktoddhāraṇā Bhakta Jana Poshaṇā
Pāpa Vināshanā Bhakta Saṃrakshaṇā
Oṃkārā Praṇava Shrī Rūpā
Pārwati Nandanā Jaya Jaga Vandanā

title: Jaya Gopala Jaya Gopala
lyrics:
Jaya Gopala Jaya Gopala
Jaya Radhey Govinda Gopala [ Jaya Gopala.. ]
Chinmayananda Hey Sai Gopala
Nityananda Roopa Sai Gopala
(bolo) Jaya Radhey Govinda Gopala
meaning: Oh Gopala, beloved Govinda of Radha, we sing your victory! You are Sai, the very form of pure consciousness and eternal bliss, and we joyously hail your divine presence.
devanagari:
जय गोपाला जय गोपाला
जय राधे गोविन्द गोपाला [ जय गोपाला ... ]
चिन्मयानंद हे साई गोपाला
नित्यानंद रूप साई गोपाला 
जय राधे गोविन्द गोपाला
respell:
Jaya Gopālā Jaya Gopālā
Jaya Rādhe Govinda Gopālā [ Jaya Gopālā ... ]
Chinmayānanda He Sāī Gopālā
Nityānanda Rūp Sāī Gopālā 
Jaya Rādhe Govinda Gopālā

title: Jaya Guru Omkara Jaya Jaya Sadguru Omkara Om
lyrics:
Jaya Guru Omkara Jaya Jaya Sadguru Omkara Om
Brahma Vishnu Sadashiva
Hara Hara Hara Hara Mahadeva
meaning: Hail to the Guru, embodiment of the sacred sound Om! We celebrate you, the true spiritual master, who manifests as Brahma the creator, Vishnu the preserver, and Sadashiva, the eternal transformer. We invoke you, Great God Shiva, the remover of all suffering.
devanagari:
जय गुरु ओंकारा जय जय सद्गुरु ओंकारा ॐ  
ब्रह्मा विष्णु सदाशिवा  
हर हर हर हर महादेवा  
शिव शिव शिव शिव सदाशिवा
respell:
Jaya Guru Oṅkārā Jaya Jaya Sadguru Oṅkārā Oṃ
Brahmā Vishṇu Sadāshivā
Har Har Har Har Mahādevā
Shiv Shiv Shiv Shiv Sadāshivā

title: Jaya Guru Deva Prabhu Sai Deva
lyrics:
Jaya Guru Deva Prabhu Sai Deva
Devadi Deva Pranamamyaham
Shiva Shiva Shambho Kailasapate
Parthipureeshwara Palayamam
Devadi Deva Pranamamyaham
meaning: Victory to you, Divine Guru, Lord Sai, God of all gods, I humbly bow before you. Oh Shiva, Shambho, Lord of Kailasa, and Lord of Parthi, please grant me your divine protection.
devanagari:
जय गुरु देवा प्रभु साई देवा
देवादी देवा प्रणामाम्यहम्
शिव शिव शम्भो कैलास पते
पर्तिपूरीश्वर पालय माम [ देवादी देव ... ]
respell:
Jaya Guru Devā Prabhu Sāī Devā
Devādī Devā Praṇāmāmyaham
Shiv Shiv Shambho Kailās Pate
Partipūrīshwar Pālay Māma [ devādī Dev ... ]

title: Jaya Guru Jaya Guru Sai Ram
lyrics:
Jaya Guru Jaya Guru Sai Ram
Jagadguru Sathya Sai Ram
Brahma Vishnu Shiva Sai Ram
Parabrahma Roopa Sai Ram
Mata Pita Guru Sai Ram
Jagadguru Sathya Sai Ram
meaning: Victory to you, Sai Ram, our beloved Guru! O Sathya Sai, universal teacher, you are the divine trinity of Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva, the very form of the Supreme Absolute. You are our Mother, Father, and spiritual guide.
devanagari:
जय गुरु जय गुरु साई राम
जगद्गुरु सत्य साई राम
ब्रह्म विष्णु शिव साई राम
परब्रह्म रूप साई राम
मात पिता गुरु साई राम
जगद्गुरु सत्य साई राम
respell:
Jaya Guru Jaya Guru Sāī Rām
Jagadguru Satya Sāī Rām
Brahma Vishṇu Shiv Sāī Rām
Parabrahma Rūp Sāī Rām
Māta Pitā Guru Sāī Rām
Jagadguru Satya Sāī Rām

title: Jaya Guru Natha Shiva Guru Natha
lyrics:
Jaya Guru Natha Shiva Guru Natha
Parthipureesha Hare Paramesha
Parama Dayala Pahi Mahesha
Jaya Jaya Sathya Sayeesha
meaning: Victory to you, Divine Guru, Lord Shiva, our Supreme Master! Oh Lord of Parthi, Hari, supremely compassionate one, please protect us. All glory to you, Sathya Sai, our beloved Lord!
devanagari:
जय गुरु नाथा शिव गुरु नाथा
पर्तीपुरीश हरे परमेशा
परम दयाला पाहि महेशा
जय जय सत्य साईशा
respell:
Jaya Guru Nāthā Shiv Guru Nāthā
Partīpurīsh Hare Parameshā
Param Dayālā Pāhi Maheshā
Jaya Jaya Satya Sāīshā

title: Jaya Ho Jaya Ho Gopalana
lyrics:
Jaya Ho Jaya Ho Gopalana
Jaya Ho Jaya Ho Narayana
Jaya Ho Jaya Ho Janardana
Jaya Ho Jaya Ho Niranjana
meaning: Victory, victory to Gopala, the divine protector, and to Narayana, the cosmic preserver! Victory, victory to Janardana, beloved of all beings, and to Niranjana, the eternally pure and untainted Lord.
devanagari:
जय हो जय हो गोपालना
जय हो जय हो नारायणा
जय हो जय हो जनार्दना
जय हो जय हो निरंजना
respell:
Jaya Ho Jaya Ho Gopālanā
Jaya Ho Jaya Ho Nārāyaṇā
Jaya Ho Jaya Ho Janārdanā
Jaya Ho Jaya Ho Nirañjanā

title: Jaya Ho Jaya Ho Lingeshwara
lyrics:
Jaya Ho Jaya Ho Lingeshwara
Jaya Ho Jaya Ho Sayeeshwara
Jaya Ho Jaya Ho Mrutyunjaya
Jaya Ho Jaya Ho Partheeshwara
Jaya Ho Jaya Ho Sayeeshwara
meaning: Oh Lord, we hail your eternal form as Lingeshwara. Glory to you, Sai, the vanquisher of death, the divine ruler of Parthi.
devanagari:
जय हो जय हो लिंगेश्वरा 
जय हो जय हो साईश्वरा 
जय हो जय हो मृत्युंजया
जय हो जय हो पर्तीश्वरा 
जय हो जय हो साईश्वरा
respell:
Jaya Ho Jaya Ho Liṅgeshwarā
Jaya Ho Jaya Ho Sāīshwarā
Jaya Ho Jaya Ho Mṛutyuñjayā
Jaya Ho Jaya Ho Partīshwarā
Jaya Ho Jaya Ho Sāīshwarā

title: Jaya Ho Jaya Ho Mooshika Vahana
lyrics:
Jaya Ho Jaya Ho Mooshika Vahana
Hey Shiva Nandana Prathama Vandana
Parvati Tanaya Siddhi Vinayaka
Sharanam Sharanam Vighna Haranam
Hey Shiva Nandana Prathama Vandana
meaning: We celebrate the glorious Ganesha, the mouse-rider, son of Shiva and Parvati, to whom all initial reverence is offered. We take refuge in this Siddhi Vinayaka, the divine remover of all impediments, who bestows success and spiritual strength.
devanagari:
जय हो जय हो मूषिक वाहन
हे शिव नंदन प्रथम वंदना
पार्वती तनया सिद्धि विनायक
शरणं शरणं विघ्न हरणम्
हे शिव नंदन प्रथम वंदना
respell:
Jaya Ho Jaya Ho Mūshik Vāhan
He Shiv Nandana Prathama Vandanā
Pārwatī Tanayā Siddhi Vināyak
Sharaṇaṃ Sharaṇaṃ Vighna Haraṇam
He Shiv Nandana Prathama Vandanā

title: Jaya Ho Nataraj
lyrics:
Jaya Ho Nataraj
Gangadhara Shambho Hey Nataraj
Phala Lochana Pahi Murari
Halahaladhara Hey Tripurari
Jaya Ho Nataraj
meaning: This bhajan offers triumphant praise to Lord Nataraj, Shiva, the cosmic dancer. It reveres him as the bearer of the Ganges, the one with the third eye of wisdom, the benevolent protector who consumed the poison and vanquished the three cities.
devanagari:
जय हो नटराज (२)
गंगाधर शम्भो हे नटराज
फाल लोचना पाहि मुरारी
हालाहल धर हे त्रिपुरारी
जय हो नटराज
respell:
Jaya Ho Naṭarāj (2)
Gaṅgādhara Shambho He Naṭarāj
Phāla Lochanā Pāhi Murārī
Hālāhal Dhara He Tripurārī
Jaya Ho Naṭarāj

title: Jaya Ho Sai Ram Jaya Ho Sai Ram
lyrics:
Jaya Ho Sai Ram Jaya Ho Sai Ram
Karuna Sindhu Ram Sai Parthipureeshwara Ram
Treta Yug Mein Ram Sai Dwapara Yug Mein Shyam
Ram Tu Hi Rehman Sai Sabka Hai Bhagawan
Kali Yug Ke Avatar Sai Parthipureeshwara Ram
meaning: Hail Sai Ram, the compassionate Lord of Parthi. This divine being manifested as Ram in Treta Yuga and Shyam in Dwapara Yuga, now appearing as Sai, the universal God revered by all faiths, including as Rehman.
devanagari:
जय हो साई राम जय हो साई राम
करुणा सिंधु राम साई पर्तिपूरी राम [ जय हो साई राम ... ]
त्रेतायुग में राम साई द्वापर युग में श्याम
राम तुम ही रहमान साई सब का है भगवान
कली युग के अवतार साई पर्तिपूरीश्वर राम
respell:
Jaya Ho Sāī Rām Jaya Ho Sāī Rām
Karuṇā Sindhu Rām Sāī Partipūrī Rām [ jay Ho Sāī Rām ... ]
Tretāyug Meṃ Rām Sāī Dwāpar Yug Meṃ Shyām
Rām Tum Hī Rahamān Sāī Sab Kā Hai Bhagavān
Kalī Yug Ke Avatār Sāī Partipūrīshwar Rām

title: Jaya Jagadeesha Hare Jaya Govinda Hare
lyrics:
Jaya Jagadeesha Hare Jaya Govinda Hare
Nityananda Brahmananda Jaya Gopala Hare
Arunachala Shiva Om Trishuladhari Shivom
Hari Narayana Om Sai Narayana Om
Jaya Devi Bharati Vidya Dayini Annapurna Mata Om
meaning: Victory to You, Lord of the Universe, Govinda, the embodiment of eternal and supreme bliss! We invoke Arunachala Shiva, who bears the trident, and Hari Narayana, who manifests as Sai. Hail to Goddess Bharati, bestower of wisdom, and to Mother Annapurna, the provider of all.
devanagari:
जय जगदीश हरे जय गोविन्द हरे
नित्यानंदा ब्रह्मानंदा जय गोपाला हरे
अरुणाचल शिव ॐ त्रिशूल धारी शिवोम
हरी नारायण ॐ साई नारायण ॐ
जय देवी भारती विद्या दायिनी अन्नपूर्णा मत ॐ
respell:
Jaya Jagadīsha Hare Jaya Govinda Hare
Nityānandā Brahmānandā Jaya Gopālā Hare
Aruṇāchala Shiv Oṃ Trishūl Dhārī Shivom
Harī Nārāyaṇ Oṃ Sāī Nārāyaṇ Oṃ
Jaya Devī Bhāratī Vidyā Dāyinī Annapūrṇā Mata Oṃ

title: Jaya Jagadeesha Jaya Paramesha
lyrics:
Jaya Jagadeesha Jaya Paramesha
Neelakantha Sadashiva
Om Hari Om
Hari Om Hari Om
Devadi Deva Deena Dayala
Chandrashekhara Shambho
Neelakantha Sadashiva
meaning: Victory to You, Lord of the Universe, Supreme God! O Blue-throated, Ever-auspicious Shiva, God of Gods, You are compassionate to the humble. We praise You, O Shambho, who bears the crescent moon upon Your head.
devanagari:
जय जगदीशा जय परमेशा
नीलकण्ठा सदा शिवा
ॐ हरि ॐ
हरि ॐ साई ॐ
देवाधिदेवा दीन दयाला
चंद्रशेखरा शंभो (2) [नीलकण्ठा सदा शिवा]
respell:
Jaya Jagadīshā Jaya Parameshā
Nīlakaṇṭhā Sadā shivā
Oṃ Hari Oṃ
Hari Oṃ Sāī Oṃ
Devādhidevā Dīna Dayālā
Chandrashekharā Shambho (2) [nīlakaṇṭhā Sadā Shivā]

title: Jaya Jagajjanani Ma
lyrics:
Jaya Jagajjanani Ma
Jaya Ma Jaya Ma Jaya Ma
Sai Shiva Shankari Sai Parameshwari
Ambe Bhavani Ma Jaya
meaning: Victory to you, Divine Mother, creator of all existence! We joyously praise you, Sai, who embodies Shiva's grace and stands as the Supreme Goddess, Amba Bhavani.
devanagari:
जय जगत जननी माँ
जय माँ जय माँ जय माँ
साई शिव शंकरी साई परमेश्वरी
अम्बे भवानी माँ (जगत)
respell:
Jaya Jagat Jananī Mām̐
Jaya Mām̐ Jaya Mām̐ Jaya Mām̐
Sāī Shiv Shaṅkarī Sāī Parameshwarī
Ambe Bhavānī Mām̐ (jagat)

title: Jaya Jaya Deva Jagadeesha Deva
lyrics:
Jaya Jaya Deva Jagadeesha Deva
Daya Sagara Sai Deva
Neeraja Nayana Ksheerabdhi Shayana
Neela Megha Shyama
Samagana Priya Sarva Dharma Priya Sathya Sai Mahadeva
meaning: Victory to the Lord of the Whole World, Sai. You are the ocean of compassion. The One with Lotus shaped eyes, whose abode is the Ocean of Milk and whose complexion is deep blue. O Great Lord Sathya Sai, who loves the music of the Vedas and who loves all religions equally.
devanagari:
जय जय देवा जगदीश देवा
दया सागरा साई देवा [ जय जय देवा ... ]
नीरज नयना क्षीराब्धि शयना
नील मेघ श्यामा
साम गान प्रिय सर्व धर्म प्रिय सत्य साई महादेवा
respell:
Jaya Jaya Devā Jagadīsha Devā
Dayā Sāgarā Sāī Devā [ Jaya Jaya Devā ... ]
Nīraj Nayanā Kshīrābdhi Shayanā
Nīla Megha Shyāmā
Sām Gān Priy Sarwa Dharma Priy Satya Sāī Mahādevā

title: Jaya Jaya Devi Girija Mata
lyrics:
Jaya Jaya Devi Girija Mata
Jaya Jagadambe Pranava Swaroopini
Ashtabhujankita Akhila Dharini
Jaya Yogeeshwara Hridaya Nivasini
meaning: Victory and praise to Mother Girija, the Universal Mother who embodies the sacred sound Om. Adorned with eight arms, she sustains the entire cosmos and resides within the heart of Lord Shiva.
devanagari:
जय जय देवी गिरिजा माता
जय जगदम्बे प्रणव स्वरूपिणी
अष्टभुजाकींत अखिला धारिणी
जय योगेश्वर हृदय निवासिनी
respell:
Jaya Jaya Devī Girijā Mātā
Jaya Jagadambe Praṇava Swarūpiṇī
Ashṭabhujākīnt Akhilā Dhāriṇī
Jaya Yogeshwar Hṛudaya Nivāsinī

title: Jaya Jaya Gajanana Gananatha
lyrics:
Jaya Jaya Gajanana Gananatha
Gauri Nandana Hey Gananatha
Buddhi Pradayaka Hey Gananatha
Siddhi Vinayaka Hey Gananatha
--
Jaya Gananatha Sai Gananatha (4)
