meaning: Victory, victory to you, O elephant-faced Lord, leader of the celestial hosts! Son of Gauri, bestower of wisdom and success, we praise you, O Gananatha, our divine guide.
devanagari:
जय जय गजानना गणनाथा
गौरी नंदन हे गणनाथा [ जय जय ... ]
बुद्धि प्रदायक हे गणनाथा
सिद्धि विनायक हे गणनाथा
जय गणनाथ साई गणनाथा (4)
respell:
Jaya Jaya Gajānanā Gaṇanāthā
Gaurī Nandana He Gaṇanāthā [ Jaya Jaya ... ]
Buddhi Pradāyak He Gaṇanāthā
Siddhi Vināyak He Gaṇanāthā
Jaya Gaṇanātha Sāī Gaṇanāthā (4)

title: Jaya Jaya Girija Bala Gajanana
lyrics:
Jaya Jaya Girija Bala Gajanana
Hey Shiva Shankara Parvati Nandana
Vighna Vinashaka Vimala Gajanana
Sharavana Sevita Sumukha Gajanana
Tava Pada Sharanam Sharanam Gajanana
meaning: We celebrate Lord Gajanana, the beloved son of Shiva and Parvati, who is pure and destroys all obstacles. This elephant-faced deity, served by his brother Sharavana, is the one at whose feet we humbly seek refuge.
devanagari:
जय जय गिरिजा बाल गजानन  
जय शिव शंकर पार्वती नंदन [ जय जय गिरिजा ... ]  
विघ्न विनाशक विमल गजानन  
शरवण सेवित सुमुख गजानन  
तव पद चरणं शरणं गजानन
respell:
Jaya Jaya Girijā Bāla Gajānana
Jaya Shiv Shaṅkar Pārwatī Nandana [ Jaya Jaya Girijā ... ]
Vighna Vināshak Vimala Gajānana
Sharavaṇ Sevit Sumukha Gajānana
Tava Pada Charaṇaṃ Sharaṇaṃ Gajānana

title: Jaya Jaya Govinda Jaya Nandalala
lyrics:
Jaya Jaya Govinda Jaya Nandalala
Radhalola Rasavilola
Tribhuvana Paripala Deena Dayala
Suradasa Prabhu Karuna Sagara
Meera Ke Prabhu Giridhara Nagara
Bhakta Sakha Bhagawan Gopala
Deena Sakha Bhagawan Gopala
meaning: Victory to Lord Govinda, the beloved son of Nanda and Radha, who delights in the divine Raas Leela. O Gopala, you are the compassionate protector of the three worlds, an ocean of mercy, and the cherished Lord of devotees like Surdas and Meera. You are truly a divine friend to both your bhaktas and the downtrodden.
devanagari:
जय जय गोविन्द जय नन्दलाला
राधा लोला रास विलोला
त्रिभुवन परिपाल दीन दयाला [ जय जय गोविन्द ... ]
सूरदास प्रभु करुणा सागर
मीरा के प्रभु गिरिधर नागर
भक्त सखा भगवान गोपाला
respell:
Jaya Jaya Govinda Jaya Nandalālā
Rādhā Lolā Rās Vilolā
Tribhuvan Paripāla Dīna Dayālā [ Jaya Jaya Govinda ... ]
Sūradās Prabhu Karuṇā Sāgar
Mīrā Ke Prabhu Giridhara Nāgar
Bhakta Sakhā Bhagavān Gopālā

title: Jaya Jaya Govinda Narayana
lyrics:
Jaya Jaya Govinda Narayana
Jaya Hari Govinda Narayana [ Jaya Jaya ... ]
Mathuradhipathey Mandara Giridhara
Murali Manohara Narayana
Narayana Namo (Sai) Narayana (3)
meaning: Hail, glorious Govinda Narayana, Hari Narayana! Oh Lord of Mathura, You who lifted the Mandara mountain and enchant all with Your divine flute, we offer our deepest salutations to You, Narayana, Sai Narayana.
devanagari:
जय जय गोविन्द नारायणा  
जय हरि गोविन्द नारायणा [ जय जय ... ]  
मथुराधीपते मन्दर गिरिधर  
मुरली मनोहर नारायणा  
नारायणा नमो (साई) नारायणा (3)
respell:
Jaya Jaya Govinda Nārāyaṇā
Jaya Hari Govinda Nārāyaṇā [ Jaya Jaya ... ]
Mathurādhīpate Mandara Giridhara
Muralī Manohar Nārāyaṇā
Nārāyaṇā Namo (sāī) Nārāyaṇā (3)

title: Jaya Jaya Hey Jagadeesha Mahesha
lyrics:
Jaya Jaya Hey Jagadeesha Mahesha
Jaya Jaya Hey Kailasa Vasa
Jaya Jaya Jaya Shiva Sai Mahesha
Jaya Hey Shambho Sai Natha
Jaya Jaya Jaya Hey Anatha Natha
meaning: Oh Lord Mahesha, ruler of the universe and dweller of sacred Kailasa, we offer our heartfelt praise to you. You are Shiva Sai, our divine protector, the compassionate Lord of the helpless. Hail to you, Shambho Sai Natha!
devanagari:
जय जय हे जगदीशा महेशा
जय जय हे कैलासा वासा [ जय जय हे जगदीशा ... ]
जय जय जय शिव साई महेशा
जय हे शंभो साई नाथा
जय जय जय हे अनाथ नाथा
respell:
Jaya Jaya He Jagadīshā Maheshā
Jaya Jaya He Kailāsā Vāsā [ Jaya Jaya He Jagadīshā ... ]
Jaya Jaya Jaya Shiv Sāī Maheshā
Jaya He Shambho Sāī Nāthā
Jaya Jaya Jaya He Anātha Nāthā

title: Jaya Jaya Jaya Devi Narayani
lyrics:
Jaya Jaya Jaya Devi Narayani
Janana Marana Bhaya Harini [ Jaya Jaya ... ]
Dukha Vinashini Jagat Paripalini
Jaya Jaya Jaya Devi Jagat Janani
Jagat Janani Shubha Karini
Jaya Jaya Jaya Devi Jagat Janani

title: Jaya Jaya Jaya Gananatha
lyrics:
Jaya Jaya Jaya Gananatha
Jaya Gananatha Sri Gananatha
Heramba Gananatha Natha
He Shiva Nandana Parvati Nandana
Jaya Jaya Jaya Gananatha Natha
meaning: Oh Gananatha, Lord of the multitudes, we sing your glorious victory! You are Heramba, the beloved son of Shiva and Parvati, our divine protector.
devanagari:
जय जय जय गणनाथा
जय गणनाथा श्री गणनाथा
हेरम्बा गणनाथा नाथा
हे शिव नन्दन पार्वती नन्दन
जय जय जय गणनाथा नाथा
respell:
Jaya Jaya Jaya Gaṇanāthā
Jaya Gaṇanāthā Shrī Gaṇanāthā
Herambā Gaṇanāthā Nāthā
He Shiv Nandana Pārwatī Nandana
Jaya Jaya Jaya Gaṇanāthā Nāthā

title: Jaya Jaya Jaya Hey Gajanana
lyrics:
Jaya Jaya Jaya Hey Gajanana
Gajanana Hey Gajavadana
Parvati Nandana Gajanana
Pashupati Tanaya Gajanana
Adi Poojya Deva Gajanana
meaning: We celebrate Gajanana, the elephant-headed Lord! He is the beloved son of Parvati and Shiva, revered as the primal deity whose worship precedes all others.
devanagari:
जय जय जय हे गजानना
गजानना हे गजवदना [ जय जय जय हे ... ]
पार्वती नंदना गजानना
पशुपति तनया गजानना
आदि पूज्य देव गजानना
respell:
Jaya Jaya Jaya He Gajānanā
Gajānanā He Gajavadanā [ Jaya Jaya Jaya He ... ]
Pārwatī Nandanā Gajānanā
Pashupati Tanayā Gajānanā
Ādi Pūjya Deva Gajānanā

title: Jaya Jaya Jaya Hey Gajanana
lyrics:
Jaya Jaya Jaya Hey Gajanana
Parvati Nandana Shubhanana
Neelakantha Suta Gajanana
Nitya Shubhanga Gajanana
meaning: Oh Gajanana, we sing your glorious victory! Beloved son of Parvati and Neelakantha, your auspicious face and eternally blessed form bring us immense joy.
devanagari:
जय जय जय हे गजानना  
पार्वती नंदन शुभनना [ जय जय ... ]  
नीलकंठ सुत गजानना  
नित्य शुभांगा गजानना
respell:
Jaya Jaya Jaya He Gajānanā
Pārwatī Nandana Shubhananā [ jaya jaya ... ]
Nīlakaṇṭh Sut Gajānanā
Nitya Shubhāṅgā Gajānanā

title: Jaya Jaya Jaya He Madhusudana
lyrics:
Jaya Jaya Jaya Hey Madhusudhana
Jaya Brindavana Mana Mohana [ Jaya Jaya ... ]
Sundara Sai Shirdi (Parthi) Vihari
Radhey Shyam Radhey Shyam Radhey Shyam Radhey Shyam
Sai Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram [ Radhey Shyam ... ]
meaning: Oh Madhusudhana, victor over evil, we hail your glory! You are the enchanting one who captivates hearts in Brindavan. Beautiful Sai, residing in Shirdi and Parthi, we lovingly chant your names, Radhey Shyam and Sai Ram.
devanagari:
जय जय जय हे मधुसूदना
जय ब्रिंदावन मन मोहना [ जय जय ... ]
सुंदर साई शिर्डी (पर्ती) विहारी
राधे श्याम राधे श्याम राधे श्याम राधे श्याम
साई राम साई राम साई राम साई राम [ राधे श्याम ... ]
respell:
Jaya Jaya Jaya He Madhusūdanā
Jaya Brindāvan Mana Mohanā [ Jaya Jaya ... ]
Sundara Sāī Shirḍī (partī) Vihārī
Rādhe Shyām Rādhe Shyām Rādhe Shyām Rādhe Shyām
Sāī Rām Sāī Rām Sāī Rām Sāī Rām [ Rādhe Shyām ... ]

title: Jaya Jaya Jaya Jaga Vandini Ma
lyrics:
Jaya Jaya Jaya Jaga Vandini Ma
Jaya Paramesha Hrudvasini Ma
Adi Shakti Parabrahma Swaroopini
Jagat Janani Chathur Veda Vilasini
Samba Vinodini Mata Bhavani
Srikari Shankari Moksha Pradayini
--
Mata Bhavani
Samba Vinodini Mata Bhavani
meaning: Oh Mother, adored by the entire universe and dwelling in the heart of the Supreme Lord, we hail your victory! You are the primordial power, the very form of the Absolute, Mother of all creation, delighting in the wisdom of the Vedas. Bhavani, who brings joy to Shiva, you bestow prosperity and ultimate liberation.
devanagari:
जय जय जय जग वंदिनी माँ
जय परमेश हृद्वासिनी माँ
आदि शक्ती परब्रह्म स्वरूपिणी
जगत् जननी चतुर्वेद विलासिनी
साम्ब विनोदिनी माता भवानी
श्रीकरी शंकरी मोक्ष प्रदायिनी
--
माता भवानी
साम्ब विनोदिनी माता भवानी
respell:
Jaya Jaya Jaya Jaga Vandinī Mām̐
Jaya Paramesha Hṛudwāsinī Mām̐
Ādi Shaktī Parabrahma Swarūpiṇī
Jagat Jananī Chaturwed Vilāsinī
Sāmba Vinodinī Mātā Bhavānī
Shrīkarī Shaṅkarī Moksha Pradāyinī
--
Mātā Bhavānī
Sāmba Vinodinī Mātā Bhavānī

title: Jaya Jaya Krishna Yadu Nandana
lyrics:
Jaya Jaya Krishna Yadu Nandana
Jaya Jaya Brindavana Chandana
Jaya Jaya Krishna Mana Mohana
Jaya Jaya Sai Gopalana
meaning: Victory, victory to you, Krishna, beloved son of the Yadu clan! You are the fragrant essence of Brindavan, the captivating charmer of all minds. All glory to you, Sai Gopala!
devanagari:
जय जय कृष्णा यदु नंदना
जय जय ब्रिंदावन चंदना [ जय जय ... ]
जय जय कृष्णा मन मोहना
जय जय साई गोपालना (2)
respell:
Jaya Jaya Kṛushṇā Yadu Nandanā
Jaya Jaya Brindāvan Chandanā [ Jaya Jaya ... ]
Jaya Jaya Kṛushṇā Mana Mohanā
Jaya Jaya Sāī Gopālanā (2)

title: Jaya Jaya Mangala Sai Namo
lyrics:
Jaya Jaya Mangala Sai Namo
Jaya Partheeshwara Sai Namo
Shiva Shakteeshwara Sai Namo
Sri Shaileshwara Sai Namo
meaning: Oh victorious and auspicious Sai, we offer our salutations to You, Lord of Parthi. You are the divine embodiment of Shiva and Shakti, the very essence of the sacred Sri Shaila mountain. We bow to You.
devanagari:
जय जय मंगल साई नमो
जय पर्तीश्वर साई नमो
शिव शक्तीश्वर साई नमो
श्री शैलेश्वर साई नमो
respell:
Jaya Jaya Maṅgal Sāī Namo
Jaya Partīshwar Sāī Namo
Shiv Shaktīshwar Sāī Namo
Shrī Shaileshwar Sāī Namo

title: Jaya Jaya Mohana Murali Gopala
lyrics:
Jaya Jaya Mohana Murali Gopala
Jaya Giridhara Brindavana Pala
Jaya Hey Madhava Ghana Ghana Neela
Jaya Meera Prabhu Radhey Gopala
meaning: Victory, victory to you, enchanting Gopala, player of the sweet flute! O Giridhari, protector of Vrindavan, your dark blue form is like dense clouds. You are the beloved Lord of Meera and Radha, our divine Gopala.
devanagari:
जय जय मोहन मुरली गोपाला
जय गिरिधर ब्रिंदावन पाला [ जय जय मोहन ... ]
जय हे माधव घन घन नीला (2)
जय मीरा प्रभु राधे गोपाला
respell:
Jaya Jaya Mohan Muralī Gopālā
Jaya Giridhara Brindāvan Pālā [ Jaya Jaya Mohan ... ]
Jaya He Mādhava Ghan Ghan Nīlā (2)
Jaya Mīrā Prabhu Rādhe Gopālā

title: Jaya Jaya Raghu Nandana Jaya Janaki Jeevana
lyrics:
Jaya Jaya Raghu Nandana Jaya Janaki Jeevana
Sharanagata Palana Jaya Jagaddodharana
Rajeeva Dala Lochana Jaya Jagadanandana
Rajadhi Raja Ramachandra Sai Jaga Vandana
meaning: Victory to Lord Rama, the joy of the Raghu clan and life of Janaki, who protects all who surrender and uplifts the entire universe. O King of Kings, Ramachandra Sai, with lotus-petal eyes, you bring delight to the world and are worshipped by all.
devanagari:
जय जय रघु नंदना जय जानकी जीवना
शरणागत पालना जय जागतोद्धारणा [ जय जय ... ]
राजीव दल लोचन जय जगदानंदना
राजाधि राज रामचंद्र साई जग वंदना
respell:
Jaya Jaya Raghu Nandanā Jaya Jānakī Jīvanā
Sharaṇāgat Pālanā Jaya Jāgatoddhāraṇā [ Jaya Jaya ... ]
Rājīva Dala Lochana Jaya Jagadānandanā
Rājādhi Rāj Rāmachandra Sāī Jaga Vandanā

title: Jaya Jaya Ram Jagadabhi Ram
lyrics:
Jaya Jaya Ram Jagadabhi Ram
Hey Deena Bandhu Sai Ram
Jai Jai Ram Jai Jai Ram Sai Ram
Danava Bhanjana Dayamaya
Dayamaya Krupamaya
Alakha Niranjana Asura Nikhandana
Hey Deena Bandhu Sai Ram
Jai Jai Ram Jai Jai Ram Sai Ram
meaning: We celebrate Rama, the world's beloved and friend to the humble, O Sai Rama. He is the compassionate, pure, and unseen destroyer of all evil, brimming with grace and ever a protector of the distressed.
devanagari:
जय जय राम जगदभी राम
दीन बंधु साई राम (हे)
जय जय राम जय जय राम साई राम
दानव भंजन दयामया
दयामया कृपामया
अलख निरंजन असुर निखंडन
दीन बंधु साई राम (हे) [ जय जय राम ... ]
respell:
Jaya Jaya Rām Jagadabhī Rām
Dīna Bandhu Sāī Rām (he)
Jay Jay Rām Jaya Jay Rām Sāī rām
Dānava Bhañjana Dayāmayā
Dayāmayā Kṛupāmayā
Alakh Nirañjana Asur Nikhaṇḍana
Dīna Bandhu Sāī Rām (he) [ Jay Jay Rām ... ]

title: Jaya Jaya Rama Janaki Rama
lyrics:
Jaya Jaya Rama Janaki Rama
Raghukula Bhooshana Raja Rama [Jaya Jaya Rama ...']
Papa Ranjana Taraka Nama
Danava Bhanjana Kodanda Rama
meaning: Victory, victory to you, Rama, beloved of Janaki, the glorious king and jewel of the Raghu dynasty. Your sacred name delights ascetics and grants liberation, O Rama, who vanquishes demons with your mighty Kodanda bow.
devanagari:
जय जय रामा जानकी रामा
रघुकुल भूषण राजा रामा [जय जय रामा ...]
तपस रंजन तारक रामा
दानव भंजन कोदंड रामा
respell:
Jaya Jaya Rāmā Jānakī Rāmā
Raghukul Bhūshaṇ Rājā Rāmā [jaya Jaya Rāmā ...]
Tapasa Rañjana Tārak Rāmā
Dānava Bhañjana Kodaṇḍa Rāmā

title: Jaya Jaya Rama Jaya Raghu Rama Dasharatha Nandana Raja Rama
lyrics:
Jaya Jaya Rama Jaya Raghu Rama Dasharatha Nandana Raja Rama
Abhaya Pradayaka Ananda Dayaka
Tribhuvana Mohana Sita Rama
Danava Bhanjana Deenoddharana
Prema Sagara Sai Rama
meaning: Hail, O Rama, glorious descendant of Raghu, beloved son of Dasharatha, our sovereign King! You grant fearlessness and bestow divine joy, enchanting all three worlds alongside Sita. Destroyer of evil and savior of the humble, you are truly an ocean of boundless love, O Sai Rama.
devanagari:
जय जय रामा जय रघु रामा दशरथ नंदन राजा रामा
अभय प्रदायक आनंद दायक
त्रिभुवन मोहन सीता रामा
दानव भंजन दीनोद्धारण
प्रेमा सागरा साई रामा
respell:
Jaya Jaya Rāmā Jaya Raghu Rāmā Dasharath Nandana Rājā Rāmā
Abhaya Pradāyak Ānanda Dāyak
Tribhuvan Mohan Sītā Rāmā
Dānava Bhañjana Dīnoddhāraṇ
Premā Sāgarā Sāī Rāmā

title: Jaya Jaya Sadguru Sai Sadashiva
lyrics:
Jaya Jaya Sadguru Sai Sadashiva
Hara Hara Shankara Shambho Mahadeva
Neelakantha Sai Bhasma Vibhushita
Hara Hara Shankara Shambho Mahadeva
Parthipureeshwara Sai Maheshwara
Hara Hara Shankara Shambho Mahadeva (Sung in the audio)
meaning: Victory, victory to you, true Guru Sai Sadashiva! We hail you, Shankara, Shambho, Mahadeva, the blue-throated one adorned with sacred ash. Oh Lord of Parthi, Sai Maheshwara, we praise your divine form.
devanagari:
जय जय सद्गुरु साई सदाशिव
हर हर शंकर शंभो महादेव
नीलकंठ साई भस्म विभूषित
हर हर शंकर शंभो महादेव
पर्तीपूरीश्वर साई महेश्वर
हर हर शंकर शंभो महादेव
respell:
Jaya Jaya Sadguru Sāī Sadāshiv
Har Har Shaṅkar Shambho Mahādeva
Nīlakaṇṭh Sāī Bhasma Vibhūshit
Har Har Shaṅkar Shambho Mahādeva
Partīpūrīshwar Sāī Maheshwar
Har Har Shaṅkar Shambho Mahādeva

title: Jaya Jaya Sai Namo Jaya Shubha Dayi Namo
lyrics:
Jaya Jaya Sai Namo Jaya Shubha Dayi Namo
Jaya Govinda Jaya Gopala Jaya Mahadeva Namo
Abhaya Pradata Vishwa Vidata
Jagadoddhara Namo
Jaya Shirdeesha Jaya Partheesha Jaya Paramesha Namo
meaning: Oh glorious Sai, we offer our salutations to you, the bestower of all auspiciousness. You are Govinda, Gopala, and Mahadeva, the giver of fearlessness, the creator and uplifter of the entire universe. Victory to you, Lord of Shirdi and Parthi, our Supreme Divine!
devanagari:
जय जय साई नमो जय शुभ दाई नमो
जय गोविन्दा जय गोपाला जय महादेव नमो [ जय जय साई ... ]
अभय प्रदाता विश्व विधाता
जगतोद्धार नमो
जय शिरडीशा जय पर्तीशा जय परमेश नमो
respell:
Jaya Jaya Sāī Namo Jaya Shubh Dāī Namo
Jaya Govindā Jaya Gopālā Jaya Mahādeva Namo [ Jaya Jaya Sāī ... ]
Abhaya Pradātā Vishwa Vidhātā
Jagatoddhāra Namo
Jaya Shiraḍīshā Jaya Partīshā Jaya Paramesha Namo

title: Jaya Jaya Shankari Jaya Parameshwari
lyrics:
Jaya Jaya Shankari Jaya Parameshwari
Jaya Shiva Shankari Ma
Jaya Vishweshwari Jaya Sarveshwari
Vibhuti Sundari Ma
Jaya Ma Jaya Ma
Puttaparthi Pureeshwari Ma
Vibhuti Sundari Ma
meaning: Oh Mother Shankari, Supreme Goddess, consort of Shiva, we hail your victory! You are the sovereign of the universe, the ruler of all, radiant and beautiful with sacred ash. Victory to you, Divine Mother, the queen of Puttaparthi!
devanagari:
जय जय शंकरी जय परमेश्वरी
जय शिव शंकरी माँ
जय विश्वेश्वरी जय सर्वेश्वरी
विभूति सुंदरी माँ  
जय मा जय माँ  
पुट्टपर्ती पूरीश्वरी माँ [ विभूति ... ]
respell:
Jaya Jaya Shaṅkarī Jaya Parameshwarī
Jaya Shiv Shaṅkarī Mām̐
Jaya Vishweshwarī Jaya Sarweshwarī
Vibhūti Sundarī Mām̐
Jaya Mā Jaya Mām̐
Puṭṭapartī Pūrīshwarī Mām̐ [ Vibhūti ... ]

title: Jaya Kailashapate Shiva Shankara
lyrics:
Jaya Kailashapate Shiva Shankara
Samba Sadashiva Shambho
Partheeshwara Sai Shiva Shambho
Shaileshwara Karunamaya Shankara
Lingodbhavakara Shiva Shambho
Trishula Jatadhara Gangadhari
Halahala Dhara Shambho
Samba Sadashiva Shambho
Partheeshwara Sai Shiva Shambho
meaning: Oh Lord Shiva, ruler of Kailash and giver of peace, we praise you as Samba Sadashiva, the eternal source of joy. You are the compassionate Lord of mountains, who manifests the Lingam, bearing the trident, Ganga, and even the deadly Halahala poison. We bow to you, Sai Shiva Shambho, the divine Lord of Parthi.
devanagari:
जय कैलाशपते शिव शंकर
साम्ब सदाशिव शंभो
पर्तीश्वर साई शिव शंभो
शैलेश्वर करुणामय शंकर
लिंगोद्भवकर शिव शंभो
त्रिशूल जटाधर गंगाधारी
हालाहल धर शंभो
साम्ब सदाशिव शंभो
पर्तीश्वर साई शिव शंभो
respell:
Jaya Kailāshapate Shiv Shaṅkar
Sāmba Sadāshiv Shambho
Partīshwar Sāī Shiv Shambho
Shaileshwar Karuṇāmaya Shaṅkar
Liṅgodbhavakar Shiv Shambho
Trishūl Jaṭādhara Gaṅgādhārī
Hālāhal Dhara Shambho
Sāmba Sadāshiv Shambho
Partīshwar Sāī Shiv Shambho

title: Jaya Kausalya Nandana Ram Paramananda Ananda Ram
lyrics:
Jaya Kausalya Nandana Ram Paramananda Ananda Ram
Jaya Shirdeesha Partheesha Ram Jaya Prasanthi Sayeesha Ram
Mangala Pavana Nam Jaya Sundara Vaidehi Ram
Jaya Sundara Sayeesha Ram
meaning: Glory to the Son of Kausalya, One of Supreme Bliss, who dwells in Shirdi and Parthi. The name Ram is potentially Auspicious and He is the beloved of Mother Vaidehi.
devanagari:
जय कौसल्या नन्दन राम परमानन्द आनन्द राम
जय शिरडीश पर्तीश राम जय प्रशान्ती साईश राम
मंगल पावन नाम जय सुन्दर वैदेही राम
जय सुन्दर साईश राम
respell:
Jaya Kausalyā Nandana Rām Paramānanda Ānanda Rām
Jaya Shiraḍīsha Partīsha Rām Jaya Prashāntī Sāīsh Rām
Maṅgal Pāvan Nām Jaya Sundara Vaidehī Rām
Jaya Sundara Sāīsh Rām

title: Jaya Lambodhara Pahi Mam
lyrics:
Jaya Lambodhara Pahi Mam
Jagadamba Suta Raksha Mam
Sharanagata Raksha Mam
Hey Karuna Nidhe Pahi Mam
Sri Gananatha Samraksha Mam
Nija Bhakti Mudam Dehi Mam
meaning: Hail to Lord Ganesha, the large-bellied son of the Divine Mother; I seek your protection as one who has surrendered to you. O fount of compassion, please grant me your complete safeguard and the joy of true devotion.
devanagari:
जय लम्बोदरा पाहि माम  
जगदम्बा सुत रक्ष मााम [ जय लम्बोदरा ... ]  
शरणागत रक्ष मााम  
हे करुणा निधे पाहि माम  
श्री गणनाथकम रक्ष मााम  
निज भक्तिमुदं देहि माम
respell:
Jaya Lambodarā Pāhi Mām
Jagadambā Sut Raksha Māām [ Jaya Lambodarā ... ]
Sharaṇāgat Raksha Māām
He Karuṇā Nidhe Pāhi Mām
Shrī Gaṇanāthakam Raksha Māām
Nija Bhaktimudaṃ Dehi Mām

title: Jaya Ma Anandamayi Janani
lyrics:
Jaya Ma Anandamayi Janani
Sab Ko Krupa Karo Janani
Bhakta Janon Ke Mangala Karini
Mangala Karo Janani Ma
Tum Ho Prema Dayini Ma
Sab Ko Krupa Karo Janani
meaning: Hail to the Mother, full of divine bliss! Shower your grace upon everyone, O Mother, as you are the one who brings well-being to your devotees. You are truly the giver of pure love.
devanagari:
जय माँ आनंदमयी जननी
सब को कृपा करो जननी
भक्त जनों के मंगल करिणी
मंगल करो जननी (माँ)
तुम हो प्रेम दायिनी (माँ) [ सब को कृपा ... ]
respell:
Jaya Mām̐ Ānandamayī Jananī
Sab Ko Kṛupā Karo Jananī
Bhakta Janoṃ Ke Maṅgal Kariṇī
Maṅgal Karo Jananī (mām̐)
Tum Ho Prem Dāyinī (mām̐) [ Sab Ko Kṛupā ... ]

title: Jaya Ma Devi
lyrics:
Jaya Ma Devi
Sharanam Dehi
Gaana Vinodini Gowri Manohari
Ananda Dayini Ma
Adi Parashakthi Ma
Mata Rani Mata Rani Mata Rani Ambe Ma
Jai Jai Ma Jai Jai Ma
Ambe Ma Jai Jai Ma
Gowri Ma Jai Jai Ma
Jai Jai Ma Jai Jai Ma (4)

title: Jaya Ma Jaya Ma Daya Karo Sai Ma
lyrics:
Jaya Ma Jaya Ma Daya Karo Sai Ma
Mukti Pradayini Prema Pradayini Shanti Pradayini Ma
Janani Ma Janani Jagajjanani Sai Ma
Daya Karo Sai Ma Jaya Ma
Kripa Karo Sai Ma Jaya Ma
meaning: We hail the Divine Mother, Sai Ma, the benevolent bestower of liberation, love, and profound peace. O Universal Mother, we humbly seek your boundless compassion and grace.
devanagari:
जय माँ जय माँ दया करो साई माँ 
मुक्ति प्रदायिनी प्रेम प्रदायिनी शान्ति प्रदायिनी माँ
जननी मा जननी जगत जननी साई माँ
दया करो साई माँ जय माँ [ (सब को) कृपा ]
respell:
Jaya Mām̐ Jaya Mām̐ Dayā Karo Sāī Mām̐
Mukti Pradāyinī Prem Pradāyinī Shānti Pradāyinī Mām̐
Jananī Mā Jananī Jagat Jananī Sāī Mām̐
Dayā Karo Sāī Mām̐ Jaya Mām̐ [ (sab Ko) Kṛupā ]

title: Jaya Ma Jaya Ma Jagadeeshwari Sai Ma
lyrics:
Jaya Ma Jaya Ma Jagadeeshwari Sai Ma
Jagadeeshwari Maheshwari Sayeeshwari Sai Ma
Jaya Ma Jaya Ma Jagadeeshwari Sai Ma
Jagadeeshwari Maheshwari Sayeeshwari Sai Ma (2)
meaning: We celebrate Mother Sai, the divine ruler of the entire universe. She embodies the great Goddess, revered as Sayeeshwari.
devanagari:
जय माँ जय माँ जगदीश्वरी साई माँ
जगदीश्वरी महेश्वरी साईश्वरी साई माँ
जय माँ जय माँ, जगदीश्वरी साई माँ
जगदीश्वरी महेश्वरी साईश्वरी साई माँ (2)
respell:
Jaya Mām̐ Jaya Mām̐ Jagadīshwarī Sāī Mām̐
Jagadīshwarī Maheshwarī Sāīshwarī Sāī Mām̐
Jaya Mām̐ Jaya Mām̐, Jagadīshwarī Sāī Mām̐
Jagadīshwarī Maheshwarī Sāīshwarī Sāī Mām̐ (2)

title: Jaya Mana Mohana Krishna Murari
lyrics:
Jaya Mana Mohana Krishna Murari
Jaya Brindavana Kalimalahari
Jaya Jaya Giridhari Parthi Vihari
Deena Bandhu Karunakar Sharan Tumhari
Jaya Partheeshwara Sai Giridhari
meaning: Oh enchanting Krishna, slayer of demons and purifier of the age, You are the lifter of mountains and resident of Vrindavan and Parthi. Friend of the humble and embodiment of mercy, I take refuge in You, Lord Sai, the very essence of Giridhari.
devanagari:
जय मन मोहन कृष्ण मुरारी
जय वृंदावन कलिमलहारी
जय जय गिरिधारी पर्ति विहारी
दीन बंधु करुणाकर शरण तुम्हारी
जय पर्तीश्वर साई गिरिधारी
respell:
Jaya Mana Mohan Kṛushṇa Murārī
Jaya Vṛundāvan Kalimalahārī
Jaya Jaya Giridhārī Parti Vihārī
Dīna Bandhu Karuṇākar Sharaṇ Tumhārī
Jaya Partīshwar Sāī Giridhārī

title: Jaya Nandalala Jai Jai Gopala
lyrics:
Jaya Nandalala Jai Jai Gopala
Mohana Moorat Sai Gopala [ Jaya Nandalala ... ]
Jaya Brindavana Madana Gopala
Jaya Partheeshwara Sai Nandalala [ Mohana Moorat ... ]
meaning: Oh Nandalala, victorious Gopala, your enchanting form, Sai Gopala, fills our hearts. We hail you, the beloved of Vrindavan, Sai Nandalala, Lord of Parthi.
devanagari:
जय नंदलाला जय जय गोपाला
मोहन मूरत साई गोपाला [ जय नंदलाला ... ]
जय बृंदावन मदन गोपाला
जय पर्तीश्वरा साई नंदलाला [ मोहन मूर्त ... ]
respell:
Jaya Nandalālā Jay Jay Gopālā
Mohan Mūrat Sāī Gopālā [ Jaya Nandalālā ... ]
Jaya Bṛundāvan Madana Gopālā
Jaya Partīshwarā Sāī Nandalālā [ Mohan Mūrt ... ]

title: Jaya Narayana Jaya Hari Aum
lyrics:
Jaya Narayana Jaya Hari Aum
Sai Narayana Jaya Hari Aum [ Jaya Narayana ... ]
Brahma Shivaarchita Jaya Hari Aum
Paapa Vinashaka Jaya Hari Aum
Jaya Hari Aum (Aum) Jaya Hari Aum
meaning: Victory to Narayana, the divine Hari, and to Sai, whose sacred names we joyfully chant. You are the supreme Lord, revered even by Brahma and Shiva, and your grace utterly destroys all our sins.
devanagari:
जय नारायण जय हरि ॐ
साई नारायण जय हरि ॐ [ जय नारायण ... ]
ब्रह्म शिवार्चिता जय हरि ॐ
पाप विनाशक जय हरि ॐ
जय हरि ॐ (ॐ) जय हरि ॐ
respell:
Jaya Nārāyaṇ Jaya Hari Oṃ
Sāī Nārāyaṇ Jaya Hari Oṃ [ Jaya Nārāyaṇ ... ]
Brahma Shivārchitā Jaya Hari Oṃ
Pāpa Vināshak Jaya Hari Oṃ
Jaya Hari Oṃ (oṃ) Jaya Hari Oṃ

title: Jaya Narayana Jaya Hari Aum
lyrics:
Jaya Narayana Jaya Hari Aum
Hari Aum Hari Aum Hari Aum Sai Aum [ Jaya Narayana ... ]
Paramatma Jaya Hari Aum
Parabrahma Sai Hari Aum
Hari Aum Hari Aum Jaya (Sai) Hari Aum
meaning: Victory to Narayana, victory to Hari Om! We joyfully chant "Hari Om" and "Sai Om," for Sai is none other than the Supreme Soul, the Absolute Reality. All glory to Hari Om, the divine essence.
devanagari:
जय नारायण जय हरि ॐ  
हरि ॐ हरि ॐ हरि ॐ साई ॐ [ जय नारायण ... ]  
परमात्मा जय हरि ॐ  
परब्रह्म साई हरि ॐ  
हरि ॐ हरि ॐ जय (साई) हरि ॐ
respell:
Jaya Nārāyaṇ Jaya Hari Oṃ
Hari Oṃ Hari Oṃ Hari Oṃ Sāī Oṃ [ Jaya Nārāyaṇ ... ]
Paramātmā Jaya Hari Oṃ
Parabrahma Sāī Hari Oṃ
Hari Oṃ Hari Oṃ Jaya (sāī) Hari Oṃ

title: Jaya Narayana Sadguru Deva
lyrics:
Jaya Narayana Sadguru Deva
Gayana Nartana Priya Saideva
Nirakara Sakara Tum Hi Ho
Poorna Brahma Avatara Tum Hi Ho
Parthi Pureeshwara Sai Mahadeva
meaning: Victory to You, Divine Guru Sai, who embodies Narayana and Mahadeva, delighting in song and dance. O Lord of Parthi, You are both the formless and the manifest divine, the complete Brahman incarnate.
devanagari:
जय नारायण सद्गुरु देवा
गायन नर्तन प्रिय साईदेवा
निराकार साकार तुम्ही हो
पूर्ण ब्रह्म अवतार तुम्ही हो
पर्तीपूरीश्वर साई महादेवा
respell:
Jaya Nārāyaṇ Sadguru Devā
Gāyan Nartana Priy Sāīdevā
Nirākār Sākār Tumhī Ho
Pūrṇa Brahma Avatāra Tumhī Ho
Partīpūrīshwar Sāī Mahādevā

title: Jaya Panduranga Jaya Vitthala
lyrics:
Jaya Panduranga Jaya Vitthala
Jagaddodhara Hari Vitthala
Pandhari Natha Jaya Hari Vitthala
Purandara Vitthala Parama Dayala
meaning: Victory to you, Panduranga, O Vitthala! You are Hari Vitthala, the uplifter of the entire world and the Lord of Pandhari. O Vitthala, beloved of Purandara, you are boundlessly kind.
devanagari:
जय पाण्डुरङ्गा जय विट्ठला
जगद्दोधारा हरि विट्ठला
पंढरी नाथा जय हरि विट्ठला
पुरन्धर विट्ठला परम दयाला
respell:
Jaya Pāṇḍuraṅgā Jaya Viṭṭhalā
Jagaddodhārā Hari Viṭṭhalā
Paṇḍharī Nāthā Jaya Hari Viṭṭhalā
Purandhara Viṭṭhalā Param Dayālā

title: Jaya Panduranga Prabho Vitthala
lyrics:
Jaya Panduranga Prabho Vitthala
Jagaddodhara Hari Vitthala
Panduranga Vitthala Pandari Natha Vitthala
Sri Ramani Hrudayanta Ranga
Mangala Kara Karunanta Ranga
Asrita Deena Janavana Ranga
Jagadoddhara Hari Vitthala
Panduranga Vitthala Pandhari Natha Vitthala (2)
----
Panduranga Vitthala Pandhari Natha Vitthala (4)
meaning: Hail to Lord Vitthala, the divine ruler of Pandharpur and savior of the universe. He resides in Lakshmi's heart, embodying all auspiciousness and boundless compassion. This benevolent Lord offers protection to the humble and dependent.
devanagari:
जय पांडुरंग प्रभो विट्ठला
जगतोद्धारा हरि विट्ठला
पांडुरंग विट्ठला पंढरी नाथ विट्ठला
श्री रमणी हृदयांतरंगा
मंगल कर करुणांतरंगा
आश्रित दीन जनावन रंगा
जगतोद्धारा हरि विट्ठला
पांडुरंग विट्ठला पंढरी नाथ विट्ठला
----
पांडुरंग विट्ठला पंढरी नाथ विट्ठला
respell:
Jaya Pāṇḍuraṅg Prabho Viṭṭhalā
Jagatoddhārā Hari Viṭṭhalā
Pāṇḍuraṅg Viṭṭhalā Paṇḍharī Nātha Viṭṭhalā
Shrī Ramaṇī Hṛudayanta Raṅgā
Maṅgal Karā Karuṇānta Raṅgā
Āshrit Dīnā Janavānā Raṅgā
Jagadodharā Hari Viṭṭhalā
Pāṇḍuraṅg Viṭṭhalā Paṇḍharī Nātha Viṭṭhalā (2)
---
Pāṇḍuraṅg Viṭṭhalā Paṇḍharī Nātha Viṭṭhalā (4)

title: Jaya Partheesha Jaya Paramesha
lyrics:
Jaya Partheesha Jaya Paramesha
Jaya Sayeesha Namo
Abhaya Pradata Prema Pradata
Jaya Sayeesha Namo
Karuna Sagara Hey Paramesha
Jaya Sayeesha Namo
meaning: Oh Lord of Parthi, Supreme Master, victory to You, Lord Sai, we offer our salutations. You are the bestower of fearlessness and divine love, an ocean of compassion, to whom we humbly bow.
devanagari:
जय पर्तीशा जय परमेशा
जय साईश नमो
अभय प्रदाता प्रेम प्रदाता
जय साईश नमो
करुणा सागर हे परमेशा
जय साईश नमो
respell:
Jaya Partīshā Jaya Parameshā
Jaya Sāīsh Namo
Abhaya Pradātā Prem Pradātā
Jaya Sāīsh Namo
Karuṇā Sāgar He Parameshā
Jaya Sāīsh Namo

title: Jaya Partheesha Jaya Paramesha
lyrics:
Jaya Partheesha Jaya Paramesha
Jaya Gaureesha Jaya Gangadhara
Jatadhara Shiva Sai Shankara
Vijayee Bhava Tava Sharanam Dehi
Sharanam Dehi
meaning: Victory to you, Lord of Parthi, Supreme Lord, consort of Gauri and bearer of the Ganga! O Shiva with matted locks, Sai Shankara, be ever victorious, and grant me your divine refuge.
devanagari:
जय पर्तीशा जय परमेशा
जय गौरीशा जय गंगाधर
जटाधरा शिव साई शंकर
विजयी भव तव शरणम् देहि
शरणम् देहि
respell:
Jaya Partīshā Jaya Parameshā
Jaya Gaurīshā Jaya Gaṅgādhara
Jaṭādharā Shiv Sāī Shaṅkar
Vijayī Bhava Tava Sharaṇam Dehi
Sharaṇam Dehi

title: Jaya Radha Madhava Jaya Kunja Vihari
lyrics:
Jaya Radha Madhava Jaya Kunja Vihari
Jaya Gopijana Vallabha Jaya Girivara Dhari [ Jaya Radha ... ]
Yashoda Nandana Vraja Jana Ranjana (2)
Yamuna Teera Vihari
Hare Rama Hare Rama Rama Rama Hare Hare
meaning: Oh Radha and Madhava, victory to you who delight in Vrindavan's sacred groves! Beloved of the Gopis, you lifted the great mountain, bringing joy to Vraja as Yashoda's son, sporting by the Yamuna's banks. We also invoke the sacred names of Rama.
devanagari:
जय राधा माधव जय कुंज विहारी
जय गोपीजन वल्लभ जय गिरिवर धारी [ जय राधा ... ]
यशोदा नंदन व्रज जन रंजन (२)
यमुना तीर विहारी
हरे राम हरे राम राम राम हरे हरे
respell:
Jaya Rādhā Mādhava Jaya Kuñj Vihārī
Jaya Gopījana Vallabh Jaya Girivar Dhārī [ Jaya Rādhā ... ]
Yashodā Nandana Vraj Jana Rañjana (2)
Yamunā Tīra Vihārī
Hare Rām Hare Rām Rām Rām Hare Hare

title: Jaya Raghu Nandana Jaya Jaya Rama
lyrics:
Jaya Raghu Nandana Jaya Jaya Rama
Jaya Jagat Janani Janaki Rama
Nava Nava Komala Megha Shyama
Bhava Harana Bhadrachala Dhama
meaning: Victory to Rama whose consort is Janaki, the Mother of Universe. Victory to the one who is ever new and fresh, the one who is of deep blue complexion, the Lord of Bhadrachala (pilgrim city in Andhra Pradesh) who destroys the cycle of Birth.
devanagari:
जय रघु नंदन जय जय रामा
जय जग जननी जानकी रामा [ जय रघु नंदन ... ]
नव नव कोमल मेघ श्यामा
भव हरणा भद्राचल रामा
respell:
Jaya Raghu Nandana Jaya Jaya Rāmā
Jaya Jag Jananī Jānakī Rāmā [ Jaya Raghu Nandana ... ]
Nava Nava Komala Megha Shyāmā
Bhava Haraṇā Bhadrāchala Rāmā

title: Jaya Rama Hare Jaya Rama Hare Jaya Sita Rama Hare
lyrics:
Jaya Rama Hare Jaya Rama Hare Jaya Sita Rama Hare
Jaya Krishna Hare Jaya Krishna Hare Jaya Radha Krishna Hare
Jaya Sai Hare Jaya Sai Hare Jaya Sai Baba Hare
meaning:
Hail the Lord Rama and Mother Sita!Victory to Lord Krishna and His dearest devotee Radha!
 Hail the Lord! Victory to Sai Baba!
devanagari:
जय राम हरे जय राम हरे जय सीता राम हरे
जय कृष्ण हरे जय कृष्ण हरे जय राधा कृष्ण हरे
जय साई हरे जय साई हरे जय साई बाबा हरे
respell:
Jaya Rām Hare Jaya Rām Hare Jaya Sītā Rām Hare
Jaya Kṛushṇa Hare Jaya Kṛushṇa Hare Jaya Rādhā Kṛushṇa Hare
Jaya Sāī Hare Jaya Sāī Hare Jaya Sāī Bābā Hare

title: Jaya Rama Janaki Rama
lyrics:
Jaya Rama Janaki Rama
Jaya Rama Sai Rama
Jaya Rama Sri Raghu Rama
Jaya Rama Sai Rama
Jaya Rama Sita Rama
Jaya Rama Sai Rama
meaning: Victory to Lord Rama of Raghu clan, whose consort is Janaki, also known as Sita. Lord Rama has incarnated in this age as Lord Sai Rama.
devanagari:
जय राम जानकी रामा
जय राम साई रामा
जय राम श्री रघु रामा
जय राम साई रामा
जय राम सीता रामा
जय राम साई रामा
respell:
Jaya Rām Jānakī Rāmā
Jaya Rām Sāī Rāmā
Jaya Rām Shrī Raghu Rāmā
Jaya Rām Sāī Rāmā
Jaya Rām Sītā Rāmā
Jaya Rām Sāī Rāmā

title: Jaya Rama Raghu Rama
lyrics:
Jaya Rama Raghu Rama
Ranadheera Sukumara
Raghupati Raghava Raja Rama
Rajeeva Lochana Rama Rama
meaning: Victory to Lord Rama, scion of the Raghu dynasty. He is the ideal king, ever youthful, and courageous in the battlefield. He brings joy to people with his soft and kind looks, which resemble lotus flower. (Lotus eyed)
devanagari:
जय रामा रघु रामा
रणधीरा सुकुमारा
रघुपति राघव राजा रामा
राजीव लोचन रामा रामा
respell:
Jaya Rāmā Raghu Rāmā
Raṇadhīrā Sukumārā
Raghupati Rāghav Rājā Rāmā
Rājīva Lochana Rāmā Rāmā

title: Jaya Sai Gurudeva Sai Gurudeva
lyrics:
Jaya Sai Gurudeva Sai Gurudeva
Guru Seva Bina Nirvana Nahin Jaya Sai Guru Deva
Tum Hi Ho Mata Pita Tum Hi Ho Sai Guru Deva
Sathya Swaroopa Rah Dikhao Sai Guru Deva
Guru Seva Bina Nirvana Nahin Jaya Sai Guru Deva
meaning: Victory to the divine master, Sai. There is no salvation without service to the master. You are the mother, father and the one who guides us along the spiritual journey. You are the embodiment of Truth.
devanagari:
जय साई गुरु देवा साई गुरु देवा
गुरु सेवा बिना निर्वाण नहीं जय साई गुरु देवा [ जय साई ... ]
तुम ही हो माता पिता तुम ही हो साई गुरु देवा
सत्य स्वरूपा राह दिखाओ साई गुरु देवा [ गुरु सेवा ... ]
respell:
Jaya Sāī Guru Devā Sāī Guru Devā
Guru Sevā Binā Nirwāṇ Nahīṃ Jaya Sāī Guru Devā [ Jaya Sāī ... ]
Tum Hī Ho Mātā Pitā Tum Hī Ho Sāī Guru Devā
Satya Swarūpā Rāh Dikhāo Sāī Guru Devā [ Guru Sevā ... ]

title: Jaya Sai Guru Deva Sai Guru Deva
lyrics:
Jaya Sai Guru Deva Sai Guru Deva
Guru Seva Bina Nirvana Nahin Jaya Sai Guru Deva [ Jaya Sai ... ]
Tum Hi Ho Mata Pitha Tum Hi Ho Sai Guru Deva
Sathya Swaroopa Raaha Dikhao Sai Guru Deva [ Guru Seva ... ]
meaning: O Divine Guru Sai, victory to you! True liberation cannot be attained without devoted service to the Guru. You are our Mother and Father, O Sai, the very embodiment of Truth; please illuminate our path.
devanagari:
जय साई गुरु देवा साई गुरु देवा
गुरु सेवा बिना निर्वाण नहीं जय साई गुरु देवा [ जय साई ... ]
तुम ही हो माता पिता तुम ही हो साई गुरु देवा
सत्य स्वरूप राह दिखाओ साई गुरु देवा [ गुरु सेवा ... ]
respell:
Jaya Sāī Guru Devā Sāī Guru Devā
Guru Sevā Binā Nirwāṇ Nahīṃ Jaya Sāī Guru Devā [ Jaya Sāī ... ]
Tum Hī Ho Mātā Pitā Tum Hī Ho Sāī Guru Devā
Satya Swarūp Rāh Dikhāo Sāī Guru Devā [ Guru Sevā ... ]

title: Jaya Sai Rama Jaya Raghu Rama
lyrics:
Jaya Sai Rama Jaya Raghu Rama
Hey Jaya Sai Rama Jaya Raghu Rama [ Jaya Sai ... ]
Dukhiyon Ke Daata Sai Rama
Premavatara Sai Rama
Shantha Swaroopa Sai Rama [ Hey Jaya ... ]
meaning: Hail to Sai Rama, hail to Raghu Rama! Oh Sai Rama, you are the generous provider to the distressed, an avatar of boundless love. You are the very form of peace, and we sing your glorious name.
devanagari:
जय साई रामा जय रघु रामा
हे जय साई रामा जय रघु रामा [ जय साई ... ]
दुखियों के दाता साई रामा
प्रेमावतारा साई रामा
शान्त स्वरूपा साई रामा [ हे जय ... ]
respell:
Jaya Sāī Rāmā Jaya Raghu Rāmā
He Jaya Sāī Rāmā Jaya Raghu Rāmā [ Jaya Sāī ... ]
Dukhiyoṃ Ke Dātā Sāī Rāmā
Premāvatārā Sāī Rāmā
Shānta Swarūpā Sāī Rāmā [ He Jaya ... ]

title: Jaya Sai Shankara Jaya Abhayankara
lyrics:
Jaya Sai Shankara Jaya Abhayankara
Samba Sadashiva Shiva Hara Hey Shiva Hara Hey Shiva Hara Hey
Jaya Gangadhara Jaya Bimbadhara
Vyagrambara Dhara Shiva Hara Hey Shiva Hara Hey Shiva Hara Hey
meaning: Victory to Lord Sai Shankara, the conferer of auspiciousness and divine protection. I seek refuge refuge in Him, who holds the Divine Mother Ganga in His matted hair, whose lips resemble bimba fruit, who wears tiger skin as his clothes and is always in the divine communion of Mother Goddess.
devanagari:
जय साई शंकर जय अभयंकर
सांब सदाशिव शिव हर हे शिव हर हे शिव हर हे [ जय साई ... ]
जय गंगाधर जय बिम्बाधर
व्याघ्रंबर धर शिव हर हे शिव हर हे शिव हर हे
respell:
Jaya Sāī Shaṅkar Jaya Abhayaṅkar
Sāmb Sadāshiv Shiv Har He Shiv Har He Shiv Har He [ Jaya Sāī ... ]
Jaya Gaṅgādhara Jaya Bimbādhara
Vyāghrambara Dhara Shiv Har He Shiv Har He Shiv Har He

title: Jaya Sayeesha Jaya Sayeesha
lyrics:
Jaya Sayeesha Jaya Sayeesha
Radha Madhava Jaya Partheesha
Hrudaya Sarathi Sai Kanhaiya
Radhe Govinda Prasanthi Nilaya
meaning: Victory to Lord Sai, who is verily Lord Krishna incarnated again on Earth, who is the charioteer of the Spiritual Heart and dwells at Prashanthi Nilayam in Parthi.
devanagari:
जय साईशा जय साईशा
राधा माधव जय पर्तीशा
हृदय सारथी साई कन्हैया
राधे गोविंदा प्रशांती निलया
respell:
Jaya Sāīshā Jaya Sāīshā
Rādhā Mādhava Jaya Partīshā
Hṛudaya Sārathī Sāī Kanhaiyā
Rādhe Govindā Prashāntī Nilayā

title: Jaya Shankara Bhava Gochara Shiva Chidambara Omkara
lyrics:
Jaya Shankara Bhava Gochara Shiva Chidambara Omkara
Parthi Vihara Papa Vidoora
Jagadoddhara Brahmapara
meaning: Glory to Shankara the Lord of Chidambaram, who is beyond senses and is personified as Omkaram, the Supreme Brahman. You are the Lord of Parthi, who removes all sin and uplift the World.
devanagari:
जया शंकरा भाव गोचरा शिव चिदम्बरा ओंकारा
पर्ति विहारा पाप विदुरा
जगतोद्धारा ब्रह्मपरा (3)
respell:
Jayā Shaṅkarā Bhāva Gocharā Shiv Chidambarā Oṅkārā
Parti Vihārā Pāpa Vidurā
Jagatoddhārā Brahmaparā (3)

title: Jaya Sri Ganesha Vighna Nasha Gajanana
lyrics:
Jaya Sri Ganesha Vighna Nasha Gajanana
Vidya Buddhi Sarva Siddhi Suranjana [Jaya Sri Ganesha]
Jaya Heramba Sri Jagadamba Nandana
Eka Danta Dayavanta Shubhanana
Mangala Dayaka Sri Vinayaka Vandana
meaning: Glory to the Lord of Ganas; the destroyer of obstacles, who has the head of an Elephant, conferring scholarship, intelligence and power. Glory to the son of Jagadamba, who is single tusked and compassionate bestower of auspiciousness. I bow to thee O Vinayaka, the unparalleled leader.
devanagari:
जय श्री गणेशा विघ्न नाश गजानना
विद्या बुद्धि सर्व सिद्धि सुरंजना [ जय श्री ... ]
जय हेरम्बा श्री जगदम्बा नंदना
एक दंता दयावंत शुभानना
मंगल दायक श्री विनायक वंदना
respell:
Jaya Shrī Gaṇesha Vighna Nāsha Gajānanā
Vidyā Buddhi Sarwa Siddhi Surañjanā [ Jaya Shrī ... ]
Jaya Herambā Shrī Jagadambā Nandanā
Ek Dānta Dayāvant Shubhananā
Maṅgal Dāyak Shrī Vināyak Vandanā

title: Jaya Vijayee Bhava Jaya Vijayee Bhava
lyrics:
Jaya Vijayee Bhava Jaya Vijayee Bhava
Bhava Bhaya Nasha Hanumanta
Pavana Kumara Pavana Veera
Ati Balavanta Hanumanta
Anjaniputra Veeranjaneya
Niranjana Vijayee Bhava
meaning: Victory to the One who removes the wordly fear of repetitive births.The son of Pavana and Anjana Devi is blemish-less and one of extraordinary strength.
devanagari:
जय विजयी भव जय विजयी भव
भव भय नाशा हनुमन्ता
पवन कुमारा पावन वीरा
अति बलावन्ता हनुमन्ता
अञ्जनी पुत्र वीरञ्जनेया
निरञ्जना विजयी भव (बोलो) (2)
respell:
Jaya Vijayī Bhava Jaya Vijayī Bhava
Bhava Bhaya Nāshā Hanumantā
Pavan Kumārā Pāvan Vīrā
Ati Balāvantā Hanumantā
Añjanī Putra vīrañjaneyā
Nirañjanā Vijayī Bhava (bolo) (2)

title: Jayatu Jayatu Rama Janani Janaki Rama
lyrics:
Jayatu Jayatu Rama Janani Janaki Rama
Janana Marana Bhaya Klesha Vinashaka
Raghupati Sita Rama Rama Rameti Rama
meaning: Victory to Lord Rama, consort of Mother Janaki, the One who destroys fear of birth, the Emperor of Raghu dynasty
devanagari:
जयतु जयतु रामा जननी जानकी रामा
जनन मरण भय क्लेश विनाशक
रघुपति सीता रामा रामा रामेति रामा
respell:
Jayatu Jayatu Rāmā Jananī Jānakī Rāmā
Janana Maraṇ Bhaya Klesh Vināshak
Raghupati Sītā Rāmā Rāmā Rāmeti Rāmā

title: Jayatu Shiva Natana Shiva
lyrics:
Jayatu Shiva Natana Shiva
Jaya Jagadeesha Mahesha Shiva [Jayatu Shiva]
Bhasma Vibhushita Phala Shashidhara
Pingala Lochana Ganga Mohana
Pinaka Vaibhava Sai Shankara
meaning: Sing the glories of the Lord of Dance, Lord Shiva, the Universal and Sovereign Lord. Shiva has the Sacred Ash smeared all over His body, the Crescent Moon on His forehead, has brown-colored eyes, charms Mother Ganges and holds the Bow (Pinaka) in His hand. Lord Sai is none other than Lord Shiva.
devanagari:
जयतु शिवा नटन शिवा
जय जगदीश महेश शिवा [जयतु शिवा]
भस्म विभूषित फाल शशिधरा
पिंगल लोचन गंगा मोहन
पिनाक वैभव साई शंकर
respell:
Jayatu Shivā Naṭana Shivā
Jaya Jagadīsha Mahesh Shivā [jayatu Shivā]
Bhasma Vibhūshit Phāla Shashidharā
Piṅgal Lochana Gaṅgā Mohan
Pināka Vaibhava Sāī Shaṅkar

title: Jeevan Jyot Jalao Kanhaiya
lyrics:
Jeevan Jyot Jalao Kanhaiya
Jo Kuch Mere Sab Hai Tera
Daya Karo Mujhe Hey Sai Shyama
Sharan Lagalo Mujhe Krishna Kanhaiya
Hey Anatha Natha Sri Sai Natha
meaning: Light the Lamp of my Life, O Young Krishna, I owe everything to You. O Lord, accept me into Your fold and bless me with Your Grace. You are none other than Lord Sai, the refuge of the forlorn.
devanagari:
जीवन ज्योत जलाओ कन्हैया
जो कुछ मेरे सब है तेरा
दया करो मुझे हे साई श्यामा
शरण लगालो मुझे कृष्ण कन्हैया
हे अनाथ नाथा श्री साई नाथा
respell:
Jīvan Jyot Jalāo Kanhaiyā
Jo Kuchh Mere Sab Hai Terā
Dayā Karo Mujhe He Sāī Shyāmā
Sharaṇ Lagālo Mujhe Kṛushṇa Kanhaiyā
He Anātha Nāthā Shrī Sāī Nāthā

title: Jeevan Jyoti Tum Ho Sai
lyrics:
Jeevan Jyoti Tum Ho Sai
Prem Ki Jyot Jalao Sai Prem Ki Jyot Jalao
Jeevan Ke In Andhiyaron Mein Sai Deep Jalao
Sai Deep Jalao Sathya Sai Deep Jalao
Prem Ki Jyot Jalao Sai Prem Ki Jyot Jalao
meaning: O Sai, You Are The Lamp Of Life That Burns Within Us. Please Light The Lamp Of Love In Us To Cross The Dark Crevices Of This Turbulent World.
devanagari:
जीवन ज्योति तुम हो साई
प्रेम की ज्योत जलाओ साई प्रेम की ज्योत जलाओ
जीवन के इन अंधियारों में साई दीप जलाओ
साई दीप जलाओ सत्य साई दीप जलाओ
प्रेम की ज्योत जलाओ साई प्रेम की ज्योत जलाओ
respell:
Jīvan Jyoti Tum Ho Sāī
Prem Kī Jyot Jalāo Sāī Prem Kī Jyot Jalāo
Jīvan Ke In Andhiyāroṃ Meṃ Sāī Dīp Jalāo
Sāī Dīp Jalāo Satya Sāī Dīp Jalāo
Prem Kī Jyot Jalāo Sāī Prem Kī Jyot Jalāo

title: Kalateetaya Siddhi Rupaya Yogeeshwaraya Namo
lyrics:
Kalateetaya Siddhi Rupaya Yogeeshwaraya Namo
Jagat Hitaya Vishwa Roopaya
Sayeeshwaraya Namo
Sathya Sayeeshwaraya Namo
Om Namah Shivaya Shivaya Namah Om
meaning: We bow to the Lord of Yogis, to the one who is beyond time and considerate. We bow to Lord Sai who has the Universe as His form, to Lord Sri Sathya Sai who is Lord Shiva, the embodiment of OM.
devanagari:
कालातीताय सिद्धि रूपाय योगीश्वराय नमो  
जगधीताय विश्व रूपाय  
(सत्य) साईश्वराय नमो  
ॐ नमः शिवाय शिवाय नमः ॐ (5)
respell:
Kālātītāya Siddhi Rūpāya Yogīshwarāy Namo
Jagadhītāya Vishwa Rūpāya
(satya) Sāīshwarāy Namo
Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy Shivāy Namaḥ Oṃ (5)

title: Kali Kali Mahakali Kapalini
lyrics:
Kali Kali Mahakali Kapalini
Durga Durga Devi Durga Bhavani
Mangala Gauri Mata Maheshwari
Raja Rajeshwari Lakshmi (Sai) Narayani
meaning: Salutations to Mother Kali, the dark complexioned, ferocious, wearing a garland of skulls. She is Durga Bhavani the destroyer of evil. She is the Lord of Emperors also known as Maheshwari, Gowri, Lakshmi and Narayani the bestower of Auspiciousness.
devanagari:
काली काली महाकाली कपालिनी
दुर्गा दुर्गा देवी दुर्गा भवानी [काली काली]
मंगल गौरी माता महेश्वरी
राज राजेश्वरी लक्ष्मी (साई) नारायणी
respell:
Kālī Kālī Mahākālī Kapālinī
Durgā Durgā Devī Durgā Bhavānī [kālī kālī]
Maṅgal Gaurī Mātā Maheshwarī
Rāj Rājeshwarī Lakshmī (sāī) Nārāyaṇī

title: Kab Loge Khabar More Ram
lyrics:
Kab Loge Khabar More Ram
Mujhe Apna Banalo Ghana Shyam
Sai Ram Sai Ram
Ghana Shyam Ghana Shyam
Sai Ram Ram Ram Sai Ram
Ghana Shyam Shyam Shyam Ghana Shyam
meaning: When will you take notice of me Oh Lord Ram? Let me merge in you Oh dark complexioned Shyam. Chant repeatedly the name of Lord Sai Ram, Ghana Shyam.
devanagari:
कब लोगे खबर मोरे राम
मुझे अपना बनालो घन श्याम
साई राम साई राम
घनश्याम घनश्याम
साई राम राम राम साई राम
घनश्याम श्याम श्याम घनश्याम
respell:
Kab Loge Khabar More Rām
Mujhe Apanā Banālo Ghan Shyām
Sāī Rām Sāī Rām
Ghan Shyām Ghan Shyām
Sāī Rām Rām Rām Sāī Rām
Ghan Shyām Shyām Shyām Ghan Shyām

title: Kailasa Nathaya Namah Om
lyrics:
Kailasa Nathaya Namah Om
Vaikuntha Vasaya Namah Om
Parthipureeshaya Namah Om
Sri Sai Devaya Namah Om
meaning: Salutations to Lord Sai, Lord of Puttaparthi, who is verily Lord Shiva, the Lord of Kailasa and Lord Narayana, the resident of Vaikunta.
devanagari:
कैलाश नाथाय नमः ॐ
वैकुण्ठ वासाय नमः ॐ
पर्तीपुरीशाय नमः ॐ
श्री साई देवाय नमः ॐ
respell:
Kailāsh Nāthāya Namaḥ Oṃ
Vaikuṇṭha Vāsāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Partīpurīshāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Shrī Sāī Devāy Namaḥ Oṃ

title: Kailasa Pathey Mahadeva Shambho
lyrics:
Kailasa Pathey Mahadeva Shambho
Hari Aum Namah Shivaya (2)
Hey Shiva Shankara Sai Shankara Aum Namah Shivaya
Hey Tripurari Bhava Bhaya Haari Aum Namah Shivaya
Hey Pralayankara Hara Hara Shankara Aum Namah Shivaya
Aum Namah Shivaya Sai Aum Namah Shivaya (2)
Shivaya Namah Aum Namah Shivaya
meaning: Oh Lord Shiva, master of Kailasa, great auspicious one, we salute you with the sacred chant "Om Namah Shivaya." You are the benevolent Sai Shankara, the vanquisher of evil, who dispels the fear of worldly existence and brings about ultimate dissolution.
devanagari:
कैलास पते महादेव शम्भो
हरि ॐ नमः शिवाय (2)
हे शिव शंकर साई शंकर ॐ नमः शिवाय
हे त्रिपुरारी भव भय हारी ॐ नमः शिवाय
हे प्रलयंकर हर हर शंकर ॐ नमः शिवाय
ॐ नमः शिवाय साई ॐ नमः शिवाय (2)
शिवाय नमः ॐ नमः शिवाय
respell:
Kailās Pate Mahādeva Shambho
Hari Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy (2)
He Shiv Shaṅkar Sāī Shaṅkar Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy
He Tripurārī Bhava Bhaya Hārī Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy
He Pralayaṅkar Har Har Shaṅkar Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy
Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy Sāī Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy (2)
Shivāy Namaḥ Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy

title: Kailasavasa Gangadhara
lyrics:
Kailasavasa Gangadhara
Ananda Tandava Sadashiva
Himagirivasa Samba Shiva
Ganapati Sevita He Jagadeesha
Sharavana Sevita He Paramesha
Shaila Gireeshwara Uma Mahesha
Neela Lochana Natana Natesha
Ananda Tandava Sadashiva
Himagirivasa Samba Shiva
meaning:
The blue-eyed Lord of the Mother Ganga 
dwells and resides in Kailas Mountain 
in the Himalayan ranges,
Whose Consort is Amba
and
as the Lord of Dance,
He performs the Celestial Dance of Bliss.
The Lord of the Universe is served by
His sons Sri Ganpati and Sri Sharavan.
devanagari:
कैलास वासा गंगाधरा  
आनंद तांडव सदाशिवा
हिमगिरी वासा सांब शिवा [ कैलास वासा ... ]  
गणपति सेवित हे जगदीशा
शरवण सेवित हे परमेशा
शैल गिरिश्वर उमा महेशा  
नील लोचना नट नटेशा [ आनंद तांडव ... ]
respell:
Kailās Vāsā Gaṅgādharā
Ānanda Tāṇḍava Sadāshivā
Himagirī Vāsā Sāmb Shivā [ Kailās Vāsā ... ]
Gaṇapati Sevit He Jagadīshā
Sharavaṇ Sevit He Parameshā
Shail Girishwar Umā Maheshā
Nīla Lochanā Naṭa Naṭeshā [ Ānanda Tāṇḍava ... ]

title: Kalavati Kali Kapalini
lyrics:
Kalavati Kali Kapalini
Devi Saraswati Veda Narayani
Mangala Gauri Mata Maheshwari
Jagadoddharini Durga Bhavani
meaning: Oh graceful Kali, fierce and adorned with skulls, and Goddess Saraswati, embodiment of the Vedas and all knowledge! Auspicious Mother Gauri, the great Maheshwari, you are Durga Bhavani, the true savior of the universe.
devanagari:
कलावती काली कपालिनी
देवी सरस्वती वेद नारायणी
मंगल गौरी माता महेश्वरी
जगदोद्धारिणी दुर्गा भवानी
respell:
Kalāvatī Kālī Kapālinī
Devī Saraswatī Ved Nārāyaṇī
Maṅgal Gaurī Mātā Maheshwarī
Jagadoddhāriṇī Durgā Bhavānī

title: Kalimala Bhanjana Kodanda Rama
lyrics:
Kalimala Bhanjana Kodanda Rama
Karunantaranga Kaivalya Dhama
Maya Manusha Munijana Prema
Madhura Manohara Mangala Dhama
Parthipureesha Prabhu Paramatma
Patita Pavana Pattabhi Rama
meaning:
Lord Rama with his bow who destroys the evil effects of Kali Age, is compassionate and grants liberation.
Lord Rama who is loved by holy men loves has an elusive form of a human being. He is the most enchanting one and the very abode of auspiciousness.
The emancipator of the downtrodden, the cosmic consciousness who earlier was the King of Ayodhya came again as the Lord of Puttaparthi.
devanagari:
कलिमल भंजन कोदंड रामा
करुणान्त रंगा कैवल्य धामा [ कलिमल भंजन ... ]
माया मानुष मुनिजन प्रेमा
मधुर मनोहर मंगल नामा
पर्तिपूरीशा प्रभु परमात्मा
पतित पावन पट्टाभि रामा
respell:
Kalimala Bhañjana Kodaṇḍa Rāmā
Karuṇānta Raṅgā Kaivalya dhāmā [ kalimala bhañjana ... ]
Māyā Mānusha Munijana Premā
Madhura Manohar Maṅgal Nāmā
Partipūrīshā Prabhu Paramātmā
Patita Pāvan Paṭṭābhi Rāmā

title: Kaliyuga Avatara Sai Bhagawan
lyrics:
Kaliyuga Avatara Sai Bhagawan
Krupa Nidhe Deenon Ke Pran
Eshwaramba Nandana Sai Bhagawan
Antaryami Sai Bhagawan
Karuna Sindhu Sai Bhagawan
Parthipureeshwara Sai Bhagawan
meaning: Oh Lord Sai, divine incarnation of the Kali Yuga, you are the treasure of grace and the very life of the humble. Son of Eshwaramba, you dwell within all hearts, an ocean of compassion, the Lord of Puttaparthi.
devanagari:
कलियुग अवतार साई भगवान
कृपा निधे दीनों के प्राण
ईश्वराम्बा नंदन साई भगवान
अंतर्यामी साई भगवान
करुणा सिंधु साई भगवान
पर्तीपूरीश्वर साई भगवान
respell:
Kaliyug Avatāra Sāī Bhagavān
Kṛupā Nidhe Dīnoṃ Ke Prāṇ
Īshwarāmbā Nandana Sāī Bhagavān
Antaryāmī Sāī Bhagavān
Karuṇā Sindhu Sāī Bhagavān
Partīpūrīshwar Sāī Bhagavān

title: Kalyana Krishna Kamaneeya Krishna
lyrics:
Kalyana Krishna Kamaneeya Krishna
Kaleeya Mardana Sri Krishna
Govardhana Giridhari Murari Gopi Mana Sanchari
Murari Gopi Mana Sanchari 
Brindavan Ki Tulasi Mala
Peetambara Dhari Murari
meaning: Enchanting and beautiful is the form of Lord Krishna who subdued the ego of serpent kaliya. The destroyer of demon Mura, Lord Krishna, holds Govardhan mountain, wears the garland of tulasi of holy Vrindavan and is ever etched in the hearts of Gopis (cowherds of Vrindavan) with His beautiful form adorned by silk.
devanagari:
कल्याण कृष्णा कमनीय कृष्णा
कालिया नर्तन श्री कृष्णा
गोवर्धन गिरिधारी मुरारी गोपी मन संचारि
मुरारी गोपी मन संचारि
ब्रिंदावन के तुलसी माला
पीताम्बर धारी मुरारी
respell:
Kalyāṇ Kṛushṇā Kamanīya Kṛushṇā
Kāliyā Nartana Shrī Kṛushṇā
Govardhana Giridhārī Murārī Gopī Mana Sañchāri
Murārī Gopī Mana Sañchāri
Brindāvan Ke Tulasī Mālā
Pītāmbara Dhārī Murārī

title: Kalyana Rama Ananda Rama
lyrics:
Kalyana Rama Ananda Rama
Rama Sri Rama Jaya Rama
Avatara Sai Avatara Rama
Poorna Avatara Sathya Sai Rama
meaning: Salutations to Lord Rama, who confers bliss and causes the welfare of the world. Salutations to Lord Rama the incarnation and Sathya Sai Rama who has come down with all the facets of an incarnation.
devanagari:
कल्याण रामा आनंद रामा
रामा श्री रामा जय रामा [ कल्याण रामा ... ]
अवतार साई अवतार रामा
पूर्णा अवतार सत्य साई रामा
respell:
Kalyāṇ Rāmā Ānanda Rāmā
Rāmā Shrī Rāmā Jaya Rāmā [ Kalyāṇ Rāmā ... ]
Avatāra Sāī Avatāra Rāmā
Pūrṇā Avatāra Satya Sāī Rāmā

title: Kalyana Ranga Kamaneeya Ranga
lyrics:
Kalyana Ranga Kamaneeya Ranga
Ananda Ranga Sadananda Ranga
Hridayanta Ranga Karunanta Ranga
Rakhumayi Ranga Sayeesha Ranga
Shirdeesha Ranga Partheesha Ranga
Ananda Ranga Sadananda Ranga
meaning: Glory to Lord Ranga (Panduranga/Narayana), the one who bestows welfare, one of Everlasting Bliss, of compassion, Lord of Rakumayi. He is verily Lord Sai, who dwells at Shirdi and Parthi.
devanagari:
कल्याण रंगा कमनीय रंगा
आनन्द रंगा सदानन्द रंगा
हृदयान्त रंगा करुणान्त रंगा
रखुमाई रंगा साईश रंगा
शिरडीश रंगा पर्तीश रंगा
आनन्द रंगा सदानन्द रंगा
respell:
Kalyāṇ Raṅgā Kamanīya Raṅgā
Ānanda Raṅgā Sadānanda Raṅgā
Hṛudayānta Raṅgā Karuṇānta Raṅgā
Rakhumāī Raṅgā Sāīsh Raṅgā
Shiraḍīsha Raṅgā Partīsha Raṅgā
Ānanda Raṅgā Sadānanda Raṅgā

title: Kamala Nayana Narayana
lyrics:
Kamala Nayana Narayana
Ksheerabdhi Shayana Narayana
Megha Varna Hari Narayana
Vaikuntha Vasa Narayana
Prasanthi Vasa Narayana
meaning: Chant the name of the beautiful lotus eyed Lord Narayana , the one who reclines on the ocean of milk, the one with a dark blue complexion. Chant the name of Lord Narayana, who has Vaikunta as His abode, the same Lord Sai Narayana whose abode is Prasanthi Nilayam!
devanagari:
कमल नयना नारायणा
क्षीराब्धि शयना नारायणा
मेघ वर्ण हरि नारायणा
वैकुण्ठ वासा नारायणा
प्रशान्ति वासा नारायणा
respell:
Kamala Nayanā Nārāyaṇā
Kshīrābdhi Shayanā Nārāyaṇā
Megha Varṇa Hari Nārāyaṇā
Vaikuṇṭha Vāsā Nārāyaṇā
Prashānti Vāsā Nārāyaṇā

title: Kamala Nayana Prabhu Kamalapate
lyrics:
Kamala Nayana Prabhu Kamalapate
Kamalasana Prabhu Kamala Kanta
Kamala Nabha Prabhu Kamala Ramana
Kamaleshwara Prabhu Kamala Natha
meaning: Oh Lord, with eyes like blooming lotuses, you are the cherished consort of Kamala. Seated on a lotus, and from your navel springs the lotus of creation, you are the supreme delight and master of Kamala.
devanagari:
कमल नयन प्रभु कमलापते
कमलासन प्रभु कमला कांता
कमल नाभ प्रभु कमला रमणा
कमलेश्वर प्रभु कमला नाथा
respell:
Kamala Nayan Prabhu Kamalāpate
Kamalāsan Prabhu Kamalā Kāntā
Kamala Nābha Prabhu Kamalā Ramaṇā
Kamaleshwar Prabhu Kamalā Nāthā

title: Kamala Netra Sayeeshwara
lyrics:
Kamala Netra Sayeeshwara
Kaivalya Teja Sureshwara
Megha Shyama Ghana Gagana Shareera
Shanta Brahma Maya Abhayakara
meaning: Oh Sai, whose eyes are like lotuses, Lord of gods, you shine with the light of ultimate liberation. Your form is dark as a rain cloud, vast as the boundless sky, embodying the peaceful Brahman who grants us fearlessness.
devanagari:
कमल नेत्र साईश्वरा
कैवल्य तेज सुरेश्वरा [ कमल नेत्र ... ]
मेघ श्याम घन गगन शरीरा
शान्त ब्रह्ममय अभयकरा
मेघ श्याम घन गगन शरीरा [ शान्त ब्रह्ममय ]
respell:
Kamala Netra Sāīshwarā
Kaivalya Teja Sureshwarā [ Kamala Netra ... ]
Megha Shyām Ghan Gagan Sharīrā
Shānta Brahmamaya Abhayakarā
Megha Shyām Ghan Gagan Sharīrā [ Shānta Brahmamaya ]

title: Kanda Kumara Vadivela
lyrics:
Kanda Kumara Vadivela
Gauri Putra Vadivela
Karthikeya Karuna Sagara
Deena Sharanya Vadivela
Sri Sai Natha Vadivela
meaning: Oh Kanda, Kumara, Vadivela, beloved son of Mother Gauri, you are Kartikeya, an ocean of boundless compassion. You are the refuge for the downtrodden and helpless, manifesting as our divine Lord Sai Natha.
devanagari:
कंदा कुमारा वडीवेला
गौरी पुत्रा वडीवेला
कार्तिकेया करुणा सागर
दीन शरण्या वडीवेला
श्री साई नाथा वडीवेला
respell:
Kandā Kumārā Vaḍīvelā
Gaurī Putrā Vaḍīvelā
Kārtikeyā Karuṇā Sāgar
Dīna Sharaṇyā Vaḍīvelā
Shrī Sāī Nāthā Vaḍīvelā

title: Kanha Kanhaiya Bansi Adhariya Brindavana Ghana Rasa Rachaiya
lyrics:
Kanha Kanhaiya Bansi Adhariya Brindavana Ghana Rasa Rachaiya
Gokula Nandana Hey Chitta Mohana
Radha Manohara Shyama
Manasa Chora Nandakishora
Parthi Vihara Sai Gopala Sai Gopala
meaning: Lord Krishna also known as Kanha and Kanhaiya performed the Raasa Leela dance in Brindavan. With the flute on His lips, He is the boy of Gokula who enchants everybody's mind, the son of Nanda and the delight of Radha. He is the one who stole butter and is none other than Lord Sai of Parthi.
devanagari:
कन्हा कन्हैया बंसी अधारिया ब्रिंदावना घन रास रचैया
गोकुल नंदना हे चित्त मोहन
राधा मनोहर श्यामा
मनस चोरा नंद किशोरा
पर्ती विहारा साई गोपाला साई गोपाला
respell:
Kanhā Kanhaiyā Baṃsī Adhāriyā Brindāvanā Ghan Rās Rachaiyā
Gokul Nandanā He Chitta Mohan
Rādhā Manohar Shyāmā
Manasa Chorā Nanda Kishorā
Partī Vihārā Sāī Gopālā Sāī Gopālā

title: Kanhaiya Teri Bansi Baje Mere Lal
lyrics:
Kanhaiya Teri Bansi Bajey Merey Lal
Nis Din Mein Bhajoon Tero Naam
Hey Nandalala Gopala
Gopala Gopala
Govinda Govinda Govinda Gopala
Sai Krishna Sai Ram
meaning: O beloved Krishna, I pray for the sound of Your divine flute while I continuously chant Your holy names. You are Nanda's dear Gopala, the protector Govinda, and manifest as Sai Krishna and Sai Ram, embodying universal divinity.
devanagari:
कन्हैया तेरी बंसी बजे मेरे लाल
निस दिन में भजूँ तेरो नाम [ कन्हैया तेरी ... ]
हे नंदलाला गोपाला
गोपाला गोपाला
गोविन्दा गोविन्दा गोपाला
साई कृष्ण साई राम
respell:
Kanhaiyā Terī Baṃsī Baje Mere Lāl
Nis Din Meṃ Bhajūm̐ Tero Nām [ Kanhaiyā Terī ... ]
He Nandalālā Gopālā
Gopālā Gopālā
Govindā Govindā Gopālā
Sāī Kṛushṇa Sāī Rām

title: Karuna Nidhey Bhagawan
lyrics:
Karuna Nidhey Bhagawan
Gopala Brindavana Sai Bhagawan
Mana Mohana Madhava Sai Bhagawan [ Karuna Nidhey ... ]
Meera Ke Prabhu Giridhara Bala
Parama Dayala Sai Krupala
Parthi Puri Bhagawan [ Mana Mohana ... ]
Karuna Nidhey Bhagawan (3)
meaning: Oh Lord, You are the very fount of compassion, Gopala of Vrindavan, the enchanting Madhava who captivates all hearts. You are Meera's beloved Giridhari, the supremely merciful and gracious Sai, our divine Lord of Puttaparthi.
devanagari:
करुणा निधे भगवान
गोपाल बृंदावन साई भगवान
मन मोहन माधव साई भगवान [करुणा निधे]
मीरा के प्रभु गिरिधर बाला
परम दयाला साई कृपाला
पर्तीपूरी भगवान
करुणा निधे भगवान
respell:
Karuṇā Nidhe Bhagavān
Gopāla Bṛundāvan Sāī Bhagavān
Mana Mohan Mādhava Sāī Bhagavān [karuṇā Nidhe]
Mīrā Ke Prabhu Giridhara Bālā
Param Dayālā Sāī Kṛupālā
Partīpūrī Bhagavān
Karuṇā Nidhe Bhagavān

title: Karuna Niketana Bhakta Sakha Prabhu
lyrics:
Karuna Niketana Bhakta Sakha Prabhu
Sharan Mein Lo Bhagawan
Dukha Bhanjana Sri Ram
Tribhuvana Sanchari Jyoti Swaroopa
Nitya Niranjana Ram
Adi Anant Hey Prema Swaroopa
Dukha Bhanjana Sri Ram
meaning: Oh Rama the ever Compassionate one, the real friend of the devotee and destroyer of sorrow, I seek refuge in you. You move around the three worlds, ever pure, you are both the beginning and the end. You are also the embodiment of love.
devanagari:
करुणा निकेतन भक्त सखा प्रभु  
शरण मे लो भगवान  
दुख भंजन श्री राम  
त्रिभुवन संचारि ज्योति स्वरूपा
नित्य निरंजन राम
आदि अनंत हे प्रेम स्वरूपा [ दुख भंजन ... ]
respell:
Karuṇā Niketana Bhakta Sakhā Prabhu
Sharaṇ Me Lo Bhagavān
Dukha Bhañjana Shrī Rām
Tribhuvan Sañchāri Jyoti Swarūpā
Nitya Nirañjana Rām
Ādi Anant He Prem Swarūpā [ Dukha Bhañjana ... ]

title: Karuna Sagara Hey Nandalala
lyrics:
Karuna Sagara Hey Nandalala
Murali Manohara Shyama Gopala
Giridhara Nagara Sai Gopala
Meera Ke Prabhu Shyama Gopala
meaning: Oh Nandalala, ocean of boundless compassion, you enchant us with your flute, dark-hued Gopala! You are the charming mountain-bearer, Sai Gopala, and the beloved Lord of Meera.
devanagari:
करुणा सागर हे नंदलाला  
मुरली मनोहर श्याम गोपाला [ करुणा सागर ... ]  
गिरिधर नागर साई गोपाला  
मीरा के प्रभु श्याम गोपाला
respell:
Karuṇā Sāgar He Nandalālā
Muralī Manohar Shyām Gopālā [ Karuṇā Sāgar ... ]
Giridhara Nāgar Sāī Gopālā
Mīrā Ke Prabhu Shyām Gopālā

title: Karuna Sagara Prema Swaroopa
lyrics:
Karuna Sagara Prema Swaroopa
Shapa Vimochana Ram
Dukha Bhanjana Sri Ram  (2)
Allah Eshwar Tere Nam
Nanak Yeshu Tere Nam
Parthipureeshwara Deena Daya Ghana
Dukha Bhanjana Sri Ram  (2)
meaning: Lord Sai is an embodiment of Divinity, Ocean of compassion, redeems our sins and destroys the sorrow. Allah, Eshwar, Nanak and Yesu are your names  O Lord! The Lord of Parthi is highly compassionate towards the distressed.
devanagari:
करुणा सागर प्रेम स्वरूपा
शाप विमोचन राम
दुख भंजन श्री राम (साई राम)
अल्लाह ईश्वर तेरे नाम
नानक येसु तेरे नाम
पर्ती पूरिश्वर दीन दयाघन [ दुख भंजन ... ]
respell:
Karuṇā Sāgar Prem Swarūpā
Shāp Vimochana Rām
Dukha Bhañjana Shrī Rām (sāī rām)
Allāh Īshwar Tere Nām
Nānak Yesu Tere Nām
Partī Pūrishwar Dīna Dayāghan [ dukha bhañjana ... ]

title: Karuna Samudra Sri Rama
lyrics:
Karuna Samudra Sri Rama
Kausalya Tanaya Sri Rama
Sharanagata Priya Sai Rama
Sharanam Sharanam Sri Rama
Sharanam Sharanam Hey Sai Rama
meaning: Oh Sri Rama, son of Kausalya, you are an boundless ocean of grace. Beloved Sai Rama, you cherish those who seek refuge in you, and so I repeatedly offer my complete surrender.
devanagari:
करुणा समुद्र श्री राम
कौसल्या तनया श्री राम
शरणागत प्रिय साई राम
शरणं शरणं साई राम
respell:
Karuṇā Samudra Shrī Rām
Kausalyā Tanayā Shrī Rām
Sharaṇāgat Priy Sāī Rām
Sharaṇaṃ Sharaṇaṃ Sāī Rām

title: Karuna Sindhu Dasharatha Nandana Parthipureeshwara Ram
lyrics:
Karuna Sindhu Dasharatha Nandana Parthipureeshwara Ram
Prema Swaroopa Prashanthi Niketana Maruti Sevita Ram
Ahalyoddharaka Rajeeva Lochana Raghukula Bhooshana Ram
meaning: Oh Lord Rama, Ocean of Compassion and Son of Dasharatha, you are the very embodiment of Love, the Lord of Parthi and the abode of supreme peace. Served by Maruti, your lotus eyes redeemed Ahalya, making you the radiant jewel of the Raghu dynasty.
devanagari:
करुणा सिंधु दशरथ नंदन पर्ती पूरीश्वर राम
प्रेम स्वरूप प्रशांति निकेतन मारुति सेवित राम
अह्ल्योद्धारक राजीव लोचन रघुकुल भूषण राम
respell:
Karuṇā Sindhu Dasharath Nandana Partī Pūrīshwar Rām
Prem Swarūp Prashānti Niketana Māruti Sevitā Rām
Ahalyā Dhārak Rājīva Lochana Raghukul Bhūshaṇ rām

title: Karunamaya Karthikeya
lyrics:
Karunamaya Karthikeya
Kaivalya Daata Sri Sai Natha [ Karunamaya ... ]
Himagiri Nandini Priya Kumara
Iha Para Sukha Dayi Bhava Bhaya Hara
Sharanagatha Priya Shanmukha Natha
Sharanam Sharanam Shambhu Kumara
Sharanam Sharanam Shambhu Kumara (3)
meaning: Oh compassionate Karthikeya, giver of ultimate liberation and Sri Sai Natha, beloved son of Parvati. You bestow joy in this world and the next, dispelling the fear of rebirth for those who surrender. We offer our complete devotion to you, Lord Shanmukha, son of Shambhu.
devanagari:
करुणामया कार्तिकेया
कैवल्य दाता श्री साई नाथा [ करुणामया ... ]
हिमगिरी नंदिनी प्रिय कुमारा
इह पर सुख दायी भव भय हारा
शरणागत प्रिय षण्मुख नाथा
शरणम् शरणम् शम्भु कुमारा
शरणम् शरणम् शम्भु कुमारा (3)
respell:
Karuṇāmayā Kārtikeyā
Kaivalya Dātā Shrī Sāī Nāthā [ Karuṇāmayā ... ]
Himagirī Nandinī Priy Kumārā
Ih Para Sukh Dāyī Bhava Bhaya Hārā
Sharaṇāgat Priy Shaṇmukha Nāthā
Sharaṇam Sharaṇam Shambhu Kumārā
Sharaṇam Sharaṇam Shambhu Kumārā (3)

title: Karunanta Ranga Kariraja Varada Kamalesha Sri Sai Rama
lyrics:
Karunanta Ranga Kariraja Varada Kamalesha Sri Sai Rama
Omkara Rama Prasanthi Rama
Parabrahma Sathya Sai Rama
Hey Parabrahma Sathya Sai Rama
Kamalesha Sri Sai Rama
meaning: The lotus eyed and compassionate Sai Rama, the one who saved the elephant king is verily the cosmic soul Sathya Sai Rama, the embodiment of Om residing in Parthi.
devanagari:
करुणान्त रंगा करिराज वरदा कमलेश श्री साई रामा
ओंकार राम प्रशान्ति रामा
परब्रह्म सत्य साई रामा
कमलेश श्री साई रामा
respell:
Karuṇānta Raṅgā Karirāj Varadā Kamalesh Shrī Sāī Rāmā
Oṅkār Rām Prashānti Rāmā
Parabrahma Satya Sāī Rāmā
Kamalesh Shrī Sāī Rāmā

title: Kasturi Ranga Kaveti Ranga
lyrics:
Kasturi Ranga Kaveti Ranga
Sri Ranga Ranga Ranga
Kalyana Ranga Karunanta Ranga
Sri Ranga Ranga Ranga
Garuda Gamana Ranga Sesha Shayana Ranga
Sri Ranga Ranga Ranga
meaning: Oh glorious Ranga, adorned with fragrant musk, dwelling by the sacred Kaveri, you are the embodiment of auspiciousness and boundless compassion. You ride upon Garuda and recline upon the cosmic serpent Sesha, ever benevolent, Sri Ranga.
devanagari:
कस्तुरी रंगा कवेटी रंगा
श्री रंग रंगा रंगा
कल्याण रंगा करुणान्त रंगा
श्री रंग रंगा रंगा
गरुड गमन रंगा शेष शयन रंगा
श्री रंग रंगा रंगा
respell:
Kasturī Raṅgā Kaveṭī Raṅgā
Shrī Raṅg Raṅgā Raṅgā
Kalyāṇ Raṅgā Karuṇānta Raṅgā
Shrī Raṅg Raṅgā Raṅgā
Garuḍ Gamana Raṅgā Shesh Shayan Raṅgā
Shrī Raṅg Raṅgā Raṅgā

title: Kasturi Tilakam Narayanam
lyrics:
Kasturi Tilakam Narayanam
Kamala Nayanam Narayanam
Guruvayoorpura Narayanam
Kali Yuga Avatara Narayanam
Govinda Govinda Narayanam (2)
meaning: Oh The Lotus Eyed Narayana adoring the scented vermillion, you are the presiding deity at Guruvayur, is also the cowherd boy who has incarnated in this Kali Age. You are the protector of Vedas (Govinda) and the path (Ayana) to the salvation of an individual's (Nara) journey.
devanagari:
कस्तूरी तिलकम् नारायणम्
कमल नयनम् नारायणम्
गुरुवायूरपुर नारायणम्
कलियुग अवतार नारायणम्
गोविन्द गोविन्द नारायणम् (2)
respell:
Kastūrī Tilakam Nārāyaṇam
Kamala Nayanam Nārāyaṇam
Guruvāyūrapura Nārāyaṇam
Kaliyug Avatāra Nārāyaṇam
Govinda Govinda Nārāyaṇam (2)

title: Kausalya Nandana Vaidehi Mohana
lyrics:
Kousalya Nandana Vaidehi Mohana
Rajeeva Lochana Rama
Yuga Avatara Parameshwara Rama
Asura Nikhandana Kodanda Rama
Bharatagraja Sri Rama Parthi Pureeshwara Rama
meaning: The Lotus eyed Rama, the son of Kousalya, enchanter of Vaidehi is the incarnation of the age. Salutations to the bow wielding Rama who was worshipped by his brother Bharata, uprooter of the demon clan, now dwells at Parthi.
devanagari:
कौसल्या नंदन वैदेही मोहन
राजीव लोचन रामा
युग अवतारा परमेश्वर रामा
असुर निखंडन कोदंड रामा
भरताग्रज श्री रामा पर्ती पूरीश्वर रामा
respell:
Kausalyā Nandana Vaidehī Mohan
Rājīva Lochana Rāmā
Yug Avatārā Parameshwar Rāmā
Asur Nikhaṇḍana Kodaṇḍa Rāmā
Bharatāgraj Shrī Rāmā Partī Pūrīshwar Rāmā

title: Kausalya Rama Karunya Dhama
lyrics:
Kausalya Rama Karunya Dhama
Ravana Mardhana Rama Sri Rama [ Kausalya ... ]
Ahalyodharaka Rama Sri Rama
Maruti Sevitha Rama Sri Rama
Sri Rama Jaya Rama Jaya Jaya Rama (3)
meaning: Oh Rama, beloved son of Kausalya, You are the very embodiment of compassion. You are the vanquisher of Ravana, the redeemer of Ahalya, and the one eternally served by Maruti. Victory to You, Sri Rama!
devanagari:
कौसल्या रामा कारुण्य  धामा 
रावण मर्दन रामा श्री रामा [ कौसल्या ... ]
अहल्योद्धारक रामा श्री रामा
मारुति सेवित रामा श्री रामा
श्री राम जय राम जय जय राम (३)
respell:
Kausalyā Rāmā Kāruṇya  Dhāmā
Rāvaṇ Mardana Rāmā Shrī Rāmā [ Kausalyā ... ]
Ahalyoddhārak Rāmā Shrī Rāmā
Māruti Sevit Rāmā Shrī Rāmā
Shrī Rām Jaya Rām Jaya Jaya Rām (3)

title: Kausalyatmaja Rama Charan
lyrics:
Kausalyatmaja Rama Charan
Vaidehi Priya Rama Charan
Maruti Sevita Rama Charan
Bharatarchita Sri Rama Charan
Ahalyoddharaka Rama Charan
Prasanthi Niketana Rama Charan
Rama Charan Sada Bhajo
meaning: Adhere to the feet of Rama O mind, the son of Kausalya, enchanter of Vaidehi, one who was served by Maruti, worshipped by Bharata and to the one who confers supreme peace.
devanagari:
कौसल्यात्मज राम चरण
वैदेही प्रिय राम चरण
मारुति सेवित राम चरण
भरता चित श्री राम चरण
अहल्योधरक राम चरण
प्रशान्ति निकेतन राम चरण
राम चरण सदा भजो
respell:
Kausalyātmaja Rām Charaṇ
Vaidehī Priy Rām Charaṇ
Māruti Sevit Rām Charaṇ
Bharatā Chit Shrī Rām charaṇ
Ahalyodharak Rām Charaṇ
Prashānti Niketana Rām Charaṇ
Rām Charaṇ Sadā Bhajo

title: Keshava Madhava Jaya Deva Madhusudana
lyrics:
Keshava Madhava Jaya Deva Madhusudana
Netra Kamala Dala Ativa Manohara
Antaryami Prabhu Parameshwara
Maya Manusha Vesha Leeladhara
Jaya Deva Madhusudana
meaning: Chant the names of the lotus eyed, the indweller and supremely enchanting Lord Keshava, Madhava, Madhusudhana who has taken the deluding form as a sport.
devanagari:
केशवा माधवा जय देव मधुसूदना
नेत्र कमल दल अतिव मनोहर 
अन्तर्यामी प्रभु परमेश्वर
माया मनुष वेष लीलाधर (2)
respell:
Keshavā Mādhavā Jaya Deva Madhusūdanā
Netra Kamala Dala Ativa Manohar
Antaryāmī Prabhu Parameshwar
Māyā Manusha Vesh Līlādhara (2)

title: Keshava Madhava Govinda Gopala
lyrics:
Keshava Madhava Govinda Gopala
Hari Bol Hari Bol Hari Hari Bol
Keshava Madhava Govinda Bol
meaning: Invoke the divine names of Keshava, Madhava, Govinda, and Gopala, all manifestations of Lord Hari. Continuously chant these sacred appellations to experience spiritual bliss and connection.
devanagari:
केशवा माधवा
गोविन्दा गोपाला
हरि बोल हरि बोल हरि हरि बोल
केशव माधव गोविन्द बोल
respell:
Keshavā Mādhavā
Govindā Gopālā
Hari Bol Hari Bol Hari Hari Bol
Keshav Mādhava Govinda Bol

title: Kodanda Rama Raghava Jaya Kalyana Krishna Keshava
lyrics:
Kodanda Rama Raghava Jaya Kalyana Krishna Keshava
Govinda Madhava Gopala Keshava
Narasimha Achyuta Narayana
Dasharatha Nandana Sita Manohara
Danava Samhara Dayanidhe
meaning:
Victory to Lord Rama, who was born in Raghu dynasty and who held the great kodanda bow. He is the darling son of Dasharatha and beloved of Sita. 
Glory to Lord Krishna whose beauty is unparalleled.

title: Koi Bole Hari Hari Koi Bole Ram Ram
lyrics:
Koi Bole Hari Hari Koi Bole Ram Ram
Koi Bole Durga Kali Koi Bole Sai Ma
Koi Bole Narayana Allah Bismillah
Koi Bole Nanak Buddha Mahavir
Sadhu Sant Fakira Jane Sab Hai Tero Nam
Bol Man Allah Malik Bol Man Sai Ram
meaning: Some may call God as Hari while some others may call Ram. Some may say Durga Kaali but some others Sai Ma. If Hindus call him Narayana, Muslims call Allah Bismillah and yet some others Nanak, Yesu, Buddha and Mahavir. Saints, Sages and Fakirs (Muslim Saints) know that One Same God is known by different names.
devanagari:
कोई बोले हरी हरी कोई बोले राम राम
कोई बोले दुर्गा काली कोई बोले साई माँ
कोई बोले नारायण अल्लाह बिस्मिल्लाह
कोई बोले नानक बुद्ध महावीरा
साधु संत फकीरा जाने सब है तेरो नाम
बोल मन अल्लाह मालिक बोल मन साई राम
respell:
Koī Bole Harī Harī Koī Bole Rām Rām
Koī Bole Durgā Kālī Koī Bole Sāī Mām̐
Koī Bole Nārāyaṇ Allāh Bismillāh
Koī Bole Nānak Buddha Mahāvīrā
Sādhu Sant Phakīrā Jāne Sab Hai Tero Nām
Bol Man Allāh Mālik Bol Man Sāī Rām

title: Koti Pranam Shata Koti Pranam
lyrics:
Koti Pranam Shata Koti Pranam
Hey Deena Natha Sai Ram
Tum Ho Bhakton Ke Yuga Avatar
Tum Ho Ananda Nanda Ke Lal
Parthipuri Ke Sai Gopal
Hey Deena Natha Sai Ram
meaning: Many repeated salutations to You Lord Sai, the refuge of the forlorn. You were born as the son of Nanda and presently the incarnation of our age, Sai Gopala residing at Parthi.
devanagari:
कोटी प्रणाम शत कोटी प्रणाम  
हे दीन नाथ साई राम (3)  
तुम हो भक्तों के युग अवतार  
तुम हो आनंदा नंद के लाल  
पर्ति पुरी के साई गोपाल [ हे दीन नाथ ... ]
respell:
Koṭī Praṇām Shat Koṭī Praṇām
He Dīna Nātha Sāī Rām (3)
Tum Ho Bhaktoṃ Ke Yug Avatār
Tum Ho Ānandā Nanda Ke Lāl
Parti Purī Ke Sāī Gopāl [ He Dīna Nātha ... ]

title: Krishna Bhajo Krishna Bhajo Murali Govinda Bhajo
lyrics:
Krishna Bhajo Krishna Bhajo Murali Govinda Bhajo
Radhe Govinda Bhajo Radhe Gopala Bhajo
Giridhari Shyama Bhajo Radhe Govinda Bhajo
Madhuvana Sanchari Shyama Gopala Bhajo (2)
meaning: "Worship Lord Krishna in all His beautiful forms—as the flute-playing Govinda, the beloved of Radha, the protector Gopala, the lifter of Govardhana Hill, and the joyful Lord of Vrindavan. By singing His name and remembering His divine deeds, one experiences love, devotion, peace, and spiritual joy
devanagari:
कृष्ण भजो कृष्ण भजो मुरली गोविन्द भजो
राधे गोविन्द भजो राधे गोपाल भजो [ कृष्ण भजो ... ]
गिरिधारी श्याम भजो राधे गोविन्द भजो
मधुवन संचारि श्याम गोपाल भजो (2)
respell:
Kṛushṇa Bhajo Kṛushṇa Bhajo Muralī Govinda Bhajo
Rādhe Govinda Bhajo Rādhe Gopāla Bhajo [ Kṛushṇa Bhajo ... ]
Giridhārī Shyām Bhajo Rādhe Govinda Bhajo
Madhuvan Sañchāri Shyām Gopāla Bhajo (2)

title: Krishna Gopala Yadu Nandana
lyrics:
Krishna Gopala Yadu Nandana
Venu Vinodana Mana Mohana
Mor Mukut Gokula Ramana
Ghanashyama Ananda Govinda
Krishna Murari Madhusudana
meaning: O Krishna, beloved Gopala, son of the Yadus, your enchanting flute music captivates all hearts. Adorned with a peacock crown, you are the joy of Gokul, dark-hued like a monsoon cloud, the very embodiment of bliss. We praise you, divine Govinda, Murari, and Madhusudana.
devanagari:
कृष्ण गोपाला यदु नंदना
वेणु विलोलना मन मोहना [ कृष्ण गोपाला ... ]
मोरा मुकुट गोकुल रमणा
घन श्याम आनंद गोविंदा
कृष्ण मुरारी मधुसूदना
respell:
Kṛushṇa Gopālā Yadu Nandanā
Veṇu Vilolanā Mana Mohanā [ Kṛushṇa Gopālā ... ]
Morā Mukuṭ Gokul Ramaṇā
Ghan Shyām Ānanda Govindā
Kṛushṇa Murārī Madhusūdanā

title: Krishna Kanhaiya Krishna Kanhaiya
lyrics:
Krishna Kanhaiya Krishna Kanhaiya
Natawara Nanda Kumara Kanhaiya
Brindavan Ke Bansi Adhariya
Radha Manohara Rasa Rachaiya
Giridhara Nagara Shyama Kanhaiya
Sri Madhusudana Sai Kanhaiya
meaning: O beautiful child Krishna, son of Nanda, the supreme actor! The one who enchanted Brindavan with His flute and the one who enacted the celestial dance with Radha and the Gopikas. O Sai Krishna, You are the one who held the mountain high and slew the demon Madhu.
devanagari:
कृष्ण कन्हैया कृष्ण कन्हैया
नटवर नन्द कुमार कन्हैया
वृन्दावन के बंसी अधरिया
राधा मनोहर रास रचैया
गिरिधर नागर श्याम कन्हैया
श्री मधुसूदन साई कन्हैया
respell:
Kṛushṇa Kanhaiyā Kṛushṇa Kanhaiyā
Naṭavar Nanda Kumāra Kanhaiyā
Vṛundāvan Ke Baṃsī Adhariyā
Rādhā Manohar Rās Rachaiyā
Giridhara Nāgar Shyām Kanhaiyā
Shrī Madhusūdana Sāī Kanhaiyā

title: Krishna Krishna Govinda Krishna Gopala Bala Krishna
lyrics:
Krishna Krishna Govinda Krishna Gopala Bala Krishna
Nanda Nandana Bhakta Chandana Gana Lola Krishna
Sundara Vadana Saroja Nayana Radha Priya Krishna
Yadava Krishna Yashoda Krishna Sathya Sai Krishna
meaning: Krishna, the son of Nanda, who is dear to His devotees delights in Music. He is Lotus eyed, with a charming countenance and dear to Radha. He belongs to the Yadava clan, son of Yashoda who has presently incarnated as Sathya Sai.
devanagari:
कृष्ण कृष्ण गोविन्द कृष्ण गोपाल बाल कृष्णा
नन्द नन्दना भक्त चन्दना गान लोल कृष्णा
सुन्दर वदना सरोज नयना राधा प्रिय कृष्णा
यादव कृष्णा यशोदा कृष्णा सत्य साई कृष्णा
respell:
Kṛushṇa Kṛushṇa Govinda Kṛushṇa Gopāla Bāla Kṛushṇā
Nanda Nandanā Bhakta Chandanā Gān Lol Kṛushṇā
Sundara Vadanā Saroj Nayanā Rādhā Priy Kṛushṇā
Yādava Kṛushṇā Yashodā Kṛushṇā Satya Sāī Kṛushṇā

title: Krishna Krishna Govinda Narayana
lyrics:
Krishna Krishna Govinda Narayana
Krishna Rama Govinda Narayana
Sai Rama Govinda Sai Shyama Gopala
Sai Krishna Govinda Narayana
meaning: Chant the name of Krishna, Govinda, Narayana, Sai Rama, Sai Shyama and Sai Krishna to the delight of everyone

title: Krishna Krishna Mana Mohana
lyrics:
Krishna Krishna Mana Mohana
Chitta Chora Radha Jeevana
Megha Shyama Madhusudana
Radha Kanta Yadu Nandana
meaning: O Krishna! the One with an enchanting form, who is dear to Radha, who is dark in complexion and the slayer of demon Madhu, You belong to the Yadu clan and have stolen our Hearts.
devanagari:
कृष्ण कृष्णा मन मोहना
चित्त चोरा राधा जीवना
मेघ श्यामा मधुसूदना
राधा कांता यदु नंदना
respell:
Kṛushṇa Kṛushṇā Mana Mohanā
Chitta Chorā Rādhā Jīvanā
Megha Shyāmā Madhusūdanā
Rādhā Kāntā Yadu Nandanā

title: Krishna Krishna Yaduvara Krishna
lyrics:
Krishna Krishna Yaduvara Krishna
Murahara Keshava Yadava Madhava
Murali Manohara Krishna Murari
Krishna Murari Shyama Murari
Murahara Keshava Yadava Madhava
meaning: The beauty of the dark clouds reflects in immensely charming Krishna. The holder of the flute, the enchanter of the hearts, he is also our beautiful Sathya Sai. The cause and completeness of creation, is our beloved Sai. We offer our prayers to both Shirdi Sai and Parthi Sai to adorn our hearts.
devanagari:
कृष्णा कृष्णा यदुवर कृष्णा  
मुरहर केशवा यादवा माधवा [ कृष्णा कृष्णा ... ]  
मुरली मनोहर कृष्ण मुरारी  
कृष्ण मुरारी श्याम मुरारी [ मुरहर केशवा ... ]
respell:
Kṛushṇā Kṛushṇā Yaduvar Kṛushṇā
Murahar Keshavā Yādavā Mādhavā [ Kṛushṇā Kṛushṇā ... ]
Muralī Manohar Kṛushṇa Murārī
Kṛushṇa Murārī Shyām Murārī [ Murahar Keshavā ... ]

title: Krishna Madhava Madhava Krishna
lyrics:
Krishna Madhava Madhava Krishna
Krishna Madhava Sai Hare
Brindavana Sanchari Shyama Gopala
Jaya Madhusudana Jaya Nandalala
Jhulana Jhule Mere Sai Nandalala
meaning:
Lord Krishna is the destroyer of ignorance (Madhava). He is verily the Lord Sai himself.
He moves around the holy town of Vrindavan with His divine form having dark complexion. He is slayer of the demon Madhu. He is also the darling son of Nanda Maharaj. Express your love for him in your heart by swinging him like a baby in the cradle.
devanagari:
कृष्ण माधव माधव कृष्णा 
कृष्ण माधवा साई हरे  
ब्रिंदावना संचारि श्याम गोपाला  
जय मधुसूदन जय नंदलाला  
झुलना झुले मेरे साई नंदलाला
respell:
Kṛushṇa Mādhava Mādhava Kṛushṇā
Kṛushṇa Mādhavā Sāī Hare
Brindāvanā Sañchāri Shyām Gopālā
Jaya Madhusūdana Jaya Nandalālā
Jhulanā Jhule Mere Sāī Nandalālā

title: Krishna Mukunda Govinda Giridhara
lyrics:
Krishna Mukunda Govinda Giridhara
Murali Mohana Narayana
Parthi Purandara Narayana
Madhava Sri Hari Mandara Giridhari
Govinda Murahara Narayana
Parthi Purandara Narayana (Hare)
meaning:
Lord Krishna is verily Narayana himself, He holds the mountain, He confers liberation, the embodiment of supreme beauty.
He removes ignorance of devotees. He rescued Mandara mountain and slayed the demon Mura. He has come again as the Lord of Parthi
devanagari:
कृष्ण मुकुंदा गोविन्द गिरिधर
मुरली मोहन नारायणा
पर्ती पुरंदर नारायणा (2)
माधव श्री हरि मंदर गिरिधारी
गोविन्द मुरहार नारायणा (हरे) [ पर्ती पुरंदर ...) ]
respell:
Kṛushṇa Mukundā Govinda Giridhara
Muralī Mohan Nārāyaṇā
Partī Purandara Nārāyaṇā (2)
Mādhava Shrī Hari Mandara Giridhārī
Govinda Murahār Nārāyaṇā (hare) [ Partī Purandara ...) ]

title: Krishna Rama Govinda Gokula Nandana Gopala
lyrics:
Krishna Rama Govinda Gokula Nandana Gopala
Rama Krishna Govinda trayi Brindavana Gopala
Sai Krishna Govinda Parthipureeshwara Gopala
Gopala Sai Gopala
Gopi Manohara Gokula Bala Sai Murari
meaning: Chant the names of Lord who incarnated as Rama and Krishna. Chant the name of Gopala, the charming child of Gokula and Brindavan. Gopala, the favourite of the Gopikas, and the one who slayed the demon Mura, is indeed our Sai.
devanagari:
कृष्णा रामा गोविन्दा गोकुल नन्दन गोपाला
रामा कृष्णा गोविन्दा जय वृन्दावन गोपाला
साई कृष्णा गोविन्द पर्तिपूरीश्वर गोपाला
गोपाला साई गोपाला
गोपी मनोहरा गोकुल बाला साई मुरारी
respell:
Kṛushṇā Rāmā Govindā Gokul Nandana Gopālā
Rāmā Kṛushṇā Govindā Jaya Vṛundāvan Gopālā
Sāī Kṛushṇā Govinda Partipūrīshwar Gopālā
Gopālā Sāī Gopālā
Gopī Manoharā Gokul Bālā Sāī Murārī

title: Krishna Rama Govinda Narayana
lyrics:
Krishna Rama Govinda Narayana
Madhava Keshava Hari Narayana
Sri Venu Gopala Krishna
Madhava Madhusudana Narayana
meaning: The lord is divinely attractive and full of joy. He is the embodiment of Vedas and destroyer of ignorance. He as Krishna destroyed the wickedness of Keshi (Keshava) and Madhu. He mesmerized his comrades with soulful music from His flute. He is the ultimate destination of humanity.
devanagari:
कृष्णा रामा गोविन्द नारायणा
माधवा केशवा हरि नारायण [ कृष्णा रामा ... ] 
श्री वेणु गोपाल कृष्णा
माधवा मधुसूदना नारायणा
respell:
Kṛushṇā Rāmā Govinda Nārāyaṇā
Mādhavā Keshavā Hari Nārāyaṇ [ Kṛushṇā Rāmā ... ]
Shrī Veṇu Gopāla Kṛushṇā
Mādhavā Madhusūdanā Nārāyaṇā

title: Krishnam Vande Nanda Kumaram
lyrics:
Krishnam Vande Nanda Kumaram
Radha Vallabha Navaneetha Choram
Ramam Vande Dasharatha Tanayam
Sita Vallabha Raghukula Tilakam
Muralidhara Sukumara Sharanam
Gopi Vallabha Nanda Kishoram

title: Krishnam Vande Nanda Kumaram
lyrics:
Krishnam Vande Nanda Kumaram
Radha Vallabha Navaneeta Choram
Ramam Vande Dasharatha Tanayam
Sita Vallabha Raghukula Tilakam
meaning: Bow to little Krishna, the son of Nanda, consort of Radha, who stole butter. I bow to Rama, the son of Dasaratha, consort of Sita and the shining star of Raghu dynasty.
devanagari:
कृष्णम् वन्दे नन्द कुमारम्
राधा वल्लभ नवनीत चोरम्
रामम् वन्दे दशरथ तनयम्
सीता वल्लभ रघुकुल तिलकम्
respell:
Kṛushṇam Vande Nanda Kumāram
Rādhā Vallabh Navanīta Choram
Rāmam Vande Dasharath Tanayam
Sītā Vallabh Raghukul Tilakam

title: Ksheerabdhi Shayana Narayana
lyrics:
Ksheerabdhi Shayana Narayana
Sri Lakshmi Ramana Narayana
Narayana Hari Narayana
Narahari Roopa Narayana
Vaikuntha Vasa Narayana
Vaidehi Mohana Narayana
Narayana Hari Narayana
Natajana Paripala Narayana
meaning: Chant the Name Lord Narayana who reclines on the Ocean of Milk, consort of Sri Lakshmi and who Incarnated as Narasimha (half Man half Lion). Narayana who has Vaikunta as His Abode, is the charmer of Vaidehi, the One who takes complete care of those who have surrendered to Him.
devanagari:
क्षीराब्धि शयना नारायणा
श्री लक्ष्मी रमण नारायणा
नारायणा हरि नारायणा
नरहरी रूप नारायणा
वैकुण्ठ वास नारायणा
वैदेही मोहन नारायणा
नारायणा हरि नारायणा
नटजन परिपाल नारायणा
respell:
Kshīrābdhi Shayanā Nārāyaṇā
Shrī Lakshmī Ramaṇa Nārāyaṇā
Nārāyaṇā Hari Nārāyaṇā
Naraharī Rūp Nārāyaṇā
Vaikuṇṭha Vās Nārāyaṇā
Vaidehī Mohan Nārāyaṇā
Nārāyaṇā Hari Nārāyaṇā
Naṭajana Paripāla Nārāyaṇā

title: Lambodara Hey Gauri Nandana
lyrics:
Lambodara Hey Gauri Nandana
Vighna Vinashaka Shubhanana
Siddhi Vinayaka Hey Dukha Bhanjana
Asura Vinashaka Shubhanana
Gauri Nandana Mooshika Vahana
Vighna Vinashaka Shubhanana
meaning: Oh Lambodara, son of Gauri, with your auspicious face, you are the great remover of all obstacles and sorrow. You are Siddhi Vinayaka, the destroyer of demons, who rides upon a mouse, bringing auspiciousness to all.
devanagari:
लम्बोदर हे गौरी नन्दन
विघ्न विनाशक शुभानना
सिद्धि विनायक हे दुःख भञ्जन
असुर विनाशक शुभानना
गौरी नन्दन मूषिक वाहन
विघ्न विनाशक शुभानना
respell:
Lambodara He Gaurī Nandana
Vighna Vināshak Shubhānanā
Siddhi Vināyak He Duḥkha Bhañjana
Asur Vināshak Shubhānanā
Gaurī Nandana Mūshik Vāhan
Vighna Vināshak Shubhānanā

title: Lambodara Hey Vinayaka
lyrics:
Lambodara Hey Vinayaka
Vighnaharana Girija Nandana
Shambhu Kumara Kalusha Vidoora
Siddhi Sadana Hey Gananatha
Pranavakara Pashupati Tanaya
Vighnaharana Girija Nandana
meaning:
Lord Ganesh is extolled in various ways. He has a large belly, representing large capacity to accept the pure offerings of devotees (lambodara). He is has no leader above (Vinayak). He removes all the obstacles and he is the darling son of mother Parvati (Girija) and Lord Shiva.
He removes the inauspicious qualities. He is the store house of various divine magical power and the leader of Ganas. He is the embodiment of 'Aum' principle.
devanagari:
लम्बोदरा हे विनायका
विघ्नहरण गिरिजा नन्दना
शंभो कुमारा कलुष विदूरा
सिद्धि सदन हे गणनाथा
प्रणवाकारा पशुपति तनया
विघ्नहरण गिरिजा नन्दना
respell:
Lambodarā He Vināyakā
Vighnaharaṇ Girijā Nandanā
Shambho Kumārā Kalush Vidūrā
Siddhi Sadana He Gaṇanāthā
Praṇavākārā Pashupati Tanayā
Vighnaharaṇ Girijā Nandanā

title: Lambodara Gananatha Gajanana
lyrics:
Lambodara Gananatha Gajanana
Parvati Nandana Shubhanana
Pashupati Tanaya Siddhi Vinayaka
Pranavakara Shambho Nandana
Parthipureesha Pahi Gajanana
Parvati (Hey Shiva) Nandana Shubhanana
meaning: Lord Ganesha is the leader of ganas, he has the face of an elephant, he has huge belly (accepts all the offerings of devotees and purifies them in return). Seeing the face of parvati's son brings forth auspiciousness. He is endowed with magical powers and he is the darling son of lord Shiva. He represents the primordial sound (pranava). He is the presiding deity of puttaparthi. I seek His divine grace.
devanagari:
लम्बोधरा गणनाथ गजानन  
पार्वती नंदन शुभनाना  
पशुपति तनया सिद्धि विनायक  
प्रणवाकारा शम्भो नंदन  
पर्तिपूरीशा पाहि गजानन  
हे शिव नंदन शुभनानना
respell:
Lambodharā Gaṇanātha Gajānana
Pārwatī Nandana Shubhanānā
Pashupati Tanayā Siddhi Vināyak
Praṇavākārā Shambho Nandana
Partipūrīshā Pāhi Gajānan
He Shiv Nandana Shubhanānanā

title: Lambodara Hey Vighneshwara
lyrics:
Lambodara Hey Vighneshwara
Shambho Kumara Siddeshwara
Shiva Shambho Kumara Siddeshwara
Ambika Tanaya Omkareshwara
Heramba Sai Shirdeeshwara
Heramba Sai Partheeshwara
meaning: Sing the glory of Lord Ganesha who removes obstacles, the son of Shambho (Shiva) and Ambika (Parvati) and who has a big stomach. He is the Lord of Yogis, the embodiment of Om, and is also known as Heramba. He is none other than Sai, the Lord of Shirdi and Parthi.
devanagari:
लंबोधरा हे विघ्नेश्वरा
शंभु कुमारा सिद्धेश्वरा [ लंबोधरा ... ]
अंबिक तनया ओंकारेश्वर
हेरंभ साई शिर्डीश्वरा (पर्तिश्वरा)
respell:
Lambodharā He Vighneshwarā
Shambhu Kumārā Siddheshwarā [ Lambodharā ... ]
Ambika Tanayā Oṅkāreshwar
Herambh Sāī Shirḍīshwarā (partishwarā)

title: Lambodara Jaya Gajanana
lyrics:
Lambodara Jaya Gajanana
Parvati Nandana Parama Daya Ghana
Bandha Vimochana Bhava Bhaya Bhanjana
Pranava Swaroopa Hey Shiva Nandana
