Pahi Prabho Mam Pahi Gajanana
meaning:
Victory to Lord Ganesh who has the face of an elephant and huge belly.
He is supremely compassionate and always brings joy to Divine mother Parvati.
He liberates devotees from the shackles of bondage and destroys the fear that arises from the illusion of duality.
Lord  Shiva's beloved son is embodiment of primordial sound.
I seek the divine refuge of the lord who has elephant face.
devanagari:
लम्बोदरा जय गजानना
पार्वती नंदन परम दया घन [ लम्बोधर ... ]
बंध विमोचन भव भय भंजन
प्रणव स्वरूपा हे शिव नंदन
पाहि प्रभो माम पाहि गजानन
respell:
Lambodarā Jaya Gajānanā
Pārwatī Nandana Param Dayā Ghan [ Lambodhara ... ]
Bandha Vimochana Bhava Bhaya Bhañjana
Praṇava Swarūpā He Shiv Nandana
Pāhi Prabho Mām Pāhi Gajānana

title: Lambodhara Jaya Gowri Sutha
lyrics:
Lambodhara Jaya Gowri Sutha
Ganadhipa Jaya Gajanana [ Lambodhara ... ]
Phaalachandra Dhara Gaja Karneshwara
Partheeshwara Maam (Sayeeshwara Maam) Paahi Prabho
meaning:
Victory to You, O Lambodhara (the One with the large, auspicious belly), O Son of Goddess Gauri (Parvati)!
Victory to You, O Lord of the Ganas (divine attendants), O Elephant-faced Lord!
O Lord who bears the crescent moon on Your forehead and whose ears are like those of an elephant,
O Lord of Parthi (or O Lord Sai), protect me, O Divine Master!
devanagari:
लम्बोदरा जय गौरी सुता
गणाधीपा जय गजानना [ लम्बोदरा ... ]
बालचन्द्रा धरा गज कर्णेश्वरा
पर्तीश्वरा माम (साईश्वरा माम) पाहि प्रभो
respell:
Lambodarā Jaya Gaurī Sutā
Gaṇādhīpā Jaya Gajānanā [ Lambodarā ... ]
Bālachandrā Dharā Gaj Karṇeshwarā
Partīshwarā Mām (sāīshwarā Mām) Pāhi Prabho

title: Lingodbhavakara Lingeshwara
lyrics:
Lingodbhavakara Lingeshwara
Partheeshwara Mam Pahi Prabho
Pahi Prabho Mam Dehi Vibho
meaning: I seek Thy Divine protection, O lord of Puttaparthi. You are the source of all the emerging and merging processes (Linga). I seek you who is the supreme Lord.
devanagari:
लिङ्गोद्भवकरा लिङ्गेश्वरा
पर्तीश्वरा माम् पाही प्रभो
पाही प्रभो माम् देही विभो
respell:
Liṅgodbhavakarā Liṅgeshwarā
Partīshwarā Mām Pāhī Prabho
Pāhī Prabho Mām Dehī Vibho

title: Listen To The Waves Of The River
lyrics:
Listen To The Waves Of The River Singing Om Namah Shivaya
Sai Om Namah Shivaya 
With Each Wave Namah Shivaya
Let Us Join In Praise Mother Ganga Singing Om Namah Shivaya
Sai Om Namah Shivaya 
Sing In Praise Namah Shivaya
With Each Wave Namah Shivaya
devanagari:
लिसन टू द वेव्ज अव द रिवर सिङिङ ॐ नमः शिवाय
साई ॐ नमः शिवाय
विद ईच वेव नमः शिवाय
लेट अस जोयन इन प्रेज मदर गंगा सिङिङ ॐ नमः शिवाय
साई ॐ नमः शिवाय
सिङ इन प्रेज नमः शिवाय
विद ईच वेव नमः शिवाय

title: Love Is My Form
lyrics:
Love Is My Form, Truth Is My Breath, Bliss Is My Food
My Life Is My Message Expansion Is My Life
No Reason For Love, No Season For Love, No Birth, No Death
Prema Sathya Ananda, Dharma Shanthi Ananda
Shirdi Sai, Sathya Sai, Prema Sai Jai Jai
Shirdi Baba, Sathya Baba, Prema Baba Jai Jai
meaning: My very form is Love, Truth is my breath, and Bliss is my sustenance; my life itself is the message I convey, and expansion is my very existence. This divine love knows no reason or season, for I transcend birth and death, embodying eternal Love, Truth, and Bliss, alongside Righteousness and Peace. Glory, glory to Shirdi Sai, Sathya Sai, and Prema Sai, the glorious manifestations of these divine principles!
devanagari:
लव इज माइ फोर्म ट्रूथ इज माइ ब्रेथ ब्लिस इज माइ फूड
माइ लाइफ इज माइ मेसज इक्स्पैन्शन इज माइ लाइफ
नो रीजन फोर लव नो सीजन फोर लव नो बरथ नो डेथ
प्रेम सत्य आनंद धर्म शान्ति आनंद
शिर्डी साई सत्य साई प्रेम साई जय जय
शिर्डी बाबा सत्य बाबा प्रेम बाबा जय जय

title: Ma Hey Ma
lyrics:
Ma Hey Ma
Sai Mata Jagat Janani
Veena Vadini Saraswati Mata
Jagat Palini Lakshmi Mata
Amba Bhavani Gauri Mata
Sai Mata Jagat Janani
meaning:
O Mother Divine, Sai Maa, you are the mother of the universe.
O Mother, you are Saraswati who plays veena. (One who brings harmony into life)
O Mother, you are Lakshmi who fosters the universe.(One who brings stability to life).
O Mother, you are Gauri, unparalleled brilliance, who infuses life into the universe (Bhavani).
devanagari:
मा हे मा (2)  
साई माता जगत जननी [ मा हे मा ... ]  
वीणा वादिनी सरस्वती माता  
जगत पालिनी लक्ष्मी माता  
अम्बे भवानी गौरी माता [ साई माता ... ]
respell:
Mā He Mā (2)
Sāī Mātā Jagat Jananī [ Mā He Mā ... ]
Vīṇā Vādinī Saraswatī Mātā
Jagat Pālinī Lakshmī Mātā
Ambe Bhavānī Gaurī Mātā [ Sāī Mātā ... ]

title: Madhava Gopala Mana Mohana Gopala
lyrics:
Madhava Gopala Mana Mohana Gopala
Sai Mohana Gopala
Yashoda Ke Bala Yadu Nandana Gopala
Bala Gopala Hey Giridhara Gopala
Bala Gopala Giridhara Gopala
Sai Mohana Gopala
meaning: O Madhava Gopala, you are the captivating enchanter of our minds. You are the beloved child of Yashoda, the joy of the Yadu dynasty, and the divine one who lifted the Govardhan mountain. The most beautiful Lord Sai is none other than Lord Gopala.
devanagari:
माधव गोपाला  मन मोहन गोपाला 
साई मोहन गोपाला 
यशोद के बाला यदु नंदन गोपाला
बाला गोपाला हे गिरिधर गोपाला 
बाला गोपाला गिरिधर गोपाला 
साई मोहन गोपाला
respell:
Mādhava Gopālā  Mana Mohan Gopālā
Sāī Mohan Gopālā
Yashod Ke Bālā Yadu Nandana Gopālā
Bālā Gopālā He Giridhara Gopālā
Bālā Gopālā Giridhara Gopālā
Sāī Mohan Gopālā

title: Madhava Gopala
lyrics:
Madhava Gopala
Nanda Nandana Ghana Shyama Gopala
Shyama Sundara Brindavana Lola
Murali Manohara Giridhara Bala
Jaya Hari Govinda Radhe Gopala
meaning: Oh Madhava, divine cowherd, beloved son of Nanda, whose dark complexion is as beautiful as a cloud! You delight in Vrindavan, enchanting all with your flute, and as a young boy, you lifted the Govardhan mountain. Victory to you, Hari, Govinda, and Radha's cherished Gopala!
devanagari:
माधवा गोपाला
नंद नंदन घन श्याम गोपाला [ माधवा ... ]
श्याम सुंदरा बृंदावन लोला
मुरली मनोहर गिरिधर बाला
जय हरि गोविंद राधे गोपाला (3)
respell:
Mādhavā Gopālā
Nanda Nandana Ghan Shyām Gopālā [ Mādhavā ... ]
Shyām Sundarā Bṛundāvan Lolā
Muralī Manohar Giridhara Bālā
Jaya Hari Govind Rādhe Gopālā (3)

title: Madhava Hare Krishna Madhura Mohana
lyrics:
Madhava Hare Krishna Madhura Mohana
Gokula Balana Devaki Nandana
Venu Vilolana Paapa Vinashana
Radhika Jeevana Rajeeva Nayana
Nanda Sunandana Gopi Ramana
Venuvilolana Papa Vinasana
meaning: O Madhava, enchanting Krishna, you are the sweet protector of Gokul and beloved son of Devaki. With your playful flute, you destroy all sins, the very life of Radha, and the lotus-eyed delight of the Gopis.
devanagari:
माधवा हरे कृष्ण मधुरा मोहना
गोकुल पालना देवकी नंदना
वेणु विलोलना पाप विनाशना [ माधवा हरे ... ]
राधिका जीवना राजीव नयना
नंद सुनंदना गोपी रमणा [ वेणु विलोलना ... ]
respell:
Mādhavā Hare Kṛushṇa Madhurā Mohanā
Gokul Pālanā Devakī Nandanā
Veṇu Vilolanā Pāpa Vināshanā [ Mādhavā Hare ... ]
Rādhikā Jīvanā Rājīva Nayanā
Nanda Sunandanā Gopī Ramaṇā [ Veṇu Vilolanā ... ]

title: Madhava Hare Madhusudana Hare
lyrics:
Madhava Hare Madhusudana Hare
Yadava Hare Yadu Nandana Hare
Keshava Hare Radha Krishna Hare
Janardana Mana Mohana Hare
Sai Sachidananda Hare
meaning: This devotional chant lovingly invokes Lord Krishna through His many divine names, such as Madhava, Madhusudhana, and Keshava, who enchants all minds and hearts. It celebrates Him as the beloved of Radha, the scion of the Yadu dynasty, and ultimately as Sai, the very essence of Truth, Consciousness, and Bliss.
devanagari:
माधवा हरे माधुसूदना हरे
यादवा हरे यदु नंदन हरे
केशवा हरे राधा कृष्णा हरे
जनार्दना मन मोहना हरे
साई सच्चिदानंद हरे
respell:
Mādhavā Hare Mādhusūdanā Hare
Yādavā Hare Yadu Nandana Hare
Keshavā Hare Rādhā Kṛushṇā Hare
Janārdanā Mana Mohanā Hare
Sāī Sachchidānanda Hare

title: Madhava Mohana Shyama Gopala
lyrics:
Madhava Mohana Shyama Gopala
Muralidhara Mukunda Gopala
Dwapara Yuga Mein Krishna Gopala
Meera Ke Prabhu Giridhara Bala
Shyama Manohara He Nandalala
Parthipureeshwara Sai Gopala
meaning: Lord Gopala who had taken birth in the Dwapara age, Lord of Meera, son of Nanda has come again as Sai Gopala at Parthi
devanagari:
माधव मोहन श्यामा गोपाला
मुरलीधर मुकुंद गोपाला
द्वापर युग में कृष्ण गोपाला
मीरा के प्रभु गिरिधर बाला
श्याम मनोहर हे नंदलाला
पर्तिपूरीश्वर साई गोपाला
respell:
Mādhava Mohan Shyāmā Gopālā
Muralīdhara Mukund Gopālā
Dwāpara Yug Meṃ Kṛushṇa Gopālā
Mīrā Ke Prabhu Giridhara Bālā
Shyām Manohar He Nandalālā
Partipūrīshwar Sāī Gopālā

title: Madhava Murahara Murali Gopala
lyrics:
Madhava Murahara Murali Gopala
Jaya Govinda Jaya Gopala
Parthi Puranjana Parama Daya Ghana
Deena Janavana Sai Gopala 
Jaya Govinda Jaya Gopala
meaning: Victory to Govinda and Gopala (names of Lord Krishna), the one of unbounded compassion, dear to the forlorn and who is none other than Lord Sai, the life principle at Parthi.
devanagari:
माधव मुरहारा मुरली गोपाला  
जय गोविन्दा जय गोपाला  
पर्ती पुरंदर परम दया घन
दीन जनवान साई गोपाला [ जय गोविन्दा ... ]
respell:
Mādhava Murahārā Muralī Gopālā
Jaya Govindā Jaya Gopālā
Partī Purandara Param Dayā Ghan
Dīna Janavān Sāī Gopālā [ Jaya Govindā ... ]

title: Madhura Madhura Murali Ghana Shyama
lyrics:
Madhura Madhura Murali Ghana Shyama
Mathuradhipathe Radhe Shyama
Surdas Prabhu He Giridhari
Meera Ke Prabhu Hrudaya Vihari
meaning:
Very sweet indeed is the Lord who is dark in complexion and plays flute!
The beloved of Radha is indeed the Lord of sweetness!
He, the lord of Surdas holds the mountain!
He, the lord of Meera resides in the heart!
devanagari:
मधुर मधुर मुरली घन श्यामा  
मथुराधिपते राधे श्यामा  
सूरदास प्रभु हे गिरिधारी
मीरा के प्रभु हृदय विहारी
respell:
Madhura Madhura Muralī Ghan Shyāmā
Mathurādhipate Rādhe Shyāmā
Sūradās Prabhu He Giridhārī
Mīrā Ke Prabhu Hṛudaya Vihārī

title: Madhura Madhura Sai Nama
lyrics:
Madhura Madhura Sai Nama
Madhura Madhura Sai Dhyana
Madhura Madhura Sai Geeta
Madhura Madhura Sai Bodha
Sundara Sundara Sai Roopa
Jayatu Jayatu Sai Krishna
meaning: Every aspect of Sai—His name, meditation, songs, and wisdom—is wonderfully sweet, and His divine form radiates exquisite beauty. We celebrate the victory of Sai, who is truly Lord Krishna.
devanagari:
मधुर मधुर साई नाम
मधुर मधुर साई ध्यान
मधुर मधुर साई गीता
मधुर मधुर साई बोधा
सुंदर सुंदर साई रूप
जयतु जयतु साई कृष्ण
respell:
Madhura Madhura Sāī Nāma
Madhura Madhura Sāī Dhyān
Madhura Madhura Sāī Gītā
Madhura Madhura Sāī Bodhā
Sundara Sundara Sāī Rūp
Jayatu Jayatu Sāī Kṛushṇa

title: Madhusudana Hare Madhava
lyrics:
Madhusudana Hare Madhava
Sri Vasudeva Janardana
Hari Keshava Narayana
Sri Hari Govinda Mana Mohana
Janardana Jagat Palana
Deenavana Dukha Bhanjana
Aravinda Lochana Anandana
Sri Vasudeva Janardana
meaning: Salutations to You, Krishna, protector of the world, friend of the meek and the humble. You are the one who protects us from sorrow. O lotus-eyed, blissful Krishna, our salutations to you.
devanagari:
मधुसूदना हरे मधवा
श्री वासुदेवा (साई देवा) जनार्दना
हरी केशवा नारायणा
श्री हरी गोविन्द मन मोहना
जनार्दना जगत पालना
दीनवना दुख भंजना
अरविन्द लोचन आनन्द नाम [ श्री वासुदेव ... ]
respell:
Madhusūdanā Hare Madhavā
Shrī Vāsudevā (sāī Devā) Janārdanā
Harī Keshavā Nārāyaṇā
Shrī Harī Govinda Mana Mohanā
Janārdanā Jagat Pālanā
Dīnavanā Dukha Bhañjanā
Aravinda Lochana Ānanda Nām [ Shrī Vāsudeva ... ]

title: Madhusudana Hey Muralidhara
lyrics:
Madhusudana Hey Muralidhara
Madhava Keshava Devadi Deva
Mana Mohana Hey Narayana
Narayana Sai Narayana
Mana Mohana Hey Narayana
Bhuvana Bharana Vandita Charana
meaning: Lord Krishna is extolled as the slayer of the demon Madhu, a magical flute player, one with beautiful hair and the Lord of lords. He is ever charming, with all the wealth of the world at His feet. He is the ultimate goal of human life.
devanagari:
मधुसूदना हे मुरलीधरा
माधवा केशवा देवादी देवा [ मधुसूदना हे ... ]
मन मोहना हे नारायणा
नारायणा साई नारायणा [ मन मोहना हे ... ]
भुवना भरणा वन्दित चरणा
respell:
Madhusūdanā He Muralīdharā
Mādhavā Keshavā Devādī Devā [ Madhusūdanā He ... ]
Mana Mohanā He Nārāyaṇā
Nārāyaṇā Sāī Nārāyaṇā [ Mana Mohanā He ... ]
Bhuvanā Bharaṇā Vandita Charaṇā

title: Madhusudana Muralidhara
lyrics:
Madhusudana Muralidhara
Madhura Madhura He Giridhara Bala
Madhava Madhusudana
Hrudayanta Ranga Sri Sai Ranga
Sri Ranga Ranga Puttaparthi Ranga
meaning: Glory to Lord Krishna, the slayer of demon Madhu and the one who holds the flute. The child who lifted the Govardhan hill who is the very embodiment of sweetness, lures the minds of everyone. He is also Lord Ranga residing in our hearts and is verily Lord Sai residing at Parthi.
devanagari:
मधुसूदना मुरलीधरा
मधुर मधुर हे गिरिधर बाला  
माधवा मधुसूदना
हृदयान्त रंगा श्री साई रंगा
श्री रंग रंगा पुट्टपर्ती रंगा [ माधव ... ]
respell:
Madhusūdanā Muralīdharā
Madhura Madhura He Giridhara Bālā
Mādhavā Madhusūdanā
Hṛudayānta Raṅgā Shrī Sāī Raṅgā
Shrī Raṅg Raṅgā Puṭṭapartī Raṅgā [ Mādhava ... ]

title: Madhuvan Ke Mohana Murali Bajaiya
lyrics:
Madhuvan Ke Mohana Murali Bajaiya
Giridhari Nanda Kumara Kanhaiya
Ananda Dham Balaram Ji Ke Bhaiyya
Giridhari Nanda Kumara Kanhaiya
Gopi Manohara Rasa Rachaiya
Giridhari Nanda Kumara Kanhaiya
meaning: O adorable Lord Krishna, You are the son of Nanda, the brother of Balaram, the one who gives bliss and the enchanting one who dances with the Gopikas.
devanagari:
मधुवन के मोहना मुरली बजैया
गिरधारी नंद कुमार कन्हैया
आनंद धाम बलराम जी के भैया
गिरधारी नंद कुमार कन्हैया
गोपी मनोहर रास रचैया
गिरधारी नंद कुमार कन्हैया
respell:
Madhuvan Ke Mohanā Muralī Bajaiyā
Giradhārī Nanda Kumāra Kanhaiyā
Ānanda Dhām Balarām Jī Ke Bhaiyā
Giradhārī Nanda Kumāra Kanhaiyā
Gopī Manohar Rās Rachaiyā
Giradhārī Nanda Kumāra Kanhaiyā

title: Madhuvan Ke Muraliwala
lyrics:
Madhuvan Ke Muraliwala
Nacho Nacho Nacho Nandalala
Nandalala Nandalala
Nacho Nacho Nacho Nandalala
Gopi Manohara Gopala Bala
Partheepureeshwara He Sai Natha
Nacho Nacho Nacho Nandalala
meaning: Dance O son of Nanda dance, the one who holds the flute, moving around the forest of demon Madhu, the Gopala of Gopis, the dear Sai of Parthi.
devanagari:
मधुवन के मुरलीवाला
नाचो नाचो नाचो नंदलाला
नंदलाला नंदलाला [ नाचो नाचो ... ]
गोपी मनोहरा गोपाल बाला
पर्तिपूरीश्वर हे साईं नाथा [ नाचो नाचो ... ]
respell:
Madhuvan Ke Muralīvālā
Nācho Nācho Nācho Nandalālā
Nandalālā Nandalālā [ Nācho Nācho ... ]
Gopī Manoharā Gopāla Bālā
Partipūrīshwar He Sāīṃ Nāthā [ nācho Nācho ... ]

title: Madhuvana Murali Guna Gao
lyrics:
Madhuvana Murali Guna Gao
Madhusudana Hari Nam Bhajo
Vraja Gopi Priya Radhe Shyam Nam
Raghupati Raghava Raja Ram Nam
Hrudaya Vihari Sri Sathya Sai Ram
Murali Manohara Mangala Nam Bhajo
meaning: Sing the glory of Lord Krishna, the one with the Flute, who moves about in the forest and who is the slayer of demon Madhu. Chant the name of Shyam, the beloved Radha and the Gopis of Brindavan. Chant the name of Lord Rama of the Raghu dynasty and Lord Shankara (Shiva) who charms Mother Gowri and the name of Lord Sathya Sai who resides in everyone's heart.
devanagari:
मधुवन मुरली गुण गाओ
मधुसूदन हरि नाम जपो [ मधुवन मुरली ... ]
व्रज गोपी प्रिय राधे श्याम नाम
राघुपति राघव राजा राम नाम
हृदय विहारी श्री सत्य साईं राम
गौरी मनोहर शंकर नाम भजो
respell:
Madhuvan Muralī Guṇ Gāo
Madhusūdana Hari Nām Japo [ Madhuvan Muralī ... ]
Vraj Gopī Priy Rādhe Shyām Nām
Rāghupati Rāghav Rājā Rām Nām
Hṛudaya Vihārī Shrī Satya Sāīṃ Rām
Gaurī Manohar Shaṅkar Nām Bhajo

title: Madhuvana Sanchari Shyama Murari
lyrics:
Madhuvana Sanchari Shyama Murari
Sri Madhusudana Muralidhari
Madhava Mohana Mayura Mukutadhara
Mathura Natha Prabhu Giridhari
Mathura Natha Sai Giridhari
meaning: Oh dark-hued Krishna, you wander through the Madhu forest, the enchanting flute-player who vanquished Mura and Madhu. Adorned with a peacock feather crown, you are the Lord of Mathura, the divine lifter of Govardhan mountain.
devanagari:
मधुवन संचारि श्यामा मुरारी
श्री मधुसूदन मुरलीधरि [ मधुवन संचारि ... ]
माधव मोहन मयूर मुकुटधर
मथुरा नाथा प्रभु (साई) गिरिधारी
respell:
Madhuvan Sañchāri Shyāmā Murārī
Shrī Madhusūdana Muralīdhari [ Madhuvan Sañchāri ... ]
Mādhava Mohan Mayūr Mukuṭadhara
Mathurā Nāthā Prabhu (sāī) Giridhārī

title: Madurapuri Nilaye Meenakshi
lyrics:
Madurapuri Nilaye Meenakshi
Kamakoti Nilaye Kamakshi
Kashipuradheeshwari Vishweshwari
Parthipuradheeshwari Sayeeshwari
meaning: Goddess Meenakshi has Her abode in Madurai, Kamakshi has Her abode in Kanchi Kamakoti, Vishweshwari has Her abode in Kashi and Saishwari has Her abode in Parthi.
devanagari:
मदुरापुरी निलये मीनाक्षी
कामकोटी निलये कामाक्षी
काशीपुराधीश्वरी विश्वेश्वरी
पर्तीपुराधीश्वरी साईश्वरी
respell:
Madurāpurī Nilaye Mīnākshī
Kāmakoṭī Nilaye Kāmākshī
Kāshīpurādhīshwarī Vishweshwarī
Partīpurādhīshwarī Sāīshwarī

title: Maha Ganapate Namostute
lyrics:
Mahaganapathe Namostute
Matangavadana Namostute
Mahaganapathe Namostute
Adi Poojita Gananatha
Ananda Dayaka Gananatha
Prathama Vandana Pranavakara
Vighneshwara Vinayaka
meaning: Salutations to the great Lord of the Ganas, the Elephant faced son of Parvati, born of the Himalaya mountains and the very embodiment of the sacred sound Om.
devanagari:
महागणपते नमोस्तुते
मातङ्गवदना नमोस्तुते
महागणपते नमोस्तुते
आदि पूजित गणनाथा
आनन्द दायक गणनाथा
प्रथम वन्दना प्रणवाकारा
विघ्नेश्वरा विनायका
respell:
Mahāgaṇapate Namostute
Mātaṅgavadanā Namostute
Mahāgaṇapate Namostute
Ādi Pūjita Gaṇanāthā
Ānanda Dāyak Gaṇanāthā
Prathama Vandanā Praṇavākārā
Vighneshwarā Vināyakā

title: Mahadeva Maheshwara Sai Narayana
lyrics:
Mahadeva Maheshwara Sai Narayana
Nata Nagara Dukha Bhanjana Sai Narayana
Karunakara Akhileshwara Sai Narayana
Allah Ho Tum Mahavir Yeshu Sai Narayana
Hrudayeshwara Partheeshwara Sai Narayana
meaning:
Sai Narayana is the Lord of all worlds, Epitome of compassion, destroyer of Sin, playful and the supreme Lord of Lords!
Sai Narayana is Allah, Mahaveer and Yeshu. He is the indweller and the Lord of Parthi as well.
devanagari:
महादेवा महेश्वरा साई नारायणा  
नटनागरा दुःख भंजन साई नारायणा  
करुणाकरा अखिलेश्वरा साई नारायणा  
अल्लाह हो तुम महावीर येशु साई नारायणा  
हृदयेश्वरा पार्थेश्वरा साई नारायणा
respell:
Mahādevā Maheshwarā Sāī Nārāyaṇā
Naṭanāgarā Duḥkha Bhañjana Sāī Nārāyaṇā
Karuṇākarā Akhileshwarā Sāī Nārāyaṇā
Allāh Ho Tum Mahāvīr Yeshu Sāī Nārāyaṇā
Hṛudayeshwarā Pārtheshwarā Sāī Nārāyaṇā

title: Mahadeva Shiva Shambho Shankara
lyrics:
Mahadeva Shiva Shambho Shankara
Maheshwara Shiva Shambho Shankara
Mouleeshwara Shiva Shambho Shankara
Madanantaka Shiva Shambho Shankara
Mrutyunjaya Shiva Shambho Shankara
meaning: Oh Mahadeva, Shiva, Shambho, Shankara, our Great God and Supreme Lord! You are Maheshwara, the Lord adorned with matted locks, Mouleeshwara. Vanquisher of desire, Madanantaka, and conqueror of death, Mrutyunjaya, we praise your auspicious presence.
devanagari:
महादेवा शिव शम्भो शंकर
महेश्वरा शिव शम्भो शंकर [ महादेव ... ]
मौलीश्वर शिव शम्भो शंकर
मदनान्तक शिव शम्भो शंकर
मृत्युञ्जया शिव शम्भो शंकर
respell:
Mahādevā Shiv Shambho Shaṅkar
Maheshwarā Shiv Shambho Shaṅkar [ Mahādeva ... ]
Maulīshwar Shiv Shambho Shaṅkar
Madanāntaka Shiv Shambho Shaṅkar
Mṛutyuñjayā Shiv Shambho Shaṅkar

title: Man Ek Bar Hari Bol
lyrics:
Man Ek Bar Hari Bol
Hari Hari Bol Hari Bol [Man Ek Bar..]
Hari Pita Hari Mata
Hari Guru Jnana Data
Chidananda Roopa Hari Patita Pavana Hari Man Ek Bar Hari Bol
meaning: O Mind, chant the name of Lord Hari at least once. He is the Mother, Father, Preceptor and the one who bestows wisdom and who is the very embodiment of Awareness and Bliss and who is the redeemer of the downtrodden.
devanagari:
मन एक बार हरि बोल
हरि हरि बोल हरि बोल [ मन एक बार ... ]
हरि पीता हरि माता
हरि गुरु ज्ञान दाता
चिदानंद रूप हरि पतित पावन हरि मन एक बार हरि बोल
respell:
Man Ek Bār Hari Bol
Hari Hari Bol Hari Bol [ mana ek bāra ... ]
Hari Pītā Hari Mātā
Hari Guru Jñāna Dātā
Chidānanda Rūp Hari Patita Pāvan Hari Man Ek Bār Hari bola

title: Man Mandir Mein Aao Sai
lyrics:
Man Mandir Mein Aao Sai
Sai Bhagawan Darsha Dikhao
Sada Nirantara Bhajo Sai Ram
Giridhara Nagara Natavara Shyam
Sai Bhagawan Darsha Dikhao
meaning: Invoke the presence of Lord Sai into the temple of mind and yearn for His Divine form. Incessantly worship and sing the glory of the Lord, as the one who holds mountain and the one who is the supreme Divine dancer.
devanagari:
मन मंदिर में आओ साईं  
साईं भगवान दर्श दिखाओ [ मन मंदिर ... ]  
सदा निरंतर भजो साईं राम  
गिरिधर नागर नटवर श्याम [ साईं भगवान ... ]
respell:
Man Mandir Meṃ Āo Sāīṃ
Sāīṃ Bhagavān Darsha Dikhāo [ Man Mandir ... ]
Sadā Nirantara Bhajo Sāīṃ Rām
Giridhara Nāgar Naṭavar Shyām [ Sāīṃ Bhagavān ... ]

title: Man Mandir Mein Sai Ram
lyrics:
Man Mandir Mein Sai Ram
Megha Shyam Radhe Shyam Sathya Sai Ram
Sri Ram Jaya Ram
Janam Janam Ka Tum Se Natha
Parthipuri Parameshwara Roopa
Deena Dayala Hey Jagannatha
Parthipuri Parameshwara Roopa
Sharan Mein Lelo Prabhu Sai Ram
Megha Shyam Radhe Shyam Sathya Sai Ram
meaning: The dark complexioned Lord Krishna, Radha's consort is the same as Lord Sathya Sai Ram dwelling in everyone's heart. O Lord, accept me in Your fold, O the refuge of the forlorn. May we be bonded with You in all our lives.
devanagari:
मन मंदिर में साई राम
मेघ श्याम राधे श्याम सत्य साई राम
श्री राम जय राम
जनम जनम का तुम से नाता
पर्तीपुरी परमेश्वर रूपा
दीन दयाला हे जगन्नाथा [पर्तीपुरी परमेश्वर ..]
चरण में लेलो प्रभु साई राम [मेघ श्याम ..]
respell:
Man Mandir Meṃ Sāī Rām
Megha Shyām Rādhe Shyām Satya Sāī Rām
Shrī Rām Jaya Rām
Janam Janam Kā Tum Se Nātā
Partīpurī Parameshwar Rūpā
Dīna Dayālā He Jagannāthā [partīpurī parameshwar ..]
Charaṇ Meṃ Lelo prabhu sāī rām [megha shyām ..]

title: Man Mein Mere Gopala Shyama Radhe Nandalala
lyrics:
Man Mey Merey Gopala Shyama Radhey Nandalala
Shyama Gopala Sai Gopala
Brindavan Ke Nandalala Brindavan Ke Nandalala
Yashoda Tanaya Gopala
Yadu Kula Tilaka Gopala
Radha Lola Gopala
Raasa Vilola Gopala
meaning: My heart is devoted to Gopala, the dark-complexioned son of Nanda and Yashoda, who resides in Brindavan. He is the glorious gem of the Yadu lineage, Radha's cherished companion, and the joyful participant in the divine Raas Leela.
devanagari:
मन में मेरे गोपाला श्यामा राधे नंदलाला
श्यामा गोपाला साईं गोपाला
बृन्दावन के नंदलाला बृन्दावन के नंदलाला
यशोदा तनया गोपाला
यादु कुल तिलक गोपाला
राधा लोला गोपाला
रास विलोल गोपाला
respell:
Man Meṃ Mere Gopālā Shyāmā Rādhe Nandalālā
Shyāmā Gopālā Sāīṃ Gopālā
Bṛundāvan Ke Nandalālā Bṛundāvan Ke Nandalālā
Yashodā Tanayā Gopālā
Yādu Kul Tilak Gopālā
Rādhā Lolā Gopālā
Rās Vilol Gopālā

title: Mana Bangaru Parthi Baba
lyrics:
Mana Bangaru Parthi Baba
Mana Shringara Vadana Sai
Antaryami Baba
Mana Sarvantaryami Sai
meaning:
Our Bangaru (most dear), O Baba of Parthi
Our Sai, the One of enchanting countenance
Our Bangaru, O Baba of Parthi
O Baba, who is my Soul
You are Our Sai, the Indweller in all
devanagari:
मन बङ्गारु पर्ती बाबा
मन शृङ्गार वदन साई
अन्तर्यामी बाबा
मन सर्वान्तर्यामी साई
respell:
Mana Baṅgāru Partī Bābā
Mana Shṛuṅgār Vadana Sāī
Antaryāmī Bābā
Mana Sarwāntaryāmī Sāī

title: Mana Mohana Murali Gopala
lyrics:
Mana Mohana Murali Gopala Jaya Govinda Radhey Gopala
Pandari Natha Jaya Hari Vittala
Govardhana Giridhari Gopala
meaning: Oh enchanting Gopala, whose flute captivates the mind, we hail you as Govinda, Radha's beloved! You are the Lord of Pandhari, Hari Vittala, the divine one who lifted the Govardhan mountain.
devanagari:
मन मोहन मुरली गोपाला जय गोविन्द राधे गोपाला
पंढरी नाथ जय हरि विट्ठला
गोवर्धन गिरिधारी गोपाला
respell:
Mana Mohan Muralī Gopālā Jaya Govinda Rādhe Gopālā
Paṇḍharī Nātha Jaya Hari Viṭṭhalā
Govardhana Giridhārī Gopālā

title: Mana Mohana Nandalal
lyrics:
Mana Mohana Nandalal
Mana Mohana Madhusudana Brindavana Nandalal
Mana Mohana Nandalal
Brindavana Nandalal
Mana Mohana Madhusudana Brindavana Nandalal
meaning: Oh, mind-enchanting Nandalal, you captivate our hearts! You are Madhusudana, the beloved son of Nanda who graced the sacred land of Vrindavan.
devanagari:
मन मोहना नंदलाल
मन मोहना मधुसूदन ब्रिंदावन नंदलाल [ मन मोहन ... ]
मन मोहना नंदलाल
ब्रिंदावना नंदलाल [ मन मोहना मधुसूदना ... ]
respell:
Mana Mohanā Nandalāl
Mana Mohanā Madhusūdana Brindāvan Nandalāl [ Mana Mohan ... ]
Mana Mohanā Nandalāl
Brindāvanā Nandalāl [ Mana Mohanā Madhusūdanā ... ]

title: Manasa Bhajare Guru Charanam
lyrics:
Manasa Bhajare Guru Charanam
Sai Charanam Pranamamyaham
Sathya Sai Charanam Pranamamyaham
Nirmala Hrudaya Virajita Charanam
Sakala Charachara Vyapaka Charanam
Bhava Sagara Uddharaka Charanam
Sai Charanam Pranamamyaham
Sathya Sai Charanam Pranamamyaham
meaning: Oh Mind, worship the feet of the Guru and bow to Sathya Sai, who resides in the pure heart. He is the essence present in all beings and non-beings, guiding us to transcend the ocean of birth and death.
devanagari:
मानस भजोरॆ गुरु चरणम्  
साई चरणम् प्रणमाम्यहम् (सत्य) (२)  
निर्मल हृदय विराजित चरणम्  
सकल चराचर व्यापक चरणम्  
भव सागर उद्धारक चरणम् 
[ (सत्य) साई चरणम् (२) ... ]
respell:
Mānasa Bhajoraॆ Guru Charaṇam
Sāī Charaṇam Praṇamāmyaham (satya) (2)
Nirmalā Hṛdaya Virājita Charaṇam
Sakala Charāchara Vyāpaka Charaṇam
Bhava Sāgara Uddhāraka Charaṇam
[ (satya) Sāī Charaṇam (2) ... ]

title: Manasa Bhajare Guru Charanam
lyrics:
Manasa Bhajare Guru Charanam
Dustara Bhava Sagara Taranam
Guru Maharaj Guru Jai Jai
Sai Natha Sadguru Jai Jai
Sathya Sai Natha Sadguru Jai Jai
Om Namah Shivaya Om Namah Shivaya
Om Namah Shivaya Shivaya Namah Om
Arunachala Shiva Arunachala Shiva
Arunachala Shiva Aruna Shivom
Omkaram Bhava Omkaram Bhava
Omkaram Bhava Om Namo Baba
meaning: O mind! Meditate on the Lotus Feet of the Lord. That will take you safely across the ocean of life and death. Glory to the supreme guru, Lord Sathya Sai. Chant ‘Om Namah Shivaya’. Chant the name of Lord Shiva, the One who resides in Arunachala. Bow to Sai Baba who is Om personified.
devanagari:
मानस भजो रे गुरु चरणम्
दुस्तर भव सागर तरणम्
गुरु महाराज गुरु जय जय
साई नाथ सद्गुरु जय जय
ॐ नमः शिवाय ॐ नमः शिवाय ॐ नमः शिवाय शिवाय नमः ॐ
अरुणाचल शिव अरुणाचल शिव अरुणाचल शिव अरुण शिवोम्
ओंकारम् भव ओंकारम् भव ओंकारम् भव ओं नमो बाबा
respell:
Mānasa Bhajo Re Guru charaṇam
Dustara Bhava Sāgar Taraṇam
Guru Mahārāj Guru Jay Jay
Sāī Nātha Sadguru Jay Jay
Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy Shivāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Aruṇāchala Shiv Aruṇāchala Shiv Aruṇāchala Shiv Aruṇ Shivom
Oṅkāram Bhava Oṅkāram Bhava Oṅkāram Bhava Oṃ Namo Bābā

title: Mandara Giridhara Madana Manohara
lyrics:
Mandara Giridhara Madana Manohara
Meera Ke Prabhu Giridhara Nagara
Giridhari Giridhari Govardhanadhara Giridhari
Madhava Madhusudana
Murali Gana Vilola
meaning: O Lord, you are the enchanting lifter of Govardhana mountain, beloved master of Meera. We adore you, Madhava, slayer of the demon Madhu, who revels in the sweet music of the flute.
devanagari:
मंदर गिरिधर मदन मनोहर
मीरा के प्रभु गिरिधर नागर
गिरिधारी गिरिधारी गोवर्धनधर गिरिधारी (2)
माधवा मधुसूदना
मुरली गान विलोला
respell:
Mandara Giridhara Madana Manohar
Mīrā Ke Prabhu Giridhara Nāgar
Giridhārī Giridhārī Govardhanadhara Giridhārī (2)
Mādhavā Madhusūdanā
Muralī Gān Vilolā

title: Mandaramala Dhara Jaya Gauri Shankara
lyrics:
Mandara Mala Dhara Jaya Gauri Shankara
Hara Hara Pahi Trinetra
Gangadhara Bimbadhara Chandramouli Shankara [Mandara Mala Dhara..]
Vamadeva Mahadeva Shiva Shiva Shiva Shankara
Sathya Dharma Shanti Prema Sathya Sai Shankara
meaning: Victory to Lord Shankara, the consort of Gowri, who adorns the garland of 'Mandara' flowers. Victory to the benevolent three-eyed one who wears the Ganga and the moon on His crown of hair. Victory to the God of Gods, Lord Shiva. He is none other than our Sathya Sai who is the embodiment of Truth, Righteousness, Peace and Love.
devanagari:
मंदार माल धरा जय गौरी शंकरा
हर हरा पाहि त्रिनेत्रा  
गंगाधर बिम्बाधर चंद्रमौली शंकरा [ मंदार माल धरा ... ]  
वामदेव महादेव शिव शिव शिव शंकरा
सत्य धर्म शांति प्रेम सत्य साईं शंकरा
respell:
Mandāra Māla Dharā Jaya Gaurī Shaṅkarā
Har Harā Pāhi Trinetrā
Gaṅgādhara Bimbādhara Chandramaulī Shaṅkarā [ Mandāra Māla Dharā ... ]
Vāmadeva Mahādeva Shiv Shiv Shiv Shaṅkarā
Satya Dharma Shānti Prem Satya Sāīṃ Shaṅkarā

title: Mandir Mein Aao Madhava
lyrics:
Mandir Mein Aao Madhava
Madhava Keshava
Adi Narayana Anantha Sai
Aao Aao Hridaya Nivasi
Radha Lola Rakhumayi Vitthala
Ranga Panduranga Vitthala
--
Vitthala Vitthala Panduranga Vitthala
Vitthala Vitthala Parthiranga Vitthala
meaning: Oh Madhava, Keshava, please come into the temple of my heart. You are the primordial Narayana, the infinite Sai, the beloved dweller within. We earnestly call upon you, Vitthala, the darling of Radha and Rukmini, O Panduranga, O Parthiranga.
devanagari:
मंदिर में आओ माधवा
माधवा केशवा [ मंदिर में ... ]
आदि नारायण अनन्त साई
आओ आओ हृदय निवासी
राधा लोला रकुमाई विट्ठला
रंगा पांडुरंगा विट्ठला
---
विट्ठल विट्ठल पर्ती रंगा विट्ठल
respell:
Mandir Meṃ Āo Mādhavā
Mādhavā Keshavā [ Mandir Meṃ ... ]
Ādi Nārāyaṇ Ananta Sāī
Āo Āo Hṛudaya Nivāsī
Rādhā Lolā Rakumāī Viṭṭhalā
Raṅgā Pāṇḍuraṅgā Viṭṭhalā
---
Viṭṭhala Viṭṭhala Partī Raṅgā Viṭṭhala

title: Mandir Mein Tum Ram Ho Sai
lyrics:
Mandir Mein Tum Ram Ho Sai
Masjid Mein Noor Mohammad
Gurudware Mein Tum Guru Nanak
Man Mandir Mein Sai Sai
Bolo Ram Ek Hi Nam (2)
Sab Mil Bolo Sai Ram
meaning: You are adored as Ram in the Temple, as the light of Mohammad in the mosque; You are Guru Nanak in the Gurudwara; In the temple of my mind, You are Sai. Chant the name of Ram, let us chant together Sai Ram.
devanagari:
मंदिर में तुम राम हो साईं
मस्जिद में नूर मोहम्मद (अल्लाह हो अकबर)
गुरुद्वारे में तुम गुरु नानक
मन मंदिर में साईं साईं
बोलो राम एक ही नाम (2)
सब मिल बोलो साईं राम
respell:
Mandir Meṃ Tum Rām Ho Sāīṃ
Masjid Meṃ Nūr Mohammad (allāh ho akabara)
Gurudwāre Meṃ Tum Guru Nānak
Man Mandir Meṃ Sāīṃ Sāīṃ
Bolo Rām Ek Hī Nām (2)
Sab Mil Bolo Sāīṃ Rām

title: Mangala Charana Gajanana
lyrics:
Mangala Charana Gajanana
Gajavadana Shubhanana
Vidya Dayaka Buddhi Pradayaka
Gauri Tanaya Gajanana
meaning: Salutations to the Lotus Feet of the benevolent and goodness bestowing Elephant-faced Lord. He is the provider of knowledge and intelligence, the son of Gowri.
devanagari:
मंगल चरणा गजानना
गजवदना शुभनना [ मंगल चरणा ... ]
विद्या दायक बुद्धि प्रदायक
गौरी तनया गजानना
respell:
Maṅgal Charaṇā Gajānanā
Gajavadanā Shubhananā [ Maṅgal Charaṇā ... ]
Vidyā Dāyak Buddhi Pradāyak
Gaurī Tanayā Gajānanā

title: Mangala Dayaka Hey Gananatha
lyrics:
Mangala Dayaka Hey Gananatha
Pranava Swaroopa Vighna Vinasha
He Shiva Nandana Pahi Dayala
Parthipureeshwara Jagat Paripala
Pranava Swaroopa Vighna Vinasha
meaning: O Lord Ganesha, the bestower of good, Lord of the Ganas, the very embodiment of the primordial sound and the destroyer of obstacles. The merciful, loving son of Lord Shiva, He is also the Lord of Parthi, the ruler of the Universe.
devanagari:
मंगल दायक हे गणनाथा
प्रणव स्वरूपा विघ्न विनाशा
हे शिव नंदन पाहि दयाला
पर्तिपूरीश्वर जगत परिपाला [ प्रणव स्वरूप ... ]
respell:
Maṅgal Dāyak He Gaṇanāthā
Praṇava Swarūpā Vighna Vināshā
He Shiv Nandana Pāhi Dayālā
Partipūrīshwar Jagat Paripālā [ praṇav Swarūp ... ]

title: Mangala Karini Jai Sai Ma
lyrics:
Mangala Karini Jai Sai Ma
Jai Sai Ma Jai Sai Ma
Bhagya Pradayini Sai Ma
Bhava Bhayaharini Sai Ma
Tribhuvana Palini Jai Sai Ma
Mata Maheshwari Sai Ma
--
Jai Jai Jai Sai Ma
meaning: Victory to Mother Sai who bestows auspiciousness and wealth, who is the destroyer of fear of worldly attachments and who is the ruler of the three worlds.
devanagari:
मंगल कारिणी जय साई माँ
जय साई माँ जय साई माँ
भाग्य प्रदायिनी साई माँ
भव भयहारिणी साई माँ
त्रिभुवन पालिनी जय साई माँ
माता महेश्वरी साई माँ
--
जय जय जय साई माँ
respell:
Maṅgal Kāriṇī Jay Sāī Mām̐
Jay Sāī Mām̐ Jay Sāī Mām̐
Bhāgya Pradāyinī Sāī Mām̐
Bhava Bhayahāriṇī Sāī Mām̐
Tribhuvan Pālinī Jay Sāī Mām̐
Mātā Maheshwarī Sāī Mām̐
--
Jay Jay Jay Sāī Mām̐

title: Mangala Karini Sai Janani
lyrics:
Mangala Karini Sai Janani
Mata Maheshwari Veda Kalamayi
Raga Priyakari Bageshwari Ma
Jagat Janani Ma Jagat Janani Ma Jagat Janani Ma
Mata Pitha Guru Sai Janani
meaning: Oh Mother Sai, you are the bestower of all blessings, the Great Goddess embodying Vedic wisdom and the arts. You delight in music, Mother of the universe, and are our divine parent and spiritual guide.

title: Mangala Pradayini Sai Shankari
lyrics:
Mangala Pradayini Sai Shankari
Shiva Shankari Sayeeshwari Shiva Shakthi Roopini [ Mangala Pradayini ... ]
Sri Chakra Dhari Nilayey Amba Moksha Dayini [ Shiva Shankari ... ]
meaning: Oh Mother Sai, you are the auspicious Shankari, the very embodiment of Shiva and Shakti. Residing within the sacred Sri Chakra, you are the divine Mother who grants ultimate liberation.

title: Mangala Shubhakari Mata Maheshwari
lyrics:
Mangala Shubhakari Mata Maheshwari
Ambe Bhavani Akhilandeshwari
Rajiva Lochani Raja Rajeshwari
Adi Parashakti Sri Parameshwari
Ananda Roopini Sai Shiva Shankari
meaning: I propitiate Mother Maheshwari, who bestows auspiciousness, Mother Bhavani the mother of the Universe, the lotus eyed Raja Rajeshwari and Shiva Shankari who is the personification of the primordial energy and eternal bliss.
devanagari:
मंगल शुभकारी माता महेश्वरी
अम्बे भवानी अखिलंडेश्वरी [ मंगल शुभकारी ... ]
राजीव लोचनी राज राजेश्वरी
आदि पराशक्ति श्री परमेश्वरी
आनंद रूपिणी हे (साई) शिव शंकरी
respell:
Maṅgal Shubhakārī Mātā Maheshwarī
Ambe Bhavānī Akhilaṇḍeshwarī [ Maṅgal Shubhakārī ... ]
Rājīva Lochanī Rāj Rājeshwarī
Ādi Parāshakti Shrī Parameshwarī
Ānanda Rūpiṇī He (sāī) Shiv Shaṅkarī

title: Manuva Bolo Jai Sita Ram Bolo Jai Radhe Shyam
lyrics:
Manuva Bolo Jai Sita Ram Bolo Jai Radhe Shyam
Jai Sita Ram Bolo Jai Radhe Shyam (3)
meaning: Let us chant and meditate on Lord Ram whose consort is Mother Sita, and Lord Shyam, the saviour of Mother Radha. May victory be to Lord Ram, who also incarnated as Lord Shyam.
devanagari:
मनुवा बोलो जय सीता राम बोलो जय राधे श्याम
जय सीता राम बोलो जय राधे श्याम (3)
respell:
Manuvā Bolo Jay Sītā Rām Bolo Jay Rādhe Shyām
Jay Sītā Rām Bolo Jay Rādhe Shyām (3)

title: Manuva Bolo Radhe Radhe Radhe Radhe Shyam Nam
lyrics:
Manuva Bolo Radhe Radhe Radhe Radhe Shyam Nam
Ram Ram Ram Bolo Ram Sita Ram Nam
Ranga Ranga Ranga Bolo Panduranga Baba Nam
Parthi Vasa Sai Deva Panduranga Baba Nam
Tukaram Namdeva Bhakta Sakha Baba Nam
Panduranga Panduranga Panduranga Baba Nam
meaning: O mind, chant the holy names of Shyam, Ram, and Panduranga. The Lord of Parthi, Sai Baba, is indeed this Panduranga, who served as a divine friend to revered devotees like Tukaram and Namdev.
devanagari:
मनुवा बोलो राधे राधे राधे राधे श्याम नाम
राम राम राम बोलो राम सीता राम नाम [ मनुवा बोलो ... ]
रंग रंग रंगा बोलो पांडुरंग बाबा नाम
पर्ती वासा साई देवा पांडुरंग बाबा नाम
तुकाराम नामदेवा भक्त सखा बाबा नाम
पांडुरंग पांडुरंग पांडुरंग बाबा नाम
respell:
Manuvā Bolo Rādhe Rādhe Rādhe Rādhe Shyām Nām
Rām Rām Rām Bolo Rām Sītā Rām Nām [ Manuvā Bolo ... ]
Raṅg Raṅg Raṅgā Bolo Pāṇḍuraṅg Bābā Nām
Partī Vāsā Sāī Devā Pāṇḍuraṅg Bābā Nām
Tukārām Nāmadevā Bhakta Sakhā Bābā Nām
Pāṇḍuraṅg Pāṇḍuraṅg Pāṇḍuraṅg Bābā Nām

title: Mata Bhavani Jagadambe Ma
lyrics:
Mata Bhavani Jagadambe Ma
O Ma O Ma O Ma
Shakti Pradayini Ananda Roopini
Katyayani Karuna Sadani
O Ma O Ma O Ma
meaning:
Glory to the Mother Bhavani (Parvati), the Mother of the Universe. 
The bestower of power, Mother Katyayani is the embodiment of bliss and the very abode of compassion.
devanagari:
माता भवानी जगदम्बे मा
ओ माँ ओ माँ ओ माँ [ माता भवानी ... ]
शक्ति प्रदायिनी आनंद रूपिणी
कट्यायनी करुणा सदनी [ ओ माँ ... ]
respell:
Mātā Bhavānī Jagadambe Mā
O Mām̐ O Mām̐ O Mām̐ [ Mātā Bhavānī ... ]
Shakti Pradāyinī Ānanda Rūpiṇī
Kaṭyāyanī Karuṇā Sadanī [ O Mām̐ ... ]

title: Mata Maheshwari Tribhuvana Janani
lyrics:
Mata Maheshwari Tribhuvana Janani
Premamayi Sathya Sai Janani
Shiva Mana Mohini Papa Vinashini
Veda Kalamayi Kalyana Dayini
Jagadoddharini Parthi Narayani
Premamayi Sathya Sai Janani
meaning: The mother of three worlds, Maheshwari (who is Parvati the Consort of Shiva) who is none other than Lord Sathya Sai is the personification of Love, is the enchanter of Lord Shiva. She is the destroyer of sins, the embodiment of Vedas and the one who bestows auspiciousness. The goddess Narayani of Parthi is the uplifter of the Universe.
devanagari:
माता महेश्वरी त्रिभुवन जननी
प्रेममयी सत्य साई जननी
शिव मन मोहिनी पाप विनाशिनी
वेद कालमयी कल्याण दायिनी
जगतोद्धारिणी पर्ती नारायणी [ प्रेममयी ]
respell:
Mātā Maheshwarī Tribhuvan Jananī
Premamayī Satya Sāī Jananī
Shiv Mana Mohinī Pāpa Vināshinī
Ved Kālamayī Kalyāṇ Dāyinī
Jagatoddhāriṇī Partī Nārāyaṇī [ Premamayī ]

title: Mata Mata Sai Mata
lyrics:
Mata Mata Sai Mata
Jagat Mata Sai Vishwa Mata
Durga Bhavani Kali Kapalini
Shanti Dayini Sai Mata
meaning: Mother Sai is the mother of the Universe. She is known by names like Durga, Bhavani, and Kali. She is the bestower of peace.
devanagari:
माता माता साई माता  
जगत माता साई विश्व माता [ माता माता ... ]  
दुर्गा भवानी काली कपालिनी  
शान्ति दायिनी साई माता
respell:
Mātā Mātā Sāī Mātā
Jagat Mātā Sāī Vishwa Mātā [ Mātā Mātā ... ]
Durgā Bhavānī Kālī Kapālinī
Shānti Dāyinī Sāī Mātā

title: Mata Pita Guru Bandhu Sakha Hari
lyrics:
Mata Pita Guru Bandhu Sakha Hari
Narayana Hari Narayana (2)
Allah Tum Ho Yeshu Tum Ho
Buddha Zoroastra Mahavir Tum Ho
Sab Ka Malik Ek Hai Bhagawan
Narayana Hari Narayana
Narayana Sai Narayana
meaning: O Lord Sai Narayana you are the Mother, Father, Guru, Kith and Kin. You are none other than Allah, Jesus, Buddha, Zoroaster, Mahavir and the Lord of the entire humanity.
devanagari:
माता पिता गुरु बंधु सखा हरि
नारायणा साई नारायणा (2)
अल्लाह तुम हो येसु तुम हो
बुद्ध जोह्राष्ट्र महावीर तुम हो
सब का मालिक एक है भगवान [ नारायणा साई ]
respell:
Mātā Pitā Guru Bandhu Sakhā Hari
Nārāyaṇā Sāī Nārāyaṇā (2)
Allāh Tum Ho Yesu Tum Ho
Buddha Johrāshṭra Mahāvīr Tum Ho
Sab Kā Mālik Ek Hai Bhagavān [ Nārāyaṇā Sāī ]

title: Mata Pitha Guru Bandhu Sakha
lyrics:
Mata Pitha Guru Bandhu Sakha Hari
Narayana Hari (Sai) Narayana
Janaki Jeevana Sita Mohana
Lakshmi Ramana Narayana
meaning: O Lord Narayana, you embody all my relationships—my mother, father, teacher, family, and friend. You are the life-force of Janaki (Sita) and the beloved consort of Lakshmi.
devanagari:
माता पिता गुरु बंधु सखा हरि
नारायणा हरि (साई) नारायणा
जानकी जीवन सीता मोहन
लक्ष्मी रमणा नारायणा
respell:
Mātā Pitā Guru Bandhu Sakhā Hari
Nārāyaṇā Hari (sāī) Nārāyaṇā
Jānakī Jīvan Sītā Mohan
Lakshmī Ramaṇā Nārāyaṇā

title: Mata Rani Teri Jai Jai Kaar
lyrics:
Mata Rani Teri Jai Jai Kaar Ambe Rani Teri Jai Jai Kaar
Mata Rani Teri Jai Jai Kaar Ambe Rani Teri Jai Jai Kaar
Ma Sheravali Ma Jyotavali
Pahadavali Ma Lattavali
Prem Se Bolo (Jai Matadi)
Sare Bolo (Jai Matadi)
Sab Mil Bolo (Jai Matadi)
Baar Se Bolo (Jai Matadi)
Mata Rani Jai Jai Kaar Ambe Rani Jai Jai Kaar
meaning: Oh Divine Mother, Queen Ambe, we declare victory and praise to you! You are the lion-mounted goddess, the radiant light, and the revered dweller of the mountains. With love, let us all together repeatedly chant "Hail Mother!"
devanagari:
माता रानी तेरी जय जय कार अम्बे रानी तेरी जय जय कार
माता रानी तेरी जय जय कार अम्बे रानी तेरी जय जय कार
मा शेरावाली मा ज्योतिवाली
पहाड़ावाली मा लट्टावाली
प्रेम से बोलो (जय मातादी)
सारे बोलो (जय मातादी)
सब मिल बोलो (जय मातादी)
बार से बोलो (जय मातादी)
माता रानी जय जय कार अम्बे रानी जय जय कार
respell:
Mātā Rānī Terī Jay Jay Kār Ambe Rānī Terī Jay Jay Kār
Mātā Rānī Terī Jay Jay Kār Ambe Rānī Terī Jay Jay Kār
Mā Sherāvālī Mā Jyotivālī
Pahāḍa़āvālī Mā Laṭṭāvālī
Prem Se Bolo (jay Mātādī)
Sāre Bolo (jay Mātādī)
Sab Mil Bolo (jay Mātādī)
Bār Se Bolo (jay Mātādī)
Mātā Rānī Jay Jay Kār Ambe Rānī Jay Jay Kār

title: Matanga Vadana Ananda Sadana
lyrics:
Matanga Vadana Ananda Sadana
Mahadeva Shiva Shambho Nandana
Maya Vinashaka Mooshika Vahana
Mata Maheshwari Bhavani Nandana
Maha Ganapate Mangala Charana
meaning:
Oh the elephant-faced Lord Ganesha, the very source of bliss.
Oh the beloved son of Lord Shiva, the Lord of Lords and the embodiment of auspiciousness.
Oh Lord, the dispeller of ignorance and who has the mouse as the vehicle.
Oh the beloved son of Divine Mother who is the consort of Maheswara, and the one who symbolises the virtue of steadfastness and faith.
Oh Lord Ganapati, the Lord of Ganas, Thy lotus feet is so auspicious.
devanagari:
मतंग वदना आनंद सदना
महादेव शिव शम्भो नंदन [ मतंग वदना ... ]
माया विनाशक मूषिक वाहन
माता महेश्वरी भवानी नंदन
महागणपते मंगल चरणा (2)
respell:
Mataṅga Vadanā Ānanda Sadanā
Mahādeva Shiv Shambho Nandana [ Mataṅga Vadanā ... ]
Māyā Vināshak Mūshik Vāhan
Mātā Maheshwarī Bhavānī Nandana
Mahāgaṇapate Maṅgal Charaṇā (2)

title: Matanga Vadana Mam Palaya
lyrics:
Matanga Vadana Mam Palaya
Mouleeshwara Shiva Gauri Nandana (2)
Mangala Dayaka Siddhi Vinayaka
meaning: O Elephant faced Lord Ganesha, protect me. O beloved son of Lord Shiva and Gowri, You are the one who bestows auspiciousness and success in our endeavours.
devanagari:
मतंगा वदना माम् पालया
मौलीश्वर शिव गौरी नंदन (२)
मंगल दायक सिद्धि विनायक
respell:
Mataṅgā Vadanā Mām Pālayā
Maulīshwar Shiv Gaurī Nandana (2)
Maṅgal Dāyak Siddhi Vināyak

title: Mathuradhipate Krishna Mukunda
lyrics:
Mathuradhipate Krishna Mukunda
Madhusudana Ghana Shyama Mukunda
Venu Vinodana Parthi Ramana
Yadu Kula Bhooshana Rajeeva Lochana
Parthipureeshwara Jaya Mana Mohana
Madhusudana Ghana Shyama Mukunda
meaning: Glory to the Lord of Mathura, Lord Krishna, also known as Mukunda and Madhusudhana (the slayer of demon Madhu). He has a dark complexion, plays enchanting music on the Flute, the crown jewel of the Yadava clan and is lotus-eyed. Victory to Lord Sai, Lord of Parthi, who fills our minds with bliss. He is verily Lord Krishna.
devanagari:
मथुराधीपते कृष्ण मुकुंदा
मधुसूदन घनश्याम मुकुंदा
वेणु विनोदना पर्ति रमणा
यदु कुल भूषण राजीव लोचना
पर्तिपूरीश्वर जय मन मोहना [ मधुसूदन ... ]
respell:
Mathurādhīpate Kṛushṇa Mukundā
Madhusūdana Ghanashyām Mukundā
Veṇu Vinodanā Parti Ramaṇā
Yadu Kul Bhūshaṇ Rājīva Lochanā
Partipūrīshwar Jaya Mana Mohanā [ madhusūdana ... ]

title: May The Love We're Sharing
lyrics:
May The Love We're Sharing Spread Its Wings
Fly Across The Earth And Bring
New Joy To Every Soul That Is Alive
Samastha Loka Sukhino Bhavanthu
May All The Beings In All The Worlds Be Happy
Revealing All That's True
And Bringing Peace To Every Soul That Is Alive
Samastha Loka Sukhino Bhavanthu
May All The Beings In All The Worlds Be Happy
devanagari:
मे द लव वीर शेरिङ स्प्रेड इट्स विङ्ज
फ्लाइ अक्रोस द अरथ अन्ड ब्रिङ
नू जोय टू एवरई सोल दैट इज अलाइव
समस्थ लोका सुखिनो भवन्थु
मे ओल द बीइङ्ज इन ओल द वरल्ड्ज बी हैपी
रिवीलिङ ओल दैट्स ट्रू
अन्ड ब्रिङिङ पीस टू एवरई सोल दैट इज अलाइव
समस्थ लोका सुखिनो भवन्थु
मे ओल द बीइङ्ज इन ओल द वरल्ड्ज बी हैपी

title: Meera Nath Hare Giridhari
lyrics:
Meera Nath Hare Giridhari
Radha Pyare Krishna Murari
Brindavan Ke Sai Murari
Bhaktoddhari Baba Murari
meaning: O Lord Giridhari, You are the beloved master of Meera and Radha's dearest Krishna Murari. You are the divine Sai of Brindavan, the compassionate Baba who liberates all devotees from suffering.
devanagari:
मीरा नाथ हरे गिरिधारी
राधा प्यारे कृष्ण मुरारी
वृन्दावन के साई मुरारी
भक्तोद्धारी बाबा मुरारी
respell:
Mīrā Nāth Hare Giridhārī
Rādhā Pyāre Kṛushṇa Murārī
Vṛundāvan Ke Sāī Murārī
Bhaktoddhārī Bābā Murārī

title: Mera Jeevan Tere Hawale Prabhu Ise Pag Pag Tu Hi Sambhale
lyrics:
Mera Jeevan Tere Hawale Prabhu Ise Pag Pag Tu Hi Sambhale
Pag Pag Tu Hi Sambhale Ise Ho Pag Pag Tu Hi Sambhale
Bhava Sagar Mein Jeevan Naiya Dol Rahi Hain O Rakhvaiya
Dol Rahi Hain O Rakhvaiya Ise Par Tu Hi Lagale Prabhu Ise Pag Pag Tu Hi Sambhale
Moh Maya Ke Bandhan Todo Hey Prabhu Apni Sharan Me Lelo
Hey Prabhu Apni Sharan Me Lelo
Ise Sai Tu Apnale Prabhu Ise Pag Pag Tu Hi Sambhale
Mera Jeevan Tere Hawale Prabhu Ise Pag Pag Tu Hi Sambhale
meaning: I submit my life in Your care, O Lord. Please take care of it every moment. The boat of my life is wobbling in this sea of worldliness, O dear Caretaker, only You should take it across. Liberate us from the bondage of illusion, take us in Your care and shelter. Please accept this sinner, O Lord.
devanagari:
मेरा जीवन तेरे हवाले प्रभु इसे पग पग तू ही संभाले
पग पग तू ही संभाले इसे हो पग पग तू ही संभाले
भव सागर में जीवन नैया डोल रही हैं ओ रखवैया
डोल रही हैं ओ रखवैया इसे पार तू ही लगा ले प्रभु इसे पग पग तू ही संभाले
मोह माया के बंधन तोड़ो हे प्रभु अपनी शरण में ले लो
हे प्रभु अपनी शरण में ले लो
इसे साई तू अपना ले प्रभु इसे पग पग तू ही संभाले
मेरा जीवन तेरे हवाले प्रभु इसे पग पग तू ही संभाले
respell:
Merā Jīvan Tere Havāle Prabhu Ise Pag Pag Tū Hī Sambhāle
Pag Pag Tū Hī Sambhāle Ise Ho Pag Pag Tū Hī Sambhāle
Bhava Sāgar Meṃ Jīvan Naiyā Ḍol Rahī Haiṃ O Rakhavaiyā
Ḍol Rahī Haiṃ O Rakhavaiyā Ise Pār Tū Hī Lagā Le Prabhu Ise Pag Pag Tū Hī sambhāle
Moh Māyā Ke Bandhan Toḍa़o He Prabhu Apanī Sharaṇ Meṃ Le lo
He Prabhu Apanī Sharaṇ Meṃ Le lo
Ise Sāī Tū Apanā Le Prabhu Ise Pag Pag Tū Hī sambhāle
Merā Jīvan Tere Havāle Prabhu Ise Pag Pag Tū Hī Sambhāle

title: Mita Smita Sundara Mukharavinda Nacho Nandalala
lyrics:
Mita Smita Sundara Mukharavinda Nacho Nandalala
Nacho Nandalala Nandalala (3)
Meera Ke Prabhu Lala Nandalala (3)
Nacho Nandalala Nandalala
meaning: O Nandalala, with your beautiful, gently smiling lotus face, please dance! You are the beloved Lord of Meera, so dance, darling Krishna.
devanagari:
मिता स्मिता सुंदर मुखरविन्दा नाचो नन्दलाला
नाचो नन्दलाला नन्दलाला (3)
मीरा के प्रभु लाला नन्दलाला (3)
नाचो नन्दलाला नन्दलाला
respell:
Mitā Smitā Sundara Mukharavindā Nācho Nandalālā
Nācho Nandalālā Nandalālā (3)
Mīrā Ke Prabhu Lālā Nandalālā (3)
nācho nandalālā nandalālā

title: Mohana Murali Govinda Jaya Radhe Govinda
lyrics:
Mohana Murali Govinda Jaya Radhe Govinda
Hey Giridhari Govinda Jaya Radhe Govinda
Krishna Murari Govinda Jaya Radhe Govinda
Parthi Vihari Govinda Jaya Radhe Govinda
meaning: O captivating flute-player Govinda, glory to you, beloved of Radha! We hail you as Giridhari, the mountain-lifter, and Krishna, the vanquisher of Mura. Victory to you, Govinda, who dwells in Parthi and is forever united with Radha.
devanagari:
मोहन मुरली गोविंदा जय राधे गोविंदा
हे गिरिधारी गोविंदा जय राधे गोविंदा
कृष्ण मुरारी गोविंदा जय राधे गोविंदा
पर्ती विहारी गोविंदा जय राधे गोविंदा
respell:
Mohan Muralī Govindā Jaya Rādhe Govindā
He Giridhārī Govindā Jaya Rādhe Govindā
Kṛushṇa Murārī Govindā Jaya Rādhe Govindā
Partī Vihārī Govindā Jaya Rādhe Govindā

title: Mohana Raghurama
lyrics:
Mohana Raghurama
Ati Sundara Sri Rama
Maruti Sevita Rama
Sri Rama Rama Jaya Rama (2)
Sri Rama Rama Sai Rama
meaning:
O enchanting Lord Rama of the Raghu dynasty.
Exceptionally Beautiful Sri Rama
Lord Rama, who is served by Maruti (Hanuman).
Victory to Thee, O Rama.
devanagari:
मोहन रघुरामा 
अति सुन्दर श्री रामा 
मारुती सेवित रामा 
श्री राम राम जय रामा (2)
श्री राम राम साई रामा
respell:
Mohan Raghurāmā
Ati Sundara Shrī Rāmā
Mārutī Sevit Rāmā
Shrī Rām Rām Jaya Rāmā (2)
Shrī Rām Rām Sāī Rāmā

title: Mooshika Vahana Gajanana
lyrics:
Mooshika Vahana Gajanana  
Parvathi Nandana Siddhi Vinayaka
Buddhi Pradayaka Jai Gananayaka
Sankata Harana Paapa Vinashaka
Parthi Pureeshwara Shubha Dayaka
Jai Gananayaka Siddhi Vinayaka (3)
Mangala Dayaka Buddhi Pradayaka
meaning: O elephant-faced Lord Ganesha, rider of the mouse and beloved son of Parvati, you are the bestower of success and intelligence. Victorious leader of the Ganas, Lord of Parthi, you remove all troubles, destroy sins, and grant auspiciousness to your devotees.
devanagari:
मूषिक वाहन गजानना
पार्वती नंदन सिद्धि विनायक
बुद्धि प्रदायक जय गणनायक
संकट हरणा पाप विनाशक
पर्ती पूरीश्वर शुभ दायका
मंगल दायक बुद्धि प्रदायका

जय गणनायक सिद्धि विनायक (3)
मंगल दायक बुद्धि प्रदायक
respell:
Mūshik Vāhan Gajānanā
Pārwatī Nandana Siddhi Vināyak
Buddhi Pradāyak Jay Gaṇanāyak
Saṅkaṭ Haraṇā Pāpa Vināshak
Partī Pūrīshwar Shubh Dāyakā
Maṅgal Dāyak Buddhi Pradāyakā

Jay Gaṇanāyak Siddhi Vināyak (3)
Maṅgal Dāyak Buddhi Pradāyak

title: Mother Oh Mother Sai Ma
lyrics:
Mother Oh Mother Sai Ma
You Mean The Whole World To Me Sai Ma
Mother Oh Mother Sai Ma
You Are The Light Of My Life Sai Ma
Ma Sai Ma, Ma Sai Ma
In Times Of Trouble And Despair
I Call Your Name, You Are Always There
How Can We Thank You Oh Dear Sai Ma
For All Your Patience And Love Sai Ma [ Ma Sai Ma ... ]
meaning: Oh Divine Mother Sai, you are the very essence of my being and the radiant light that guides my life. In every moment of trouble and despair, I call upon your sacred name, knowing you are always present with your boundless love and infinite patience. How can I ever adequately express my gratitude for your unwavering grace?
devanagari:
मदर ओ मदर साई माँ
यू मीन द होल वरल्ड टू मी साई माँ
मदर ओ मदर साई माँ
यू आर द लाइट अव माइ लाइफ साई माँ
माँ साई माँ माँ साई माँ
इन टाइम्ज अव ट्रबल अन्ड डिस्पेर
आइ कोल योर नेम यू आर ओल्वेज देर
हाउ कैन वी थैङ्क यू ओ डिर साई माँ
फोर ओल योर पेशन्स अन्ड लव साई माँ

title: Mrutyunjayaya Namah Om
lyrics:
Mrutyunjayaya Namah Om
Trayambakaya Namah Om
Lingeshwaraya Namah Om
Sayeeshwaraya Namah Om
Om Namah Shivaya Namah Om (4)
meaning: Humble salutations to Lord Saishwara who is none other than lord Shiva, the One who has conquered death, the One with three eyes and the formless One who has no beginning nor end.
devanagari:
मृत्युंजयाय नमः ॐ
त्र्यम्बकाय नमः ॐ
लिंगेश्वराय नमः ॐ
साईश्वराय नमः ॐ
ॐ नमः शिवाय नमः ॐ (4)
respell:
Mṛutyuñjayāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Tryambakāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Liṅgeshwarāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Sāīshwarāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy Namaḥ Oṃ (4)

title: Mukunda Madhava Murali Manohara Govardhana Giridhari
lyrics:
Mukunda Madhava Murali Manohara Govardhana Giridhari
Gopi Poojita Manasa Chora Peetambara Dhari
Hari Mukunda Madhava Murali Manohara Govardhana Giridhari
Geeta Bodhaka Sai Sundara
Vandita Hrudaya Vihari (2)
meaning: Oh Mukunda, Madhava, enchanting flutist and lifter of Govardhan, you are the beautiful Sai, adored by the Gopis, stealing their hearts while adorned in yellow. Divine teacher of the Gita, you eternally reside in the worshipped hearts of your devotees.
devanagari:
मुकुंद माधव मुरली मनोहर गोवर्धन गिरिधारी
गोपी पूजित मानस चोरा पीतांबर धारी
हरि मुकुंद माधव मुरली मनोहर गोवर्धन गिरिधारी
गीता बोधक साई सुंदर
वंदित हृदय विहारी
respell:
Mukund Mādhava Muralī Manohar Govardhana Giridhārī
Gopī Pūjita Mānasa Chorā Pītāmbara Dhārī
Hari Mukund Mādhava Muralī Manohar Govardhana Giridhārī
Gītā Bodhaka Sāī Sundara
Vandita Hṛudaya Vihārī

title: Mukunda Murari Murari Gopal
lyrics:
Mukunda Murari Murari Gopal
Hey Gopala Sai Hey Sai Nandalal
Prasanthi Nivasi Nivasi Nandalal
Hey Antaratma Jyoti Hey Jyoti Nandalal
Sathyam Sivam Sivam Sundaram
Hey Sundararoopa He Sai Nandalal
meaning: Oh Mukunda, Murari, Gopal, beloved Nandalal, You are the divine Sai, dwelling in Prashanthi. You are the radiant light of our inner self, the very embodiment of Truth, Auspiciousness, and supreme Beauty.
devanagari:
मुकुंदा मुरारी मुरारी गोपाल
हे गोपाल साई हे साई नंदलाल
प्रशांति निवासी निवासी नंदलाल
हे अंतरात्मा ज्योति हे ज्योति नंदलाल
सत्यम् शिवम् शिवम् सुंदरम्
हे सुंदररूपा हे साई नंदलाल
respell:
Mukundā Murārī Murārī Gopāl
He Gopāla Sāī He Sāī Nandalāl
Prashānti Nivāsī Nivāsī Nandalāl
He Antarātmā Jyoti He Jyoti Nandalāl
Satyam Shivam Shivam Sundaram
He Sundararūpā He Sāī Nandalāl

title: Murali Gaana Lola Nanda Gopa
lyrics:
Murali Gaana Lola Nanda Gopa Bala Raavo Raavo Radha Lola Radha Lola
Treta Yugamuna Sitaa Ramudai
Dwapara Yugamuna Radha Loludai
Geetanu Drapina Taraka Naamudai
Yuga Yuga Manduna Taguroopa Dhaariyai
meaning: Come, O Krishna, Nanda's son, who delights in flute music and is Radha's beloved. You manifested as Rama in the Treta Yuga and as Radha's enchanting companion in Dwapara, revealing the Bhagavad Gita. Across all ages, you assume a captivating form.
devanagari:
मुरली गाना लोला  नन्द गोप बाला रावो रावो राधा लोला  राधा लोला 
त्रेता युगमुन सीता रामुडै
द्वापर युगमुन राधा लोलुडै
गीतनु द्रापिना तारक नामुडै
युग युग मंदुना तगुरुप धारियै
respell:
Muralī Gānā Lolā  Nanda Gop Bālā Rāvo Rāvo Rādhā Lolā  Rādhā Lolā
Tretā Yugamuna Sītā Rāmuḍai
Dwāpara Yugamuna Rādhā Loluḍai
Gītanu Drāpinā Tārak Nāmuḍai
Yug Yug Mandunā Tagurup Dhāriyai

title: Murali Krishna Mukunda Krishna Mohana Krishna Krishna Krishna
lyrics:
Murali Krishna Mukunda Krishna Mohana Krishna Krishna Krishna
Gopi Krishna Gopala Krishna Govardhanadhara Krishna Krishna
Radha Krishna Bala Krishna Rasa Vilola Krishna Krishna
Shirdi Krishna Parthi Krishna Sri Sathya Sai Krishna Krishna
meaning: Oh Krishna, You are the enchanting flutist, the giver of liberation, and the beloved of the Gopis, who lifted Govardhan mountain. We lovingly invoke You as the playful child with Radha, delighting in the Rasa dance, and as the divine presence manifested in Shirdi and Parthi, Sri Sathya Sai.
devanagari:
मुरली कृष्णा मुकुंद कृष्णा मोहन कृष्णा कृष्णा कृष्णा
गोपी कृष्णा गोपाल कृष्णा गोवर्धनधर कृष्णा कृष्णा  
राधा कृष्णा बाल कृष्णा रास विलोला कृष्णा कृष्णा  
शिर्डी कृष्णा पर्ति कृष्णा श्री सत्य साईं कृष्णा कृष्णा
respell:
Muralī Kṛushṇā Mukund Kṛushṇā Mohan Kṛushṇā Kṛushṇā Kṛushṇā
Gopī Kṛushṇā Gopāla Kṛushṇā Govardhanadhara Kṛushṇā Kṛushṇā
Rādhā Kṛushṇā Bāla Kṛushṇā Rās Vilolā Kṛushṇā Kṛushṇā
Shirḍī Kṛushṇā Parti Kṛushṇā Shrī Satya Sāīṃ Kṛushṇā Kṛushṇā

title: Murali Manohara Shyama Murari
lyrics:
Murali Manohara Shyama Murari
Gopala Sai Gopala
Radha Lola Hare Giridhari
Gopala Sai Gopala
meaning: Oh enchanting flute-player, dark-hued Krishna, beloved Gopala, we lovingly invoke you. You are Radha's playful companion, the remover of sorrows, and the divine lifter of mountains.
devanagari:
मुरली मनोहर श्याम मुरारी
गोपाला साई गोपाला
राधा लोल हरे गिरिधारी 
गोपाला साई गोपाला
respell:
Muralī Manohar Shyām Murārī
Gopālā Sāī Gopālā
Rādhā Lol Hare Giridhārī
Gopālā Sāī Gopālā

title: Murali Vinodana Munijana Mohana
lyrics:
Murali Vinodana Munijana Mohana
Natana Manohara Gopala
Nitya Niranjana Hrudaya Sanjeevana
Deena Janavana Gopala
Natana Manohara Gopala
meaning: Oh Krishna, You play the flute, You are charmer of the minds of sages, enchanting dancer, ever new and able to resurrect the heart and who is compassionate towards the afflicted.
devanagari:
मुरली विनोदन मुनिजन मोहन
नटन मनोहर गोपाला
नित्य निरंजन हृदय संजीवन
दीन जनावन गोपाला
नटन मनोहर गोपाला
respell:
Muralī Vinodana Munijana Mohan
Naṭana Manohar Gopālā
Nitya Nirañjana Hṛudaya Sañjīvan
Dīna Janāvan Gopālā
Naṭana Manohar Gopālā

title: Muralidhara He Ghana Shyama
lyrics:
Muralidhara He Ghana Shyama
Partheeshwara Sai Shyama
Giridhari Parthi Vihari
Meera Ke He Giridhari
Surdas Ke Krishna Murari
Ghana Shyama Megha Shyama Sai Shyama
Giridhari Parthi Vihari
meaning: Salutations to You Lord Sai, resident of Parthi. You are none other than Lord Krishna, the Lord of Meera and Soordas. You held the Govardhan Mountain to save the cowherds. Your complexion is that of dark clouds.
devanagari:
मुरलीधर हे घन श्यामा
पर्तीश्वर साई श्यामा
गिरिधारी पर्ती विहारी
मीरा के हे गिरिधारी
सूरदास के कृष्ण मुरारी
घन श्यामा मेघ श्यामा साई श्यामा
गिरिधारी पर्ती विहारी
respell:
Muralīdhara He Ghan Shyāmā
Partīshwar Sāī Shyāmā
Giridhārī Partī Vihārī
Mīrā Ke He Giridhārī
Sūradās Ke Kṛushṇa Murārī
Ghan Shyāmā Megha Shyāmā Sāī Shyāmā
Giridhārī Partī Vihārī

title: Muralidhara Murahara Natawara
lyrics:
Muralidhara Murahara Natawara
Gopi Jana Priya Giridhara
Brindavana Sanchara Jagatoddhara
Yashoda Bala Nanda Kumara
meaning: Oh Flute-bearer, vanquisher of Mura, supreme dancer, beloved of the Gopis and lifter of mountains! You walk through Vrindavan, uplifting the entire universe. You are the dear child of Yashoda and son of Nanda.
devanagari:
मुरलीधरा मुरहारा नटवरा
गोपी जन प्रिय गिरिधरा
ब्रिंदावन संचार जगतोद्धारा
यशोदा बाला नंद कुमारा
respell:
Muralīdharā Murahārā Naṭavarā
Gopī Jana Priy Giridharā
Brindāvan Sañchāra Jagatoddhārā
Yashodā Bālā Nanda Kumārā

title: My heart is beating, Sai Ram, Sai Ram
lyrics:
My heart is beating, Sai Ram, Sai Ram,
Keeps on repeating, Sai Ram, Sai Ram,
Sai Ram, Sai Ram, Sai Ram, Sai Ram, Sai Ram, Sai Ram, Sai (2x)
With every breath of mine, soham Sai Ram
Thought, speech, and action, sarvam Sai Ram
My soul eternal atma Sai Ram (2x)
My bliss eternal ananda Sai Ram
Sai Ram, Sai Ram, Sai Ram, Sai Ram, Sai Ram, Sai Ram, Sai (2x)
devanagari:
माइ हार्ट इज बीटिङ साई राम साई राम
कीप्स आन रिपीटिङ साई राम साई राम
साई राम साई राम साई राम साई राम साई राम साई राम साई एक्स

माइ सोल इटरनल आत्मा साई राम एक्स
माइ ब्लिस इटरनल आनंद साई राम
साई राम साई राम साई राम साई राम साई राम साई राम साई एक्स

title: Mythilipathe Raghu Nandana
lyrics:
Mythilipathe Raghu Nandana
Rama Raghava Rajeeva Lochana [Mythilipathe..]
Deenavana He Karunamaya
Kamala Nayana Kausalya Tanaya
meaning: O consort of Sita, the princess of Mithila, the descendant of the Raghu dynasty! O Rama! The Lotus-eyed Lord! The protector of the poor! O Lord filled with Compassion! The Lotus -eyed Lord who is the son of Queen Kausalya!
devanagari:
मैथिली पते रघु नंदना
रामा राघवा राजीव लोचना [ मैथिली पते ... ]
दीनवाना हे करुणामया
कमला नयना कौसल्या तनया
respell:
Maithilī Pate Raghu Nandanā
Rāmā Rāghavā Rājīva Lochanā [ Maithilī Pate ... ]
Dīnavānā He Karuṇāmayā
Kamalā Nayanā Kausalyā Tanayā

title: Naada Brahmamayi Sayeeshwari
lyrics:
Naada Brahmamayi Sayeeshwari
Bhagawathi Mata Krupa Sagari [ Naada ... ]
Varahi Vaishnavi Vageshwari
Matangi Mahamaye Mookambikey
Parameshwari Hari Sodari
Bhava Bhaya Haarini Sathya Sayeeshwari
meaning: Invoking the Divine Mother as the protective Vārāhi, the sustaining Vaiṣṇavi, and the goddesses of speech, wisdom, and arts, Vāgeśvari and Mātaṅgi. She is also the supreme cosmic energy (Mahāmāya, Parameśvari), the unified power of Mūkāmbika, and the divine sister of Lord Viṣṇu. Calling upon these names of Mother Sai destroys all the worldly fears and invokes Her grace.

title: Nam Bhajo Hari Nam Bhajo
lyrics:
Nam Bhajo Hari Nam Bhajo
Narayana Sai Narayana
Nanda Ananda Mukunda Hare
Brindavana Sai Baba Hare
--
Baba Hare Sai Baba Hare
Brindavana Sai Baba Hare
meaning: Chant the name of Lord Hari who incarnated as Lord Krishna, the adorable son of Nanda in Brindavan. Lord Sai Baba is none other than Lord Hari.
devanagari:
नाम भजो हरि नाम भजो
नारायणा साई नारायणा [ नाम भजो ... ]
नंदा आनंदा मुकुंदा हरे (2)
ब्रिंदावना साई बाबा हरे
---
बाबा हरे साई बाबा हरे (3)
respell:
Nām Bhajo Hari Nām Bhajo
Nārāyaṇā Sāī Nārāyaṇā [ Nām Bhajo ... ]
Nandā Ānandā Mukundā Hare (2)
Brindāvanā Sāī Bābā Hare
---
Bābā Hare Sāī Bābā Hare (3)

title: Nacho Hey Nataraj Shiva Shambho
lyrics:
Nacho Hey Nataraj Shiva Shambho
Hara Bhole Nath Shiva Shambho
Shiva Shambho Shiva Shambho
Dama Dama Dama Dama Damaru Baje
Hara Bhole Nath Shiva Shambho
Hara Sai Nath Shiva Shambho
meaning: Sing the glory of Lord Shiva who performs the Celestial dance while the miniature drum "Damaru" beats. Chant the divine names of Shiva and Sainatha, who redeems from all troubles (Hara) and the one who is easily pleased.
devanagari:
नाचो हे नटराज शिव शम्भो
हर भोलें नाथ शिव शम्भो
शिव शम्भो शिव शम्भो
डम डम डम डम डमरू बजे
हर भोलें नाथ (साई नाथ) शिव शम्भो
respell:
Nācho He Naṭarāj Shiv Shambho
Har Bholeṃ Nāth Shiv Shambho
Shiv Shambho Shiv Shambho
Ḍama Ḍama Ḍama Ḍama Ḍamarū Baje
Har Bholeṃ Nāth (sāī Nāth) Shiv Shambho

title: Nada Brahma Sayeeshwara
lyrics:
Nada Brahma Sayeeshwara
Hara Hara Hara Shiva Shankara
Gauri Ramana Sadashiva
Hara Hara Gange Mahadeva
meaning: Glory to Lord Sai, the Lord of divine Music, the very embodiment of Lord Shiva, the one reveling in the cosmic dance, the Lord of Goddess Parvati, the Eternal Lord holding the Holy river Ganga in His hair locks! Glory to the great Lord Sai Shiva.
devanagari:
नाद ब्रह्म साईश्वरा
हर हर हर शिव शंकरा
गौरी रमणा सदाशिवा
हर हर गंगे महादेवा
respell:
Nāda Brahma Sāīshwarā
Har Har Har Shiv Shaṅkarā
Gaurī Ramaṇā Sadāshivā
Har Har Gaṅge Mahādevā

title: Namah Parvati Pataye Hara Hara
lyrics:
Namah Parvati Pataye Hara Hara
Hara Hara Shankara Mahadeva
Hara Hara Hara Hara Mahadeva
Shiva Shiva Shiva Shiva Sadashiva
Mahadeva Sadashiva
Sadashiva Mahadeva
----
Hara Hara Hara Hara Mahadeva (3)
Shiva Shiva Shiva Shiva Sadashiva
Mahadeva Sadashiva
Sadashiva Mahadeva
meaning: Our salutations to the Lord of Mother Parvati, Supreme God who is ever auspicious, eternal and destroys all the negativities.
devanagari:
नमः पार्वती पतये हर हर  
हर हर शंकर महादेवा  
हर हर हर हर महादेवा

महादेवा सदाशिवा
सदाशिवा महादेवा

महादेवा सदाशिवा [ सदाशिवा महादेवा ]

title: Namah Shivaya Namah Shivaya
lyrics:
Namah Shivaya Namah Shivaya
Samba Sadashiva Namah Shivaya
Girija Shankara Namah Shivaya
Bhavani Shankara Namah Shivaya
Lingodbhavakara Sai Manohara
Namah Shivaya Namah Shivaya
meaning: Our salutations to the Lord of Mother Parvati, Supreme God who is ever auspicious, eternal and destroys all the negativities.
devanagari:
नमः शिवाया नमः शिवाया
सांब सदाशिव नमः शिवाया
गिरिजा शंकर नमः शिवाया
भवानी शंकर नमः शिवाया
लिंगोद्ध्भवकर साई मनोहर
नमः शिवाया नमः शिवाया (2)
respell:

Sāmb Sadāshiv Namaḥ Shivāyā

Bhavānī Shaṅkar Namaḥ Shivāyā
Liṅgoddhbhavakar Sāī Manohar
Namaḥ Shivāyā Namaḥ Shivāyā (2)

title: Namami Brahma Namami Vishnu Namami Maheshwara
lyrics:
Namami Brahma Namami Vishnu Namami Maheshwara
Smarami Brahma Smarami Vishnu (2)
Smarami Saishwara (2)
meaning: I salute Brahma, the God of creation, I prostrate to Vishnu, the God of sustenance and I worship Lord Shiva, the Lord of destruction. I meditate on Brahma, I contemplate on Vishnu and I dwell upon Lord Sai.
devanagari:
नमामि ब्रह्म नमामि विष्णु नमामि महेश्वरा
स्मरामि ब्रह्म स्मरामि विष्णु (2)
स्मरामि साईश्वरा (2)
respell:
Namāmi Brahma Namāmi Vishṇu Namāmi Maheshwarā
Smarāmi Brahma Smarāmi Vishṇu (2)
Smarāmi Sāīshwarā (2)

title: Namami Nityam Gananatham
lyrics:
Namami Nityam Gananatham
Smarami Nityam Gajavadanam
meaning: To the Lord of the Divine Forces, Always I bow in reverence. I am always singing Your glory, God Ganesha.
devanagari:
नमामि नित्यम् गणनाथम्
स्मरामि नित्यम् गजवदनम्
respell:
Namāmi Nityam Gaṇanātham
Smarāmi Nityam Gajavadanam

title: Namami Sai Padapankajam
lyrics:
Namami Sai Padapankajam
Smarami Sai Namamrutam
Bhajami Sai Charanambujam
Karomi Sai Sankeertanam
meaning: I bow down to the Lotus feet of Lord Sai. I meditate  upon His nectarous name. I worship His divine Lotus feet. I sing of His infinite glory.
devanagari:
नमामि साई पदपंकजम्
स्मरामि साई नामामृतम्
भजामि साई चरणामभुजम
करोमि साई संकीर्तनम्
respell:
Namāmi Sāī Padapaṅkajam
Smarāmi Sāī Nāmāmṛutam
Bhajāmi Sāī Charaṇāmabhujam
Karomi Sāī Saṅkīrtanam

title: Namami Shankara Shambho Maheshwara
lyrics:
Namami Shankara Shambho Maheshwara
Namami Sadguru Mahadeva [ Namami Shankara ... ]
Namami Brahma Namami Vishnu
Namami Sadguru Sai Deva
meaning: I bow to Shankara, Shambho, the Great Lord, and to the Divine Guru, Mahadeva. My salutations extend to Brahma and Vishnu, and to the True Teacher, Lord Sai.
devanagari:
नमामि शंकरा शंभो महेश्वरा
नमामि सद्गुरु महादेवा 
नमामि ब्रह्मा नमामि विष्णु
नमामि सद्‌गुरु साई देवा
respell:

Namāmi Sadguru Mahādevā
Namāmi Brahmā Namāmi Vishṇu
Namāmi Sad‌guru Sāī Devā

title: Namo Bhagawate Vasudevaya
lyrics:
Namo Bhagawate Vasudevaya
Namo Bhagawate Rama Roopaya
Namo Bhagawate Shyama Roopaya
Namo Bhagawate Vasudevaya
Ram Rahim Krishna Karim Yeshu Buddha Mahavir (Sai)
Sarva Dharma Priya Sai Devaya
meaning: I bow down to Lord who is the son of Vasudeva, I worship the Lord in the form of Rama, I prostrate the Lord in the form of Krishna. he is Rama, Krishna; Rahim and Karim (merciful and compassionate), Jesus Christ, Buddha and Mahaveer. I bow down to Lord Sai who is fond of all faiths.
devanagari:
नमो भगवते वासुदेवाया
नमो भगवते राम रूपाया
नमो भगवते श्याम रूपाया
[ नमो भगवते ... ]
राम रहीम कृष्ण करीम येसु बुद्ध महावीर
सर्व धर्म प्रिय साई देवाया
सर्व धर्म प्रिय साई रूपाया
respell:
Namo Bhagavate Vāsudevāyā
Namo Bhagavate Rām Rūpāyā
Namo Bhagavate Shyām Rūpāyā
[ Namo Bhagavate ... ]
Rām Rahīm Kṛushṇa Karīm Yesu Buddha Mahāvīr
Sarwa Dharma Priy Sāī Devāyā
Sarwa Dharma Priy Sāī Rūpāyā

title: Namo Namo Hari Narayana
lyrics:
Namo Namo Hari Narayana (3)
Narahari Roopa Narayana
Naada Swaroopa Narayana
Parthi Pureesha Narayana
Paapa Vimochana Narayana
Narayana Hari (Sai) Narayana
meaning: We bow again and again to you, Hari Narayana, who takes the form of the man-lion Narahari and whose essence is divine sound. O Lord of Puttaparthi, you are the compassionate one who liberates us from all our sins.
devanagari:
नमो नमो हरि नारायणा (3)  
नरहरी रूप नारायणा  
नाद स्वरूपा नारायणा  
पर्ति पुरीशा नारायणा  
पाप विमोचन नारायणा  
नारायणा हरि (साई) नारायणा
respell:
Namo Namo Hari Nārāyaṇā (3)
Naraharī Rūp Nārāyaṇā
Nāda Swarūpā Nārāyaṇā
Parti Purīshā Nārāyaṇā
Pāpa Vimochana Nārāyaṇā
Nārāyaṇā Hari (sāī) Nārāyaṇā

title: Namo Namo Nataraja Namo Hara Jata Jootadhara Shambho
lyrics:
Namo Namo Nataraja Namo Hara Jata Jootadhara Shambho
Namo Namo Nataraja
Pavana Gangadhari 
Danava Mada Samhari
Parthipuri Vihari
Parama Daya Ghana Shourie
Namo Namo Nataraja
meaning: We offer salutations to Nataraja, the divine dancer, who is the benevolent Hara, adorned with matted locks and bearing the sacred Ganga. He vanquishes demonic arrogance, resides in Puttaparthi, and is the ultimate embodiment of compassion and strength.
devanagari:
नमो नमो नटराज नमो हर जटा जूटधर शम्भो
नमो नमो नटराजा
पावन गंगाधारी
दानव मद सम्हारी
पर्तीपुरी विहारी
परम दयाघन शौरी
नमो नमो नटराजा
respell:
Namo Namo Naṭarāj Namo Har Jaṭā Jūṭadhara Shambho
Namo Namo Naṭarājā
Pāvan Gaṅgādhārī
Dānava Mada Samhārī
Partīpurī Vihārī
Param Dayāghan Shaurī
Namo Namo Naṭarājā

title: Namo Namo Sri Devi Namo
lyrics:
Namo Namo Sri Devi Namo
Srita Jana Palini Sai Namo
Chinmaya Roopini Devi Namo
Sri Partheeshwari Sai Namo
meaning: Oh Divine Mother, we offer our humble salutations to You, the protector of all who seek Your shelter. You are the embodiment of pure consciousness, the revered Goddess of Parthi, Sai.
devanagari:
नमो नमो श्री देवी नमो
श्रित जन पालिनी साई नमो
चिन्मय रूपिणी देवी नमो
श्री पर्तीश्वरी साई नमो
respell:
Namo Namo Shrī Devī Namo
Shrit Jana Pālinī Sāī Namo
Chinmaya Rūpiṇī Devī Namo
Shrī Partīshwarī Sāī Namo

title: Namo Sharada Namo Sharada Namo Sharada Mata
lyrics:
Namo Sharada Namo Sharada Namo Sharada Mata
Hey Vidya Jnana Pradayini
Ma Veena Pustaka Dharini
Bhava Bhanjani Manoranjani
Sathya Sayeeshwari Mata
Sathya Sayeeshwari Sathya Sayeeshwari Sathya Sayeeshwari Mata
Sathya Sayeeshwari Mata
meaning: We offer salutations to Mother Sharada, the divine giver of wisdom and knowledge, who gracefully holds the Veena and sacred book. She dispels the illusions of worldly existence, captivating the mind, and is revered as Mother Sathya Sai.
devanagari:
नमो शारदा नमो शारदा नमो शारदा माता
हे विद्या ज्ञान प्रदायिनी
मा वीणा पुस्तक धारिणी
भव भंजनी मनोरंजनी
सत्य साईश्वरी माता
सत्य साईश्वरी सत्य साईश्वरी सत्य साईश्वरी माता
सत्य साईश्वरी माता
respell:
