He Vidyā Jñāna Pradāyinī
Mā Vīṇā Pustaka Dhāriṇī
Bhava Bhañjanī Manorañjanī
Satya Sāīshwarī Mātā
Satya Sāīshwarī Satya Sāīshwarī Satya Sāīshwarī Mātā
Satya Sāīshwarī Mātā

title: Nanda Ke Dulare Yashoda Ke Pyare
lyrics:
Nanda Ke Dulare Yashoda Ke Pyare
Govinda Murare Deenon Ke Sahare
Karuna Sagara Giridhara Nagara
Murali Manohara Shyama Murare
Murali Manohara Sai Murare
meaning:
O Beloved Son of Nanda, O Dear Child of Mother Yashoda,
O Govinda, O Slayer of the demon Mura, You are the refuge and support of the humble and needy.
O Ocean of Compassion, O Lifter of the Govardhana Mountain, O Lord of the people,
O Enchanter with the flute, Dark-hued Lord Krishna, O Murari,
O Flute-playing Enchanter, O Sai who is Murari Himself.
devanagari:
नंद के दुलारे यशोदा के प्यारे
गोविंद मुरारे दीनों के सहारे
करुणा सागर गिरिधर नागर
मुरली मनोहर श्याम मुरारे
मुरली मनोहर साई मुरारे
respell:
Nanda Ke Dulāre Yashodā Ke Pyāre
Govind Murāre Dīnoṃ Ke Sahāre
Karuṇā Sāgar Giridhara Nāgar
Muralī Manohar Shyām Murāre
Muralī Manohar Sāī Murāre

title: Nanda Ke Lal Murali Gopal
lyrics:
Nanda Ke Lal Murali Gopal
Giridhari Govinda Radhe Gopal
Nanda Mukunda Radhey Gopal
Radhey Jaya Radhey Jaya Radhe Gopal
--
Radhey Radhey Radhey Gopal
Radhey Radhey Murali Gopal
Radhey Radhey Shyama Gopal
Radhey Radhey Sai Gopal
meaning: Oh Krishna, beloved son of Nanda, you are the enchanting flute-player, the protector who lifted Govardhan, and Radha's divine companion. We hail you, the dark-hued cowherd, who also manifests as Sai, our cherished Lord.
devanagari:
नंदा के लाल मुरली गोपाल
गिरिधारी गोविन्द राधे गोपाल
नंदा मुकुंद राधे गोपाल
राधे जय राधे जय राधे गोपाल
राधे राधे राधे गोपाल
राधे राधे मुरली गोपाल
राधे राधे श्याम गोपाल
राधे राधे साईं गोपाल
respell:
Nandā Ke Lāl Muralī Gopāl
Giridhārī Govinda Rādhe Gopāl
Nandā Mukund Rādhe Gopāl
Rādhe Jay Rādhe Jay Rādhe Gopāl
Rādhe Rādhe Rādhe Gopāl
Rādhe Rādhe Muralī Gopāl
Rādhe Rādhe Shyām Gopāl
Rādhe Rādhe Sāīṃ Gopāl

title: Nanda Kishora Jaya Gopal
lyrics:
Nanda Kishora Jaya Gopal
Navaneeta Chora Shyama Gopal
Meera Ke Nath Prabhu Giridhara Gopal
Rasa Vilola Radhe Gopal
meaning:
Victory to Lord Gopal, the Divine cowherd and beloved child of King Nanda
Victory to Him who is dark in complexion and who stole the fresh butter of Vrindavan
Victory to the one who holds the mountain and adored by Meera
Victory to Radha's eternal companion who enthralled people with His Divine dance Rasaleela
devanagari:
नन्द किशोरा जय गोपाल
नवनीत चोरा श्याम गोपाल
मीरा के नाथ प्रभु गिरिधर गोपाल
रास विलोला राधे गोपाल
respell:
Nanda Kishorā Jaya Gopāl
Navanīta Chorā Shyām Gopāl
Mīrā Ke Nāth Prabhu Giridhara Gopāl
Rās Vilolā Rādhe Gopāl

title: Nanda Kishora Narayana
lyrics:
Nanda Kishora Narayana
Navaneetha Chora Narayana
Narahari Roopa Narayana
Nada Swaroopa Narayana
meaning: O Narayana, You are the playful child Krishna, the loving butter thief, the mighty Narasimha who protects devotees, and the divine cosmic sound present throughout creation. We worship You in all Your forms and seek Your love, protection, and spiritual guidance."
devanagari:
नंद किशोरा नारायणा
नवनीत चोरा नारायणा [ नंद किशोरा ... ]
नरहरी रूपा नारायणा
नाद स्वरूपा नारायणा
respell:
Nanda Kishorā Nārāyaṇā
Navanīta Chorā Nārāyaṇā [ Nanda Kishorā ... ]
Naraharī Rūpā Nārāyaṇā
Nāda Swarūpā Nārāyaṇā

title: Nanda Kishora Navaneeta Chora
lyrics:
Nanda Kishora Navaneetha Chora
Brindavana Sanchara
Hey Shesha Shayana Hey Garuda Gamana
Aravinda Nayana Gopalana
meaning: Oh, youthful son of Nanda, butter-thief of hearts, who gracefully roams the sacred groves of Brindavan. You are the divine one resting on the cosmic serpent Shesha, riding the mighty Garuda, with eyes like blooming lotuses, our beloved cowherd Gopala.
devanagari:
नंद किशोरा नवनीता चोरा
ब्रिंदावना संचारा
हे शेष शयना हे गरुड़ गमना
अरविंद नयना गोपालना
respell:
Nanda Kishorā Navanītā Chorā
Brindāvanā Sañchārā
He Shesh Shayanā He Garuḍa़ Gamanā
Aravind Nayanā Gopālanā

title: Nanda Kishora Navaneetha Chora Sai Gopala
lyrics:
Nanda Kishora Navaneetha Chora Sai Gopala
Govardhana Giridhari Murari Hey Nandalala
Nandalala Nandalala
Goparipala Gokula Bala Giridhara Gopala
Murali Lola Munijana Pala Hey Nandalala [ Nandalala ... ]
meaning: O playful child of Nanda, the butter thief and divine protector, Sai Gopala, you are the lifter of Govardhana Hill and the beloved of the cowherds. O Nandalala, you enchant with your flute and safeguard the sages, bringing joy to Gokula.
devanagari:
नंद किशोरा नवनीत चोरा साई गोपाला
गोवर्धन गिरिधारी मुरारी हे नंदलाला
नंदलाला नंदलाला
गोपरिपाला गोकुल बाला गिरिधरा गोपाला
मुरली लोला मुनिजना पाला हे नंदलाला [ नंदलाला ... ]
respell:
Nanda Kishorā Navanīta Chorā Sāī Gopālā
Govardhana Giridhārī Murārī He Nandalālā
Nandalālā Nandalālā
Goparipālā Gokul Bālā Giridharā Gopālā
Muralī Lolā Munijanā Pālā He Nandalālā [ Nandalālā ... ]

title: Nanda Mukunda Hari Gopala
lyrics:
Nanda Mukunda Hari Gopala
Gopi Jana Priya Goparipala
Bhakta Samrakshaka Sai Gopala
Nanda Nanda Mukunda Gopala
meaning:
Oh Krishna! You are the cowherd boy, the one who grants liberation.
You are the favorite of the cowherds and the protector of cows (all noble souls).
Oh Sai Krishna you are the one who protects His devotees.
You are the one who gives happiness to Nanda too.
devanagari:
नंद मुकुंद हरि गोपाला
गोपी जन प्रिय गोपरिपाला [ नंद मुकुंद ... ]
भक्त सम्रक्षक साई गोपाला
नंदा नंद मुकुंद गोपाला
respell:
Nanda Mukund Hari Gopālā
Gopī Jana Priy Goparipālā [ Nanda Mukund ... ]
Bhakta Samrakshak Sāī Gopālā
Nandā Nanda Mukund Gopālā

title: Nanda Nanda Mukunda Gopala
lyrics:
Nanda Nanda Mukunda Gopala
Murali Mohana Shyama Gopala
Shyama Gopal Ghana Shyama Gopala
Murali Mohana Shyama Gopala
--
meaning:
Oh Son of Nanda! You are the cowherd boy Krishna who grants us liberation. You are the one who enchants us by playing the flute.
Oh blue colored Lord resembling the dark color of clouds, Victory be to you, the child of Nanda.
Victory be to you oh Lord of Radha, the cowherd girl.
devanagari:
नंदा नंद मुकुंद गोपाला
मुरली मोहन श्याम गोपाला
श्याम गोपाल घन श्याम गोपाला [ मुरली मोहन ... ]
जय जय जय जय जय नंदलाला
जय नंदलाला श्याम गोपाला [ मुरली मोहन ... ]
respell:
Nandā Nanda Mukund Gopālā
Muralī Mohan Shyām Gopālā
Shyām Gopāl Ghan Shyām Gopālā [ Muralī Mohan ... ]
Jay Jay Jay Jay Jay Nandalālā
Jaya Nandalālā Shyām Gopālā [ Muralī Mohan ... ]

title: Nanda Nandana Hari Govinda Gopala
lyrics:
Nanda Nandana Hari Govinda Gopala
Ghana Shyama Mana Mohana (2)
Gopi Lola Gopala
Gokula Bala Gopala
He Nandalala Gopala
meaning:
The son of Nanda, Oh Vishnu! You are the protector of cows. 
You are the blue colored Lord resembling the clouds and the One who enchants the mind.
You are the favorite of the devout cowherd girls.
The cowherd boy who is the beloved child of the cowherd abode Gokula and the loving child of Nanda.
devanagari:
नंदा नंदन हरि गोविन्द गोपाल
घन श्याम मन मोहना (2)
गोपी लोला गोपाला
गोकुल बाला गोपाला
हे नंदलाला गोपाल [ घन श्याम ]
respell:
Nandā Nandana Hari Govinda Gopāla
Ghan Shyām Mana Mohanā (2)
Gopī Lolā Gopālā
Gokul Bālā Gopālā
He Nandalālā Gopāla [ Ghan Shyām ]

title: Nanda Nandana Navaneeta Chora
lyrics:
Nanda Nandana Navaneeta Chora
Gokula Bala Venu Gopala
Mathura Natha Hare Krishna Gopala
Shyama Gopala Sai Gopala
Vanamali Giridhari Shyama Gopala
Gokula Bala Venu Gopala
meaning: Oh Krishna, beloved son of Nanda and mischievous butter thief, you are the enchanting flute-player and protector of cows from Gokula. Lord of Mathura, adorned with a forest garland, you are the dark-hued one who lifted the Govardhan mountain, our divine cowherd, revered as Sai Gopala.
devanagari:
नन्द नन्दना नवनीत चोरा
गोकुल बाला वेणु गोपाला
मथुरा नाथ हरे कृष्ण गोपाला
श्याम गोपाला साई गोपाला
वनमाली गिरधारी श्याम गोपाला
गोकुल बाला वेणु गोपाला
respell:
Nanda Nandanā Navanīta Chorā
Gokul Bālā Veṇu Gopālā
Mathurā Nātha Hare Kṛushṇa Gopālā
Shyām Gopālā Sāī Gopālā
Vanamālī Giradhārī Shyām Gopālā
Gokul Bālā Veṇu Gopālā

title: Nandalal Nandalal Nandalal Yadu Nandalal
lyrics:
Nandalal Nandalal Nandalal Yadu Nandalal
Nandalala Navaneetha Chora
Radha Pyaarey Nandalal
Maayi Meera Manasa Chora
Parthi Vihari Nandalal
meaning: Oh Nandalal, beloved son of Nanda from the Yadu clan, you are the charming butter thief. You are Radha's dearest love, who captivated the heart of Saint Meera, and now dwell in Puttaparthi.
devanagari:
नन्दलाल नन्दलाल नन्दलाल यदु नन्दलाल
नन्दलाला नवनीत चोरा
राधा प्यारे नन्दलाल
माई मीरा मानस चोरा
पर्ती विहारी नन्दलाल
respell:
Nandalāl Nandalāl Nandalāl Yadu Nandalāl
Nandalālā Navanīta Chorā
Rādhā Pyāre Nandalāl
Māī Mīrā Mānasa Chorā
Partī Vihārī Nandalāl

title: Nandalala Nandalala Daya Karo Bhagawan
lyrics:
Nandalala Nandalala Daya Karo Bhagawan
Bhava Sagar Se Par Utaro
Daya Karo Bhagawan
Krupa Karo Bhagawan
Tumhari Sharan Bin Anath Hain Hum
Daya Karo Bhagawan
(Sai) Krupa Karo Bhagawan
meaning: Oh child of Nanda! Oh Lord! Have compassion on me. Help me cross this Ocean of life. Have compassion on me. Have pity on me. Without (the shelter of) your feet, we are orphans Oh Lord! Have compassion towards me. Have pity on me Oh Lord Sai!
devanagari:
नंदलाला नंदलाला दया करो भगवान
भव सागर से पार उतारो
दया ( साई कृपा ) करो भगवान
तुम्हरी शरण बिन अनाथ है हम
दया ( साई कृपा ) करो भगवान
respell:
Nandalālā Nandalālā Dayā Karo Bhagavān
Bhava Sāgar Se Pār Utāro
Dayā ( Sāī Kṛupā ) Karo Bhagavān
Tumharī Sharaṇ Bin Anāth Hai Ham
Dayā ( Sāī Kṛupā ) Karo Bhagavān

title: Nandalala Nandalala
lyrics:
Nandalala Nandalala
Nacho Nacho Nacho Nandalala
Navaneeta Chora He Bala Gopala
Gopi Manohara Gopala Bala
meaning: Oh child of Nanda! Rejoice in dance, dance and dance! You are the Lord of the cowherds who stole butter! You are the beautiful child Krishna! The one who enchanted the cowherd girls! The cowherd child!
devanagari:
नंदलाला नंदलाला
नाचो नाचो नाचो नंदलाला
नवनीत चोरा हे बाल गोपाला
गोपी मनोहरा गोपाला बाला
respell:
Nandalālā Nandalālā
Nācho Nācho Nācho Nandalālā
Navanīta Chorā He Bāla Gopālā
Gopī Manoharā Gopālā Bālā

title: Nandalala Navaneeta Chora Natavara Lala Gopala
lyrics:
Nandalala Navaneeta Chora Natavara Lala Gopala
Devaki Vasudeva Kumara Deva Deva Gopala [Nandalala Navaneeta ...]
Mohana Murali Gana Vilola Mohana Sai Gopala
meaning: Oh beloved Gopala, son of Nanda, you are the playful butter thief and the supreme dancer. Born to Devaki and Vasudeva, you are the Lord of Lords, enchanting all with your melodious flute.
devanagari:
नन्दलाला नवनीत चोरा नटवर लाला गोपाला
देवकी वासुदेव कुमारा देव देव गोपाला [नन्दलाला नवनीत ...]
मोहन मुरली गान विलोला मोहना साई गोपाला
respell:
Nandalālā Navanīta Chorā Naṭavar Lālā Gopālā
Devakī Vāsudeva Kumārā Deva Deva Gopālā [nandalālā Navanīta ...]
Mohan Muralī Gān Vilolā Mohanā Sāī Gopālā

title: Nandalala Yadu Nandalala
lyrics:
Nandalala Yadu Nandalala
Brindavana Govinda Lala
Radha Lola Nandalala
Radha Madhava Nandalala
meaning: Oh Nandalala, beloved child of Nanda from the Yadu lineage, you are the divine cowherd of Vrindavan. You are the delight of Radha, her cherished Madhava.
devanagari:
नंदलाला यदु नंदलाला
ब्रिंदावन गोविंदा लाला
राधा लोला नंदलाला
राधा माधव नंदलाला (जय)
respell:
Nandalālā Yadu Nandalālā
Brindāvan Govindā Lālā
Rādhā Lolā Nandalālā
Rādhā Mādhava Nandalālā (jay)

title: Nandeeshwara He Nataraja
lyrics:
Nandeeshwara He Nataraja
Nandatmaja Hari Narayana
Narayana Hari (Sai) Narayana
Nagabharana Namah Shivaya
Nada Swaroopa Namo Namo
Narayana Hari (Sai) Narayana
meaning: Oh Lord of Nandi, the divine bull, You are the Lord of cosmic dance, Shiva. You are also the son of Nanda, Lord Vishnu, the ultimate refuge of all beings. Oh Sai Narayana, You are Shiva, who is adorned with the snake! You are the one who embodies divine music!
devanagari:
नंदीश्वरा हे नटराजा
नंदात्मजा हरि नारायणा
नारायणा हरि ( साई ) नारायणा
नागभारणा नमः शिवाय
नाद स्वरूपा नमो नमो [ नारायण हरि ( साई ) ... ]
respell:
Nandīshwarā He Naṭarājā
Nandātmajā Hari Nārāyaṇā
Nārāyaṇā Hari ( Sāī ) Nārāyaṇā
Nāgabhāraṇā Namaḥ Shivāy
Nāda Swarūpā Namo Namo [ Nārāyaṇ Hari ( Sāī ) ... ]

title: Nandi Vahana Nataraja Hare
lyrics:
Nandi Vahana Nataraja Hare
Indushekhara Shiva Raja Hare
Bandha Vimochana Jaya Baba Hare
Parthipureeshwara Shiva Sai Hare
--
Sai Hare Sri Sai Hare
Baba Hare Sai Baba Hare
meaning: We pray to the Lord of Divine dance (Nataraja) who is seated on Nandi, who has adorned moon on his head, who is auspiciousness Himself, who shatters the shackles of bondage, who is the Supreme Father of all beings. We pray to the Lord of Puttaparthi who in essence is that Supreme lord Shiva himself.
devanagari:
नंदी वाहना नटराज हरे
इन्दुशेखर शिव राज हरे [ नंदी वाहना ... ]  
बंध विमोचन जय बाबा हरे
पर्ती पूरीश्वर शिव साई हरे
---
साई हरे श्री साई हरे
बाबा हरे साई बाबा हरे
respell:
Nandī Vāhanā Naṭarāj Hare
Indushekhar Shiv Rāj Hare [ nandī vāhanā ... ]
Bandha Vimochana Jaya Bābā Hare
Partī Pūrīshwar Shiv Sāī hare
---
Sāī Hare Shrī Sāī Hare
Bābā Hare Sāī Bābā Hare

title: Narayan Narayan Bhajamana Narayan
lyrics:
Narayan Narayan Bhajamana Narayan
SriHari Madhava Narayan Bhajamana Narayan
Murali Shyam Mohana Shyam Murali Mohana Shyam
Mere Ram He Ghana Shyam Sai Sadguru Nam
meaning: O mind, continuously chant the sacred name of Narayana, who is Sri Hari and Madhava. Remember the enchanting dark-hued Lord Krishna, who plays the flute, and my Lord Rama, whose complexion is like a rain cloud, recognizing them all in the name of Sai, the true Guru.
devanagari:
नारायण नारायण भज मन नारायण  
श्री हरि माधव नारायण भज मन नारायण  
मुरली श्याम मोहन श्याम मुरली मोहन श्याम  
मेरे राम हे घन श्याम साईं सद्गुरु नाम
respell:
Nārāyaṇ Nārāyaṇ Bhaja Mana Nārāyaṇ
Shrī Hari Mādhava Nārāyaṇ Bhaja Mana Nārāyaṇ
Muralī Shyām Mohan Shyām Muralī Mohan Shyām
Mere Rām He Ghan Shyām Sāīṃ Sadguru Nām

title: Narayana Govinda Harey
lyrics:
Narayana Govinda Harey
Narayana Gopala Harey [ Narayana Govinda ... ]
Shanthakara Bhujanga Shayana
Narayana Veda Parayana
meaning: O Narayana, Govinda, Gopala, we invoke your divine names! You are the very embodiment of peace, resting serenely upon the cosmic serpent. O Narayana, you are the ultimate truth and profound wisdom enshrined within the Vedas.
devanagari:
नारायण गोविन्द हरे
नारायण गोपाल हरे [ नारायण गोविन्द ... ]

नारायणा वेद पारायणा
respell:

Nārāyaṇ Gopāla Hare [ Nārāyaṇ Govinda ... ]
Shāntakārā Bhujaṅga Shayanā
Nārāyaṇā Ved Pārāyaṇā

title: Narayana Hari Om Hari Om Hari Om
lyrics:
Narayana Hari Om Hari Om Hari Om
Sai Narayana Hari Om Hari Om Hari Om
Shantakara Bhujanga Shayana
Padmanabha Hari Om
Sai Narayana Hari Om
meaning: Oh Narayana, divine Hari, we offer our salutations to You, who manifest as Sai. You are the very form of peace, resting upon the cosmic serpent, and from Your navel springs the lotus of creation. We bow to You, Sai Narayana, the source of all.

साई नारायण हरि ॐ
respell:

Sāī Nārāyaṇ Hari Oṃ Hari Oṃ Hari Oṃ [sāī Nārāyaṇ Hari ... ]
Shāntakārā Bhujaṅgā Shayanā
Padmanābha Hari Oṃ
Sāī Nārāyaṇ Hari Oṃ

title: Narayana Hari Naam Bhajorey
lyrics:
Narayana Hari Naam Bhajorey (3)
Krishna Janardhana Jaya Panduranga
Radha Ramana Hari Narayana
Ayodhya Vasi Sri Raghu Rama
Dasharatha Nandana Janaki Rama
Parthi (Shirdi) Pureeshwara Sri Sai Rama
meaning: Oh, let us chant the sacred names of Narayana and Hari! We glorify Krishna, Janardhana, and Panduranga, the beloved of Radha. We remember Sri Rama, the resident of Ayodhya and son of Dasharatha, and Sri Sai Rama, the Lord of Parthi and Shirdi, as we sing your divine praise.
devanagari:
नारायण हरि नाम भजोरे (3)  
कृष्ण जनार्दन जय पांडुरंगा  
राधा रमण हरि नारायण  
अयोध्या वासी श्री रघु राम  
दशरथ नंदन जानकी राम  
पर्ति (शिरडी) पूरीश्वर श्री साई राम
respell:
Nārāyaṇ Hari Nām Bhajore (3)
Kṛushṇa Janārdana Jaya Pāṇḍuraṅgā

Ayodhyā Vāsī Shrī Raghu Rām
Dasharath Nandana Jānakī Rām
Pārthī (shiraḍī) Pūreshwar Shrī Sāī Rām

title: Narayana Hari Nama Bhajore Narayana Veda Parayana
lyrics:
Narayana Hari Naama Bhajorey Narayana Veda Parayana
Karuna Bharana Bhava Bhaya Harana
Pavana Charana Patitha Janavana
Narayana Hari (Sai) Narayana (3)
meaning: Sing the names of Lord Narayana, who is the very heart of the sacred Vedas. Adorned with compassion, He removes the fear of worldly existence, and His purifying feet are the salvation for the fallen and the lost.
devanagari:
नारायण हरि नाम भजोरे नारायणा वेद पारायणा  
करुणा भारणा भव भय हरणा  
पवन चरण पतित जनवना
नारायणा हरि (साई) नारायणा (3)
respell:
Nārāyaṇ Hari Nāma Bhajore Nārāyaṇā Ved Pārāyaṇā
Karuṇā Bhāraṇā Bhava Bhaya Haraṇā
Pavan Charaṇ Patita Janavanā
Nārāyaṇā Hari (sāī) Nārāyaṇā (3)

title: Narayana Hari Narayana
lyrics:
Narayana Hari Narayana
Nanda Govinda Ananda Narayana
Narayana Hari Narayana
Govinda Ananda Narayana
Nanda Govinda Ananda Narayana
meaning: O Narayana, Hari, you are the divine essence! You are Govinda, beloved son of Nanda, the very embodiment of supreme bliss. Narayana, you are the source of all joy.
devanagari:

नंद गोविंद आनंद नारायणा
नारायणा हरी नारायणा
गोविंद आनंद नारायणा
नंद गोविंद आनंद नारायणा
respell:
Nārāyaṇā Harī Nārāyaṇā
Nanda Govind Ānanda Nārāyaṇā
Nārāyaṇā Harī Nārāyaṇā
Govind Ānanda Nārāyaṇā
Nanda Govind Ānanda Nārāyaṇā

title: Narayana Hari Narayana Bhaja Narayana Sai Narayana
lyrics:
Narayana Hari Narayana Bhaja Narayana Sai Narayana
Narayana Hari Narayana Narayana Sai Narayana
Narayana Hari Narayana Jaya Narayana Sai Narayana
Narayana Hari Narayana Narayana Sai Narayana
meaning: Oh Narayana, divine Hari, we earnestly adore You, Narayana, who manifests as Sai. Glory to You, Narayana, our beloved Sai.
devanagari:
नारायण हरि नारायण भज नारायण साई नारायण
नारायण हरि नारायण नारायण साई नारायण
नारायण हरि नारायण जय नारायण साई नारायण
नारायण हरि नारायण नारायण साई नारायण
respell:

Nārāyaṇ Hari Nārāyaṇ Nārāyaṇ Sāī Nārāyaṇ

title: Narayana Hari Narayana Hari Narayana Veda Parayana
lyrics:
Narayana Hari Narayana Hari Narayana Veda Parayana
Shambho Mahadeva Shambho Mahadeva Shambho Mahadeva Sadashiva
meaning: Glory to Lord Narayana, the author of Vedas. Glory to Lord Shiva who is ever blissful and who bestows welfare.
devanagari:
नारायणा हरि नारायणा हरि नारायणा वेद पारायणा  
शंभो महादेव शंभो महादेव शंभो महादेव सदाशिवा
respell:
Nārāyaṇā Hari Nārāyaṇā Hari Nārāyaṇā Ved Pārāyaṇā
Shambho Mahādeva Shambho Mahādeva Shambho Mahādeva Sadāshivā

title: Narayana Hari Narayana
lyrics:
Narayana Hari Narayana
Narahari Roopa Narayana
Vaikunta Vasa Namo Narayana
Vaidehi Mohana Narayana
Narayana Namo Narayana
Narayana Veda Parayana (Sai Narayana)
meaning: O Narayana, remover of sorrow, we offer our salutations to You, who manifested as the mighty Narahari and enchanted Vaidehi as Rama. Dweller of Vaikuntha, You are the very essence of the Vedas, O Sai Narayana.
devanagari:
नारायणा हरि नारायणा
नरहरी रूप नारायण
वैकुंट वासा नमो नारायण  
वैदेही मोहन नारायण  
नारायण नमो नारायण  
नारायण वेद पारायण (साई नारायण)
respell:
Nārāyaṇā Hari Nārāyaṇā
Naraharī Rūp Nārāyaṇ
Vaikuṇṭ Vāsā Namo Nārāyaṇ
Vaidehī Mohan Nārāyaṇ
Nārāyaṇ Namo Nārāyaṇ
Nārāyaṇ Ved Pārāyaṇ (sāī Nārāyaṇ)

title: Narayana Hari Narayana
lyrics:
Narayana Hari Narayana
Narahari Roopa Namo Narayana
Neeraja Nayana Neeradhi Shayana
Narada Sannuta Namo Narayana
meaning:
O Lord Narayana, you are the final refuge of all beings! O Lord Vishnu! You are the lion faced Narasimha! Salutations to you O Lotus eyed One! You are the One who reclines on the ocean!
O Lord praised by Sage Narada! Obeisance to you O Narayana!
devanagari:
नारायणा हरि नारायणा
नरहरी रूप नमो नारायण [ नारायणा हरि ... ]
निरधी नयन नीरडी शयना
नारद सन्नुत नमो नारायण
respell:
Nārāyaṇā Hari Nārāyaṇā
Naraharī Rūp Namo Nārāyaṇ [ Nārāyaṇā Hari ... ]
Niradhī Nayan Nīraḍī Shayanā
Nārad Sannuta Namo Nārāyaṇ

title: Narayana Narayana Jaya Govinda Hare
lyrics:
Narayana Narayana Jaya Govinda Hare
Narayana Narayana Jaya Gopala Hare
meaning: O Narayana! O Govinda! O, the cowherd, Lord Krishna! Victory be to you!
devanagari:
नारायण नारायण जय गोविन्द हरे
नारायण नारायण जय गोपाल हरे
नारायण नारायण जय गोविन्द हरे (2)
नारायण नारायण जय गोपाल हरे
respell:
Nārāyaṇ Nārāyaṇ Jaya Govinda Hare
Nārāyaṇ Nārāyaṇ Jaya Gopāla Hare
Nārāyaṇ Nārāyaṇ Jaya Govinda Hare (2)
Nārāyaṇ Nārāyaṇ Jaya Gopāla Hare

title: Nataraja Hey Tripurari
lyrics:
Nataraja Hey Tripurari
Jaya He Jaya He Shambho
Nandi Vahana Nagabharana
Phala Lochana Paramashiva
Pavana Charana Pahi Mahesha
meaning: Hail Shiva, the destroyer of demon King Tripura. Victory to Lord Shiva who is revered as master of all dance forms, Nataraja. The celestial snakes adorn him as garlands and who rides Nandi, the great bull. We bow at his lotus feet seeking solace as he is the supreme form with the third eye who grants succor to the whole creation. We bow to Shankara who is also famously known as Mahesha.
devanagari:
नटराजा हे त्रिपुरारी
जय हे जय हे शंभो [ नटराजा हे ... ]
नंदी वाहना नागाभरणा
फाल लोचना परम शिवा
पावन चरणा पाहि महेशा
respell:
Naṭarājā He Tripurārī
Jaya He Jaya He Shambho [ Naṭarājā He ... ]
Nandī Vāhanā Nāgābharaṇā
Phāla Lochanā Param Shivā
Pāvan Charaṇā Pāhi Maheshā

title: Nataraja Namami Shankara
lyrics:
Nataraja Namami Shankara
Shivaraja Shiva Shiva Shankara
Shirdipureeshwara Shiva Shankara
Parthipureeshwara Parameshwara
Hrudayeshwara Sayeeshwara
meaning: Salutations to the Lord Shankara, the master of cosmic dance, the embodiment of auspiciousness. He is not only the lord of Shirdi and Parthi but also the  indweller of every heart.
devanagari:
नटराजा नमामि शंकर
शिवराजा शिव शिव शंकर
शिरडीपूरीश्वर शिव शंकरा
पर्तीपूरीश्वर परमेश्वरा
हृदयेश्वरा साईश्वरा
respell:
Naṭarājā Namāmi Shaṅkar
Shivarājā Shiv Shiv Shaṅkar
Shiraḍīpūrīshwar Shiv Shaṅkarā
Partīpūrīshwar Parameshwarā
Hṛudayeshwarā Sāīshwarā

title: Nataraja Nataraja Nartana Sundara Nataraja
lyrics:
Nataraja Nataraja Nartana Sundara Nataraja
Shiva Raja Shiva Raja Shiva Tandava Priya Shiva Raja
Chidambaresha Nataraja
Parthipureesha Nataraja
meaning:
Salutations to the Lord of dance, Nataraja (Lord Shiva), who is enchanting as the Divine Dancer.
He is the Shiva, the Emperor Supreme, who is fond of the cosmic dance, the Tandava.
Nataraja, the Lord of Chidambaram (the holy temple in Southern India)
Nataraja, the Lord of Parthi.
devanagari:
नटराजा नटराजा नर्तन सुंदर नटराजा
शिव राजा शिव राजा शिव तांडव प्रिय शिव राजा  
चिदंबरेशा नटराजा
पर्ति पूरीशा नटराजा
respell:
Naṭarājā Naṭarājā Nartana Sundara Naṭarājā
Shiv Rājā Shiv Rājā Shiv Tāṇḍava Priy Shiv Rājā
Chidambareshā Naṭarājā
Parti Pūrīshā Naṭarājā

title: Nataraja Nataraja Natanashekara Raja
lyrics:
Nataraja Nataraja Natanashekara Raja
Shiva Raja Shiva Raja  Natanashekara Raja
Shiva Shiva Namo Hara Hara Namo
Shankara Shiva Nataraja
Namah Parvati Pataye Hara
Hara Hara Hara Hara Mahadeva
meaning: Glory to Shiva, the ultimate dancer, who mesmerizes one and all with his cosmic dance. Lord Shiva, who has no parallel to his dance and his dancing style. When his devotees sing his glory incessantly, he is enchanted. We bow to Shiva, the Lord of Parvathi, Hara Hara to bestow eternal bliss on his devotees.
devanagari:
नटराजा नटराजा नटन शेखर राजा
शिव राजा शिव राजा नटन शेखर राजा
शिव शिव नमो हरा हरा नमो
शंकर शिव नटराजा [ नटराजा नटराजा ... ]
नमः पार्वती पतये हर (ॐ)
हर हर हर हर महादेवा
respell:
Naṭarājā Naṭarājā Naṭana Shekhar Rājā
Shiv Rājā Shiv Rājā Naṭana Shekhar Rājā
Shiv Shiv Namo Harā Harā Namo
Shaṅkar Shiv Naṭarājā [ Naṭarājā Naṭarājā ... ]
Namaḥ Pārwatī Pataye Har (oṃ)
Har Har Har Har Mahādevā

title: Nataraja Nataraja Natana Sundara Nataraja
lyrics:
Nataraja Nataraja Natana Sundara Nataraja
Shivaraja Shivaraja Shivakami Priya Shivaraja
Chidambaresha Nataraja (Shiva)
Parthi Purisha Shivaraja (Putta)
meaning: O Nataraja, King of Dance, your beautiful cosmic performance is a wonder to behold! You are Shiva, the beloved consort of Shivakami, who graces both Chidambaram and Puttaparthi as their divine Lord.
devanagari:
नटराजा नटराजा नर्तन  सुन्दर नटराजा 
शिवराजा शिवराजा शिवकामी प्रिय शिवराजा
चिदम्बरेशा नटराजा  (शिव)
पर्तिपुरीशा शिवराजा  (पुट्ट)
respell:
Naṭarājā Naṭarājā Nartana  Sundara Naṭarājā
Shivarājā Shivarājā Shivakāmī Priy Shivarājā
Chidambareshā Naṭarājā  (shiv)
Partipurīshā Shivarājā  (puṭṭa)

title: Natavara Krishna Natavara Krishna Radhe Nandalala
lyrics:
Natavara Krishna Natavara Krishna Radhe Nandalala
Hare Hare Madhava Hare Gopika Lola
Krishna Ghana Ghana Neela Krishna Gokula Bala
Hare Hare Madhava Hare Gopika Lola
meaning: Oh Krishna, the supreme dancer, beloved child of Nanda and Radha's darling. Hail Madhava, whose dark blue form enchants the Gopis and who is the cherished child of Gokul.
devanagari:
नटवर कृष्णा नटवर कृष्णा राधे नंदलाला
हरे हरे माधवा हरे गोपिका लोला
कृष्णा घना घना नीला कृष्ण गोकुल बाला
हरे हरे माधव हरा गोपिका लोला
respell:
Naṭavar Kṛushṇā Naṭavar Kṛushṇā Rādhe Nandalālā
Hare Hare Mādhavā Hare Gopikā Lolā
Kṛushṇā Ghanā Ghanā Nīlā Kṛushṇa Gokul Bālā
Hare Hare Mādhava Harā Gopikā Lolā

title: Natavara Lal Giridhara Gopal
lyrics:
Natavara Lal Giridhara Gopal
Meera Prabhu Ghana Shyama Gopal
Veda Sara Jeevan ka-Adhaar
Gopi Manohara Hrudaya Vihar
meaning: Mischievous Krishna, the protector of Gokul, who lifted the Gowardhan mountain and stole the pure Hearts of Gopis. He is the Lord of Meera, whose Heart was filled with pure Love for the dark hued Gopala. He, whose name is the essence of all Vedas. He is also the life force for us. We bow to Gopal who always resides in the pure Hearts of the cowheard Gopis.
devanagari:
नटवर लाल गिरिधर गोपाल
मीरा प्रभु घन श्यामा गोपाल [ नटवर लाल ... ]
वेद सार जीवन आधार
मुरली (गोपी) मनोहर हृदय विहार
respell:
Naṭavar Lāl Giridhara Gopāl
Mīrā Prabhu Ghan Shyāmā Gopāl [ Naṭavar Lāl ... ]
Ved Sār Jīvan Ādhār
Muralī (gopī) Manohar Hṛudaya Vihār

title: Neela Megha Shyama Krishna Gopala Krishna
lyrics:
Neela Megha Shyama Krishna Gopala Krishna
Radha Ramana Sathya Narayana
Vatapatra Shayana Sai Narayana
Manusha Vesha Dhari Sathya Narayana
Parthipuri Nayaka Sai Narayana
meaning: O Krishna, dark as a blue cloud, beloved of Radha and divine cowherd, you are Sathya Narayana. You recline on a banyan leaf, taking human form as Sai, the Lord of Parthi, embodying truth and grace.
devanagari:
नील मेघ श्याम कृष्ण गोपाल कृष्णा
राधा रमणा सत्य नारायणा
वत पत्र शयन साई नारायणा [ नीला मेघ ... ]
मानुष वेशधारी सत्य नारायणा
पर्तिपुरी नायका साई नारायणा
respell:
Nīla Megha Shyām Kṛushṇa Gopāla Kṛushṇā
Rādhā Ramaṇā Satya Nārāyaṇā
Vat Patra Shayan Sāī Nārāyaṇā [ Nīlā Megha ... ]
Mānusha Veshadhārī Satya Nārāyaṇā
Partipurī Nāyakā Sāī Nārāyaṇā

title: Neelakantha Mahadeva Gauri Vandana
lyrics:
Neelakantha Mahadeva Gauri Vandana
Chandra Chooda Daya Natha Nandi Vahana
Sambashiva Shuladhari Naga Bhushana
Phala Netra Umakanta Parama Pavana
meaning: O God of Gods, the blue-throated one, You are worshipped by the Divine Mother Gowri. You are adorned with the moon on Your tresses, and has Nandi (the great bull) as Your vehicle. You are full of compassion. You carry the Trident and wear the snake as ornament. With Mother Uma as consort, You are adorned with the third eye and the purest of the Pure. Bless us all at all times.
devanagari:
नीलकंठ महादेव गौरी वंदना
चंद्र चूड़ दया नाथ नंदी वाहना
सांब शिव शूलधारी नाग भूषणा
फाल नेत्र उमाकांत परम पावना
respell:
Nīlakaṇṭh Mahādeva Gaurī Vandanā
Chandra Chūḍa़ Dayā Nātha Nandī Vāhanā
Sāmb Shiv Shūladhārī Nāga Bhūshaṇā
Phāla Netra Umākānt Param Pāvanā

title: Neelakantha Gangadhara Hara Umapate
lyrics:
Neelakantha Gangadhara Hara Umapate
Pralayankara Abhayankara Kailasapate
Dama Dama Dama, Dama Dama Dama, Damaru Baje
Nataraja Manohara Tandava Nache
Partheeshwara Parameshwara Jagadeesha Hare
meaning:
The blue-throated One who is the supporter of Ganga, the Destroyer, He is the Lord of Uma,
The One that causes destruction, and also the one who blesses with fearlessness, he is the Lord of Kailasa.
The blue-throated One who is the supporter of Ganga, the Destroyer, He is the Lord of Uma
The sounds 'Dama Dama' resonate as He plays the Damaru,
The Enchanter, the Master of dance, performs the Tandava,
Salutations to Him, the Lord of Parthi, the Lord Supreme and the Lord of the world!
devanagari:
नीलकण्ठ गंगाधर हरा उमापते
प्रलयंकर अभयंकर कैलासपते
डम डम डम डम डम डम डमरू बाजे
नटराज मनोहरा तांडव नाचे
पर्तीश्वर परमेश्वर जगदीश हरे
respell:
Nīlakaṇṭha Gaṅgādhara Harā Umāpate
Pralayaṅkar Abhayaṅkar Kailāsapate
Ḍama Ḍama Ḍama Ḍama Ḍama Ḍama Ḍamarū Bāje
Naṭarāj Manoharā Tāṇḍava Nāche
Partīshwar Parameshwar Jagadīsha Hare

title: Niranjani Sai Bhavani
lyrics:
Niranjani Sai Bhavani
Jagat Janani Ananda Dayini [Niranjani Sai ..]
Durga Lakshmi Narayani
Sri Kamalasana Hamsa Vahini
meaning: Salutations to the blemishless Mother Sai, the creator and bestower of life. The universal mother is the source of bliss divine. She is the combination of Durga (power) and Lakshmi (wealth), Narayani (all-round welfare) and Hamsa vahini (Saraswathi - education), Kamalasana (seated on the Lotus bloom). We bow to the mother who is everything for us.
devanagari:
निरंजनी साई भवानी
जग जननी आनन्द दायिनी [निरंजनी साई ..]
दुर्गा लक्ष्मी नारायणी
श्री कमलासन हंस वाहिनी
respell:
Nirañjanī Sāī Bhavānī
Jag Jananī Ānanda Dāyinī [nirañjanī Sāī ..]
Durgā Lakshmī Nārāyaṇī
Shrī Kamalāsan Haṃs Vāhinī

title: Nirupama Guna Sadana Charana Neeraja Dala Nayana
lyrics:
Nirupama Guna Sadana Charana Neeraja Dala Nayana
Kashayambara Vesha Dharana Kali Yuga Avatara
Nitya Ranjana Nirmala Charita Nirupama Yogendra
Maha Deva Nataraja Viraja Asha Pasha Nasha Esha
meaning: Oh Lord, whose virtues are beyond compare and whose eyes are like lotus petals, you appear in saffron robes as the Kali Yuga's divine incarnation. Eternally captivating with a pure heart, you are the supreme Yogi, the magnificent Nataraja who liberates us by destroying all worldly bonds.
devanagari:
निरुपम गुण सदना चरणा नीरज दल नयना
काशायम्बर वेश धारण कली युग अवतारा
नित्य रंजना निर्मल चरिता निरुपम योगेन्द्रा
महातेज नटराज विराजा आश पाश नाश ईशा
respell:
Nirupama Guṇ Sadanā Charaṇā Nīraj Dala Nayanā
Kāshāyambara Vesh Dhāraṇ Kalī Yug Avatārā
Nitya Rañjanā Nirmala Charitā Nirupama Yogendrā
Mahāteja Naṭarāj Virājā Āsh Pāsha Nāsha Īshā

title: Nithyanandam Satchidanandam
lyrics:
Nithyanandam Satchidanandam
Hari Hari Hari Aum Narayana
Narayana Hari Narayana [ Hari Hari ... ]
Prema Swaroopa Premananda (2) [ Hari Hari ... ]
Narayana Sai Narayana [ Hari Hari ... ]
meaning: Oh Narayana, you are the eternal bliss, the very essence of truth, consciousness, and joy. We invoke your sacred names, Hari and Aum, for you are the embodiment of pure love and the giver of supreme happiness, manifest even as Sai.
devanagari:
नित्यानंदम सच्चिदानंदम
हरि हरि हरि ॐ नारायणा
नारायण हरि नारायणा [ हरि हरि ... ]  
प्रेम स्वरूपा प्रेमानंदा (2) [ हरि हरि ... ]  
नारायणा साई नारायणा [ हरि हरि ... ]
respell:
Nityānandam Sachchidānandam
Hari Hari Hari Oṃ Nārāyaṇā
Nārāyaṇ Hari Nārāyaṇā [ Hari Hari ... ]
Prem Swarūpā Premānandā (2) [ Hari Hari ... ]
Nārāyaṇā Sāī Nārāyaṇā [ Hari Hari ... ]

title: O Baba Sai Baba
lyrics:
O Baba Sai Baba
Deenon Ke Dukha Harte Baba
Ram Hi Baba Krishna Hi Baba
Nara Dehi Narayana Baba
meaning: O Lord Sai Baba! kindly remove the misery of the meek. You are none other than Lord Rama, Krishna and Narayana incarnated as Lord Sai Baba'
devanagari:
ओ बाबा साई बाबा
दीनों के दुख हरते बाबा [ ओ बाबा ... ]
राम ही बाबा कृष्ण ही बाबा
नार देहि नारायण बाबा (2)
respell:
O Bābā Sāī Bābā
Dīnoṃ Ke Dukha Harate Bābā [ O Bābā ... ]
Rām Hī Bābā Kṛushṇa Hī Bābā
Nāra Dehi Nārāyaṇ Bābā (2)

title: O Bhagawan O Bhagawan Araj Suno Mere Sai Bhagawan
lyrics:
O Bhagawan O Bhagawan Araj Suno Mere Sai Bhagawan
Parthipuri Ke Tum Ho Data
Brindavan Ke Tum Ho Data
Sab Bhakton Ke Man Ko Bhata
Par Utaro Naiya More
Sai Ghana Shyama Sai Ghana Shyama
meaning: O Lord, hear my prayers my dear Sai. Oh Lord Sai Baba, You are the boon bestowing Lord of Parthi and Brindavan. You are the beloved of all devotees, enchanting their minds and hearts. Please help us cross this boat safely across the river of life, O Sai, the one having deep blue complexion.
devanagari:
ओ भगवान ओ भगवान अरज सुनो मेरे साई भगवान
पर्तीपुरी के तुम हो दाता
ब्रिंदावन के तुम हो दाता
सब भक्तों के मन को भाता
पार उतारो नैया मोरी
साई घन श्यामा साई घन श्यामा
respell:
O Bhagavān O Bhagavān Araj Suno Mere Sāī Bhagavān
Partīpurī Ke Tum Ho Dātā
Brindāvan Ke Tum Ho Dātā
Sab Bhaktoṃ Ke Man Ko Bhātā
Pār Utāro Naiyā Morī
Sāī Ghan Shyāmā Sāī Ghan Shyāmā

title: O Lord Purify Me
lyrics:
O Lord, Purify Me And Make My Heart Worth Stealing
Our Precious Possession That Is Full Of Loving Feeling
Take Every Good Thought And Take Every Action
Soaked In The Sweetness Of Love And Caumpassion
Bada Chitha Chora Brindavana Sanchara
Gopala Gopala Hey Murali Gopala
Govardhanodhara Gopala Bala
Gopi Manohara Radhey Gopala
devanagari:
ओ लोर्ड प्युरफाइ मी अन्ड मेक माइ हार्ट वरथ स्टीलिङ
आउअर प्रेशस पजेशन दैट इज फुल अव लविङ फीलिङ
टेक एवरई गुड थोट अन्ड टेक एवरई ऐक्शन
सोक्ट इन द स्वीट्नस अव लव अन्ड कम्पैशन
बाड चित्त चोरा ब्रिंदावन संचारा
गोपाला गोपाला हे मुरली गोपाला
गोवर्धनोधर गोपाला बाला
गोपी मनोहर राधे गोपाला

title: O Lord Take My Love
lyrics:
O Lord, Take My Love, Let It Flow In Full Devotion To Thee
O Lord, Take My Hands, Let Them Work Unceasingly For Thee
O Lord, Take My Soul, Let It Merge In Perfect Oneness With Thee
O Lord, Take My Mind, Let My Thoughts Be In Tune With Thee
O Lord, Take My Everything, And Let Me Be An Instrument For Thee
O Lord, Take My Love, Let It Flow In Full Devotion To Thee
O Lord, Take My Hands, Let Them Work Incessantly For Thee
O Lord, Take My Soul, Let It Merge In Perfect Oneness With Thee
O Lord, Take My Mind, Let My Thoughts Be In Tune With Thee
O Lord, Take My Everything, And Let Me Be An Instrument For Thee
devanagari:
ओ लोर्ड टेक माइ लव लेट इट फ्लो इन फुल डिवोशन टू दी
ओ लोर्ड टेक माइ हैन्ड्ज लेट देम वरक उन्चेअसिन्ग्ल्य फोर दी
ओ लोर्ड टेक माइ सोल लेट इट मरज इन परफेक्ट वन्नस विद दी
ओ लोर्ड टेक माइ माइन्ड लेट माइ थोट्स बी इन टून विद दी
ओ लोर्ड टेक माइ एव्रीथिङ अन्ड लेट मी बी ऐन इन्स्ट्रमन्ट फोर दी
ओ लोर्ड टेक माइ लव लेट इट फ्लो इन फुल डिवोशन टू दी
ओ लोर्ड टेक माइ हैन्ड्ज लेट देम वरक इन्सेसन्ट्ली फोर दी
ओ लोर्ड टेक माइ सोल लेट इट मरज इन परफेक्ट वन्नस विद दी
ओ लोर्ड टेक माइ माइन्ड लेट माइ थोट्स बी इन टून विद दी
ओ लोर्ड टेक माइ एव्रीथिङ अन्ड लेट मी बी ऐन इन्स्ट्रमन्ट फोर दी

title: Om Shiva Om Shiva Sachidananda Shiva
lyrics:
Om Shiva Om Shiva Sachidananda Shiva
Shambho Shankara Samba Sadashiva
Om Shiva Om Shiva Sachidananda Shiva
Shambho Shankara Samba Sadashiv
meaning: Oh Shiva, Om Shiva, You are the absolute truth, consciousness, and bliss itself. We invoke You, Shambho, Shankara, ever united with Ambika, the eternally auspicious Sadashiva.
devanagari:
ॐ शिव ॐ शिव सच्चिदानन्द शिव
शम्भो शङ्कर साम्ब सदाशिव
ॐ शिव ॐ शिव सच्चिदानन्द शिव
शम्भो शङ्कर साम्ब सदाशिव
respell:
Oṃ Shiv Oṃ Shiv Sachchidānanda Shiv
Shambho Shaṅkar Sāmba Sadāshiv
Oṃ Shiv Oṃ Shiv Sachchidānanda Shiv
Shambho Shaṅkar Sāmba Sadāshiv

title: Omkara Roopini Janani Ma
lyrics:
Omkara Roopini Janani Ma
Mangala Karini Janani Ma
Gana Vinodini Janani Ma
Ananda Dayini Janani Ma
Janani Ma Partheeshwari Ma
meaning: Oh Divine Mother, your very form is the sacred Om, bringing all auspiciousness and delighting in devotional music. You are the giver of supreme bliss, our beloved Mother, the Divine Sovereign of Parthi.
devanagari:
ॐकार रूपिणी जननी मा
मंगल कारिणी जननी मा
गान विनोदिनी जननी मा
आनंद दायिनी जननी मा
जननी मा पर्तीश्वरी मा
respell:
Oṃkār Rūpiṇī Jananī Mā
Maṅgal Kāriṇī Jananī Mā
Gān Vinodinī Jananī Mā
Ānanda Dāyinī Jananī Mā
Jananī Mā Partīshwarī Mā

title: Pahi Gajanana Deenavana
lyrics:
Pahi Gajanana Deenavana
Sindura Vadana Sritajana Palana
Ambika Tanaya Amaradeeshwara
Aganita Guna Gana Ananda Dayaka
meaning:
All the obstacles and troubles get anhilated when one contemplates on all pervading Lord Vishnu who is cladded in white, with a pleasant and glowing face like the moon and has four arms.
Just as the divine effulgence emerging from the lotus like face of the daughter of Mountains (Mother Parvati) is always fixed on the elephant faced Lord Ganesha,
May the constant grace of Ekadanta (single tusked), who grants boon for various prayers of His devotees be on those who worship Him.
We pray to Lord Ganesha to protect us - the unprotected. Your face shines while You are bestowing welfare on those who surrender and the downtrodden. As the beloved child of Ambika, You are praised by the celestial beings as there is no one equal to You, O the Lord who grants bliss.
devanagari:
पाही गजानन दिनवना
सिन्धुर वदना श्रित जन पालन
[ पाही गजानन ... ]
अम्बिक तनया अमराधीश्वर
अगणित गुण गन आनंद दायक
respell:
Pāhī Gajānana Dinavanā
Sindhura Vadanā Shrit Jana Pālan
[ Pāhī Gajānana ... ]
Ambika Tanayā Amarādhīshwar
Agaṇita Guṇ Gan Ānanda Dāyak

title: Paahi Paahi Gajanana
lyrics:
Paahi Paahi Gajanana
Parvathi Nandana Gajanana
Pashupathi Tanaya Gajanana
Buddhi Pradatha Gajanana
Siddhi Vinayaka Shubhanana
Lambodhara Jaya Gajanana
Parvathi Nandana Gajanana
meaning: O Gajanana, protect us, protect us! Beloved son of Parvati and Pashupati (Shiva), you are the bestower of wisdom and the granter of success. With your auspicious face and large belly, we hail your victory!
devanagari:
पाहि पाहि गजानना 
पार्वति नंदन गजानना 
पशुपति तनया गजानना 
बुद्धि प्रदाता गजानना 
सिद्धि विनायक शुभानना 
लम्बोदरा जय गजानना 
पार्वति नंदन गजानना
respell:
Pāhi Pāhi Gajānanā
Pārwati Nandana Gajānanā
Pashupati Tanayā Gajānanā
Buddhi Pradātā Gajānanā
Siddhi Vināyak Shubhānanā
Lambodarā Jaya Gajānanā
Pārwati Nandana Gajānanā

title: Paahi Paahi Gajanana
lyrics:
Paahi Paahi Gajanana
Parvathi Tanaya Gajanana
Mooshika Vahana Gajanana
Modaka Hasta Gajanana
Chamara Karna Gajanana
Vilambita Sutra Gajanana
Paahi Paahi Gajanana
Parvathi Tanaya Gajanana
Mooshika Vahana Gajanana
Modaka Hasta Gajanana
Chamara Karna Gajanana
Vilambita Sutra Gajanana
Vamana Roopa Gajanana
Maheshwara Putra Gajanana
Vighna Vinashaka Gajanana
Tava Paada Namasthey Gajanana

title: Paahi Paahi Hey Mahesha
lyrics:
Paahi Paahi Hey Mahesha
Maya Rahita Gowri Kantha
Shiva Shiva Shankara Shambho Shankara
Ganga Jatadhara Gowri Manohara
Shooladhara Vibhuti Sundara
Haalaahala Dhara Natana Manohara
Aashritha Rakshaka Hey Tripurari

title: Par Karo Uddhar Karo Prabhu Parthipuri Bhagawan
lyrics:
Par Karo Uddhar Karo Prabhu Parthipuri Bhagawan
Hare Ram Ram Ram Ghana Shyam Shyam Shyam Hey Sai Nath Bhagawan
Deena Dayakara Karuna Moorthi Kali Yuga Avatar Sai Bhagawan
Allah Sai Buddha Zoroastra Yeshu Christu Bhagawan
meaning: O Lord of Parthi! Save me and help me to get released from the cycle of birth and demise. O Merciful Lord Sai Ram! You are the Incarnation of the Kali Age, the embodiment of all names - Ram, Krishna, Allah, Buddha, Zoroaster and Jesus Christ.
devanagari:
पार करो उद्धार करो प्रभु पर्ती पूरी भगवान
हरे राम राम राम घन श्याम श्याम श्याम हे साई नाथ भगवान
दीन दयाकर करुणा मूर्ति कली युग अवतार साई भगवान
अल्लाह साई बुद्ध जोह्राष्ट्र येसु क्रिष्टु भगवान
respell:
Pār Karo Uddhār Karo Prabhu Partī Pūrī Bhagavān
Hare Rām Rām Rām Ghan Shyām Shyām Shyām He Sāī Nātha Bhagavān
Dīna Dayākar Karuṇā Mūrti Kalī Yug Avatār Sāī Bhagavān
Allāh Sāī Buddha Johrāshṭra Yesu Krishṭu Bhagavān

title: Padmanabha Narayana
lyrics:
Padmanabha Narayana
Parthi Vasa Narayana
Narayana Namo Narayana
Narayana Hari Narayana
Narayana Sai Narayana
meaning: O Narayana, the divine source from whom creation unfolds, you graciously dwell in Parthi. We bow to you, Narayana, the remover of all sorrow, who has manifested in the form of Sai.
devanagari:
पद्मनाभा नारायणा
पर्ती (बद्री) वासा नारायणा (2)
नारायणा नमो (साई) नारायणा (3)
respell:
Padmanābhā Nārāyaṇā
Partī (badrī) Vāsā nārāyaṇā (2)
Nārāyaṇā Namo (sāī) nārāyaṇā (3)

title: Pahi Mahesha He Jagadeesha
lyrics:
Pahi Mahesha He Jagadeesha
Dehi Dehi Tava Pada Seva
Poorna Brahma Sanathana Swami
Jaya He Jaya He Antaryami
meaning:
Kindly protect O Supreme Lord of the Universe.
Grant us the service at Thy lotus feet
O Swami, You are Supreme Lord and Eternal
Victory to Thee O indweller of us!
devanagari:
पाहि महेशा हे जगदीशा
देहि देहि तव पद सेवा
पूर्ण ब्रह्म सनातन स्वामी
जय हे जय हे अन्तर्यामी
respell:
Pāhi Maheshā He Jagadīshā
Dehi Dehi Tava Pada Sevā
Pūrṇa Brahma Sanātana Swāmī
Jaya He Jaya He Antaryāmī

title: Pandhari Nivasa Hey Panduranga
lyrics:
Pandhari Nivasa Hey Panduranga
Hey Parthi Vasa Sri Sai Deva
Deena Rakshaka Anatha Rakshaka
Bhakta Vatsala Hey Sayeeshwara
meaning: Sing the glory of the Lord of Pandharpur, Panduranga. He is the resident of Parthi, Lord Sai, who is the protector of the weak, the orphaned and the under privileged. He is the Lord who always takes care of His devotees.
devanagari:
पंढरी निवासा हे पांडुरंगा
हे पर्ती वासा श्री साई देवा [ पंदरी निवासा ... ]
दीन रक्षका अनाथ रक्षका ( साई )
भक्त वत्सला हे साईश्वरा (2)
respell:
Paṇḍharī Nivāsā He Pāṇḍuraṅgā
He Partī Vāsā Shrī Sāī Devā [ Pandarī Nivāsā ... ]
Dīna Rakshakā Anātha Rakshakā ( Sāī )
Bhakta Vatsalā He Sāīshwarā (2)

title: Panduranga Panduranga Vitthala Pahe
lyrics:
Panduranga Panduranga Vitthala Pahe
Deena Natha Karuna Natha
Sai Natha Hare
Pandhari Natha Panduranga
Vitthala Pahe
meaning:
Oh Lord Panduranga! Oh Vittala! You are the protector of the meek and helpless.
You are the merciful lord.
Oh! Sai Natha, you are the Lord of Pandharpur.
devanagari:
पांडुरंगा पांडुरंगा विट्ठला पाहे
दीन नाथा करुणा नाथा
साई नाथ हरे
पंढरी नाथा पांडुरंगा
विट्ठला पाहे
respell:
Pāṇḍuraṅgā Pāṇḍuraṅgā Viṭṭhalā Pāhe
Dīna Nāthā Karuṇā Nāthā
Sāī Nātha Hare
Paṇḍharī Nāthā Pāṇḍuraṅgā
Viṭṭhalā Pāhe

title: Panduranga Vitthala Jai Pandhari Natha Vitthala
lyrics:
Panduranga Vitthala Jai Pandhari Natha Vitthala
Panduranga Vitthala Jai Pundarikaksha Vitthala
Vitthala Jai Vitthala Purandara Vitthala
Vitthala Jai Vitthala Jai Rakhumayi Vitthala
meaning:
Victory to the lord of Pandari, who waited patiently for his devotee Pundalika.
Victory to that Pundarikaksha.
Recite the name of Lord: Panduranga and Vittala.
 Victory to Vittala (Vishnu), the Lord of Rakumayi (Rukmini)
devanagari:
पांडुरंग विट्ठला जय पंढरी नाथा विट्ठला
पांडुरंग विट्ठला जय पुंडरीकाक्क्षा विट्ठला [ पांडुरंग ... ]
विट्ठला जय विट्ठला पुरंदर विट्ठला (2)
विट्ठला जय विट्ठला जय रकुमाई विट्ठला
respell:
Pāṇḍuraṅg Viṭṭhalā Jay Paṇḍharī Nāthā Viṭṭhalā
Pāṇḍuraṅg Viṭṭhalā Jay Puṇḍarīkākkshā Viṭṭhalā [ Pāṇḍuraṅg ... ]
Viṭṭhalā Jay Viṭṭhalā Purandara Viṭṭhalā (2)
Viṭṭhalā Jay Viṭṭhalā Jay Rakumāī Viṭṭhalā

title: Pandhari Ranga Vitthala Jaya Panduranga Vitthala
lyrics:
Pandhari Ranga Vitthala Jaya Panduranga Vitthala
Kasturi Ranga Vitthala Kamaneeya Ranga Vitthala
Govinda Ranga Vitthala Gopala Ranga Vitthala
Kalyana Ranga Vitthala Karunanta Ranga Vitthala
Partheesha Ranga Vitthala Sathya Sai Ranga Vitthala
meaning: Victory to Lord Vitthala, the radiant deity of Pandharpur! We praise your beautiful form, fragrant like musk, as Govinda and Gopala, the auspicious one whose compassion is boundless. You are indeed the Lord of Parthi, Sathya Sai.
devanagari:
पांडुरंग विट्ठला जय पांडुरंग विट्ठला
कस्तूरी रंग विट्ठला कमनीय रंग विट्ठला [ पांडुरंग ... ]
गोविन्द रंगा विट्ठला गोपाल रंग विट्ठला
कल्याण रंग विट्ठला करुणान्त रंग विट्ठला
पर्तिश रंग विट्ठला जय साई रंग विट्ठला
respell:
Pāṇḍuraṅg Viṭṭhalā Jaya Pāṇḍuraṅg Viṭṭhalā
Kastūrī Raṅg Viṭṭhalā Kamanīya Raṅg Viṭṭhalā [ Pāṇḍuraṅg ... ]
Govinda Raṅgā Viṭṭhalā Gopāla Raṅg Viṭṭhalā
Kalyāṇ Raṅg Viṭṭhalā Karuṇānta Raṅg Viṭṭhalā
Partisha Raṅg Viṭṭhalā Jaya Sāī Raṅg Viṭṭhalā

title: Panduranga Vittaley Hari Narayana
lyrics:
Panduranga Vittaley Hari Narayana Hari Narayana Govinda (3)
Bhajo ( Sai ) Narayana Govinda (2)
meaning: We joyfully chant the holy names of Panduranga Vittala, Hari, Narayana, and Govinda. With devotion, we worship you, divine Narayana Govinda, our beloved Lord.
devanagari:
पांडुरंग विट्ठल हे हरि नारायण हरि नारायण गोविन्दा (3)
भजो ( साई ) नारायण गोविन्दा (2)
respell:
Pāṇḍuraṅg Viṭṭhal He Hari Nārāyaṇ Hari Nārāyaṇ govindā (3)
Bhajo ( Sāī ) Nārāyaṇ Govindā (2)

title: Pannaga Shayana Kali Avatara
lyrics:
Pannaga Shayana Kali Avatara
Narayana Hari Om
Parama Niranjana Neeraja Nayana
Sayeeshwaraya Hari Om
Sathya Sayeeshwaraya Hari Om
Buddhi Pradayaka Papa Vinashaka
Sathya Sanathana Tum Ho
Deena Nath Hey Prabhu Parameshwara
Karuna Sagar Tum Ho
meaning: Lord Narayana is the ultimate destination of humanity. He rests on serpent (transcended desires), he is the incarnation of this Kali age. He is blemishless and has lotus like eyes. He is verily Lord Sai himself. He confers liberation by redeeming all the sins. He is the truth eternal. He is the supreme absolute who motivates the dejected through his ocean like compassion.
devanagari:
पन्नग शयना कलि अवतारा
नारायणा हरि ॐ
परम निरंजन नीरज नयना
साईश्वराय हरि ॐ
सत्य साईश्वराय हरि ॐ
बुद्धि प्रदायक पाप विनाशक
सत्य सनातन तुम हो
दीना नाथ हे प्रभु परमेश्वर
करुणा सागर तुम हो
respell:
Pannaga Shayanā Kali Avatārā
Nārāyaṇā Hari Oṃ
Param Nirañjana Nīraj Nayanā
Sāīshwarāy Hari Oṃ
Satya Sāīshwarāy Hari Oṃ
Buddhi Pradāyak Pāpa Vināshak
Satya Sanātana Tum Ho
Dīnā Nāth He Prabhu Parameshwar
Karuṇā Sāgar Tum Ho

title: Hey Parama Dayalu Sai Ram
lyrics:
Hey Parama Dayalu Sai Ram
Bhagawan Bhagawan
Treta Yug Mein Dasharatha Nandana
Dwapara Yug Mein Murali Mohana
Kali Yuga Mein Sai Narayana
Ek Prabhu Anek Nam
meaning: O supremely compassionate Lord, you are the one divine essence who appeared as Rama in the Treta age and the enchanting Krishna in the Dwapara age. In this current Kali Yuga, you have come as Sai Narayana, revealing the truth that the one Lord is known by many names.
devanagari:
परम दयालु साई राम (हे)  
भगवान भगवान [ (हे) परम दयालु ... ]  
त्रेतायुग में दशरथ नंदन  
द्वापर युग में मुरली मोहन  
कलियुग में साई नारायण  
एक प्रभु अनेक नाम
respell:
Param Dayālu Sāī Rām (he)
Bhagavān Bhagavān [ (he) Param Dayālu ... ]
Tretāyug Meṃ Dasharath Nandana
Dwāpara Yug Meṃ Muralī Mohan
Kaliyug Meṃ Sāī Nārāyaṇ
Ek Prabhu Anek Nām

title: Paramananda Govinda Gopala Jai
lyrics:
Paramananda Govinda Gopala Jai
Sai Nanda Mukunda Gopala Jai
Sai Krishna Hare Sai Rama Hare
Jaya Keshava Madhava Mohana Hare
Mukharavinda Gopala Jai
Sachidananda Govinda Gopala Jai
Sai Nanda Mukunda Gopala Jai
meaning: Glory to supremely blissful, Lord Govinda- Gopala, Mukunda, Keshava, Madhava, Krishna and Rama. Glory to Lotus-Faced Gopala (protector of all beings), Who is the very embodiment of Truth, Awareness  and Bliss.
devanagari:
परमानंद गोविंद गोपाल जय
साई नंदा मुकुंदा गोपाल जय
साई कृष्णा हरे साई रामा हरे
जय केशव माधव मोहन हरे
मुखारविंदा गोपाल जय
सच्चिदानंद गोविंद गोपाल जय
साई नंदा मुकुंदा गोपाल जय
respell:
Paramānanda Govind Gopāla Jay
Sāī Nandā Mukundā Gopāla Jay
Sāī Kṛushṇā Hare Sāī Rāmā Hare
Jaya Keshav Mādhava Mohan Hare
Mukhāravindā Gopāla Jay
Sachchidānanda Govind Gopāla Jay
Sāī Nandā Mukundā Gopāla Jay

title: Parteeshwara Sai Baba Ab Aao Mere Nandalala
lyrics:
Parteeshwara Sai Baba Ab Aao Mere Nandalala
Jagadeesha Krupa Sagara
Paramesha Daya Sagara
Jai Jai Sai Ram, Bolo Jai Jai Sai Ram (3)
meaning: O Sai Baba, Lord of Puttaparthi, please manifest now as our beloved Nandalala. As the Lord of all worlds and the Supreme Being, you embody boundless grace and profound compassion. We joyfully chant victory to Sai Ram.
devanagari:
परतीश्वरा साई बाबा अब आओ साई नंदलाला  
जगदीशा कृपा सागरा   
परमेशा दया सागरा
जय जय साई राम, बोलो जय जय साई राम (3)
respell:
Paratīshwarā Sāī Bābā Ab Āo Sāī Nandalālā
Jagadīshā Kṛupā Sāgarā
Parameshā Dayā Sāgarā
Jay Jay Sāī Rām, Bolo Jay Jay Sāī Rām (3)

title: Partheeshwara Sathya Sayeeshwara
lyrics:
Partheeshwara Sathya Sayeeshwara
Daya Karo Hari Narayana
Sri Sai Narayana Sai
Sri Sai Narayana
Bhava Sagaroddhara Bhuvanavana
Sharanagatatrana Narayana
Daya Karo Hari Narayana
Sri Sai Narayana Sai
Sri Sai Narayana
meaning: O Lord Sathya Sai, Lord of Puttaparthi, O Lord Sai Narayana, have compassion on us. You are the One who can help us cross the ocean of samsara. Hey Sai Narayana, we surrender to Thee. Please have compassion on us, Sai Narayana.
devanagari:
पर्तीश्वरा सत्य साईेश्वरा
दया करो हरि नारायणा
श्री साई नारायणा (साई)
भाव सागरोध्दार भुवनवना
शरणागत त्राण नारायणा [ दया करो ... ]
श्री साई नारायणा (साई)
respell:
Partīshwarā Satya Sāīeshwarā
Dayā Karo Hari Nārāyaṇā
Shrī Sāī Nārāyaṇā (sāī)
Bhāva Sāgarodhdāra Bhuvanavanā
Sharaṇāgat Trāṇ Nārāyaṇā [ Dayā Karo ... ]
Shrī Sāī Nārāyaṇā (sāī)

title: Partheeshwara Parameshwara
lyrics:
Partheeshwara Parameshwara
Pavana Nama Sayeeshwara
Jagadeeshwara Hrudayeshwara
Jagadoddhara Jatadhara
Pavana Nama Sayeeshwara
meaning: Sing the glorious name of Lord Sai, the incarnation of Lord Shiva. Sing the beautiful name of He who is the Lord of the Universe and the One who resides in our Hearts. Sustainer of Creation, the long-tressed Lord with the glorious name.
devanagari:
पर्तीश्वरा परमेश्वरा
पावन नामा साईश्वरा
जगदीश्वरा हृदयेश्वरा
जगदोद्धारा जटाधरा
पावन नामा साईश्वरा
respell:
Partīshwarā Parameshwarā
Pāvan Nāmā Sāīshwarā
Jagadīshwarā Hṛudayeshwarā
Jagadoddhārā Jaṭādharā
Pāvan Nāmā Sāīshwarā

title: Partheeshwara Sri Sai Prabho
lyrics:
Partheeshwara Sri Sai Prabho
Eshwaramba Nandana Sai Prabho
Eshwara Allah Sri Sai Ram Nam
Buddha Zoroastra Sai Krishna Nam
Madhava Mohana Sai Narayana
Prema Avatara Prabhu Sai Rama
meaning: Sing the glory of Lord of Parthi, Sri Sai, the darling son of Eshwaramba. He is the personification of Eshwar, Allah, Krishna, Zoroastra, Buddha and Madhava. He is the incarnation of Divine Love.
devanagari:
पर्तिश्वर श्री साई प्रभो  
ईश्वराम्बा नंदना साई प्रभो [ पर्तिश्वर श्री ]  
ईश्वर अल्लाह श्री साई राम नाम  
बुद्ध जोह्राष्ट्र साई कृष्ण नाम  
माधव मोहन साई नारायण  
प्रेम अवतारा प्रभु साई रामा
respell:
Partishwar Shrī Sāī Prabho
Īshwarāmbā Nandanā Sāī Prabho [ partishwar shrī ]
Īshwar Allāh Shrī Sāī Rām Nām
Buddha Johrāshṭra Sāī Kṛushṇa Nām
Mādhava Mohan Sāī Nārāyaṇ
Prem Avatārā Prabhu Sāī Rāmā

title: Partheeshwari Jagat Janani
lyrics:
Partheeshwari Jagat Janani
Jaya Jaya Jaya Hey Sai Janani
Veda Kalamayi Devi Bhavani
Nada Vidya Mayi Narayani
Karuna Sadani Karunamayi Ma
Sharanam Sharanam Sai Ma
Jaya Jaya Jaya Hey Sai Janani
meaning: Divine Mother of Parthi, O Sai, the One who sustains the Universe, victory to You. You are the knowledge of the Vedas, You are the Goddess of Music and Arts. You are full of Grace, verily the embodiment of Grace. We surrender at Your feet, Mother Sai.
devanagari:
पर्तिश्वरी जगत जननी
जय जय जय हे साई जननी [ पर्तिश्वरी जगत ... ]
वेद कालामयी देवी भवानी
नाद विद्यामयी नारायणी
करुणा सदनी करुणामयी माँ
शरणम् शरणम् साई माँ [ जय जय ]
respell:
Partishwarī Jagat Jananī
Jaya Jaya Jaya He Sāī Jananī [ Partishwarī Jagat ... ]
Ved Kālāmayī Devī Bhavānī
Nāda Vidyāmayī Nārāyaṇī
Karuṇā Sadanī Karuṇāmayī Mām̐
Sharaṇam Sharaṇam Sāī Mām̐ [ Jaya Jaya ]

title: Parthipuri Mein Janam Liya Jo Sai Baba Nam Hain
lyrics:
Parthipuri Mein Janam Liya Jo Sai Baba Nam Hain
Mayura Mukuta Dhara Murali Manohara Sai Shyama Nam Hain
Hey Shiva Shankara Uma Maheshwara Sai Shambho Nam Hain
Hey Parameshwara Parthipureeshwara Tu Hi Mera Pran Hain
meaning: Oh Sai Baba, born in Parthi Puri, You are the enchanting Sai Shyama, adorned with a peacock crown and playing the flute, embodying Lord Krishna. You are also Sai Shambho, Shiva Shankara, Uma Maheshwara. Oh Supreme Lord of Parthi, You are indeed my very life and soul.
devanagari:
पर्ती पुरी में जनम लिया जो साई बाबा नाम है
मयूर मुकुटधर मुरली मनोहर साई श्यामा नाम है
हे शिव शंकर उमा महेश्वर साई शंभो नाम है
हे परमेश्वर पर्ती पूरीश्वर तू ही मेरा प्राण है
respell:
Partī Purī Meṃ Janam Liyā Jo Sāī Bābā Nām Hai
Mayūr Mukuṭadhara Muralī Manohar Sāī Shyāmā Nām Hai
He Shiv Shaṅkar Umā Maheshwar Sāī Shambho Nām Hai
He Parameshwar Partī Pūrīshwar Tū Hī Merā Prāṇ Hai

title: Parthi Vihara Papa Vidoora
lyrics:
Parthi Vihara Papa Vidoora
Pavana Charana Sai Narayana
Allah Tum Ho Yeshu Tum Ho
Sab Ke Malik Sai Tum Ho
Buddha Zoroastra Nanak Tum Ho
Tum Ho Baba Antaryami
Sab Bhakton Ke Palanhare
Kaliyuga Avatara Sai Narayana
meaning: O Sai Narayana, residing in Parthi, your sacred presence purifies and removes all sins. You embody the divine essence of Allah, Jesus, Buddha, Zoroaster, and Nanak, serving as the indwelling Lord and protector for all devotees. You are truly the Kali Yuga avatar, sustaining all who seek you.
devanagari:
पर्ती विहारा पाप विदूरा
पावन चरणा साई नारायण
अल्लाह तुम हो येशु तुम हो
सबके मालिक साई तुम हो
बुद्ध जोराष्ट्रा नानक तुम हो
तुम हो बाबा अंतर्यामी
सब भक्तों के पालनहारे
कलियुग अवतार साई नारायण
respell:
Partī Vihārā Pāpa Vidūrā
Pāvan Charaṇā Sāī Nārāyaṇ
Allāh Tum Ho Yeshu Tum Ho
Sabake Mālik Sāī Tum Ho
Buddha Jorāshṭrā Nānak Tum Ho
Tum Ho Bābā Antaryāmī
Sab Bhaktoṃ Ke Pālanahāre
Kaliyug Avatāra Sāī Nārāyaṇ

title: Parthipureeshwara Sai Allah Maula Sai
lyrics:
Parthipureeshwara Sai Allah Maula Sai
Gurudware Mein Nanak Sai
Girijaghar Mein Yeshu Sai
Buddha Zoroastra Mahavir Sai
Sarva Dharma Priya Sri Sathya Sai
meaning: O Lord Sai, the Lord of Puttaparthi, You are verily Allah. You reside in Gurudwaras as Nanak and in churches as Lord Jesus Christ. You are none other than Buddha, Zohrashtra and Mahavira. Glory to Thee, O Lord Sathya Sai who fosters all religions.
devanagari:
पर्तिपूरीश्वर साई अल्लाह मौला साई
गुरुद्वारे में नानक साई
गिरजाघर में येशु साई
बुद्ध ज़ोराष्ट्र महावीर साई
सर्व धर्म प्रिय श्री सत्य साई
respell:
Partipūrīshwar Sāī Allāh Maulā Sāī
Gurudwāre Meṃ Nānak Sāī
Girajāghar Meṃ Yeshu Sāī
Buddha ज़orāshṭra Mahāvīr Sāī
Sarwa Dharma Priy Shrī Satya Sāī

title: Parthipuri Gurudev Puttaparthipuri Gurudev
lyrics:
Parthipuri Gurudev Puttaparthipuri Gurudev
Prashanti Nilaya Prashanthi Niketana
Prema Sai Gurudev Puttaparthipuri Gurudev
Parabrahma Gurudev Param Jyothi Gurudev
Shirdi Pureesha Parthi Pureesha
Sathya Sai Gurudev Puttaparthipuri Gurudev
meaning: O Divine Teacher of Puttaparthi, you are the very abode of supreme peace and tranquility. You are Prema Sai, the Supreme Absolute, the ultimate divine light, the Lord of Shirdi and Parthi, our beloved Sathya Sai Guru.
devanagari:
पर्तिपुरी गुरुदेव पुट्टपर्तीपुरी गुरुदेव  
प्रशांति निलय प्रशांति निकेतन  
प्रेम साई गुरुदेव पुट्टपर्तीपुरी गुरुदेव  
परब्रह्म गुरुदेव परम ज्योति गुरुदेव  
शिर्डी पूरेश पर्तिपुरीशा
सत्य साई गुरुदेव पुट्टपर्तीपुरी गुरुदेव
respell:
Partipurī Gurudev Puṭṭapartīpurī Gurudev
Prashānti Nilay Prashānti Niketana
Prem Sāī Gurudev Puṭṭapartīpurī Gurudev
Parabrahma Gurudev Param Jyoti Gurudev
Shirḍī Pūresh Partipurīshā
Satya Sāī Gurudev Puṭṭapartīpurī Gurudev

title: Parvati Nandana Gajanana
lyrics:
Parvati Nandana Gajanana
Pashupati Nandana Niranjana
Pahi Prabho Mam Pahi Prasanna
Girija Nandana Shubhanana
meaning: Oh Beloved Son of Mother Parvathi! Oh Lord Gajanana! Oh Lord of all beings! Kindly shower Your grace and protect us, Oh pleasant-faced Lord! Oh Beloved Son of Mother Girija! You are forever conferring auspiciousness.
devanagari:
पर्वती नंदन गजानना
पशुपति नंदन निरंजना [ पर्वती नंदन ... ]
पाही प्रभो माम पाही प्रसन्ना
गिरिजा नंदन शुभानना
respell:
Parwatī Nandana Gajānanā
Pashupati Nandana Nirañjanā [ Parwatī Nandana ... ]
Pāhī Prabho Mām Pāhī Prasannā
Girijā Nandana Shubhānanā

title: Parvati Tanaya Vighna Vinashaka
lyrics:
Parvati Tanaya Vighna Vinashaka
Mangala Dayaka Deva
Jai Ganesh Jai Ganesh Jai Ganesh
Sindhoora Vadana Prathama Vandana
Alakha Niranjana Mooshika Vahana
Pashankushadhara Shambho Nandana
Mangala Dayaka Deva
Jai Ganesh Jai Ganesh Jai Ganesh
meaning: Victory to Lord Ganesha, the beloved son of Parvati and Shiva, who removes all obstacles and bestows auspiciousness. We bow to your vermillion face, the pure and unseen one, who rides a mouse and holds the noose and goad, always worshipped first.
devanagari:
पार्वती तानया सिद्धि विनायक
मंगल दायक देवा
जय गणेश जय गणेश जय गणेश
सिन्धुरा वदना प्रथम वंदना
अलक निरञ्जन मूषिक वाहन
पाशांकुश धर शम्भो नन्दन [ मंगल दायक ... ]
respell:
Pārwatī Tānayā Siddhi Vināyak
Maṅgal Dāyak Devā
Jay Gaṇesh Jay Gaṇesh Jay Gaṇesh
Sindhurā Vadanā Prathama Vandanā
Alak Nirañjana Mūshik Vāhan
Pāshāṅkush Dhara Shambho Nandana [ Maṅgal Dāyak ... ]

title: Pashupati Tanaya Bala Gajanana
lyrics:
Pashupati Tanaya Bala Gajanana
Tum Ho Vighna Vinasha Ganesha
Tum Ho Vighna Vinasha
He Shiva Nandana Bala Gajanana
Vidya Buddhi Pradata
Mangala Kara He Mangala Kara He
Sundara Sai Ganesha Ganesha
Sundara Sai Ganesha
meaning: O elephant-faced Lord Ganesha, the Beloved Son of Lord Shiva – the Master of all Beings. You are the One who removes all our obstacles. You are the elephant-faced darling child of Lord Shiva. You are the Bestower of Supreme Wisdom and Spiritual Discrimination. Do always be kind to us and shower on us auspiciousness. O Lord Sai! You are the Beautiful One!
devanagari:
पशुपति तनया बाल गजानन
तुम हो विघ्न विनाशा गणेशा
हे शिव नंदन बाल गजानन
विद्या बुद्धि प्रदाता
मंगल कर हे मंगल कर हे
सुंदर साई गणेशा गणेशा
respell:
Pashupati Tanayā Bāla Gajānana
Tum Ho Vighna Vināshā Gaṇeshā
He Shiv Nandana Bāla Gajānana
Vidyā Buddhi Pradātā
Maṅgal Kar He Maṅgal Kar He
Sundara Sāī Gaṇeshā Gaṇeshā

title: Patita Pavana Ram Parthipureeshwara Ram
lyrics:
Patita Pavana Ram 
Parthipureeshwara Ram
Pavana Nam Taraka Nam Papa Vimochana Ram
Danava Bhanjana Ram Dasharatha Nandana Ram
Pavana Nam Taraka Nam Papa Vimochana Ram
meaning: O Rama, purifier of the fallen and Lord of Parthi, Your sacred name is the ultimate redeemer, freeing us from all transgressions. You are the beloved son of Dasharatha, the mighty vanquisher of all demonic forces.
devanagari:
पतित पावन राम
पर्ती पूरीश्वर राम
पावन नाम तारक नाम पाप विमोचन राम [ पतित पावन ... ]
दानव भंजन राम दशरथ नंदन राम [ पावन नाम ... ]
respell:
Patita Pāvan Rām
Partī Pūrīshwar Rām
Pāvan Nām Tārak Nām Pāpa Vimochana Rām [ Patita Pāvan ... ]
Dānava Bhañjana Rām Dasharath Nandana Rām [ Pāvan Nām ... ]

title: Pavana Suta Hanuman Ki Jai
lyrics:
Pavana Suta Hanuman Ki Jai
Sitapati Ramachandra Ki Jai [ Pavana Suta.. ]
Parakrama Anjaneya Ki Jai (2)
Parthipuri Sai Nath Ki Jai (2)
meaning: Victory to Hanuman, the son of wind God, Victory to the chosen Lord of Sita, Lord Ram, Victory to the mighty son of Anjana Devi, Victory to the Lord of Parthi, Sai Nath.
devanagari:
पवन सुत हनुमान की जय  
सीता पति (सियावर) रामचन्द्र की जय [ पवन सुत ... ]  
पराक्रम अंजनेय की जय (2)  
पर्ति पुरी साईं नाथ की जय (2)
respell:
Pavan Sut Hanumān Kī Jay
Sītā Pati (siyāvar) Rāmachandra Kī Jay [ Pavan Sut ... ]
Parākram Añjaneya Kī Jay (2)
Parti Purī Sāīṃ Nāth Kī Jay (2)

title: Poorna Brahma Avatara Sai
lyrics:
Poorna Brahma Avatara Sai
Sakala Jagat Adhara Sai
Allah Yeshu Rama Sai
Buddha Mahavir Nanak Sai
Hum Bhakton Ke Baba Sai
Sarva Dharma Avatara Sai
meaning: Pray to Lord Sai, who is in complete form,who is the source of the entire universe, who is Allah, Yesu, Rama, Budhha, Mahavir, Nanak and who is the God of all the religions i.e he is Sarbadharma Avatara.
devanagari:
पूर्ण ब्रह्म अवतारा साई
सकल जगत आधारा साई
अल्लाह येशु रामा साई
बुद्ध महावीर नानक साई
हम भक्तों के बाबा साई
सर्व धर्म अवतारा साई
respell:
Pūrṇa Brahma Avatārā Sāī
Sakal Jagat Ādhārā Sāī
Allāh Yeshu Rāmā Sāī
Buddha Mahāvīr Nānak Sāī
Ham Bhaktoṃ Ke Bābā Sāī
Sarwa Dharma Avatārā Sāī

title: Prabhu Ramachandra Ke Doota Hanumanta Anjaneya
lyrics:
Prabhu Ramachandra Ke Doota Hanumanta Anjaneya
Hanumanta Hanumanta Hanumanta Anjaneya
Hey Pavan Putra Hanumanta Balabheema Anjaneya
Balabheema Balabheema Balabheema Anjaneya
meaning:
Chant the name of Hanuman who is also known as Anjaneya (son of Anjana Devi), the devout servent of Lord Rama.  
He is the son of wind God and mightiest of the mighty.
devanagari:
प्रभु रामचन्द्र के दूता हनुमन्ता आंजनेया  
हनुमन्ता हनुमन्ता हनुमन्ता आंजनेया  
हे पवन पुत्र हनुमन्ता बलभीमा आंजनेया  
बलभीमा बलभीमा बलभीमा आंजनेया
respell:
Prabhu Rāmachandra Ke Dūtā Hanumantā Āñjaneyā
Hanumantā Hanumantā Hanumantā Āñjaneyā
He Pavan Putra Hanumantā Balabhīmā Āñjaneyā
Balabhīmā Balabhīmā Balabhīmā Āñjaneyā

title: Pranam Sweekar Karo Sai Mahadeva
lyrics:
Pranam Sweekar Karo Sai Mahadeva
Sai Mahadeva Sai Mahadeva
Allah Eshwar Yeshu Sai
Buddha Mahavir Nanak Sai
Natana Sutradhari Jagannatha Sai
Sai Mahadeva Sai Mahadeva
meaning: Accept our salutations O Sai, the Lord of Gods, You are verily the Supreme One, be it Allah, Eshwar, Jesus, Buddha, Mahavira and Guru Nanak. You are the supreme Director and Lord of the world.
devanagari:
प्रणाम स्वीकर करो साई महादेवा 
साई महादेवा साई महादेवा [ प्रणाम स्वीकर ... ]  
अल्लाह ईश्वर येशु साई  
बुद्ध जोह्राष्ट्र महावीर साई  
नटन सूत्रधारी जगन्नाथ साई [ साई महादेव ... ]
respell:
Praṇām Swīkar Karo Sāī Mahādevā
Sāī Mahādevā Sāī Mahādevā [ Praṇām Swīkar ... ]
Allāh Īshwar Yeshu Sāī
Buddha Johrāshṭra Mahāvīr Sāī
Naṭana Sūtradhārī Jagannātha Sāī [ Sāī Mahādeva ... ]

title: Pranamami Sri Durge Sai Narayani
lyrics:
Pranamami Sri Durge Sai Narayani
Jaya Jagadambe Devi Bhavani
Jaya Mahishasura Samharini
Mahamaya Dukha Harini
meaning:
We offer our obeisance to Thee, Mother Durga, Narayani (Sister of Narayana), 
the Mother of the Universe, Goddess Bhavani, 
We offer our obeisance to Thee, Mother Durga, Narayani
Victory to Thee, the destroyer of demon Mahishasura 
Goddess Mahamaya (the primordial form of Nature), the remover of all miseries.
devanagari:
प्रणामामि श्री दुर्गे साई नारायणी
जय जगदम्बे देवी भवानी [ प्रणामामि श्री ... ]
जय महिषासुर संहारिणी
महामाया दुःख हारिणी
respell:
Praṇāmāmi Shrī Durge Sāī Nārāyaṇī
Jaya Jagadambe Devī Bhavānī [ Praṇāmāmi Shrī ... ]
Jaya Mahishāsur Saṃhāriṇī
Mahāmāyā Duḥkha Hāriṇī

title: Pranava Swaroopa Hari Om Sai
lyrics:
Pranava Swaroopa Hari Om Sai
Narayana Hari Om
Sathya Sayeeshwaraya Hari Om
Yadavaya Madhavaya Govindaya Namah Om
Paramatma Roopaya Hari Om
Hari Om Hari Om
Sathya Sayeeshwaraya Hari Om
meaning: O Lord Sathya Sai, you are the very embodiment of the Primordial sound ‘Om’. You are Narayana, the indweller of all beings. You are Krishna of the Yadava clan, one with Vishnu, the Lord of fortunes (Madhava), you are the protector of all beings, Govinda. The embodiment of the Supreme Soul, we pay our obeisance to you.
devanagari:
प्रणव स्वरूपा हरि ॐ साई
नारायणा हरि ॐ
सत्य साईश्वराय हरि ॐ
यादवाय माधवाय गोविंदाय नमः ॐ
परमात्म रूपाय हरि ॐ
हरि ॐ हरि ॐ
सत्य साईश्वराय हरि ॐ
respell:
Praṇava Swarūpā Hari Oṃ Sāī
Nārāyaṇā Hari Oṃ
Satya Sāīshwarāy Hari Oṃ
Yādavāy Mādhavāy Govindāya Namaḥ Oṃ
Paramātma Rūpāya Hari Oṃ
Hari Oṃ Hari Oṃ
Satya Sāīshwarāy Hari Oṃ

title: Pratah Smaranam Sri Ramam
lyrics:
Pratah Smaranam Sri Ramam
Munijana Sevita Sri Ramam [Pratah Smaranam]
Ananda Dayaka Sri Ramam
Moksha Pradayaka Sri Ramam
Bhajamana Sai Ramam Ramam
meaning: Chant the name of Lord Rama in the dawn, the Lord who is worshipped by the sages and noble souls, who bestows happiness and liberation. Chant the name of Lord Sai who is none other than Lord Rama.
devanagari:
प्रातः स्मरणम् श्री रामम्
मुनिजन सेवित श्री रामम् [प्रातः स्मरणम्]
आनन्द दायक श्री रामम्
मोक्ष प्रदायक श्री रामम्
भजमन साई रामम् रामम्
respell:
Prātaḥ Smaraṇam Shrī Rāmam
Munijana Sevit Shrī Rāmam [prātaḥ Smaraṇam]
Ānanda Dāyak Shrī Rāmam
Moksha Pradāyak Shrī Rāmam
Bhajamana Sāī Rāmam Rāmam

title: Pratah Smaranam Sri Guru Charanam
lyrics:
Prathah Smaranam Sri Guru Charanam
Sayeesha Charanam Sri Guru Charanam
Brahmananda Pradayaka Charanam
Sharanam Sharanam Sayeesha Charanam
meaning: Meditate on the Lotus Feet of the Guru in the early hours of dawn. Meditate on the Holy Feet of Sadguru Sai, the dispeller of ignorance. Surrender to the Lotus Feet of Sai who confers Supreme Bliss. We take refuge at Your Lotus Feet, O Lord Sai
devanagari:
प्रातः स्मरणम् श्री गुरु चरणम्
साईश चरणम् श्री गुरु चरणम् [ प्रातः स्मरणम् ... ]
ब्रह्मानन्द प्रदायक चरणम्
शरणम् शरणम् साईश चरणम्
respell:
Prātaḥ Smaraṇam Shrī Guru Charaṇam
Sāīsh Charaṇam Shrī Guru Charaṇam [ Prātaḥ Smaraṇam ... ]
Brahmānanda Pradāyak Charaṇam
Sharaṇam Sharaṇam Sāīsh Charaṇam

title: Prathama Sharana Gananayaka
lyrics:
Prathama Sharana Gananayaka
Prathah Smaranam Vinayaka
Parthi Pureeshwara Shubha Dayaka [ Prathama Sharana ... ]
Vidya Dayaka Hey Gananayaka
Buddhi Pradayaka Vinayaka
Mangala Kara Hey Prashanthi Dayaka
Parvathi Tanaya Vinayak
Prathah Smaranam Vinayaka [ Parthi Pureeshwara ... ]
devanagari:
प्रथमा शरणा गणनायका
प्रातः स्मरणं विनायका
पर्तीपूरीश्वर शुभा दायका [ प्रथमा शरणा ... ]
विद्या दायका हे गणनायका
बुद्धि प्रदायका विनायका
मंगला करा हे प्रशांति दायका
पार्वती तनया विनायक
प्रातः स्मरणं विनायका [ पर्तीपूरीश्वर ... ]
respell:
Prathamā Sharaṇā Gaṇanāyakā
Prātaḥ Smaraṇaṃ Vināyakā
Partīpūrīshwar Shubhā Dāyakā [ prathamā Sharaṇā ... ]
Vidyā Dāyakā He Gaṇanāyakā
Buddhi Pradāyakā Vināyakā
Maṅgalā Karā He Prashānti Dāyakā
Pārwatī Tanayā Vināyak
Prātaḥ Smaraṇaṃ Vināyakā [ Partīpūrīshwar ... ]

title: Prathama Sharana Gananayaka
lyrics:
Prathama Sharana Gananayaka
Vighna Vinashaka Siddhi Vinayaka [Prathama Sharana ..]
Vidya Dayaka Buddhi Pradayaka
Mooshika Vahana Pahi Gajanana
meaning:
First pay obeisance to the Lord of demigods, Lord Vinayaka who destroys obstacles and assures success in our endeavours.The One who grants knowledge (spiritual) and intelligence.
O Lord Gajanana who has mouse (wayward mind kept under His control) as his vehicle, please protect us!
devanagari:
प्रथम शरण गणनायका
विघ्न विनाशक सिद्धि विनायक [प्रथम शरण ..]
विद्या दायक बुद्धि प्रदायक
मूषिक वाहन पाहि गजानन
respell:
Prathama Sharaṇ Gaṇanāyakā
Vighna Vināshak Siddhi Vināyak [prathama Sharaṇ ..]
Vidyā Dāyak Buddhi Pradāyak
Mūshik Vāhan Pāhi Gajānana

title: Prathama Vandana Gananatha
lyrics:
Prathama Vandana Gananatha
Gajavadana Jaya Gananatha
Vidya Dayaka Buddhi Pradayaka
Vighna Vinashaka Vinayaka
Suramuni Vandita Vinayaka
meaning:
Our foremost salutations to the Lord of Ganas
O Elephant-faced Lord! Victory to Thee, the Master of all Celestial Beings.
O Lord! You are the Bestower of all knowledge and wisdom.
O Supreme Leader! You are the remover of all obstacles, and worshipped and adored by Saints and angels.
devanagari:
प्रथमा वंदना गणनाथा
गजवदना जय गणनाथा
विद्या दायक बुद्धि प्रदायक
विघ्न विनाशक विनायका
सुरमुनि वंदित विनायका
respell:
Prathamā Vandanā Gaṇanāthā
Gajavadanā Jaya Gaṇanāthā
Vidyā Dāyak Buddhi Pradāyak
Vighna Vināshak Vināyakā
Suramuni Vandita Vināyakā

title: Prathama Vandana Gauri Nandana
lyrics:
Prathama Vandana Gauri Nandana
Hey Shiva Nandana Pahi Gajanana
Eka Danta Gunavanta Vinayaka
Vighna Harana Shubha Mangala Charana
Pranava Swaroopa Pahi Gajanana
meaning: Foremost obeisance to Lord Ganesha, the beloved Prince of Lord Shiva and Mother Gowri. The One with out a leader, the single-tusked One of noble character, You are the remover of obstacles, the bestower of auspiciousness. We bow to You, the embodiment of Pranava (Omkar).
devanagari:
प्रथम वन्दना गौरी नन्दना
हे शिव नन्दना पाहि गजानना [ प्रथम वन्दना ... ]
एक दन्त गुणवान्त विनायक
विघ्न हरण शुभ मंगल चरणा
प्रणव स्वरूप पाहि ( साई ) गजानना
respell:
Prathama Vandanā Gaurī Nandanā
He Shiv Nandanā Pāhi Gajānanā [ Prathama Vandanā ... ]
Ek Danta Guṇavānta Vināyak
Vighna Haraṇ Shubh Maṅgal Charaṇā
Praṇava Swarūp Pāhi ( Sāī ) Gajānanā

title: Prema Bhakti Jagao Man Mein
lyrics:
Prema Bhakti Jagao Man Mein
Aao Mere Hriday Mein Baba
Tum Ho Deena Janon Ke Baba
Tum Ho Bhakta Janon Ke Sai
Aao Mere Hriday Mein Baba
meaning: Oh Baba, please enter my heart and ignite within me pure love and devotion. You are the refuge for the humble and the cherished guide for all your devotees.
devanagari:
प्रेम भक्ती जगाओ मन में
आओ मेरे हृदय में बाबा
तुम हो दीन जनों के बाबा
तुम हो भक्त जनों के साई
respell:
Prem Bhaktī Jagāo Man Meṃ
Āo Mere Hṛuday Meṃ Bābā
Tum Ho Dīna Janoṃ Ke Bābā
Tum Ho Bhakta Janoṃ Ke Sāī

title: Prem Eshwar Hain Eshwar Prem Hain
lyrics:
Prem Eshwar Hain Eshwar Prem Hain
Har Dhadkan Mein Sai Sama Hai Eshwar Prem Hain
Ram Rahim Krishna Karim
Zoroastra Yeshu Nanak
Koi Bhi Nam Japore Manuva Eshwar Prem Hain
meaning: God is Love; Love is God. Lord Sai is the indweller of the Heart and is the sustainer of each Heart beat, which repeats that God is Love. Oh Mind! worship any name of the Lord - Rama or Krishna, Rahim, Zoroaster, Jesus or Nanak, as all names and forms are love and only love."
devanagari:
प्रेम ईश्वर है ईश्वर प्रेम है
हर धड़कन में साईं समा है ईश्वर प्रेम है [ प्रेम ईश्वर ... ]
राम रहीम कृष्ण करीम
ज़ोहराष्ट्रा येशु नानक
कोई भी नाम जपो रे मनुवा ईश्वर प्रेम है (मनुवा)
respell:
Prem Īshwar Hai Īshwar Prem Hai
Har Dhaḍa़kan Meṃ Sāīṃ Samā Hai Īshwar Prem Hai [ Prem Īshwar ... ]
Rām Rahīm Kṛushṇa Karīm
ज़oharāshṭrā Yeshu Nānak
Koī Bhī Nām Japo Re Manuvā Īshwar Prem hai (manuvā)

title: Prem Se Bolo Ek Bar Sai Ram
lyrics:
Prem Se Bolo Ek Bar Sai Ram
Bolo Ram Sai Ram
Madhura Manohara Ram
Mohana Moorat Ram
He Karuna Sindho Ram
He Raghupati Raghava Ram
He Patita Pavana Ram
Bolo Ram Sai Ram
meaning: Chant the Holy name of Lord Sai Ram with Love. Chant the name of Lord Rama, of the Raghu dynasty who is charming and pleasing, the ocean of mercy and the saviour of the miserable and fallen.
devanagari:
प्रेम से बोलो एक बार साईं राम
बोलो राम साईं राम [ प्रेम से ... ]
मधुर मनोहर राम
हे मोहन मूर्त राम
हे करुणा सिंधु राम
हे रघुपति राघव राम
हे पतित पावन राम [ बोलो राम ... ]
respell:
Prem Se Bolo Ek Bār Sāīṃ Rām
Bolo Rām Sāīṃ Rām [ Prem Se ... ]
Madhura Manohar Rām
He Mohan Mūrt Rām
He Karuṇā Sindhu Rām
He Raghupati Rāghav Rām
He Patita Pāvan Rām [ Bolo Rām ... ]

title: Prem Se Gao Mangala Nam
lyrics:
Prem Se Gao Mangala Nam
Govinda Gopala Bolo Hari Nam
Prem Ke Sindho Deena Ke Bandho
Karunamaya Sai Nayanabhi Rama
Govinda Gopala Bolo Hari Nam
--
Harey Krishna Harey Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram
Sai Ram Sai Ram
Harey Krishna Harey Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram
meaning: Joyfully chant the sacred names of the divine, including Govinda, Gopala, and Hari. This compassionate Lord Sai, an ocean of love and friend to the humble, is a beautiful sight to behold, inspiring continuous remembrance of Krishna, Ram, and Sai Ram.
devanagari:
प्रेम से गाओ मंगल नाम
गोविन्द गोपाल बोलो हरि नाम
प्रेम के सिंधु दीना के बंधू
करुणामय साई नयनाभि राम [ गोविन्द गोपाल ... ]
---
हरे कृष्ण हरे राम साई राम साई राम (3)  
साई राम साई राम (3)  
हरे कृष्ण हरे राम साई राम साई राम
respell:

Govinda Gopāla Bolo Hari Nām

---
Hare Kṛushṇa Hare Rām Sāī Rām Sāī Rām (3)
Sāī Rām Sāī Rām (3)
Hare Kṛushṇa Hare Rām Sāī Rām Sāī Rām

title: Prem Se Gao Pavana Nam
lyrics:
Prem Se Gao Pavana Nam
Rama Rama Raghu Nandana Rama
Jaya Jaya Rama Jaya Raghu Rama
Jaya Sai Rama Jaya Sathya Nama
meaning: With Love sing the purifying and uplifting name of Lord Rama of the Raghu dynasty. Victory to Lord of Janaki, Victory to Lord Sathya Sai.
devanagari:
प्रेम से गाओ पावन नाम
राम राम रघु नंदन रामा [ प्रेम से ... ]
जय जय रामा जय रघु रामा
जय साई रामा जय सत्य नामा
respell:
Prem Se Gāo Pāvan Nām
Rām Rām Raghu Nandana Rāmā [ Prem Se ... ]
Jaya Jaya Rāmā Jaya Raghu Rāmā
Jaya Sāī Rāmā Jaya Satya Nāmā

title: Prema Maya Bhagawan Sai Ram
lyrics:
Prema Maya Bhagawan Sai Ram
Karunamaya Sai Rama Rama Rama Ram
He Dukhabhanjana Palanhare
He Leelamaya Apadsahare
Sharan Mein Lelo Sai Rama Rama Rama Ram
meaning: Oh Lord Sai Ram, You are the very embodiment of divine love and boundless compassion, the playful one who dispels all sorrow and sustains us. We earnestly seek Your shelter, our ultimate support in distress; please take us into Your loving embrace.
devanagari:
प्रेम मया भगवान साई राम
करुणामया साई राम राम राम राम
हे दुःखभंजन पालनहारे
हे लीलामय आपद्सहारे
शरण में लेलो साई राम राम राम राम
respell:
Prem Mayā Bhagavān Sāī Rām
Karuṇāmayā Sāī Rām Rām Rām Rām
He Duḥkhabhañjana Pālanahāre
He Līlāmaya Āpadsahāre
Sharaṇ Meṃ Lelo Sāī Rām Rām Rām Rām

title: Prema Mudita Manase Kaho
lyrics:
Prema Mudita Manase Kaho Rama Rama Ram Rama Rama Ram Rama Rama Ram Sri Rama Rama Ram
Papa Kate Dukha Mite Lete Rama Nam
Bhava Samudra Sukhada Nava Ek Rama Nam
Parama Shanti Sukha Nidhana Divya Rama Nam
Niradhara Ko Adhara Ek Rama Nam
Parama Gopya Parama Divya Mantra Rama Nam
Sant Hrudaya Sada Vasata Ek Rama Nam
Mata Pita Bandhu Sakha Sab Hi Rama Nam
Bhakta Janara Jeevana Dhana Ek Rama Nam
--
Rama Rama Ram Rama Rama Ram Rama Rama Ram
Sri Rama Rama Ram
meaning:
With a heart filled with love, say Rama's name - Shree Rama’s name
Taking Rama's name destroys sins and removes sorrows; Rama's name is the comfortable boat with which the ocean of life can be crossed
Rama's divine name bestows highest peace; His name is the support to those who have no support
Rama’s name is mother, father, relation, friend and everything; it’s life's treasure for all devotees.
Chant the name – Rama Rama Ram!
devanagari:
प्रेम मुदित मनसे कहो राम राम राम राम राम राम राम राम राम श्री राम राम राम
पाप कटे दुख मिटे लेत राम नाम
भव समुद्र सुखद नाव एक राम नाम
परम शान्ति सुख निधान दिव्य राम नाम
निराधार को आधार एक राम नाम
परम गोप्य परम दिव्य मन्त्र राम नाम
सन्त हृदय सदा वसत एक राम नाम
माता पिता बन्धु सखा सब ही राम नाम
भक्त जनर जीवन धन एक राम नाम

राम राम राम राम राम राम राम राम राम
श्री राम राम राम
respell:

Bhava Samudra Sukhad Nāva Ek Rām Nām

Nirādhāra Ko Ādhāra Ek Rām Nām
Param Gopya Param Divya Mantra Rām Nām
Sant Hṛudaya Sadā Vasat Ek Rām Nām
Mātā Pitā Bandhu Sakhā Sab Hī Rām Nām
Bhakta Janara Jīvan Dhana Ek Rām Nām

Rām Rām Rām Rām Rām Rām Rām Rām Rām
Shrī Rām Rām Rām

title: Prema Sai Parthi Sai
lyrics:
Prema Sai Parthi Sai
Pavana Sai Parama Guru Sai
Mangala Kara Karuna Sai
Karuna Sai Karuna Sai (Not Sung in the audio)
Madhura Madhura Hrudaya Nivasi
Murali Gana Vilola Sai
meaning: Protect us, Lord Sai. You are the form of light, protecting all three worlds. You are the worship, you are the song. You are the beginning and end. You are the Lord of all. You are my Lord.
devanagari:
प्रेम साई पर्ती साई
पावन साई परम गुरु साई
मंगल कर करुणा साई
करुणा साई करुणा साई
मथुरा मधुरा हृदय निवासी
मुरली गान विलोल साई
respell:
Prem Sāī Partī Sāī
Pāvan Sāī Param Guru Sāī
Maṅgal Kar Karuṇā Sāī
Karuṇā Sāī Karuṇā Sāī
Mathurā Madhurā Hṛudaya Nivāsī
Muralī Gān Vilol Sāī

title: Premaswaroopini Janani Ma
lyrics:
Premaswaroopini Janani Ma
Charana Namostute Sai Ma
Jagadambe Krupakari Sai Ma
Karunamayi Janani Sai Ma
Tribhuvana Palini Sai Ma
Charana Namostute Sai Ma
meaning: O Mother Sai, you embody divine love and are the nurturing Mother of all creation. We offer our humble reverence at your sacred feet, seeking your boundless grace and compassion as the benevolent protector of the three worlds.
devanagari:
प्रेमा स्वरूपिणी जननी मा  
चरण नमोस्तुते साई मा [ प्रेमा स्वरूपिणी ... ]  
जगदांबे कृपाकरी साई मा  
करुणामयी जननी साई मा  
त्रिभुवन पालिनी साई मा [ चरण नमोस्तुते ... ]
respell:
Premā Swarūpiṇī Jananī Mā
Charaṇ Namostute Sāī Mā [ Premā Swarūpiṇī ... ]
Jagadāmbe Kṛupākarī Sāī Mā
Karuṇāmayī Jananī Sāī Mā
Tribhuvan Pālinī Sāī Mā [ Charaṇ Namostute ... ]

title: Prema Mayi Sai Ma Jnana Mayi Sai Ma
lyrics:
Prema Mayi Sai Ma Jnana Mayi Sai Ma
Jaya Ma Jaya Ma Jaya Ma
Shiva Shakti Roopini Sai Ma Moksha Pradayini Ma
Jaya Ma Jaya Ma (2)
Jaya Ma Jaya Ma Jaya Ma
meaning: O Mother Sai! You are the embodiment of love, wisdom and bliss. Victory to Thee, Mother Sai! Sai is the embodiment of Lord Shiva and Shakthi in one and is ever remaining in a state of bliss. She is the Supreme Consciousness incarnate and grants liberation.
devanagari:
प्रेमामयी साई माँ ज्ञानमयी साई माँ
जय माँ जय माँ जय माँ
शिव शक्ति रूपिणी साई माँ मोक्ष प्रदायिनी माँ
जय माँ जय माँ जय माँ
जय माँ जय माँ जय माँ
respell:

Jaya Mām̐ Jaya Mām̐ jaya mām̐
Jaya Mām̐ Jaya Mām̐ Jaya Mām̐

title: Premamrita Barsao Baba
lyrics:
Premamrita Barsao Baba
Daya Karo Bhagawan
Kripa Karo Bhagawan
Tumhari Daya Bin Kaisa Jeevan
Rom Rom Mein Basnewale Ram
Janam Maran Se Par Utaro
Daya Karo Bhagawan
Krupa Karo Bhagawan
meaning: O Divine One, pour forth your loving grace and compassion upon me, as life feels adrift without your mercy. You dwell within every cell of my being, and I implore you to lead me past the cycle of birth and death.
devanagari:
प्रेमामृत बरसाओ बाबा
दया करो भगवान
कृपा करो भगवान
तुम्हारी दया बिन कैसा जीवन
रोम रोम में बसनेवाले राम
जनम मरण से पार उठाओ
दया करो भगवान [ कृपा करो ... ]
respell:
Premāmṛuta Barasāo Bābā
Dayā Karo Bhagavān
Kṛupā Karo Bhagavān
Tumhārī Dayā Bin Kaisā Jīvan
Rom Rom Meṃ Basanevāle Rām
Janama Maraṇ Se Pār Uṭhāo
Dayā Karo Bhagavān [ Kṛupā Karo ... ]

title: Punya Nam Pavitra Nam Ram Nam Sai Ram
lyrics:
Punya Nam Pavitra Nam Ram Nam Sai Ram
Hare Krishna Hare Ram Madhura Nam Sai Ram
Karuna Sindhu Sita Ram Deena Bandhu Radhe Shyam
Hare Krishna Hare Ram Madhura Nam Sai Ram
meaning:
How purifying, how meritorious, the name of Lord Rama! Our Sai Rama! 
Krishna, Rama, Sai – all names so divine! So nectarine! 
How purifying, how meritorious, the name of Lord Rama! Our Sai Rama! 
Lord Rama, the ocean of Compassion! Lord Krishna, the refuge of the forlorn! 
Krishna, Rama, Sai – all names so divine! So nectarine!
devanagari:
पुण्य नाम पवित्र नाम राम नाम साई राम
हरे कृष्ण हरे राम मधुर नाम साई राम
[ पुण्य नाम ... ]
करुणा सिंधु सीता राम दीन बंधु राधे श्याम
[ हरे कृष्ण ... ]
respell:

[ Puṇya Nām ... ]

[ Hare Kṛushṇa ... ]

title: Purandara Ranga Hare Vitthala
lyrics:
Purandara Ranga Hare Vitthala
Pandhari Ranga Hare Vitthala
Narahari Ranga Hare Vitthala
Murahara Ranga Hare Vitthala
meaning: Chant the name of Vitthala, the Lord worshipped by Saint Purandara Dasa. Glory to Vitthala, the Lord of Pandarpur. Glory to the One who slayed the demon Mura and the One who has taken human form
devanagari:
पुरंदर रंगा हरे विट्ठला
पंढरी रंगा हरे विट्ठला [ पुरंदर रंगा ... ]
नरहरी रंगा हरे विट्ठला
मुरहर रंगा हरे विट्ठला
respell:

title: Rasa Vilola Nandalala
lyrics:
Rasa Vilola Nandalala
Radha Madhava Nandalala
Nanda Kishora Nandalala
Navaneeta Chora Nandalala
--
Nandalala Sai Nandalala
meaning: Chant the name of the son of Nanda, Lord Krishna, who is fond of the Raasa leela (divine folk dance with Gopis). The Lord of Radha, is the one who steals the hearts of devotees. CHECK
devanagari:
रासा विलोला नंदलाला
राधा माधव नंदलाला [ रास विलोल ... ]
नंद किशोरा नंदलाला
नवनीता चोरा नंदलाला
नंदलाला साई नंदलाला (2)
respell:

Nanda Kishorā Nandalālā

title: Radha Ke Natavaralal Kanhaiya
lyrics:
Radha Ke Natavaralal Kanhaiya
Gokula Bala Goparipala [Radha Ke ..]
Nanda Kumara Rasa Vilola
Meera Ke Prabhu Nanda Lal Kanhaiya
meaning: Lord Krishna, the Lord of Radha and Meera, The child of Gokula, is the sustainer of all beings. The darling son of Nanda, Lord Krishna, is fond of the Rasa leela (divine dance depicting the ecstacy of the union of the individual souls with the Supreme One).
devanagari:
राधा के नटवर लाल कन्हैया
गोकुल बाला गोपरिपाला [ राधा के ... ]
नंद कुमार रासा विलोला
मीरा के प्रभु नंद लाल कन्हैया
respell:
Rādhā Ke Naṭavar Lāl Kanhaiyā
Gokul Bālā Goparipālā [ Rādhā Ke ... ]
Nanda Kumāra Rāsā Vilolā
Mīrā Ke Prabhu Nanda Lāl Kanhaiyā

title: Radha Krishna Karuna Lola Radhe Govinda
lyrics:
Radha Krishna Karuna Lola Radhe Govinda
Radhe Govinda Murali Govinda
Radhe Radhe Govinda Murali Govinda
meaning: Chant the name of Krishna the compassionate Lord of Radha, the cowherd boy, the one who plays the enchanting flute.
devanagari:
राधा कृष्ण करुणा लोला राधे गोविन्दा
राधे गोविन्दा मुरली गोविन्दा
राधे राधे गोविन्दा मुरली गोविन्दा
respell:

Rādhe Govindā Muralī Govindā
Rādhe Rādhe Govindā Muralī Govindā

title: Radha Madhava Madana Gopala
lyrics:
Radha Madhava Madana Gopala
Nanda Mukunda Natavara Lala
Mathura Natha Deena Dayala
Sai Govinda Giridhara Bala
meaning: Oh Krishna, beloved of Radha, enchanting cowherd and son of Nanda, you are the divine dancer who grants liberation. Lord of Mathura, you show boundless compassion to the humble, and as Sai Govinda, you are the child who lifted the mountain.
devanagari:
राधा माधव मदन गोपाला
नंद मुकुंदा नटवर लाला [ राधा माधव ... ]
मथुरा नाथा दीना दयाला
साई गोविन्दा गिरिधर बाला
respell:

Nanda Mukundā Naṭavar Lālā [ Rādhā Mādhava ... ]
Mathurā Nāthā Dīnā Dayālā
