title: Radha Pyare Jaya Gopal
lyrics:
Radha Pyare Jaya Gopal
Radha Madhava Jaya Gopal
Brindavan Ke Jaya Gopal
Murali Manohara Jaya Gopal
----
Jaya Gopal Jaya Gopal
meaning: Victory to the Beloved Lord of Radha, the Universal Protector. Victory to the Lord of Brindavan. Victory to the Most Beautiful One with the flute on His lips.
devanagari:
राधा प्यारे जय गोपाल
राधा माधव जय गोपाल
वृन्दावन के जय गोपाल
मुरली मनोहर जय गोपाल
----
जय गोपाल जय गोपाल (x५)
respell:
Rādhā Pyāre Jaya Gopāl
Rādhā Mādhava Jaya Gopāl
Vṛundāvan Ke Jaya Gopāl
Muralī Manohar Jaya Gopāl
----
Jaya Gopāl Jaya Gopāl (x5)

title: Radha Radha Gokula Bala
lyrics:
Radha Radha Gokula Bala
Nanda Nanda Mukunda Gopala
Navaneeta Chora Shyama Gopala
Radha Madhava Rasa Vilola
meaning: Oh Krishna, beloved of Radha, the divine child of Gokula! You are Nanda's dear son, Mukunda Gopala, the charming dark-hued butter thief. You are Radha's Madhava, who revels in the enchanting Rasa dance.
devanagari:
राधा राधा गोकुला बाला
नन्दा नन्द मुकुन्द गोपाला
नवनीत चोरा श्याम गोपाला
राधा माधव रास विलोला
respell:
Rādhā Rādhā Gokulā Bālā
Nandā Nanda Mukunda Gopālā
Navanīta Chorā Shyām Gopālā
Rādhā Mādhava Rās Vilolā

title: Radha Radha Radhakrishna Radha
lyrics:
Radha Radha Radhakrishna Radha
Radhakrishna Radha
Radha Radha Radhakrishna Radha
meaning: Radha, Radha, Radhakrishna, Radha! We lovingly invoke your sacred names, O divine beloveds. Our hearts are filled with the sweet remembrance of Radha and Krishna.
devanagari:
राधा राधा राधाकृष्ण राधा
राधाकृष्ण राधा
राधा राधा राधाकृष्ण राधा
respell:
Rādhā Rādhā Rādhākṛushṇa Rādhā
Rādhākṛushṇa Rādhā
Rādhā Rādhā Rādhākṛushṇa Rādhā

title: Radhe Radhe Brindavana Radhe
lyrics:
Radhe Radhe Brindavana Radhe
Govinda Gopala Nache Radhe
Radhe Radhe Madhura Murali Baje
Nanda Kishora Ki Payal Baje
Ruma Jhuma Ruma Jhuma Payal Baje
meaning: O Radha of Brindavana, dance in the name of Gopala and Govinda - the names of Lord Krishna, the son of Nanda, the one who plays the Flute sweetly. May the anklets of His and all those who dance in His name ring melodiously.
devanagari:
राधे राधे वृंदावन राधे
गोविंद गोपाल नाचे राधे
राधे राधे मधुर मुरली बाजे
नंद किशोर की पायल बाजे
रुम झुम रुम झुम पायल बाजे
respell:
Rādhe Rādhe Vṛundāvan Rādhe
Govind Gopāla Nāche Rādhe
Rādhe Rādhe Madhura Muralī Bāje
Nanda Kishor Kī Pāyal Bāje
Rum Jhuma Rum Jhuma Pāyal Bāje

title: Radhe Govinda Gopala Jaya Govinda Radhe Gopala
lyrics:
Radhe Govinda Gopala Jaya Govinda Radhe Gopala
Govinda Govinda Gopala
Krishna Madhusudana Madhusudana Krishna
Govinda Govinda Gopala
Sai Govinda Govinda Gopala
meaning: Chant the names of Lord Gopala, Krishna, the one who tends to cows, Lord of Radha. Repeat the names incessantly of Krishna, who slayed the demon Madhu
devanagari:
राधे गोविन्द गोपाला जय गोविन्द राधे गोपाला
गोविन्द गोविन्द गोपाला (2) [ राधे गोविन्द ... ]
कृष्णा मधुसूदना मधुसूदना कृष्णा
गोविन्द गोविन्द गोपाला (साई)
respell:
Rādhe Govinda Gopālā Jaya Govinda Rādhe Gopālā
Govinda Govinda Gopālā (2) [ Rādhe Govinda ... ]
Kṛushṇā Madhusūdanā Madhusūdanā Kṛushṇā
Govinda Govinda Gopālā (sāī)

title: Radhey Govinda Jai Jai Radhey
lyrics:
Radhey Govinda Jai Jai Radhey Gopala
Deena Natha Govinda Anatha Natha Gopala [ Radhey Govinda ... ]
Radha Lola Govinda Raasa Vilola Gopala
Govinda Jaya Govinda Gopala Sai Gopala
meaning: O Govinda, beloved of Radha, glory to you, O Gopala! You are the compassionate Lord of the downtrodden and the protector of the forsaken. Enchanted by Radha, you joyfully revel in the divine Raas Leela.
devanagari:
राधे गोविंदा जय जय राधे गोपाला
दीनानाथा  गोविंदा अनाथनाथा गोपाला [ राधे गोविंदा ... ]
राधा लोला गोविंदा रास विलोला गोपाला
गोविंदा जय गोविंदा गोपाला जय गोपाला
respell:
Rādhe Govindā Jay Jay Rādhe Gopālā
Dīnānāthā  Govindā Anāthanāthā Gopālā [ Rādhe govindā ... ]
Rādhā Lolā Govindā Rās Vilolā Gopālā
Govindā Jaya Govindā Gopālā Jay Gopālā

title: Radhe Govinda Krishna Murari
lyrics:
Radhe Govinda Krishna Murari
Sathya Sai Mukunda Murari
Nanda Ananda Radhe Govinda
Radhe Govinda Sai Mukunda
Sathya Sai Mukunda Murari
meaning: O blue-complexioned Lord Govinda, beloved of Radha! You are the destroyer of the demon Mura. Victory to You Lord Sai, who bestows liberation. Victory to the blissful son of Nanda, the Lord of Radha, protector of all beings.
devanagari:
राधे गोविन्द कृष्ण मुरारी
जय (सत्य) साई मुकुंद मुरारी [ राधे गोविन्द ... ]
नंदा आनंदा राधे गोविन्दा
राधे गोविन्दा साई मुकुंदा
सत्य साई मुकुंद मुरारी
respell:
Rādhe Govinda Kṛushṇa Murārī
Jaya (satya) Sāī Mukund Murārī [ Rādhe Govinda ... ]
Nandā Ānandā Rādhe Govindā
Rādhe Govindā Sāī Mukundā
Satya Sāī Mukund Murārī

title: Radhe Govinda Radhe Gopala Sai Ram
lyrics:
Radhe Govinda Radhe Gopala Sai Ram
Bansidhara Bansidhara He Chittachora
He Natavara He Natavara Nanda Kishora
Ghanashyama Sundara Meghashyama Sundara Sai Ram
meaning: Oh Govinda, Gopala, beloved of Radha, and divine Sai Ram, You are the enchanting flute-player who steals our hearts. Beautiful Son of Nanda, supreme dancer, Your dark complexion is like a magnificent rain cloud, captivating all.
devanagari:
राधे गोविन्द राधे गोपाल साई राम
बंसिधरा बंसिधरा हे चिता चोरा
हे नटवरा हे नटवर नंद किशोरा
घन श्याम सुंदर मेघ श्याम सुंदर साई राम
respell:
Rādhe Govinda Rādhe Gopāla Sāī Rām
Baṃsidharā Baṃsidharā He Chitā Chorā
He Naṭavarā He Naṭavar Nanda Kishorā
Ghan Shyām Sundara Megha Shyām Sundara Sāī Rām

title: Radhe Krishna Radhe Krishna Jai Sri Krishna Radhe Radhe
lyrics:
Radhe Krishna Radhe Krishna Jai Sri Krishna Radhe Radhe
Radhe Krishna Radhe Radhe
Jai Sri Krishna Radhe Radhe
Shirdi Krishna Parthi Krishna Sai Krishna Radhe Radhe
Radhe Krishna Radhe Krishna Jai Sri Krishna Radhe Radhe
Radhe Krishna Radhe Radhe
Jai Sri Krishna Radhe Radhe
meaning: Repeat the Names of Radhe Krishna, O Shirdi Krishna and Parthi Krishna! Victory be to Sai Krishna!
devanagari:
राधे कृष्णा राधे कृष्णा जय श्री कृष्णा राधे राधे (2)
राधे कृष्णा राधे राधे
जय श्री कृष्णा राधे राधे
शिर्डी कृष्णा पर्ति कृष्णा साईं कृष्णा राधे राधे
राधे कृष्णा राधे कृष्ण जय श्री कृष्णा राधे राधे
राधे कृष्णा राधे राधे [ जय श्री ... ]
respell:
Rādhe Kṛushṇā Rādhe Kṛushṇā Jay Shrī Kṛushṇā Rādhe Rādhe (2)
Rādhe Kṛushṇā Rādhe Rādhe
Jay Shrī Kṛushṇā Rādhe Rādhe
Shirḍī Kṛushṇā Parti Kṛushṇā Sāīṃ Kṛushṇā Rādhe Rādhe
Rādhe Kṛushṇā Rādhe Kṛushṇa Jay Shrī Kṛushṇā Rādhe Rādhe
Rādhe Kṛushṇā Rādhe Rādhe [ Jay Shrī ... ]

title: Radhe Radhe Radhe Radhe Govinda
lyrics:
Radhe Radhe Radhe Radhe Govinda
Hey Radhe Gopala
Radhe Govinda Bhajo Radhe Gopala (2) [Radhe Radhe..]
Murali Manohara Govinda Hey Madhava Murahara Govinda (2)
meaning: Oh Radha, oh Govinda, we ceaselessly call upon your divine names. We worship you, Gopala, the enchanting flute player, Madhava, the slayer of the demon Mura.
devanagari:
राधे राधे राधे राधे गोविंदा
हे राधे गोपाला
राधे गोविन्द भजो राधे गोपाला (2) [ राधे राधे ... ]
मुरली मनोहरा गोविंदा हे माधव मुरहारा गोविंदा (2)
respell:
Rādhe Rādhe Rādhe Rādhe Govindā
He Rādhe Gopālā
Rādhe Govinda Bhajo Rādhe Gopālā (2) [ Rādhe Rādhe ... ]
Muralī Manoharā Govindā He Mādhava Murahārā Govindā (2)

title: Radhe Shyam Panduranga Vitthale Rakhumayi
lyrics:
Radhe Shyam Panduranga Vitthale Rakhumayi
Panduranga Purandhara Vitthale Rakhumayi
meaning: Oh Panduranga Vitthala, beloved Shyam of Radha, we lovingly invoke your sacred name. With your divine consort Rakhumayi, you are the supreme Lord, the very heart of devotion.
devanagari:
राधे श्याम पांडुरंग विट्ठले हे रखुमाई
पांडुरंग पुरंदर विट्ठले हे रखुमाई
राधे श्याम पांडुरंग विट्ठले हे रखुमाई (2) [ पांडुरंग ... ]
respell:
Rādhe Shyām Pāṇḍuraṅg Viṭṭhale He rakhumāī
Pāṇḍuraṅg Purandara Viṭṭhale He rakhumāī
Rādhe Shyām Pāṇḍuraṅg Viṭṭhale He rakhumāī (2) [ pāṇḍuraṅg ... ]

title: Radhe Shyama Radhe Shyama Radhe Gopala
lyrics:
Radhe Shyama Radhe Shyama Radhe Gopala
Jaya Madhava Jaya Keshava Jaya Muraliganalola
Pandarinatha Parama Dayala
Parthipureesha Sai Deva
Jaya Madhava Jaya Keshava Jaya Muraliganalola
meaning: O Radha's beloved Shyam, O Gopala, we hail your divine forms, Madhava and Keshava, who delight in the enchanting music of the flute. You are the supremely compassionate Lord of Pandhari and the divine Sai, ruler of Parthi.
devanagari:
राधे श्याम राधे श्याम राधे गोपाला  
जय माधव जय केशव जय मुरली गाना लोला [ राधे श्याम ... ]  
पंढरी नाथ परम दयाला  
पर्ति पूरीशा साई देव [ जय माधव ... ]
respell:
Rādhe Shyām Rādhe Shyām Rādhe Gopālā
Jaya Mādhava Jaya Keshav Jaya Muralī Gānā Lolā [ Rādhe Shyām ... ]
Paṇḍharī Nātha Param Dayālā
Parti Pūrīshā Sāī Deva [ Jaya Mādhava ... ]

title: Radhe Shyama He Ghanashyama
lyrics:
Radhe Shyama He Ghanashyama
Radha Madhava Mangala Dhama
Jaya Jaya Jaya Hey Megha Shyama
Megha Shyama Megha Shyama
Jaya Jaya Jaya Brindavana Dhama
meaning: This bhajan calls out to Krishna, the dark-hued beloved of Radha, whose divine form is likened to a rain cloud. It celebrates Him as the auspicious Lord and glorious master of Vrindavan, offering Him repeated praise and adoration.
devanagari:
राधे श्यामा हे घन श्यामा
राधा माधव मंगल धामा [ राधे श्यामा ... ]
जय जय जय हे मेघ श्यामा
मेघ श्यामा मेघ श्यामा [ जय जय ... ]
जय जय जय वृंदावन धामा
respell:
Rādhe Shyāmā He Ghan Shyāmā
Rādhā Mādhava Maṅgal Dhāmā [ Rādhe Shyāmā ... ]
Jaya Jaya Jaya He Megha Shyāmā
Megha Shyāmā Megha Shyāmā [ Jaya Jaya ... ]
Jaya Jaya Jaya Vṛundāvan Dhāmā

title: Radhika Jeevana
lyrics:
Radhika Jeevana
Krishna Janardana
Radhe Govinda Radhe Gopala
Devaki Nandana
Nanda Nandana He Gopika Ranjana
Murali Mohana
Sri Madhusudana
Krishna Krishna Sri Madhusudana
meaning:
Sing the praises of Lord Krishna, the very soul of His devotee (Radha)
Krishna, the one adored by everyone , the darling son of Nanda, the enchanter of the Gopikas with His divine flute. He is the slayer of the demon,Madhu.
devanagari:
राधिका जीवन
कृष्ण जनार्दन
राधे गोविन्द राधे गोपाल
देवकी नंदन
[ राधिका ... ]
नंद नंदन हे गोपिका रञ्जना
मुरली मोहन
श्री मधुसूदन (कृष्ण कृष्ण)
respell:
Rādhikā Jīvan
Kṛushṇa Janārdana
Rādhe Govinda Rādhe Gopāla
Devakī Nandana
[ Rādhikā ... ]
Nanda Nandana He Gopikā Rañjanā
Muralī Mohan
Shrī Madhusūdana (kṛushṇa Kṛushṇa)

title: Raghava Raghu Nandana
lyrics:
Raghava Raghu Nandana
Madhava Madhusudana
Rajeeva Dala Lochana Shyama Bansi Mohana
Donon Hi Nam Hai Ananda Dham
meaning: Sing the glory of Raghava, the scion of Raghu dynasty, Lord Rama. He is also the sweet Lord Krishna who slayed demonic force Madhu. He is the lotus-eyed and dark-hued one, who enchants us with His flute. Both the names, Ram and Shyam grant liberation and bliss
devanagari:
राघवा रघु नन्दना
माधवा मधुसूदना
राजीव दल लोचना श्यामा बंसी मोहना
दोनों ही नाम है आनन्द धामा
respell:
Rāghavā Raghu Nandanā
Mādhavā Madhusūdanā
Rājīva Dala Lochanā Shyāmā Baṃsī Mohanā
Donoṃ Hī Nām Hai Ānanda Dhāmā

title: Raghava Rama Raghuveera
lyrics:
Raghava Rama Raghuveera
Sridhara Madhava Govinda [Raghava Rama]
Keshava Madhava Madhusudana
Achyuta Ananta Narayana
Gopiya Lola Gopala
meaning: Oh Rama, valiant hero of the Raghu lineage, we invoke your sacred name. We remember Krishna, the beloved of Lakshmi, the protector of all, who vanquished the demon Madhu. You are the unfailing, infinite Narayana, the darling Gopala cherished by the Gopis.
devanagari:
राघवा रामा रघुवीरा
श्रीधरा माधवा गोविंदा [राघवा रामा]
केशवा माधवा मधुसूदना
अच्युता अनंता नारायणा
गोपिय लोला गोपाला
respell:
Rāghavā Rāmā Raghuvīrā
Shrīdharā Mādhavā Govindā [rāghavā Rāmā]
Keshavā Mādhavā Madhusūdanā
Achyutā Anantā Nārāyaṇā
Gopiya Lolā Gopālā

title: Raghava Sundara Rama Raghuvara
lyrics:
Raghava Sundara Rama Raghuvara
Parama Pavana Hey Jaga Vandana
Patitodharana Bhakta Parayana
Ravana Mardana Vighna Bhanjana
Parthipureeshwara Sai Narayana
meaning: O beautiful Rama, best of the Raghu clan, supremely pure and revered by all creation. You are the uplifter of the fallen, the ultimate refuge for devotees, who vanquished Ravana and shatters all obstacles. We invoke you, Lord Sai Narayana, divine ruler of Parthi.
devanagari:
राघव सुन्दर राम रघुवर
परम पावना हे जग वन्दन [ राघव सुन्दर ... ]
पतितोद्धारण भक्त परायण
रावण मर्धन विघ्न भंजन
पर्तिपूरीश्वर साई नारायण
respell:
Rāghav Sundara Rām Raghuvar
Param Pāvanā He Jaga Vandana [ Rāghav Sundara ... ]
Patitoddhāraṇ Bhakta Parāyaṇ
Rāvaṇ Mardhana Vighna Bhañjana
Partipūrīshwar Sāī Nārāyaṇ

title: Raghu Nandana Raghava Rama Hare
lyrics:
Raghu Nandana Raghava Rama Hare
Hey Janaki Jeevana Rama Hare
Hey Rajeeva Lochana Rama Hare
Sri Rama Hare Sai Rama Hare
Hey Rajeeva Lochana Rama Hare
meaning: Worship Lord Rama of Raghu Dynasty. Worship the lotus-eyed Lord Rama, who is the very life-breath of Mother Sita. Sai Rama who is verily Lord Rama, we sing Your praises.
devanagari:
रघु नंदन राघव राम हरे
हे जानकी जीवन राम हरे
हे राजीव लोचन राम हरे
श्री राम हरे साई राम हरे (5)
respell:
Raghu Nandana Rāghav Rām Hare
He Jānakī Jīvan Rām Hare
He Rājīva Lochana Rām Hare
Shrī Rām Hare Sāī Rām Hare (5)

title: Raghukula Bhushana Rajeeva Nayana
lyrics:
ALAP
Ramaya Ramabhadraya Ramachandraya Vedase
Raghunathaya Nathaya Sitaya Pataye Namaha

Raghukula Bhushana Rajeeva Nayana
Eshwaramba Nandana Sathya Sai Rama
Janaki Vallabha Lavanya Rama
Nirupama Sundara Sugunabhi Rama
Prasanthi Nilaya Pavana Dhama
Jaya Jaya Rama Prabhu Sai Rama
meaning: Glory to the jewel of the Raghu Dynasty, the Lotus-eyed Lord Rama. He is the darling son of Mother Eshwaramba, Lord Sathya Sai Rama. The beloved of Janaki (Sita), exquisitely handsome Lord Rama, who is beautifully-complexioned and the most virtuous. Victory to that Rama, who is our Lord Sai Rama, of the sacred Prashanthi Nilayam.
devanagari:
रघुकुल भूषण राजीव नयना
ईश्वराम्बा नंदन सत्य साई रामा
जानकी वल्लभ लावण्य रामा
निरुपम सुंदर सुगुणाभि रामा
प्रशांति निलया पावन धामा
जय जय रामा प्रभु साई रामा
respell:
Raghukul Bhūshaṇ Rājīva Nayanā
Īshwarāmbā Nandana Satya Sāī Rāmā
Jānakī Vallabh Lāvaṇya Rāmā
Nirupama Sundara Suguṇābhi Rāmā
Prashānti Nilayā Pāvan Dhāmā
Jaya Jaya Rāmā Prabhu Sāī Rāmā

title: Raghunandana Hey Raghunandana
lyrics:
Raghunandana Hey Raghunandana (2)
Pyare Mere Nandana Raghunandana [ Raghunandana...]
Janaki Jeevana Raghunandana
Dasharatha Tanaya Raghunandana
Dashamukha Mardana Raghunandana
Rajeeva Lochana Raghunandana
Raghunandana Hey Raghunandana
meaning: I bow down to Lord Rama of the Raghu dynasty who is beloved to me. He is the life-breath of mother Janaki. The prince of King Dasharatha, the destroyer of ten-headed Ravana, I bow down to You O Lotus-eyed prince of the Raghu dynasty.
devanagari:
रघुनंदना हे रघुनंदना (2)
प्यारे मेरे नंदना रघु नंदना [रघु नंदना ...]
जानकी जीवन रघु नंदना
दशरथ तनया रघु नंदना
दश मुख मर्दन रघु नंदना
राजीव लोचना रघु नंदना [रघु नंदना ...]
respell:
Raghunandanā He Raghunandanā (2)
Pyāre Mere Nandanā Raghu Nandanā [raghu Nandanā ...]
Jānakī Jīvan Raghu Nandanā
Dasharath Tanayā Raghu Nandanā
Dasha Mukha Mardana Raghu Nandanā
Rājīva Lochanā Raghu Nandanā [raghu Nandanā ...]

title: Raghupate Sri Rama Chandra Raghava Daya Nidhe
lyrics:
Raghupate Sri Rama Chandra Raghava Daya Nidhe
Pashupate Sri Parvateesha Shankara Sadashiva
Madhava Sri Radhikesha Govinda Hare Krishna
meaning:
Rama, the Lord of the Raghus, who is still and shining as the moon, You are an ocean of mercy! 
O Lord of all creatures, beloved of the Mother Parvathi, You are the unchanging Shiva, the source of Goodness. 
O Krishna, the splendorous Lord of Radha! You are the protector of our souls and remover of sorrows!
devanagari:
रघुपाते श्री राम चन्द्रा राघवा दया निधे
पशुपते श्री पार्वतीशा शंकरा सदाशिवा
माधवा श्री राधिकेशा गोविन्दा हरे कृष्णा
respell:
Raghupāte Shrī Rām Chandrā Rāghavā Dayā Nidhe
Pashupate Shrī Pārwatīshā Shaṅkarā Sadāshivā
Mādhavā Shrī Rādhikeshā Govindā Hare Kṛushṇā

title: Raghupate Raghava Raja Rama
lyrics:
Raghupate Raghava Raja Rama
O Raja Rama O Sai Rama
Dasharatha Nandana Raja Rama
Kousalyatmaja Sundara Rama
Rama Rama Jaya Raja Rama Shyamala Komala Megha Shyama
Jai Jai Ram Jai Jai Ram
Jai Jai Ram Jai Jai Ram Jai Jai Rama Rama Raja Ram
Patita Pavana Sitapate Rama
meaning: Pray and Chant the name of Lord Rama, the handsome Prince of King Dasharatha and Mother Kausalya. Victory be to You O Lord Rama, who is same as the dark complexioned and soft natured Megha Shyama ( cloud complexioned lord). Victory to Lord Rama, the saviour of the downtrodden and the Lord of Sita
devanagari:
रघुपते राघवा राजा रामा
ओ राजा (साई) रामा [ रघुपते ... ]
दशरथ नंदन राजा रामा कौसल्यात्मज सुंदर रामा
राम राम जय राजा रामा राघव मोहन मेघ श्यामा
जय जय राम जय जय राम  
जय जय राम जय जय राम जय जय राम राम राजा राम
पतित पावन सीता पते रामा
respell:
Raghupate Rāghavā Rājā Rāmā
O Rājā (sāī) Rāmā [ Raghupate ... ]
Dasharath Nandana Rājā Rāmā Kausalyātmaja Sundara Rāmā
Rām Rām Jaya Rājā Rāmā Rāghav Mohan Megha Shyāmā
Jay Jay Rām Jay Jay Rām
Jay Jay Rām Jay Jay Rām Jay Jay Rām Rām Rājā Rām
Patita Pāvan Sītā Pate Rāmā

title: Raghupathi Raghava Raja Ram
lyrics:
Raghupathi Raghava Raja Ram
Patitha Pavana Sita Ram
Raghupathi Raghava Raja Ram
Patitha Pavana Sita Ram
Rama Rama Jaya Raja ( Sai ) Ram
Rama Rama Jaya Raja Ram
Rama Rama Jaya Sita Ram
Rama Rama Jaya Sai Ram
meaning: Oh King Rama, lord of the Raghu dynasty, you are the divine purifier who uplifts the fallen, ever united with Sita. We joyously chant your glorious name, Rama, celebrating your victory and divine presence, including as Sai.
devanagari:
रघुपति राघव राजा राम
पतित पावन सीता राम
रघुपति राघव राजा राम
पतित पावन सीता राम
राम राम जय राजा ( साई ) राम
राम राम जय राजा राम
राम राम जय सीता राम
राम राम जय साई राम
respell:
Raghupati Rāghav Rājā Rām
Patita Pāvan Sītā Rām
Raghupati Rāghav Rājā Rām
Patita Pāvan Sītā Rām
Rām Rām Jaya Rājā ( Sāī ) Rām
Rām Rām Jaya Rājā Rām
Rām Rām Jaya Sītā Rām
Rām Rām Jaya Sāī Rām

title: Raghupati Raghava Raja Ram Patita Pavana Sita Ram
lyrics:
Raghupati Raghava Raja Ram Patita Pavana Sita Ram
Eshwara Allah Tere Nam
Sab Ko Sanmati Do Bhagawan
Raghupati Raghava Raja Ram Patita Pavana Sita Ram
Sita Ram Jaya Sita Ram Bhaj Pyare Man Sita Ram
Sita Ram Sita Ram
Bhaj Pyare Man Sita Ram
Raghupati Raghava Raja Ram Patita Pavana Sita Ram
meaning: Victory to You, Lord Rama, king of the Raghu dynasty, and the Lord of Sita, the protector of the poor and helpless. Sing praises to our beloved Lord Sita Ram, known also as Ishwara and Allah. O Lord, please endow us with intelligence.
devanagari:
रघुपति राघव राजा राम पतित पावन सीता राम
ईश्वर अल्लाह तेरे नाम
सब को सन्मति दो भगवान
रघुपति राघव राजा राम पतित पावन सीता राम
सीता राम जय सीता राम भज प्यारे मन सीता राम
सीता राम सीता राम
भज प्यारे मन सीता राम
रघुपति राघव राजा राम पतित पावन सीता राम
respell:
Raghupati Rāghav Rājā Rām Patita Pāvan Sītā Rām
Īshwar Allāh Tere Nām
Sab Ko Sanmati Do Bhagavān
Raghupati Rāghav Rājā Rām Patita Pāvan Sītā Rām
Sītā Rām Jaya Sītā Rām Bhaj Pyāre Man Sītā Rām
Sītā Rām Sītā Rām
Bhaj Pyāre Man Sītā Rām
Raghupati Rāghav Rājā Rām Patita Pāvan Sītā Rām

title: Raghuveera Ranadheera Rama Rama Ram
lyrics:
Raghuveera Ranadheera Rama Rama Ram
Rakhumayi Vitthala Shyama Shyama Shyam
Sukumara Sundara Rama Rama Ram
Shirdeesha Partheesha Shyama Shyama Shyam
meaning: Let us sing the glories of Ram, champion of the Raghu dynasty, one of might and courage. Chant the name of Lord Vitthala of Rakhumayi, the dark hued one. Victory to the good, young and handsome Ram, the Lord of Shirdi and Parthi.
devanagari:
रघुवीर राणधीर राम राम राम  
रकुमाई विट्ठला श्याम श्याम श्याम [ रघुवीर ... ]  
सुकुमार सुंदर राम राम राम  
शिरडीश पर्तिश (साईश) राम राम राम
respell:
Raghuvīr Rāṇadhīra Rām Rām Rām
Rakumāī Viṭṭhalā Shyām Shyām Shyām [ Raghuvīr ... ]
Sukumāra Sundara Rām Rām Rām
Shiraḍīsha Partisha (sāīsh) Rām Rām Rām

title: Rahiman Rahiman Ram Rahim
lyrics:
Rahiman Rahiman Ram Rahim
Sai Ram Sai Ram Krishna Karim
Buddha Zoroastra Nanak Sai
Yeshu Pita Prabhu Sai Tum Ho
Bhajare Manuva Ram Rahim
Ram Rahim Sai Krishna Karim
meaning: O Mind! Chant the various names of the same Lord Ram, Rahim, the gracious One, Krishna, Karim, the compassionate. O Lord Sai You are Buddha, Zoroastra, Nanak and You are the One who sent Jesus. You are the embodiment of all that has come.
devanagari:
रहिमन रहिमन राम रहिम
साई राम साई राम कृष्ण करीम
बुद्ध जोहराष्ट्र नानक साई
येसु पिता प्रभु साई तुम हो
भजोरें मनुवा राम रहिम
राम रहिम साई कृष्ण करीम
respell:
Rahiman Rahiman Rām Rahim
Sāī Rām Sāī Rām Kṛushṇa Karīm
Buddha Joharāshṭra Nānak Sāī
Yesu Pitā Prabhu Sāī Tum Ho
Bhajoreṃ Manuvā Rām Rahim
Rām Rahim Sāī Kṛushṇa Karīm

title: Raja Rajeshwari Jaganmohini
lyrics:
Raja Rajeshwari Jaganmohini
Jagadambe Mangala Karini
Jagadoddharini Vighna Vinashini
Chira Sukha Dayini Sai Janani
meaning: Effulgent and beautiful Goddess Amba enchants the world and bestows auspiciousness. She destroys obstacles and saves the world. Mother Sai grants everlasting happiness
devanagari:
राज राजेश्वरी जगन्मोहिनी (अम्बा)
जगदम्बे मंगल कारिणी [ (अम्बा) राज राजेश्वरी ... ]
जगतोद्धारिणी विघ्न विनाशिनी
चिर सुख दायिनी साई जननी
respell:
Rāj Rājeshwarī Jaganmohinī (ambā)
Jagadambe Maṅgal Kāriṇī [ (ambā) Rāj Rājeshwarī ... ]
Jagatoddhāriṇī Vighna Vināshinī
Chira Sukh Dāyinī Sāī Jananī

title: Rajeeva Lochana Jaya Jaya Rama
lyrics:
Rajeeva Lochana Jaya Jaya Rama
Raghukula Bhushana Jaya Raghu Rama
Dasharatha Nandana Lavanya Rama
Abhaya Pradayaka Ananda Rama
Janaki Vallabha Sugunabhi Rama
Jagadoddhara Sathya Sai Rama
meaning:
Victory to Lord Rama whose eyes resemble lotus and who is the ornament of the Raghu dynasty.
The Lord who is the beloved son of Dasharatha, is the embodiment of supreme beauty. He confers Divine protection and is Bliss himself.
He is the Divine companion of Janaka's daughter (Mother Sita) and is filled with Divine qualities.
He has incarnated as Lord Sai Rama to foster the mankind.
devanagari:
राजीव लोचन जय जय रामा
रघुकुल भूषण जय रघु रामा
दशरथ नंदन लावण्य रामा
अभय प्रदायक आनंद रामा
जानकी वल्लभ सुगुणाभि रामा
जागतोद्धारण सत्य साईं रामा
respell:
Rājīva Lochana Jaya Jaya Rāmā
Raghukul Bhūshaṇ Jaya Raghu Rāmā
Dasharath Nandana Lāvaṇya Rāmā
Abhaya Pradāyak Ānanda Rāmā
Jānakī Vallabh Suguṇābhi Rāmā
Jāgatoddhāraṇ Satya Sāīṃ Rāmā

title: Rajeeva Lochana Sai Narayana
lyrics:
Rajeeva Lochana Sai Narayana
Narahari Roopa Namo Narayana
Parama Dayaghana Patita Pavana
Nitya Niranjana Sai Narayana
Narahari Roopa Namo Narayana
meaning: Oh Sai Narayana, whose eyes are like beautiful lotuses, we offer salutations to you, who manifested in the form of Narahari. You are the supreme embodiment of compassion, the purifier of the fallen, and eternally pure.
devanagari:
राजीव लोचन साई नारायण
नरहरि रूपा नमो नारायण
परम दयाघन पतित पावन
नित्य निरंजन साई नारायण
नरहरि रूपा नमो नारायण
respell:
Rājīva Lochana Sāī Nārāyaṇ
Narahari Rūpā Namo Nārāyaṇ
Param Dayāghan Patita Pāvan
Nitya Nirañjana Sāī Nārāyaṇ
Narahari Rūpā Namo Nārāyaṇ

title: Raksha Karo Bhagawan Sathya Sai Bhagawan
lyrics:
Raksha Karo Bhagawan Sathya Sai Bhagawan
Pahi Dayalu Dehi Krupalu
Sathya Dharma Shanti Prema Pradata
Nitya Nirmala Jeevana Data
Brahma Vishnu Maheshwara Roopa
Sathyam Shivam Sundaram
meaning: Oh Lord Sathya Sai, we implore your protection! You are the compassionate guardian, mercifully granting Truth, Righteousness, Peace, and Love, and the eternal fount of pure life. Manifesting as Brahma, Vishnu, and Maheshwara, you embody the very essence of Truth, Goodness, and Beauty.
devanagari:
रक्षा करो भगवान सत्य साई भगवान
पाहि दयालु देही कृपालु
सत्य धर्म शान्ति प्रेम प्रदाता
नित्य निर्मल जीवन दाता
ब्रह्मा विष्णु महेश्वर रूपा
सत्यम् शिवम् सुंदरम
respell:
Rakshā Karo Bhagavān Satya Sāī Bhagavān
Pāhi Dayālu Dehī Kṛupālu
Satya Dharma Shānti Prem Pradātā
Nitya Nirmala Jīvan Dātā
Brahmā Vishṇu Maheshwar Rūpā
Satyam Shivam Sundaram

title: Raksha Raksha Jagadeeshwara
lyrics:
Raksha Raksha Jagadeeshwara
Parthipuri Parameshwara
Pahi Pahi Parameshwara
Dehi Dehi Tava Pada Seva
meaning: Protect us, Oh Lord of the Universe! Protect us, Oh Lord of Parthi! Protect and bless us. We pray to Thee to grant us the opportunity to serve at Your Lotus Feet.
devanagari:
रक्ष रक्ष जगदीश्वरा
पर्ती पूरी परमेश्वरा
पाही पाही परमेश्वरा
देही देही तव पद सेवा
respell:
Raksha Raksha Jagadīshwarā
Partī Pūrī Parameshwarā
Pāhī Pāhī Parameshwarā
Dehī Dehī Tava Pada Sevā

title: Ram Kaho Krishna Kaho Eshwar Allah Sai Kaho
lyrics:
Ram Kaho Krishna Kaho Eshwar Allah Sai Kaho
Buddha Kaho Guru Nanak Kaho Zoroastra Mahavir Yeshu Kaho
Yug Avatar Tum Ho Vishwa Shakti Tum Ho
Sarva Dharma Priya Sai Mahesha
Parabrahma Tum Ho (Sai)
meaning: Chant the name of Ram, Krishna, Eshwar or Allah. Chant the name of Buddha, Guru Nanak or Zoroaster. Chant either Mahavir or Jesus. O Sai, You are the incarnation of this age. You are the power behind the Universe. You are Sai Mahesha, who loves all religion equally. You are the embodiment of the Supreme One.
devanagari:
राम कहो कृष्ण कहो ईश्वर अल्लाह साईं कहो
बुद्ध कहो गुरु नानक कहो ज़ोहराष्ट्र महावीर येसु कहो [ राम कहो ... ]
युग अवतार तुम हो विश्व शक्ति तुम हो
सर्व धर्म प्रिय साईं महेशा
परब्रह्म तुम हो (साईं)
respell:
Rām Kaho Kṛushṇa Kaho Īshwar Allāh Sāīṃ Kaho
Buddha Kaho Guru Nānak Kaho Ja़oharāshṭra Mahāvīr Yesu Kaho [ Rām Kaho ... ]
Yug Avatāra Tum Ho Vishwa Shakti Tum Ho
Sarwa Dharma Priy Sāīṃ Maheshā
Parabrahma Tum Ho (sāīṃ)

title: Ram Kaho Sai Ram Kaho
lyrics:
Ram Kaho Sai Ram Kaho
Shyam Kaho Ghana Shyam Kaho
Yesu Kaho Zohrashtra Kaho
Jag Ka Vidhata Sai Kaho
Mandir Mey Kabhi Masjid Mey
Apna Hrudaya Mey Sai Bhagawan
meaning: Oh, call upon the Divine by any name – Rama, Shyam, Jesus, or Zoroaster – for it is Sai, the Creator of all existence. Whether sought in temples or mosques, know that the beloved Lord Sai Bhagawan truly resides within the sanctuary of our own heart.
devanagari:
राम कहो साई राम कहो
श्याम कहो घन श्याम कहो
येसु कहो ज़ोहराष्ट्र कहो
जग का विधाता साई कहो
मंदिर में कभी मस्जिद में
अपना हृदय में साई भगवान
respell:
Rām Kaho Sāī Rām Kaho
Shyām Kaho Ghan Shyām Kaho
Yesu Kaho Ja़oharāshṭra Kaho
Jag Kā Vidhātā Sāī Kaho
Mandir Meṃ Kabhī Masjid Meṃ
Apanā Hṛudaya Meṃ Sāī Bhagavān

title: Ram Nam Bolo Sai Ram Bolo Sai Shyam Ghana Shyam Jai Bolo
lyrics:
Ram Nam Bolo Sai Ram Bolo Sai Shyam Ghana Shyam Jai Bolo
Ram Nam Bolo Sai Ram Bolo
Sai Shyam Ghana Shyam
meaning: Chant the divine names of Lord Rama, Lord Krishna, Lord Saibaba.
devanagari:
राम नाम बोलो साई नाम बोलो साई श्याम घन श्याम जय बोलो
राम नाम बोलो साई नाम बोलो
साई श्याम घन श्याम
respell:
Rām Nām Bolo Sāī Nām Bolo Sāī Shyām Ghan Shyām Jay Bolo
Rām Nām Bolo Sāī Nām Bolo
Sāī Shyām Ghan Shyām

title: Ram Rahim Ko Bhajne Wale Tere Pujari Baba
lyrics:
Ram Rahim Ko Bhajane Wale Tere Pujari Baba
Tera Nam Ek Sahara (3)
Tumhi Ho Geeta Tumhi Ramayan
Tumhi Ho Veda Quran
Baba Tumhi Ho Veda Quran
Tera Nam Ek Sahara
meaning: O Sai Baba, You are revered by followers of both Ram and Rahim, with Your name serving as their singular refuge. You embody the profound wisdom found in the Gita, Ramayana, Vedas, and Quran, offering universal spiritual guidance.
devanagari:
राम रहीम को भजनवाले तेरे पूजारी बाबा  
तेरा नाम एक सहारा (3)  
तुम ही हो गीता तुम ही रामायण  
तुम ही हो वेद कुरान [ तेरा नाम ... ]
respell:
Rām Rahīm Ko Bhajanavāle Tere Pūjārī Bābā
Terā Nām Ek Sahārā (3)
Tum Hī Ho Gītā Tum Hī Rāmāyaṇ
Tum Hī Ho Ved Kurān [ Terā Nām ... ]

title: Ram Ram Bhajoman Hare Hare
lyrics:
Ram Ram Bhajoman Hare Hare
Sai Ram Bhajoman Hare Hare
Raghupati Raja Rama Ram
Patita Pavana Sita Ram
Sai Ram Bhajoman Hare Hare
meaning: O mind! worship Lord Rama of the Raghu Dynasty. The Lord of Sita, Lord Rama, destroys sins and evil, uplifts and liberates the penitent.
devanagari:
राम राम भजो मन हरे हरे  
साई राम भजो मन हरे हरे [ राम राम ... ]  
रघुपति राजा राम राम  
पतित पावन सीता राम [ साई राम ... ]
respell:
Rām Rām Bhajo Mana Hare Hare
Sāī Rām Bhajo Mana Hare Hare [ Rām Rām ... ]
Raghupati Rājā Rām Rām
Patita Pāvan Sītā Rām [ Sāī Rām ... ]

title: Ram Ram Ram Parama Sumangala Ram Ram Ram
lyrics:
Ram Ram Ram Parama Sumangala Ram Ram Ram
Janani Janaki Jeevana Ram
Jai Jai Ram Sai Ram Jayatu Jayatu Rama
Parama Sumangala Ram Ram Ram
meaning: The name of Ram, the One who is the very life of mother Janaki is highly auspicious. Victory to Ram and Sai Ram.
devanagari:
राम राम राम परम सुमंगल राम राम राम
जननी जानकी जीवन राम
जय जय राम साई राम जयतु जयतु रामा
परम सुमंगल राम राम राम
respell:
Rām Rām Rām Param Sumaṅgal Rām Rām Rām
Jananī Jānakī Jīvan Rām
Jay Jay Rām Sāī Rām Jayatu Jayatu Rāmā
Param Sumaṅgal Rām Rām Rām

title: Rama Charan Sukhdayi Bhajore
lyrics:
Rama Charan Sukhdayi Bhajore
Rama Nam Ke Do Akshar Mein
Sab Sukh Shanti Samayire
Sai Nath Ke Charano Mein Akar
Jeevan Saphal Banaore
meaning: Chant at the sacred feet of Rama - that gives happiness. Those two syllables in the word Ra-Ma encompasses all the joy, peace and happiness. Make your life worthwhile by surrendering at the Lotus Feet of Sai Nath
devanagari:
राम चरण सुख दाई भजोरें (3)
राम नाम के दो अक्षर में
सब सुख शांति समायिरे
साई नाथ के चरणों में आकर
जीवन सफल बनाओरे
respell:
Rām Charaṇ Sukh Dāī Bhajoreṃ (3)
Rām Nām Ke Do Akshar Meṃ
Sab Sukh Shānti Samāyire
Sāī Nāth Ke Charaṇoṃ Meṃ Ākar
Jīvan Saphal Banāore

title: Ram Hare Hari Nam Bolo
lyrics:
Ram Hare Hari Nam Bolo
Hari Nam Bolo Sai Nam Bolo
Sairama Parama Dayala
Parama Dayala Parama Dayala
Man Mandir Mein Diya Ujala
--
Allah Sai Bolo Maula Sai Bolo
Nanak Sai Bolo Govind Sai Bolo
Yeshu Sai Bolo Buddha Sai Bolo
Allah Sai Bolo Maula Sai Bolo (not sung in the audio)
meaning: Oh supremely compassionate Sai Rama, we earnestly chant your holy names, along with Ram and Hari, for you have lit the lamp of divine light within the temple of our hearts. We also call upon you as Allah, Maula, Nanak, Govind, Jesus, and Buddha, recognizing the one divine presence in all traditions.
devanagari:
राम हरे हरि नाम बोलो
हरि नाम बोलो साईं नाम बोलो [ राम हरे ... ]
साईं रामा परम दयाला
परम दयाला (2)
मन मंदिर में दिया उजाला
अल्लाह साईं बोलो मौलाह साईं बोलो
येसु साईं बोलो बुद्धा साईं बोलो
नानक साईं बोलो गोविन्द साईं बोलो
अल्लाह साईं बोलो मौला साईं बोलो
respell:
Rām Hare Hari Nām Bolo
Hari Nām Bolo Sāīṃ Nām Bolo [ Rām Hare ... ]
Sāīṃ Rāmā Param Dayālā
Param Dayālā (2)
Man Mandir Meṃ Diyā Ujālā
Allāh Sāīṃ Bolo Maulāh Sāīṃ Bolo
Yesu Sāīṃ Bolo Buddhā Sāīṃ Bolo
Nānak Sāīṃ Bolo Govinda Sāīṃ Bolo
Allāh Sāīṃ Bolo Maulā Sāīṃ Bolo

title: Rama Hare Sai Krishna Hare Sarva Dharma Priya Sai Hare
lyrics:
Rama Hare Sai Krishna Hare Sarva Dharma Priya Sai Hare
Allah Eshwar Sai Hare
Guru Nanak Yeshu Buddha Hare
Zoroastra Mahavira Sai Hare
Sarva Dharma Priya Sai Hare (Baba)
--
Rama Hare Sai Krishna Hare (4)
meaning: Glory to Rama, glory to Krishna, glory to Lord Sai, who loves all religions equally. Glory to the name of the Lord of all faiths; Who is known by different names as Rama, Krishna, Allah, Eshwar, Guru Nanak, Jesus, Buddha, Zoroaster and Mahavira. Sai responds to any of these names.
devanagari:
राम हरे साई कृष्ण हरे सर्व धर्म प्रिय साई हरे
अल्लाह ईश्वर साई हरे
गुरु नानक येसु बुद्ध हरे
जोराष्ट्र महावीर साई हरे
सर्व धर्म प्रिय साई हरे (बाबा)
---
राम हरे साई कृष्ण हरे (4)
respell:
Rām Hare Sāī Kṛushṇa Hare Sarwa Dharma Priy Sāī Hare
Allāh Īshwar Sāī Hare
Guru Nānak Yesu Buddha Hare
Jorāshṭra Mahāvīr Sāī Hare
Sarwa Dharma Priy Sāī Hare (bābā)
---

title: Rama Hare Sita Ram
lyrics:
Rama Hare Sita Ram
Shyama Hare Radhe Shyam
Sita Vallabha Sundara Ram
Murali Manohara Radhe Shyama
Parthi Pureeshwara Ram
meaning: O Rama, beloved of Sita, and Shyama, dear to Radha, we lovingly chant your sacred names. You are the beautiful consort of Sita, the enchanting flute-player, and the divine Lord of Parthi.
devanagari:
राम हरे सिता राम
श्याम हरे राधे श्याम
सिता वल्लभ सुंदर राम
मुरली मनोहर राधे श्याम
पर्तिपूरीश्वर राम
respell:
Rām Hare Sitā Rām
Shyām Hare Rādhe Shyām
Sitā Vallabh Sundara Rām
Muralī Manohar Rādhe Shyām
Partipūrīshwar Rām

title: Rama Jayam Raghu Rama Jayam
lyrics:
Rama Jayam Raghu Rama Jayam
Raghava Dhyanamey Premamayam [ Rama Jayam ... ]
Rama Sita Pathi Raghava Mantram
Prema Niguna Gana Seva Niranthram
Rama Dayapara Parama Pavitram
Raghukula Dasharatha Suthamutha Mitram
meaning: Victory to Rama, victory to Raghu Rama! Our meditation on Raghava is pure love, for Rama, husband of Sita, is our sacred mantra. We offer continuous service through selfless devotion to you, Oh compassionate and supremely pure Rama, beloved son of Dasharatha and cherished friend of the Raghu dynasty.
devanagari:
राम जयम् रघु राम जयम्
राघव ध्यानमे प्रेममयम्
राम सीता पति राघव मन्त्रम्
प्रेम निगुण गण सेवा निरन्तरम्
राम दयापर परम पवित्रम्
रघुकुल दशरथ सुतपुत मित्रम्
respell:
Rām Jayam Raghu Rām Jayam
Rāghav Dhyāname Premamayam
Rām Sītā Pati Rāghav Mantram
Prem Niguṇ Gaṇ Sevā Nirantaram
Rām Dayāpara Param Pavitram
Raghukul Dasharath Sutaputa Mitram

title: Rama Krishna Govinda Narayana Keshava
lyrics:
Rama Krishna Govinda Narayana Keshava
Radhika Ramana Madhava Jaya Ranga Deva
Radhika Ramana Madhava
Hare Rama Hare Krishna Sita Rama Raghava
Radhika Ramana Madhava Jaya Ranga Deva
Radhika Ramana Madhava
meaning: Chant the names of the Lord Rama, Krishna, Narayana, Keshava and Madhava. The one adored by Radha, Lord of Lakshmi, victory to you the Lord of the World.
devanagari:
राम कृष्ण गोविन्द नारायण केशवा
राधिका रमण माधवा जय रंग देवा
हरे राम हरे कृष्ण सीता राम राघवा [ राधिका रमण ... ]
हरे राम हरे कृष्ण सीता राम राघवा
राधिका रमण माधवा जय रंग देवा
राधिका रमण माधवा
respell:
Rām Kṛushṇa Govinda Nārāyaṇ Keshavā
Rādhikā Ramaṇa Mādhavā Jaya Raṅg Devā
Hare Rām Hare kṛushṇa sītā rām rāghavā [ rādhikā ramaṇa ... ]
Hare Rām Hare Kṛushṇa Sītā Rām Rāghavā
Rādhikā Ramaṇa Mādhavā Jaya Raṅg Devā
Rādhikā Ramaṇa Mādhavā

title: Rama Krishna Govinda Narayana
lyrics:
Rama Krishna Govinda Narayana
Narayana Hari Narayana [ Rama Krishna ... ]
Sri Lakshmi Ramana Narayana
Aum Anantha Narayana (Hari) (3)
meaning: Oh Narayana, we invoke your sacred names – Rama, Krishna, and Govinda – recognizing you as the beloved of Lakshmi and the remover of all suffering. You are the infinite, supreme Hari, the very essence of existence.
devanagari:
राम कृष्ण गोविन्द नारायणा
नारायणा हरि नारायणा [ राम कृष्ण ... ]
श्री लक्ष्मी रमणा नारायणा
ॐ अनन्त नारायणा (हरि) (3)
respell:
Rām Kṛushṇa Govinda Nārāyaṇā
Nārāyaṇā Hari Nārāyaṇā [ Rām Kṛushṇa ... ]
Shrī Lakshmī Ramaṇā Nārāyaṇā
Oṃ Ananta Nārāyaṇā (hari) (3)

title: Rama Krishna Hari Jai Jai Mukunda Murari
lyrics:
Rama Krishna Hari Mukunda Murari
Panduranga Hari Panduranga Hari
Deva Deva Deva Mahadeva Deva
Adi Deva Deva Brahma Vishnu Deva
Deva Deva Deva Sathya Sai Deva
Panduranga Hari Panduranga Hari
--
Panduranga Hari Jai Jai Panduranga Hari (5)
Panduranga Hari Panduranga Hari
meaning: Chant the names of the Lord Rama, Krishna, Hari, Mukunda, the one who liberates, Murari, the one who slayed the demon, Mura. He is Panduranga, Lord of Lords. He is the great God, Mahadeva (Shiva), He is the primordial Lord, the trinity of Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva. He has taken form as Sathya Sai. Victory to Lord Pandu Ranga Hari.
devanagari:
राम कृष्ण हरि मुकुंद मुरारी
पांडुरंग हरि पांडुरंग हरि
देव देव देवा महादेव देवा
आदि देव देवा ब्रह्मा विष्णु देवा
देव देव देवा सत्य साईं देवा [ पांडुरंग हरि ... ]
---
पांडुरंग हरि जय जय पांडुरंग हरि (5)  
पांडुरंग हरि पांडुरंग हरि
respell:
Rām Kṛushṇa Hari Mukund Murārī
Pāṇḍuraṅg Hari Pāṇḍuraṅg Hari
Deva Deva Devā Mahādeva Devā
Ādi Deva Devā Brahmā Vishṇu Devā
Deva Deva Devā Satya Sāīṃ Devā [ Pāṇḍuraṅg Hari ... ]
---

Pāṇḍuraṅg Hari Pāṇḍuraṅg Hari (2)

title: Rama Krishna Hari Narayana
lyrics:
Rama Krishna Hari Narayana
Deena Janavana Hari Narayana
Deena Sharanya Narayana
Bhava Bhaya Harana Sai Narayana
meaning: Chant the name of Lord Rama, Krishna, Narayana and Hari. Lord Narayana, who is the protector and the One in whom the downtrodden takes refuge, is none other than Lord Sai Narayana, who protects and liberates us from the bondage of life.
devanagari:
राम कृष्ण हरी नारायणा
दीन जनावन हरी नारायण
दीना शरण्या नारायणा
भव भय हरणा साई नारायणा
respell:
Rām Kṛushṇa Harī Nārāyaṇā
Dīna Janāvan Harī Nārāyaṇ
Dīnā Sharaṇyā Nārāyaṇā
Bhava Bhaya Haraṇā Sāī Nārāyaṇā

title: Rama Krishna Tum Ho Jaya Ram Jaya Ram
lyrics:
Rama Krishna Tum Ho Jaya Ram Jaya Ram
Sai Krishna Tum Ho Sai Ram Sai Ram
Yeshu Pita Tum Ho Hey Ram Hey Ram
Allah Eshwar Ho Allah Ho Akbar
Shirdi Sai Tum Ho Sai Ram Sai Ram
meaning: O Lord Sai you are the embodiment of all names and every form like Rama, Krishna, Yesu, Allah, Ishwar and Shirdi Sai
devanagari:
राम कृष्ण तुम हो जय राम जय राम
साई कृष्ण तुम हो साई राम साई राम
येशु पिता तुम हो हे राम हे राम
अल्लाह ईश्वर हो अल्लाह हो अकबर
शिरडी साई तुम हो साई राम साई राम
respell:
Rām Kṛushṇa Tum Ho Jaya Rām Jaya Rām
Sāī Kṛushṇa Tum Ho Sāī Rām Sāī Rām
Yeshu Pitā Tum Ho He Rām He Rām
Allāh Īshwar Ho Allāh Ho Akabar
Shiraḍī Sāī Tum Ho Sāī Rām Sāī Rām

title: Ramakrishna Vasudeva Narayana Hari Hari
lyrics:
Ramakrishna Vasudeva Narayana Hari Hari
Viswaroopa Vasudeva Narayana Hari Hari
Narayana Hari Hari Om Narayana Hari Hari
Viswaroopa Vasudeva Narayana Hari Hari
Viswaroopa Saideva Narayana Hari Hari
meaning: Chant the names of Lord Rama, Krishna, Vasudeva, Narayana, Hari and the all-pervading cosmic form of the Lord of Lords, Sai Deva.
devanagari:
राम कृष्ण वासुदेव नारायण हरि हरि
विश्व रूप वासुदेव नारायण हरि हरि
नारायण हरि हरि ॐ नारायण हरि हरि [ विश्व रूप ... ]
respell:
Rām Kṛushṇa Vāsudeva Nārāyaṇ Hari Hari
Vishwa Rūp Vāsudeva Nārāyaṇ Hari Hari
Nārāyaṇ Hari Hari Oṃ Nārāyaṇ Hari Hari [ Vishwa Rūp ... ]

title: Rama Lakshmana Janaki Jai Bolo Hanuman Ki
lyrics:
Rama Lakshmana Janaki Jai Bolo Hanuman Ki
Anjani Putra Balabheema Anjaneya Balabheema
Balabheem (6) Balabheema
Vayukumara Balabheema Vanara Veera Balabheema
Balabheem (6) Balabheema
Parthipureesha Sai Rama Pavana Purusha Sai Rama
Sai Ram (6) Sai Rama
meaning: Victory to Hanuman, along with Rama and Lakshmana and Sita. Victory to the mighty son of Anjana, Hanuman, the son of Vayu (God of Wind) and the son of the monkey clan. Bow to the Lord of Parthi, Sai Rama, the pure and the blemish-less on
devanagari:
राम लक्ष्मण जानकी जय बोलो हनुमान की
अंजनी पुत्रा  बलभीमा आंजनेया बलभीमा
बलभीम (६) बलभीमा
वायुकुमारा बलभीमा वानर वीरा बलभीमा
बलभीम (६) बलभीमा
पर्तीपुरीशा साई रामा पावन पुरुषा साई रामा
साई राम (६) साई रामा
respell:
Rām Lakshmaṇa Jānakī Jay Bolo Hanumān Kī

Balabhīm (6) Balabhīmā

title: Rama Lakshmana Janaki Jai Bolo Hanuman Ki
lyrics: Rama Lakshmana Janaki Jai Bolo Hanuman Ki
meaning: Victory to Lord Rama, Lakshmana, Mother Sita and Hanuman
devanagari: राम लक्ष्मण जानकी जय बोलो हनुमान की
respell: Rām Lakshmaṇa Jānakī Jay Bolo Hanumān Kī

title: Rama Nama Tarakam Sada Bhajore
lyrics:
Rama Nama Tarakam Sada Bhajore
Sada Bhajore Sada Japore [ Rama Nama...]
Rama Rama Rama Jai Kodanda Rama
Rama Rama Rama Jai Pattabhi Rama
Rama Rama Rama Jai Kalyana Rama
(Sai) Rama Rama Rama Jai Kalyana Rama
meaning: Be ever involved in chanting and singing the holy name of Lord Rama which is a medium to transcend our lives. The Lord is extolled as the one who wields the Kodanda bow, the coronated Emperor and the benevolent.
devanagari:
राम नाम तारकं सदा भजोरे
सदा भजोरे सदा जपो रे [ राम नाम ... ]
राम राम राम जय कोदंड रामा
राम राम राम जय पट्टभि रामा
राम राम राम जय कल्याण रामा
respell:
Rām Nāma Tārakaṃ Sadā Bhajore
Sadā Bhajore Sadā Japo Re [ Rām Nāma ... ]
Rām Rām Rām Jaya Kodaṇḍa Rāmā
Rām Rām Rām Jaya Paṭṭabhi Rāmā
Rām Rām Rām Jaya Kalyāṇ Rāmā

title: Rama Raghuvara Rama Sita Rama
lyrics:
Rama Raghuvara Rama Sita Rama Rama Ram (2)
Rama Dasharatha Nandana Kamaneeya Komala Ram
Rama Danava Bhanjana Kodanda Raja Ram
Deena Bandhu Karuna Sindhu Rama Sai Ram
Rama Bhaja Mana Rama Bhaja Mana Rama Pavana Naam
meaning: O mind, chant the purifying name of Lord Rama, the beloved of Sita, son of Dasharatha, and descendant of Raghu. He is the tender, beautiful one who wields the Kodanda bow to vanquish demons, a friend to the distressed, and an ocean of boundless compassion.
devanagari:
राम रघुवर राम सीता राम राम राम (२)  
राम दशरथ नंदन कमनीय कोमल राम  
राम दानव भंजन कोदंड राजा राम  
दीन बंधु करुणा सिंधु राम साई राम  
राम भजा मन राम भजा मन राम पावन नाम
respell:
Rām Raghuvar Rām Sītā Rām Rām Rām (2)
Rām Dasharath Nandana Kamanīya Komala Rām
Rām Dānava Bhañjana Kodaṇḍa Rājā Rām
Dīna Bandhu Karuṇā Sindhu Rām Sāī Rām
Rām Bhajā Mana Rām Bhajā Mana Rām Pāvan Nām

title: Rama Raghuvara Rama Sita Rama Rama Ram
lyrics:
Rama Raghuvara Rama Sita Rama Rama Ram
Sri Rama Rama Ram Sai Rama Rama Ram [ Rama Raghuvara.. ]
He Patita Pavana Ram He Shyamala Komala Ram
He Vaidehi Priya Ram Sai Rama Rama Jaya Ram
Sri Rama Rama Ram Sai Rama Rama Ram
meaning: Chant the name of Rama whose consort is mother Sita; He who liberates the penitent, the handsome and tender Lord. Victory to Lord Sai Rama, who is the beloved of Vaidehi (Sita).
devanagari:
राम रघुवर राम सीता राम राम राम  
श्री राम राम राम साई राम राम राम [ राम रघुवर ... ]  
हे पतित पावन राम हे श्यामला कोमला राम  
हे वैदेही प्रिय राम साई राम राम जय राम [ श्री राम ... ]
respell:

Shrī Rām Rām Rām Sāī Rām Rām Rām [ Rām Raghuvar ... ]

He Vaidehī Priy Rām Sāī Rām Rām Jaya Rām [ Shrī Rām ... ]

title: Rama Rama Jaya Raghukula Tilaka
lyrics:
Rama Rama Jaya Raghukula Tilaka
Rajeeva Lochana Ram
Eshwaramba Suta Jaya Jaga Vandana
Ratnakara Kula Deepa (3)
meaning: Worship the Lotus - Eyed Lord Rama, who is the auspicious symbol of the Raghu dynasty.  Victory to the son of Mother Eshwaramba who is worshipped by the entire world and is the glory of the Rathnakara dynasty.
devanagari:
राम राम जय रघुकुल तिलका
राजीव लोचन राम
ईश्वराम्बा सुत जय जग वंदन
रत्नाकर कुल दीपा (3)
respell:
Rām Rām Jaya Raghukul Tilakā
Rājīva Lochana Rām
Īshwarāmbā Sut Jaya Jaga Vandana
Ratnākar Kul Dīpā (3)

title: Rama Rama Rama Jaya Kodanda Rama
lyrics:
Rama Rama Rama Jaya Kodanda Rama
Rama Rama Rama Jaya Kalyana Rama
Rama Rama Rama Jaya Vaidehi Rama
Rama Rama Rama Jaya Pattabhi Rama
Rama Rama Rama Jaya Atmabhi Rama
Rama Rama Rama Jaya Prabhu Sai Rama
meaning: Victory to Lord Rama who holds the mighty bow, who is ever holy and auspicious, who is the lord of mother sita (daughter of videha king),   who is reverential and royal, who is the source of life and who is verily the Lord Sai himsel
devanagari:
राम राम राम जय कोदण्ड रामा 
राम राम राम जय कल्याण रामा 
राम राम राम जय वैदेही रामा 
राम राम राम जय पट्टाभि रामा 
राम राम राम जय आत्माभि रामा 
राम राम राम जय प्रभु साई रामा
respell:

Rām Rām Rām Jaya Kalyāṇ Rāmā
Rām Rām Rām Jaya Vaidehī Rāmā
Rām Rām Rām Jaya Paṭṭābhi Rāmā
Rām Rām Rām Jaya Ātmābhi Rāmā
Rām Rām Rām Jaya Prabhu Sāī Rāmā

title: Rama Rama Rama Rama Rama Nama Tarakam
lyrics:
Rama Rama Rama Rama Rama Nama Tarakam
Ramakrishna Vasudeva Bhakti Mukti Dayakam
Janaki Manoharam Sakala Loka Nayakam
Shankaradi Sevyamana Divya Nama Keertanam
meaning: Chant the name of Rama, the ultimate redeemer, and the names of Rama and Krishna, bestowers of devotion and liberation. This divine name, belonging to Janaki's beloved and the sovereign of all worlds, is revered and sung even by Shiva and other great deities.
devanagari:
राम राम राम राम राम नाम तारकम
राम कृष्ण वासुदेव भक्ती मुक्ति दायकम् [ राम राम ... ]
जानकी मनोहरम् सकल लोक नायकम्
शंकरादि सेव्यमान दिव्य नाम कीर्तनम्
respell:
Rām Rām Rām Rām Rām Nāma Tārakam
Rām Kṛushṇa Vāsudeva Bhaktī Mukti Dāyakam [ Rām Rām ... ]
Jānakī Manoharam Sakal Lok Nāyakam
Shaṅkarādi Sevyamāna Divya Nāma Kīrtanam

title: Rama Rama Rama Sai Rama Namo
lyrics:
Rama Rama Rama Sai Rama Namo
Krishna Krishna Krishna Sai Krishna Namo
Yeshu Yeshu Yeshu Sai Yeshu Namo
Buddha Buddha Buddha Sai Buddha Namo  [Rama Rama Rama...]
Allah Allah Allah Sai Allah Namo
Zoroastra Zoroastra Sai Namo
Mahavira Mahavira Sai Namo
Guru Nanak Guru Nanak Nanak Namo
meaning: I bow to Lord Rama, Krishna, Jesus Christ, Allah, Buddha, Zohrashtra, Mahavir and Guru Nanak. All are but emanations of our Lord Sai.
devanagari:
राम राम राम साई रामा  नमो
कृष्ण कृष्ण कृष्ण साई कृष्णा नमो
येशु येशु येशु साई येशु नमो
बुद्ध बुद्ध बुद्ध साई बुद्धा नमो  [राम राम राम...]
अल्लाह अल्लाह अल्लाह साई अल्लाह नमो
ज़ोराष्ट्रा ज़ोराष्ट्रा साई नमो
महावीर महावीर साई नमो
गुरु नानक गुरु नानक नानक नमो
respell:
Rām Rām Rām Sāī Rāmā  Namo
Kṛushṇa Kṛushṇa Kṛushṇa Sāī Kṛushṇā Namo
Yeshu Yeshu Yeshu Sāī Yeshu Namo
Buddha Buddha Buddha Sāī Buddhā Namo  [rām Rām Rām...]
Allāh Allāh Allāh Sāī Allāh Namo
ज़orāshṭrā ज़orāshṭrā Sāī Namo
Mahāvīr Mahāvīr Sāī Namo
Guru Nānak Guru Nānak Nānak Namo

title: Rama Rama Ravikula Soma
lyrics:
Rama Rama Ravikula Soma
Kodanda Rama Pattabhi Rama
Sai Rama Saketa Rama
Jaya Jaya Rama Janaki Rama
meaning:
Oh King Rama you are the crest jewel of the Solar dynasty (Ravi Clan) and holder of "Kodanda" bow. 
Lord Sai is verily Lord Rama who resides in Saketh (Vaikuntha, Heaven) 
Victory to Lord Rama, consort of Mother Sita
devanagari:
राम राम रविकुल सोमा
कोदंड रामा पट्टभी रामा
साई रामा साकेत रामा
जय जय रामा जानकी रामा
respell:
Rām Rām Ravikul Somā
Kodaṇḍa Rāmā Paṭṭabhī Rāmā
Sāī Rāmā Sāket Rāmā
Jaya Jaya Rāmā Jānakī Rāmā

title: Rama Rama Sai Rama
lyrics:
Rama Rama Sai Rama
Parthipureesha Sai Ram
Madhura Manohara Sundara Nam
Shyamala Komala Nayanabhi Ram
Ravikula Mandana Rajana Ram
Parama Pavana Mangala Dham
meaning: Invoke Lord Rama and Sai Rama, the Lord of Puttaparthi, whose name is exquisitely sweet, captivating, and beautiful. With your dark, gentle, and pleasing eyes, O King Rama, ornament of the Solar dynasty, you are the supreme purifier and fount of all auspiciousness.
devanagari:
राम राम साई राम  
पर्ति पूरीशा साई राम [ राम राम ... ]  
मधुर मनोहर सुंदर नाम  
श्यामल कोमल नयनभि राम  
रविकुल मंडन राजन राम  
परम पावना मंगल धाम
respell:
Rām Rām Sāī Rām
Parti Pūrīshā Sāī Rām [ Rām Rām ... ]
Madhura Manohar Sundara Nām
Shyāmala Komala Nayanabhi Rām
Ravikul Maṇḍana Rājana Rām
Param Pāvanā Maṅgal Dhām

title: Rama Rama Sai Ram Sita Ram Radhe Shyam
lyrics:
Rama Rama Sai Ram Sita Ram Radhe Shyam
Dasharatha Nandana Sita Ram Vasudeva Nandana Radhe Shyam
Eshwaramba Nandana
Parthipureeshwara Sai Ram
meaning: We lovingly chant the names of Rama, Sai Ram, Sita-Rama, and Radha-Shyam. You are Rama, the cherished son of Dasharatha with Sita, and Krishna, the dear son of Vasudeva with Radha. We also revere Sai Ram, the divine child of Eshwaramba and the Lord of Puttaparthi.
devanagari:
राम राम साईराम सीता राम राधे श्याम (3)  
दशरथ नंदन सीता राम वासुदेव नंदन राधे श्याम  
ईश्वराम्बा नंदना
पर्तिपुरीश्वर साईराम
respell:
Rām Rām Sāīrām Sītā Rām Rādhe Shyām (3)
dasharath Nandana Sītā Rām Vāsudeva Nandana Rādhe Shyām
īshwarāmbā Nandanā
partipurīshwar Sāīrām

title: Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram
lyrics:
Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram
Kausalya Nandana Dasharatha Ram
Janaki Vallabha Jaya Jaya Ram
Lakshmana Sevita Lavanya Ram
Ravana Mardhana Ranadheera Ram
Ayodhya Vasi Raja Ram
Anjana Priya Suta Atmabhi Ram
meaning: Chant the name of Rama, who has come as Sai Rama. Victory to Rama the darling son of Kausalya and Dasaratha and the beloved of Sita. The gentle Lord who was served by brother Lakshmana, the illustrious warrior Rama who destroyed demon King Ravana. The resident King of Ayodhya, the indwelling Lord of the dear son of Anjana (Hanuman).
devanagari:
राम साई राम साई राम साई राम (2)
कौसल्या नंदन दशरथ राम
जानकी वल्लभ जय जय राम
लक्ष्मण सेविता लावण्य राम
रावण मार्धन रणधीरा राम
अयोध्या वासी राजा राम
अञ्जन प्रिय सुत आत्माभि राम
respell:
Rām Sāī Rām Sāī Rām Sāī Rām (2)
Kausalyā Nandana Dasharath Rām
Jānakī Vallabh Jaya Jaya Rām
Lakshmaṇa Sevitā Lāvaṇya Rām
Rāvaṇ Mārdhana Raṇadhīrā Rām
Ayodhyā Vāsī Rājā Rām
Añjana Priy Sut Ātmābhi Rām

title: Rama Sita Krishna Radha
lyrics:
Rama Sita Krishna Radha Vitthala Rakhumayi Jai Jai Vittala Rakhumayi (2)
Surdas Prabhu Karuna Sagara Vittala Rakhumayi
Meera Ke Prabhu Giridhara Naagara Vittala Rakhumayi
Sai Natha Prabhu Gaana Manohara Vittala Rakhumayi Jai Jai Vittala Rakhumayi
Vittala Vittala Vittala Jai Jai (3)
Vittala Jai Jai Panduranga Jai Jai
Vittala Vittala Vittala Jai Jai
meaning: Glory to Lord Vitthala and Mother Rakhumayi, who embody the divine love of Rama-Sita and Krishna-Radha. You are the compassionate Lord of Surdas, Meera's beloved Giridhar, and the enchanting Sai Nath who delights in devotional song. All praise to you, O Panduranga!
devanagari:
राम सीता कृष्ण राधा विट्ठल रखुमाई जय जय विट्ठल रखुमाई (२)
सूरदास प्रभु करुणा सागर विट्ठल रखुमाई
मीरा के प्रभु गिरिधर नागर विट्ठल रखुमाई
साई नाथ प्रभु गान मनोहर विट्ठल रखुमाई जय जय विट्ठला रखुमाई
विट्ठल विट्ठल विट्ठल जय जय (३)
विट्ठल जय जय पाण्डुरंग जय जय
विट्ठल विट्ठल विट्ठल जय जय
respell:
Rām Sītā Kṛushṇa Rādhā Viṭṭhala Rakhumāī Jay Jay Viṭṭhala Rakhumāī (2)
Sūradās Prabhu Karuṇā Sāgar Viṭṭhala Rakhumāī
Mīrā Ke Prabhu Giridhara Nāgar Viṭṭhala Rakhumāī
Sāī Nātha Prabhu Gān Manohar Viṭṭhala Rakhumāī Jay Jay Viṭṭhalā Rakhumāī
Viṭṭhala Viṭṭhala Viṭṭhala Jay Jay (3)
Viṭṭhala Jay Jay Pāṇḍuraṅg Jay Jay
Viṭṭhala Viṭṭhala Viṭṭhala Jay Jay

title: Rama Sri Ramachandra Jaya Jaya Rama
lyrics:
Rama Sri Ramachandra Jaya Jaya Rama
Karunabhi Rama Kamaneeya Nama
Kodanda Rama Kalyana Rama
Sharanagata Paripalana Sri Charana Rama
Rama Sri Rama Sai Rama
Samara Vijaya Rama Saketa Rama
meaning: "O Lord Rama, embodiment of compassion and righteousness, wielder of the divine bow, protector of those who surrender to You, victorious over evil and Lord of Ayodhya, we sing Your glory and seek Your blessings
devanagari:
रामा श्री रामचन्द्र जय जय रामा
करुणाभि रामा कमनीय रामा [ रामा श्री ... ]
कोदंड रामा कल्याण रामा
शरणागत परिपालन श्री चरणा रामा
रामा श्री रामा साई रामा
समर विजय रामा साकेत रामा
respell:
Rāmā Shrī Rāmachandra Jaya Jaya Rāmā
Karuṇābhi Rāmā Kamanīya Rāmā [ Rāmā Shrī ... ]
Kodaṇḍa Rāmā Kalyāṇ Rāmā
Sharaṇāgat Paripālan Shrī Charaṇā Rāmā
Rāmā Shrī Rāmā Sāī Rāmā
Samara Vijaya Rāmā Sāket Rāmā

title: Ram Sumira Mana Ram Sumira Mana
lyrics:
Ram Sumira Mana Ram Sumira Mana
Ram Sumira Mana Ram
Janaki Vallabha Dasharatha Nandana
Ramachandra Sri Ram (3)
Bhaja Mana Sita Ram Ram Bhaja Mana Sita Ram
Bhaja Mana Radhe Shyam Shyam Bhaja Mana Radhe Shyam
Bhaja Mana Sai Ram Ram Bhaja Mana Sai Ram
meaning: O mind, chant the name of Lord Rama, the beloved of Sita and the son of King Dasharatha. Worship, Oh mind, Lord Rama, Lord Krishna and Lord Sai.
devanagari:
राम सुमिर मन राम सुमिर मन
राम सुमिर मन राम
जानकी वल्लभ दशरथ नंदन
रामचन्द्र श्री राम (3)
भज मन सीता राम राम भज मन सीता राम
भज मन राधे श्याम श्याम भज मन राधे श्याम
भज मन साई राम राम भज मन साई राम
respell:
Rām Sumira Man Rām Sumira Man
Rām Sumira Man Rām
Jānakī Vallabh Dasharath Nandana
Rāmachandra Shrī Rām (3)
Bhaja Mana Sītā Rām Rām Bhaja Mana Sītā Rām
Bhaja Mana Rādhe Shyām Shyām Bhaja Mana Rādhe Shyām
Bhaja Mana Sāī Rām Rām Bhaja Mana Sāī Rām

title: Ramachandra Prabhu Raghuvamsha Rama
lyrics:
Ramachandra Prabhu Raghuvamsha Rama
Sitapate Jaya Janaki Rama
Ahalyoddharaka Sugunabhi Rama
Ravana Samhara Kodanda Rama
Ayodhya Rama Pattabhi Rama
Nava Nava Komala Sri Sai Rama
Sitapate Jaya Janaki Rama
meaning: O Ramachandra, born in the Raghu dynasty, victory to You, the consort of Seetha. You uplifted Ahalya from her curse. You are the embodiment of fine qualities, You are the destroyer of Ravana, You are the One with a bow in one hand. You are the Rama of Ayodhya and You are verily our Sai Rama.
devanagari:
रामचन्द्र प्रभु रघु वंश रामा  
सीता पते जय जानकी रामा [ रामचन्द्र ... ]  
अहल्योधरक सुगुणाभि रामा  
रावण संहार कोदंड रामा  
अयोध्या रामा पट्टाभि रामा  
नव नव कोमल श्री साई रामा [ सीता पते ... ]
respell:
Rāmachandra Prabhu Raghu Vaṃsh Rāmā
Sītā Pate Jaya Jānakī Rāmā [ Rāmachandra ... ]
Ahalyodharak Suguṇābhi Rāmā
Rāvaṇ Saṃhār Kodaṇḍa Rāmā
Ayodhyā Rāmā Paṭṭābhi Rāmā
Nava Nava Komala Shrī Sāī Rāmā [ Sītā Pate ... ]

title: Ramachandra Raghuveera Ramachandra Ranadheera
lyrics:
Ramachandra Raghuveera Ramachandra Ranadheera
Ramachandra Raghunatha Ramachandra Jagannatha
Ramachandra Mama Bandho Ramachandra Daya Sindho
Raghuveera Ranadheera
Raghunatha Jagannatha
Raghurama Parandhama
Mama Bandho Daya Sindho (2)
meaning: Glory to Lord Rama, the hero of the Raghu dynasty. Glory to Ramachandra, the illustrious warrior prince. He is verily the heavenly abode, the goal of our life. He is the Lord of Raghu dynasty, the Lord of all worlds. He is our very own relative, the sea of mercy and compassion. Sing the glory of Lord Rama.
devanagari:
रामचन्द्र राघुवीरा रामचन्द्र रणधीरा
रामचन्द्र राघुनाथा रामचन्द्र जगन्नाथा
रामचन्द्र मम बन्धो रामचन्द्र दया सिंधो
राघुवीरा रणधीरा
राघुनाथा जगन्नाथा
रघुरामा परन्धामा
मम बन्धो दया सिंधो (2)
respell:
Rāmachandra Rāghuvīrā Rāmachandra Raṇadhīrā
Rāmachandra Rāghunāthā Rāmachandra Jagannāthā
Rāmachandra Mama Bandho Rāmachandra Dayā Sindho
Rāghuvīrā Raṇadhīrā
Rāghunāthā Jagannāthā
Raghurāmā Parandhāmā
Mama Bandho Dayā Sindho (2)

title: Ramachandra Sri Rama
lyrics:
Ramachandra Sri Rama
Sairama Jaya Rama
Dasharatha Nandana Dayabhi rama
Dashamukha Mardana Rama Rama
Tapasa Ranjana Taraka Nama
Ahalyoddharaka Rama Rama
meaning: Oh Lord Ramachandra, victorious and compassionate Sai Rama, beloved son of Dasharatha. You are the vanquisher of the ten-headed demon, whose sacred name delights ascetics and grants liberation. We praise You, the divine redeemer who uplifted Ahalya.
devanagari:
रामचंद्र श्री राम
साईरामा जय रामा
दशरथ नंदन दयाभिरामा
दशमुख मर्दन रामा रामा
तापस रंजन तारक नामा
अहल्योद्धारक रामा रामा
respell:
Rāmachandra Shrī Rām
Sāīrāmā Jaya Rāmā
Dasharath Nandana Dayābhirāmā
Dashamukha Mardana Rāmā Rāmā
Tāpasa Rañjana Tārak Nāmā
Ahalyoddhārak Rāmā Rāmā

title: Ramam Bhajo Raghu Ramam Bhajo
lyrics:
Ramam Bhajo Raghu Ramam Bhajo
Raghukula Tilakam Ramam Bhajo
Dasharatha Nandana Ramam Bhajo
Dasha Mukha Mardana Ramam Bhajo
meaning:
Sing the name of Lord Rama, the crest-jewel of Raghu clan.
Praise the Lord Rama the beloved son of Dasharatha.
Adore the Lord Rama who slayed the ten-headed demon, Ravana.
devanagari:
रामम् भजो रघु रामम् भजो
रघुकुल तिलकं रामम् भजो [ रामम् भजो ... ]
दशरथ नंदन रामम् भजो
दशमुख मर्धन रामम् भजो
respell:
Rāmam Bhajo Raghu Rāmam Bhajo
Raghukul Tilakaṃ Rāmam Bhajo [ Rāmam Bhajo ... ]
Dasharath Nandana Rāmam Bhajo
Dashamukha Mardhana Rāmam Bhajo

title: Ravikula Mandana Rajiva Lochana Raghava
lyrics:
Ravikula Mandana Rajiva Lochana Raghava
Vasudeva Nandana Bandha Vimochana Vasudeva
Karuna Niketana Krishna Janardana Keshava
Sri Madhusudana Murali Mohana Madhava
meaning: Sai took the form of Lord Rama of Raghu dynasty; In Dwapara yuga, He was the son of Vasudeva, as Krishna, who liberates us from bondage. The abode of compassion, the protector of all, the one who conquered the demon Madhu and the one who enchants all with the melody from his flute.
devanagari:
रविकुल मण्डन राजीव लोचन राघवा
वासुदेव नन्दन बन्ध विमोचन वासुदेवा
करुणा निकेतन कृष्ण जनार्दन केशवा
श्री मधुसूदन मुरली मोहन माधवा
respell:
Ravikul Maṇḍana Rājīva Lochana Rāghavā
Vāsudeva Nandana Bandha Vimochana Vāsudevā
Karuṇā Niketana Kṛushṇa Janārdana Keshavā
Shrī Madhusūdana Muralī Mohan Mādhavā

title: Remind Me My Lord
lyrics:
Remind Me My Lord (3) Who I Am
I Am Aum, I Am Aum, Eternal Aum
Through This Life Of Distraction And Of Illusion, Remind Me ...
... My Lord, Who I Am
I Am Truth, I Am Peace, Divine Bliss
Ananda Swaroopa, Hey Prema Swaroopa, Remind Me My Lord Who I Am
I Am Love, I Am Love, Pure Love
meaning: Oh Lord, amidst the distractions and illusions of this life, please remind me of my true self. I am the eternal Aum, the very essence of Truth, Peace, and divine Bliss, the embodiment of pure Love. Awaken me to this inherent divinity within.
devanagari:
रीमाइन्ड मी माइ लोर्ड हू आइ ऐम
आइ ऐम ॐ आइ ऐम ॐ इटरनल ॐ
थ्रू दिस लाइफ अव डिस्ट्रैक्शन अन्ड अव इलूजन रीमाइन्ड मी
माइ लोर्ड हू आइ ऐम
आइ ऐम ट्रूथ आइ ऐम पीस डिवाइन ब्लिस
आनंद स्वरूपा हे प्रेम स्वरूपा रीमाइन्ड मी माइ लोर्ड हू आइ ऐम
आइ ऐम लव आइ ऐम लव प्युर लव

title: Repeat His Name Sai Ram
lyrics:
Repeat His Name, Sai Ram, Sai Ram
Say It With Love, Sai Ram, Sai Ram
Picture His Form, Sai Ram, Sai Ram
He Is Everywhere, Feel Him Shining Within You
Rama Rama Ram Ram, Sai Rama Ram Ram
meaning: Let us lovingly repeat the sacred name of Sai Ram, visualizing his divine form. He is omnipresent, dwelling everywhere and shining as the inner light within each of us. Chant "Rama Rama Ram Ram, Sai Rama Ram Ram" to feel his presence.
devanagari:
रिपीट हिज़ नेम, साई राम, साई राम
से इट विथ लव, साई राम, साई राम
पिक्चर हिज़ फॉर्म, साई राम, साई राम
ही इज़ एव्री वेयर, फील हिम शाइनिंग विदिन यू
राम राम राम राम, साई राम राम राम
respell:
Ripīṭ Hija़ Nem, Sāī Rām, Sāī Rām
Se Iṭ Vith Lav, Sāī Rām, Sāī Rām
Pikchar Hija़ Phaॉrm, Sāī Rām, Sāī Rām
Hī Ija़ Evrī Veyar, Phīl Him Shāiniṅg Vidin yū
Rām Rām Rām Rām, Sāī Rām Rām Rām

title: Rhum Jhum Nacho Nanda Dular
lyrics:
Rhum Jhum Nacho Nanda Dular
Madhava Murahara Madana Gopal [Rhum Jhum Nacho...]
Radha Manohara Natavara Lal
Govinda Giridhara Murali Gopal
meaning: Oh beloved child of Nanda, dance with the sweet sound of anklets! You are Madhava, the destroyer of Mura, the enchanting Gopal, who captivates Radha's heart as the supreme dancer. Oh Govinda, lifter of mountains, you are our playful darling, the flute-playing cowherd.
devanagari:
रुमझुम नाचो नंद दुलार
माधव मुरहर मदन गोपाल
राधा मनोहर नटवर लाल
गोविंद गिरिधर मुरली गोपाल
respell:
Rumajhum Nācho Nand Dulār
Mādhava Murahar Madana Gopāl
Rādhā Manohar Naṭavar Lāl
Govind Giridhara Muralī Gopāl

title: Sab Ka Malik Ek Hai Sai Tum Ho Bhagawan
lyrics:
Sab Ka Malik Ek Hai Sai Tum Ho Bhagawan
Sarvadharma Priya Ram Parthipureeshwara Ram
Manava Seva Madhava Seva Sabko Seva Karo
Bhajan Bina Sukh Shanti Nahin Sai Bhajan Karo
Prem Se Sabko Seva Karo Sai Bhajan Karo
Allah Sai Ram Buddha Yeshu Bhagawan
Nanak Sai Ram Zoroastra Mahavir Nam
meaning: Sai, the one Lord of all, embodies the divine and is cherished by every faith. Serve all beings with love, for service to humanity is service to God, and find true peace and happiness through devotional singing of Sai's glory.
devanagari:
सब का मालिक एक है साईं तुम हो भगवान
सर्व धर्म प्रिय राम पर्ति पूरीश्वर राम
मानवा सेवा माधव सबकी सेवा करो
भजन बिना सुख शांति नहीं साईं भजन करो
प्रेम से सबकी सेवा करो साईं भजन करो
अल्लाह साईं राम बुद्ध येशु भगवान
नानक साईं राम ज़ोराष्ट्र महावीर नाम
respell:
Sab Kā Mālik Ek Hai Sāīṃ Tum Ho Bhagavān
Sarwa Dharma Priy Rām Parti pūrīshwar rām
Mānavā Sevā Mādhava Sabakī Sevā Karo
Bhajan Binā Sukh Shānti Nahīṃ Sāīṃ Bhajan Karo
Prem Se Sabakī Sevā Karo Sāīṃ Bhajan Karo
Allāh Sāīṃ Rām Buddha Yeshu Bhagavān
Nānak Sāīṃ Rām ज़orāshṭra Mahāvīr Nām

title: Sabari Girisha Engal Nayaka
lyrics:
Sabari Girisha Engal Nayaka, Sharanam Ayyappa Swami Sharanam Ayyappa
Mohana Roopa Mohini Bala
Sharanam Sharanam Bhagawane Sharanam Ayyappa
Parthi Pureesha Sadguru Deva, Sharanam Ayyappa Swami Sharanam Ayyappa
Jyothi Swaroopa Paapa Vinasha [ Sharanam Sharanam ... ]
Sharanam Sharanam Ayyappa Swami Sharanam Ayyappa (2)
meaning:
O Lord of Sabarimala, our beloved Leader and Protector, we seek refuge in You, O Lord Ayyappa!
O One of enchanting form, O Divine Son of Mohini,
We surrender to You, O Lord; we seek refuge in You, O Ayyappa!
O Lord of Parthi, O Divine Sadguru, we seek refuge in You, O Lord Ayyappa!
O Embodiment of Divine Light, Destroyer of sins,
We surrender to You, O Lord; we seek refuge in You, O Ayyappa!
Refuge in You, O Lord Ayyappa! Refuge in You, O Lord Ayyappa!
devanagari:
सबरी गिरिशा एंगल नायका, शरणम् अय्यप्पा स्वामी शरणम् अय्यप्पा  
मोहन रूपा मोहिनी बाला  
शरणम् शरणम् भगवाने शरणम् अय्यप्पा  
पर्तिपूरीशा सद्गुरु देवा, शरणम् अय्यप्पा स्वामी शरणम् अय्यप्पा  
ज्योति स्वरूपा पाप विनाशा [ शरणम् शरणम् ... ]  
शरणम् शरणम् अय्यप्पा स्वामी शरणम् अय्यप्पा (2)
respell:
Sabarī Girishā Eṅgal Nāyakā, Sharaṇam Ayyappā Swāmī Sharaṇam Ayyappā
Mohan Rūpā Mohinī Bālā
Sharaṇam Sharaṇam Bhagavāne Sharaṇam Ayyappā
Partipūrīshā Sadguru Devā, Sharaṇam Ayyappā Swāmī Sharaṇam Ayyappā
Jyoti Swarūpā Pāpa Vināshā [ Sharaṇam Sharaṇam ... ]
Sharaṇam Sharaṇam Ayyappā Swāmī Sharaṇam Ayyappā (2)

title: Sada Nirantara Hari Gun Gao
lyrics:
Sada Nirantara Hari Gun Gao
Prema Bhakthi Se Bhajan Sunao
Sai Nath Ke Charanon Mein Aao
Man Mandir Mein Deep Jalao
Jeevan Naiya Par Lagao
meaning: Always sing the glory of our Lord; Let the bhajan resound with love and devotion; Come to the lotus feet of our Lord Sai; In your heart's temple, light the lamp of love; He will take you across the ocean of life.
devanagari:
सदा निरंतर हरि गुण गाओ
प्रेम भक्ती से भजन सुनाओ [ सदा निरंतर ... ]
साई नाथ के चरणों में आओ
मन मंदिर में दीप जलाओ
जीवन नैया पार लगाओ
respell:
Sadā Nirantara Hari Guṇ Gāo
Prem Bhaktī Se Bhajan Sunāo [ Sadā Nirantara ... ]
Sāī Nāth Ke Charaṇoṃ Meṃ Āo
Man Mandir Meṃ Dīp Jalāo
Jīvan Naiyā Pār Lagāo

title: Sada Shivaranjani Sai Janani
lyrics:
Sada Shivaranjani Sai Janani
Shambavi Shankari Durga Bhavani
Akhilandeshwari Raja Rajeshwari
Mata Maheshwari Narayani
meaning:
O Divine Mother Sai, the ever auspicious and blissful.
You are the Divine consort of Lord Shiva, the remover of negative forces (Durga), the giver of existence (Bhavani).
You are the supreme Empress who rules the entire cosmos, the Divine mother of all who guides the humans in their ultimate journey (Narayani).
devanagari:
सदा शिवरंजनी साई जननी
शाम्भवी शंकरी दुर्गा भवानी
अखिलंडेश्वरी राज राजेश्वरी
माता महेश्वरी नारायणी
respell:
Sadā Shivarañjanī Sāī Jananī
Shāmbhavī Shaṅkarī Durgā Bhavānī
Akhilaṇḍeshwarī Rāj Rājeshwarī
Mātā Maheshwarī Nārāyaṇī

title: Sadguru Brahma Sanatana Hey
lyrics:
Sadguru Brahma Sanatana Hey
Parama Daya Ghana Pavana Hey
Janmaja Dukha Vinashana Hey
Jagadoddharana Karana Hey
(Sathya) Sai Krishna Janardhana Hey
Bhava Bhaya Jaladhi Tarana Hey
meaning: Worship the compassionate, noble Guru, who is eternal. He is the saviour of the world, who alone can help overcome the sorrows. O Sai Krishna, please help us cross the ocean of life and death.
devanagari:
सद्गुरु ब्रह्म सनातन हे
परम दयाघन पावन हे
जन्मज दुःख विनाशन हे
जगतोद्धारण कारण हे
साई कृष्ण जनार्दन हे
जनार्दन हे जनार्दन हे [ साई कृष्ण ... ]
भव भय जलधि तारण हे
respell:
Sadguru Brahma Sanātana He
Param Dayāghan Pāvan He
Janmaja Duḥkha Vināshan He
Jagatoddhāraṇ Kāraṇ He
sāī Kṛushṇ Janārdana He
Janārdana He Janārdan He [ sāī kṛushṇa ... ]
bhava bhaya jaladhi tāraṇ he

title: Sadguru Nadane Va Va Va
lyrics:
Sadguru Nadane Va Va Va
Satchidanandane Va Va Va
Sarva dayalane Va Va Va
Sathya Sayi Nadane Va Va Va
Shirdipuri Vasane Va Va Va
Parthipuri Vasane Va Va Va
Shiva Shakthi Roopane Va Va Va [ Sathya Sayi ... ]
Sadguru Nathudey Maa Baba
Satchidanandudey Maa Baba
Sarva Dayaludey Maa Baba
Sathya Sai Nathudey Maa Baba
meaning: O True Guru, Lord Sathya Sai, embodiment of Truth, Consciousness, and Bliss, we earnestly call for your presence! You are the all-merciful one, dwelling in Shirdi and Parthi, the very form of Shiva and Shakti. Indeed, you are our beloved Baba, our divine guide and source of all compassion.
devanagari:
सद्गुरु नाथने वा वा वा 
सच्चिदानंदने वा वा वा 
सर्व दयालने वा वा वा 
सत्य साई नाथने वा वा वा 
शिर्डीपुरी वासने वा वा वा 
पर्तीपुरी वासने वा वा वा 
शिव शक्ति रूपने वा वा वा 
सद्गुरु नाथुडे मा बाबा
सच्चिदानंदुडे मा बाबा
सर्व दयालुडे मा बाबा
सत्य साई नाथुडे मा बाबा
respell:
Sadguru Nāthane Vā Vā Vā
Sachchidānandane Vā Vā Vā
Sarwa dayālane Vā Vā Vā
Satya Sāī Nāthane Vā Vā Vā
Shirḍīpurī Vāsane Vā Vā Vā
Partīpurī Vāsane Vā Vā Vā
Shiv Shakti Rūpane Vā Vā Vā
Sadguru Nāthuḍe Mā Bābā
Sachchidānanduḍe Mā Bābā
Sarwa Dayāluḍe Mā Bābā
Satya Sāī Nāthuḍe Mā Bābā

title: Sadguru Sai Ram Jai Bolo Sadguru Sai Ram
lyrics:
Sadguru Sai Ram Jai Bolo Sadguru Sai Ram
Mata Pita Prabhu Ram Sai Bandhu Sakha Bhagawan
Allah Sai Ram Nanak Yeshu Sai Ram
Zoroastra Sai Ram Sai Ram Gautama Sai Ram
Jai Bolo Sai Ram Jai Jai Sai Ram
Jai Bolo Sai Ram Ram Jai Sathya Sai Ram
Jai Sathya Sai Ram
meaning: Chant Victory to our Divine Preceptor Sai Ram who is our mother, father, lord, relative and friend. O Lord Sathya Sai, You are verily Allah, Guru Nanak, Jesus Christ, Zohrashtra and Gautama Buddha. Victory to Thee, O Lord.
devanagari:
सद्गुरु साई राम जय बोलो सद्गुरु साई राम  
माता पिता प्रभु राम साई बंधु सखा भगवान  
[ सद्गुरु साई ... ]  
अल्लाह साई राम नानक येसु साई राम  
जोराष्ट्र साई राम साई राम गौतम साई राम  
जय बोलो साई राम जय जय साई राम  
जय बोलो साई राम राम जय सत्य साई राम  
जय सत्य साई राम
respell:
Sadguru Sāī Rām Jay Bolo Sadguru Sāī Rām
Mātā Pitā Prabhu Rām Sāī Bandhu Sakhā Bhagavān
[ Sadguru Sāī ... ]
Allāh Sāī Rām Nānak Yesu Sāī Rām
Jorāshṭra Sāī Rām Sāī Rām Gautama Sāī Rām
Jay Bolo Sāī Rām Jay Jay Sāī Rām
Jay Bolo Sāī Rām Rām Jay Satya Sāī Rām
Jay Satya Sāī Rām

title: Sadguru Sai Saraswati
lyrics:
Sadguru Sai Saraswati
Brahma Deva Sati Bharati
Mangala Manjula Vagvilasini
Veena Vadini Kalavati
Hamsa Vahini Vidya Dayini
Veda Mata Sri Sai Bhagawati
meaning: Worship the Supreme Teacher, Sai, the auspicious embodiment of all learning and wisdom (Saraswati), consort of Lord Brahma (Creator aspect of the Trinity); the one who is adept in the art of producing sweet melodies on the Veena (string instrument) and the bestower of all knowledge, who has the celestial swan as vehicle.
devanagari:
सद्गुरु साई सरस्वती  
ब्रह्म देव सती भारती  
मंगल मंजुल वाग्विलासिनी  
वीणा वादिनी कलावती  
हंस वाहिनी विद्या दायिनी  
वेद माता श्री साई भगवती
respell:
Sadguru Sāī Saraswatī
Brahma Deva Satī Bhāratī
Maṅgal Mañjula Vāgwilāsinī
Vīṇā Vādinī Kalāvatī
Haṃs Vāhinī Vidyā Dāyinī
Ved Mātā Shrī Sāī Bhagavatī

title: Sahara Do Bhagawan
lyrics:
Sahara Do Bhagawan
Mujhe Daya Karo Mujhe Krupa Karo
Mujhe Sanmati Do Bhagawan
Sada Sath Raho He Bhagawan
Sada Raksha Karo He Bhagawan
Shanti Bhakti Prem Do Bhagawan
meaning: O Lord, be my constant support, showering me with your mercy and enlightened wisdom. Remain ever by my side, offering your divine protection, and fill my being with peace, devotion, and pure love.
devanagari:
सहारा दो भगवान
मुझे दया करो मुझे कृपा करो
सन्मति दो भगवान [ सहारा दो ... ]
सदा साथ रहो हे भगवान
सदा रक्षा करो हे भगवान
शांति भक्ति प्रेम दो भगवान
respell:
Sahārā Do Bhagavān
Mujhe Dayā Karo Mujhe Kṛupā Karo
Sanmati Do Bhagavān [ Sahārā Do ... ]
Sadā Sāth Raho He Bhagavān
Sadā Rakshā Karo He Bhagavān
Shānti Bhakti Prem Do Bhagavān

title: Sai Om Sai Om Sai Om
lyrics:
Sai Om Sai Om Sai Om
Tan Man Pran Mein Sai Om
Shayan Sapan Mein Sai Om
Gagan Pavan Mein Sai Om
Nayan Nayan Mein Sai Om
Janam Maran Mein Sai Om
meaning: Sai Om, Sai Om, Sai Om! Your divine presence resonates within my body, mind, and life-breath. From the depths of sleep and dreams to the expanse of sky and wind, in every gaze and through the journey of birth and death, Sai Om, You are eternally manifest.
devanagari:
साई ॐ साई ॐ साई ॐ
तन मन प्राण में साई ॐ [ साई ॐ ... ]
शयन सपन में साई ॐ
गगन पवन में साई ॐ [ शयन ... ]
नयन नयन में साई ॐ
जनम मरण में साई ॐ
respell:
Sāī Oṃ Sāī Oṃ Sāī Oṃ
Tan Man Prāṇ Meṃ Sāī Oṃ [ Sāī Oṃ ... ]
Shayan Sapan Meṃ Sāī Oṃ
Gagan Pavan Meṃ Sāī Oṃ [ Shayan ... ]
Nayan Nayan Meṃ Sāī Oṃ
Janam Maraṇ Meṃ Sāī Oṃ

title: Sai Avatara Parthi Pureesha
lyrics:
Sai (Prema) Avatara Parthi Pureesha 
Jagadodhara Namo
Eswaramba Nandana Prema Avatara
Tum Ho Merey Pran (Baba)
Parthipuri Bhagawan
Daya (Krupa) Karo Bhagawan
Jagadodhara Namo
meaning: O Sai, divine incarnation of Love, Lord of Parthi and son of Eswaramba, you are the very breath of my life. We bow to you, the savior of the universe, and earnestly pray, O Lord of Parthipuri, please shower us with your boundless grace.
devanagari:
साई (प्रेम) अवतारा पर्ती पूरीशा
जगतोद्धार नमो
ईश्वराम्बा नंदन प्रेम अवतारा
तुम हो मेरे प्राण (बाबा)
पर्तीपुरी भगवान
दया (कृपा) करो भगवान
जगतोद्धार नमो
respell:
Sāī (prem) Avatārā Partī Pūrīshā
Jagatoddhāra Namo
Īshwarāmbā Nandana Prem Avatārā
Tum Ho Mere Prāṇ (bābā)
Partīpurī Bhagavān
Dayā (kṛupā) Karo Bhagavān
Jagatoddhāra Namo

title: Sai Avatara Yuga Avatara
lyrics:
Sai Avatara Yuga Avatara
Deena Dayala Sankata Hara
Sai Brahma Sai Vishnu
Sai Maheshwara
Sathya Sai Prema Sai
Sab Dharmon Ke Baba Sai
Sai Parameshwara
meaning: O Supreme Lord Sai! O incarnation of this Kali Age! You are the protector of the meek, the remover of danger. You are Brahma (Creator), Vishnu (Sustainer) and Maheshwara (Destroyer of evil) and the beloved Sai of devotees. Chant the name of the Lord of Lords, Lord Sathya Sai, Prema Sai, who loves all religions.
devanagari:
साई अवतारा युग अवतारा
दीन दयाला संकट हारा [ साई अवतारा ... ]
साई ब्रह्मा साई विष्णु
साई महेश्वरा [ साई अवतारा ... ]
सत्य साई प्रेम साई
सब धर्मों के बाबा साई
साई परमेश्वरा
respell:
Sāī Avatārā Yug Avatārā
Dīna Dayālā Saṅkaṭ Hārā [ Sāī Avatārā ... ]
Sāī Brahmā Sāī Vishṇu
Sāī Maheshwarā [ Sāī Avatārā ... ]
Satya Sāī Prem Sāī
Sab Dharmoṃ Ke Bābā Sāī
Sāī Parameshwarā

title: Sai Baba Geeta Sudha Madhuram Madhuram Anandam
lyrics:
Sai Baba Geeta Sudha Madhuram Madhuram Anandam (3)
Shirdi Baba Geeta Sudha Madhuram Madhuram Anandam
Parthi Baba Geeta Sudha Madhuram Madhuram Anandam
meaning: The divine utterances of Sai Baba, from both Shirdi and Parthi, are a sweet, blissful nectar. Listening to these sacred words brings immense joy and spiritual delight.
devanagari:
साई बाबा गीता सुधा मधुरम् मधुरम् आनन्दम् (3)
शिर्डी (पर्ती) बाबा गीता सुधा मधुरम् मधुरम् आनन्दम्
respell:
Sāī Bābā Gītā Sudhā Madhuram Madhuram Ānandam (3)
Shirḍī (partī) Bābā Gītā Sudhā Madhuram Madhuram Ānandam

title: Sai Baba Pranam
lyrics:
Sai Baba Pranam
Shirdi Baba Pranam
O Mere Atma Ram
Lelo Mere Pranam
Eshwar Allah Ram
Sab Ke Prabhu Sai Ram
Pooran Karo Mere Kam
Hey Parama Shanti Priya Ram
meaning: Kindly accept my offering of salutations, O indweller of every being, Sai Baba, who is the incarnation of the Sai of Shirdi. Sing the names of Sai like Ishwar, Allah and Ram, for he belongs to every Home. Please bless me for the successful completion of all my works, O embodiment of eternal Peace.
devanagari:
साई बाबा प्रणाम
शिर्डी बाबा प्रणाम
ओ मेरे आत्मा राम
लेलो मेरे प्रणाम
ईश्वर अल्लाह राम
सब के घर साई राम
पूरण करो मेरे काम
हे परम शान्ति प्रिय राम
respell:
Sāī Bābā Praṇām
Shirḍī Bābā Praṇām
O Mere Ātmā Rām
Lelo Mere Praṇām
Īshwar Allāh Rām
Sab Ke Ghar Sāī Rām
Pūraṇ Karo Mere Kām
He Param Shānti Priy Rām

title: Sai Baba Sakala Bhuvan Ke Data
lyrics:
Sai Baba Sakala Bhuvan Ke Data
Roopa Manohara Kamala Kanta
Yuga Avatar Sai Baba Daya Karo Parthi Baba
Shirdi Parthi Hrudaya Nivasi
Prasanthi Sundara Sai
meaning:
Sai Baba, the Protector of the Universe. 
O Master of Kamala (Mother Lakshmi) whose form is bewitchingly beautiful. 
O Avatar of this Age, Baba of Parthi shower Your mercy
You reside in Shirdi and Parthi, and in all hearts
O beautiful Lord Sai of Prasanthi.
devanagari:
साई बाबा सकला भुवन के दाता (3)
रूप मनोहर कमला कांता
युग अवतार साई बाबा दया करो पर्ती बाबा
शिर्डी पर्ती हृदय निवासी
प्रशांति सुंदर साई
respell:
Sāī Bābā Sakalā Bhuvan Ke Dātā (3)
Rūp Manohar Kamalā Kāntā
Yug Avatār Sāī Bābā Dayā Karo Partī Bābā
Shirḍī Partī Hṛudaya Nivāsī
Prashānti Sundara Sāī

title: Sai Sathya Palana
lyrics:
Sai Sathya Palana
Baba Sathya Palana
Shirdipuri Vasa Sai Sarvesha
He Shirdipuri Vasa He Parthipuri Vasa Sarvesha Sathya Palana  [Sai Sathya ..]
Akhila Nivasa Jaya Hrishikesha
Mangalakara He Pavana Purusha
Shirdipuri Vasa Sai Sarvesha  [He Shirdipuri Vasa...]
meaning: Glory to You Lord Sai Baba, the Embodiment of Truth. Glory to You, Lord of Shirdi and Parthi, the embodiment and protector of Truth. Glory to the Supreme Lord who is Omnipresent and who bestows auspiciousness and Grace.
devanagari:
साई (बाबा) सत्य पालना
शिर्डीपुरी वासा साई सर्वेशा
हे पर्तिर्पुरी वासा हे शिर्डीपुरी वासा सर्वेशा सत्य पालना [ साई सत्य ... ]  
अखिल निवासा जय हृषीकेशा
मंगलकारा हे पावन पुरुशा
शिर्डीपुरी वासा साई सर्वेशा [ हे पर्तिर्पुरी वासा ... ]
respell:
Sāī (bābā) Satya Pālanā
Shirḍīpurī Vāsā Sāī Sarweshā
He Partirpurī Vāsā He Shirḍīpurī Vāsā Sarweshā Satya Pālanā [ Sāī Satya ... ]
Akhil Nivāsā Jaya Hṛushīkeshā
Maṅgalakārā He Pāvan Purushā
Shirḍīpurī Vāsā Sāī Sarweshā [ He Partirpurī Vāsā ... ]

title: Sai Bina Raha Na Jaaye
lyrics:
Mohabbat Ki Kami Dil Mein Agar Ehasaas Hota Hai
Zara Jhanko To Paaoge Ki Sai Paas Hota Hai
O...Karishma Ye Useekaa Hai, Ki, Duniya Khoob Soorat Lagati Hai
Varnaa Admi Ko Admi Kya Raas Hota Hai 

Sai Bina Raha Na Jaaye (2)
Chain Na Aaye Mohe Chain Na Aaye (Sai Bina..) 
Jabse Dekha Tujhko Sai Mere
Darsh Ke Pyaase Naina Saanjh Savere
Aa..
Jabse Hai Dekha Tujhko Sai Mere
Darsh Ke Pyaase Naina Saanjh Savere 
Mit Mar Jaayen Tujhpe Hum Se Na Ruthe Tu
Zindagi Saunp De Ham Charano Mein Tere Yun (2)
Mana Mandir Se Jao Na Sai (2)
Chain Na Aaye Mohe Chain Na Aaye 

Sai Bina Raha Na Jaaye
Tu Mera Dil Meri Dhadkan Tu Hi Hai Manzil Meri (2)
Mera Jeevan Tere Darshan Meri Sab Saansen Hai teri (3)
Tujhpe Kurba Ho Ye Jeevan (2)
Ab Tamanna Hai Ye Meri
Ab Tamanna Hai Ye Meri, Bas Tamanna Hai Meri 
Tujhepe Kurba Ho Ye Jeevan Ab Tamanna Hai Ye Meri... 

Sai Bina Raha Na Jaaye...  Aa...
meaning: Oh Sai, when my heart feels a lack of love, I find You ever-present within; it is Your miracle that makes the world beautiful, for without You, I find no peace. My eyes constantly thirst for Your divine sight, and I cannot live without You, for You are my heart, my destination, and my every breath.
devanagari:
मोहब्बत की कमी दिल में अगर एहसास होता है  
जरा झांको तो पाओगे की साई पास होता है  
ओ...करिश्मा ये उसेका है, की, दुनिया खूबसूरत लगती है  
वरना आदमी को आदमी क्या रास होता है  

साई बिना रहा न जाए (2)  
चैन न आए मोहे चैन न आए (साई बिना..)  
जबसे देखा तुझको साई मेरे  
दर्शन के प्यासे नैनां सांझ सवेरे  
आ..  
जबसे है देखा तुझको साई मेरे  
दर्शन के प्यासे नैनां सांझ सवेरे  
मिट मर जाएं तुझपे हम से न रूठे तू  
जिंदगी सौंप दे हम चरणों में तेरे यूं (2)  
मान मंदिर से जाओ न साई (2)  
चैन न आए मोहे चैन न आए  

साई बिना रहा न जाए  
तू मेरा दिल मेरी धड़कन तू ही है मंजिल मेरी (2)  
मेरा जीवन तेरे दर्शन मेरी सब सांसें हैं तेरी (3)  
तुझपे कुर्बान हो ये जीवन (2)  
अब तमन्ना है ये मेरी  
अब तमन्ना है ये मेरी, बस तमन्ना है मेरी  
तुझेपे कुर्बान हो ये जीवन अब तमन्ना है ये मेरी...  

साई बिना रहा न जाए...  आ...
respell:
Mohabbat Kī Kamī Dil Meṃ Agar Ehasās Hotā Hai
Jarā Jhāṅko To Pāoge Kī Sāī Pās Hotā Hai
O...karishmā Ye Usekā Hai, Kī, Duniyā Khūbasūrat Lagatī Hai
Varanā Ādamī Ko Ādamī Kyā Rās Hotā Hai

Sāī Binā Rahā N Jāe (2)
Chain N Āe Mohe Chain N Āe (sāī Binā..)
Jabase Dekhā Tujhako Sāī Mere
Darshan Ke Pyāse Naināṃ Sāñjh Savere
Ā..
Jabase Hai Dekhā Tujhako Sāī Mere
Darshan Ke Pyāse Naināṃ Sāñjh Savere
Miṭ Mar Jāeṃ Tujhape Ham Se N Rūṭhe Tū
Jindagī Saump De Ham Charaṇoṃ Meṃ Tere Yūṃ (2)
Māna Mandir Se Jāo N Sāī (2)
Chain N Āe Mohe Chain N Āe

Sāī Binā Rahā N Jāe
Tū Merā Dil Merī Dhaḍa़kan Tū Hī Hai Mañjil Merī (2)
Merā Jīvan Tere Darshan Merī Sab Sāṃseṃ Haiṃ terī (3)
Tujhape Kurbāna Ho Ye Jīvan (2)
Ab Tamannā Hai Ye Merī
Ab Tamannā Hai Ye Merī, Bas Tamannā Hai Merī
Tujhepe Kurbāna Ho Ye Jīvan Ab Tamannā Hai Ye Merī...

Sāī Binā Rahā N Jāe...  Ā...

title: Sai Charan Sukh Dayi Man
lyrics:
Sai Charan Sukh Dayi Man
Sai Bina Jeena Kya Hain
Sai Charan Sukh Dayi Man
Mata Bhi Tum Pita Bhi Tum
Aao Bhagawan Deejo Darshan
Basjao Sai Man Mandir Mein
Sai Bina Jeena Kya Hain
meaning: Know O Mind, there is no greater peace and bliss than when you surrender at the Feet of Sai. What is life without You, O Sai? Sai, You are our Mother and our Father. Please show us Your darshan and install Yourself in our hearts, for what is life without You?
devanagari:
साई चरण सुख दायी मन
साई बिना जीना क्या हैं
साई चरण सुख दायी मन
माता भी तुम पिता भी तुम
आओ भगवन दीजो दर्शन
बसजाओ साई मन मंदिर में
साई बिना जीना क्या हैं
respell:
Sāī Charaṇ Sukh Dāyī Man
Sāī Binā Jīnā Kyā Haiṃ
Sāī Charaṇ Sukh Dāyī Man
Mātā Bhī Tum Pitā Bhī Tum
Āo Bhagavan Dījo Darshan
Basajāo Sāī Man Mandir Meṃ
Sāī Binā Jīnā Kyā Haiṃ

title: Sai Ghana Shyam Sai Ghana Shyam
lyrics:
Sai Ghana Shyam Sai Ghana Shyam
Radhe Govinda Bhajo Radhe Gopala Bhajo
Murali Gopala Bhajo Sai Ghana Shyam
Sai Ghana Shyam Sai Ghana Shyam
Sai Ghana Shyam Shyam Sai Ghana Shyam
meaning: Oh Sai, whose complexion is like a dark rain cloud, we lovingly chant your sacred names. We worship Radha's beloved Govinda and Gopala, the divine flute-player, recognizing you as the embodiment of these forms.
devanagari:
साई घन श्याम साई घन श्याम
राधे गोविंद भजो राधे गोपाल भजो
मुरली गोपाल भजो साई घन श्याम
साई घन श्याम साई घन श्याम
साई घन श्याम श्याम साई घन श्याम
respell:
Sāī Ghan Shyām Sāī Ghan Shyām
Rādhe Govind Bhajo Rādhe Gopāla Bhajo
Muralī Gopāla Bhajo Sāī Ghan Shyām
Sāī Ghan Shyām Sāī Ghan Shyām
Sāī Ghan Shyām Shyām Sāī Ghan Shyām

title: Sai Hain Jeevan Jeevan Sathya Sai
lyrics:
Sai Hain Jeevan Jeevan Sathya Sai
Sai Mera Jeevan Sahara
Tere Bina Sai Sab Hain Andhera
Par Karo Meri Jeevan Naiya
Charan Lagalo Mujhe Sai Kanhaiya
meaning: O Lord Sathya Sai! You are my life. You are the constant companion and support in my life. Without You there is darkness (ignorance) in my life. Kindly help me to cross the ocean of life and death. O Lord Sai Krishna! Accept me at Your Lotus Feet.
devanagari:
साईं है जीवन जीवन सत्य साईं
साईं मेरा जीवन सहारा [ साईं है ... ]
तेरे बिना साईं सब है अंधेरा
पार करो मेरे जीवन नैया
चरण लगालो मुझे साईं कन्हैया
respell:
Sāīṃ Hai Jīvan Jīvan Satya Sāīṃ
Sāīṃ Merā Jīvan Sahārā [ Sāīṃ Hai ... ]
Tere Binā Sāīṃ Sab Hai Andherā
Pār Karo Mere Jīvan Naiyā
Charaṇ Lagālo Mujhe Sāīṃ Kanhaiyā

title: Sai Hamara Hum Sai Ke Aisa Prem Hamara
lyrics:
Sai Hamara Hum Sai Ke Aisa Prem Hamara
Sai Ram Hamara Sai Ram Hamara
Sathya Sai Hai Nam Tumhara Shirdi Sai Avatara
Hindu Muslim Sikh Isai Sabka Palan Hara
Sai Ram Hamara Sai Ram Hamara
meaning: O Lord Sai, we belong to You and You are verily ours ; this is the loving relationship that we share ; Glory to you, O Lord Sai Ram, You are ours. Praise to be Lord Sathya Sai who is the Avatar of Shirdi Sai and who is the nourisher and protector of Hindus Muslims Sikhs and Christians.
devanagari:
साई हमारा हम साई के ऐसा प्रेम हमारा
साई राम हमारा साई राम हमारा
सत्य साई है नाम तुम्हारा शिर्डी साई अवतारा [ साई राम ... ]
हिंदू मुस्लिम सिख ईसाई सब का पालनहारा [ साई राम ... ]
respell:
Sāī Hamārā Ham Sāī Ke Aisā Prem Hamārā
Sāī Rām Hamārā Sāī Rām Hamārā
Satya Sāī Hai Nām Tumhārā Shirḍī Sāī Avatārā [ Sāī Rām ... ]
Hindū Muslim Sikh Īsāī Sab Kā Pālanahārā [ Sāī Rām ... ]

title: Sai Jayanti Prashanthi Niketana
lyrics:
Sai Jayanti Prashanthi Niketana
Hrudaya Sarathi Sathya Sanatana  [ Sai Jayanti ... ]
Sumadhura Gambhira Naama Sankeertana
Bhaktha Vrinda Karey Ananda Narthana
meaning: O Sai, glory of Prashanthi Niketana, You are the eternal Truth, the charioteer guiding our hearts. As Your profoundly sweet name is chanted, the assembly of devotees dances in pure bliss.
devanagari:
साई जयंती प्रशांति निकेतन
हृदय सारथी सत्य सनातन
सुमधुर गंभीर नाम संकीर्तन
भक्त वृंद करे आनंद नर्तन
respell:
Sāī Jayantī Prashānti Niketana
Hṛudaya Sārathī Satya Sanātana
Sumadhura Gambhīra Nāma Saṅkīrtana
Bhakta Vṛund Kare Ānanda Nartana

title: Sai Kanhaiya Sai Kanhaiya
lyrics:
Sai Kanhaiya Sai Kanhaiya
Par Karo Meri Jeevana Naiya
Tum Ho Mere Ma Bap Bhaiya
Hrudaya Nivasi Krishna Kanhaiya
Hrudaya Nivasi Sai Kanhaiya
Par Karo Meri Jeevana Naiya
meaning: O Lord Sai Krishna, ferry us across the ocean of life. You are verily our Mother, Father and Brother. Glory to Lord Sai Krishna Who resides in our Inner Conscience
devanagari:
साईं कन्हैया साईं कन्हैया
पार करो मेरे जीवन नैया
तुम हो मेरे माँ बाप भईया
हृदय निवासी कृष्ण कन्हैया
हृदय निवासी साईं कन्हैया [ पार करो ... ]
respell:
Sāīṃ Kanhaiyā Sāīṃ Kanhaiyā
Pār Karo Mere Jīvan Naiyā
Tum Ho Mere Mām̐ Bāp Bhaīyā
Hṛudaya Nivāsī Kṛushṇa Kanhaiyā
Hṛudaya Nivāsī Sāīṃ Kanhaiyā [ Pār Karo ... ]

title: Sai Mahadeva Sathya Sai Mahadeva
lyrics:
Sai Mahadeva Sathya Sai Mahadeva (2)
Alakh Niranjan Abhaya Karambhuja Sai Mahadeva [ Sai Mahadeva ... ]
Nithya Niranjana Vibhuti Sundara Sai Mahadeva (2)
Hara Hara Shankara Shiva Shiva Shankara (2)
meaning: O Sai Mahadeva, the Great God of Truth, you are the unseen, eternally pure one. With your lotus hands, you dispel all fear, radiant and beautiful with sacred ash. We hail you, Shiva, the benevolent one!
devanagari:
साई महादेव सत्य साई महादेव (2)  
अलख निरंजन अभय करंभुजा साई महादेव [ साई महादेव ... ]  
नित्य निरंजन विभूति सुंदर साई महादेव (2)  
हर हर शंकर शिव शिव शंकर (2)
respell:
Sāī Mahādeva Satya Sāī Mahādeva (2)
Alakh Nirañjan Abhaya Karambhujā Sāī Mahādeva [ Sāī Mahādeva ... ]
Nitya Nirañjana Vibhūti Sundara Sāī Mahādeva (2)
Har Har Shaṅkar Shiv Shiv Shaṅkar (2)

title: Sai Mahadeva Sathya Sai Mahadeva
lyrics:
Sai Mahadeva Sathya Sai Mahadeva
Parthipureeshwara Hey Sai Baba Maheshwara Hey
Nirupama Gunasadana Sai Neeraja Dala Nayana
Vibhuti Sundara Hey Sai Baba Maheshwara Hey
meaning: Oh Sai, the Great God, Sathya Sai, Lord of Parthi! You are Maheshwara, the very abode of incomparable virtues, whose eyes are like tender lotus petals. Beautifully adorned with sacred ash, we praise you, Sai Baba, our Great Lord.
devanagari:
साई महादेवा (सत्य)
पर्ती पूरीश्वर हे साई बाबा महेश्वर हे [ साई महादेव ]
