निरुपम गुण सधना साई नीरज दल नयना
विभूति सुंदर हे साई बाबा महेश्वर हे
respell:
Sāī Mahādevā (satya)
Partī Pūrīshwar He Sāī Bābā Maheshwar He [ Sāī Mahādeva ]
Nirupama Guṇ Sadhanā Sāī Nīraj Dala Nayanā
Vibhūti Sundara He Sāī Bābā Maheshwar He

title: Sai Mata Jaya Jagadambe
lyrics:
Sai Mata Jaya Jagadambe Jaya Jagadambe Maa Oh Sai Maa 
Guru Devi, Namo Namah 
Lakshmi Devi, Namo Namah 
Sai Matha, Jaya Jagadambe, Jaya Jagadambe, Maa Oh Sai Maa 
Brahmani Maa Shiva Shankari Maa, Girija Maheshwari Vaishnavi Maa 
Guru Devi, Namo Namah 
Lakshmi Devi, Namo Namah
meaning: Oh Mother Sai, victory to you, Mother of the Universe! We offer our salutations to you as the Divine Guru and as Lakshmi, the bestower of prosperity. You embody all forms of the Divine Mother—Brahmani, Shiva Shankari, Girija, Maheshwari, and Vaishnavi—the supreme feminine power.
devanagari:
साई माता जय जगदम्बे जय जगदम्बे माँ ओ साई माँ
गुरु देवी, नमो नमः
लक्ष्मी देवी, नमो नमः
साई माता, जय जगदम्बे, जय जगदम्बे, माँ ओह साई माँ
ब्रह्मणी माँ शिव शंकारी माँ, गिरिजा महेश्वरी वैष्णवी माँ
गुरु देवी, नमो नमः
लक्ष्मी देवी, नमो नमः
respell:
Sāī Mātā Jaya Jagadambe Jaya Jagadambe Mām̐ O Sāī Mām̐
Guru Devī, Namo Namaḥ
Lakshmī Devī, Namo Namaḥ
Sāī Mātā, Jaya Jagadambe, Jaya Jagadambe, Mām̐ Oh Sāī Mām̐
Brahmaṇī Mām̐ Shiv Shaṅkārī Mām̐, Girijā Maheshwarī Vaishṇavī Mām̐
Guru Devī, Namo Namaḥ
Lakshmī Devī, Namo Namaḥ

title: Sai Mata Partheeshwari
lyrics:
Sai Mata Partheeshwari
Karunamayi Sayeeshwari
Jaya Jaya Sai Durge Ambe Bhavani
Janani Devi Jagadeeshwari
Sai Lakshmi Saraswati Mata
Hrudayeshwari Jagat Janani
meaning: Oh Mother Sai, Divine Empress of Puttaparthi, you are the very embodiment of compassion. We hail you as Durga, Amba, Bhavani, the Universal Mother, and the essence of Lakshmi and Saraswati. Residing in our hearts, you are the Mother of all creation.
devanagari:
साई माता पर्तीश्वरी
करुणामयी साईश्वरी
जय जय साई दुर्गे अम्बे भवानी
जननी देवी जगदीश्वरी
साई लक्ष्मी सरस्वती माता
हृदयेश्वरी जगत् जननी
respell:
Sāī Mātā Partīshwarī
Karuṇāmayī Sāīshwarī
Jaya Jaya Sāī Durge Ambe Bhavānī
Jananī Devī Jagadīshwarī
Sāī Lakshmī Saraswatī Mātā
Hṛudayeshwarī Jagat Jananī

title: Sai Mata Pita Deena Bandhu Sakha
lyrics:
Sai Mata Pita Deena Bandhu Sakha
Tere Charanon Mein Sai Mera Koti Pranam
Mujhe Shakti Do Mere Sai Shiva
Mujhe Bhakti Do Mere Sai Shiva
Mujhe Mukti Do Mere Sai Shiva
meaning: O Sai, you embody the divine roles of mother, father, and compassionate friend to the vulnerable; at your sacred feet, I offer countless prostrations. I humbly pray, O Sai Shiva, for the blessings of inner strength, unwavering devotion, and ultimate liberation.
devanagari:
साई मात पिता दीना बंधु सखा
तेरे चरणों में साई मेरा कोटी प्रणाम
साई मात पिता दीना बंधु सखा [ तेरे चरणों ... ]
मुझे शक्ति दो मेरे साई शिवा
मुझे भक्ति दो मेरे साई शिवा
मुझे मुक्ति दो मेरे साई शिवा
respell:
Sāī Māta Pitā Dīnā Bandhu Sakhā
Tere Charaṇoṃ Meṃ Sāī Merā Koṭī Praṇām
Sāī Māta Pitā Dīnā Bandhu Sakhā [ Tere Charaṇoṃ ... ]
Mujhe Shakti Do Mere Sāī Shivā
Mujhe Bhakti Do Mere Sāī Shivā
Mujhe Mukti Do Mere Sāī Shivā

title: Sai Mera Tum Ho Sahara
lyrics:
Sai Mera Tum Ho Sahara
Shirdi Avatara Sai Parthipuri Bhagawan
Deenon Ke Tum Prana Sakha Prabhu
Mere Sai Ram
Mere Sai Ram Baba Parthipuri Bhagawan
meaning: O Sai, you are my ultimate refuge and strength. You are the divine incarnation, linking Shirdi's legacy with Parthi, and the compassionate friend to the humble and needy. My beloved Sai Ram, Lord of Parthi, you are truly my own.
devanagari:
साई मेरा तुम हो सहारा
शिर्डी अवतारा साई पर्ती पूरी भगवान
दीनों के तुम प्राण सखा प्रभु
मेरे साई राम
मेरे साई राम बाबा पर्तीपुरी भगवान
respell:
Sāī Merā Tum Ho Sahārā
Shirḍī Avatārā Sāī Partī Pūrī Bhagavān
Dīnoṃ Ke Tum Prāṇ Sakhā Prabhu
Mere Sāī Rām
Mere Sāī Rām Bābā Partīpurī Bhagavān

title: Sai Nam Bolo Govind Nam Bolo
lyrics:
Sai Nam Bolo Govind Nam Bolo
Mahadeva Bolo Jai Panduranga Bolo
Sai Nam Bolo Govind Nam Bolo
Ram Krishna Bolo Jai Buddha Sai Bolo
Zoroastra Mahavira Yeshu Sai Bolo
Allah Sai Bolo Maula Sai Bolo
Prema Sai Shanthi Dayi Sathya Sai Bolo
---
Govinda Bolo Gopala Bolo
Prema Sai Shanthi Dayi Sathya Sai Bolo
meaning:
Chant the name of Lord Sai; chant the name of Lord Krishna who is Lord Govinda. 
Chant the name of Lord Shiva, The Great Lord; chant the name of Lord Krishna who is Lord Panduranga. 
Chant the names of Lord Rama, Lord Krishna and Lord Buddha. Let us adore Lord Sai, who is the same Lord Buddha.
Chant the names of the divine prophets Zoroastra, Mahaveera and Lord Jesus Christ. 
Chant the name of the Infinite Lord who is hailed as Allah and Maula. Let us call out to Lord Sai as Sai Allah and Sai Maula.
Chant the name of Lord Sathya Sai, the Personification of the Ultimate Truth, the One who is an Embodiment of Love and who alone can confer on us permanent peace.
Chant the name of Lord Krishna who is also called Govinda and Gopala.
devanagari:
साई नाम बोलो गोविन्द नाम बोलो  
महादेव बोलो जय पांडुरंग बोलो [ साई नाम ... ]  
राम कृष्ण बोलो जय बुद्ध साई बोलो  
झोरोस्ट्रा महावीर येशु साई बोलो  
अल्लाह साई बोलो मौलाह साई बोलो  
प्रेम साई शान्ति दायी सत्य साई बोलो  
गोविन्द बोलो गोपाल बोलो (3)
respell:
Sāī Nām Bolo Govinda Nām Bolo
Mahādeva Bolo Jay Pāṇḍuraṅg Bolo [ Sāī Nām ... ]
Rām Kṛushṇa Bolo Jay Buddha Sāī Bolo
Jhorosṭrā Mahāvīr Yeshu Sāī Bolo
Allāh Sāī Bolo Maulāh Sāī Bolo
Prem Sāī Shānti Dāyī Satya Sāī Bolo
Govinda Bolo Gopāla Bolo (3)

title: Sai Nama Keertana Kali Yuga Sadhana
lyrics:
Sai Nama Keertana Kali Yuga Sadhana
Jagadoddharana Krishna Janardana
Sai Murari Sri Madhusudana
Mayura Mukutadhara Madhava Mohana
Neela Varna Ghana Natajana Palana
Jagadoddharana Krishna Janardana
meaning: Singing the glory of Lord Sai is the penance for Kali Yuga. He is verily Lord Krishna, the redeemer of the universe. He is the one who slayed the demons Mura and Madhu. He is the enchanter with the peacock feather onHis crown. He is the dark blue-hued one who is the savior of all and who is the mischievous darling son of Nanda.
devanagari:
साई नाम कीर्तन काली युग साधना  
जागतोद्धारण कृष्ण जनार्दन [ साई नाम ... ]  
साई मुरारी श्री मधुसूदन  
मयूर मुकुटधर माधव मोहन  
नील वर्ण घन नटजन पालन [ जागतोद्धारण कृष्ण ... ]
respell:
Sāī Nāma Kīrtana Kālī Yug Sādhanā
Jāgatoddhāraṇ Kṛushṇa Janārdana [ Sāī Nāma ... ]
Sāī Murārī Shrī Madhusūdana
Mayūr Mukuṭadhara Mādhava Mohan
Nīla Varṇa Ghan Naṭajana Pālan [ Jāgatoddhāraṇ Kṛushṇa ... ]

title: Sai Nam Bolo Sathya Sai Nam Bolo
lyrics:
Sai Nam Bolo Sathya Sai Nam Bolo
Sai Madhava Sai Keshava Sri Hari Nam Bolo
Allah Eshwar Esha Maseeha
Buddha Mahavir Nam
Sai Madhava Sai Keshava Sri Hari Nam Bolo
meaning:
Chant the divine names of Lord Sathya Sai, Madhava, Keshava and Sri Hari!
Chant the holy names of Allah, Eshwar, Eesa(Jesus), Maseenha, Buddha and Mahaveer!
devanagari:
साई नाम बोलो सत्य साई नाम बोलो
साई माधवा साई केशवा श्री हरि नाम बोलो
अल्लाह ईश्वर ईशा मसीहा
बुद्ध महावीर नाम
साई माधवा साई केशवा श्री हरि नाम बोलो
respell:
Sāī Nām Bolo Satya Sāī Nām Bolo
Sāī Mādhavā Sāī Keshavā Shrī Hari Nām Bolo
Allāh Īshwar Īshā Masīhā
Buddha Mahāvīr Nām
Sāī Mādhavā Sāī Keshavā Shrī Hari Nām Bolo

title: Sai Narayana Narayana Mangala Nam
lyrics:
Sai Narayana Narayana Mangala Nam
Sathya Narayana Narayana Mangala Nam
Sai Brahma Sai Vishnu
Sai Parameshwara Omkara
Sai Paramananda Mukunda
Sayeesha Mangala Nam Sathya Sayeesha Mangala Nam
meaning: The auspicious names of Sai Narayana and Sathya Narayana bring forth blessings. Lord Sai embodies the divine trinity of Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva, and is the sacred primordial sound Om. We celebrate Sai as the supreme bliss, the liberator Mukunda, and chant the blessed name of Sathya Sai.
devanagari:
साई नारायण नारायण मंगल नाम
सत्य नारायण नारायण मंगल नाम [ साई नारायण ... ]
साई ब्रह्मा साई विष्णु
साई परमेश्वर ओंकारा
साई परमआनंद मुकुंदा
(सत्य) साईश मंगल नाम
respell:
Sāī Nārāyaṇ Nārāyaṇ Maṅgal Nām
Satya Nārāyaṇ Nārāyaṇ Maṅgal Nām [ Sāī Nārāyaṇ ... ]
Sāī Brahmā Sāī Vishṇu
Sāī Parameshwar Oṅkārā
Sāī Paramaānanda Mukundā
(satya) Sāīsh Maṅgal Nām

title: Sai Narayana Narayana
lyrics:
Sai Narayana Narayana
Sathya Narayana Narayana
Gana Lola Prabhu Narayana
Deena Pala Jaya Narayana
meaning: Chant the name of the merciful and omniscient Lord Sai Narayana, who rejoices when the divine glory is sung. Victory to Lord Narayana who is the protector of the meek.
devanagari:
साई नारायण नारायण
सत्य नारायण नारायण [ साई नारायण ... ]
गान लोल प्रभु नारायण
दीन पाल जय नारायण
respell:
Sāī Nārāyaṇ Nārāyaṇ
Satya Nārāyaṇ Nārāyaṇ [ Sāī Nārāyaṇ ... ]
Gān Lol Prabhu Nārāyaṇ
Dīna Pāla Jaya Nārāyaṇ

title: Sai Nath Deena Nath Brahma Roopa Sadguru
lyrics:
Sai Nath Deena Nath Brahma Roopa Sadguru
Nirakara He Akara Sathya Sai Sadguru
Omkara Sadguru Nirvikara Sadguru
Nirvikara Sadguru Omkara Sadguru
Sai Nath Deena Nath Brahma Roopa Sadguru
Mata Pita Sadguru Sakala Tum Hi Sadguru
Sakala Tum Hi Sadguru Sakala Tum Hi Sadguru
meaning: Salutations to You, O Lord Sainatha, the Supreme Guru, who is the protector of the weak and the downtrodden, who is the very embodiment of Brahman. You are the Formless that has taken Form as Lord Sai. Glory to You Oh Lord, the untroubled one, who is present in the ancient sound Omkara. Glory to You, O Lord Sai Sadguru, who is our mother, father and our everything.
devanagari:
साई नाथ दीना नाथ ब्रह्मा रूप सद्गुरु
निराकार हे आकार सत्य साई सद्गुरु
ॐकार सद्गुरु निर्विकार सद्गुरु
निर्विकार सद्गुरु ॐकार सद्गुरु
साई नाथ दीना नाथ ब्रह्मा रूप सद्गुरु
मात पिता सद्गुरु सकल तुम ही सद्गुरु
सकल तुम ही सद्गुरु सकल तुम ही सद्गुरु
respell:
Sāī Nāth Dīnā Nāth Brahmā Rūp Sadguru
Nirākār He Ākār Satya Sāī Sadguru
Oṃkār Sadguru Nirwikār Sadguru
Nirwikār Sadguru Oṃkār Sadguru
Sāī Nāth Dīnā Nāth Brahmā Rūp Sadguru
Māta Pitā Sadguru Sakal Tum Hī Sadguru
Sakal Tum Hī Sadguru Sakal Tum Hī Sadguru

title: Sai Nath Bhagawan Sai Nath Bhagawan
lyrics:
Sai Nath Bhagawan Sai Nath Bhagawan
Sathyam Shivam Sundaram Sai Nath Bhagawan | Sai Nath Bhagawan...|
Buddham Sharanam Gachchami
Dhammam Sharanam Gachchami
Sangham Sharanam Gachchami
Sayeesha Sharanam Gachchami
meaning: O Lord Sai, You are Truth, Auspiciousness and Beauty. O Lord Sai I take refuge in Buddha (the enlightened one). I take refuge in Dhamma (the ultimate Truth). I take refuge in Sangham (the holy community). O Lord Sai, I take refuge in You!
devanagari:
साईं नाथ भगवान साईं नाथ भगवान
सत्यं शिवं सुंदरं साईं नाथ भगवान [ साईं नाथ ... ]
बुद्धं शरणं गच्छामि
धम्मं शरणं गच्छामि
संगं शरणं गच्छामि
साईशा शरणं गच्छामि (सत्य)
respell:
Sāīṃ Nātha Bhagavān Sāīṃ Nātha Bhagavān
Satyaṃ Shivaṃ Sundaraṃ Sāīṃ Nātha Bhagavān [ Sāīṃ Nātha ... ]
Buddhaṃ Sharaṇaṃ Gachchhāmi
Dhammaṃ Sharaṇaṃ Gachchhāmi
Saṅgaṃ Sharaṇaṃ Gachchhāmi
Sāīshā Sharaṇaṃ Gachchhāmi (satya)

title: Sai Pita Aur Mata Sai
lyrics:
Sai Pita Aur Mata Sai
Deena Dayala Data Sai
Sai Guru Sai Sakha Sahodara
Sai Sathya Shiva Sai Sundara
Veda Upanishad Geeta Sai
Deena Dayala Data Sai
meaning: Chant the holy name of Sai who is our father, mother, and who is the protector of the weak and downtrodden. He is the preceptor, friend, and sibling. He is verily the Truth, the Goodness, and the Beautiful. He is the embodiment of Vedas, the Upanishads, and the Geeta.
devanagari:
साई पीता और माता साई  
दीन दयाला दाता साई [ साई पीता ... ]  
साई गुरु साई सखा सहोदर  
साई सत्य शिव साई सुंदर  
वेद उपनिषद गीता साई [ दीन दयाला ... ]
respell:
Sāī Pītā Aur Mātā Sāī
Dīna Dayālā Dātā Sāī [ Sāī Pītā ... ]
Sāī Guru Sāī Sakhā Sahodara
Sāī Satya Shiv Sāī Sundara
Ved Upanishad Gītā Sāī [ Dīna Dayālā ... ]

title: Sai Prem De Shanti De Anand De Baba Prem De
lyrics:
Sai Prem De Shanti De Anand De Baba Prem De
Tum Ho Baba Daya Ke Sagar
Tum Ho Guna Mandir Natanagar
Adi Anant Hey Sathya Sanatana
Alakha Niranjana Sai Janardana
Satchidananda Prabho Krupa Karo
Prem De Shanti De Anand De Baba Prem De
meaning: O Lord Sai! we pray to Thee to grant us Peace, Happiness and Love. You are the ocean of Grace and Mercy. The One who possesses all good and pure qualities, Your form is Infinite, Eternal Truth with no beginning or end. You are beyond the perception of senses, always supremely Pure, O Sai, uplifter of humanity, you are Sat-Chit-Ananda - Existence, Consciousness and Divine Bliss. Shower Your compassion on us.
devanagari:
साई प्रेम दे शान्ति दे आनन्द दे बाबा प्रेम दे
तुम हो बाबा दया के सागर
तुम हो गुण मन्दिर नट नागर
आदि अनन्त हे सत्य सनातन
अलख निरञ्जन साई जनार्दन
सच्चिदानन्द प्रभो कृपा करो
प्रेम दे शान्ति दे आनन्द दे बाबा प्रेम दे (साई)
respell:
Sāī Prem De Shānti De Ānanda De Bābā Prem De
Tum Ho Bābā Dayā Ke Sāgar
Tum Ho Guṇ Mandira Naṭa Nāgar
Ādi Ananta He Satya Sanātana
Alakh Nirañjana Sāī Janārdana
Sachchidānanda Prabho Kṛupā Karo
Prem De Shānti De Ānand De Bābā Prem De (sāī)

title: Sai Ram Ghana Shyam Bhagawan Tumhara Nam
lyrics:
Sai Ram Ghana Shyam Bhagawan Tumhara Nam
Tum Bin Koi Nahi Rakhwale
Tum Bin Koi Nahi Apat Sahare
Tum Bin Prem Koi Nahi Denewale
Tum Ho Mère Atma Ram Baba
Bhagawan Tumhara Nam
Sai Ram Tumhara Nam
meaning: O Lord Sai, you are verily Lord Rama and Krishna. There is none other than You to protect us, to save us from all adversities and to give us unconditional love. O Lord Sai, you are the in-dweller of our hearts.
devanagari:
साई राम घन श्याम भगवान तुम्हारा नाम
तुम बिना कोई नहीं रखवाले
तुम बिना कोई नहीं आपद सहारे
तुम बिना प्रेम कोई नहीं देनेवाले
तुम हो मेरे आत्म राम बाबा
भगवान ( साई राम ) तुम्हारा नाम
respell:
Sāī Rām Ghan Shyām Bhagavān Tumhārā Nām
Tum Binā Koī Nahīṃ Rakhavāle
Tum Binā Koī Nahīṃ Āpad Sahāre
Tum Binā Prem Koī Nahīṃ Denevāle
Tum Ho Mere Ātma Rām Bābā
Bhagavān ( Sāī Rām ) Tumhārā Nām

title: Sai Ram Jaya Sai Ram Shirdi Pureeshwara Ram
lyrics:
Sai Ram Jaya Sai Ram Shirdi Pureeshwara Ram
Sai Ram Jaya Sai Ram Parthi Pureeshwara Ram
Allah Nam Hai Tera O Sai Baba
Sab Ke Malik Tum Ho O Sai Baba
Yeshu Nanak Buddha Mahavir Sab Hai Sai Ram
Sab Hai Sai Ram
meaning: Victory to You O Lord Sai of Shirdi and Parthi. You are the Lord of the entire humanity, You are Allah, Jesus, Nanak, Buddha and Mahavira.
devanagari:
साई राम जय साई राम शिरडी पूरीश्वरा राम
साई राम जय साई राम पर्ती  पूरीश्वरा राम
अल्लाह नाम है तेरा ओ साई बाबा
सब के मालिक तुम हो ओ साई बाबा
येशु नानक बुद्ध महावीर सब है साई राम
सब है साई राम
respell:
Sāī Rām Jaya Sāī Rām Shiraḍī Pūrīshwarā Rām
Sāī Rām Jaya Sāī Rām Partī  Pūrīshwarā Rām
Allāh Nām Hai Terā O Sāī Bābā
Sab Ke Mālik Tum Ho O Sāī Bābā
Yeshu Nānak Buddha Mahāvīr Sab Hai Sāī Rām
Sab Hai Sāī Rām

title: Sai Ram Sai Ram
lyrics:
Sai Ram Sai Ram
Gayen Geet Sada Subah Aur Shyam
Har Ek Pal Me Har Ek Kshan Mein
Bhaje Hum Sada Tero Nam
Koi Kahe Tujhe Janaki Rama
Koi Pukare Radhe Shyam
Hamare Liye Tum Sai Bhagawan
meaning: O Lord Sai Ram, we sing forever Your glory from dawn to dusk. We sing Your glory with every breath, every second and forever. O Sai, some call You Rama, some others prefer to call You Shyama (Krishna), but You will remain as Sai Bhagawan for us.
devanagari:
साई राम साई राम  
गायें गीत सदा सुबह और शाम  
हर एक पल में हर एक क्षण में  
भजें हम सदा तेरो नाम [ गायें गीत ... ]  
कोई कहे तुझे जानकी राम  
कोई पुकारे राधे श्याम  
हमारे लिए तुम साई भगवान [ गायें गीत ... ]
respell:
Sāī Rām Sāī Rām
Gāyeṃ Gīt Sadā Subah Aur Shām
Har Ek Pal Meṃ Har Ek Kshaṇ Meṃ
Bhajeṃ Ham Sadā Tero Nām [ Gāyeṃ Gīt ... ]
Koī Kahe Tujhe Jānakī Rām
Koī Pukāre Rādhe Shyām
Hamāre Lie Tum Sāī Bhagavān [ Gāyeṃ Gīt ... ]

title: Sai Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram Bhajo
lyrics:
Sai Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram Bhajo
Sadguru Sai Rama Nam Bhajo
Sai Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram Bhajo
Allah Malik Sai Ram Bhajo
Buddha Mahavir Sai Ram Bhajo
Yeshu Pita Prabhu Sai Ram Bhajo
Sai Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram Bhajo
meaning: Chant the name of Sai Ram, the divine preceptor. He is none other than Allah, Buddha, Mahavir, and Jesus.
devanagari:
साई राम साई राम साई राम भजो
सद्गुरु साई राम नाम भजो
साई राम साई राम साई राम भजो
अल्लाह मालिक साई राम भजो
बुद्ध महावीर साई राम भजो
येशु पिता प्रभु साई राम भजो
साई राम साई राम साई राम भजो
respell:
Sāī Rām Sāī Rām Sāī Rām Bhajo
Sadguru Sāī Rām Nām Bhajo
Sāī Rām Sāī Rām Sāī Rām Bhajo
Allāh Mālik Sāī Rām Bhajo
Buddha Mahāvīr Sāī Rām Bhajo
Yeshu Pitā Prabhu Sāī Rām Bhajo
Sāī Rām Sāī Rām Sāī Rām Bhajo

title: Sai Ram Sai Ram
lyrics:
Sai Ram Sai Ram
Sai Ram Jai Sai Ram
Parthipureeshwara Sai Ram
Raghupati Raghava Raja Ram
Patita Pavana Sita Ram
Eshwar Allah Tere Nam
Sab Ko Sanmati Do Bhagawan
meaning: Chant the name of Lord Sai Ram who resides in Parthi. He is Lord Rama, the consort of Mother Sita. He is the noblest of the Raghu dynasty who uplifts the sinners. He is none other than Lord Shiva and Allah. Oh Lord, bless us with wisdom.
devanagari:
साई राम साई राम
साई राम जय साई राम
पर्तिपुरीश्वर साई राम [साई राम साई राम]
रघुपति राघव राजा राम
पतीत  पावन सीता राम
ईश्वर अल्लाह तेरे नाम
सब को सन्मति दो भगवान
respell:
Sāī Rām Sāī Rām
Sāī Rām Jay Sāī Rām
Partipurīshwar Sāī Rām [sāī rām sāī rām]
Raghupati Rāghav Rājā Rām
Patīta  Pāvan Sītā Rām
Īshwar Allāh Tere Nām
Sab Ko Sanmati Do Bhagavān

title: Sai Ram Sai Shyam Mere Sai Ram
lyrics:
Sai Ram Sai Shyam Mere Sai Ram
Mere Sai Mere Baba Mere Pran Nath Ram
Tere Dwar Pe Mein Avoon Mujhe Shanti Do Bhagawan
Mujhe Shanti Do Bhagawan
Mere Jeevan Mein Sat Raho Sai Nath Hey
meaning: Oh Lord Sai Rama, Sai Shyama, my dear Baba, I am standing at Your door step, bestow me with peace Oh Lord, be with me all through my life, Oh Lord Sai.
devanagari:
साई राम साई श्याम मेरे साई राम
मेरे साई मेरे बाबा मेरे प्राण नाथ राम [ साई राम ... ]
तेरे द्वार पे मैं आऊं मुझे शांति दो भगवान
मुझे शांति दो भगवान
मेरे जीवन में साथ रहो साई नाथ हे
respell:
Sāī Rām Sāī Shyām Mere Sāī Rām
Mere Sāī Mere Bābā Mere Prāṇ Nātha Rām [ Sāī Rām ... ]
Tere Dwār Pe Maiṃ Āūṃ Mujhe Shānti Do Bhagavān
Mujhe Shānti Do Bhagavān
Mere Jīvan Meṃ Sāth Raho Sāī Nātha He

title: Sai Rama Hare Sai Krishna Hare
lyrics:
Sai Rama Hare Sai Krishna Hare (2)
Raghupati Raghava Rama Hare
Rajeeva Lochana Rama Hare
Sai Rama Hare Sai Krishna Hare
Parthi Pureeshwara Sai Hare
meaning: Salutations to You, Lord Sai, residing in Parthi. You are verily Lord Rama, the one with beautiful Lotus shaped eyes and the noblest of the Raghu Dynasty. You are verily Lord Krishna.
devanagari:
साई राम हरे साई कृष्ण हरे (2)
रघुपति राघव राम हरे
राजीव लोचन राम हरे
साई राम हरे साई कृष्ण हरे
पर्ती पुरीश्वर साई हरे
respell:
Sāī Rām Hare Sāī Kṛushṇa Hare (2)
Raghupati Rāghav Rām Hare
Rājīva Lochana Rām Hare
Sāī Rām Hare Sāī Kṛushṇa Hare
Partī Purīshwar Sāī Hare

title: Sai Rama Hey Ghana Shyama
lyrics:
Sai Rama Hey Ghana Shyama
Parama Dayaghana Atma Rama
Shanta Saguna Hari Hara Paramatma
Bhakta Samrakshaka Dayabhi Rama
Patita Pavana Sathya Sai Rama
Sharanam Sharanam Hey Sai Rama
meaning: Salutations to Lord Sai Rama, You are the most compassionate, the virtuous one who safeguards the devotees and the one who uplifts the downtrodden. O Lord, we seek Your protection.
devanagari:
साई रामा हे घन श्यामा
परम दयाघन आत्मा रामा [ साई राम ... ]
शान्त सगुण हरि हर परमात्मा
भक्त सम्रक्षक दयाभि रामा
पतित पावन सत्य साई रामा
शरणम् शरणम् हे साई रामा
respell:
Sāī Rāmā He Ghan Shyāmā
Param Dayāghan Ātmā Rāmā [ Sāī Rām ... ]
Shānta Saguṇ Hari Har Paramātmā
Bhakta Samrakshak Dayābhi Rāmā
Patita Pāvan Satya Sāī Rāmā
Sharaṇam Sharaṇam He Sāī Rāmā

title: Sai Rama Hey Ghana Shyama
lyrics:
Sai Rama Hey Ghana Shyama
Dasharatha Nandana Sri Raghu Rama [ Sai Rama ... ]
Parthi Pureeshwara Pavana Naama
Pavana Naama Pavana Naama [ Parthi Pureeshwara ... ]
Sharanam Sharanam Hey Sai Rama
meaning: Oh Sai Rama, dark and beautiful like a rain cloud, You are the beloved son of Dasharatha and the glorious Rama of the Raghu lineage. Lord of Parthi, your name is supremely pure and sacred. We surrender completely to You, Oh Sai Rama.
devanagari:
साई राम हे घन श्याम
दशरथ नंदन श्री रघु राम [ साई राम ... ]
पर्ती पुरीश्वर पावन नाम
पावन नाम पावन नाम [ पर्ती पुरीश्वर ... ]
शरणं शरणं हे साई राम
respell:
Sāī Rām He Ghan Shyām
Dasharath Nandana Shrī Raghu Rām [ Sāī Rām ... ]
Partī Purīshwar Pāvan Nāma
Pāvan Nāma Pāvan Nāma [ Partī Purīshwar ... ]
Sharaṇaṃ Sharaṇaṃ He Sāī Rām

title: Sai Sai Smarana Karo
lyrics:
Sai Sai Smarana Karo
Guru Charana Kamala Dhyana Karo
Keshava Madhava Bhajana Karo
Sadguru Sai Seva Karo (Shri)
meaning: Chant the name of Lord Sai, meditate upon His Lotus Feet, sing the glory of Keshava, Madhava (names of Lord Krishna), serve the Divine Preceptor Sai.
devanagari:
साई साई स्मरण करो  
गुरु चरण कमल ध्यान करो [ साई साई ... ]  
केशव माधव भजन करो  
सद्गुरु साई सेवा करो (श्री)
respell:
Sāī Sāī Smaraṇ Karo
Guru Charaṇ Kamala Dhyān Karo [ Sāī Sāī ... ]
Keshav Mādhava Bhajana Karo
Sadguru Sāī Sevā Karo (shrī)

title: Sai Sundara Sundara
lyrics:
Sai Sundara Sundara
Vyagrambaradhara Hare Hari Hara
Ananta Guna Mandira Sundara
Natana Sundara Bhuvana Sundara
meaning: This song praises Lord Sai as the most beautiful in the world, the one who is none other than Lord Shiva adorning tiger skin, who is highest in virtues and who is the most charming Cosmic dancer.
devanagari:
साई सुन्दरा सुन्दरा
व्याघ्रांबरधर हरे हरि हरा
[ साई सुन्दर ... ]
अनन्त गुण मन्दिरा सुन्दरा
नटन सुन्दरा भुवन सुन्दरा
respell:
Sāī Sundarā Sundarā
Vyāghrāmbaradhara Hare Hari Harā
[ Sāī Sundara ... ]
Ananta Guṇ Mandirā Sundarā
naṭana sundarā bhuvan sundarā

title: Sai Tere Charanon Mein Koti Pranam
lyrics:
Sai Tere Charanon Mein Koti Pranam
Sharana Mein Lelo Sai Prabho
Tum Ho Mere Mata Pita Sai
Tum Ho Mere Bandhu Sakha
Tum Ho Mere Sab Kuch Sai
Deejo Hum Ko Sharana Tumhare
meaning: O Lord Sai, I offer a million salutations at Thy Lotus feet, please take me in Your fold. You are my mother, father, kith and kin. You are my every thing O Sai, I offer myself at Your feet.
devanagari:
साई तेरे चरणों में कोटि प्रणाम
शरण में लेलो साई प्रभो
तुम हो मेरे माता पिता साई
तुम हो मेरे बंधु सखा
तुम हो मेरे सब कुछ साई
दीजो हम को शरण तुम्हारे
respell:
Sāī Tere Charaṇoṃ Meṃ Koṭi Praṇām
Sharaṇ Meṃ Lelo Sāī Prabho
Tum Ho Mere Mātā Pitā Sāī
Tum Ho Mere Bandhu Sakhā
Tum Ho Mere Sab Kuchh Sāī
Dījo Ham Ko Sharaṇ Tumhāre

title: Sai You Are More Precious Than Silver
lyrics:
Sai You Are More Precious Than Silver
Sai You Are More Valued Than Gold
Sai You Are More Beautiful Than Diamonds
Nothing In This World Compares With You
Sai You Are Rama And Krishna
Sai You Are The Sun And The Moon
Sai You Are The Cause Of All Created
All The Universe Depends On You
Sai You Are More Precious Than Silver
Sai You Are More Valued Than Gold
Sai You Are More Beautiful Than Diamonds
meaning: Oh Sai, You are infinitely more precious than any earthly treasure, surpassing silver, gold, and diamonds; truly, nothing in this world can compare to Your divine essence. You embody the very forms of Rama and Krishna, illuminating existence as the sun and moon, for You are the ultimate source and sustainer upon whom the entire universe depends.
devanagari:
साई यू आर मोर प्रेशस दैन सिल्वर
साई यू आर मोर वैल्यूड दैन गोल्ड
साई यू आर मोर ब्यूटफल दैन डाइमन्ड्ज
नथिङ इन दिस वरल्ड कम्पेर्ज विद यू
साई यू आर राम अन्ड कृष्ण
साई यू आर द सन अन्ड द मून
साई यू आर द काज अव ओल क्रीएटड
ओल द यूनवरस डिपेन्ड्ज आन यू
साई यू आर मोर प्रेशस दैन सिल्वर
साई यू आर मोर वैल्यूड दैन गोल्ड
साई यू आर मोर ब्यूटफल दैन डाइमन्ड्ज

title: Sairam Sairam Sairam Bhajo
lyrics:
Sairam Sairam Sairam Bhajo
Sadguru Sai Ram Naam Bhajo
Sairam Sairam Sairam Bhajo (2)
Allah Malik Sairam Bhajo
Buddha Mahavir Sairam Bhajo
Yesu Pita Prabhu Sairam Bhajo
Sairam Sairam Sairam Bhajo
meaning: Oh, let us chant the holy name of Sai Ram, our True Guru! Continuously invoke Sai Ram, for He is Allah the Master, Buddha, Mahavir, and Lord Jesus the Father, embodying the one divine truth revered by all.
devanagari:
साईराम साईराम साईराम भजो
सद्गुरु साई राम नाम भजो
साईराम साईराम साईराम भजो (2)
अल्लाह मालिक साईराम भजो
बुद्ध महावीर साईराम भजो
येसु पिता प्रभु साईराम भजो
साईराम साईराम साईराम भजो
respell:
Sāīrām Sāīrām Sāīrām Bhajo
Sadguru Sāī Rām Nām Bhajo
Sāīrām Sāīrām Sāīrām Bhajo (2)
Allāh Mālik Sāīrām Bhajo
Buddh Mahāvīr Sāīrām Bhajo
Yesu Pitā Prabhu Sāīrām Bhajo
Sāīrām Sāīrām Sāīrām Bhajo

title: Sakshat Parabhrahma Sai Guru Vandana Sathya Sai
lyrics:
Sakshat Parabhrahma Sai Guru Vandana Sathya Sai
Guru Pada Ranjana Guru Paramesha
Guru Brahma Guru Vishnu Mahesha
Sadguru Sai Parthi Pureesha
Charana Namostute Sai Mahesha
meaning: Our salutations at Your divine Lotus feet, Oh Lord Sai. You are our divine preceptor, the Supreme God, and the unified form of the Trinity (Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva).
devanagari:
साक्षात परब्रह्म साई गुरु वंदना सत्य साई
गुरु पद रंजन गुरु परमेशा
गुरु ब्रह्म गुरु विष्णु महेशा  
सद्गुरु साई पार्थी पूरेशा
चरण नमोस्तुते साई महेशा
respell:
Sākshāt Parabrahma Sāī Guru Vandanā satya sāī
Guru Pada Rañjana Guru Parameshā
Guru Brahma Guru Vishṇu Maheshā
Sadguru Sāī Pārthī Pūreshā
Charaṇ Namostute Sāī Maheshā

title: Samba Sadashiva Sayeeshwara
lyrics:
Samba Sadashiva Sayeeshwara
Gangadhara Hara Gauri Shiva
Narthana Sundara Natana Manohara
Natya Priyakara Nataneshwara
meaning: Oh Lord Sayeeshwara you are none other than Lord Shiva also called by other names like Gangadhara, Gowri Shiva and Nataneshwara who performs the beautiful Cosmic dance.
devanagari:
सांब सदाशिव साईश्वरा
गंगाधरा हर गौरी शिवा [ सांब ... ]
नर्तन सुंदर नट मनोहर
नाट्य प्रियकर नटनेश्वरा (2)
respell:
Sāmb Sadāshiv Sāīshwarā
Gaṅgādharā Har Gaurī Shivā [ Sāmb ... ]
Nartana Sundara Naṭa Manohar
Nāṭya Priyakar Naṭaneshwarā (2)

title: Samba Vinodini Shiva Sai Shankari
lyrics:
Samba Vinodini Shiva Sai Shankari
Mangala Gauri Mata Maheshwari
Akhilandeshwari Raja Rajeshwari
Daya Sagari Parama Krupakari
meaning: Salutations to Mother Parvathi, the Goddess of the whole Universe and the consort of Lord Shiva. She is the supremely compassionate Mother who bestows auspiciousness.
devanagari:
साम्ब विनोदिनी शिव साई शङ्करी
मङ्गल गौरी माता महेश्वरी
अखिलाण्डेश्वरी राज राजेश्वरी
दया सागरी परम कृपाकरी
respell:
Sāmba Vinodinī Shiv Sāī Shaṅkarī
Maṅgal Gaurī Mātā Maheshwarī
Akhilāṇḍeshwarī Rāj Rājeshwarī
Dayā Sāgarī Param Kṛupākarī

title: Sanathana Sarathe Sayeesha
lyrics:
Sanathana Sarathe Sayeesha
Sarvottama Guna Nidhe Paramesha
Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram Ram
Suramuni Vandita Sadhu Jana Poshita
Sarva Janashraya Sayeesha
Sadguru Deva Satchidananda
Sashtanga Sharanam Mama Guru Deva
Sashtanga Sharanam Mama Sai Deva
Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram Ram
meaning: Salutations at Your divine lotus feet Oh Lord Sai, You are the upholder of the "Eternal Laws" (Sanathana Dharma), the one who is the embodiment of all virtues, the one who is worshipped by sages and noble ones and the one whom the entire humanity worships.
devanagari:
सनातन सारथे साईशा
सर्वोत्तम गुण निधेय परमेशा
राम साई राम साई राम राम  
सुरमुनि वन्दिता साधु जन पोषित
सर्व जनाश्रय साईशा
सद्गुरु देव सच्चिदानंदा
साष्टांग शरणं मम गुरु (साई) देवा [ राम साई राम ... ]
respell:
Sanātana Sārathe Sāīshā
Sarwottama Guṇ Nidhey Parameshā
Rām Sāī Rām Sāī Rām Rām
Suramuni Vanditā Sādhu Jana Poshit
Sarwa Janāshray Sāīshā
Sadguru Deva Sachchidānandā
Sāshṭāṅga Sharaṇaṃ Mama Guru (sāī) Devā [ Rām Sāī Rām ... ]

title: Sankata Harana Govinda
lyrics:
Sankata Harana Govinda
Pankaja Charana Govinda
Sathya Sai Deva Govinda
Saptagiri Vasa Govinda
Govinda Hari Govinda
meaning: Glory to Lord Govinda (Narayana) who resides in the seven hills and has now incarnated as Lord Sathya Sai, who is the remover of all obstacles. O Lord, we offer ourselves at Your tender lotus feet.
devanagari:
संकट हरणा गोविन्दा
पंकज चरणा गोविन्दा
सत्य साई देवा गोविन्दा
सप्तगिरी वासा गोविन्दा
गोविन्दा हरि गोविन्दा
respell:
Saṅkaṭ Haraṇā Govindā
Paṅkaj Charaṇā Govindā
Satya Sāī Devā Govindā
Saptagirī Vāsā Govindā
Govindā Hari Govindā

title: Sankata Harana Sri Sai Ramana
lyrics:
Sankata Harana Sri Sai Ramana
Pankaja Charana Namo Namo
Vedoddharana Venkata Ramana
Lakshmi Narayana Namo Namo
Sai Narayana Namo Namo
Namo Namo Namo Namo
Pankaja Charana Namo Namo
meaning: Salutations to Lord Sai(who is alos the Lord Srinivasa of Tirupati), the one with feet soft like Lotus, the one who is the upholder of Vedas and who is the consort of Lashmi.
devanagari:
संकट हरणा श्री साई रामणा
पंकज चरणा नमो नमो
वेदोद्धरणा वेंकट रामणा
लक्ष्मी (साई) नारायण नमो नमो
नमो नमो नमो नमो [ पंकज चरणा ... ]
respell:
Saṅkaṭ Haraṇā Shrī Sāī Rāmaṇā
Paṅkaj Charaṇā Namo Namo
Vedoddharaṇā Veṅkaṭ Rāmaṇā
Lakshmī (sāī) Nārāyaṇ Namo Namo
Namo Namo Namo Namo [ Paṅkaj Charaṇā ... ]

title: Sarva Dharma Priya Deva
lyrics:
Sarva Dharma Priya Deva
Sathya Sai Deva
Allah Yeshu Buddha Aur Nanak
Zoroastra Mahavir Tum Ho
Rama BHi Tum Ho Krishna Bhi Tum Ho
Vishwa Roopa Tum Ho
meaning: Glory to Lord Sathya Sai who fosters all faiths and religions. He is verily the embodiment of Allah, Christ, Buddha, Nanak, Zorastra, Mahaveera, Ram and Krishna.
devanagari:
सर्व धर्म प्रिय देवा
सत्य साईं देवा
अल्लाह येसु बुद्ध और नानक
जोहराष्ट्र महावीर तुम हो
राम भी तुम हो कृष्ण भी तुम हो
विश्व रूप तुम हो (2)
respell:
Sarwa Dharma Priy Devā
Satya Sāīṃ Devā
Allāh Yesu Buddha Aur Nānak
Joharāshṭra Mahāvīr Tum Ho
Rām Bhī Tum Ho Kṛushṇa Bhī Tum Ho
Vishwa Rūp Tum Ho (2)

title: Sarva Dharma Priya Sai Deva
lyrics:
Sarva Dharma Priya Sai Deva
Sai Deva Deva Deva
Allah Yeshu Guru Grantha Govinda
Maula Sai Mahavir Madhava
Zoroastra Buddha Sai Shankara
meaning: Salutation to Lord Sai who is the embodiment of all religions and faiths. HE is none other than Allah, Jesus, Nanak, Mahaveer, Krishna, Buddha and Zorastra.
devanagari:
सर्व धर्म प्रिय साई देवा
साई देवा देव देवा [ सर्व धर्म ... ]
अल्लाह येसु गुरु ग्रंथ गोविन्द
मौला साई महावीर माधवा
झोरोस्ट्रा बुद्ध साई शंकरा [ साई देवा ... ]
respell:
Sarwa Dharma Priy Sāī Devā
Sāī Devā Deva Devā [ Sarwa Dharma ... ]
Allāh Yesu Guru Granth Govinda
Maulā Sāī Mahāvīr Mādhavā
Jhorosṭrā Buddha Sāī Shaṅkarā [ Sāī Devā ... ]

title: Sarva Dharma Swaroopa Sai
lyrics:
Sarva Dharma Swaroopa Sai
Parthi Ke Avatara
Mere Baba Mere Sai
Sai Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram
Hindu Muslim Isai Ate Hain Tere Dware
Milte Hain Tere Dware
Sai Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram
meaning: Glory to the Lord of Shirdi(Parthi) Sai who is the embodiment of all Religions and Faiths who draws all to HIS door step.
devanagari:
सर्व धर्म स्वरूपा साई
शिर्डी के (पर्ति के) अवतारा
मेरे बाबा मेरे साई
साई राम साई राम साई राम साई राम
हिंदू मुस्लिम इसाई आते हैं तेरे द्वारे
मिलते हैं तेरे द्वारे [ साई राम साई राम ... ]
respell:
Sarwa Dharma Swarūpā Sāī
Shirḍī Ke (parti ke) avatārā
Mere Bābā Mere Sāī
Sāī Rām Sāī Rām Sāī Rām Sāī Rām
Hindū Muslim Isāī Āte Haiṃ Tere Dwāre
Milate Haiṃ Tere Dwāre [ sāī rām sāī rām ... ]

title: Sarva Mangala Sai Janani
lyrics:
Sarva Mangala Sai Janani
Parthi Nivasini Parama Shivani
Mata Maheshwari Durga Bhavani
Adi Parashakti Sai Narayani
Jagadoddharini Bhava Bhayaharini
meaning: We praise mother Sai, who resides in Parthi, who is none other than Goddess Durga(whose other names are Shivani, Maheshwari, Parashakthi, all depicting the consort of Lord Shiva) as the most auspicious one and the one who destroys the fears of this materialistic world.
devanagari:
सर्व मंगला साई जननी
पर्ती निवासिनी परम शिवानी [ सर्व मंगला ... ]
माता महेश्वरी दुर्गा भवानी
आदि पराशक्ति साई नारायणी
जगतोद्धारिणी भव भय हारिणी
respell:
Sarwa Maṅgalā Sāī Jananī
Partī Nivāsinī Param Shivānī [ Sarwa Maṅgal ... ]
Mātā Maheshwarī Durgā Bhavānī
Ādi Parāshakti Sāī Nārāyaṇī
Jagatoddhāriṇī Bhava Bhaya Hāriṇī

title: Sarva Nama Swaroopam Sai Baba
lyrics:
Sarva Nama Swaroopam Sai Baba
Sarva Hrudaya Nivasam Sai Baba
Sarva Daivatva Swaroopam Sai Baba
Sarva Dharma Virajam Sai Baba
Om Brahma Sanatana Sai Baba
meaning: O Lord Sai, You are the personification of all Names (of Gods), You live in everyone's hearts, You are the reflection of all pervading divinity, You are pure and You symbolize all faiths. O Lord Sai, You are the eternal Supreme Conscience.
devanagari:
सर्व नाम स्वरूपम् साई बाबा
सर्व हृदय निवासम् साई बाबा
सर्व दैवत्व स्वरूपम् साई बाबा
सर्व धर्म विराजम् साई बाबा
ॐ ब्रह्म सनातन साई बाबा
respell:
Sarwa Nāma Swarūpam Sāī Bābā
Sarwa Hṛudaya Nivāsam Sāī Bābā
Sarwa Daivatwa Swarūpam Sāī Bābā
Sarwa Dharma Virājam Sāī Bābā
Oṃ Brahma Sanātana Sāī Bābā

title: Sarvatra Govinda Nama Sankeertana Govinda Hari Govinda
lyrics:
Sarvatra Govinda Nama Sankeertana Govinda Hari Govinda
Govinda Hari Govinda Hari Govinda Hari Govinda
Purana Purusha Govinda Hari Punya Shloka Govinda
Bhakta Vatsala Govinda Hari Bhagavata Priya Govinda
Krishna Rama Govinda Hari Rama Krishna Govinda
Sai Rama Govinda Hari Sai Krishna Govinda
meaning: I adore and worship Lord Srinivasa (who is none other than Sai Rama and Sai Krishna). He is adored as Purana Purusha (original personality of God hood), Bhaktha Vatsala (always affectionate to devotees), Bhagawata Priya (dear and initimate to great devotees)
devanagari:
सर्वत्र गोविन्द नाम संकीर्तन गोविंदा हरि गोविंदा  
गोविंदा हरि गोविंदा हरि गोविंदा हरि गोविंदा  
पुराण पुरुष गोविंदा हरि पुण्य श्लोका गोविंदा  
भक्त वत्सला गोविंदा हरि भागवता प्रिया गोविंदा  
कृष्णा रामा गोविंदा हरि रामा कृष्णा गोविंदा  
साई रामा गोविंदा हरि साई कृष्णा गोविंदा
respell:
Sarwatra Govinda Nāma Saṅkīrtana Govindā Hari Govindā
Govindā Hari Govindā Hari Govindā Hari Govindā
Purāṇ Purush Govindā Hari Puṇya Shlokā Govindā
Bhakta Vatsalā Govindā Hari Bhāgavatā Priyā Govindā
Kṛushṇā Rāmā Govindā Hari Rāmā Kṛushṇā Govindā
Sāī Rāmā Govindā Hari Sāī Kṛushṇā Govindā

title: Sat Guru Dev Raha Dikhao Prabhu
lyrics:
Sath Guru Dev Raha Dikhao Prabhu
Raha Dikhao Sai Deva
Tum Ho Mere Prana Data
Tum Ho Mere Bhagya Data
meaning: O Lord Sai, our Divine Preceptor, show us the path to liberation, You are our life giver as well as the one who bestows all prosperity.
devanagari:
सत् गुरु देव राह दिखाओ प्रभु
राह दिखाओ साई देवा
तुम हो मेरे प्राण दाता
तुम हो मेरे भाग्य दाता
respell:
Sat Guru Dev Rāh Dikhāo Prabhu
Rāh Dikhāo Sāī Devā
Tum Ho Mere Prāṇ Dātā
Tum Ho Mere Bhāgya Dātā

title: Sathya Dharma Shanti Prema Sabko Deejo
lyrics:
Sathya Dharma Shanti Prema Sabko Deejo
Sathya Dharma Shanti Prema Swaroop Aap Hai
Sathya Dharma Shanti Prema Jeevan Ka Marma Hai
Gurudev Gurudev Gurudev Gurudev
meaning: O Lord Sai, our Divine Preceptor, You are the personification of Truth, Righteousness, Peace and Love, which are the foundations of this human life.
devanagari:
सत्य धर्म शांति प्रेम सब को दीजो  
सत्य धर्म शांति प्रेम स्वरूप आप हैं  
सत्य धर्म शांति प्रेम जीवन का मर्म है  
गुरु देव गुरु देव (2)
respell:
Satya Dharma Shānti Prem Sab Ko Dījo
Satya Dharma Shānti Prem Swarūp Āp Haiṃ
Satya Dharma Shānti Prem Jīvan Kā Marm Hai
Guru Dev Guru Dev (2)

title: Sathya Dharma Shanti Prema Swaroopa
lyrics:
Sathya Dharma Shanti Prema Swaroopa
Prasanthi Nilaya Deva
Rama Ho Krishna Ho Sai Rama Deva
Shiva Shakti Swaroopa Baba Hey Deena Palana Baba
Hey Prasanthi Nilaya Deva Hey Poornavatara Baba
Allah Ho Maulah Ho Sai Rama Deva
meaning: Salutations to the Lord of Prashanthi, Lord Sai, who is the embodiment of Truth, Peace, Love and Harmony, O Lord Sai, You are none other than Rama, Krishna, Shiva, Shakthi, Allah and Maulah all of whom offer solace to the weak and the downtrodden.
devanagari:
सत्य धर्म शान्ति प्रेम स्वरूपा प्रशान्ति निलया देवा
राम हो कृष्ण हो साईं राम देवा  
शिव शक्ति स्वरूप बाबा हे दीन पालना बाबा  
हे प्रशान्ति निलया देवा हे पूर्णावतारा बाबा  
अल्लाह हो मौला हो साईं राम देवा
respell:
Satya Dharma Shānti Prem Swarūpā Prashānti Nilayā Devā
Rām Ho Kṛushṇa Ho Sāīṃ Rām Devā
Shiv Shakti Swarūp Bābā He Dīna Pālanā Bābā
He Prashānti Nilayā Devā He Pūrṇāvatārā Bābā
Allāh Ho Maulā Ho Sāīṃ Rāma Devā

title: Sathya Narayana Govinda Madhava Sai Narayana Govinda Keshava
lyrics:
Sathya Narayana Govinda Madhava Sai Narayana Govinda Keshava
Hare Krishna Hare Krishna Hare Krishna Hare Hare
Hare Rama Hare Rama Hare Rama Hare Hare
meaning: Salutations to Lord Sathya Narayana, also known as Govinda, Madhava, Narayana, Keshava, Rama and Krishna.
devanagari:
सत्य नारायण गोविन्द माधवा साई नारायण गोविन्द केशवा (3)
हरे रामा हरे रामा हरे रामा हरे हरे
हरे कृष्णा हरे कृष्णा हरे कृष्णा हरे हरे
respell:
Satya Nārāyaṇ Govinda Mādhavā Sāī Nārāyaṇ Govinda Keshavā (3)
Hare Rāmā Hare Rāmā Hare Rāmā Hare Hare
Hare Kṛushṇā Hare Kṛushṇā Hare Kṛushṇā Hare Hare

title: Sathya Sai Padambujam Bhajare Manasa Nirantaram
lyrics:
Sathya Sai Padambujam Bhajare Manasa Nirantaram
Parama Pavitram Pavana Charanam
Kalimala Dahanam Sri Guru Charanam
Bhava Bhaya Nashana Durita Nivarana
Parthi Pureeshwara Pankaja Charanam
Bhajare Manasa Nirantaram
Bhaja Bhajare Manasa Nirantaram
meaning: Meditate incessantly upon the most holy and auspicious Lotus Feet of Lord Sathya Sai, the Feet of the Divine Preceptor, which will eradicate the sins of this Kali age, the Feet, which will destroy all the fears of this materialistic world and remove the obstacles.
devanagari:
सत्य साईं पादाम्भुजं भजोरे मानस निरन्तरम्  
परम पवित्रं पावन चरणम्  
कालिमल दहनं श्री गुरु चरणम्  
भव भय नाशन दु्रित निवारण  
पर्ती  पूरीश्वर पंकज चरणम्  
भजोरे मानस निरन्तरम्  
भजोरे मानस निरन्तरम् (2)
respell:
Satya Sāīṃ Pādāmbhujaṃ Bhajore Mānasa Nirantaram
Param Pavitraṃ Pāvan Charaṇam
Kālimala Dahanaṃ Shrī Guru Charaṇam
Bhava Bhaya Nāshan Durit Nivāraṇ
Partī  Pūrīshwar Paṅkaj Charaṇam
Bhajore Mānasa Nirantaram
Bhajore Mānas Nirantaram (2)

title: Sathya Sai Rama Hey Ghanashyama
lyrics:
Sathya Sai Rama Hey Ghanashyama
Prema Sudha Barso Shanti Sudha Barso
Kali Yuga Mein Tum Yuga Avatari
Sathya Sai Rama Hey Ghanashyama
meaning: O Lord Sathya Sai, the most venerable one, shower on us Your immense love and bestow peace upon us, O Lord of this Kali age.
devanagari:
सत्य साईं रामा हे घन श्यामा
प्रेम सुधा बरसो शान्ति सुधा बरसो [ सत्य साईं ... ]
कली युग में तुम युग अवतारी
सत्य साईं रामा हे घन श्यामा
respell:
Satya Sāīṃ Rāmā He Ghan Shyāmā
Prem Sudhā Baraso Shānti Sudhā Baraso [ Satya Sāīṃ ... ]
Kalī Yug Meṃ Tum Yug Avatārī
Satya Sāīṃ Rāmā He Ghan Shyāmā

title: Sathya Sai Smaranam Smaranam Parthi Sai Smaranam
lyrics:
Sathya Sai Smaranam Smaranam Parthi Sai Smaranam
Tribhuvana Palaka Sai Mahesha Parthi Sai Smaranam
Sri Guru Charanam Bhava Dukha Haranam
Sathya Sai Smaranam Smaranam
Parthi Sai Smaranam Smaranam
meaning: Constantly remember the name of Sathya Sai - the Lord of Parthi, the one who sustains all three worlds, chant the name of Sai Mahesha the one who removes all fears and sorrows of this materialistic world.
devanagari:
सत्य साई स्मरणम् स्मरणम् पर्ती साई स्मरणम्
त्रिभुवन पालक साई महेशा पर्ती साई स्मरणम् [सत्य साई ...]
श्री गुरु चरणम् भव दुःख हरणम्
सत्य साई स्मरणम् स्मरणम्
सत्य साई स्मरणम्
respell:
Satya Sāī Smaraṇam Smaraṇam Partī Sāī Smaraṇam
Tribhuvan Pālak Sāī Maheshā Partī Sāī Smaraṇam [satya Sāī ...]
Shrī Guru Charaṇam Bhava Duḥkha Haraṇam
Satya Sāī Smaraṇam Smaraṇam
Satya Sāī Smaraṇam

title: Sathya Sanatana Nitya Niranjana Bhakta Parayana Narayana
lyrics:
Sathya Sanatana Nitya Niranjana Bhakta Parayana Narayana
Govinda Govinda Narayana (2)
Narayana Sai Narayana
Parthi Puranjana Narayana
Govinda Govinda Narayana
meaning: Glory to You, O Lord Sai of Parthi, You are verily Lord Narayana. You are the indweller of Your devotees who chant Your name at all times. You are the personification of Truth and Purity.
devanagari:
सत्य सनातन नित्य निरंजन भक्त परायण नारायणा
गोविन्द गोविन्द नारायणा (2)
नारायणा साई नारायणा
पर्ति पुरंदर नारायणा [ गोविन्द गोविन्द ... ]
respell:
Satya Sanātana Nitya Nirañjana Bhakta Parāyaṇ Nārāyaṇā
Govinda Govinda Nārāyaṇā (2)
Nārāyaṇā Sāī Nārāyaṇā
Parti Purandara Nārāyaṇā [ Govinda Govinda ... ]

title: Sathya Swaroopini Ma Sai Prema Swaroopini Ma
lyrics:
Sathya Swaroopini Maa Sai Premaswaroopini Maa
Paramananda Daayini Hrudaya Nivaasini Parthi Nivaasini Maa
Vighna Vinaashini Bhava Bhaya Haarini Kali Kapalini Maa
Hey Tribhuvana Paalini Mangala Kaarini Moksha Pradaayini Maa
Paramananda Daayini Hrudaya Nivaasini Parthi Nivaasini Maa
meaning: Sing the Glory of Mother Sai - the embodiment of truth and bliss, the one who showers joy, the one who is present in everyone's heart, the one who removes all obstacles, fear and sorrow, the one who protects and sustains all the three worlds and is the embodiment of auspiciousness and the one who leads us to the path of liberation.
devanagari:
सत्य स्वरूपिणी मा साई प्रेम स्वरूपिणी मा  
आनंद दायिनी हृदय विहारिणी पर्ति निवासिनी मा (परम)  
विघ्न विनाशिनी भव भय हरिणी काली कपालिनी मा  
हे त्रिभुवन पालिनी मंगल करिणी मोक्ष प्रदायिनी मा [ आनंद ... ]
respell:
Satya Swarūpiṇī Mā Sāī Prem Swarūpiṇī Mā
Ānanda Dāyinī Hṛudaya Vihāriṇī Parti Nivāsinī Mā (param)
Vighna Vināshinī Bhava Bhaya Hariṇī Kālī Kapālinī Mā
He Tribhuvan Pālinī Maṅgal Kariṇī Moksha Pradāyinī Mā [ Ānanda ... ]

title: Sathyam Jnanam Anantam Brahma
lyrics:
Sathyam Jnanam Anantam Brahma (3)
Sathyam Brahma
Jnanam Brahma
Anantam Brahma
meaning: Glory to You, O Lord Sai, who is verily the Supreme Being, the embodiment of Eternal Truth, Wisdom and who is Infinite.
devanagari:
सत्यं ज्ञानं अनन्तं ब्रह्मा (3)
सत्यं ब्रह्मा
ज्ञानं ब्रह्मा
अनन्तं ब्रह्मा
respell:
Satyaṃ Jñānaṃ Anantaṃ Brahmā (3)
Satyaṃ Brahmā
Jñānaṃ Brahmā
Anantaṃ Brahmā

title: Sayeeshwari Amba Jagadeeshwari
lyrics:
Sayeeshwari Amba Jagadeeshwari
Kalyani Kanchipuri Kamakshi
Partheeshwari Amba Parameshwari
Matangi Madurapuri Meenakshi
meaning: Salutations to Mother Sai whose abode is Parthi, who is the mother to this entire universe. She is also the presiding deity in Kanchi (by name Kamakshi) and Madurai (by name Meenakshi)
devanagari:
साईश्वरी अम्बा जगदीश्वरी
कल्याणी कांचीपुरी कामाक्षी
पर्तीश्वरी अम्बा परमेश्वरी
मातंगी मदुरापुरी मीनाक्षी
respell:
Sāīshwarī Ambā Jagadīshwarī
Kalyāṇī Kāñchīpurī Kāmākshī
Partīshwarī Ambā Parameshwarī
Mātaṅgī Madurāpurī Mīnākshī

title: Shaila Gireeshwara Uma Maheshwara
lyrics:
Shaila Gireeshwara Uma Maheshwara
Kashi Vishweshwara Sadashiva
Sadashiva Sadashiva
Sadashiva Shambho Sadashiva
meaning: Salutations to Lord Shiva who is the Lord of Kashi (also known as Banares) and the consort of Goddess Uma (Parvathi).
devanagari:
शैला गिरीश्वर उमा महेश्वर
काशी विश्वेश्वर सदाशिवा
सदाशिवा सदाशिवा
सदाशिवा शम्भो सदाशिवा
respell:
Shailā Girīshwar Umā Maheshwar
Kāshī Vishweshwar Sadāshivā
Sadāshivā Sadāshivā
Sadāshivā Shambho Sadāshivā

title: Shambho Mahadeva Gangadhara
lyrics:
Shambho Mahadeva Gangadhara
Kailasa Vasa Shiva Shankara
Parvati Ramana Parameshwara
Paratpara Jagadeeshwara
meaning: Salutations to Lord Shiva Shankara (also known as Mahadeva) who holds the sacred river Ganges in His matted locks, who has made Mount Kailasa His abode, who is Higher than the Highest, the Lord of the Universe and the consort of Goddess Parvathi.
devanagari:
शम्भो महादेव गंगाधारा 
कैलास वासा  शिव शङ्करा
पार्वति रमणा परमेश्वरा
परात्परा जगदीश्वरा
respell:
Shambho Mahādeva Gaṅgādhārā
Kailās Vāsā  Shiv Shaṅkarā
Pārwati Ramaṇā Parameshwarā
Parātparā Jagadīshwarā

title: Shambho Mahadeva Mallikarjuna
lyrics:
Shambho Mahadeva Mallikarjuna
Mangala Charana Trilochana
Pinaka Pani Parvati Ramana
Bhava Bhaya Harana Sanatana
Parthipureeshwara Patita Pavana
meaning: Our salutations at the sacred feet of Lord Shiva, (also known as Shambho, Mahadeva and Mallikarjuna) who wields the Bow (Pinaka), who is the consort of Parvathi, who destroys the fear of materialistic world and who is none other than Lord Sai of Parthi.
devanagari:
शम्भो महादेव मल्लीकार्जुना
मंगल चरणा त्रिलोचना
पिनाक पानी पार्वती रमणा
भव भय हरणा सनातना
पर्तिपूरीश्वर पतित पावना
respell:
Shambho Mahādeva Mallīkārjunā
Maṅgal Charaṇā Trilochanā
Pināka Pānī Pārwatī Ramaṇā
Bhava Bhaya Haraṇā Sanātanā
Partipūrīshwar Patita Pāvanā

title: Shambho Mahadeva Shiva Shambho Mahadeva
lyrics:
Shambho Mahadeva Shiva Shambho Mahadeva
Hara Haraya Bhava Bhavaya Shiva Shivaya Namah Om
Om Namah Shivaya Om Om Namah Shivaya Om
meaning: Sing the glory of Lord Shiva who is also called Shambho and Mahadeva. He is the one who destroys the fear of the materialistic world.
devanagari:
शम्भो महादेवा शिव शम्भो महादेवा
हर हराय भव भवाय शिव शिवाय नमः ॐ
ॐ नमः शिवाय ॐ ॐ नमः शिवाय ॐ
respell:
Shambho Mahādevā Shiv Shambho Mahādevā
Har Harāy Bhava Bhavāy Shiv Shivāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy Oṃ Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy Oṃ

title: Shambho Mahadeva Shiva Shambho Mahadeva
lyrics:
Shambho Mahadeva Shiva Shambho Mahadeva
Samba Sadashiva Sai Shankara Shambho Mahadeva
Hara Hara Hara Shambho Bhava Bhaya Hara Hara Shambho
Shiva Shiva Shiva Shambho Sathya Sayeeshwara Shambho
meaning: Sing the glory of the Lord who is worshipped in the form of Lord Shambho, Mahadeva, Shiva and Shankara.
devanagari:
शम्भो महादेवा शिव शम्भो महादेवा
सांब सदाशिव साई शंकर शम्भो महादेवा
हर हर हर शम्भो भव भय हर हर शम्भो
शिव शिव शिव शम्भो सत्य साईश्वर शम्भो
respell:
Shambho Mahādevā Shiv Shambho Mahādevā
Sāmb Sadāshiv Sāī Shaṅkar Shambho Mahādevā
Har Har Har Shambho Bhava Bhaya Har Har Shambho
Shiv Shiv Shiv Shambho Satya Sāīshwar Shambho

title: Shambho Mahadeva
lyrics:
Shambho Mahadeva
Shiva Shambho Mahadeva
Chandrakaladhara Gangadhara
Gauri Vara Shankara
Shiva Shiva Shiva Shambho
Hara Hara Hara Shambho
Hara Gauri Natha Shambho
Hara Sai Natha Shambho
meaning: Glory to Lord Shiva who is also known as Mahadeva and Shambho, the one who adorns the crescent Moon on His forehead and the sacred river Ganges in His matted locks, the one who is the consort of Gowri (Parvathi).
devanagari:
शम्भो महादेवा (3) (शिव)
चन्द्रकलाधर गंगाधरा
गौरी वरा शंकरा
शिव शिव शिव शम्भो
हर हर हर शम्भो
हर गौरी (सत्य साईं) नाथ शम्भो
respell:
Shambho Mahādevā (3) (shiv)
Chandrakalādhara Gaṅgādharā
Gaurī Varā Shaṅkarā
Shiv Shiv Shiv Shambho
Har Har Har Shambho
Har Gaurī (satya Sāīṃ) Nātha Shambho

title: Shambho Murare Shankara Murare
lyrics:
Shambho Murare Shankara Murare
Murahara Phani Dhara Shankara Murare
meaning: Sing the Glory of Lord Shankara (Shiva), the slayer of the demon Mura and the one who adorns the serpent around His neck.
devanagari:
शम्भो मुरारे शंकर मुरारे
मुरहर फणी धर शंकर मुरारे
शम्भो मुरारे शंकर मुरारे [ मुरहर फणी ... ]
respell:
Shambho Murāre Shaṅkar Murāre
Murahar Phaṇī Dhara Shaṅkar Murāre
Shambho Murāre Shaṅkar Murāre [ Murahar Phaṇī ... ]

title: Shambho Shankara Deva
lyrics:
Shambho Shankara Deva
Bhole Baba Mahadeva
Sai Baba Mahadeva
Pahi Prabho Sharanam Deva (2)
Bhole Baba Mahadeva
Sai Baba Mahadeva
--
Hara Hara Gange Mahadeva (3)
meaning: Glory to Lord Shiva who bears the Holy river Ganga and who is the Lord of the Lords, Mahadeva. We offer our salutations and surrender to You, O Lord Sai Baba. You are verily the embodiment of Lord Shiva.
devanagari:
शम्भो शंकर देवा
भोले (साई) बाबा महादेवा
पाही प्रभो शरणम् देवा (२) [ भोले बाबा ... ]
हर हर गंगे महादेवा (३)
respell:
Shambho Shaṅkar Devā
Bhole (sāī) Bābā Mahādevā
Pāhī Prabho Sharaṇam Devā (2) [ Bhole Bābā ... ]
Har Har Gaṅge Mahādevā (3)

title: Shambho Shankara Shiva Shambho Shankara
lyrics:
Shambho Shankara Shiva Shambho Shankara
Shambho Shankara Samba Sadashiva Shambho Shankara
Parthi Nayaka Paramesha Pahi Mam (2)
Shambho Shankara Samba Sadashiva Shambho Shankara
meaning: Salutations to Lord Sai, the Lord of Puttaparthi, who is none other than Lord Shiva also glorified as Shambho, Shankara, Sadashiva and Paramesha.
devanagari:
शम्भो शंकरा शिव शम्भो शंकरा
शम्भो शंकर सांब सदाशिव शम्भो शंकरा 
पर्ति नायका परमेशा पाही माम (2) [ शम्भो शंकर सांब... ]
respell:
Shambho Shaṅkarā Shiv Shambho Shaṅkarā
Shambho Shaṅkar Sāmb Sadāshiv Shambho Shaṅkarā
Parti Nāyakā Parameshā Pāhī Mām (2) [ Shambho Shaṅkar Sāmb... ]

title: Shambho Shiva Shankara
lyrics:
Shambho Shiva Shankara
Gangadhara Hara Gauri Shiva
Hara Hara Mahadeva Kailasa Vasa
Partheesha Paramesha Pahi Prabho
meaning: Salutations to Lord Shiva - The source of eternal happiness and auspiciousness, resides in mount Kailash with Mother Gowri as His divine consort and holds Ganga on his head. I seek the grace of this supreme Lord who is also the Lord of Puttaparthi!
devanagari:
शम्भो शिव शंकरा
गंगाधरा हर गौरी शिवा [ शम्भो शिव ... ]
हर हर महादेव कैलास वासा
पर्तीश परमेश पाही प्रभो
respell:
Shambho Shiv Shaṅkarā
Gaṅgādharā Har Gaurī Shivā [ Shambho Shiv ... ]
Har Har Mahādeva Kailās Vāsā
Partīsha Paramesha Pāhī Prabho

title: Shambu Kumara Gauri Tanaya
lyrics:
Shambu Kumara Gauri Tanaya
Gajanana Sadaya Jaya Jaya
Varada Ganesha Durita Vinasha
Pranavakara Natha Sadaya
meaning: Salutations to Lord Ganesha, the son of Lord Shiva (Shambhu) and Mother Parvathi (Gowri), the one who grants boons, destroys obstacles and who is personification of the Primordial sound "Om".
devanagari:
शम्भु कुमारा गौरी तनया
गजानना सदया जय जय
वरद गणेशा दुरित विनाशा
प्रणवाकार नाथ सादय [ गजानना सदया ... ]
respell:
Shambhu Kumārā Gaurī Tanayā
Gajānanā Sadayā Jaya Jaya
Varad Gaṇeshā Durit Vināshā
Praṇavākār Nātha Sādaya [ Gajānanā Sadayā ... ]

title: Shambhu Kumara Haro Hara
lyrics:
Shambhu Kumara Haro Hara
Shiva Shankari Bala Haro Hara
Uma Sutha Shanmukha Guha
Shiva Sharavana Bhava Haro Hara
Pazhani Girisha Haro Hara Puttaparthi Pureesha Haro Hara
Hara Hara Hara Hara Shiva Shiva Shiva Shiva [ Shiva Sharavana ... ]
meaning: Oh Son of Shambhu and Shankari, divine child of Uma, we hail you, six-faced Guha, born of Sharavana! Lord of Palani Hill, you are also the revered Lord of Puttaparthi, Sai, whose sacred names we chant with devotion.
devanagari:
शंभु कुमारा हरो हरा 
शिव शंकरी बाला हरो हरा 
उमा सुता षण्मुखा गुहा 
शिव शरवण भव हरो हरा 
पलनी  गिरीशा  हरो हरा पुट्टपर्ती पुरीशा  हरो हरा 
हर हर हर हर शिव शिव शिव शिव 
शिव शरवण भव हरो हरा
respell:
Shambhu Kumārā Haro Harā
Shiv Shaṅkarī Bālā Haro Harā
Umā Sutā Shaṇmukhā Guhā
Shiv Sharavaṇ Bhava Haro Harā
Palanī  Girīshā  Haro Harā Puṭṭapartī Purīshā  Haro Harā
Har Har Har Har Shiv Shiv Shiv Shiv
shiv sharavaṇ bhava haro harā

title: Shankara Nama Bhajo
lyrics:
Shankara Nama Bhajo
Shankara Shankara Nama Bhajo (3)
Peetambhara Dhara Sai Shankara
Chandrakala Dhara Gauri Manohara
meaning: Let us chant the holy name of Shankara, the divine Lord. O Sai Shankara, you are adorned in golden robes, the beloved of Gauri, who bears the crescent moon upon your forehead.
devanagari:
शंकर नाम भजो
शंकर शंकर नाम भजो (3) [ शंकर नाम ... ]
पीताम्बर धर साई शंकर
चन्द्रकला धर गौरी मनोहर
respell:
Shaṅkar Nām Bhajo
Shaṅkar Shaṅkar Nām Bhajo (3) [ Shaṅkar Nām ... ]
Pītāmbara Dhara Sāī Shaṅkar
Chandrakalā Dhara Gaurī Manohar

title: Shankara Sadashiva Chandrashekhara
lyrics:
Shankara Sadashiva Chandrashekhara
Chandrashekhara Sai Shankara
Neelakantha Shooladhari Sai Shankara
Phala Netra Tripurahari Sai Shankara
Chandrashekhara Sai Shankara
meaning: Obeisance to Lord Sai who is none other than Lord Shankara (Shiva), the one who holds the crescent moon on His head. He is also known as Neelakanta, as His throat is blue in color (due to the poison He swallowed during the conflict between Gods and demons). Salutations to the one who holds the Trident and who has the Third Eye on His forehead and who slayed the demon Tripura.
devanagari:
शंकरा सदाशिवा चंद्रशेखरा
चंद्रशेखरा (सत्य) साई शंकरा [ शंकरा सदाशिवा ... ]
नीलकंठ शूलधारी साई शंकरा
फाल नेत्र त्रिपुर हारी साई शंकरा [ चंद्रशेखरा ... ]
respell:
Shaṅkarā Sadāshivā Chandrashekharā
Chandrashekharā (satya) Sāī Shaṅkarā [ Shaṅkarā Sadāshivā ... ]
Nīlakaṇṭh Shūladhārī Sāī Shaṅkarā
Phāla Netra Tripura Hārī Sāī Shaṅkarā [ Chandrashekharā ... ]

title: Shankara Shankara Sadashiva
lyrics:
Shankara Shankara Sadashiva
Sadashiva Hey Samba Shiva
Amba Sahita Samba Shiva
Samba Shiva Hey Sadashiva
meaning: Pray to the ever blissfull Lord Shankara (Shiva) who is always with Mother Amba (Parvathi).
devanagari:
शंकर शंकर सदाशिवा
सदाशिवा हे सांब शिवा [ शंकर ... ]
अम्बा सहिता सांबा शिवा
सांब शिवा हे सदाशिवा
respell:
Shaṅkar Shaṅkar Sadāshivā
Sadāshivā He Sāmb Shivā [ Shaṅkar ... ]
Ambā Sahitā Sāmbā Shivā
Sāmb Shivā He Sadāshivā

title: Shankara Shankara
lyrics:
Shankara Shankara
Sai Shankara
Nada Shareera Vedoddhara
Kaliyuga Avatara Sai
Hara Shiva Shankara Sai
Shiva Shiva Shankara Sai
Chandrashekara Sai Parthi Shankara Sai
meaning: Glory to Lord Sai Shankara who is the embodiment of music and the vedas who have taken the form of Sai in this age of Kali, we hail victory to you and offer our salutations to you, O Sai!
devanagari:
शंकरा शंकरा
साई शंकरा
नाद शरीरा वेदोत्धारा
कलियुग अवतार साई
हर शिव शंकर साई शिव शिव शंकर साई
चन्द्रशेखरा साई पर्ति शंकर साई
respell:
Shaṅkarā Shaṅkarā
Sāī Shaṅkarā
Nāda Sharīrā Vedotdhārā
Kaliyug Avatāra Sāī
Har Shiv Shaṅkar Sāī Shiv Shiv Shaṅkar Sāī
Chandrashekharā Sāī Parti Shaṅkar Sāī

title: Shankara Shankara Samba Sadashiva Shankara Shankara Shambho
lyrics:
Shankara Shankara Samba Sadashiva Shankara Shankara Shambho
Chandrakaladhara Shankara Ganga Jatadhara Shankara
Kailasa Vasa Shankara Trishula Dhari Shankara
Shivaya Bhavaya
Shiva Bhava Hara Chandrashekara
meaning: Glory to Lord Shiva, the most auspicious one who is adorned with the crescent moon and who bears the Holy Ganges on His head. He is the resident of Mount Kailasa, wields a Trident and destroys the fear of the materialistic world.
devanagari:
शंकर शंकर सांब सदाशिव शंकर शंकर शम्भो
चन्द्रकलाधर शंकरा गंगा जटाधर शंकरा [ शंकर शंकर ... ]
कैलास वासा शंकरा त्रिशूल धारी शंकरा
शिवाय भवाय
शिवा भवा हर चन्द्रशेखरा
respell:
Shaṅkar Shaṅkar Sāmb Sadāshiv Shaṅkar Shaṅkar Shambho
Chandrakalādhara Shaṅkarā Gaṅgā Jaṭādhara Shaṅkarā [ Shaṅkar Shaṅkar ... ]
Kailās Vāsā Shaṅkarā Trishūl Dhārī Shaṅkarā
Shivāy Bhavāy
Shivā Bhavā Har Chandrashekharā

title: Shankara Shankara Shankara Shankara Shambho Shankara
lyrics:
Shankara Shankara Shankara Shankara Shambho Shankara
Shiva Shambho Hara Shambho Shiva Shiva Shiva Shambho
Shiva Shambho Hara Shambho
Shambho Shankara Sayeesha
Trishula Dhari Trinetra Dhari
Shiva Shambho Hara Shambho
Shambho Shankara Sayeesha
meaning: Salutations to Lord Sai who is none other than Lord Shiva (with other names like Shambho, Shankara), the one who is armed with the Trident and with the third eye on His forehead.
devanagari:
शंकर शंकर शंकर शंकर शम्भो शंकरा
शिव शम्भो हर शम्भो शिव शिव शिव शम्भो
शिव शम्भो हर शम्भो
शम्भो शंकर साईशा
त्रिशूल धारी त्रिनेत्र धारी
शिव शम्भो हर शम्भो
शम्भो शंकर साईशा
respell:
Shaṅkar Shaṅkar Shaṅkar Shaṅkar Shambho Shaṅkarā
Shiv Shambho Har Shambho Shiv Shiv Shiv Shambho
Shiv Shambho Har Shambho
Shambho Shaṅkar Sāīshā
Trishūl Dhārī Trinetra Dhārī
Shiv Shambho Har Shambho
Shambho Shaṅkar Sāīshā

title: Shankara Shankara Shankari Manohara
lyrics:
Shankara Shankara Shankari Manohara
Parvathi Nayaka
Paahi Gangadhara
Pankaja Lochana
Pannaga Bhooshana
Chandrabimba Mukha
Chandrashekara Harey
Jai Jai Shankara Hara Hara Shankara (6)
meaning: Oh Shankara, beloved of Shankari and consort of Parvati, we seek your divine protection, O bearer of the Ganga. Your lotus eyes gaze upon us, your face shines like the full moon, and you are adorned with serpents, bearing the crescent moon upon your head. Victory and salutations to you, Lord Shiva!
devanagari:
शंकरा शंकरा शंकरि मनोहरा
पार्वती नायका
पाहि गंगाधरा
पंकज लोचना
पन्नग भूषणा
चन्द्रबिम्बा मुखा
चन्द्रशेखरा हरे
जय जय शंकर हर हर शंकर (6)
respell:
Shaṅkarā Shaṅkarā Shaṅkari Manoharā
Pārwatī Nāyakā
Pāhi Gaṅgādharā
Paṅkaj Lochanā
Pannaga Bhūshaṇā
Chandrabimbā Mukhā
Chandrashekharā Hare
Jay Jay Shaṅkar Har Har Shaṅkar (6)

title: Shankara Shiva Shankara Shiva Shankara Shambho
lyrics:
Shankara Shiva Shankara Shiva Shankara Shambho
Shankara Shiva Shankara Shiva Shambho Mahadeva
Dama Dama Damaru Bhaje Shankara Ghana Ghana Ghanta Bhaje
Hara Bhole Nath Shambho Hara Sai Nath Shambho
Hara Hara Bhole Nath Shambho Hara Sai Nath Shambho
meaning: Salutations to Lord Shankara, also known as Shiva and Shambho who dances to the sound of Damaru (the miniature drum in His hand) and the ringing of bells. Chant the name of Sai Natha who is verily Lord Shiva.
devanagari:
शंकरा शिव शंकरा शिव शंकरा शम्भो
शंकरा शिव शंकरा शिव शम्भो महादेवा [ शंकरा ... ]
डम डम डमरू बजे शंकर घन घन घंटा बजे
(हर) हर भोले नाथ शम्भो हर साई नाथ शम्भो
respell:
Shaṅkarā Shiv Shaṅkarā Shiv Shaṅkarā Shambho
Shaṅkarā Shiv Shaṅkarā Shiv Shambho Mahādevā [ Shaṅkarā ... ]
Ḍama Ḍama Ḍamarū Baje Shaṅkar Ghan Ghan Ghaṇṭā Baje
(har) Har Bhole Nātha Shambho Har Sāī Nātha Shambho

title: Shankaram Bhaje Shankaram Bhaje Parthi Vasa Sai Deva Shankaram Bhaje
lyrics:
Shankaram Bhaje Shankaram Bhaje Parthi Vasa Sai Deva Shankaram Bhaje
Sadgurum Bhaje Sadgurum Bhaje Sachidananda Guru Sadgurum Bhaje
meaning: Chant the name of Lord Sai whose abode is Parthi, who is none other than Lord Shankara, chant the name of the Universal Preceptor who is the embodiment of bliss.
devanagari:
शंकरं भजे शंकरं भजे पर्ती वासा साई देवा शंकरं भजे
सद्गुरुं भजे सद्गुरुं भजे सच्चिदानंद गुरु सद्गुरुं भजे
respell:
Shaṅkaraṃ Bhaje Shaṅkaraṃ Bhaje Partī Vāsā Sāī Devā Shaṅkaraṃ Bhaje
Sadguruṃ Bhaje Sadguruṃ Bhaje Sachchidānanda Guru Sadguruṃ Bhaje

title: Shankari Bhakta Vashankari Ma
lyrics:
Shankari Bhakta Vashankari Ma
Sankataharini Sai Ma
Pranava Swaroopini Prema Dayini
Parthipureeshwari Palaya Mam
Mangala Karini Manjula Bhashini
Jnana Dayini Sai Ma
Sai Ma Sai Ma
Sai Ma Sathya Sai Ma
meaning: Salutations to Mother Shankari (Parvathi), who is the remover of obstacles, who is verily Mother Sai, the embodiment of the Primordial Sound Om. Protect us O Lord of Parthi, the bestower of love, wisdom, and auspiciousness.
devanagari:
शङ्करी भक्त वशङ्करी माँ
सङ्कटहारिणी साई माँ
प्रणव स्वरूपिणी प्रेम दायिनी
पर्तीपुरीश्वरी पालय माम्
मङ्गल कारिणी मञ्जुळ भाषिणी
ज्ञान दायिनी साई माँ
साई माँ साई माँ
साई माँ सत्य साई माँ
respell:
Shaṅkarī Bhakta Vashaṅkarī Mām̐
Saṅkaṭahāriṇī Sāī Mām̐
Praṇava Swarūpiṇī Prem Dāyinī
Partīpurīshwarī Pālay Mām
Maṅgal Kāriṇī Mañjuळ Bhāshiṇī
Jñāna Dāyinī Sāī Mām̐
Sāī Mām̐ Sāī Mām̐
Sāī Mām̐ Satya Sāī Mām̐

title: Shanmukha Shanmukha Sai Sundara
lyrics:
Shanmukha Shanmukha Sai Sundara
Shiva (Guru) Sharavanabhava Om
Mangala Gauri Shankara Nandana [ Shiv (guru) ... ]
Parti Vihari Pranavakari [ Shiv (guru) ... ]
meaning: O Shanmukha, beautiful Lord Muruga and son of Shiva and Parvati, You are the embodiment of divine wisdom and the sacred Om. As Sai and as the Divine Guru, You guide and protect Your devotees, granting courage, knowledge, auspiciousness, and spiritual enlightenment. We bow to You and seek Your grace.
devanagari:
षण्मुख षण्मुख साई सुन्दर
शिव (गुरु) शरवण भव ॐ
मंगल गौरी शंकर नंदन [ शिव (गुरु) ... ]
पर्ती विहारी प्रणवाकारी [ शिव (गुरु) ... ]
respell:
Shaṇmukha Shaṇmukha Sāī Sundara
Shiv (guru) Sharavaṇ Bhava Oṃ
Maṅgal Gaurī Shaṅkar Nandana [ Shiv (guru) ... ]
Partī Vihārī Praṇavākārī [ Shiv (guru) ... ]

title: Shanta Durge Shanta Swaroopini
lyrics:
Shanta Durge Shanta Swaroopini
Shyamala Komala Mana Mohini
Adi Anadi Ananta Swaroopini
Moksha Pradayini Narayani
Mukti Pradayini Narayani
meaning: This song extols Mother Durga who has a peaceful appearance, attractive dark complexioned soft features, who is the embodiment of a form that is all pervading without beginning and end and the one who liberates us from the cycle of birth and death.
devanagari:
शांता दुर्गे शांत स्वरूपिणी
श्यामल कोमल मन मोहिनी
आदि अनादि अनंत स्वरूपिणी
मोक्ष प्रदायिनी नारायणी
मुक्ति प्रदायिनी नारायणी
respell:
Shāntā Durge Shānt Swarūpiṇī
Shyāmala Komala Mana Mohinī
Ādi Anādi Ananta Swarūpiṇī
Moksha Pradāyinī Nārāyaṇī
Mukti Pradāyinī Nārāyaṇī

title: Sharanam Sharanam Pahi Gajanana
lyrics:
Sharanam Sharanam Pahi Gajanana
Vighna Vinashaka Gananatha
Buddhi Pradayaka Pahi Gajanana
Asura Nikhandana Pahi Gajanana
Pahi Gajanana Pahi Gajanana
Vighna Vinashaka Gananatha
meaning: Surrender to Lord Gajanana, who removes and destroys all obstacles in our path to salvation, the one who bestows wisdom, the one who destroys all the demonic qualities within us.
devanagari:
शरणं शरणं पाहि गजानना
विघ्न विनाशक गणनाथा
बुद्धि प्रदायक पाहि गजानन
असुर निखंडन पाहि गजानन
पाहि गजानन पाहि गजानन
[ विघ्न विनाशक ... ]
respell:
Sharaṇaṃ Sharaṇaṃ Pāhi Gajānanā
Vighna Vināshak Gaṇanāthā
Buddhi Pradāyak Pāhi Gajānana
Asur Nikhaṇḍana Pāhi Gajānana
Pāhi Gajānana Pāhi Gajānana
[ Vighna Vināshak ... ]

title: Sharanam Sharanam Sharanam Sharanam Sharanam Ayyappa
lyrics:
Sharanam Sharanam Sharanam Sharanam Sharanam Ayyappa
Shabarimamalayil Vazhum Sharanam Ayyappa
[Sharanam..]
Bhakta Jana Rakshakane Sharanam Ayyappa
Bhakti Mukti Dayakane Sharanam Ayyappa
Shiva - Shakti Roopa Sai Roopa Sharanam Ayyappa
Sarvadevataswaroopa Sharanam Ayyappa
[Sharanam..]

2nd and 3rd Speed:
Swamiye..  (chorus - Ayyappa) 
Swami Sharanam … (chorus -Ayyappa Sharanam)
meaning: Oh Lord Ayyappa, I offer my complete surrender to you, who dwells in the sacred Sabarimala. You are the protector of devotees, the bestower of devotion and liberation, embodying the divine forms of Shiva-Shakti, Sai, and indeed all deities.
devanagari:
शरणम् शरणम् शरणम् शरणम् शरणम् अय्यप्पा
शबरिमामलयिल वाझुम शरणम् अय्यप्पा
[शरणम्..]
भक्त जन रक्षकने शरणम् अय्यप्पा
भक्ति मुक्ति दायकने शरणम् अय्यप्पा
शिव - शक्ति रूप साई रूप शरणम् अय्यप्पा
सर्वदेवतास्वरूप शरणम् अय्यप्पा
[शरणम्..]

दूसरी और तीसरी गति:
स्वामिये.. (कोरस - अय्यप्पा) 
स्वामी शरणम् … (कोरस - अय्यप्पा शरणम्)
respell:
Sharaṇam Sharaṇam Sharaṇam Sharaṇam Sharaṇam Ayyappā
Shabarimāmalayil Vājhum Sharaṇam Ayyappā
[sharaṇam..]
Bhakta Jana Rakshakane Sharaṇam Ayyappā
Bhakti Mukti Dāyakane Sharaṇam Ayyappā
Shiv - Shakti Rūp Sāī Rūp Sharaṇam Ayyappā
Sarwadevatāswarūp Sharaṇam Ayyappā
[sharaṇam..]

dūsarī aur tīsarī Gati:
Swāmiye.. (koras - Ayyappā) 
swāmī Sharaṇam … (koras - ayyappā Sharaṇam)

title: Shata Bar Kaho Re Sai Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram
lyrics:
Shata Bar Kaho Re Sai Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram
He Mangala Nayana Ram He Gopi Jeevana Shyam
He Shirdi Ke Bhagawan He Prasanthi Nilaya Ram
Shata Koti Namana Sai Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram
meaning: Our innumerable salutations to Lord Sai Ram, the one whose look is the most auspicious and the one who is the very life of the Gopikas. He is the Lord of Shirdi and the one who resides at Prashanthi Nilayam in Puttaparthi. Let us chant His name million times.
devanagari:
शत बार कहो रे साई राम साई राम साई राम साई राम
हे मंगल नयना राम हे गोपी जीवना श्याम
हे शिरडी के भगवान हे प्रशांति निलया राम
शत कोटि नमन साई राम
साई राम साई राम साई राम
respell:
Shat Bār Kaho Re Sāī Rām Sāī Rām Sāī Rām Sāī Rām
He Maṅgal Nayanā Rām He Gopī Jīvanā Shyām
He Shiraḍī Ke Bhagavān He Prashānti Nilayā Rām
Shat Koṭi Namana Sāī Rām
Sāī Rām Sāī Rām Sāī Rām

title: Sheetala Charanam Komala Charanam Manjula Charanam Mama Guru Charanam
lyrics:
Sheetala Charanam Komala Charanam Manjula Charanam Mama Guru Charanam
Mrudula Charanam Anugraha Charanam
Sadguru Charanam Sada Smarami
Prema Data Sai Guru Natha
Pavana Charanam Sada Smarami
Pavana Charanam Sada Bhajami
meaning: The feet of my preceptor is cooling and soft, they are tender to touch and they are full of grace. Let us all meditate and offer our prayers to these holy feet, which always shower love and grace.
devanagari:
शीतल चरणं कोमल चरणं, मञ्जुल चरणं मम गुरु चरणं
मृदुल चरणं अनुग्रह चरणं 
सद्गुरु चरणं सदा स्मरामि 
प्रेम दाता साई गुरु नाथ 
पावन चरणं सदा भजामि
respell:
Shītala Charaṇaṃ Komala Charaṇaṃ, Mañjula Charaṇaṃ Mama Guru Charaṇaṃ
Mṛudula Charaṇaṃ Anugrah Charaṇaṃ
Sadguru Charaṇaṃ Sadā Smarāmi
Prem Dātā Sāī Guru Nātha
Pāvan Charaṇaṃ Sadā Bhajāmi

title: Sesha Saila Vasa Narayana
lyrics:
Sesha Saila Vasa Narayana
Bhakta Parijata Naryana
Sarva Jeeva Vasa Narayana
Sama Gana Lola Narayana
Sathya Sai Roopa Narayana
meaning: Salutations to Lord Narayana who is reclining on the Celestial Serpent Adi Sesha. O Lord, You are the ever-pleasing Parijata flower for Your devotees, the indweller of all beings. You foster the Saama Veda which is the basis of music. O Lord Sathya Sai, You are none other than Lord Narayana.
devanagari:
शेष शैल वासा नारायण
भक्त पारिजाता नारायणा [ शेष शैला ... ]
सर्व जीव वासा नारायणा
साम गान लोला नारायणा
सत्य साई रूपा नारायणा (हे)
respell:
Shesh Shail Vāsā Nārāyaṇ
Bhakta Pārijātā Nārāyaṇā [ Shesh Shailā ... ]
Sarwa Jīva Vāsā Nārāyaṇā
Sām Gān Lolā Nārāyaṇā
Satya Sāī Rūpā Nārāyaṇā (he)

title: Shirdi Ke Sai Parthi Ke Baba
lyrics:
Shirdi Ke Sai Parthi Ke Baba
Tum Ho Hamare Pyare Sai Baba
Premamaya Sai Prema Pradata
Eshwaramba Nandana Jagat Paripala
Papa Vinashaka Parama Krupala
meaning: O Lord Sai! You are the Avatar of Shirdi and as well as Parthi! You are our loving Sai Baba! You are the supreme Lord of this Universe, personification of love, bestower of divine love! O compassionate son of mother Eshwaramba, annihilate our sins.
devanagari:
शिर्डी के साई पर्ती के बाबा
तुम हो हमारे प्यारे साई बाबा [ शिर्डी के ... ]
प्रेममय साई प्रेम प्रदाता
ईश्वराम्बा नंदन जगत परिपाला
पाप विनाशक परम कृपाला
respell:
Shirḍī Ke Sāī Partī Ke Bābā
Tum Ho Hamāre Pyāre Sāī Bābā [ Shirḍī Ke ... ]
Premamaya Sāī Prem Pradātā
Īshwarāmbā Nandana Jagat Paripālā
Pāpa Vināshak Param Kṛupālā

title: Shirdi Nivasa Sai Shankara
lyrics:
Shirdi Nivasa Sai Shankara
Parthi Nivasa Sai Shankara
Bhavateeta Bhava Gochara
Kalateeta Kala Bhairava
--
Jai Jagadeeshwara Omkareshwara
meaning: The residing divinity of Shirdi and Parthi is verily the same Sai Shankara (One who is the embodiment of auspiciousness). Though He is beyond emotions and time He shows glimpses of His divinity when one is filled with sublime feelings. Time originates and dissolves in Him. Victory to that Lord of Universe who is the source of the primordial sound (Omkar).
devanagari:
शिर्डी निवासा साई शंकरा
पर्ती निवासा साई शंकरा
भावातीता भाव गोचरा
कालातीता काल भैरवा
जय जगदीश्वर ॐकारेश्वर (५)
respell:
Shirḍī Nivāsā Sāī Shaṅkarā
Partī Nivāsā Sāī Shaṅkarā
Bhāvātītā Bhāva Gocharā
Kālātītā Kāl Bhairavā
Jay Jagadīshwar Oṃkāreshwar (5)

title: Shirdi Sai Dwarakamayi Prasanthivasi Sai Ram
lyrics:
Shirdi Sai Dwarakamayi Prasanthivasi Sai Ram
Sai Ram Sai Ram Ek Nam Sundar Nam
Allah Eshwar Sai Ram
Parthipuri Ke Hey Bhagawan
Daya Karo Daya Karo Daya Karo Hey Bhagawan
Daya Karo Krupa Karo Raksha Karo Hey Bhagawan
meaning: Salutations to Lord Shirdi Baba, the Lord of Dwarakamayi and to the Lord of Prashanthi, Sai Ram, the name so enthralling. He is none other than Allah and Eshwar (Shiva) and the Lord of Parthi. O Lord show mercy and protect us.
devanagari:
शिर्डी साई द्वारकामाई प्रशांति वासी साई राम  
साई राम साई राम एक नाम सुंदर नाम [ शिर्डी साई ... ]  
अल्लाह ईश्वर साई राम  
पर्तिपुरी के हे भगवान  
दया करो कृपा करो रक्षा करो हे भगवान [ साई राम ... ]
respell:
Shirḍī Sāī Dwārakāmāī Prashānti Vāsī Sāī Rām
Sāī Rām Sāī Rām Ek Nām Sundara Nām [ Shirḍī Sāī ... ]
Allāh Īshwar Sāī Rām
Partipurī Ke He Bhagavān
Dayā Karo Kṛupā Karo Rakshā Karo He Bhagavān [ Sāī Rām ... ]

title: Shirdi Sai Hey Bhagawan
lyrics:
Shirdi Sai Hey Bhagawan
Uddhara Karo Bhagawan
Janam Maran Se Paar Karo Tum Sai Natha Bhagawan
Bhava Bandhan Se Door Karo Tum Deena Natha Bhagawan
Daya Karo Bhagawan (Mujhey)
meaning: O Lord Shirdi Sai, we earnestly pray for Your divine liberation. Guide us beyond the cycle of birth and death, releasing us from worldly attachments, and bestow Your mercy upon us.
devanagari:
शिर्डी साई हे भगवान  
उद्धार करो भगवान  
जनम मरण से पार करो तुम साई नाथ भगवान  
भव बंधन से दूर करो तुम दीना नाथ भगवान  
दया करो भगवान (मुझे)
respell:
Shirḍī Sāī He Bhagavān
Uddhāra Karo Bhagavān
Janam Maraṇ Se Pār Karo Tum Sāī Nātha Bhagavān
Bhava Bandhan Se Dūr Karo Tum Dīnā Nātha Bhagavān
Dayā Karo Bhagavān (mujhe)

title: Shirdi Sai Pandarpura Parthipura Pandarpura
lyrics:
Shirdi Sai Pandarpura Parthipura Pandarpura
Parabrahma Sakshath Hai Sathya Sai Vittala Vittala [ Shirdi Sai ... ]
Baktha Sakha Panduranga Deena Sakha Sai Ranga (2)
Sri Hari Vittala Jaya Hari Vittala (3)
Vittala Vittala Jaya Hari Vittala
meaning: Oh Shirdi Sai and Parthi Sai, You are verily Lord Vittala of Pandharpur, the Supreme Reality made manifest. As Panduranga, You are the beloved friend of devotees, and as Sai Ranga, the compassionate protector of the downtrodden. Victory to You, Lord Hari Vittala!
devanagari:
शिर्डी साई पंढरपुर पर्तिपुर पंढरपुर
परब्रह्म साक्षात है सत्य साई विट्ठल विट्ठल [ शिर्डी साई ... ]
भक्त सखा पांडुरंग दीन सखा साई रंग (2)
श्री हरि विट्ठल जय हरि विट्ठल (3)
विट्ठल विट्ठल जय हरि विट्ठल
respell:
Shirḍī Sāī Paṇḍharapura Partipura Paṇḍharapura
Parabrahma Sākshāt Hai Satya Sāī Viṭṭhala Viṭṭhala [ Shirḍī Sāī ... ]
Bhakta Sakhā Pāṇḍuraṅg Dīna Sakhā Sāī Raṅg (2)
Shrī Hari Viṭṭhala Jaya Hari Viṭṭhala (3)
Viṭṭhala Viṭṭhala Jaya Hari Viṭṭhala

title: Shirdi Sai Parthi Sai Humko Deejo Premamruta Dhara Premamruta Dhara
lyrics:
Shirdi Sai Parthi Sai Humko Deejo Premamruta Dhara Premamruta Dhara
Tava Seva Ka Avsar Deejo Sathya Sai Mahadev
Ganamrut Mein Bhav Bhi Deejo Prema Sai Bhagawan Prema Sai Bhagawan
meaning: O Lord Sai of Shirdi and Puttaparthi, please let the perennial stream of Love flow from You to us, O Lord Sathya Sai, please provide us the opportunity to serve You, O Lord Prema Sai, please instill the devotion and Love whenever we sing Your Glorious Name.
devanagari:
शिरडी साई पर्ती साई हम को दीजो प्रेमामृत धारा प्रेमामृत धारा
तव सेवा का अवसर दीजो सत्य साई महादेव
गानामृत में भाव भी दीजो प्रेम साई भगवान प्रेम साई भगवान
respell:
Shiraḍī Sāī Partī Sāī Ham Ko Dījo Premāmṛuta Dhārā Premāmṛuta Dhārā
Tava Sevā Kā Avasar Dījo Satya Sāī Mahādev
Gānāmṛuta Meṃ Bhāv Bhī Dījo Prem Sāī Bhagavān Prem Sāī Bhagavān

title: Shirdi Sai Shankara Parthi Vihari Shankara
lyrics:
Shirdi Sai Shankara Parthi Vihari Shankara
Shankara Abhayankara Bhavabhayahari Shankara
Paramatma Shiva Shankara Pavana Purusha Shankara
Sathya Swaroopa Shankara Sathya Sai Shankara
meaning: Obeisance to Lord Sai of Shirdi who has now incarnated at Parthi. He is the embodiment of Lord Shankara (Shiva). O Lord who is all pervading, the most auspicious and sacred, who removes all fear, we offer our humble salutations.
devanagari:
शिर्डी साई शंकरा पर्ति विहारी शंकरा
शंकरा अभयंकरा भव भय हारी शंकरा [ शिर्डी साई ... ]
परमात्मा शिव शंकरा पावन पुरुष शंकरा
सत्य स्वरूपा शंकरा सत्य साई शंकरा
respell:
Shirḍī Sāī Shaṅkarā Parti Vihārī Shaṅkarā
Shaṅkarā Abhayaṅkarā Bhava Bhaya Hārī Shaṅkarā [ Shirḍī Sāī ... ]
Paramātmā Shiv Shaṅkarā Pāvan Purush Shaṅkarā
Satya Swarūpā Shaṅkarā Satya Sāī Shaṅkarā

title: Shiva Hara He Hara Shiva He
lyrics:
Shiva Hara He Hara Shiva He
Samba Sadashiva Shiva Hara He
Hara Hara Hara Hara Mahadeva
Parvati Ramana Sadashiva
Namami Shankara Tava Charanam
Bhajami Shankara Tava Charanam
meaning: We offer our obeisance at the feet of Lord Shiva who is worshipped as Sadashiva, Mahadeva and as the consort of Mother Parvathi.
devanagari:
शिव हर हे हरा शिव हे  
साम्ब सदाशिव शिव हर हे  
हर हर हर हर महादेवा
पार्वती रमणा सदाशिवा
नमामि शंकर तव चरणम्
भजामि शंकर तव चरणम्
respell:
Shiv Har He Harā Shiv He
Sāmba Sadāshiv Shiv Har He
Har Har Har Har Mahādevā
Pārwatī Ramaṇā Sadāshivā
Namāmi Shaṅkar Tava Charaṇam
Bhajāmi Shaṅkar Tava Charaṇam

title: Shiva Maheswara Shiva Maheshwara Shiva Maheshwara Sai Ram
lyrics:
Shiva Maheswara Shiva Maheshwara Shiva Maheshwara Sai Ram
Shiva Maheswara Shiva Shankara Shiva Mahadeva Sai Ram
Kailasa Vasa Mahadeva
Jagadeeshwara Hara Mahadeva
Tribhuvana Pala Baba Sai Deva (Om)
meaning: Salutations to Lord Shiva, also known as Maheshwara, who resides in the holy mountains of Kailasa. We sing Your glory, O Lord Sai, You are the Lord and protector of all creatures in the three worlds. (According to Hindu mythology there are three worlds, Sky, Earth and Sub-terrain.)
devanagari:
शिव महेश्वरा शिव महेश्वरा शिव महेश्वरा साई राम
शिव महेश्वरा शिव शंकरा शिव महादेवा साई राम
कैलास वासा महादेवा
जगदीश्वर हर महादेवा
त्रिभुवन पाल बाबा साई देवा
respell:
Shiv Maheshwarā Shiv Maheshwarā Shiv Maheshwarā Sāī Rām
Shiv Maheshwarā Shiv Shaṅkarā Shiv Mahādevā Sāī Rām
Kailās Vāsā Mahādevā
Jagadīshwar Har Mahādevā
Tribhuvan Pāla Bābā Sāī Devā

title: Shiva Nataraj Nataraj We Surrender
lyrics:
Shiva Nataraj Nataraj We Surrender
Jai We Surrender
Shiva Nataraj Nataraj We Surrender
Jai We Surrender
Caume Lift The Veil Lift The Veil Of Illusion
Light Up Our Heart And Dispel Our Confusion
Jai We Surrender
Shiva We Surrender To You
meaning: Oh Shiva Nataraj, Lord of the cosmic dance, we surrender ourselves completely to You. We earnestly pray, come and lift the veil of illusion from our minds, illuminating our hearts and dispelling all confusion. Jai, we surrender to You.
devanagari:
शिव नटराज नटराज वी सरएन्डर
जय वी सरएन्डर
शिव नटराज नटराज वी सरएन्डर
जय वी सरएन्डर
कम लिफ्ट द वेल लिफ्ट द वेल अव इलूजन
लाइट अप आउअर हार्ट अन्ड डिस्पेल आउअर कन्फ्यूजन
जय वी सरएन्डर
शिव वी सरएन्डर टू यू

title: Shiva Shambho Hara Hara Shambho
lyrics:
Shiva Shambho Hara Hara Shambho
BhavaNasha Kailasa Nivasa [ Shiva Shambho.. ]
Parvatipate Hare Pashupate
Gangadhara Hara Gauripate
meaning: O Lord Shiva, You are the destroyer of all fear, the one who resides in the holy mountains of Kailasa, the consort of Mother Parvathi, the one who holds the mighty Ganges in Your matted locks, the consort of Mother Gowri. We pray and offer our humble salutations at Your Feet.
devanagari:
शिव शम्भो हर हर शम्भो  
भवनाशा कैलास निवासा [ शिव शम्भो ... ]  
पार्वती पते हर पाशुपते  
गंगाधरा हर गौरी पते
respell:
Shiv Shambho Har Har Shambho
BhavaNāshā Kailās Nivāsā [ Shiv Shambho ... ]
Pārwatī Pate Har Pāshupate
Gaṅgādharā Har Gaurī Pate

title: Shiva Shambho Narayana
lyrics:
Shiva Shambho Narayana
Parthi Vasa Jagadeeshwara
Shirdi Vasa Jagadeeshwara
Sathya Sai Shiva Shankara
meaning: We pray to our Lord Sai who is the embodiment of Lord Shiva and Lord Narayana. He is the Lord of all worlds, who has descended as the Lord of Parthi and Shirdi. We surrender to our Lord Sathya Sai, who is Lord Shiva and Shankara who confers on us bliss.
devanagari:
शिव शम्भो नारायणा
पर्ती वासा जगदीश्वरा [ शिव शम्भो ... ]
शिर्डी वासा जगदीश्वरा
सत्य साईं शिव शंकरा
respell:
Shiv Shambho Nārāyaṇā
Partī Vāsā Jagadīshwarā [ Shiv Shambho ... ]
Shirḍī Vāsā Jagadīshwarā
Satya Sāīṃ Shiv Shaṅkarā

title: Shiva Shambho Shambho Shiva Shambho Mahadeva
lyrics:
Shiva Shambho Shambho Shiva Shambho Mahadeva
Hara Hara Hara Hara Mahadeva  Shiva Shambho Mahadeva
Halahaladhara Shambho Anatha Natha Shambho
Hari Om Hari Om Hari Om Namah Shivaya
Hari Om Om Om Hari Om Hari Om Namah Shivaya
meaning: We sing the glory of Lord Shiva the one who has consumed poison to save the world and the one who is compassionate and protects the needy and downtrodden. We pray to you Oh Lord Shiva and offer our salutations.
devanagari:
शिव शम्भो शम्भो शिव शम्भो महादेवा
हर हर हर हर महादेवा शिव शम्भो महादेवा
हालाहल धरा शम्भो अनाथ नाथ शम्भो  
हरि ॐ (ॐ ॐ) हरि ॐ हरि ॐ नमः शिवाय
respell:
Shiv Shambho Shambho Shiv Shambho Mahādevā
Har Har Har Har Mahādevā Shiv Shambho Mahādevā
Hālāhal Dharā Shambho Anātha Nātha Shambho
Hari Oṃ (oṃ Oṃ) Hari Oṃ Hari Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy

title: Shiva Shankara Parvati Ramana
lyrics:
Shiva Shankara Parvati Ramana
Gangadhara Bhuvanabharana
Sharanagata Vandita Charana
Karunakara Bhava Bhaya Harana
meaning:
Glory to lord Shiva Shankara who is the consort of Mother Parvatim the one who holds the mighty Ganges in HIS locks and whose radiance shines brightly over all worlds. 
 surrender and offer our prayers at your Holy Feet Oh Lord who is most compassionate and the one who removes all fears.
devanagari:
शिव शंकर पार्वती रमणा
गंगाधर भुवनाभरणा
शरणागत वन्दित चरणा
करुणाकर भव भय हरणा
respell:
Shiv Shaṅkar Pārwatī Ramaṇā
Gaṅgādhara Bhuvanābharaṇā
Sharaṇāgat Vandita Charaṇā
Karuṇākar Bhava Bhaya Haraṇā

title: Shiva Shiva Hara Bhola Maheshwara Shambho Shankara
lyrics:
Shiva Shiva Hara Bhola Maheshwara Shambho Shankara
Ganga Jatadhara Gauri Manohara Shambho Shankara
Vyagrambhara Chandrakaladhara Shambho Shankara
Halahala Dhara Shaila Gireeshwara Shambho Shankara
meaning: Salutations to Lord Shiva who is also know as Hara, Bhola Maheshwara and Shambho Shankara. He carries the sacred river Ganga on HIS matted hair. He is the consort of Gowri and wears Tiger Skin, adorns crescent shaped moon on his head and lives on Mount Kailasa. He is the one who swallowed the poison to save GODS (in a battle between Gods and Demons, hence he is also known as Haalahala Dhara or Neelakanta)
devanagari:
शिव शिव हर हर भोला महेश्वर शम्भो शंकरा
गंग जटाधर गौरी मनोहर शम्भो शंकरा
[ शिव शिव ... ]
व्याघ्रम्बरधार चन्द्रकलाधार शम्भो शंकरा
हालाहलधर शैल गिरिश्वर शम्भो शंकरा
[ गंगा जटाधर ... ]
respell:
Shiv Shiv Har Har Bholā Maheshwar Shambho Shaṅkarā
Gaṅg Jaṭādhara Gaurī Manohar Shambho Shaṅkarā
[ Shiv Shiv ... ]
Vyāghrambaradhāra Chandrakalādhāra Shambho Shaṅkarā
Hālāhaladhara Shail Girishwar Shambho Shaṅkarā
[ Gaṅgā Jaṭādhara ... ]

title: Shiva Shiva Shambho Mahesha Gireesha
lyrics:
Shiva Shiva Shambho Mahesha Gireesha
Hara Hara Sai Mahadeva
Nandi Vahana Naga Bhushana
Phala Lochana Tripura Samhari
Parama Purusha Shiva Ganga Dhari
Chandrakaladhara Parvati Ramana
Hara Hara Sai Mahadeva
Om Hara Hara Sai Mahadeva
meaning: Salutations to Lord Sai who is none other than Lord Shiva, the consort of Parvathi. Salutations to the one who resides on Mount Kailasa, who moves around on Nandi, the celestial Bull, who wears the serpent as an ornament around His neck, has a third eye on the forehead, holds the sacred river Ganga and crescent moon on His head and who slayed the demon Tripura.
devanagari:
शिव शिव शम्भो महेश गिरीशा
हर हर साई महादेवा
नन्दी वाहना नाग भूषणा
फाल लोचना त्रिपुर संहारी
परम पुरुष शिव गंगा धारी
चन्द्रकलाधर पार्वती रमणा
हर हर साई महादेवा
ॐ हर हर साई महादेवा
respell:
Shiv Shiv Shambho Mahesh Girīshā
Har Har Sāī Mahādevā
Nandī Vāhanā Nāga Bhūshaṇā
Phāla Lochanā Tripura Saṃhārī
Param Purush Shiv Gaṅgā Dhārī
Chandrakalādhara Pārwatī Ramaṇā
Har Har Sāī Mahādevā
Oṃ Har Har Sāī Mahādevā

title: Shiva Shiva Shambho Tandava Priyakara
lyrics:
Shiva Shiva Shambho Tandava Priyakara
Bhava Bhava Bhairava Bhavani Shankara
Hara Hara Bham Bham Bhola Maheshwara
Dama Dama Damaru Natana Manohara
Sathyam Shivam Sai Sundara
meaning: I adore  Lord Sai who is none other than Lord Shiva. He is described as the one who loves Cosmic dance (Tandava Priyakara), simple in nature (Bhola) and personification of Truth (Sathyam), Goodness (Shivam) and Beauty (Sundaram).
devanagari:
शिव शिव शम्भो तांडव प्रियकर
भव भव भैरव भवानी शंकर [ शिव शिव ... ]
हर हर भम भम भोला महेश्वर
डम डम डमरू नटन मनोहर
सत्यं शिवं साई सुन्दर
respell:
Shiv Shiv Shambho Tāṇḍava Priyakar
Bhava Bhava Bhairav Bhavānī Shaṅkar [ Shiv Shiv ... ]
Har Har Bham Bham Bholā Maheshwar
Ḍama Ḍama Ḍamarū Naṭana Manohar
Satyaṃ Shivaṃ Sāī Sundara

title: Shiva Shiva Shankara Hara Parameshwara
lyrics:
Shiva Shiva Shankara Hara Parameshwara
Bala Gangadhara Sai
Shiva Shiva Shankara Parthipureeshwara
Nata Shiva Shankara Sai
Bala Gangadhara Sai
meaning: Worship Shiva who is also known as Hara, Shankara, Gangadhara, Parameshwara and Nata Shiva Shankara (the one who performs Cosmic dance). He is also Lord of Parthi.
devanagari:
शिव शिव शंकर हर परमेश्वर  
बाल गंगाधर साई  
शिव शिव शंकर पर्ति पूरिश्वर  
नट शिव शंकर साई [ बाल गंगाधर ... ]
respell:
Shiv Shiv Shaṅkar Har Parameshwar
Bāla Gaṅgādhara Sāī
Shiv Shiv Shaṅkar Parti Pūrishwar
Naṭa Shiv Shaṅkar Sāī [ Bāla Gaṅgādhara ... ]

title: Shiva Shiva Shiva Shambho
lyrics:
Shiva Shiva Shiva Shambho Hara Hara Hara Shambho Shiva Shiva Hara Shambho
Jaya Kailasa Nivasa Mahesha Jaya Jaya Jaya Shambho [ Shiva Shiva ... ]
Jaya Jaya Jaya Shambho Shiva Shiva Shiva Shambho Hara Hara Hara Shambho [ Shiva Shiva ... ]
Parthi Vihara Rudrakaara Loka Anugraha Leela Damaruka Dhara Mandara Mala Shiva Shiva Shiva Shambho [ Shiva Shiva ... ]
meaning: Oh Lord Shiva, auspicious Shambho, remover of all sorrow, we sing Your glorious names! Victorious dweller of Kailasa, Great Lord, You manifest as Rudra in Parthi, gracing the world with Your divine play. Adorned with Mandara flowers and bearing the Damaru, we ceaselessly chant Your holy name.
devanagari:
शिव शिव शिव शंभो हर हर हर शंभो शिव शिव हर शंभो
जय कैलासा निवास महेशा  जय जय जय शंभो [ शिव शिव ... ]
जय जय जय शंभो शिव शिव शिव शंभो हर हर हर शंभो [ शिव शिव ... ]
पर्ती विहारा रुद्राकारा लोकानुग्रह लीला डमरुक धारा लोकानुग्रह मंदार माला शिव शिव शिव शंभो [ शिव शिव ... ]
respell:
Shiv Shiv Shiv Shambho Har Har Har Shambho Shiv Shiv Har Shambho
Jaya Kailāsā Nivās Maheshā  Jaya Jaya Jaya Shambho [ Shiv Shiv ... ]
Jaya Jaya Jaya Shambho Shiv Shiv Shiv Shambho Har Har Har Shambho [ Shiv Shiv ... ]
Partī Vihārā Rudrākārā Lokānugrah Līlā Ḍamaruk Dhārā Lokānugrah Mandāra Mālā Shiv Shiv Shiv Shambho [ Shiv Shiv ... ]

title: Shiva Shiva Shiva Shiva Shirdi Pureeshwara Shambho Shankara Samba Shivom
lyrics:
Shiva Shiva Shiva Shiva Shirdi Pureeshwara Shambho Shankara Samba Shivom
Bhava Hara Purahara Puttapartheeshwara Shambho Shankara Sada Shivom
Kailasachala Bala Shiva Kalakoota Dhara Bala Shiva
Keli Lalasa Bala Shiva Leela Tandava Bala Shiva
meaning: O Lord Sai, Lord of Shirdi and Parthi, we worship You as Shiva, Parameshwara, Shambho and Shankara. You are the remover of fear and worldly misery, Your abode is Kailasa and You are a great dancer of the Tandava (Celestial Dance).
devanagari:
