शिव शिव शिव शिव शिर्डी पूरीश्वर शम्भो शंकर सांब शिवोम
भव हर पुरहार पुर्तापर्थेश्वर शम्भो शंकर सदा शिवोम
कैलाशाचल बाल शिवा कालकूट धर बाल शिवा
केली लालसा बाल शिवा लीला तांडव बाल शिवा
respell:
Shiv Shiv Shiv Shiv Shirḍī Pūrīshwar Shambho Shaṅkar Sāmb Shivom
Bhava Har Purahār Purtāpartheshwar Shambho Shaṅkar Sadā Shivom
Kailāshāchala Bāla Shivā Kālakūṭ Dhara Bāla Shivā
Kelī Lālasā Bāla Shivā Līlā Tāṇḍava Bāla Shivā

title: Shiva Shiva Shiva Shiva Shivaya Namah Om
lyrics:
Shiva Shiva Shiva Shiva Shivaya Namah Om
Hara Hara Hara Hara Haraya Namah Om
Alakha Nirajana Bhava Bhaya Bhanjana
Sayeeshwaraya Namah Om
Pranava Swaroopa Paramesha
Partheeshwaraya Namah Om
Sathya Sayeeshwaraya Namah Om
meaning: Worship Lord Shiva with the mantra "Shivaya Namah Om Haraya Namah Om". Pray to Lord Shiva who is ever pure, who dispels the fear of this materialistic world, who is the personification of the Primordial "Om". He is none other than Lord Sai, Lord of Parthi.
devanagari:
शिव शिव शिव शिव शिवाय नमः ॐ
हर हर हर हर हराय नमः ॐ [ शिव शिव ... ]
अलख निरंजन भव भय भंजन
साईश्वराय नमः ॐ
प्रणव स्वरूप परमेश्वर
पर्तीश्वराय (सत्य साईश्वराय) नमः ॐ
respell:
Shiv Shiv Shiv Shiv Shivāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Har Har Har Har Harāy Namaḥ Oṃ [ Shiv Shiv ... ]
Alakh Nirañjana Bhava Bhaya Bhañjana
Sāīshwarāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Praṇava Swarūp Parameshwar
Partīshwarāy (satya Sāīshwarāy) Namaḥ Oṃ

title: Shiva Shiva Shiva Shiva Shivaya Namah Aum
lyrics:
Shiva Shiva Shiva Shiva Shivaya Namah Aum
Aum Namah Shivaya Shivaya Namah Aum [ Shiva Shiva ... ]
Hara Hara Hara Hara Haraya Namah Aum
Aum Namah Shivaya Shivaya Namah Aum
meaning: We offer our profound reverence to Shiva, the auspicious Lord, and to Hara, the remover of all suffering. With every breath, we chant "Om Namah Shivaya," honoring your divine presence.
devanagari:
शिव शिव शिव शिव शिवाय नमः ॐ
ॐ नमः शिवाय शिवाय नमः ॐ [ शिव शिव ... ]
हर हर हर हर हराय नमः ॐ
ॐ नमः शिवाय शिवाय नमः ॐ
respell:
Shiv Shiv Shiv Shiv Shivāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy Shivāy Namaḥ Oṃ [ Shiv Shiv ... ]
Har Har Har Har Harāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Oṃ Namaḥ Shivāy Shivāy Namaḥ Oṃ

title: Shiva Shiva Shiva Shiva Shivaya Namah Aum
lyrics:
Shiva Shiva Shiva Shiva Shivaya Namah Aum
Hara Hara Hara Hara Haraya Namah Aum [ Shiva Shiva ... ]
Shivaya Namah Aum Haraya Namah Aum
Hara Hara Hara Hara Haraya Namah Aum
Shivaya Namah Aum Haraya Namah Aum [ Hara Hara ... ]
meaning: Chant the name of Lord Shiva, the destroyer of sins and the cycle of birth and death.
devanagari:
शिव शिव शिव शिव शिवाय नमः ॐ
हर हर हर हर हराय नमः ॐ [ शिव शिव ... ]
शिवाय नमः ॐ हराय नमः ॐ
हर हर हर हर हराय नमः ॐ
शिवाय नमः ॐ हराय नमः ॐ [ हर हर ... ]
respell:
Shiv Shiv Shiv Shiv Shivāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Har Har Har Har Harāy Namaḥ Oṃ [ Shiv Shiv ... ]
Shivāy Namaḥ Oṃ Harāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Har Har Har Har Harāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Shivāy Namaḥ Oṃ Harāy Namaḥ Oṃ [ Har Har ... ]

title: Shiva Shivam Hara Haram
lyrics:
Shiva Shivam Hara Haram Jaya Jayam Shankaram (3)
Chandrakaladhara Shiva Shivam Ganga Jatadhara Hara Haram
Samba Sadashiva Jaya Jayam Sai Maheshwara Shankaram
Shiva Shivam Hara Haram Jaya Jayam Shankaram (2)
meaning: Shiva, the auspicious one, remover of all suffering, we hail your glorious and benevolent presence. O bearer of the crescent moon and the Ganga in your matted locks, eternally auspicious Lord with Parvati, and the great Sai Maheshwara.
devanagari:
शिव शिवम् हर हरम् जय जयम् शंकरम् (3)
चन्द्रकलाधर शिव शिवम् गंगा जटाधर हर हरम्
सांब सदाशिव जय जयम् साई महेश्वर शंकरम्
शिव शिवम् हर हरम् जय जयम् शंकरम् (2)
respell:
Shiv Shivam Har Haram Jaya Jayam Shaṅkaram (3)
Chandrakalādhara Shiv Shivam Gaṅgā Jaṭādhara Har Haram
Sāmb Sadāshiv Jaya Jayam Sāī Maheshwar Shaṅkaram
Shiv Shivam Har Haram Jaya Jayam Shaṅkaram (2)

title: Shivaya Parameshwaraya Chandrashekaraya Namah Aum
lyrics:
Shivaya Parameshwaraya Chandrashekaraya Namah Aum
Bhavaya Guna Sambhavaya Shiva Tandavaya Namah Aum
Shivaya Parameshwaraya Chandrashekaraya Namah Aum [ Bhavaya Guna ... ]
Shivaya Parameshwaraya Sashi Shekaraya Namah Aum
Bhavaya Guna Sambhavaya Shiva Tandavaya Namah Aum
Shivaya Parameshwaraya Chandrashekaraya Namah Aum [ Bhavaya Guna ... ]
meaning: Salutations to you, Lord Shiva, the Supreme One, who graces his brow with the crescent moon. You are the very essence of existence, manifesting through all qualities, and the performer of the divine, cosmic Tandava dance.
devanagari:
शिवाय परमेश्वराय चंद्रशेखराय नमः ॐ
भवाय गुण सम्भवाय शिव तांडवाय नमः ॐ
शिवाय परमेश्वराय चंद्रशेखराय नमः ॐ [ भावाय गुण ... ]
शिवाय परमेश्वराय शशि शेखराय नमः ॐ
भवाय गुण सम्भवाय शिव तांडवाय नमः ॐ
शिवाय परमेश्वराय चंद्रशेखराय नमः ॐ [ भावाय गुण ... ]
respell:
Shivāy Parameshwarāy Chandrashekharāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Bhavāy Guṇ Sambhavāy Shiv Tāṇḍavāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Shivāy Parameshwarāy Chandrashekharāy Namaḥ Oṃ [ Bhāvāy Guṇ ... ]
Shivāy Parameshwarāy Shashi Shekharāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Bhavāy Guṇ Sambhavāy Shiv Tāṇḍavāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Shivāy Parameshwarāy Chandrashekharāy Namaḥ Oṃ [ Bhāvāy Guṇ ... ]

title: Shivaya Parameshwaraya Chandrashekaraya Namah Om
lyrics:
Shivaya Parameshwaraya Chandrashekaraya Namah Om
Bhavaya Guna Sambhavaya Shiva Tandavaya Namah Om
Shivaya Parameshwaraya Chandrashekaraya Namah Om
Bhavaya Guna Sambhavaya Shiva Tandavaya Namah Om
meaning: Bow to Lord Shiva, who is the Lord of the Universe with a crescent moon on His hair, who loves the Tandava (cosmic) dance, who gives us virtues to go through our cycle of birth and death.
devanagari:
शिवाय परमेश्वराय चन्द्रशेखराय नमः ॐ
भवाय गुण सम्भावाय शिव तांडवाय नमः ॐ
शिवाय परमेश्वराय चन्द्रशेखराय नमः ॐ
भवाय गुण सम्भावाय शिव तांडवाय नमः ॐ
respell:
Shivāy Parameshwarāy Chandrashekharāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Bhavāy Guṇ Sambhāvāy Shiv Tāṇḍavāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Shivāy Parameshwarāy Chandrashekharāy Namaḥ Oṃ
Bhavāy Guṇ Sambhāvāy Shiv Tāṇḍavāy Namaḥ Oṃ

title: Shuklambaradhara Ganapati Mantram
lyrics:
Shuklambaradhara Ganapati Mantram
Nityam Nityam Japo Japo
Vighna Vinashaka Vidya Dayaka
Veera Ganapati Bhajo Bhajo
meaning: Chant daily the Mantra of Lord Ganapati (Ganesha), the one who wears a white cloth, the remover of all obstacles, the bestower of knowledge and the one who is very courageous.
devanagari:
शुक्लाम्बरधर गणपति मंत्रम्
नित्यम् नित्यम् जपो जपो
विघ्न विनाशक विद्या दायक
वीर गणपति भजो भजो
respell:
Shuklāmbaradhara Gaṇapati Mantram
Nityam Nityam Japo Japo
Vighna Vināshak Vidyā Dāyak
Vīr Gaṇapati Bhajo Bhajo

title: Shyama Murari Ayo Re
lyrics:
Shyama Murari Ayo Re
Sai Murari Ayo Re
Gayo Re Guna Gayo Re
Payo Re Peetambhara Dhari
meaning: Sing in ecstasy of the arrival of Lord Krishna who is none other than Lord Sai. Lord Krishna is also called Shyama (dark-hued) and Murari (slayer of the demon Mura). Wearing the yellow cloth is a characteristic of Lord Krishna's attire.
devanagari:
श्याम मुरारी आयो रे
साई मुरारी आयो रे
गायो रे गुण गायो रे
पायो रे पीताम्बर धारी
respell:
Shyām Murārī Āyo Re
Sāī Murārī Āyo Re
Gāyo Re Guṇ Gāyo Re
Pāyo Re Pītāmbara Dhārī

title: Shyama Sundara Hari Govinda Bolo
lyrics:
Shyama Sundara Hari Govinda Bolo
Govinda Bolo Hari Gopala Bolo
Madana Mohana Hari Govinda Bolo
Kamala Nayana Prabhu Gopala Bolo
Radha Ramana Hari Govinda Bolo
--
Govinda Bolo Gopala Bolo
meaning: Chant the various names of Lord Krishna – Hari and Govinda. Glory to the to the beautiful, dark-hued, enchanting Lord with lotus petal eyes and who is dear to Radha.
devanagari:
श्याम सुन्दर हरी गोविन्द बोल
गोविन्द बोलो हरी गोपाल बोलो
मदन मोहन हरी गोविन्द बोलो
कमल नयन प्रभु गोपाल बोलो
राधा रमण हरी गोविन्द बोलो
--
गोविन्द बोलो गोपाल बोलो
respell:
Shyām Sundara Harī Govinda Bol
Govinda Bolo Harī Gopāla Bolo
Madana Mohan Harī Govinda Bolo
Kamala Nayan Prabhu Gopāla Bolo
Rādhā Ramaṇa Harī Govinda Bolo
--
Govinda Bolo Gopāla Bolo

title: Shyama Sundara Madana Mohana Radhe Gopal
lyrics:
Shyama Sundara Madana Mohana Radhe Gopal
Radhe Gopal
Radhe Gopal Bhajo Radhe Gopal
Shanka Chakra Gadadhara Radhe Gopal
Radhe Gopal
Radhe Gopal Bhajo Radhe Gopal
meaning: Chant the various names of Lord Krishna such as, Shyama Sundara, Madana Mohana, Shankha Chakra Gadadhara, Radhey Gopala, Murali Manohara etc.
devanagari:
श्याम सुन्दर मदन मोहन राधे गोपाल
जय राधे गोपाल
राधे गोपाल भजो राधे गोपाल
शंख चक्र गदाधरा राधे गोपाल
जय राधे गोपाल [ राधे गोपाल ... ]
respell:
Shyām Sundara Madana Mohan Rādhe Gopāl
Jay Rādhe Gopāl
Rādhe Gopāl Bhajo Rādhe Gopāl
Shaṅkh Chakra Gadādharā Rādhe Gopāl
Jay Rādhe Gopāl [ Rādhe Gopāl ... ]

title: Shyama Sundara Madana Mohana
lyrics:
Shyama Sundara Madana Mohana
Mora Makuta Dhari
Madhava Hari Madhava Hari Madhava Giridhari
meaning: Oh beautiful dark-hued Lord, enchanter of all hearts, you wear the peacock feather in your crown. Madhava Hari, you are the divine one who lifted the mountain, our beloved Giridhari.
devanagari:
श्याम सुन्दर मदन मोहन
मोर मुकुट धारी
माधव हरि माधव हरि माधव गिरिधारी
respell:
Shyām Sundara Madana Mohan
Mora Mukuṭ Dhārī
Mādhava Hari Mādhava Hari Mādhava Giridhārī

title: Shyamala Komala Krishna Murari
lyrics:
Shyamala Komala Krishna Murari
Shyamala Ghana Shyamala Megha Shyamala Komala Krishna Murari
Sridhara Yaduvara Krishna Murari
Sridhara Nanda Yaduvara Bhava Bhaya Hara Giridhara Krishna Murari
Sridhara Yaduvara Krishna Murari
meaning: Chant the name of the dark complexioned and soft natured Krishna, who is also known as, Murari, Ghana Shyama, Megha Shyama, Sridhara, Yaduvara, Giridhara etc.
devanagari:
श्यामल कोमल कृष्णा मुरारी
श्यामल घन श्यामल मेघ श्यामल कोमल कृष्णा मुरारी
श्रीधर यदुवर कृष्णा मुरारी
श्रीधर नन्द यदुवर भव भय हर गिरिधर कृष्णा मुरारी
श्रीधर यदुवर कृष्णा मुरारी
respell:
Shyāmala Komala Kṛushṇā Murārī
Shyāmala Ghan Shyāmala Megha Shyāmala Komala Kṛushṇā Murārī
Shrīdhara Yaduvar Kṛushṇā Murārī
Shrīdhara Nanda Yaduvar Bhava Bhaya Har Giridhara Kṛushṇā Murārī
Shrīdhara Yaduvar Kṛushṇā Murārī

title: Siddhi Vinayaka Mangala Data
lyrics:
Siddhi Vinayaka Mangala Data
Buddhi Pradyaka Gananatha
Vighna Harana Prabhu Vighneshwara Tum
Gauri Nandana Hey Jaga Vandana
Namostute Namostute
meaning: Oh Lord Vinayaka (Lord Ganesha), You fulfill our wishes and bestow auspiciousness. You bestow knowledge to all, Oh Lord of Ganaas, You destroy the obstacles in our lives. Oh son of Goddess Gowri (Parvathi), You are worshipped by the entire Universe. Salutations to You, Oh Lord Vighneshwara.
devanagari:
सिद्धि विनायक मंगळ दाता
बुद्धि प्रदायक गणनाथा
विघ्न हरण प्रभु विघ्नेश्वर तुम
गौरी नंदन हे जग वंदन
नमोस्तुते नमोस्तुते
respell:
Siddhi Vināyak Maṅgaळ Dātā
Buddhi Pradāyak Gaṇanāthā
Vighna Haraṇ Prabhu Vighneshwar Tum
Gaurī Nandana He Jaga Vandana
Namostute Namostute

title: Siddhi Vinayaka Pahi Gajanana
lyrics:
Siddhi Vinayaka Pahi Gajanana
Gauri Nandana Hey Jagavandana [Siddhi Vinayaka..]
Pashankushadhara Vighna Vinasha
Buddhi Pradayaka Papa Vinasha
meaning: Salutations to elephant faced son of Gowri, Lord Ganesha, bestower of auspiciousness and knowledge. He is the master of the universe who removes obstacles and destroys sins and who carries the noose and the hook.
devanagari:
सिद्धि विनायक पाहि गजानना  
गौरी नंदन हे जगवंदन [सिद्धि विनायक पाहि गजानना]
पाशांकुशधर विघ्न विनाशा 
बुद्धि प्रदायका  पाप विनाशा
respell:
Siddhi Vināyak Pāhi Gajānanā
Gaurī Nandana He Jagavandana [siddhi Vināyak pāhi gajānanā]
Pāshāṅkushadhara Vighna Vināshā
Buddhi Pradāyakā  Pāpa Vināshā

title: Simha Vahini Sai Narayani
lyrics:
Simha Vahini Sai Narayani
Mata Maheshwari Durga Bhavani
Akhilandeshwari Jaya Jagat Janani
Abhaya Pradayini Ananda Roopini
Mangala Karini Moksha Pradayini
meaning: Chant the name of Sai Narayani who rides on the Lion and who is known by many names as Maheshwari, Durga Bhavani, Akhilandeshwari. She is the mother of this universe, who is a symbol of eternal happiness, the one who blesses everyone and grants liberation.
devanagari:
सिंह वाहिनी साई नारायणी
माता महेश्वरी दुर्गा भवानी [ सिंह वाहिनी ... ]
अखिलंडेश्वरी जय जग जननी
अभय प्रदायिनी आनंद रूपिणी
मंगल कारिणी मोक्ष प्रदायिनी
respell:
Siṃh Vāhinī Sāī Nārāyaṇī
Mātā Maheshwarī Durgā Bhavānī [ Siṃh Vāhinī ... ]
Akhilaṇḍeshwarī Jaya Jaga Jananī
Abhaya Pradāyinī Ānanda Rūpiṇī
Maṅgal Kāriṇī Moksha Pradāyinī

title: Sita Ram Bolo Bolo Sita Ram Radhe Shyam Bolo Bolo Radhe Shyam
lyrics:
Sita Ram Bolo Bolo Sita Ram Radhe Shyam Bolo Bolo Radhe Shyam
Sairam Bolo Bolo Sairam (4x)
meaning: Sing the names of Lord Rama, the consort of Mother Sita. Chant the names of Lord Krishna and Lord Sai.
devanagari:
सीता राम बोलो बोलो सीता राम राधे श्याम बोलो बोलो राधे श्याम
साईराम बोलो बोलो साईराम (4x)
respell:
Sītā Rām Bolo Bolo Sītā Rām Rādhe Shyām Bolo Bolo Rādhe Shyām
Sāīrām Bolo Bolo Sāīrām (4x)

title: Sita Ram Nam Bhajo
lyrics:
Sita Ram Nam Bhajo
Madhura Madhura Sai Nama Bhajo
Radhe Shyam Nama Bhajo
Madhura Madhura Sai Nama Bhajo
meaning: Sing the Name and Glory of Lord Rama (Sita Ram), Lord Krishna (Radhey Shyam) and Lord Sai whose names are the sweetest of all.
devanagari:
सीता राम नाम भजो
मधुर मधुर साई नाम भजो
राधे श्याम नाम भजो
मधुर मधुर साई नाम भजो
respell:
Sītā Rām Nām Bhajo
Madhura Madhura Sāī Nāma Bhajo
Rādhe Shyām Nāma Bhajo
Madhura Madhura Sāī Nāma Bhajo

title: Sita Ram Sita Ram Sita Ram Radhe Shyam Radhe Shyam Radhe Shyam
lyrics:
Sita Ram Sita Ram Sita Ram Radhe Shyam Radhe Shyam Radhe Shyam
Dasharatha Nandana Janaki Jeevana
Raghukula Bhooshana Jaya Jaya Ram
Jaya Jaya Ram Jaya Sai Ram
Jaya Jaya Ram Ram Jaya Sai Ram
meaning: Victory to Lord Rama, who is the crown jewel of Raghu Dynasty, who is the consort of Sita and the son of Dasharatha.
devanagari:
सीता राम सीता राम सीता राम राधे श्याम राधे श्याम राधे श्याम
दशरथ नंदन जानकी जीवन
रघुकुल भूषण जय जय राम
जय जय राम जय साई राम
जय जय राम राम जय साई राम
respell:

Dasharath Nandana Jānakī Jīvan
Raghukul Bhūshaṇ Jaya Jaya Rām
Jaya Jaya Rām Jaya Sāī Rām
Jaya Jaya Rām Rām Jaya Sāī Rām

title: Sita Rama Sri Raghu Rama
lyrics:
Sita Rama Sri Raghu Rama
Dasharathe Hey Jaya Rama
Atma Rama Aganita Guna Dhama
Pavana Nama Parandhama
meaning: Salutations to Lord Rama from Raghu dynasty, who is the consort of Mother Sita and the son of King Dasharatha. Lord Rama is the one with blemishless character, whose name is sacred and the one who is the supreme Lord.
devanagari:
सीता रामा श्री रघु रामा
दाशरथे हे जय रामा
आत्म रामा अगणित गुण धामा
पवन नामा परंधामा
respell:
Sītā Rāmā Shrī Raghu Rāmā
Dāsharathe He Jaya Rāmā
Ātma Rāmā Agaṇita Guṇ Dhāmā
Pavan Nāmā Parandhāmā

title: Soham Soham Dhyan Karo
lyrics:
Soham Soham Dhyan Karo
Sadguru Sai Dhyan Karo
Soham Brahma Soham Vishnu
Soham Sai Dhyan Karo
Soham Atma Shiva Paramatma
Brahmananda Se Hrudaya Bharo
meaning: Meditate on the divine word 'Soham' which means 'I am That'. Meditate on Sai who is our true and Divine Mentor. Soham is none other than Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva and the Atma (Higher self or Higher Conscience). Fill your hearts with Divine Bliss.
devanagari:

सोहम साई ध्यान करो
सोहम आत्मा शिव परमात्मा
ब्रह्मानंद से हृदय भरो
respell:

Sadguru Sāī Dhyān Karo [ So'haṃ So'haṃ ... ]
Soham Brahmā Soham Vishṇu
Soham Sāī Dhyān Karo
Soham Ātmā Shiv Paramātmā
Brahmānanda Se Hṛudaya Bharo

title: Sri Ganapati Hari Om
lyrics:
Sri Ganapati Hari Om
Ganapati Hari Om Guna Nidhi Hari Om
Hari Om Ganapati Hari Om
Varada Abhayakara Ananda Dayaka
Shiva Shakti Nandana Om
Ganapati Hari Om Guna Nidhi Hari Om
Hari Om Ganapati Hari Om
meaning: Salutations to Lord Ganapathi (Ganesha), the virtuous one, the one who destroys fears and bestows happiness, the son of Lord Shiva and Goddess Shakthi (Parvathi).

शिव शक्ति नंदन ॐ
गणपति हरि ॐ गुण निधि हरि ॐ
हरि ॐ गणपति हरि ॐ

lyrics:
Sri Ganesha Sri Ganesha Sri Ganesha Pahimam
Jaya Ganesha Jaya Ganesha Jaya Ganesha Raksha Mam
Sri Ganesha Pahi Mam Jaya Ganesha Raksha Mam
Jaya Ganesha Jaya Ganesha Jaya Ganesha Raksha Mam

श्री गणेश पाहि माम जय गणेश रक्षमाम

title: Sri Ganesha Vinayaka
lyrics:
Sri Ganesha Vinayaka
Vighna Vinashaka Vinayaka
Mangala Dayaka Vinayaka
Bhava Bhaya Nasha Vinayaka
Parthipureeshwara Vinayaka
meaning: Oh Lord Ganesha, remover of the fear of the materialistic world, you remove obstacles and grant auspiciousness, Oh Lord Vinayaka of Parthi.
devanagari:
श्री गणेशा विनायका
विघ्न विनाशक विनायका
मंगल दायक विनायका

title: Sri Guru Paduka Stotram
lyrics:
Verse 1
अनन्तसंसारसमुद्रतार- नौकायिताभ्यां गुरुभक्तिदाभ्याम् । 
वैराग्यसाम्राज्यदपूजनाभ्यां नमो नमः श्रीगुरुपादुकाभ्याम् ॥ १ ॥

Ananta saṃsāra samudra tāra-naukāyitābhyāṃ gurubhaktidābhyām | 
Vairāgya sāmrājyada pūjanābhyāṃ namo namaḥ śrīgurupādukābhyām || 1 ||

Salutations and Salutations to the revered Guru's Sandals, Which act as a boat to cross the endless ocean of Saṃsāra (worldly existence), Which bestow devotion to the Guru, And the worship of which grants the sovereignty of renunciation (Vairāgya).

Verse 2
कवित्ववाराशिनिशाकराभ्यां दौर्भाग्यदावाम्बुदमालिकाभ्याम् । 
दूरीकृतानम्रविपत्तिताभ्यां नमो नमः श्रीगुरुपादुकाभ्याम् ॥ २ ॥

Kavitva vārāśi niśākarābhyāṃ daurbhāgya dāvāmbuda mālikābhyām | 
Dūrīkṛtānamra vipattitābhyāṃ namo namaḥ śrīgurupādukābhyām || 2 ||

Salutations and Salutations to the revered Guru's Sandals, Which are like the full moon to the ocean of poetry (or knowledge/artistic skill), Which are like a chain of rain clouds for the forest fire of misfortune, And which caumpletely remove the distress of those who bow before them.

Verse 3
नता ययोः श्रीपतितां समीयुः कदाचिदप्याशु दरिद्रवर्याः । 
मूकाश्च वाचस्पतितां हि ताभ्यां नमो नमः श्रीगुरुपादुकाभ्याम् ॥ ३ ॥

Natā yayōḥ śrīpatitāṃ samīyuḥ kadācidapyāśu daridravaryāḥ | 
Mūkāśca vācaspatitāṃ hi tābhyāṃ namo namaḥ śrīgurupādukābhyām || 3 ||

Salutations and Salutations to the revered Guru's Sandals, By bowing to which, even the poorest of the poor quickly attain the status of the Lord of Wealth (Śrīpati), And by which even the mute attain the eloquence of a great orator (Vācaspati, Brihaspati).

Verse 4
नालीकनीकाशपदाहृताभ्यां नानाविमोहादिनिवारिकाभ्याम् । 
नमज्जनाभीष्टततिप्रदाभ्यां नमो नमः श्रीगुरुपादुकाभ्याम् ॥ ४ ॥

Nālīkanīkāśapadāhṛtābhyāṃ nānāvimohādinivārikābhyām | 
Namajjanābhīṣṭatati pradābhyāṃ namo namaḥ śrīgurupādukābhyām || 4 ||

Salutations and Salutations to the revered Guru's Sandals, Which draw the mind towards the Guru's lotus-like feet, Which ward off various delusions and other negative thoughts, And which grant a multitude of desired objects to the devotees who bow down.

Verse 5
नृपालिमौलिव्रजरत्नकान्ति- सरिद्विराजज्झषकन्यकाभ्याम् । 
नृपत्वदाभ्यां नतलोकपङ्क्तेः नमो नमः श्रीगुरुपादुकाभ्याम् ॥ ५ ॥

Nṛpālimaulivrajaratnakānti-saridvirājjhajṣakanyakābhyām | 
Nṛpatvadābhyāṃ natalokapaṅkteḥ namo namaḥ śrīgurupādukābhyām || 5 ||

Salutations and Salutations to the revered Guru's Sandals, Which shine like a pair of mermaids (jhaṣakanyaka) in the river of light emanating fraum the jewels on the crowns of bowing kings, And which grant kingship (or supreme authority) to the entire host of people who prostrate.

Verse 6
पापान्धकारार्कपरम्पराभ्यां तापत्रयाहीन्द्रखगेश्वराभ्याम् । 
जाड्याब्धिसंशोषणवाडवाभ्याम् नमो नमः श्रीगुरुपादुकाभ्याम् ॥ ६ ॥

Pāpāndhakārārkaparamparābhyāṃ tāpatrayāhīndrakhageśvarābhyām | 
Jāḍyābdhisaṃśoṣaṇavāḍavābhyām namo namaḥ śrīgurupādukābhyām || 6 ||

Salutations and Salutations to the revered Guru's Sandals, Which are like a succession of suns dispelling the darkness of sins, Which are like the Lord of the Birds (Garuḍa) for the great serpents of the three miseries (Tāpatraya), And which are like the submarine fire (Vāḍava) drying up the ocean of inertia (or dullness).

Verse 7
शमादिषट्कप्रदवैभवाभ्यां समाधिदानव्रतदीक्षिताभ्याम् । 
रमाधवाङ्घ्रिस्थिरभक्तिदाभ्यां नमो नमः श्रीगुरुपादुकाभ्याम् ॥ ७ ॥

Śamādiṣaṭkapradavaibhavābhyāṃ samādhidānavratadīkṣitābhyām | 
Ramādhavāṅghristhirabhaktidābhyāṃ namo namaḥ śrīgurupādukābhyām || 7 ||

Salutations and Salutations to the revered Guru's Sandals, Which possess the glory of granting the six qualities beginning with Śama (control of mind, senses, etc.), Which are vowed to bestow the boon of Samādhi (deep meditative absorption), And which grant steadfast devotion to the feet of the Lord of Lakṣmī (Ramādhava, i.e., Vishnu).

Verse 8
स्वार्चापराणामखिलेष्टदाभ्यां स्वाहासहायाक्षधुरन्धराभ्याम् । 
स्वान्ताच्छभावप्रदपूजनाभ्यां नमो नमः श्रीगुरुपादुकाभ्याम् ॥ ८ ॥

Svārcāparāṇāmakhileṣṭadābhyāṃ svāhāsahāyākṣadhurandharābhyām | 
Svāntācchabhāvapradapūjanābhyāṃ namo namaḥ śrīgurupādukābhyām || 8 ||

Salutations and Salutations to the revered Guru's Sandals, Which grant all desires to those intent on worshipping them, Which bear the burden of assisting the senses (akṣa) with the help of the sacred offering (Svāhā), And the worship of which bestows the state of pure joy (or clear heart, svānta).

Verse 9
कामादिसर्पव्रजगारुडाभ्यां विवेकवैराग्यनिधिप्रदाभ्याम् । 
बोधप्रदाभ्यां द्रुतमोक्षदाभ्यां नमो नमः श्रीगुरुपादुकाभ्याम् ॥ ९ ॥

Kāmādisarpavrajagāruḍābhyāṃ vivekavairāgyanidhipradābhyām | 
Bodhapradābhyāṃ drutamokṣadābhyāṃ namo namaḥ śrīgurupādukābhyām || 9 ||

Salutations and Salutations to the revered Guru's Sandals, Which are like the Garuda for the multitude of serpent-like desires (Kāma) and other vices, Which grant the treasure of discrimination (Viveka) and renunciation (Vairāgya), Which bestow enlightenment (Bodha) and quickly grant liberation (Mokṣa).
meaning: Oh revered Guru's sandals, we offer our salutations again and again! You are the divine boat that carries us across the endless ocean of worldly existence, bestowing profound devotion and the supreme state of renunciation. Your sacred grace dispels all misfortune, ignorance, and sin, granting wisdom, liberation, and fulfilling every sincere desire of those who humbly bow before you.
devanagari:
अनन्तसंसारसमुद्रतार-
नौकायिताभ्यां गुरुभक्तिदाभ्याम् ।
वैराग्यसाम्राज्यदपूजनाभ्यां
नमो नमः श्रीगुरुपादुकाभ्याम् ॥ १ ॥

कवित्ववाराशिनिशाकराभ्यां
दौर्भाग्यदावाम्बुदमालिकाभ्याम् ।
दूरीकृतानम्रविपत्तिताभ्यां
नमो नमः श्रीगुरुपादुकाभ्याम् ॥ २ ॥

नता ययोः श्रीपतितां समीयुः
कदाचिदप्याशु दरिद्रवर्याः ।
मूकाश्च वाचस्पतितां हि ताभ्यां
नमो नमः श्रीगुरुपादुकाभ्याम् ॥ ३ ॥

नालीकनीकाशपदाहृताभ्यां
नानाविमोहादिनिवारिकाभ्याम् ।
नमज्जनाभीष्टततिप्रदाभ्यां
नमो नमः श्रीगुरुपादुकाभ्याम् ॥ ४ ॥

नृपालिमौलिव्रजरत्नकान्ति-
सरिद्विराजज्झषकन्यकाभ्याम् ।
नृपत्वदाभ्यां नतलोकपङ्क्तेः
नमो नमः श्रीगुरुपादुकाभ्याम् ॥ ५ ॥

पापान्धकारार्कपरम्पराभ्यां
तापत्रयाहीन्द्रखगेश्वराभ्याम् ।
जाड्याब्धिसंशोषणवाडवाभ्याम्
नमो नमः श्रीगुरुपादुकाभ्याम् ॥ ६ ॥

शमादिषट्कप्रदवैभवाभ्यां
समाधिदानव्रतदीक्षिताभ्याम् ।
रमाधवाङ्घ्रिस्थिरभक्तिदाभ्यां
नमो नमः श्रीगुरुपादुकाभ्याम् ॥ ७ ॥

स्वार्चापराणामखिलेष्टदाभ्यां
स्वाहासहायाक्षधुरन्धराभ्याम् ।
स्वान्ताच्छभावप्रदपूजनाभ्यां
नमो नमः श्रीगुरुपादुकाभ्याम् ॥ ८ ॥

कामादिसर्पव्रजगारुडाभ्यां
विवेकवैराग्यनिधिप्रदाभ्याम् ।
बोधप्रदाभ्यां द्रुतमोक्षदाभ्यां
नमो नमः श्रीगुरुपादुकाभ्याम् ॥ ९ ॥
respell:

title: Sri Guru Parthi Vasa
lyrics:
Sri Guru Parthi Vasa
Sai Brahma Vishnu Mahesha [ Sri Guru.. ]
Allah Bhi Tum Ho Maula Bhi Tum Ho
Zoroastra Mahavira Yeshu Bhi Tum Ho
Ram Rahim Ho Krishna Karim Ho
meaning: Chant the name of Lord of Parthi who is Guru, Brahma, Vishnu, Mahesha, Allah, Zohrashtra, Mahavira and He is also none other than Rama, Krishna and Karim.
devanagari:
श्री गुरु पर्ती वासा
साई ब्रह्म विष्णु महेशा [ श्री गुरु ... ]
अल्लाह भी तुम हो मौलाह भी तुम हो
जोहराष्ट्र महावीर येसु भी तुम हो
राम रहीम हो कृष्ण करीम हो
respell:
Shrī Guru Partī Vāsā
Sāī Brahma Vishṇu Maheshā [ Shrī Guru ... ]
Allāh Bhī Tum Ho Maulāh Bhī Tum Ho
Joharāshṭra Mahāvīr Yesu Bhī Tum Ho
Rām Rahīm Ho Kṛushṇa Karīm Ho

title: Sri Hari Bol Sri Hari Bol Mukunda Madhava Hari Hari Bol
lyrics:
Sri Hari Bol Sri Hari Bol Mukunda Madhava Hari Hari Bol
Ek Prabhu Ke Aneka Naam Prema Se Bolo Sai Bhagawan
Sai Bhagawan Bolo Sai Bhagawan
meaning: Invoke the divine names of Hari, Mukunda, and Madhava, recognizing that the one supreme Lord manifests through countless appellations. Lovingly call out to Lord Sai, chanting his name with devotion.
devanagari:
श्री हरि बोल श्री हरि बोल मुकुंद माधव हरि हरि बोल
एक प्रभु के अनेक नाम प्रेम से बोलो साई भगवान
साई भगवान बोलो साई भगवान
respell:
Shrī Hari Bol Shrī Hari Bol Mukund Mādhava Hari Hari Bol
Ek Prabhu Ke Aneka Nām Prem Se Bolo Sāī Bhagavān
Sāī Bhagavān Bolo Sāī Bhagavān

title: Sri Lakshmi Ramana Narayana
lyrics:
Sri Lakshmi Ramana Narayana
Narayana Veda Parayana
Bhava Bhaya Harana Vandita Charana
Alakha Niranjana Narayana
Vaidehi Mohana Narayana
meaning: Salutation to Lord Narayana who is the beloved of Goddess Lakshmi. Salutations to the one who has knowledge of all the Vedas, the one who removes the fear of the materialistic world, whose feet are worshipped by all, who is always pure and who has enchanted Vaidehi (Sita) as Lord Rama.
devanagari:
श्री लक्ष्मी रमणा नारायणा
नारायणा वेद पारायणा [ श्री लक्ष्मी ... ]
भव भय हरणा वन्दित चरणा
अलख निरञ्जन नारायणा
वैदेही मोहन नारायणा (२)
respell:
Shrī Lakshmī Ramaṇā Nārāyaṇā
Nārāyaṇā Ved Pārāyaṇā [ Shrī Lakshmī ... ]
Bhava Bhaya Haraṇā Vandita Charaṇā
Alakh Nirañjana Nārāyaṇā
Vaidehī Mohan Nārāyaṇā (2)

title: Sri Raghu Nandana Dasharatha Nandana
lyrics:
Sri Raghu Nandana Dasharatha Nandana
Bhadradeeshwara Rama
Vaidehi Priya Vaikuntha Vasa
Sada Smarami Rameti Rama
meaning: Chant incessantly the holy name of Rama from Raghu Dynasty. He is the son of King Dasharatha and who is the presiding deity in Bhadrachalam (a holy place). He is the beloved of Vaidehi (Sita) and the one who resides in Vaikunta (the abode of Lord Vishnu).
devanagari:
श्री रघु नंदन दशरथ नंदन
भद्रादीश्वर रामा
वैदेही प्रिया वैकुंठ वासा
सदा स्मरामि रामेति रामा
respell:
Shrī Raghu Nandana Dasharath Nandana
Bhadrādīshwar Rāmā
Vaidehī Priyā Vaikuṇṭh Vāsā
Sadā Smarāmi Rāmeti Rāmā

title: Sri Raghu Nandana Janaki Jeevana
lyrics:
Sri Raghu Nandana Janaki Jeevana
Rama Rama Rama Sai
Rama Rama Rama Ram
Alakha Niranjana Asura Nikhandana
Rajeeva Lochana Bhava Bhaya Bhanjana
Rama Rama Rama Sai
Rama Rama Rama Ram
meaning: Worship Lord Rama, who is the consort of Janaki (Sita), who is always pure, the slayer of demons, the one with eyes like Lotus and who destroys the fear of the materialistic world.
devanagari:
श्री रघु नंदन जानकी जीवन
राम राम राम साई
राम राम राम राम
अलख निरंजन असुर निखंडन
राजीव लोचन भव भय भंजन
राम राम राम साई
राम राम राम राम
respell:
Shrī Raghu Nandana Jānakī Jīvan
Rām Rām Rām Sāī
Rām Rām Rām Rām
Alakh Nirañjana Asur Nikhaṇḍana
Rājīva Lochana Bhava Bhaya Bhañjana
Rām Rām Rām Sāī
Rām Rām Rām Rām

title: Sri Raghu Nandana Sita Rama
lyrics:
Sri Raghu Nandana Sita Rama
Rajeeva Lochana Raja Rama
Raja Rama
Sai Rama
Bhava Bhaya Bhanjana Taraka Nama
Atma Rama Sai Rama
Kalimala Bhanjana Kodanda Rama
meaning: Worship Lord Rama of Raghu Dynasty, the consort of Sita, the one with lotus eyes, the one whose sacred name destroys the fear of the materialistic world and grants liberation, the one who is Atma Rama (inner self or higher conscience), the one who wields the bow named "Kodanda" and the one who destroys the impurities of the age of Kali. He is verily Lord Sai.
devanagari:
श्री रघु नंदन सीता रामा
राजीव लोचन राजा रामा
राजा (साई) रामा
भव भय भंजन तारक नामा
आत्मा रामा साई रामा
कालिमल भंजन कोडंड रामा
respell:
Shrī Raghu Nandana Sītā Rāmā
Rājīva Lochana Rājā Rāmā
Rājā (sāī) Rāmā
Bhava Bhaya Bhañjana Tārak Nāmā
Ātmā Rāmā Sāī Rāmā
Kālimala Bhañjana Koḍaṇḍa Rāmā

title: Sri Ram Jaya Ram Jaya Jaya Ram Janaki Jeevana Ram
lyrics:
Sri Ram Jaya Ram Jaya Jaya Ram Janaki Jeevana Ram
Patita Pavana Rama Hare Jaya Raghava Sundara Ram
Deenoddharana Rama Hare Jaya Maruti Sevita Ram
Jaya Ram Jaya Ram Jaya Raghu Ram Janaki Jeevana Ram
meaning: Victory to Lord Rama, the embodiment of auspiciousness, the very life of Janaki (Sita) the uplifter of downtrodden, the beautiful one from Raghu dynasty, who sanctifies the sinners and the one who is worshipped by Maruti (Hanuman).
devanagari:
श्री राम जय राम जय जय राम जानकी जीवन राम  
पतित पावन राम हरे जय राघव सुंदर राम  
दीणोद्धारणा राम हरे जय मारुति सेवित राम  
जय जय राम जय रघु राम जानकी जीवन राम
respell:
Shrī Rām Jaya Rām Jaya Jaya Rām Jānakī Jīvan Rām
Patita Pāvan Rām Hare Jaya Rāghav Sundara Rām
Dīṇoddhāraṇā Rām Hare Jaya Māruti Sevit Rām
Jaya Jaya Rām Jaya Raghu Rām Jānakī Jīvan Rām

title: Sri Ram Jaya Ram Jaya Jaya Ram
lyrics:
Sri Ram Jaya Ram Jaya Jaya Ram
Raghupati Raghava Raja Ram
Dasharatha Nandana Sri Raghu Ram
Parthipureeshwara Sai Ram
Raghupati Raghava Raja Ram
meaning: Oh glorious Lord Rama, king of the Raghu dynasty and beloved son of Dasharatha, we sing your victory! We also honor Sai Rama, the divine sovereign of Puttaparthi, recognizing him as the very embodiment of you, Lord Rama.
devanagari:
श्री राम जय राम जय जय राम
रघुपति राघव राजा राम
दशरथ नंदन श्री रघु राम
पर्तीपूरीश्वर साई राम
रघुपति राघव राजा राम
respell:
Shrī Rām Jaya Rām Jaya Jaya Rām
Raghupati Rāghav Rājā Rām
Dasharath Nandana Shrī Raghu Rām
Partīpūrīshwar Sāī Rām
Raghupati Rāghav Rājā Rām

title: Sri Rama Charanam Sri Rama Charanam Sri Rama Charanam Bhaje
lyrics:
Sri Rama Charanam Sri Rama Charanam Sri Rama Charanam Bhaje
Vaidehi Ramam Vaikuntha Dhamam
Bhoopala Choodamani
Atmabhi Ramam Prabhu Sai Ramam
Sri Rama Charanam Bhaje
Sathya Sai Rama Charanam Bhaje
meaning: Worship the feet of Lord Sri Rama, Lord of Vaidehi, whose abode is Vaikunta. Like the Choodamani, which is the best among the jewels worn on the head, Sri Rama is the Crown Jewel among the kings who have ruled this world. He is the Atma (Higher self or Higher conscience) Rama, Sathya Sai Rama.
devanagari:
श्री राम चरणम् श्री राम चरणम् श्री राम चरणम् भजे (२)  
वैदेही रामं वैकुंट धामं  
भूपाल चूड़ामणि  
आत्मभि रामं प्रभु साई रामं  
श्री (सत्य साई) राम चरणम् भजे (३)
respell:
Shrī Rām Charaṇam Shrī Rām Charaṇam Shrī Rām Charaṇam Bhaje (2)
Vaidehī Rāmaṃ Vaikuṇṭ Dhāmaṃ
Bhūpāla Chūḍa़āmaṇi
Ātmabhi Rāmaṃ Prabhu Sāī Rāmaṃ
Shrī (satya Sāī) Rām Charaṇam Bhaje (3)

title: Sri Rama Jaya Rama Jaya Jaya Rama
lyrics:
Sri Rama Jaya Rama Jaya Jaya Rama
Sri Rama Jaya Rama Sundara Rama [ Sri Rama ... ]
Sri Rama Jaya Rama Mangala Naama
Sri Rama Jaya Rama Atma Rama
Sri Rama Jaya Rama Sita (Sai) Rama
meaning: Oh Lord Rama, we sing your glorious victory! You are the beautiful one, whose auspicious name reveals you as the indwelling Self, Sita's beloved, and truly, you are Sai.
devanagari:
श्री राम जय राम जय जय रामा  
श्री राम जय राम सुन्दर रामा  
श्री राम जय राम मङ्गल नामा  
श्री राम जय राम आत्मा रामा  
श्री राम जय राम सीता (साई) रामा
respell:

Shrī Rām Jaya Rām Sundara Rāmā
Shrī Rām Jaya Rām Maṅgal Nāmā
Shrī Rām Jaya Rām Ātmā Rāmā
Shrī Rām Jaya Rām Sītā (sāī) Rāmā

title: Sri Rama Jaya Rama
lyrics:
Sri Rama Jaya Rama
Dasharathe Jaya Raghu Rama
Kalyana Rama Kodanda Rama
Sita Rama Sri Raghu Rama
Ram Jaya Ram
Sri Ram Jaya Ram
Sri Rama Jaya Rama Jaya Jaya Rama
meaning: Victory to Lord Rama of Raghu dynasty, the son of Dasharatha and the consort of Mother Sita. Victory to the one who wields the Kodanda bow and who bestows welfare on all.
devanagari:
श्री रामा  जय रामा 
दाशरथे जय रघु रामा 
कल्याण रामा  कोदण्ड रामा 
सीता रामा  श्री रघु रामा 
राम जय राम
श्री राम जय राम
श्री राम जय राम जय जय रामा
respell:
Shrī Rāmā  Jaya Rāmā
Dāsharathe Jaya Raghu Rāmā
Kalyāṇ Rāmā  Kodaṇḍa Rāmā
Sītā Rāmā  Shrī Raghu Rāmā
Rām Jaya Rām
Shrī Rām Jaya Rām
Shrī Rām Jaya Rām Jaya Jaya Rāmā

title: Sri Rama Rama Rama Ram Yadu Nandana Hey Ghanashyam
lyrics:
Sri Rama Rama Ram Yadu Nandana Hey Ghanashyam
Sri Ram Jaya Ram Jaya Jaya Ram (2)
Sri Ram Jaya Ram Jaya Sai Ram
Raghupati Raghava Raja Ram
Patita Pavana Sita Ram
Sri Ram Jaya Ram Jaya Jaya Ram
Sri Ram Jaya Ram Jaya Sai Ram
meaning: Sing the name of Rama, who is beloved of Sita and son of Dasharatha and star of Raghu clan. Fill the mind with the glory of Rama, who sanctifies the sinners. Repeat the name of Sai Ram.
devanagari:
श्री राम राम राम यदु नंदन हे घना श्याम  
श्री राम जय राम जय जय राम (3)  
रघुपति राघव राजा राम  
पतित पावन सीता राम [ श्री राम जय राम ... ]
respell:
