Shrī Rām Jaya Rām Jaya Jaya Rām (3)
Raghupati Rāghav Rājā Rām
Patita Pāvan Sītā Rām [ Shrī Rām Jaya Rām ... ]

title: Sri Rama Rama Rama Raghuveera Rama Ram
lyrics:
Sri Rama Rama Rama Raghuveera Rama Ram
Sri Rama Rama Rama Bharatagraja Rama Ram
Sri Rama Rama Rama Ranadheera Rama Ram
Sri Rama Rama Rama Sharanam Tava Rama Ram
meaning: O Sri Rama, valiant hero of the Raghu dynasty and elder brother of Bharata, we invoke your sacred name. We humbly seek your divine refuge, surrendering ourselves completely to you.
devanagari:
श्री राम राम रामा रघुवीरा राम राम
श्री राम राम रामा भारताग्रज राम राम
श्री राम राम रामा रणधीरा राम राम
श्री राम राम रामा शरणं तव राम राम
respell:
Shrī Rām Rām Rāmā Raghuvīrā Rām Rām
Shrī Rām Rām Rāmā Bhāratāgraj Rām Rām
Shrī Rām Rām Rāmā Raṇadhīrā Rām Rām
Shrī Rām Rām Rāmā Sharaṇaṃ Tava Rām Rām

title: Sri Rama Sri Raghu Rama
lyrics:
Sri Rama Sri Raghu Rama
Sri Rama Sita Rama
Sri Rama Megha Shyama
Sri Rama Sai Rama
meaning: Chant the various name of Rama -Raghu Rama, Sita Rama, Megha Shyama, Sai Rama
devanagari:
श्री राम श्री रघु रामा
श्री राम सीता रामा
श्री राम मेघ श्यामा
श्री राम साई रामा
respell:
Shrī Rām Shrī Raghu Rāmā
Shrī Rām Sītā Rāmā
Shrī Rām Megha Shyāmā
Shrī Rām Sāī Rāmā

title: Sri Ramachandra Jaya Ramachandra
lyrics:
Sri Rama Chandra Jaya Rama Chandra
Raghuveera Ranadheera Raghukula Rama
Dasaratha Nandana Dayabhi Rama
Danava Bhanjana Kodanda Rama
Kalyana Rama Kamaneeya Rama
meaning: Victory to Lord Rama, the valiant hero of the battlefield, the son of Dasharatha. Lord Rama is the most compassionate one, the slayer of demons, the wielder of the sacred bow Kodanda, one who does good to everyone and who is very attractive to look at.
devanagari:
श्री रामचंद्रा जय रामचंद्रा
रघुवीर रणधीर रघुकुल रामा [ श्री रामचंद्रा ... ]
दशरथ नंदन दयाभि रामा
दानव भंजन कोदंड रामा
कल्याण रामा कमनीय रामा [ रघुवीर ... ]
respell:
Shrī Rāmachandrā Jaya Rāmachandrā
Raghuvīr Raṇadhīra Raghukul Rāmā [ shrī rāmachandrā ... ]
Dasharath Nandana Dayābhi Rāmā
Dānava Bhañjana Kodaṇḍa Rāmā
Kalyāṇ Rāmā Kamanīya Rāmā [ raghuvīr ... ]

title: Sri Ranga Hare Vitthala Sai Ranga Hare Vitthala
lyrics:
Sri Ranga Hare Vitthala Sai Ranga Hare Vitthala
Hey Daya Nidhe Vitthala Hey Krupa Nidhe Vitthala
Hey Sai Prabho Vitthala Sathya Sai Prabho Vitthala
meaning: Chant Sri Ranga, Vittala who is all compassionate and merciful Oh Lord Sai Vittala, Oh Sathya Sai Vittala
devanagari:
श्री रंगा हरे विट्ठला साई रंगा हरे विट्ठला
हे दया निधे विट्ठला हे कृपा निधे विट्ठला
हे साई प्रभो विट्ठला सत्य साई प्रभो विट्ठला
respell:
Shrī Raṅgā Hare Viṭṭhalā Sāī Raṅgā Hare Viṭṭhalā
He Dayā Nidhe Viṭṭhalā He Kṛupā Nidhe Viṭṭhalā
He Sāī Prabho Viṭṭhalā Satya Sāī Prabho Viṭṭhalā

title: Sri Ranga Sri Ranga Ranga Ranga Sri Ranga
lyrics:
Sri Ranga Sri Ranga Ranga Ranga Sri Ranga (2)
Kaveri Thata Vasa Kasturi Ranga
Karunya Lavanya KarunantaRanga
Jaya Panduranga Jaya SaiRanga (2)
meaning: Chant the name of Lord Sriranga who resides on the banks of river Kaveri. He is compassionate and HIS beauty is enchanting. Victory to you Oh Lord Panduranga.
devanagari:
श्री रंगा श्री रंगा रंग रंग श्री रंगा (2)
कावेरी तट वासा कस्तूरी रंगा
करुण्य लावण्य करुणान्त रंगा
जय पांडुरंगा जय साई रंगा (2)
respell:
Shrī Raṅgā Shrī Raṅgā Raṅg Raṅg Shrī Raṅgā (2)
Kāverī Taṭa Vāsā Kastūrī Raṅgā
Karuṇya Lāvaṇya Karuṇānta Raṅgā
Jaya Pāṇḍuraṅgā Jaya Sāī Raṅgā (2)

title: Sri Sai Natha Guru Govinda
lyrics:
Sri Sai Natha Guru Govinda
Parthipureeshwara Jaya Govinda
Prasanthi Nilaya Radhe Govinda
Sri Guru Jaya Guru Vitthala Govinda
meaning: Sing the name of Lord Sai who is our Guru, the Lord Govinda who resides in Parthi, the Lord of Radha and also known by the name of Vittala.
devanagari:
श्री साई नाथा गुरु गोविन्दा
पर्थिपुरीश्वर​ जय गोविन्दा
प्रशान्ति निलया राधे गोविन्दा
श्री गुरु जय गुरु विट्ठला गोविन्दा
respell:
Shrī Sāī Nāthā Guru Govindā
Parthipurīshwara​ Jaya Govindā
Prashānti Nilayā Rādhe Govindā
Shrī Guru Jaya Guru Viṭṭhalā Govindā

title: Sri Sai Rama Sundara Nama
lyrics:
Sri Sai Rama Sundara Nama
Pavana Charana Prasanthi Rama
Jagadashraya Bhava Bandha Vimochana
Ahalyoddharaka Rama Hare
Rama Hare Rama Hare
Parthipureesha Mangala Dhama
Pavana Charana Prasanthi Rama
meaning: Oh Lord Sai Rama of Prashanthi, from whom the entire world seeks solace and liberation, you are none other than Lord Rama who liberated Ahalya. Oh Lord of Parthi we offer our salutations at your sacred feet.
devanagari:
श्री साई रामा सुन्दर नामा
पावन चरणा प्रशान्ति चरणा
जगदाश्रय भव बन्ध विमोचन
अहलोद्धारक राम हरे
राम हरे राम हरे
पर्तीपुरीशा मङ्गल धामा
पावन चरणा प्रशान्ति रामा
respell:
Shrī Sāī Rāmā Sundara Nāmā
Pāvan Charaṇā Prashānti Charaṇā
Jagadāshray Bhava Bandha Vimochana
Ahaloddhārak Rām Hare
Rām Hare Rām Hare
Partīpurīshā Maṅgal Dhāmā
Pāvan Charaṇā Prashānti Rāmā

title: Sri Venkatesha Sayeeshwara
lyrics:
Sri Venkatesha Sayeeshwara
Tirumalai Vasa Sayeeshwara
Sayeeshwara Sathya Sayeeshwara
Balaji Govinda Sayeeshwara
Akhilanda Natha Ananda Roopa
Venkatesha Sai Venkatesha
Balaji Govinda Sayeeshwara
meaning: Salutations to Lord Sai who is also the Lord Venkateshwara or Balaji who resides in Tirumala the Lord Govinda. He is the Lord of the whole Universe and the embodiment of happiness. Worship Lord Sathya Sayeeshwara.
devanagari:
श्री वेंकटेशा साईश्वरा
तिरुमलै वासा साईश्वरा
साईश्वरा सत्य साईश्वरा
बालाजी गोविन्द साईश्वरा  (2)
अखिलाण्ड नाथा आनन्द रूपा
वेंकटेशा साई वेंकटेशा  (3)
बालाजी गोविन्द साईश्वरा  (2)
respell:
Shrī Veṅkaṭeshā Sāīshwarā
Tirumalai Vāsā Sāīshwarā
Sāīshwarā Satya Sāīshwarā
Bālājī Govinda Sāīshwarā  (2)
Akhilāṇḍa Nāthā Ānanda Rūpā
Veṅkaṭeshā Sāī Veṅkaṭeshā  (3)
Bālājī Govinda Sāīshwarā  (2)

title: Srikari Kripakari Kshemankari Sayeeshwari
lyrics:
Srikari Kripakari Kshemankari Sayeeshwari
Shankari Abhayankari Shubhankari Sayeeshwari
Tandavakeli Priyakari Bhairavi Pralayankari
Sarveshwari Sundari Dayakari Maheshwari
meaning: Glory be to the beautiful, compassionate and all-pervading goddess Parvati, the consort of Shankara (Shiva), the one who bestows auspiciousness, who looks after the welfare of devotees, who bestows fearlessness and who is fond of the 'Tandava' dance.
devanagari:
श्रीकरी कृपाकरी क्षेमंकरि साईश्वरि
शंकरी अभयंकरि शुभंकरी साईश्वरि [ श्रीकरी कृपाकरी ... ]
तांडवकेली प्रियकरी भैरवी प्रलयंकरी
सर्वेश्वरी सुंदरी दयाकरी महेश्वरी
respell:
Shrīkarī Kṛupākarī Kshemaṅkari Sāīshwari
Shaṅkarī Abhayaṅkari Shubhaṅkarī Sāīshwari [ Shrīkarī Kṛupākarī ... ]
Tāṇḍavakelī Priyakarī Bhairavī Pralayaṅkarī
Sarweshwarī Sundarī Dayākarī Maheshwarī

title: Srinivasa Govinda Sri Venkatesha Govinda
lyrics:
Srinivasa Govinda Sri Venkatesha Govinda
Purana Purusha Govinda Pundarikaksha Govinda
Dashavidha Roopa Govinda Krishna Rama Govinda
Krishna Rama Govinda Rama Krishna Govinda
Sai Rama Govinda Sai Krishna Govinda
Venkataramana Govinda Sankata Harana Govinda
meaning: Chant the names of Srinivasa, Govinda, Venkatesha the one who is the Lord of great Epics and the one who has taken ten incarnations. He is also the Lord Sai Rama and Sai Krishna.
devanagari:
श्रीनिवासा गोविन्दा श्री वेंकटेशा गोविन्दा
पुराण पुरुषा गोविन्दा पुंडरीकाक्क्षा गोविन्दा
दशविद रूपा गोविन्दा कृष्णा रामा गोविन्दा
कृष्णा रामा गोविन्दा रामा कृष्णा गोविन्दा
साई राम गोविन्दा साई कृष्णा गोविन्दा
respell:
Shrīnivāsā Govindā Shrī Veṅkaṭeshā Govindā
Purāṇ Purushā Govindā Puṇḍarīkākkshā Govindā
Dashavid Rūpā Govindā Kṛushṇā Rāmā Govindā
Kṛushṇā Rāmā Govindā Rāmā Kṛushṇā Govindā
Sāī Rām Govindā Sāī Kṛushṇā Govindā

title: Srinivasa Sri Venkatesha
lyrics:
Srinivasa Sri Venkatesha
Balaji Govinda Sayeesha
Parama Dayala Tirumala Vasa
Padma Lakshmi Vallabha Esha
Pundarikaksha Papa Vinasha
meaning: Oh Lord Srinivasa, Sri Venkatesha, Balaji, Govinda, Oh Sayeesha you are the compassionate Lord residing on the hills of Tirumala accompanied by Padmavati and Lakshmi. You are Pundarikaksha the destroyer of sins.
devanagari:
श्रीनिवासा श्री वेंकटेशा
बालाजी गोविन्द साईशा  [श्रीनिवासा श्री...]
परम दयाला तिरुमला वासा
पद्मा लक्ष्मी वल्लभ ईशा
पुण्डरीकाक्क्षा पाप विनाशा
respell:
Shrīnivāsā Shrī Veṅkaṭeshā
Bālājī Govinda Sāīshā  [shrīnivāsā shrī...]
Param Dayālā Tirumalā Vāsā
Padmā Lakshmī Vallabh Īshā
Puṇḍarīkākkshā Pāpa Vināshā

title: Srinivasa Venkatesha
lyrics:
Srinivasa Venkatesha
Sritajana Paripala Sayeesha
Tirumala Giri Vasa Govinda
Garuda Vahana Govinda Govinda
Govinda Govinda Srinivasa Govinda
Govinda Govinda Shirdi Vasa Govinda
Govinda Govinda Parthi Vasa Govinda
meaning: Sing the names of Lord Srinivasa, Venkatesha (names of Lord Vishnu) and Lord Sayeesha who protects all those who have surrendered to Him. Glory to Lord Govinda who resides in Tirupati and the one who rides on Garuda.
devanagari:
श्रीनिवासा वेंकटेशा 
श्रीत जन परिपाला साईशा
[ श्रीनिवासा ... ]
तिरुपति गिरी वासा गोविन्दा
गरुड़ वाहन गोविन्दा गोविन्दा
गोविन्द गोविन्दा श्रीनिवास गोविन्दा
गोविन्द गोविन्दा शिर्डी वासा गोविन्दा
गोविन्द गोविन्दा पर्ति वासा गोविन्दा
respell:
Shrīnivāsā Veṅkaṭeshā
Shrīt Jana Paripālā Sāīshā
[ Shrīnivāsā ... ]
Tirupati Girī Vāsā Govindā
Garuḍa़ Vāhan Govindā Govindā
Govinda Govindā Shrīnivās Govindā
Govinda Govindā Shirḍī Vāsā Govindā
Govinda Govindā Parti Vāsā Govindā

title: Subah Aur Sham Bolo Hari Nam
lyrics:
Subah Aur Sham Bolo Hari Nam
Gopi Gopala Bhajo Sai Ghanashyam
Chalo Man Chalo Chale Baba Ke Dham
Shirdi Ke Dham Sathya Sai Ke Dham
meaning: Chant the name of Lord Hari day in and day out. Chant Gopi, Gopala, Ghana Shyam (various names of Lord Krishna) and Sai who is verily Krishna. O Mind, let us proceed with our journey to the abodes of Shirdi Sai Baba and Sathya Sai Baba.
devanagari:
सुबह और शाम बोल हरी नाम
गोपी गोपाल भजो साई घनश्याम
चलो मन चलो चले बाबा के धाम
शिरडी के धाम सत्य साई के धाम
respell:
Subah Aur Shām Bol Harī Nām
Gopī Gopāla Bhajo Sāī Ghanashyām
Chalo Man Chalo Chale Bābā Ke Dhām
Shiraḍī Ke Dhām Satya Sāī Ke Dhām

title: Subrahmanyam Subrahmanyam
lyrics:
Subrahmanyam Subrahmanyam Shanmukha Natha Subrahmanyam
Subrahmanyam Subrahmanyam Sai Natha Subrahmanyam
Shiva Shiva Shiva Shiva Subrahmanyam Hara Hara Hara Hara Subrahmanyam
Shiva Shiva Hara Hara Subrahmanyam Hara Hara Shiva Shiva Subrahmanyam
Shiva Sharavana Bhava Subrahmanyam Guru Sharavana Bhava Subrahmanyam
Shiva Shiva Hara Hara Subrahmanyam Hara Hara Shiva Shiva Subrahmanyam
meaning: O Subrahmanya, Lord of six faces, we call upon your divine name! You are our beloved Sai Natha, the divine teacher born of Shiva, who emerged from the sacred Sharavana grove. We ceaselessly chant the holy names of Shiva and Hara in devotion to you.
devanagari:
सुब्रह्मण्यं सुब्रह्मण्यं शान्मुख नाथ सुब्रह्मण्यं  
सुब्रह्मण्यं सुब्रह्मण्यं साई नाथ सुब्रह्मण्यं  
शिव शिव शिव शिव सुब्रह्मण्यं हर हर हर हर सुब्रह्मण्यं  
शिव शिव हर हर सुब्रह्मण्यं हर हर शिव शिव सुब्रह्मण्यं  
शिव शरावण भव सुब्रह्मण्यं गुरु शरावण भव सुब्रह्मण्यं  
शिव शिव हर हर सुब्रह्मण्यं हर हर शिव शिव सुब्रह्मण्यं
respell:
Subrahmaṇyaṃ Subrahmaṇyaṃ Shānmukha Nātha Subrahmaṇyaṃ
Subrahmaṇyaṃ Subrahmaṇyaṃ Sāī Nātha Subrahmaṇyaṃ
Shiv Shiv Shiv Shiv Subrahmaṇyaṃ Har Har Har Har Subrahmaṇyaṃ
Shiv Shiv Har Har Subrahmaṇyaṃ Har Har Shiv Shiv Subrahmaṇyaṃ
Shiv Sharāvaṇ Bhava Subrahmaṇyaṃ Guru Sharāvaṇ Bhava Subrahmaṇyaṃ
Shiv Shiv Har Har Subrahmaṇyaṃ Har Har Shiv Shiv Subrahmaṇyaṃ

title: Sundar Sundar Sai Sundar
lyrics:
Sundara Sundara Sai Sundara
Kamala Nayana Sai Ram (2) [ Sundara Sundara … ]
Partipuri Mey Janam Liya
Bhakthon Ka Uddhaar Kiya
Patita Pavana Pavana Naam [ Kamala Nayana ... ]
Jai Jai Ram Ram Ram Sai Ram Ram Ram
meaning: Oh beautiful, beautiful Sai, lotus-eyed Sai Ram! You took birth in Puttaparthi to redeem your devotees, and your holy name is the sacred purifier of the fallen. Glory to Sai Ram!
devanagari:
सुंदर सुंदर साई सुंदर  
कमल नयन साई राम (2) [ सुंदर सुंदर … ]  
पर्तिपुरी में जन्म लिया  
भक्तों का उद्धार किया  
पतित पावन पावन नाम [ कमल नयन ... ]  
जय जय राम राम राम साई राम राम राम
respell:
Sundara Sundara Sāī Sundara
Kamala Nayan Sāī Rām (2) [ Sundara Sundara … ]
Partipurī Meṃ Janm Liyā
Bhaktoṃ Kā Uddhār Kiyā
Patita Pāvan Pāvan Nām [ Kamala Nayan ... ]
Jay Jay Rām Rām Rām Sāī Rām Rām Rām

title: Sundara Mukha Sri Gajanana
lyrics:
Sundara Mukha Sri Gajanana
Eka Danta Sri Gajanana
Prathama Namami Gajanana
Rishi Muni Vandita Gajanana
Gajanana Om Gajanana (3)
meaning: Salutations to Lord Ganesh, the beautiful elephant-faced Lord with a single tusk and the one whom the entire universe worships first. The wise and noble sages too worship Him first.
devanagari:
सुंदर मुख श्री गजानना  
एक दन्त श्री गजानना [ सुंदर मुख ... ]  
प्रथम नमामि गजानना  
ऋषि मुनि वन्दित गजानना  
गजानना ॐ गजानना (3)
respell:
Sundara Mukha Shrī Gajānanā
Ek Danta Shrī Gajānanā [ Sundara Mukha ... ]
Prathama Namāmi Gajānanā
Ṛshi Muni Vandita Gajānanā
Gajānanā Oṃ Gajānanā (3)

title: Sundara Padam Sai Padam
lyrics:
Sundara Padam Sai Padam
Pankaja Charanam Papa Vimochanam
Nataraja Natanam Sai Padam
Sri Krishna Nartanam Sai Padam
Bhava Dukha Haranam Sai Padam
Jagadoddharanam Sai Padam
meaning: Oh, the beautiful feet of Sai, like tender lotus petals, they cleanse us of all sin. These are the divine dancing feet of Nataraja and Sri Krishna, removing all worldly sorrow and uplifting the entire universe.
devanagari:
सुन्दर पादम साई पादम
पंकज चरणम् पाप विमोचनम्
नटराज नटनम् साई पादम
श्री कृष्ण नर्तनम् साई पादम
भव दुःख हरणम् साई पादम
जगदोद्धारणम् साई पादम
respell:
Sundara Pādam Sāī Pādam
Paṅkaj Charaṇam Pāpa Vimochanam
Naṭarāj Naṭanam Sāī Pādam
Shrī Kṛushṇa Nartanam Sāī Pādam
Bhava Duḥkha Haraṇam Sāī Pādam
Jagadoddhāraṇam Sāī Pādam

title: Sundara Shyam Nayanabhi Ram
lyrics:
Sundara Shyam Nayanabhi Ram
Hey Ghanashyam Nayanabhi Ram
Natavara Shyam Nayanabhi Ram
Radhe Shyam Nayanabhi Ram
Sai Shyam Nayanabhi Ram
meaning: Oh beautiful Shyam, whose very sight enchants our eyes, you are the cloud-dark one, the supreme dancer. Beloved of Radha and manifest as Sai, your divine form is eternally pleasing to behold.
devanagari:
सुन्दर श्याम नयनभि राम
हे घनश्याम नयनभि राम
नटवर श्याम नयनभि राम
राधे श्याम नयनभि राम
साई श्याम नयनभि राम
respell:
Sundara Shyām Nayanabhi Rām
He Ghanashyām Nayanabhi Rām
Naṭavar Shyām Nayanabhi Rām
Rādhe Shyām Nayanabhi Rām
Sāī Shyām Nayanabhi Rām

title: Sundara Shyama Murari Sai
lyrics:
Sundara Shyama Murari Sai
Gopala Sri Hari Sri Hari
Parama Niranjana Madhava Sai
Sakala Charachara Vyapaka Sai
meaning: This devotional song extols Lord Sai as the beautiful dark-hued Krishna, addressed as Murari, Gopala, and Sri Hari. It declares Sai to be the supreme, pure Madhava, whose divine essence permeates every aspect of the universe.
devanagari:
सुंदर श्याम मुरारी साई
गोपाला श्री हरि श्री हरि (2)
परम निरञ्जन माधव साई
सकल चराचर व्यापक साई [ गोपाला श्री ... ]
respell:
Sundara Shyām Murārī Sāī
Gopālā Shrī Hari Shrī Hari (2)
Param Nirañjana Mādhava Sāī
Sakal Charāchara Vyāpaka Sāī [ Gopālā Shrī ... ]

title: Sundara Sundara Nachey Sundara Sai Ghana Shyam
lyrics:
Sundara Sundara Nachey Sundara Sai Ghana Shyam
Nacherey Sai Sundara Shyam
Rhumaka Jhumaka Jhum Ghungaroo Baajey Nachey Ghana Shyam
Nachey Natavara Sai Sundara Merey Sai Ram
Nachey Nachey Man Mandir Mey Merey Sai Ram [ Nacherey ... ]
meaning: O beautiful, dark-complexioned Lord Sai, you dance gracefully with jingling anklets, enchanting all who witness. Please dance in the temple of our hearts, dear Sai Ram, filling our lives with your divine rhythm.
devanagari:
सुंदर सुंदर नाचे सुंदर साई घनश्याम
नाचरे साई सुंदर श्याम
झुमक झुमक झुम घुंगरू बाजे नाचे घनश्याम
नाचे नटवर साई सुंदर मेरे साई राम  
नाचे नाचे मन मंदिर में मेरे साई राम [ नाचरे ... ]
respell:
Sundara Sundara Nāche Sundara Sāī Ghanashyām
Nāchare Sāī Sundara Shyām
Jhumaka Jhumaka Jhum Ghuṅgarū Bāje Nāche Ghanashyām
Nāche Naṭavar Sāī Sundara Mere Sāī Rām
Nāche Nāche Man Mandir Meṃ Mere Sāī Rām [ Nāchare ... ]

title: Sundara Sundara Vinayaka
lyrics:
Sundara Sundara Vinayaka
Shubha Mangala Dayaka Vinayaka
Vighna Koti Hara Vimala Gajanana
Sakala Vighna Hara Pahi Gajanana
Eshwari Nandana Parthi Gajanana
--
Jai Jai Ganesha Jai Sri Ganesha
meaning: Lord Ganesha who is very beautiful, who bestows everything good and auspicious. HE is the remover of all obstacles that come in our way. He is Sai Gajanana who resides in Parthi.
devanagari:
सुंदर सुंदर विनायका
शुभ मंगल दायक विनायका
विघ्न कोटि हर विमल गजानन
सकल विघ्न हर साई गजानन
ईश्वरी नंदन पर्ती गजानन
--
जय जय गणेश जय श्री गणेश (4)
respell:
Sundara Sundara Vināyakā
Shubh Maṅgal Dāyak Vināyakā
Vighna Koṭi Har Vimala Gajānana
Sakal Vighna Har Sāī Gajānana
Īshwarī Nandana Partī Gajānana
--
Jay Jay Gaṇesh Jay Shrī Gaṇesh (4)

title: Sundara Vadana Sarisaja Nayana
lyrics:
Sundara Vadana Sarisaja Nayana
Parthi Puri Bhagawan
Jagat Paripala Prashanthi Nilaya
Tum Ho Mère Bhagawan
Daya Karo Bhagawan
Kripa Karo Bhagawan
Parthipureesha He Paramesha
Raksha Karo Bhagawan

title: Sundara Vadani Suguna Manohari
lyrics:
Sundara Vadani Suguna Manohari
Mandahasa Mukha Shashi Vadani
Chandana Kumkuma Alankruta Vadani
Sai Maheshwari Raja Rajeshwari
--
Om Shakti Om  Om Shakti Om  Om Shakti Om  Om Shakthi Om
meaning: Chant 'Om Shakthi Om' repeatedly which extols Mother as Maheshwari, virtuous Goddess of Emperors, having a blissful smile with the sandal paste and vermillion on her beautiful face.
devanagari:
सुंदर वदनी सुगुण मनोहरी
मंद हास मुख शशि वदनी
चंदन कुमकुम अलंकृत वदनी
साई महेश्वरी राज राजेश्वरी
ॐ शक्ति ॐ ॐ शक्ति ॐ ॐ शक्ति ॐ ॐ शक्ति ॐ (2)
respell:
Sundara Vadanī Suguṇ Manoharī
Manda Hās Mukha Shashi Vadanī
Chandana Kumakum Alaṅkṛut Vadanī
Sāī Maheshwarī Rāj Rājeshwarī
Oṃ Shakti Oṃ Oṃ Shakti Oṃ Oṃ Shakti Oṃ Oṃ Shakti Oṃ (2)

title: Suramuni Vanditha Vinayaka
lyrics:
Suramuni Vanditha Vinayaka
Ananda Dayaka Vinayaka
Hey Shiva Nandana Shubhanana
Sai Ganesha Vinayaka
Sai Ganesha Sai Ganesha Sai Ganesha Vinayaka (2)
meaning: O Vinayaka, revered by gods and sages, You are the divine bestower of joy. Beloved son of Shiva, with an auspicious face, we lovingly call upon You as Sai Ganesha.
devanagari:
सुरमुनि वन्दित विनायका 
आनंद दायक विनायका 
हे शिवनंदना शुभानना 
साई गणेशा विनायका 
साई गणेशा साई गणेशा साई गणेशा विनायका
respell:
Suramuni Vandita Vināyakā
Ānanda Dāyak Vināyakā
He Shivanandanā Shubhānanā
Sāī Gaṇeshā Vināyakā
Sāī Gaṇeshā Sāī Gaṇeshā Sāī Gaṇeshā Vināyakā

title: Swami Take My Hand
lyrics:
Swami Take My Hand, Jesus Take My Hand,
Dear Lord Take My Hand, Take My Hand And Lead The Way
I'll Never Forget You, You'll Always Be With Me,   [ Dear Lord  ... ]
You Are Guide And Protector, Mother And Father,  [ Dear Lord  ... ]
Teach Me Loving Service, Peace And Contentment
[ Dear Lord ... ]
devanagari:
स्वामी टेक माइ हैन्ड जीजस टेक माइ हैन्ड
डिर लोर्ड टेक माइ हैन्ड टेक माइ हैन्ड अन्ड लेड द वे
आइल नेवर फरगेट यू यूल ओल्वेज बी विद मी
यू आर गाइड अन्ड प्रटेक्टर मदर अन्ड फादर
टीच मी लविङ सरवस पीस अन्ड कन्टेन्ट्मन्ट

title: Terey Janam Din Me Sai
lyrics:
Terey Janam Din Me Sai Tujhe Koti Pranam Karenge
Tujhe Koti Pranam Karenge Tujhe Koti Pranam Karenge [ Terey Janam ... ]
Teri Janma Bhumi Me Sai Aye Bichchade Behan Aur Bhai
Teri Pooja Karne Baba Teri Prashanthi Me Ayenge [ Terey Janam ... ]
Dhanya Ho Eshwaramba Merey Sai Ko Tumne Janma
Teyis November Ko Baba Sai Bhajan Aur Gaan Karenge
Happy Birthday To You Sai Rama Happy Birthday To You Sai Baba
meaning: On your birthday, O Sai, we offer countless salutations. Devotees, like scattered siblings, will gather in Prashanthi, your sacred birthplace, to worship you and sing your glories on November 23rd, honoring Mother Eshwaramba who bore you.
devanagari:
तेरे जनम दिन में साईं तुझे कोटि प्रणाम करेंगे  
तुझे कोटि प्रणाम करेंगे तुझे कोटि प्रणाम करेंगे [ तेरे जनम ... ]  
तेरी जन्म भूमि में साईं आए बिछड़े बहन और भाई  
तेरी पूजा करने बाबा तेरी प्रशांति में आएंगे [ तेरे जनम ... ]  
धन्य हो ईश्वरांबा मेरे साईं को तुमने जन्मा  
तेईस नवंबर को बाबा साईं भजन और गान करेंगे  
हैप्पी बर्थडे टू यू साईं राम हैप्पी बर्थडे टू यू साईं बाबा
respell:
Tere Janam Din Meṃ Sāīṃ Tujhe Koṭi Praṇām Kareṅge
Tujhe Koṭi Praṇām Kareṅge Tujhe Koṭi Praṇām Kareṅge [ Tere Janam ... ]
Terī Janma Bhūmi Meṃ Sāīṃ Āe Bichhaḍa़e Bahan Aur Bhāī
Terī Pūjā Karane Bābā Terī Prashānti Meṃ Āeṅge [ Tere Janam ... ]
Dhanya Ho Īshwarāmbā Mere Sāīṃ Ko Tumane Janmā
Teīs Navambar Ko Bābā Sāīṃ Bhajan Aur Gān Kareṅge
Haippī Barthaḍe Ṭū Yū Sāīṃ Rām Haippī Barthaḍe Ṭū Yū Sāīṃ Bābā

title: Terey Siva Prabhu Koi Nahin Hai
lyrics:
Terey Siwa Prabhu Koi Nahin Hai Tujko Mera Pranam  
Tujko Mera Pranam O Sai Baba Tujko Mera Pranam
Murali Manohara Asha Na Todo
Dukh Bhanjana Mera Saath Na Chodo
Dwar Khada Hoon Mein Dukhiyara
Sun Ley Meri Pukar O Sai Baba Sun Ley Meri Pukar
meaning: O Lord Sai, You are my sole refuge, and I offer my humble respects. Beloved Krishna, the enchanting flutist, do not let my hopes fade, nor abandon me, the sorrow-stricken soul at your threshold. I implore you, Sai Baba, to heed my desperate call.
devanagari:
तेरे सिवा प्रभु कोई नहीं है तुझको मेरा प्रणाम
तुझको मेरा प्रणाम ओ साई बाबा तुझको मेरा प्रणाम
मुरली मनोहर आशा न तोड़ो
दुख भंजन मेरा साथ न छोड़ो
द्वार खड़ा हूँ मैं दुखियारा
सुन ले मेरी पुकार ओ साई बाबा सुन ले मेरी पुकार
respell:
Tere Sivā Prabhu Koī Nahīṃ Hai Tujhako Merā Praṇām
Tujhako Merā Praṇām O Sāī Bābā Tujhako Merā Praṇām
Muralī Manohar Āshā N Toḍa़o
Dukh Bhañjana Merā Sāth N Chhoḍa़o
Dwār Khaḍa़ā Hūm̐ Maiṃ Dukhiyārā
Sun Le Merī Pukār O Sāī Bābā Sun Le Merī Pukār

title: The Name Of God Is Flowing Within Me
lyrics:
The Name Of God Is Flowing Within Me
I Hear It Always Singing Within Me
Allah, Allah Shivaya Sathya Sai Baba
Rama Rama Jehovah Buddha Lord Jesus
The Name Of God Is Flowing Within Me
I Hear It Always Singing Within Me
devanagari:
द नेम अव गाड इज फ्लोइङ विदिन मी
आइ हीर इट ओल्वेज सिङिङ विदिन मी
अल्लाह अल्लाह शिवाय सत्य साई बाबा
राम राम जहोव बुद्ध लोर्ड जीजस
द नेम अव गाड इज फ्लोइङ विदिन मी
आइ हीर इट ओल्वेज सिङिङ विदिन मी

title: Triloka Palini Jagadeeshwari
lyrics:
Triloka Palini Jagadeeshwari
Sadananda Roopini Sayeeshwari
Karunya Lavanya Kadambari
Partheeshwari Amba Shiva Shankari
Puttapartheeshwari Amba Shiva Shankar
meaning: Oh Mother Sayeeshwari, you are the protector of three worlds, one who is always blissful, compassionate and beautiful, the mother of PArthi, the consort of Shiva, our salutations to you.
devanagari:
त्रिलोक पालिनी जगदीश्वरी
सदानंद रूपिणी साईेश्वरी [ त्रिलोक पालिनी ... ]
करुण्य लावण्य कादम्बरी
पर्तीश्वरि अम्बा शिव शंकरी
respell:
Trilok Pālinī Jagadīshwarī
Sadānanda Rūpiṇī Sāīeshwarī [ Trilok Pālinī ... ]
Karuṇya Lāvaṇya Kādambarī
Partīshwari Ambā Shiv Shaṅkarī

title: Tripura Sundari Ma Amba Daya Sagari Ma
lyrics:
Tripura Sundari Ma Amba Daya Sagari Ma
Sundara Vadani Ma Amba Suguna Manohari Ma
Jaya Jagat Janani Ma Amba Jagadoddharini Ma
Parthi Nivasini Ma Amba Papa Vimochani Ma
meaning: Oh mother of Parthi you are the most beautiful in all the three worlds, you are the ocean of compassion, full of virtues you are the mother who liberates the world and frees us from our sins.
devanagari:
त्रिपुर सुन्दरी मा अम्बा दया सागरी माँ
सुन्दर वदनी मा अम्बा सुगुण मनोहरी माँ
जय जगत जननी मा अम्बा जगतोद्धारिणी माँ
पर्ती निवासिनी मा अम्बा पाप विमोचनी माँ
respell:
Tripura Sundarī Mā Ambā Dayā Sāgarī Mām̐
Sundara Vadanī Mā Ambā Suguṇ Manoharī Mām̐
Jaya Jagat Jananī Mā Ambā Jagatoddhāriṇī Mām̐
Partī Nivāsinī Mā Ambā Pāpa Vimochanī Mām̐

title: Tripurari Shiva Shankara
lyrics:
Tripurari Shiva Shankara
Nandi Vahana Naga Bharana
Omkareshwara Namah Shivaya
Mahakaleshwara Namah Shivaya
meaning: Oh Lord Shiva, the slayer of demon Tripura, the one who wears the serpent as an ornament, the personification of the primordial sound “OM”, the Lord Mahakala, I offer my salutations to you.
devanagari:
त्रिपुरारी शिव शंकरा
नंदी वाहना नागा भरणा
ओंकारेश्वर नमः शिवाया
महाकालेश्वर नमः शिवाया
respell:
Tripurārī Shiv Shaṅkarā
Nandī Vāhanā Nāgā Bharaṇā
Oṅkāreshwar Namaḥ Shivāyā
Mahākāleshwar Namaḥ Shivāyā

title: Tum Bin Pran Nahi O Sai Mere
lyrics:
Tum Bin Pran Nahi O Sai Mere
Sab Bhakton Ka Tum Ho Sahara
Rahim Kaho Raghu Ram Kaho
Nanak Yeshu Mahavir Sri Shankara Prema Avatara Sai Ram
Tum Ho Mere Pran O Sai Mere
Tum Ho Sai Bhagawan
meaning: O Sai, You are the very breath of my being and the ultimate support for all devotees. You are revered in every name—be it Rahim, Rama, Nanak, Jesus, Mahavira, or Shiva—the divine incarnation of love, my life, and my God.
devanagari:
तुम बिन प्राण नहीं ओ साई मेरे
सब भक्तों का तुम हो सहारा
रहीम कहो रघु राम कहो [तुम बिन ...]
नानक येसु महावीर शिव शंकर प्रेमावतारा साई राम
तुम हो मेरे प्राण ओ साई मेरे
तुम हो साई भगवान
respell:
Tum Bin Prāṇ Nahīṃ O Sāī Mere
Sab Bhaktoṃ Kā Tum Ho Sahārā
Rahīm Kaho Raghu Rām Kaho [tum Bin ...]
Nānak Yesu Mahāvīr Shiv Shaṅkar Premāvatārā Sāī Rām
Tum Ho Mere Prāṇ O Sāī Mere
Tum Ho Sāī Bhagavān

title: Tum Ho Anath Nath Bhagawan
lyrics:
Tum Ho Anath Nath Bhagawan
O Sai Mere Prana Sakha Bhagawan
Mata Pita Guru Bandhu Tum Ho
Bhakta Sakha Bhagawan
Deena Sakha Bhagawan
Bhagawan Bhagawan
Prana Sakha Bhagawan Sai Mere
O Sai Mere Prana Sakha Bhagawan
meaning: Oh Sai Bhagawan, You are the refuge for the unprotected and my most cherished life-friend. You are our Mother, Father, Guru, and kin, always a compassionate companion to devotees and the humble.
devanagari:
तुम हो अनाथ नाथ भगवान
ओ साई मेरे प्राण सखा भगवान
मात पिता गुरु बंधु तुम हो
भक्त (दीन) सखा भगवान
भगवान भगवान (२)
प्राण सखा भगवान (ॐ साई मेरे)
respell:
Tum Ho Anātha Nāth Bhagavān
O Sāī Mere Prāṇ Sakhā Bhagavān
Māta Pitā Guru Bandhu Tum Ho
Bhakta (dīna) Sakhā Bhagavān
Bhagavān Bhagavān (2)
Prāṇ Sakhā Bhagavān (oṃ Sāī Mere)

title: Tum Ho Data Sai Shankara
lyrics:
Tum Ho Data Sai Shankara
Hum Ko Deejo Ananda Baba
Aao Shankara Anathanatha
Deejo Darshan Deenanatha
meaning: O Sai, divine giver who is Shiva incarnate, please bestow upon us true bliss. We implore you, Lord of the helpless and downtrodden, to grant us your sacred vision.
devanagari:
तुम हो दाता साई शंकर
हम को दीजो आनंद बाबा [ तुम हो दाता ... ]
आओ शंकर अनाथ नाथा
दीजो दर्शन दीना नाथा
respell:
Tum Ho Dātā Sāī Shaṅkar
Ham Ko Dījo Ānanda Bābā [ Tum Ho Dātā ... ]
Āo Shaṅkar Anātha Nāthā
Dījo Darshan Dīnā Nāthā

title: Tum Ho Ram Tum Ho Shyam
lyrics:
Tum Ho Ram Tum Ho Shyam
Bhakton Ke Pran Bhagawan Sai Ram
Sita Ram Radhe Shyam
Ek Prabhu Bhagawan Sai Ram
Bhakton Ke Pran Bhagawan Sai Ram
meaning: You are the forms of Lord Rama and Krisha. You are the very life of your devotees. You are Ram , Lord of Sita and Shyam  the one dear to Radha. You are the one we adore Oh Dear Bhagawan Sai Ram.
devanagari:
तुम हो राम तुम हो श्याम
भक्तों के प्राण भगवान साई राम
सीता राम राधे श्याम
एक प्रभु भगवान साई राम [ भक्तों के ... ]
respell:
Tum Ho Rām Tum Ho Shyām
Bhaktoṃ Ke Prāṇ Bhagavān Sāī Rām
Sītā Rām Rādhe Shyām
Ek Prabhu Bhagavān Sāī Rām [ Bhaktoṃ Ke ... ]

title: Tum Ho Shyam Ram Rahim
lyrics:
Tum Ho Shyam Ram Rahim
Ram Rahim Shyam Rahim
Baba Tum Ho Shyam Ram Rahim
Allah Yeshu Buddha Mahavir
Nanak Sai Zoroastra Bhi Ho
Sarva Dharma Priya Sai Narayana
Sarva Dharma Priya Sai Shankara
meaning: You are the Lord of every religion, Oh Sai. Devotees adore you as Ram, Rahim, Allah, Allah, Buddha, Mahaveera, Nanak and Zohrashtra, Narayana and Shankara.
devanagari:
तुम हो श्याम राम रहीम (बाबा)
राम रहीम श्याम रहीम [ तुम हो ... ]
अल्लाह येसु बुद्ध महावीर
नानक साई जोहराष्ट्र भी हो
सर्व धर्म प्रिय साई नारायण (शंकर)
respell:
Tum Ho Shyām Rām Rahīm (bābā)
Rām Rahīm Shyām Rahīm [ Tum Ho ... ]
Allāh Yesu Buddha Mahāvīr
Nānak Sāī Joharāshṭra Bhī Ho
Sarwa Dharma Priy Sāī Nārāyaṇ (shaṅkar)

title: Tum Ho Vighna Vinasha Ganesha
lyrics:
Tum Ho Vighna Vinasha Ganesha (3)
Parvati Nandana Pahi Gajanana
Pranava Swaroopa Parthi Pureesha
Pahi Ganesha Vighna Vinasha
meaning: Protect me Oh Lord Ganesha, the destroyer of all obstacles, the son of Parvati, the embodiment of primordial sound “OM” and the Lord of Parthi.
devanagari:
तुम हो विघ्न विनाशा गणेशा (3)
पार्वती नंदन पाहि गजानन
प्रणव स्वरूप पर्ति पूरीशा
पाहि गणेशा विघ्न विनाशा
respell:
Tum Ho Vighna Vināshā Gaṇeshā (3)
Pārwatī Nandana Pāhi Gajānana
Praṇava Swarūp Parti Pūrīshā
Pāhi Gaṇeshā Vighna Vināshā

title: Va Va Murugaiyya Vadivel Azhaga
lyrics:
Va Va Murugaiyya Vadivel Azhaga
Ka Va Va Kumara Thiru Karthikeya [ Va Va ... ]
Singara Vela Shiva Shakthi Bala
Sangeeta Lola Sathya Sayeesha
Va Va Muruga Vadivel Azhaga (6)
meaning: Oh beautiful Lord Muruga, wielder of the divine spear, we earnestly call for your presence. Come, Kumara, sacred Karthikeya, charming son of Shiva and Shakti, who delights in music, Lord Sathya Sai.

title: Vahe Guru Vahe Guru Vahe Guru Ji Bolo
lyrics:
Vahe Guru Vahe Guru Vahe Guru Ji Bolo
Sathya Nam Sathya Nam Sathya Nam Ji Bolo
Nitya Nitya Japiye Tere Nam Ji Bolo
Sathya Nam Sathya Nam Sathya Nam Ji Bolo
Ram Ram Ram Ram Ram Ram Ji Bolo
Rama Rama Rama Rama Rama Rama Ji Bolo
Nitya Nitya Japiye Ram Nam Ji Bolo
Krishna Krishna Krishna Krishna Krishna Krishna Ji Bolo
Nitya Nitya Japiye Krishna Nam Ji Bolo
--
Govinda Jai Jai Gopala Jai Jai
Radha Ramana Hari Govinda Jai Jai
meaning: chant the names of the Divine Preceptor Vahey Guru, Lords Rama, Krishna, Shiva, Dattatreya and Govinda who is the beloved of Radha. Victory to Lord Govinda  and Gopala (names of Lord Krishna).
devanagari:
वाहे गुरु वाहे गुरु वाहे गुरु जी बोलो  
सत्य नाम सत्य नाम सत्य नाम जी बोलो  
नित्य नित्य जापिये तेरे नाम जी बोलो [ सत्य नाम ... ]  
राम राम राम राम राम राम जी बोलो  
नित्य नित्य जापिये राम नाम जी बोलो  
कृष्ण कृष्ण कृष्ण कृष्ण कृष्ण कृष्ण जी बोलो  
नित्य नित्य जापिये कृष्ण नाम जी बोलो  
गोविन्द जय जय गोपाल जय जय  
राधा रमण हरि गोविन्दा जय जय  
गोविन्द जय जय गोपाल जय जय  
राधा रमण हरि गोविन्द जय जय
respell:
Vāhe Guru Vāhe Guru Vāhe Guru Jī Bolo
Satya Nām Satya Nām Satya Nām Jī Bolo
Nitya Nitya Jāpiye Tere Nām Jī Bolo [ Satya Nām ... ]
Rām Rām Rām Rām Rām Rām Jī Bolo
Nitya Nitya Jāpiye Rām Nām Jī Bolo
Kṛushṇa Kṛushṇa Kṛushṇa Kṛushṇa Kṛushṇa Kṛushṇa Jī Bolo
Nitya Nitya Jāpiye Kṛushṇa Nām Jī Bolo
Govinda Jay Jay Gopāla Jay Jay
Rādhā Ramaṇa Hari Govindā Jay Jay
Govinda Jay Jay Gopāla Jay Jay
Rādhā Ramaṇa Hari Govinda Jay Jay

title: Vaikunthapate Sai Hare
lyrics:
Vaikunthapate Sai Hare
Vaijayanti Mala Dhari
Hari Govinda Hari Gopala
Vara Godavari Teera Vihari
Vara Chitravati Teera Vihari
meaning: Glory to Lord Sai who is verily Lord Narayana of Vaikunta, who wears the Vaijayanti garland (a necklace worn by Lord Narayana as a sign of victory). He is Lord Hari and Govinda who resides on the banks of river Godavari and on the banks of the river Chithravathi as Lord Sai.
devanagari:
वैकुण्ठपते साई हरे
वैजयंती माला धारी
हरी गोविंदा हरी गोपाला
वर गोदावरी तीर विहारी
वर चित्रावती तीर विहारी
respell:
Vaikuṇṭhapate Sāī Hare
Vaijayantī Mālā Dhārī
Harī Govindā Harī Gopālā
Var Godāvarī Tīra Vihārī
Var Chitrāvatī Tīra Vihārī

title: Vaishnavi Ma Varahi Ma
lyrics:
Vaishnavi Ma Varahi Ma
Vishweshwari Ma Vani Ma [ Vaishnavi Ma ... ]
Shakthi Swaroopini Sai Ma
(Pra)Shanthi Pradayini Santoshi Ma
meaning: Oh Divine Mother, in your sacred forms as Vaishnavi and Varahi, you are the sovereign of the universe and the fount of all wisdom. You are Sai, the very embodiment of cosmic power, and Santoshi, the generous bestower of profound peace upon all.
devanagari:
वैष्णवी माँ वाराही माँ
विश्वेश्वरी माँ वाणी माँ [ वैष्णवी माँ ... ]
शक्ति स्वरूपिणी साई माँ
(प्र)शांति प्रदायिनी संतोषी माँ
respell:
Vaishṇavī Mām̐ Vārāhī Mām̐
Vishweshwarī Mām̐ Vāṇī Mām̐ [ Vaishṇavī Mām̐ ... ]
Shakti Swarūpiṇī Sāī Mām̐
(pra)shānti Pradāyinī Santoshī Mām̐

title: Vanamali Radha Ramana Giridhari Govinda
lyrics:
Vanamali Radha Ramana Giridhari Govinda
Neela Megha Sundara Narayana Govinda
Bhakta Hrudaya Mandara Bhanu Koti Sundara
Nanda Nanda Gopa Brinda Narayana Govinda
--
Narayana Govinda (6)
Narayana Narayana Narayana Govinda
Narayana Govinda (2)
Hari Hari Hari Narayana Govinda
meaning: Chant the name of Lord Govinda (Krishna) who wears a garland of forest flowers, who lifted the Govardhana hill and the beloved of Radha. He is beautiful with dark-blue complexion and is none other than Lord Narayana. He is like the Mandara flower in the hearts of His devotees, effulgent like a million Suns, the son of Nanda and one among the cowherds of Brindavan.
devanagari:
वनमाली राधा रमणा गिरिधारी गोविन्दा
नील मेघ सुन्दरा नारायण गोविन्दा [ वनमाली राधा ... ]
भक्त हृदय मन्दारा भानु कोटि सुन्दरा
नंद नंद गोपा वृन्द नारायण गोविन्दा
नारायण गोविन्दा (6)
नारायण नारायण नारायण गोविन्दा
नारायण गोविन्दा (3)
respell:
Vanamālī Rādhā Ramaṇā Giridhārī Govindā
Nīla Megha Sundarā Nārāyaṇ Govindā [ Vanamālī Rādhā ... ]
Bhakta Hṛudaya Mandārā Bhānu Koṭi Sundarā
Nanda Nanda Gopā Vṛunda Nārāyaṇ Govindā
Nārāyaṇ Govindā (6)
Nārāyaṇ Nārāyaṇ Nārāyaṇ Govindā
Nārāyaṇ Govindā (2)

title: Vanamali Vasudeva Jagan Mohana Radha Ramana
lyrics:
Vanamali Vasudeva Jagan Mohana Radha Ramana
Jagan Mohana Radha Ramana
Shashi Vadana Sarasija Nayana Jagan Mohana Radha Ramana
Radha Ramana Radha Ramana
Hari Hari Radha Ramana Radha Ramana
meaning: Oh Lord Krishna, adorning the garland made of forest flowers, You attract all minds and the whole world. Your charming bright face which is like a shining moon and Your lotus eyes are admired by Radha.
devanagari:
वनमाली वासुदेवा जगन्मोहन राधा रमणा
जगन्मोहन राधा रमण (2)
शशि वदना सरसिज नयन जगन्मोहन राधा रमणा (3)
राधा रमणा राधा रमणा (4)
respell:
Vanamālī Vāsudevā Jaganmohan Rādhā Ramaṇā
Jaganmohan Rādhā Ramaṇa (2)
Shashi Vadanā Sarasij Nayan Jaganmohan Rādhā Ramaṇā (3)
Rādhā Ramaṇā Rādhā Ramaṇā (4)

title: Vande Uma Nandanam Gajananam
lyrics:
Vande Uma Nandanam Gajananam
Sura Muni Sevita Sumukha Gajananam
Vidya Dayaka Buddhi Pradayaka
Siddhi Vinayaka Pahi Gajananam
meaning: Salutations to Lord Gajanana, the son of Uma and the one who is worshipped by sages, who is the giver of knowledge, intellect and boons.
devanagari:
वन्दे उमा नन्दनम् गजाननम्  
सुरमुनि सेविता सुमुख गजाननम् [ वन्दे उमा ... ]  
विद्या दायक बुद्धि प्रदायक  
सिद्धि विनायक पाहि गजाननम्
respell:
Vande Umā Nandanam Gajānanam
Suramuni Sevitā Sumukha Gajānanam [ Vande Umā ... ]
Vidyā Dāyak Buddhi Pradāyak
Siddhi Vināyak Pāhi Gajānanam

title: Varuvai Varuvai Varuvai Amma
lyrics:
Varuvai Varuvai Varuvai Amma
Thiruve Uruvai Varuvai Amma
Irulai Neekkida Varuvai Amma
Undan Arulai Pozhindhidu Sai Amma [ Varuvai Varuvai ... ]
Kalyani Karumari Kamakshi Niye
Mahalakshmi Matangi Meenakshi Niye
Varalakshmi Varahi Visalakshi Niye
Ulagalum Maye Prashanthi Thaye
Amma Amma Amma Amma

title: Vayu Kumara Vanara Veera
lyrics:
Vayu Kumara Vanara Veera
Ati Balavanta Hanumanta
Kesari Nandana Anjani Putra
Jaya Ho Jaya Ho Pavana Kumara
meaning: Victory to Hanuman who is the son of the God of wind. You are endowed with supreme valour and are the son of  King Kesari and Mother Anjana Devi.
devanagari:
वायु कुमारा वानर वीरा
अति बलवन्ता हनुमन्ता
केसरी नन्दन अञ्जनी पुत्त्रा
जय हो जय हो पवन कुमारा
respell:
Vāyu Kumārā Vānara Vīrā
Ati Balavantā Hanumantā
Kesarī Nandana Añjanī Puttrā
Jaya Ho Jaya Ho Pavan Kumārā

title: Veera Dheera Shoora Hanuman Ki Jai
lyrics:
Veera Dheera Shoora Hanuman Ki Jai
Pavana Putra Anjaneya Hanuman Ki Jai
Sada Rama Nam Japat Hanuman Ki Jai
Rama Rama Rama Rama Rama Rama Rama Ram
Sita Shoka Nasha Karan Hanuman Ki Jai
meaning: I bow down to  Hanuman the courageous. He is the son of the god of wind, he is the one that constantly repeats the name of Lord Rama. He is the remover of Mother Sita’s worries.
devanagari:
वीर धीर शूर हनुमान की जय  
पवन पुत्र आंजनेय हनुमान की जय [ वीर धीर ... ]  
सदा राम नाम जपत हनुमान की जय  
राम राम राम राम राम राम राम राम [ सदा राम ... ]  
सीता शोक नाश कारण हनुमान की जय
respell:
Vīr Dhīra Shūr Hanumān Kī Jay
Pavan Putra Āñjaneya Hanumān Kī Jay [ Vīr Dhīra ... ]
Sadā Rām Nāma Japata Hanumān Kī Jay
Rām Rām Rām Rām Rām Rām Rām Rām [ Sadā Rām ... ]
Sītā Shok Nāsha Kāraṇ Hanumān Kī Jay

title: Veera Hanumana Ati Balawana Ram Naam Rasiyarey
lyrics:
Veera Hanumana Ati Balawana Ram Naam Rasiyarey
Hey Prabhu Mana (Ho Tapovana) Basiyarey [ Veera Hanumana ... ]
Sita Ram Jai Sita Ram Radhey Shyam Jai Radhey Shyam (2) [ Veera Hanumana ... ]
Raghupathi Raghava Raja Ram Patitha Pavana Sita Ram (2) [ Veera Hanumana ... ]
meaning: Oh valiant Hanuman, supremely strong, you are deeply devoted to the name of Rama, dwelling within our hearts as a sacred presence. We joyfully chant the names of Sita-Rama and Radha-Shyama, glorifying King Rama, the descendant of Raghu, who purifies and uplifts all fallen souls.
devanagari:
वीर हनुमाना अति बलवाना राम नाम रसियारे
हे प्रभु मन (हो तपोवन) बसियारे
सीता राम जय सीता राम राधे श्याम जय राधे श्याम
रघुपति राघव राजा राम पतित पावन सीता राम
respell:
Vīr Hanumānā Ati Balavānā Rām Nām Rasiyāre
He Prabhu Mana (ho Tapovan) Basiyāre
Sītā Rām Jay Sītā Rām Rādhe Shyām Jay Rādhe Shyām
Raghupati Rāghav Rājā Rām Patita Pāvan Sītā Rām

title: Veera Maruti Gambheera Maruti
lyrics:
Veera Maruti Gambheera Maruti
Dheera Maruti Ati Dheera Maruti
Geeta Maruti Sangeeta Maruti
Doota Maruti Rama Doota Maruti
Bhakta Maruti Parama Bhakta Maruti
meaning:
Maruti, the son of Wind God, he who has supreme valor, courage and is highly talented in Music. 
He is the messenger and devotee of the highest order of Lord Rama.
devanagari:
वीर मारुति गंभीर मारुति
धीर मारुति अति धीर मारुति [वीर मारुति]
गीत मारुति संगीत मारुति
दूत मारुति राम दूत मारुति
भक्त मारुति परम भक्त मारुति
respell:
Vīr Māruti Gambhīra Māruti
Dhīra Māruti Ati Dhīra Māruti [vīr Māruti]
Gīt Māruti Saṅgīt Māruti
Dūta Māruti Rām Dūta Māruti
Bhakta Māruti Param Bhakta Māruti

title: Vibhuti Sundara Sai Nath
lyrics:
Vibhuti Sundara Sai Nath
Sai Nath Sai Nath Sathya Sai Nath
Gangadhara Hara Samba Sadashiva
Sai Nath Sathya Sai Nath
Sai Nath Sai Nath Sathya Sai Nath
meaning: Chant the name of Lord Sathya Sai who is none other than Lord Shiva who is covered with sacred ash  and whose head is adorned with pious river Ganga.
devanagari:
विभूति सुन्दर साई नाथ
साई नाथ साई नाथ सत्य साई नाथ
गंगाधर हर साम्ब सदाशिव
साई नाथ सत्य साई नाथ
साई नाथ साई नाथ सत्य साई नाथ
respell:
Vibhūti Sundara Sāī Nāth
Sāī Nāth Sāī Nāth Satya Sāī Nāth
Gaṅgādhara Har Sāmba Sadāshiv
Sāī Nāth Satya Sāī Nāth
Sāī Nāth Sāī Nāth Satya Sāī Nāth

title: Vidya Dayini Bhagawati
lyrics:
Vidya Dayini Bhagawati
Namo Namo Namo Sai Narayani
Chinmaya Roopini Nada Swaroopini
Namo Namo Namo Sai Narayani
meaning: We bow to the Divine Mother, the bestower of all knowledge. Our repeated salutations to Sai Narayani, who embodies pure consciousness and the very essence of cosmic sound.
devanagari:
विद्या दायिनी भगवती
नमो नमो नमो साई नारायणी [ विद्या दायिनी ... ]
चिन्मय रूपिणी नाद स्वरूपिणी [ नमो नमो ... ]
respell:
Vidyā Dāyinī Bhagavatī
Namo Namo Namo Sāī Nārāyaṇī [ Vidyā Dāyinī ... ]
Chinmaya Rūpiṇī Nāda Swarūpiṇī [ Namo Namo ... ]

title: Vighna Vinashaka Devadi Deva
lyrics:
Vighna Vinashaka Devadi Deva
Adi Sanathana Deva
Prathama Poojya Gananatha
Bhava Bhaya Bhanjana Nitya Niranjana
Siddhi Vinayaka Deva
Mangala Dayaka Shambho Manohara
Prathama Poojya Gananatha
meaning: You are always offered the first prayers in any worship Oh Lord of Ganas (the attendees of Lord Shiva), Oh Lord of Lords, eternal, ancient and destroyer of obstacles. You destroy the fear of birth and death, you are the Lord of powers acquired through austerities, the blemishless, who bestows auspiciouness and dear son of Lord Shiva.
devanagari:
विघ्न विनाशक देवादि देवा
आदि सनातन देवा
प्रथम पूज्य गणनाथा
भव भय भंजन नित्य निरंजन
सिद्धि विनायक देवा
मंगल दायक शम्भो मनोहर [ प्रथम पूज्य ... ]
respell:
Vighna Vināshak Devādi Devā
Ādi Sanātana Devā
Prathama Pūjya Gaṇanāthā
Bhava Bhaya Bhañjana Nitya Nirañjana
Siddhi Vināyak Devā
Maṅgal Dāyak Shambho Manohar [ Prathama Pūjya ... ]

title: Vighna Vinashaka Gananatha
lyrics:
Vighna Vinashaka Gananatha
Gajanana He Gajavadana
Gananatha Gananatha
Pranava Swaroopa Gananatha
Parthipureeshwara Gananatha
meaning: The elephant faced Lord Ganesha is the leader of Ganas (the attendees of Lord Shiva), destroyer of all obstacles. He is the embodiment of primordial sound "OM" and resides in Parthi.
devanagari:
विघ्न विनाशक गणनाथा
गजानन हे गजवदना
गणनाथा गणनाथा
प्रणव स्वरूप गणनाथा
पर्ती पूरीश्वर गणनाथा [ गजानन हे ... ]
respell:
Vighna Vināshak Gaṇanāthā
Gajānana He Gajavadanā
Gaṇanāthā Gaṇanāthā
Praṇava Swarūp Gaṇanāthā
Partī Pūrīshwar Gaṇanāthā [ Gajānana He ... ]

title: Vighneshwara Gananatha Gajanana
lyrics:
Vighneshwara Gananatha Gajanana
Parvati Nandana Shubhanana
Mangala Moorthi Sri Gananatha
Jaya Gananatha Sri Gananatha (2)
Ashta Vinayaka Shubhanana
Siddhi Vinayaka Shubhanana
meaning: Victory to Lord Vighneshwara (Lord Ganesha) the son of Parvati, having a pleasant and auspicious face, who bestows eight types of blessings, He is also known as Sidhhi Vinayaka (one who fulfills your prayers).
devanagari:
विघ्नेश्वरा गणनाथ गजानन
पार्वती नंदन शुभानना
मंगल मूर्ति श्री गणराया
जय गणराया श्री गणराया (2)  
अष्ट (सिद्धि) विनायक शुभानना
respell:
Vighneshwarā Gaṇanātha Gajānana
Pārwatī Nandana Shubhānanā
Maṅgal Mūrti Shrī Gaṇarāyā
Jaya Gaṇarāyā Shrī Gaṇarāyā (2)
Ashṭa (siddhi) Vināyak Shubhānanā

title: Vighneshwara Maha Devadi Deva
lyrics:
Vighneshwara Maha Devadi Deva
Vighna Vinashaka Deva
Pranavakara Jyoti Swaroopa
Jaya Mangalakara Deva
meaning: You are offered the first prayers in any worship Oh Lord of Ganas (the attendees of Lord Shiva), oh Lord of Lords, eternal, ancient and destroyer of obstacles. You annihilate the fear of birth and death, Lord of powers acquired through austerities, who bestows auspiciousness and dear son of Lord Shiva.
devanagari:
विघ्नेश्वर महा देवादि देवा
विघ्न विनाशक देवा
प्रणवाकारा ज्योति स्वरूपा
जय मंगलकर देवा
respell:
Vighneshwar Mahā Devādi Devā
Vighna Vināshak Devā
Praṇavākārā Jyoti Swarūpā
Jaya Maṅgalakar Devā

title: Vighneshwara Vinayaka
lyrics:
Vighneshwara Vinayaka
Vishwadhara Namostute
Namostute Namostute
Suramuni Vandita Vinayaka
Sharanam Sharanam Vinayaka
meaning: Salutations and surrender to Lord Vighneshwara (Lord Ganesha) who sustains the Universe, who is worshipped by Holy and Pious sages and who destroys the fear of this world.
devanagari:
विघ्नेश्वरा विनायका
विश्वाधारा नमोस्तुते
नमोस्तुते नमोस्तुते [ विश्वाधारा ... ]
सुरमुनि वन्दित विनायका
भव भय नाशा विनायका
शरणम् शरणम् विनायका (2)
respell:
Vighneshwarā Vināyakā
Vishwādhārā Namostute
Namostute Namostute [ Vishwādhārā ... ]
Suramuni Vandita Vināyakā
Bhava Bhaya Nāshā Vināyakā
Sharaṇam Sharaṇam Vināyakā (2)

title: Vighneshwaram Bhajore Manasa Vighnaharam Bhajore
lyrics:
Vighneshwaram Bhajore Manasa Vighnaharam Bhajore
Bhajore Vighneshwaram Bhajore
Manasa Vighnaharam Bhajore
meaning: Oh Mind! Sing the praises of  Lord Vighneshwara(Lord Ganesha) who removes all obstacles and destroys them.
devanagari:
विघ्नेश्वरम् भजोरे मानसा विघ्न हरम् भजोरे (2)
(भजोरे) विघ्नेश्वरम् भजोरे मानसा विघ्न हरम् भजोरे
respell:
Vighneshwaram Bhajore Mānasā Vighna Haram Bhajore (2)
(bhajore) Vighneshwaram Bhajore Mānasā Vighna Haram Bhajore

title: Vinati Suno Mere Sai Bhagawan
lyrics:
Vinati Suno Mere Sai Bhagawan
Daya Karo Mere Sai Bhagawan
Bhakta Janon Ke Tuma Ho Pran
Deena Dayala Karuna Nidhan
Tribhuvana Pala Sadhu Paritra
meaning: Listen to my pleadings Oh my Lord Sai, have compassio on me, you are the very life of your devotees, you are the treasure house of compassion showing mercy on the downtrodden, you are the one who sustains the three worlds and the protector of saints.
devanagari:
विनती सुनो मेरे साई भगवान
दया करो मेरे साई भगवान
भक्त जनों के तुम हो प्राण
दीन दयाला करुणा निधान
त्रिभुवन पाला साधु परित्रा
respell:
Vinatī Suno Mere Sāī Bhagavān
Dayā Karo Mere Sāī Bhagavān
Bhakta Janoṃ Ke Tum Ho Prāṇ
Dīna Dayālā Karuṇā Nidhān
Tribhuvan Pālā Sādhu Paritrā

title: Vinayaka Vinayaka
lyrics:
Vinayaka Vinayaka
Vighna Vinashaka Vinayaka
Gauri Nandana He Shiva Nandana
Parvati Nandana Gajanana
Mooshika Vahana Gajanana
Modaka Hasta Gajanana
meaning: Salutations to Lord Vinayaka(Lord Ganesha), the destroyer of obstacles, the elephant faced son of Parvati and Shiva, the one who rides on the Mouse and who has Modaka (a type of sweet) in his hand.
devanagari:
विनायका विनायका
विघ्न विनाशक विनायका
गौरी नंदन हे शिव नंदन
पार्वती नंदन गजानना
मूषिक वाहन गजानना
मोदक हस्ता गजानना
respell:
Vināyakā Vināyakā
Vighna Vināshak Vināyakā
Gaurī Nandana He Shiv Nandana
Pārwatī Nandana Gajānanā
Mūshik Vāhan Gajānanā
Modaka Hastā Gajānanā

title: Vinayaka Vinayaka
lyrics:
Vinayaka Vinayaka
Vishwadhara Vinayaka
Siddhi Vinayaka Bhava Bhaya Nasha
Suramuni Vandita Sri Ganesha
meaning: Salutations to Lord Vinayaka(Lord Ganesha) who grants sustenance to the Universe, who fulfills the wishes of everyone, the one who destroys fear and the one who is worhshipped by sages and demi gods.
devanagari:
विनायका विनायका
विश्वाधारा विनायका (हे)
[ विनायका विनायका ... ]
सिद्धि विनायक भव भय नाशा
सुरमुनि वंदिता श्री गणेशा
[ विश्वाधारा विनायका ... ]
respell:
Vināyakā Vināyakā
Vishwādhārā Vināyakā (he)
[ Vināyakā Vināyakā ... ]
Siddhi Vināyak Bhava Bhaya Nāshā
Suramuni Vanditā Shrī Gaṇeshā
[ Vishwādhārā Vināyakā ... ]

title: Vishnu Satchidananda Venu Gopala Bala
lyrics:
Vishnu Satchidananda Venu Gopala Bala
Krishna Rama Govinda Hari Hari
meaning: Chant the various names of Lord Vishnu, namely Rama, Govinda, Hari and the child Krishna holding the flute in HIS hand, who are all the embodiments of Being (Sath), Awareness(Chith) and Bliss(Ananda).
devanagari:
विष्णु सच्चिदानंद वेणु गोपाल बाल
कृष्णा रामा गोविंद हरी हरी
respell:
Vishṇu Sachchidānanda Veṇu Gopāla Bāla
Kṛushṇā Rāmā Govind Harī Harī

title: Vishwadhari Shiva Avatari
lyrics:
Vishwadhari Shiva Avatari
Sai Shankara Namo Namo [ Vishwadhari Shiva ... ]
Mathura Natha Narayana Hari
Sai Shankara Namo Namo (Sathya) (2)
meaning: We offer salutations to Sai Shankara, the sustainer of the universe and an incarnation of Lord Shiva. He is also the Lord of Mathura, Narayana Hari, embodying the divine essence of both deities.
devanagari:
विश्वाधारी शिव अवतारी
साई शंकर नमो नमो [ विश्वाधारी शिव ... ]
मथुरा नाथा नारायण हरि
साई शंकर नमो नमो (सत्य) (2)
respell:
Vishwādhārī Shiv Avatārī
Sāī Shaṅkar Namo Namo [ Vishwādhārī Shiv ... ]
Mathurā Nāthā Nārāyaṇ Hari
Sāī Shaṅkar Namo Namo (satya) (2)

title: Vitthala Bhajo Sai Vitthala Bhajo
lyrics:
Vitthala Bhajo Sai Vitthala Bhajo (2)
Pandhari Natha Panduranga Vitthala Bhajo
Parthi Vasa Sai Deva Vitthala Bhajo
meaning: Sing the glory of Lord Vittala, also known as Panduranga the Lord of Pandharpur and the Lord who resides in Parthi.
devanagari:
विट्ठल भजो साई विट्ठल भजो (2)  
पंढरी नाथा पांडुरंगा विट्ठल भजो  
पर्ति वासा साई देवा विट्ठल भजो
respell:
Viṭṭhala Bhajo Sāī Viṭṭhala Bhajo (2)
Paṇḍharī Nāthā Pāṇḍuraṅgā Viṭṭhala Bhajo
Parti Vāsā Sāī Devā Viṭṭhala Bhajo

title: Vitthala Hari Vitthala
lyrics:
Vitthala Hari Vitthala
Panduranga Vitthale Hari Narayana
Purandara Vitthale Hari Narayana
Hari Narayana Bhajo Narayana
Sai Narayana Sathya Narayana
meaning: Sing the glory of Hari Vittala, also known as Panduranga Vittala, Purandhara Vittala, Sai Narayana and Sathya Narayana.
devanagari:
विट्ठला हरि विट्ठला (3)  
पांडुरंग (पुरंदर) विट्ठल हरि नारायण  
हरि नारायण भजो नारायण  
साई नारायण सत्य नारायण
respell:
Viṭṭhalā Hari Viṭṭhalā (3)
Pāṇḍuraṅg (purandara) Viṭṭhal Hari Nārāyaṇ
Hari Nārāyaṇ Bhajo Nārāyaṇ
Sāī Nārāyaṇ Satya Nārāyaṇ

title: Vitthala Narayana
lyrics:
Vitthala Narayana
Narayana Sai Narayana
Madhusudana Narayana
He Sesha Shayana Narayana
Narayana Hari Narayana
Narayana Sai Narayana
--
Vitthala Vitthala Panduranga Vitthala
Vitthala Vitthala Parthi Ranga Vitthala
Vitthala Vitthala Sai Ranga Vitthala
meaning: Sing the glory of Lord Narayana reclining on Adishesha (the celestial snake). He is none other than Madhusudhana (Krishna).
devanagari:
विट्ठला नारायणा
नारायणा साई नारायणा [ विट्ठला ... ]
मधुसूदना नारायणा
हे शेष शयन नारायणा
नारायणा (हरि) साई नारायणा (2)
विट्ठल विट्ठल पांडुरंगा विट्ठल
विट्ठल विट्ठल साईरंगा विट्ठल
respell:
Viṭṭhalā Nārāyaṇā
Nārāyaṇā Sāī Nārāyaṇā [ Viṭṭhalā ... ]
Madhusūdanā Nārāyaṇā
He Shesh Shayan Nārāyaṇā
Nārāyaṇā (hari) Sāī Nārāyaṇā (2)
Viṭṭhala Viṭṭhala Pāṇḍuraṅgā Viṭṭhala
Viṭṭhala Viṭṭhala Sāīraṅgā Viṭṭhala

title: Vitthala Vitthala Hari Vitthala
lyrics:
Vitthala Vitthala Hari Vitthala
Vitthala Vitthala Nama Bhajo Hari Vitthala
Panduranga Vitthala Vitthala Vitthala Nam
Vitthala Vitthala Nama Bhajo Hari Vitthala
Vitthala Vitthala Hari Vitthala
Vitthala Vitthala Sai Vitthala
meaning: Chant the name of Vittala, Panduranga Vittala, Sai Vittala. Sing the glories of Lord Vittala at all times.
devanagari:
विट्ठल विट्ठल हरि विट्ठला
विट्ठल विट्ठल नाम भजो हरि विट्ठला
पांडुरंग विट्ठला विट्ठल विट्ठल नाम
विट्ठल विट्ठल नाम भजो हरि विट्ठला
विट्ठल विट्ठल हरि (साई) विट्ठला
respell:
Viṭṭhala Viṭṭhala Hari Viṭṭhalā
Viṭṭhala Viṭṭhala Nāma Bhajo Hari Viṭṭhalā
Pāṇḍuraṅg Viṭṭhalā Viṭṭhala Viṭṭhala Nām
Viṭṭhala Viṭṭhala Nāma Bhajo Hari Viṭṭhalā
Viṭṭhala Viṭṭhala Hari (sāī) Viṭṭhalā

title: Vitthoba Vitthala Panduranga
lyrics:
Vitthoba Vitthala Panduranga
Panduranga Hari Panduranga [Vitthoba Vitthala]
Narahari Ranga Ranga Panduranga
Purandara Ranga Panduranga
Panduranga Hari Panduranga
meaning: Sing the glory of Lord Panduranga, also known as Vittoba and Vittala, Narahari Ranga, Purandhara Ranga and several other names.
devanagari:
विठोबा विठ्ठला पांडुरंगा
पांडुरंगा हरि पांडुरंगा [विठोबा विठ्ठला]
नरहरि रंगा रंगा पांडुरंगा
पुरंदर रंगा पांडुरंगा
पांडुरंगा हरि पांडुरंगा
respell:
Viṭhobā Viṭhṭhalā Pāṇḍuraṅgā
Pāṇḍuraṅgā Hari Pāṇḍuraṅgā [viṭhobā Viṭhṭhalā]
Narahari Raṅgā Raṅgā Pāṇḍuraṅgā
Purandara Raṅgā Pāṇḍuraṅgā
Pāṇḍuraṅgā Hari Pāṇḍuraṅgā

title: We Are Blessed
lyrics:
We Are Blessed We Are Blessed We Are Blessed
Sai Baba Is Watching Over Us
We Are Here To Sing Your Sweet Name
Let The Light Of Your Glory Shine On Us
Bless Us All With Your Presence, Gurudev [ We Are Blessed ... ]
No More Tears No More Sorrow No More Death
Banish The Darkness With Your Love
We Are Born In The Golden Age Of Sai [ We Are Blessed ... ]
meaning: Oh Sai Baba, we are profoundly blessed by your constant watchfulness and divine presence. We gather to sing your sacred name, imploring your glorious light to shine upon us, dispelling all sorrow, tears, and the shadow of death with your boundless love, for we are born into your golden age.
devanagari:
वी आर ब्लेस्ट वी आर ब्लेस्ट वी आर ब्लेस्ट
साई बाबा इज वाचिङ ओवर अस
वी आर हीर टू सिङ योर स्वीट नेम
लेट द लाइट अव योर ग्लोरी शाइन आन अस
ब्लेस अस ओल विद योर प्रेजन्स गुरुदेव
नो मोर टेर्ज नो मोर सारो नो मोर डेथ
बैनिश द डार्क्नस विद योर लव
वी आर बोर्न इन द गोल्डन एज अव साई

title: Why Fear When I am Here
lyrics:
Why Fear When I Am Here?
So Says Baba, Sathya Sai Baba, Sathya Sai Baba, My Lord [ Why Fear ... ]
All I Want Is Your Love In God, No Matter What Your Faith
So Says Baba, Sathya Sai Baba, Sathya Sai Baba, My Lord [ Why Fear ... ]
All Of Them Brought The Message Of Love, Love Your Fellow Man
So Says Baba, Sathya Sai Baba, Sathya Sai Baba, My Lord [ Why Fear ... ]
Find The Light That Is In Your Heart And Reach The Praumised Land
So Says Baba, Sathya Sai Baba, Sathya Sai Baba, My Lord
devanagari:
वाइ फिर वेन आइ ऐम हीर
सो सेज बाबा सत्य साई बाबा सत्य साई बाबा माइ लोर्ड
ओल आइ वान्ट इज योर लव इन गाड नो मैटर वट योर फेथ
सो सेज बाबा सत्य साई बाबा सत्य साई बाबा माइ लोर्ड
ओल अव देम ब्रोट द मेसज अव लव लव योर फेलो मन
सो सेज बाबा सत्य साई बाबा सत्य साई बाबा माइ लोर्ड
फाइन्ड द लाइट दैट इज इन योर हार्ट अन्ड रीच द प्रामस्ट लैन्ड
सो सेज बाबा सत्य साई बाबा सत्य साई बाबा माइ लोर्ड

title: Yadu Nanda Ananda Nanda Gopala
lyrics:
Yadu Nanda Ananda Nanda Gopala
Radhey Radhey Govinda Radhey Gopala
Hari Anandamaya Sai Gopala (2)
Radha Lola Ananda Nanda Gopala [ Radhey Radhey ... ]
devanagari:
यदु नंदा आनंद नंद गोपाला
राधे राधे गोविन्द राधे गोपाला
हरि आनंदमय साई गोपाला (2)
राधा लोला आनंद नंद गोपाला [ राधे राधे ... ]
respell:
Yadu Nandā Ānanda Nanda Gopālā
Rādhe Rādhe Govinda Rādhe Gopālā
Hari Ānandamaya Sāī Gopālā (2)
Rādhā Lolā Ānanda Nanda Gopālā [ Rādhe Rādhe ... ]

title: Yadu Nandana Gopala
lyrics:
Yadu Nandana Gopala
Jaya Brindavana Lola
Jaya Murali Gana Vilola
Gopala Gopala Sai Gopala
meaning: Chant the name of Sai Gopala, the son of Yadu dynasty, who moved around in Brindavan and who enchants everyone by the sound of Flute HE plays.
devanagari:
यदु नंदन गोपाला
जय बृंदावन लोला
जय मुरली गान विलोला
गोपाला गोपाला साई गोपाला
respell:
Yadu Nandana Gopālā
Jaya Bṛundāvan Lolā
Jaya Muralī Gān Vilolā
Gopālā Gopālā Sāī Gopālā

title: Yug Yug Ke Avatar Tumhi Ho
lyrics:
Yug Yug Ke Avatar Tumhi Ho
Mere Ram Mere Shyam Shirdi Sai Parthi Ram
Jag Ke Palanhar Tumhi Ho
Allah Eshwar Tere Nam
Sabko Sanmati Do Bhagawan
Allah Eshwar Tere Nam Shirdi Sai Parthi Ram
Jag Ke Palanhar Tumhi Ho
meaning: Oh Lord, You are the eternal Avatar, appearing through every age as my Rama, my Krishna, Shirdi Sai, and Parthi Rama. You are the sustainer of the entire universe, known by the sacred names of Allah and Ishwar. We pray that You grant good wisdom to all, O Bhagawan.
devanagari:
युग युग के अवतार तुम ही हो
मेरे राम मेरे श्याम शिर्डी साई पर्ती राम
जग के पालन्हार तुम ही हो
अल्लाह ईश्वर तेरे नाम
सब को संमति दो भगवान
अल्लाह ईश्वर तेरे नाम शिर्डी साई पर्ती राम [ जग के ... ]
respell:
Yug Yug Ke Avatār Tum Hī ho
Mere Rām Mere Shyām Shirḍī Sāī Partī Rām
Jag Ke Pālanhār Tum Hī Ho
Allāh Īshwar Tere Nām
Sab Ko Sammati Do Bhagavān
Allāh Īshwar Tere Nām Shirḍī Sāī Partī Rām [ Jag Ke ... ]

title: Yuga Avatara Sai Rama
lyrics:
Yuga Avatara Sai Rama
Rama Rama Ram
Sai Rama Rama Ram
Rama Rama Ram Sitapathe Sri Ram
Parama Niranjana Prasanthi Rama
Sri Raghu Rama Sai Rama
Rama Rama Ram
Sai Rama Rama Ram
meaning: Oh Lord Sai Rama you are the incarnation of this KALI age, the consort of Sita, oh  Lord Rama of Prashanthi, you are eternally pure, you are the Lord Rama of the Raghu dynasty.
devanagari:
युग अवतारा साई राम
राम राम राम (साई)
राम राम राम सीता पते श्री राम (2) [ युग अवतार ... ]
परम निरंजन प्रशांति राम
श्री रघु रामा साई रामा
राम राम राम (साई)
respell:
Yug Avatārā Sāī Rām
Rām Rām Rām (sāī)
Rām Rām Rām Sītā Pate Shrī Rām (2) [ Yug Avatāra ... ]
Param Nirañjana Prashānti Rām
Shrī Raghu Rāmā Sāī Rāmā
Rām Rām Rām (sāī)
